summary: Processing of personal data without the data subject's consent is prohibited unless one of the listed exceptions in Art. 4(1)-(11) applies.
quote: يُحظر معالجة البيانات الشخصية دون موافقة صاحبها

summary: Processing must be fair, transparent and lawful; data collected for a specific purpose and not processed incompatibly with it; data adequate and limited to what is necessary; data accurate and updated; measures to erase or correct inaccurate data; data kept securely; data not kept after the purpose is exhausted except in anonymised form (Art. 5(1)-(7)).
quote: أن تكون المعالجة بطريقة عادلة وشفافة ومشروعة

summary: Where processing relies on consent, the controller must be able to prove the data subject's consent, and consent must be clear, simple, unambiguous and easily accessible, including a statement of the right to withdraw and an easy withdrawal procedure (Art. 6(1)(a)-(c)).
quote: أن تكون الموافقة معدة بطريقة واضحة وبسيطة وغير مبهمة وسهلة الوصول إليها
conditional_on: processing based on consent

summary: Take appropriate technical and organisational measures to apply the standards needed to protect and secure personal data, to keep it confidential and private, and to prevent breach, destruction, alteration or tampering, considering nature, scope and purposes of processing and the risks.
quote: اتخاذ الإجراءات والتدابير التقنية والتنظيمية الملائمة لتطبيق المعايير القياسية اللازمة لحماية وتأمين

summary: Apply appropriate measures both when determining and during processing, including data masking; for default settings, apply measures so that processing is limited to the specified purpose, covering volume and type of data, type of processing, storage period and accessibility (Art. 7(2)-(3)).
quote: تطبيق التدابير الملائمة سواء أثناء تحديد وسائل المعالجة أو أثناء المعالجة نفسها

summary: Keep a special record of personal data with prescribed contents (controller and DPO details, data categories, authorised persons, retention periods, purposes, cross-border movements, security measures) and provide it to the Office on request (Art. 7(4)).
quote: مسك سجل خاص للبيانات الشخصية، على أن يتضمن هذا السجل

summary: Appoint only a processor that provides sufficient guarantees for applying the technical and organisational measures so that processing meets the requirements of the decree-law and its executive regulation (Art. 7(5)).
quote: تعيين المعالج الذي يتوفر لديه ضمانات كافية لتطبيق التدابير التقنية والتنظيمية

summary: Provide the Office with any information it requests for its functions, upon a decision of the competent judicial authority (Art. 7(6)).
quote: تزويد المكتب، وبناءً على قرار من الجهة القضائية المختصة، بأي معلومات يطلبها
conditional_on: decision of the competent judicial authority

summary: Carry out processing and its execution in accordance with the controller's instructions and the contracts and agreements between them, which specify scope, subject, purpose, nature, data types and categories of data subjects (Art. 8(1)).
quote: إجراء المعالجة وتنفيذها وفقًا لتعليمات المتحكم، والعقود والاتفاقات المبرمة بينهما

summary: Apply appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data at the design stage, both when determining the means of processing and during processing, taking into account cost, nature, scope and purposes (Art. 8(2)); Art. 8(6) also requires securing processing media and devices.
quote: تطبيق الإجراءات والتدابير التقنية والتنظيمية الملائمة لحماية البيانات الشخصية في مرحلة التصميم

summary: Process only for the specified purpose and duration; if processing exceeds the duration, notify the controller to obtain an extension or instructions (Art. 8(3)); erase data after the processing period or deliver it to the controller (Art. 8(4)).
quote: إجراء المعالجة وفق الغرض والمدة المحددة لها

summary: Do not disclose personal data or processing results except where legally permitted (Art. 8(5)).
quote: عدم القيام بأي عمل من شأنه الإفصاح عن البيانات الشخصية أو نتائج المعالجة إلا في الأحوال المصرح

summary: Keep a special record of personal data processed on behalf of the controller, with prescribed contents, and provide it to the Office on request (Art. 8(7)); Art. 8(8) also requires means to demonstrate compliance on request of the controller or the Office.
quote: مسك سجل خاص للبيانات الشخصية التي تتم معالجتها نيابة عن المتحكم

summary: Once aware of a personal data breach that may affect privacy, confidentiality or security, notify the Office of the breach and the investigation results within the period and under the procedures set by the executive regulation, with the details listed in Art. 9(1)(a)-(f).
applies_from: from 2 January 2022 (Art. 31); period set by the executive regulation
quote: يلتزم المتحكم بمجرد علمه بوجود
conditional_on: breach that may affect the privacy, confidentiality or security of personal data

summary: Notify the data subject of a breach that may affect the privacy, confidentiality or security of their personal data, within the period set by the executive regulation, and inform them of the measures taken (Art. 9(2)).
applies_from: from 2 January 2022 (Art. 31); period set by the executive regulation
quote: يجب على المتحكم أن يخطر صاحب البيانات في حال كان الانتهاك
conditional_on: breach that may affect the privacy, confidentiality or security of the data subject's personal data

summary: On becoming aware of a personal data breach, notify the controller immediately so that the controller can report it to the Office (Art. 9(3)).
quote: المتحكم بهذا الاختراق أو الانتهاك فور علمه بذلك

summary: After receiving the controller's breach report, the Office verifies the causes of the breach and the adequacy of security measures, and imposes administrative sanctions referred to in Art. 26 where a violation is established (Art. 9(4)).
quote: يتولى المكتب بعد استلام البلاغ من المتحكم
conditional_on: receipt of a breach report from the controller

summary: Appoint a data protection officer with adequate skills where processing creates a high-level risk through new or volume-related technologies, involves systematic evaluation of sensitive data including profiling and automated processing, or involves large volumes of sensitive data; notify the Office of the officer's contact address (Art. 10(1)-(3)).
quote: يجب على المتحكم والمعالج تعيين مسؤول لحماية البيانات
conditional_on: processing with high-level risk, systematic evaluation of sensitive data, or large volumes of sensitive data (Art. 10(1))

summary: Ensure the data protection officer is properly and timely involved in all data protection matters, is provided with resources and support, is not dismissed or penalised for performing duties, and is not given tasks creating a conflict of interest (Art. 12(1)(a)-(d)).
quote: ضمان إشراكه بشكل مناسب وفي الوقت الملائم في كافة المسائل المتعلقة بحماية البيانات الشخصية
conditional_on: appointment of a data protection officer under Art. 10

summary: On the data subject's request and free of charge, provide information on the types of data processed, purposes, automated decisions including profiling, recipients, retention criteria, rectification, erasure and restriction procedures, cross-border safeguards, breach procedures and complaint procedures (Art. 13(1)).
quote: يحق لصاحب البيانات وبناءً على طلب يقدمه إلى المتحكم
conditional_on: request by the data subject

summary: Before processing begins, provide the data subject with the information in Art. 13(1)(b), (d) and (z): purposes, recipients, and cross-border transfer safeguards.
quote: يجب على المتحكم، وقبل البدء بالمعالجة، تزويد صاحب البيانات بالمعلومات

summary: Enable the data subject to obtain their personal data provided to the controller in a structured, machine-readable form where processing is based on consent or contract and is automated, and to request transfer to another controller where technically feasible (Art. 14).
quote: يحق لصاحب البيانات الحصول على البيانات الشخصية الخاصة به
conditional_on: processing based on consent or contractual obligation and carried out by automated means

summary: Correct or complete inaccurate personal data without undue delay on request, and erase personal data in the cases listed in Art. 15(2)(a)-(d), subject to the exceptions in Art. 15(3).
quote: يحق لصاحب البيانات طلب تصحيح بياناته الشخصية غير الدقيقة
conditional_on: request by the data subject

summary: On the data subject's request, restrict and stop processing in the cases listed in Art. 16(1)(a)-(c), including where the data is inaccurate or processing is unlawful; retain data for the data subject's legal claims on request (Art. 16(2)).
quote: يحق لصاحب البيانات إلزام المتحكم بتقييد وإيقاف المعالجة
conditional_on: cases listed in Art. 16(1)

summary: When lifting a processing restriction, notify the data subject.
quote: يجب على المتحكم في حال قام برفع التقييد المنصوص عليه في هذه المادة، أن يخطر
conditional_on: lifting of a restriction under Art. 16

summary: Stop processing on the data subject's objection in the cases listed: direct marketing including related profiling, statistical surveys unless necessary for public interest, and processing contrary to Art. 5 (Art. 17).
quote: يحق لصاحب البيانات الاعتراض على معالجة بياناته الشخصية وإيقاف المعالجة
conditional_on: objection by the data subject in the cases listed in Art. 17

summary: Enable the data subject to object to decisions based on automated processing that have legal effects or significantly affect them, including profiling, subject to the exceptions in Art. 18(2); Art. 18(3) requires protective measures in those cases.
quote: يحق لصاحب البيانات الاعتراض على القرارات التي تصدر عن المعالجة المؤتمتة
conditional_on: decisions based on automated processing with legal effects or significant effects

summary: On the data subject's request, include human involvement in reviewing automated processing decisions; in the cases of Art. 18(2), apply measures to protect the data subject's privacy, confidentiality and rights (Art. 18(3)-(4)).
quote: يتعين على المتحكم إدخال العنصر البشري في مراجعة قرارات المعالجة المؤتمتة
conditional_on: request by the data subject for review of an automated decision

summary: Provide appropriate and clear means and mechanisms enabling the data subject to contact the controller and request the exercise of their rights.
quote: على المتحكم توفير طرق وآليات مناسبة وواضحة لتمكين صاحب البيانات من التواصل معه

summary: Implement appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure information security proportionate to processing risks, according to international standards and best practices, which may include encryption, masking, business continuity, data recovery and regular testing of effectiveness (Art. 20(1)-(2)).
quote: يجب على المتحكم والمعالج وضع واتخاذ إجراءات وتدابير تقنية وتنظيمية ملائمة

summary: Before processing using new technologies that create a high risk, assess the impact of the proposed processing on data protection, including the cases in Art. 21(2)(a)-(b) (systematic automated evaluation with legal or significant effects, and large volumes of sensitive data); the assessment must cover the minimum content in Art. 21(3)(a)-(d), be coordinated with the DPO, and be reviewed periodically (Art. 21(5), (7)).
quote: يجب على المتحكم قبل القيام بإجراء المعالجة، أن يقوم
conditional_on: use of new technologies creating a high risk, or the cases in Art. 21(2)

summary: The Office prepares and publishes on its website a list of types of processing that do not require a data protection impact assessment (Art. 21(6)).
quote: على المكتب إعداد قائمة بنوع عمليات المعالجة غير الملزمة بتقييم أثر حماية البيانات الشخصية

summary: Personal data may be transferred outside the State in the cases approved by the Office: where the destination has data protection legislation with the listed provisions and enforcement mechanisms, or where the State has joined bilateral or multilateral data protection agreements with the destination states (Art. 22(1)-(2)).
quote: يجوز نقل البيانات الشخصية إلى خارج الدولة في الأحوال الآتية المعتمدة من المكتب
conditional_on: adequate level of protection in the destination (Art. 22)

summary: Where there is no adequate level of protection, personal data may be transferred outside the State in the cases of Art. 23(1)(a)-(f), including under a contract binding the entity abroad, with the data subject's explicit consent not contrary to public and security interests, or where necessary for a contract, legal claims, international judicial cooperation or the public interest.
quote: يجوز للمنشآت العاملة في الدولة وفي تلك الدول أن
conditional_on: absence of an adequate level of protection in the destination (Art. 23)

summary: The executive regulation sets the controls and requirements for the cross-border transfer cases in Art. 23(1).
applies_from: from issue of the executive regulation
quote: تحدد اللائحة التنفيذية لهذا المرسوم بقانون الضوابط والاشتراطات للحالات
conditional_on: issue of the executive regulation

summary: The Office may exempt, in whole or in part, establishments that do not process large volumes of personal data from the requirements of the decree-law, according to standards set by the executive regulation (Art. 3).
quote: يكون للمكتب إعفاء بعض المنشآت التي لا تقوم بمعالجة حجم كبير من البيانات الشخصية
conditional_on: criteria set by the executive regulation

summary: The Office receives complaints from data subjects about alleged violations, verifies them in coordination with the controller and processor, and may impose the administrative sanctions in Art. 26 where a violation is established (Art. 24(2)-(3)).
quote: يتولى المكتب استلام الشكاوى المقدمة من صاحب البيانات
conditional_on: complaint by the data subject

summary: The Council of Ministers, on the Office Director General's proposal, may delegate to competent local government bodies, within their local jurisdiction, some of the Office's powers under the decree-law (Art. 27).
quote: تفويض أيّ من الجهات الحكومية المحلية المختصة
conditional_on: proposal by the Office Director General

summary: The Council of Ministers, on the Office Director General's proposal, issues the executive regulation of the decree-law within 6 months of its issue (Art. 28).
applies_from: within 6 months from the date of issue of the decree-law (Art. 28)
quote: اللائحة التنفيذية لهذا المرسوم بقانون، وذلك
conditional_on: proposal by the Office Director General

summary: Controllers and processors must bring their position into conformity with the decree-law within a period not exceeding 6 months from the issue of the executive regulation; the Council of Ministers may extend this period for a similar period (Art. 29).
applies_from: within 6 months from the date of issue of the executive regulation (Art. 29)
quote: على المتحكم والمعالج توفيق أوضاعهما بما يتفق وأحكام هذا المرسوم بقانون
conditional_on: issue of the executive regulation

summary: Adhered goods suppliers may not supply the VPU with imported inputs or intermediate goods that have not undergone a transformation giving them a new form; imported goods may not exceed 50% of the total value of the supply contract for infrastructure works. Services suppliers without transformation are limited to Art. 190 benefits on final goods (b).
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
quote: En ningún caso el proveedor adherido al RIGI podrá proveer al VPU insumos o bienes intermedios importados que no hayan sido sometidos a un proceso de transformación
conditional_on: Applies to suppliers adhered to the RIGI under the substituted Art. 8 of Annex I.

summary: Suppliers of goods or services with imported merchandise must file with the Application Authority, together with the RIGI adhesion request, identification data, the VPU and project concerned, proof of a contract or letters of intent, a sworn statement on the goods, and the trade balance and currency flows for the first three years.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
quote: los proveedores de bienes o servicios con mercadería importada deberán presentar ante la Autoridad de Aplicación junto con la solicitud de adhesión al RIGI
conditional_on: Applies when the supplier seeks adhesion to the Registro de Proveedores RIGI.

summary: Where the currency flow requires net demand for foreign exchange, the Application Authority must refer the matter to the Central Bank to report on possible distortion of the exchange market, considering the consolidated project flows.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
provision: Art. 4 (substituting Anexo I, Art. 10, last paragraph)
quote: deberá dar intervención al BANCO CENTRAL DE LA REPÚBLICA ARGENTINA para que se expida respecto de la posible distorsión en el mercado de cambios
conditional_on: Applies only where the required currency flow shows a net demand for foreign exchange.

summary: Accreditation of compliance with the minimum investment amount in qualifying assets must be made on the basis of amounts actually disbursed by the VPU. The minimum amounts themselves are set in a table not reproduced in the text.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
quote: La acreditación del cumplimiento del Monto Mínimo de Inversión en activos computables deberá efectuarse sobre la base de los importes efectivamente erogados por el VPU

summary: For expansion of a Preexistent Project through a new technology product, the expansion must meet concurrently: product innovation with at least 50% of components differing by economic value; investment of at least USD 250,000,000; and a market useful life of 10 years or less.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
quote: la ampliación de dicho proyecto deberá cumplir, de manera concurrente, con las siguientes condiciones
conditional_on: Applies to expansions in the Technology Sector that incorporate a new product.

summary: The VPU must submit with the adhesion request a Technical Report on Useful Life Cycle, issued by a competent and independent professional, identifying the estimated technological and commercial validity period of the new product.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
provision: Art. 8 (substituting Anexo I, Art. 60, condition c)
quote: el VPU deberá presentar, junto con la solicitud de adhesión, un Informe Técnico de Ciclo de Vida Útil, emitido por un profesional competente e independiente
conditional_on: Applies to the new-product expansion condition under Art. 60(c).

summary: Expansion of a Preexistent Project not adhered to the RIGI may qualify as a RIGI Unique Project only if it meets all RIGI requirements and the minimum investment for the sector, and the applicant submits a plan committing that RIGI incentives apply exclusively to the expansion. The applicant must also inform and accredit these data at the time of the adhesion request.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
quote: el proyecto de Ampliación del Proyecto Preexistente cumpla con todos los requisitos previstos en el RIGI
conditional_on: Qualification is at the consideration of the Application Authority.

summary: The existing vehicle of the Preexistent Project being expanded must set up a Dedicated Branch (Sucursal Dedicada) whose sole purpose is the expansion.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
provision: Art. 9 (inserting Anexo I, Art. 60 bis, third paragraph)
quote: el respectivo vehículo societario del Proyecto Preexistente objeto de Ampliación deberá constituir una Sucursal Dedicada
conditional_on: Applies to expansions of Preexistent Projects under Art. 60 bis.

summary: At the time of the adhesion request, the applicant must state acceptance that the VPU and its partners or shareholders will resolve disputes, including over rights and incentives of members, partners or shareholders, through the mechanisms of Art. 221 of Law 27.742, including the RIGI Panel. The applicant may propose another dispute mechanism.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
provision: Art. 9 (inserting Anexo I, Art. 60 bis, final paragraph)
quote: deberá manifestarse la aceptación de que tanto el VPU como sus Socios o Accionistas resolverán las Disputas
conditional_on: Applies to expansions of Preexistent Projects under Art. 60 bis.

summary: An expansion of a RIGI Project must not alter the Unique Project condition or the conditions under Art. 3(j), and the project must continue to meet the requirements considered for approval of its adhesion. No prior authorisation is required, without prejudice to oversight powers.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
quote: requerirá que el proyecto continúe cumpliendo con los requisitos que se consideraron para la aprobación de su adhesión al RIGI
conditional_on: Applies to expansions of an existing RIGI Project under Art. 61.

summary: Where the optional special amortisation regime is elected, beneficiaries must declare annually the useful life assigned to all depreciable assets, in the form and terms set by ARCA. Penalties and interest in Art. 69(c) are enforcement and not coded here.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
quote: los sujetos beneficiados deberán declarar anualmente la vida útil asignada a la totalidad de sus bienes amortizables
conditional_on: Applies only if the beneficiary opts into the special amortisation regime.

summary: Assets to which the special amortisation regime applies must remain in the VPU's assets until the end of the activity cycle that motivated their acquisition or the end of their useful life, if shorter.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
quote: los bienes a los que se les aplique el régimen deberán permanecer en el patrimonio del VPU hasta la conclusión del ciclo de la actividad
conditional_on: Applies to assets subject to the special amortisation regime.

summary: Once the amortisation option is exercised, it must be communicated to the Application Authority and ARCA, in the form and terms they set, and it applies to all investments over the life of the VPU.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
quote: Una vez ejercida la opción, deberá comunicarse a la Autoridad de Aplicación y a la AGENCIA DE RECAUDACIÓN Y CONTROL ADUANERO (ARCA)
conditional_on: Applies once the beneficiary exercises the option under Art. 69(d).

summary: For accelerated amortisation of infrastructure or processing assets authorised by the Application Authority, the VPU must accredit through competent professional certification that the depreciation method used is appropriate for the project.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
quote: el VPU acredite, mediante certificación profesional competente, que el tipo de depreciación utilizada
conditional_on: Applies where the Application Authority authorises use of the regime for infrastructure assets under Art. 69 (last paragraphs).

summary: Once it grants an authorisation for infrastructure assets under the accelerated amortisation regime, the Application Authority must notify ARCA of that treatment.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
quote: la Autoridad de Aplicación notificará dicho tratamiento a la AGENCIA DE RECAUDACIÓN Y CONTROL ADUANERO (ARCA)
conditional_on: Applies after the authorisation under Art. 69(d) is granted.

summary: Where dividends or remittances abroad must be made through the Dedicated Branch under contractual or corporate agreements, the company holding the branch must act as withholding agent and apply the applicable rate to the share of profits attributable to the VPU.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
provision: Art. 12 (substituting Anexo I, Art. 72, last paragraph)
quote: la sociedad titular de la Sucursal Dedicada, la que deberá actuar como agente de retención del gravamen
conditional_on: Applies where contractual or corporate agreements require remittances through the Dedicated Branch.

summary: For the import tariff exemption on goods that are not listed as capital goods or IT goods, the VPU must demonstrate their technical essentiality and operational availability through an independent engineer's certificate.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
provision: Art. 13 (substituting Anexo I, Art. 83, second paragraph)
quote: el VPU deberá acreditar mediante certificación expedida por ingeniero independiente
conditional_on: Applies only to goods not listed as BK or BIT that the VPU requests and the Application Authority exceptionally authorises.

summary: The Central Bank may, while the general exchange-market regime requires export proceeds to be settled, set conditions for adhered VPUs with export-related incentives: they may access the exchange market only where foreign currency received and settled equals or exceeds amounts demanded for the project. Payments of interest and dividends are excluded.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
quote: el BANCO CENTRAL DE LA REPÚBLICA ARGENTINA podrá disponer respecto de los VPU adheridos
conditional_on: Applies while the general exchange regime requires settlement of export proceeds and for VPUs whose feasibility analysis includes the Art. 198 incentive.

summary: Under the Central Bank measure, a VPU that is subject to it may access the exchange market for any purpose only if the foreign currency it has received and settled is at least equal to the amounts demanded for the project at that date.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
quote: solo podrán acceder al mercado de cambios por cualquier concepto
conditional_on: Applies only where the Central Bank has issued a provision under Art. 100(c).

summary: Non-resident contributions or external financing received and settled by consortium members or partners, or by shareholders or the Dedicated Branch, count toward the VPU only to the extent they are effectively used for the project and recorded as allocated to it, under Central Bank procedures.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
provision: Art. 14 (substituting Anexo I, Art. 100, c, second paragraph)
quote: se registren contablemente como afectados al mismo
conditional_on: Applies only to funds effectively used for the Unique Project and processed under Central Bank procedures.

summary: Suppliers of goods or services with imported merchandise may request voluntary deregistration from the RIGI Supplier Registry at any time, provided they have met obligations from RIGI operations and have no pending infraction proceedings or final sanctions.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
provision: Art. 15 (inserting Anexo I, Art. 113, last paragraph)
quote: podrán solicitar, bajo los mismos términos y alcances que los establecidos en el presente artículo para el VPU, su baja voluntaria del Registro de Proveedores RIGI en cualquier momento
conditional_on: Subject to the conditions stated in the provision.

summary: The Application Authority must evaluate deregistration requests from suppliers and ensure that the deregistration does not affect rights or obligations arising from earlier operations under the regime.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
provision: Art. 15 (inserting Anexo I, Art. 113, last paragraph)
quote: debiendo asegurar que la baja no afecte derechos u obligaciones derivados de operaciones previamente realizadas bajo el régimen
conditional_on: Applies to deregistration requests under Art. 113 as amended.

summary: In a sanctioning proceeding against the VPU, the VPU must present its evidence in defence within a maximum of 30 business days from the start of the procedure.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
quote: deberá presentar las pruebas que hagan a su derecho de defensa dentro de un plazo máximo de TREINTA (30) días hábiles de iniciado el procedimiento
conditional_on: Applies when a proceeding (sumario) is opened against the VPU.

summary: The Application Authority must set up an Project Evaluation Committee to analyse RIGI adhesion requests from VPUs.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
provision: Art. 17 (substituting Anexo I, Art. 123, second paragraph)
quote: La Autoridad de Aplicación deberá conformar un Comité Evaluador de Proyectos

summary: All technical reports produced in evaluating RIGI requests must have the approval of the competent substantive area. The Committee or the Secretariat of Industry and Commerce then issues a recommendation of approval or rejection based on those reports.
applies_from: day of publication in the Boletín Oficial (Art. 18)
provision: Art. 17 (substituting Anexo I, Art. 123, first and last paragraphs)
quote: Todos los informes técnicos producidos deberán contar con la conformidad del área sustantiva interviniente

summary: Complementary rules to this regulation must be issued by the Autoridad de Aplicación, AFIP, the BCRA and other secretariats within their competences, within 30 calendar days of publication.
applies_from: 30 días corridos a contar desde la publicación de esta reglamentación
quote: deberán ser dictadas por parte de la Autoridad de Aplicación

quote: Facúltese al Poder Ejecutivo nacional a elaborar, con el acuerdo de las provincias

summary: Any norm or act by the Nation, provinces or the City of Buenos Aires that limits or undermines the RIGI title is declared null, and courts must block its application.
quote: cualquier norma o vía de hecho por la que se limite, restrinja, vulnere, obstaculice o desvirtúe lo establecido en el presente título
conditional_on: Applies to jurisdictions that adhered to the RIGI

summary: A special project vehicle (VPU) seeking RIGI adhesion must have as its sole object one or more phases of a single admitted project and hold no non-project activities or assets.
quote: los VPU no deberán desarrollar actividades ni poseer activos no afectados a dicho proyecto

summary: Suppliers of imported goods registered under the RIGI must invoice annually to RIGI vehicles at least the percentage set by the enforcement authority.
quote: los proveedores deberán facturar anualmente
conditional_on: From registration as RIGI supplier

summary: Each calendar year, RIGI suppliers must declare under oath to the enforcement authority, with an accountant's certification, the invoicing percentage achieved.
quote: Al vencimiento de cada año calendario el proveedor deberá informar dicho porcentaje

summary: A company that adheres to the RIGI through a dedicated branch must meet the listed requirements for that branch, including separate registration, tax number, assigned capital and separate accounts.
quote: una sucursal que deberá cumplir con los siguientes requisitos
conditional_on: Where the company opts to establish a dedicated branch

summary: Entities whose VPU members have listed final convictions, bankruptcy, or confirmed fiscal, customs or social security debts may not apply for RIGI inclusion.
quote: No podrán solicitar su inclusión en el RIGI quienes
conditional_on: At adhesion and at the date of plan approval

summary: RIGI investments must be of long-term character, with the ratio of expected net cash flow to planned capital investment not above the set percentage; minimum investment must be completed before the deadline.
quote: las inversiones deberán tener un carácter de largo plazo

summary: The national Executive sets the percentage of the minimum investment that must be completed in the first and second years.
quote: el Poder Ejecutivo nacional establecerá el porcentaje del monto mínimo de inversión

summary: At least 40 percent of the minimum investment must be reached in the first two years as a condition for remaining in the RIGI.
quote: al menos, el cuarenta por ciento (40%) del monto mínimo de inversión como condición de permanencia en el RIGI

summary: When acquired company shares count as qualifying assets, the acquired company must be merged into the VPU within 180 calendar days.
quote: se fusione con el VPU dentro de un plazo de ciento ochenta (180) días corridos
conditional_on: Where acquired shares are counted as qualifying assets

summary: A VPU must file an adhesion request and investment plan and obtain the enforcement authority's approval of both to adhere to the RIGI.
quote: los VPU deberán:

summary: The adhesion request and investment plan must contain the listed minimum items, including project description, investment amounts, timetable, sworn statement on market distortion, financing and risk studies; modifications must be notified within 30 business days.
quote: La solicitud de adhesión y el plan de inversión indicado en el artículo 175 deberán contener como mínimo lo siguiente

summary: The investment plan must include a commitment to contract local suppliers for at least 20 percent of the payments to suppliers, maintained through construction and operation, where local supply is available.
quote: deberá contener un compromiso de contratación de proveedores locales
conditional_on: Where local supply is available at market price and quality

summary: The enforcement authority must decide on adhesion requests uniformly and without discretion, and notify the approval or rejection within 5 business days; rejection must state the grounds.
quote: El acto administrativo de aprobación o rechazo de la solicitud de adhesión deberá ser notificado

summary: By notification of the approval, the VPU irrevocably assumes the obligations for permanence in the regime; it must comply with the commitments of Art. 172 a) and b).
applies_from: From notification of the approval act
quote: la obligación de cumplir con los compromisos previstos en los incisos a) y b) del artículo 172

summary: A VPU may not hold or develop other activities or projects beyond the adhered project; incentives may be used only for that project.
quote: El VPU no podrá ser titular ni desarrollar otras actividades o proyectos distintos del proyecto adherido

summary: The enforcement authority must monitor the minimum investment deadline, first two-year investment, other RIGI obligations and proper use of incentives.
quote: La autoridad de aplicación deberá hacer seguimiento y controlar

summary: Assets counted toward the minimum investment must remain dedicated to the adhered project for their useful life or the stability period, unless authorised for sale and replacement.
quote: Los activos que se hayan computado a efectos del cumplimiento del monto mínimo de inversión deberán permanecer afectados al proyecto adherido

summary: VPU may modify its investment plan without prior approval but must notify the application authority within five business days and update its sworn information (Art. 176).
applies_from: dentro de los cinco (5) días hábiles de decidida o conocida
quote: debiendo, sin embargo, notificar la modificación a la autoridad de aplicación dentro de los cinco (5) días hábiles de decidida o conocida
conditional_on: modification of an approved investment plan that does not fall under the listed reserved aspects

summary: Request for modification of reserved investment-plan aspects (reduction of investment in first two years, extension of minimum-investment deadline) must be filed at least 60 calendar days before expiry with grounds.
applies_from: con una antelación mínima de sesenta (60) días corridos antes de su vencimiento
quote: La solicitud de modificación de plan de inversión en estos casos deberá ser realizada por el VPU con una antelación mínima de sesenta (60) días corridos
conditional_on: modification of reserved investment-plan aspects requiring prior authorization

summary: VPU with certain knowledge that an essential condition for permanence cannot be met must inform the authority within ten business days.
applies_from: dentro de los diez (10) días hábiles siguientes de tomado dicho conocimiento
quote: deberá informarlo a la autoridad de aplicación dentro de los diez (10) días hábiles siguientes de tomado dicho conocimiento
conditional_on: certain knowledge of the impossibility of complying with an essential condition or requirement

summary: The application authority must analyse the VPU's notification and decide on permanence or termination in the RIGI, and may order changes to investment conditions.
quote: La autoridad de aplicación deberá analizar la presentación y resolver sobre la permanencia o terminación del VPU en el RIGI
conditional_on: receipt of a notification of impossibility of compliance

summary: As a condition of permanence in the RIGI, the VPU undertakes to comply with all essential conditions and requirements of the regime.
quote: el VPU asume el compromiso de cumplir con todas las condiciones y requisitos esenciales del presente régimen
conditional_on: permanence in the RIGI

summary: A VPU affected by force majeure or fortuitous event must notify the authority in writing, stating whether it is a suspension (with estimated duration) or partial or total closure, and its nature and causes.
applies_from: dentro de los quince (15) días de tomar conocimiento de su existencia
quote: deberá comunicar dicha circunstancia a la autoridad de aplicación, por escrito, dentro de los quince (15) días de tomar conocimiento de su existencia
conditional_on: occurrence of a fortuitous event or force majeure

summary: The regulation shall establish the classes of guarantees required to preserve tax credits relating to tax and customs incentives; VPUs may choose among the listed guarantee forms.
quote: La reglamentación establecerá las clases de garantías que deberán exigirse para preservar el crédito fiscal

summary: Whoever pays dividends or profits to foreign beneficiaries from VPUs must withhold the 7% rate and remit it to the tax authority as a final single payment.
quote: quien los pague efectúe la pertinente retención e ingrese a la Administración Federal de Ingresos Públicos dicho porcentaje
conditional_on: payment of dividends or profits to beneficiaries abroad

summary: Transactions between a VPU and its members or related entities are subject to Art. 17 of the income tax law; contributions to cost-sharing arrangements must be valued at arm's-length.
quote: el valor de las contribuciones o aportes efectuados por cada participante debe ajustarse al que una empresa independiente aceptaría
conditional_on: transactions with members or related local entities; cost-sharing agreements

summary: The regulation shall set the requirements, procedures and conditions for issuing and delivering Tax Credit Certificates and transferring remaining balances; the application authority issues implementing norms.
quote: La reglamentación establecerá los requisitos, procedimientos y condiciones para la emisión y entrega de los Certificados de Crédito Fiscal

summary: The national tax authority may not challenge the computation of transferred remaining tax credit balances nor claim from suppliers or third parties payment of taxes settled with those balances.
quote: La Administración Federal de Ingresos Públicos no podrá impugnar el cómputo de los remanentes de esos créditos fiscales transferidos
conditional_on: transfer of remaining Tax Credit Certificate balances

summary: Provincial, City of Buenos Aires and municipal taxes may not reach operations or economic relations between a VPU and its members; any such levy is treated as a breach of Art. 165.
quote: No podrán alcanzarse con ningún tributo local las operaciones, transferencias, ventas, locaciones, prestaciones ni ninguna otra relación económica entre el VPU y sus miembros.
conditional_on: UTE or similar contractual association VPUs

summary: Imposition of any national tax on imports of listed goods by VPUs is prohibited; such imposition is a breach of Art. 165.
quote: Cualquier imposición en tal sentido será considerada como una violación a lo establecido en el artículo 165 de esta ley.
conditional_on: importations by VPUs listed in Art. 190

summary: Goods imported under the import-duty exemption may not be transferred, except to another RIGI VPU (inputs used in production excepted).
quote: no puede ser objeto de transferencia, salvo que dicha transferencia se efectúe a otro VPU adherido al RIGI
conditional_on: goods benefiting from Art. 190 exemption

summary: A transfer of goods to another RIGI VPU must be notified to the application authority within 15 calendar days.
applies_from: dentro de los quince (15) días corridos siguientes de ocurrido
quote: lo cual deberá ser notificado a la autoridad de aplicación dentro de los quince (15) días corridos siguientes de ocurrido
conditional_on: transfer of goods under Art. 190 to another VPU

summary: Direct import and export prohibitions or restrictions, quotas, official prices and regulatory restrictions on supply, transport and processing of VPU inputs and exports may not be applied to VPUs.
quote: sin que puedan aplicárseles prohibiciones ni restricciones directas, restricciones cuantitativas, cupos o cuotas, de ningún tipo
conditional_on: VPUs adhered to the RIGI

summary: VPUs may opt to keep accounting records and financial statements in US dollars using IFRS.
quote: podrán optar por llevar sus registros contables y estados financieros preparados en dólares estadounidenses

summary: The Central Bank shall issue the norms needed to implement in the exchange market regulations the rights recognised in Art. 199.
applies_from: en el plazo máximo de treinta (30) días corridos de publicada la presente ley
quote: dictará en el plazo máximo de treinta (30) días corridos de publicada la presente ley, las normas necesarias

summary: Public bodies and private entities involved in exchange-market formalities for VPUs shall ensure their processing does not disrupt the project.
quote: velarán porque su tramitación no afecte el normal desenvolvimiento y ejecución de dicho proyecto
conditional_on: procedures for VPU access to the exchange market

summary: The national State guarantees VPUs the listed rights (product availability and export freedom, asset protection against confiscation, continuity of operation, dividend remittance, access to justice); the State shall give VPUs all necessary cooperation to repel confiscatory or expropriatory acts.
quote: El Estado prestará al VPU toda la colaboración necesaria para repeler actos confiscatorios o expropiatorios de hecho o de derecho

summary: Incentives in chapters IV and V may not be affected by repeal of the law or by creation of more burdensome tax, customs or exchange regulation during the 30-year stability period.
applies_from: durante los treinta (30) años siguientes de la fecha de adhesión por parte del VPU
quote: no podrán ser afectados ni por la derogación de la presente ley ni por la creación de normativa tributaria, aduanera o cambiaria respectivamente más gravosa
conditional_on: VPU adhesion to the RIGI

summary: New taxes created after adhesion, and increases of existing taxes, do not apply to VPUs, except the listed exceptions; VPUs keep the right to reject tax claims exceeding the stabilised amount.
quote: Los nuevos tributos que se creen a partir de la fecha de adhesión, distintos de los vigentes a la fecha de adhesión o de lo previsto en el capítulo IV del presente título, no serán aplicables a tales VPU.
conditional_on: VPU adhesion to the RIGI

summary: The national tax authority shall establish a free manual self-assessment procedure for customs duties that does not require prior payment or prior authorisation.
quote: La Administración Federal de Ingresos Públicos deberá establecer un procedimiento de autoliquidación manual libre
conditional_on: import or export clearance by VPUs

summary: The Central Bank shall issue the norms needed to guarantee the exchange-rate stability rights under Art. 205.
applies_from: en el plazo máximo de treinta (30) días de publicada la presente ley
quote: dictará en el plazo máximo de treinta (30) días de publicada la presente ley, las normas necesarias

summary: Exchange-rate regulations imposing more burdensome conditions may not affect VPUs' exchange-regime stability; VPUs are exempt from restrictions of the general exchange regime that contradict or are more burdensome than RIGI rights.
applies_from: desde la fecha de adhesión al RIGI y durante el plazo del artículo 201
quote: no podrán ser afectados por la normativa cambiaria que se dicte estableciendo condiciones más gravosas
conditional_on: VPU adhesion to the RIGI

summary: A VPU that alleges a breach of exchange-rate stability may continue to apply the rules in force at adhesion, notifying the Central Bank by formal means.
quote: notificando fehacientemente al Banco Central de la República Argentina esta circunstancia
conditional_on: VPU alleges a violation of exchange-rate stability

summary: Where the Central Bank considers no breach occurred, it must request the VPU to specify the norm concerned within 15 days, and must issue a reasoned resolution accepting or rejecting the breach within 90 business days.
applies_from: dentro de un plazo de noventa (90) días hábiles
quote: el Banco Central de la República Argentina deberá dictar resolución fundada aceptando o desestimando la existencia de una violación a la estabilidad normativa cambiaria dentro de un plazo de noventa (90) días hábiles
conditional_on: VPU alleges a violation of exchange-rate stability

summary: Direct or indirect transfer of VPU shares, quotas or interests needs no prior authorisation but must be reported to the authority; pledges and similar security arrangements are likewise reported.
applies_from: dentro de los quince (15) días corridos siguientes de ocurrido
quote: debiendo informar de ello a ésta última dentro de los quince (15) días corridos siguientes de ocurrido
conditional_on: transfer or encumbrance of VPU shares, quotas or interests

summary: RIGI benefits may not be accumulated with incentives of the same nature under pre-existing promotional regimes.
quote: Los beneficios previstos en el RIGI no podrán ser acumulados con incentivos de la misma naturaleza existentes en otros regímenes promocionales preexistentes.
conditional_on: VPU adhesion to the RIGI

summary: The Executive designates the application authority, empowered to approve or reject adhesion requests and investment plans, to supervise the RIGI, verify compliance, decide forfeiture of incentives and issue operative norms.
quote: El Poder Ejecutivo nacional designará la autoridad de aplicación del presente título de la ley

summary: The application authority issues the operative, clarifying and complementary norms needed to ensure adequate compliance with the RIGI.
quote: El dictado de las normas operativas, aclaratorias y complementarias

summary: The application authority may delegate its powers to government Secretariats by productive sector.
quote: La autoridad de aplicación podrá delegar en las Secretarías de gobierno las facultades previstas en el artículo precedente

summary: Beneficiaries must submit to the application authority the information requested about the project status and the VPUs.
quote: Los sujetos beneficiarios deberán presentar ante la autoridad de aplicación la información que les fuera requerida
conditional_on: request for information by the application authority

summary: The national tax authority is instructed to create a specific area to assign tax IDs (CUIT) to VPUs and supervise their tax and customs compliance.
quote: Instrúyese a la Administración Federal de Ingresos Públicos a crear un área específica

summary: Provinces, the City of Buenos Aires and municipalities are invited to adhere to the RIGI on all its terms and conditions.
quote: Invítase a las provincias, a la Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires y a los municipios a adherir al RIGI en todos sus términos y condiciones.

summary: Adhering provinces, the City of Buenos Aires and municipalities may not impose new local levies on VPUs, except fees for services actually provided; fees may not exceed the specific cost of the service.
quote: no podrán imponer a los VPU nuevos gravámenes locales, salvo las tasas retributivas por servicios efectivamente prestados
conditional_on: adhesion to the RIGI by the province, City of Buenos Aires or municipality

summary: The Executive must regulate the RIGI within 30 days from its publication in the Official Gazette.
applies_from: 30 días, a contar desde su publicación en el Boletín Oficial
quote: El Poder Ejecutivo nacional deberá reglamentar el presente régimen en el término de treinta (30) días

summary: Where the declared sale price is not a suitable tax base for tobacco, the tax authority shall use the price it determines; prices at least 20% below its survey are not suitable.
quote: corresponderá utilizar el precio que determine la Administración Federal de Ingresos Públicos
conditional_on: sale price reported by taxpayers is not a suitable base for the taxable value

summary: The Executive and the tax authority shall regulate the tobacco valuation provision and issue complementary norms.
quote: El Poder Ejecutivo nacional y la Administración Federal de Ingresos Públicos reglamentarán lo prescrito en este artículo

summary: Cigarettes, domestic or imported, must be sold in packs or containers under the conditions and forms set by the Executive.
quote: deberán expenderse en paquetes o envases en las condiciones y formas que reglamente el Poder Ejecutivo nacional

summary: Minimum tax amounts for tobacco are to be updated quarterly by CPI variation; the Executive may within limits raise or lower them.
quote: Los importes consignados en el segundo párrafo de este artículo se actualizarán trimestralmente

summary: Provinces and the City of Buenos Aires are invited to enact the norms necessary to establish procedures consistent with the law's purposes.
quote: Invítase a las provincias y a la Ciudad Autónoma de Buenos Aires a dictar las normas que resulten necesarias

summary: The Executive shall regulate the law within a maximum of 90 days from its entry into force, except where a specific deadline is set, and issue complementary, interpretive or clarifying norms.
applies_from: noventa (90) días a partir de su entrada en vigencia
quote: el Poder Ejecutivo nacional reglamentará la presente ley en un plazo máximo de noventa (90) días a partir de su entrada en vigencia
conditional_on: except where a specific deadline is set in the law

summary: Demand of one project, establishment or economically or technically linked set must be counted as a whole and may not be split into smaller demands to avoid XDEM classification.
provision: Anexo, Art. 1 (definition of Demanda Extratendencial); Art. 3
quote: deberá considerarse en forma integral, no pudiendo ser fraccionada, parcializada o ... subdividida en demandas de menor potencia cuando ello tenga por objeto o efecto evitar su encuadramiento como XDEM

summary: Every XDEM must register in the Registro de XDEM of the Secretaría de Energía, stating expected commercial-enablement date, power required, estimated annual energy, connection facilities, committed transmission expansions and the committed supply plan; registration does not itself enable it as a MEM agent.
quote: Toda Demanda Extratendencial (XDEM) deberá registrarse ante la Secretaría de Energía.

summary: An XDEM with self-generation must also declare total installed power, a staged load schedule, its associated generation (GAC) and its capacity to modulate withdrawals, and obtain separate Autogenerador enablement where applicable.
quote: En el caso de tratarse de una XDEM con autogeneración deberá registrarse ante la Secretaría de Energía declarando: potencia instalada total, cronograma de incorporación de carga por etapas, características de GAC, y capacidad de modulación de su retiro de la red.
conditional_on: XDEM with self-generation

summary: File with the Secretaría de Energía (copy to the OED), together with the transmission-access request to ENReGE, a sworn Plan Especial de Abastecimiento for the first five years: contracting commitments, location of new energy and capacity supply, schedules and backup; supply must come from Nueva Oferta Elegible XDEM.
provision: Anexo, Art. 5, paras. 1-2; Res. Art. 1 (substituting Res. SE 400/2025, Art. 13, para. 1)
quote: con carácter de Declaración Jurada un Plan Especial de Abastecimiento (PEA) para los primeros CINCO (5) años de funcionamiento

summary: Before commercial enablement, file a sworn updated supply plan with a 5-year rolling horizon: month-by-month maximum demand for 60 months, a certificate of capacity backing and energy coverage identifying contracts with new eligible supply, and grid studies validated by the transmission company; update it annually afterwards.
quote: Todo GUMA-XDEM deberá presentar ante la Secretaría de Energía, en calidad de Declaración Jurada, previamente y como condición para su Habilitación Comercial
conditional_on: Before commercial enablement; annual updates from the following year

summary: Incorporation of an XDEM into the MEM requires prior enablement by the Secretaría de Energía (under subcategory XDEM-DATOS or XDEM-PRODUCCIÓN) after the OED's evaluation; commercial enablement by the OED, and each staged power increase, requires proof of the conditions set, including supply, firm capacity and connection.
quote: La incorporación de una Demanda Extratendencial (XDEM) al MERCADO ELÉCTRICO MAYORISTA (MEM) requerirá la previa habilitación de la SECRETARÍA DE ENERGÍA

summary: Commit new firm capacity on incorporation equal to 115% of maximum demand for XDEM-DATOS (reserve guarantee) and 100% for XDEM-PRODUCCIÓN.
provision: Anexo, Art. 5, para. 4; Res. Art. 1 (substituting Res. SE 400/2025, Art. 13, para. 1)
quote: La XDEM DATOS deberá comprometer, como incorporación, una potencia firme equivalente al CIENTO QUINCE POR CIENTO (115 %) de su demanda máxima

summary: Prove each month contractual energy coverage from Nueva Oferta Elegible XDEM of at least 80% of energy demanded; the rest may be bought transitorily in the spot market subject to the charges.
quote: Todo GUMA-XDEM deberá acreditar mensualmente una cobertura contractual mediante Nueva Oferta Elegible XDEM

summary: Hold contractual firm-capacity coverage able to supply the demand physically at its node, of at least 100% of maximum power requirement (115% for XDEM-DATOS), from thermal, storage of at least 6 hours, hydro, nuclear or recognised new technologies.
quote: El GUMA-XDEM debe contar con cobertura de potencia firme. Dicha potencia debe ser capaz de abastecer físicamente la demanda en el nodo de consumo correspondiente.

summary: XDEM bear service, additional and transport costs like other large users, receive MEM service charges in proportion to monthly energy, and are excluded from the renewable-contract discount of Res. 281-E/2017 Art. 20 and from the MATER exemption from commercialisation and administration charges.
quote: La XDEM deberá hacerse cargo de costos de servicios, adicionales y transporte como el resto de los Grandes Usuarios del MEM.

summary: Projects assigned capacity conditional on a transmission expansion pay the OED a quarterly reservation charge (USD 2,500/MW; USD 5,000/MW during the 8-quarter extension) and may withdraw the reservation at any time by formal notice.
quote: Los proyectos a los que se asigne capacidad conforme el Inciso a) deberán abonar al OED un cargo trimestral de reserva de capacidad
conditional_on: Access conditional on a transmission expansion (Subanexo I, Art. 2(a))

summary: Applications for MEM incorporation or access linked to XDEM pending at entry into force must be adapted to the regime within 60 days, including registration and subcategory classification, even if the holder is not yet a MEM agent.
quote: Esta obligación alcanza a los titulares de dichas solicitudes aunque aún no revistan la calidad de Agentes del MEM.
conditional_on: Application pending at 2026-09-25

summary: Stage 1 (transmission access): define maximum power, schedule, location, connection point and supply plan, and file load-flow, short-circuit and transient-stability studies showing the demand can be supplied without transmission constraints or forced generation dispatch and without degrading the SADI.
provision: Subanexo II, point 2.1; Anexo, Art. 5, para. 3
quote: En la Solicitud de Acceso a la Capacidad de Transporte se deberá verificar que la demanda propuesta puede abastecerse sin requerir despacho de generación forzada.

summary: Stage 2: detailed design studies (RMS, EMT, control interaction, power quality) after access approval and before buying equipment, then operation studies 5-7 months before commissioning, both approved by the transmission company and the OED; deliver PSS/E and PSCAD models allowing independent reproduction.
quote: Los estudios de esta etapa deberán realizarse inmediatamente después de la aprobación del acceso y previamente a la adquisición de equipamiento
conditional_on: After access approval; before commissioning

summary: Stage 3: factory and site acceptance tests, a test report before commercial enablement, and a final studies report within 60 days after it, with homologated models and updated installation data.
quote: Previamente a la Habilitación Comercial, el AGENTE deberá presentar un informe de ensayos que documente el comportamiento de la instalación
conditional_on: Before and within 60 days after commercial enablement

summary: Meet mandatory technical performance requirements at the connection point as design conditions: voltage and reactive-power control, ramp limits, limits on variability and oscillations, voltage and frequency ride-through, RoCoF, active-power recovery, stable control interactions, phase-jump tolerance, power quality, and coordinated protection and automatic schemes.
provision: Res. Art. 4; Subanexo II, points 3 to 3.10
quote: Dichos requerimientos no dependen del diseño particular de la instalación, constituyen condiciones exigibles de desempeño en el punto de conexión, y deberán ser considerados como condiciones de diseño obligatorias del proyecto.

summary: Provide demand-reduction schemes for falling frequency that take part in the SADI under-frequency load-shedding scheme (cumulative steps from 3% at 49.0 Hz to 42% at 48.4 Hz).
quote: La instalación deberá disponer de esquemas de reducción de la demanda ante disminuciones de frecuencia

summary: Install monitoring and phasor-measurement equipment at the connection point linked to the OED's data concentrator, an operating centre, real-time supervision via ICCP and disturbance recording, with data available to the OED in real time and afterwards.
quote: La instalación deberá integrarse a los sistemas de supervisión del OED y CCA proporcionando información en tiempo real del punto de conexión

summary: Install a commercial metering system (SMEC) under Annex 24 of Los Procedimientos with accuracy class 0.2s/0.2 at XDEM interconnection points, whatever the voltage level.
provision: Anexo, Art. 1 (definition of SMEC); Subanexo II, point 3.16
quote: Todo GUMA-XDEM deberá instalarlo bajo su responsabilidad

summary: Provide operating information and demand forecasts (5-year profile, seasonal, weekly and daily databases) and inform the OED and the transmission company of significant changes to the supply plan, power, schedule, technology or models; studies may then have to be repeated.
quote: debiendo el solicitante informar al OED cualquier modificación significativa en las previsiones de potencia, energía o perfil de consumo originalmente declaradas

summary: The OED (CAMMESA) evaluates each complete application, verifying registration, GUMA requirements, supply-plan consistency, new eligible supply, firm capacity, technical requirements and absence of harm to the SADI, requires cures, and sends a technical report to the Secretaría de Energía.
quote: A tal efecto, el OED deberá verificar, como mínimo

summary: The Secretaría de Energía decides on enablement under subcategory XDEM-DATOS or XDEM-PRODUCCIÓN and may set particular conditions on load, firm capacity, contract coverage, expansions and new supply.
quote: El acto de habilitación podrá establecer condiciones particulares

summary: The Secretaría de Energía may exceptionally allow a lower firm-capacity coverage percentage for new XDEM in exporting areas with structural transmission limits, on a reasoned OED report.
quote: con carácter excepcional, autorizar una reducción del porcentaje de cobertura de potencia correspondiente a comprometer

summary: The Secretaría de Energía instructs the OED to allocate MEM service charges to XDEM in proportion to energy demanded each month.
quote: La SECRETARÍA DE ENERGÍA instruirá al ORGANISMO ENCARGADO DEL DESPACHO (OED) para que asigne específicamente a las XDEM los cargos correspondientes a los Servicios del MERCADO ELÉCTRICO MAYORISTA (MEM)

summary: Revenues from the energy-coverage and firm-capacity-deficit charges, and forfeited capacity-reservation amounts, go to the Export Account of the MEM Stabilisation Fund (Res. SE 1.037/2021) to promote generation, firm capacity and reliability.
