conditional_on: Art. 6 suspended per Acórdão nº 58 of 3 March 2026 (preceding item V)

summary: Data centres must use technologies and practices promoting energy efficiency and reduced energy consumption (IV) and operate in line with environmental and sustainability best practices (V); to be included in the operational procedure.
applies_from: when the operational procedure under Art. 85-B is issued
provision: Art. 6 (inserting Resolução 715/2019, Título VI-A, Art. 85-C incisos IV e V)
quote: utilizar tecnologias e práticas que promovam a eficiência energética e redução da energia consumida
conditional_on: Art. 6 suspended per Acórdão nº 58 of 3 March 2026 (preceding item V)

summary: The operational procedure must set out the process for recognising entities that will carry out conformity assessment of data centres.
applies_from: when the operational procedure under Art. 85-B is issued
quote: O procedimento operacional deverá indicar, igualmente, o processo de reconhecimento de entidades
conditional_on: Art. 6 suspended per Acórdão nº 58 of 3 March 2026 (preceding item V)

summary: Existing operational procedures for designating Certification Bodies (OCD) and accrediting test laboratories apply, as applicable, to recognition of entities assessing data centres.
applies_from: entrada em vigor na data de sua publicação (Art. 7, caput)
provision: Art. 6 (inserting Resolução 715/2019, Título VI-A, Art. 85-E caput)
quote: Aplicar-se-á, no que couber, os procedimentos operacionais para designação de Organismo de Certificação Designado
conditional_on: Art. 6 suspended per Acórdão nº 58 of 3 March 2026 (preceding item V)

summary: The Superintendência responsible for the assessment procedure may issue complementary rules on designation of OCDs and accreditation of laboratories for data-centre assessment.
applies_from: entrada em vigor na data de sua publicação (Art. 7, caput)
provision: Art. 6 (inserting Resolução 715/2019, Título VI-A, Art. 85-E parágrafo único)
quote: poderá expedir regras complementares à designação de OCDs e habilitação de Laboratórios
conditional_on: Art. 6 suspended per Acórdão nº 58 of 3 March 2026 (preceding item V)

summary: Amends the small-scale agents rule (Res. CD/ANPD 2/2022, Art. 14 II) so that small-scale controllers must communicate to ANPD and the data subject incidents that may cause relevant risk or damage under this Regulation.
applies_from: na data da sua publicação (Resolução, Art. 3)
provision: Art. 2 (amending Resolução CD/ANPD nº 2/2022, Art. 14 II)
quote: II - no caso da comunicação, à ANPD e ao titular, da ocorrência de incidente de segurança que possa acarretar risco ou dano relevante aos titulares
conditional_on: agentes de tratamento de pequeno porte

summary: Controller must communicate to ANPD and to the data subject incidents that may cause relevant risk or damage to data subjects.
applies_from: na data da sua publicação (Resolução, Art. 3)
quote: O controlador deverá comunicar à ANPD e ao titular a ocorrência de incidente de segurança que possa acarretar risco ou dano relevante aos titulares.

summary: Communication to ANPD within three business days of the controller learning the incident affected personal data, unless a specific legal deadline applies; must contain the items in §2, be made by electronic form (§4), and be made by the encarregado with proof of relationship or representation powers (§5); supplementary information may be added within twenty business days (§3).
applies_from: na data da sua publicação (Resolução, Art. 3)
quote: A comunicação de incidente de segurança à ANPD deverá ser realizada pelo controlador no prazo de três dias úteis
conditional_on: ressalvada a existência de prazo para comunicação previsto em legislação específica

summary: Controller may request, with reasons, confidentiality from ANPD for information protected by law, such as commercial or industrial secrets.
applies_from: na data da sua publicação (Resolução, Art. 3)
quote: Cabe ao controlador solicitar à ANPD, de maneira fundamentada, o sigilo de informações protegidas por lei

summary: ANPD may request additional information from the controller about the incident, including processing records, DPIA and incident treatment report, setting a deadline.
applies_from: na data da sua publicação (Resolução, Art. 3)
quote: A ANPD poderá, a qualquer tempo, solicitar informações adicionais ao controlador

summary: Communication to the data subject within three business days of the controller learning the incident affected personal data, with the items in §caput; in plain language; directly and individually where possible, otherwise by public disclosure for at least three months (§§1-3).
applies_from: na data da sua publicação (Resolução, Art. 3)
quote: A comunicação de incidente de segurança ao titular deverá ser realizada pelo controlador no prazo de três dias úteis

summary: Controller must file in the ANPD process a declaration that the data subjects were notified, with the means used, within three business days after the Art. 9 deadline ends.
applies_from: na data da sua publicação (Resolução, Art. 3)
quote: O controlador deverá juntar ao processo de comunicação de incidente uma declaração de que foi realizada a comunicação aos titulares

summary: Controller must keep a record of every security incident, including unreported ones, for at least five years from the date of registration, with minimum contents listed in §1; §2 exempts entities under LGPD Art. 23 subject to archival rules.
applies_from: na data da sua publicação (Resolução, Art. 3)
quote: O controlador deverá manter o registro do incidente de segurança, inclusive daquele não comunicado à ANPD e aos titulares, pelo prazo mínimo de cinco anos

summary: ANPD may at any time carry out, or order, audits or inspections of processing agents to collect information or validate information received.
applies_from: na data da sua publicação (Resolução, Art. 3)
quote: A ANPD poderá, a qualquer momento, realizar auditorias ou inspeções junto aos agentes de tratamento

summary: ANPD may analyse incident communication processes in aggregate and adopt standardised measures, in line with its monitoring cycle report.
applies_from: na data da sua publicação (Resolução, Art. 3)
quote: Os processos de comunicação de incidente de segurança poderão ser analisados de forma agregada

summary: During the process, ANPD may order the controller, with or without prior hearing, to adopt immediate preventive measures to safeguard data subjects' rights.
applies_from: na data da sua publicação (Resolução, Art. 3)
quote: a ANPD poderá determinar ao controlador, com ou sem a sua prévia manifestação, a adoção imediata de medidas preventivas

summary: Controller must adopt immediate preventive measures when ANPD so orders under Art. 15, to prevent, mitigate or reverse the effects of the incident.
applies_from: na data da sua publicação (Resolução, Art. 3)
quote: a adoção imediata de medidas preventivas necessárias para salvaguardar direitos dos titulares
conditional_on: determinação da ANPD nos termos do Art. 15

summary: ANPD may investigate, through its incident investigation procedure, incidents with relevant risk that the controller did not report, and may request information for that purpose.
applies_from: na data da sua publicação (Resolução, Art. 3)
quote: A ANPD poderá apurar, por meio do procedimento de apuração de incidente de segurança, a ocorrência de incidentes

summary: Where ANPD establishes an incident, it directs the controller to send the communication to the authority and to data subjects, under the deadlines in Arts. 6 and 9.
applies_from: na data da sua publicação (Resolução, Art. 3)
quote: a ANPD determinará ao controlador o envio da comunicação à Autoridade e aos titulares
conditional_on: constatada a ocorrência de incidente de segurança pela ANPD

summary: After assessing severity, ANPD may order the controller to take measures to safeguard data subjects, such as wide disclosure of the incident in the media and measures to reverse or mitigate its effects.
applies_from: na data da sua publicação (Resolução, Art. 3)
quote: a ANPD poderá determinar ao controlador a adoção de providências para a salvaguarda dos direitos dos titulares

summary: When direct communication is insufficient to reach a significant part of affected data subjects, ANPD may order wide media disclosure of the incident at the controller's expense, in a manner proportionate to the controller's reach (§§3-5).
applies_from: na data da sua publicação (Resolução, Art. 3)
quote: a ANPD poderá determinar ampla divulgação do incidente em meios de comunicação, às expensas do controlador
conditional_on: comunicação do controlador insuficiente para parcela significativa dos titulares afetados (Art. 19 §3)

summary: ANPD may publish aggregated statistical information on security incidents on its website as active transparency.
applies_from: na data da sua publicação (Resolução, Art. 3)
quote: a ANPD poderá divulgar, em seu sítio eletrônico, informações estatísticas agregadas relativas aos incidentes de segurança

summary: Even after the process is declared extinct for lack of risk or damage (Art. 23 II), ANPD may order security measures directly related to the incident.
applies_from: na data da sua publicação (Resolução, Art. 3)
quote: a ANPD poderá determinar a adoção de medidas de segurança diretamente relacionadas ao incidente
conditional_on: extinção do processo nos termos do Art. 23 II

summary: Controller must verify whether an operation is an international transfer, whether it is subject to Brazilian law, and whether it rests on a valid legal basis and transfer mechanism.
quote: Cabe ao controlador verificar

summary: Processor must assist the controller by providing the information it holds that is needed for that verification.
quote: O operador prestará auxílio ao controlador

summary: Controller and processor must adopt effective measures able to demonstrate compliance with data protection rules, proportionate to the risk and to the transfer mechanism used.
quote: O controlador e o operador deverão adotar medidas eficazes e capazes de comprovar a observância

summary: International transfers may be made only for legitimate, specific and explicit purposes informed to the data subject, without incompatible further processing, and must be limited to the minimum necessary; a legal basis under LGPD art. 7 or 11 and a valid transfer mechanism are required.
quote: A transferência internacional de dados somente poderá ser realizada para atender a propósitos legítimos

summary: ANPD may recognise, by adequacy decision, the equivalence of the data protection level of a foreign country or international organisation.
quote: A ANPD poderá reconhecer, mediante decisão de adequação,

summary: Adequacy procedure is instructed by the technical area, reviewed by the Federal Specialised Prosecutor, and decided by the Board; adequacy decisions are issued by Board Resolution and published on the ANPD website.
quote: A decisão de adequação será proferida por Resolução do Conselho Diretor

summary: Reliance on standard contractual clauses requires their full adoption without alteration of the Annex II text, through a contract between exporter and importer.
quote: a adoção integral e sem alteração do texto disponibilizado no Anexo II
conditional_on: Transfer relies on standard contractual clauses

summary: On request, controller must provide the data subject with the full text of the clauses used for the transfer, subject to trade and industrial secrets, within 15 days; controller must also publish on its website a simple-language document on the transfer.
quote: O controlador deverá disponibilizar ao titular, em caso de solicitação, a íntegra das cláusulas

summary: ANPD may recognise the equivalence of standard contractual clauses of other countries or international organisations with the Annex II clauses.
quote: A ANPD poderá reconhecer a equivalência de cláusulas-padrão contratuais

summary: Clauses recognised as equivalent are approved by Board Resolution and published on the ANPD website.
quote: serão aprovadas por Resolução do Conselho Diretor

summary: Specific contractual clauses must provide for application of Brazilian data protection law to the transfer and for submission to ANPD supervision.
quote: as cláusulas contratuais específicas deverão prever a aplicação da legislação nacional de proteção de dados pessoais
conditional_on: Specific contractual clauses are used

summary: Controller must submit the full text of the clauses, including specific clauses, for ANPD approval.
quote: O controlador deverá apresentar a íntegra das cláusulas
conditional_on: Specific contractual clauses are used

summary: In clauses submitted for approval, controller must use the standard clause wording where possible and identify and justify each specific clause adopted.
quote: adotar, sempre que possível, a redação das cláusulas-padrão contratuais
conditional_on: Clauses are submitted to ANPD approval

summary: Global corporate rules must be linked to implementation of a privacy governance programme meeting the minimum conditions of LGPD art. 50 § 2.
quote: deverão estar vinculadas à implementação de programa de governança em privacidade
conditional_on: Global corporate rules are used

summary: Global corporate rules must contain at least: description of transfers, countries, group structure, binding nature, allocation of responsibility, data subject rights, review process with prior ANPD approval, and notice to ANPD of changes in guarantees.
quote: as normas corporativas globais deverão conter, no mínimo:
conditional_on: Global corporate rules are used

summary: Global corporate rules must indicate the applicable data subject rights and the means of exercising them, including an easy-access channel and the right to petition ANPD.
quote: indicação dos direitos dos titulares aplicáveis e os meios para o seu exercício
conditional_on: Global corporate rules are used

summary: Global corporate rules must provide for communication to ANPD of changes in guarantees, especially where a group member is subject to a foreign legal requirement that prevents compliance.
quote: previsão de comunicação à ANPD em caso de alterações nas garantias
conditional_on: Global corporate rules are used

summary: Global corporate rules must provide for immediate notification to the responsible entity when a group member abroad is subject to a legal requirement preventing compliance, unless legally prohibited.
quote: a norma corporativa global deve prever obrigação de notificação imediata à entidade responsável
conditional_on: Global corporate rules are used

summary: Specific contractual clauses and global corporate rules must be submitted to ANPD approval.
quote: deverão ser submetidas à aprovação da ANPD
conditional_on: Specific clauses or global corporate rules are used

summary: Approval request must be accompanied at minimum by the full clauses or rules, constitutional documents, any prior authority decision, and proof of compliance with Chapter VI or VII.
quote: deverá ser instruído, conforme o caso, com, no mínimo:
conditional_on: Approval request for specific clauses or global corporate rules

summary: The technical area analyses approval requests and the Board decides after the Federal Specialised Prosecutor's opinion.
quote: será analisado pela área técnica competente

summary: ANPD publishes on its website a list of approved specific clauses and global corporate rules, with applicant, approval date and Board decision, and publishes full text of specific clauses that other controllers may use.
quote: A ANPD publicará em seu sítio eletrônico a relação das cláusulas contratuais específicas

summary: On request, controller must provide the data subject with the full text of approved specific clauses or global corporate rules, and publish a simple-language document on the transfer.
quote: O controlador deverá disponibilizar ao titular, em caso de solicitação, a íntegra das cláusulas contratuais específicas
conditional_on: Specific clauses or global corporate rules are used

summary: Changes to specific clauses and global corporate rules require prior ANPD approval.
quote: dependem de prévia aprovação da ANPD

summary: Board may establish a simplified approval procedure for changes that do not affect the guarantees presented.
quote: O Conselho Diretor poderá estabelecer procedimento simplificado para a aprovação de alterações

summary: Agents using contractual clauses for international transfers must incorporate the ANPD-approved standard contractual clauses into their contract instruments within 12 months of publication of the Resolution.
applies_from: 12 months from publication of the Resolution
provision: Resolução CD/ANPD nº 19, Art. 2 parágrafo único
quote: deverão incorporar as cláusulas-padrão contratuais aprovadas pela ANPD
conditional_on: Agents use contractual clauses for international transfers

summary: Importer may not carry out onward transfers except as provided in clause 18.3 (applies where Option A is chosen).
quote: O Importador não poderá realizar Transferência Posterior
conditional_on: Option A of clause 3 is chosen

summary: Parties must keep records of personal data security incidents as required by national law.
quote: As Partes devem manter o registro de incidentes de segurança com dados pessoais

summary: Parties must adopt and, when necessary, demonstrate effective measures to comply with the clauses and national law; they must also limit use to the specified purposes.
quote: As Partes se comprometem a adotar e, quando necessário, demonstrar a adoção de medidas eficazes

summary: Parties must limit processing to the minimum necessary for their purposes, with relevant, proportionate and non-excessive data.
quote: limitar o tratamento ao mínimo necessário para a realização de suas finalidades

summary: Parties must guarantee data subjects clear information on processing and agents, easy and free consultation, and accuracy and updating of data, subject to clause 4.
quote: garantir aos Titulares, observado o disposto na Cláusula 4.

summary: Parties must adopt security measures appropriate to the risks of the transfer.
quote: adotar as medidas de segurança apropriadas e compatíveis com os riscos

summary: Parties may not process personal data for unlawful or abusive discriminatory purposes.
quote: não realizar tratamento de Dados Pessoais para fins discriminatórios ilícitos ou abusivos

summary: Parties must maintain records of processing operations and present the documentation to ANPD on request.
quote: manter registro das operações de tratamento dos Dados Pessoais

summary: Where sensitive personal data are transferred, parties must apply additional safeguards, including specific security measures proportionate to the risks.
quote: as Partes aplicarão salvaguardas adicionais, incluindo medidas de segurança específicas
conditional_on: Transfer involves sensitive personal data

summary: Where personal data of children and adolescents are transferred, parties must apply additional safeguards, including measures ensuring processing in their best interest.
quote: as Partes aplicarão salvaguardas adicionais, incluindo medidas que assegurem
conditional_on: Transfer involves personal data of children and adolescents

summary: Exporter warrants that the personal data were collected, processed and transferred in accordance with national law.
quote: O Exportador garante que os Dados Pessoais foram coletados

summary: Designated party publishes on its website a simple-language document on the transfer; on request, parties provide a copy of the clauses free of charge; information to data subjects must be in Portuguese.
quote: A Parte Designada publicará, em sua página na Internet, documento contendo informações

summary: Designated party must respond to data subject requests (access, correction, anonymisation or deletion, portability, revocation of consent, review of automated decisions and others) within 15 days; the non-designated party must forward or refer requests.
quote: O prazo para atendimento às solicitações previstas nesta Cláusula e no item 14.3. é de 15 (quinze) dias

summary: Parties must immediately inform those with whom data were shared of corrections, deletions, anonymisation or blocking, unless impossible or disproportionate.
quote: As Partes deverão informar, imediatamente, aos Agentes de Tratamento

summary: Designated party must report to ANPD and data subjects, within 3 business days, security incidents that may cause relevant risk or damage to data subjects.
quote: A Parte Designada deverá comunicar à ANPD e aos Titulares, no prazo de 3 (três) dias úteis

summary: Importer must keep a register of security incidents as national law requires.
quote: O Importador deve manter o registro de incidentes de segurança

summary: Importer making onward transfers must ensure purpose compatibility and bind the recipient by written contract to the clause safeguards.
quote: deve garantir, mediante instrumento contratual escrito, que as salvaguardas previstas nestas Cláusulas serão observadas pelo terceiro destinatário
conditional_on: Onward transfer is made

summary: Importer must notify the exporter and the data subject of an access request from authorities, unless notification is legally prohibited.
quote: O Importador notificará o Exportador e o Titular sobre Solicitação de Acesso
conditional_on: Access request received

summary: Importer must take appropriate legal measures, including court action, to protect data subjects where there is adequate legal ground to challenge an access request.
quote: O Importador adotará as medidas legais cabíveis
conditional_on: Adequate legal ground to challenge an access request

summary: Importer must keep a register of access requests (date, requester, purpose, data types, number of requests and legal measures taken), for ANPD and the exporter.
quote: o Importador deve manter registro de Solicitações de Acesso

summary: Parties must delete personal data after processing ends, except for the purposes listed in clause 20.1.
quote: As Partes deverão eliminar os Dados Pessoais
conditional_on: Processing has ended

summary: Parties must adopt security measures protecting personal data, including after the transfer ends, and carry out periodic evaluation and review of those measures.
quote: As Partes deverão adotar medidas de segurança que garantam proteção aos Dados Pessoais

summary: Importer must promptly notify the exporter of a change in law or practice that alters its ability to comply with the clauses.
quote: o Importador notificará, de imediato, o Exportador
conditional_on: Change in law or practice in the recipient country

summary: On breach or impossibility of compliance by the importer, exporter may suspend the transfer, request return, transfer or deletion of the data, or terminate the contract.
quote: podendo, conforme o caso:
conditional_on: Breach or impossibility of compliance by the importer

summary: Small-scale processing agents must, when asked by the ANPD, prove within fifteen days that they meet the qualification conditions of Arts. 2 and 3.
applies_from: within fifteen days of the ANPD's request
quote: Caberá ao agente de tratamento de pequeno porte, quando solicitado pela ANPD, comprovar que se enquadra nas disposições do art. 2º e do art. 3º deste regulamento em até quinze dias.
conditional_on: when requested by the ANPD

summary: Small-scale agents must make information on processing available and respond to data subject requests under Arts. 9 and 18 LGPD, by electronic, printed or other accessible means.
quote: Os agentes de tratamento de pequeno porte devem disponibilizar informações sobre o tratamento de dados pessoais e atender às requisições dos titulares

summary: Small-scale agents may organise through representative entities, legal persons or natural persons to negotiate, mediate and conciliate complaints from data subjects.
quote: Fica facultado aos agentes de tratamento de pequeno porte, inclusive àqueles que realizem tratamento de alto risco, organizarem-se

summary: Small-scale agents may comply with the duty to keep records of processing operations (LGPD Art. 37) in simplified form.
quote: podem cumprir a obrigação de elaboração e manutenção de registro das operações de tratamento de dados pessoais

summary: The ANPD shall provide a model for the simplified processing record.
quote: A ANPD fornecerá modelo para o registro simplificado de que trata o caput.

summary: The ANPD shall set out flexibilisation or a simplified procedure for security incident communication for small-scale agents, by specific regulation.
quote: A ANPD disporá sobre flexibilização ou procedimento simplificado de comunicação de incidente de segurança

summary: Small-scale agents that do not appoint a data protection officer must provide a communication channel for data subjects.
quote: deve disponibilizar um canal de comunicação com o titular de dados
conditional_on: where the agent does not appoint an encarregado

summary: Small-scale agents must adopt essential and necessary administrative and technical measures based on minimum information security requirements, taking account of privacy risk and their own reality.
quote: devem adotar medidas administrativas e técnicas essenciais e necessárias, com base em requisitos mínimos de segurança da informação

summary: Small-scale agents may establish a simplified information security policy, taking into account implementation costs and their structure, scale and volume of operations.
quote: podem estabelecer política simplificada de segurança da informação

summary: Small-scale agents may provide the simplified declaration under LGPD Art. 19(I) within fifteen days of the data subject's request.
applies_from: within fifteen days from the data subject's request
quote: podem fornecer a declaração simplificada de que trata o art. 19, I, da LGPD no prazo de até quinze dias

summary: The ANPD may direct a small-scale agent to comply with obligations otherwise waived or relaxed, considering the nature or volume of operations and risks to data subjects.
quote: A ANPD poderá determinar ao agente de tratamento de pequeno porte o cumprimento das obrigações dispensadas ou flexibilizadas
conditional_on: considering the relevant circumstances of the situation

summary: Sanction decisions must be reasoned, stating facts and legal grounds, and must apply the sanction under the parameters of LGPD art. 52 §1 and ANPD regulation (amending text inserted into Resolução CD/ANPD nº 1/2021, Art. 55 §1).
applies_from: date of publication (Resolução CD/ANPD nº 4/2023, Art. 4)
quote: A decisão será motivada, com indicação dos fatos e dos fundamentos jurídicos

summary: Where measures are imposed on the infringer, the decision must also state, where applicable, the execution term and verification conditions, and the value and payment period of any simple or daily fine (amending text inserted into Resolução CD/ANPD nº 1/2021, Art. 55 §2).
applies_from: date of publication (Resolução CD/ANPD nº 4/2023, Art. 4)
quote: a decisão também deverá conter, quando aplicável:
conditional_on: where measures of a positive or negative obligation are imposed

summary: After a decision is maintained or partly reconsidered, the General Coordination of Enforcement must forward the case to the Board of Directors with an admissibility and merits analysis (amending text inserted into Resolução CD/ANPD nº 1/2021, Art. 62 §3).
applies_from: date of publication (Resolução CD/ANPD nº 4/2023, Art. 4)
quote: a Coordenação-Geral de Fiscalização remeterá o processo ao Conselho Diretor

summary: During the investigation phase, ANPD must inform the principal sectoral regulator of the controller, so that it can comment on the consequences of suspension or prohibition sanctions for regulated activities.
applies_from: date of publication (Resolução CD/ANPD nº 4/2023, Art. 4)
quote: a ANPD dará ciência ao principal órgão ou entidade reguladora setorial
conditional_on: when sanctions under Art. 3, VII to IX are considered

summary: Sanctions may be applied only after an administrative procedure with a reasoned ANPD decision, guaranteeing defence, adversarial process and due process.
applies_from: date of publication (Resolução CD/ANPD nº 4/2023, Art. 4)
quote: As sanções serão aplicadas após procedimento administrativo mediante decisão fundamentada da ANPD

summary: Where there are several infringers, sanctions must be applied individually to each.
applies_from: date of publication (Resolução CD/ANPD nº 4/2023, Art. 4)
quote: as sanções serão aplicadas de forma individualizada
conditional_on: where there is a plurality of infringers

summary: Sanction notification and the counting of time limits under the Regulation are to follow the Enforcement Process Regulation (Resolução CD/ANPD nº 1/2021).
applies_from: date of publication (Resolução CD/ANPD nº 4/2023, Art. 4)
quote: A intimação da sanção e a contagem dos prazos previstos neste Regulamento serão realizadas conforme o disposto

summary: In defining a sanction, ANPD must consider the listed parameters and criteria (gravity, good faith, advantage, economic condition, recidivism, degree of harm, cooperation, governance practices, corrective measures, proportionality).
applies_from: date of publication (Resolução CD/ANPD nº 4/2023, Art. 4)
quote: Na definição da sanção, devem ser considerados os seguintes parâmetros e critérios

summary: ANPD classifies infringements as minor, medium or serious according to the gravity and nature of the infringement and the personal rights affected, with the criteria in §§ 2 and 3.
applies_from: date of publication (Resolução CD/ANPD nº 4/2023, Art. 4)
quote: As infrações são classificadas, segundo a gravidade e a natureza das infrações

summary: The base value of a simple fine is calculated for each infringement using the methodology in Appendix I, considering the infringement classification, the turnover of the infringer and the degree of harm.
applies_from: date of publication (Resolução CD/ANPD nº 4/2023, Art. 4)
quote: será utilizada, para cada infração cometida, a metodologia descrita no Apêndice I deste Regulamento
conditional_on: when a simple fine is applied

summary: The result of applying aggravating and mitigating circumstances may not fall below the minimum values in Appendix II, and is capped at 2% of Brazilian turnover or R$ 50,000,000.00.
applies_from: date of publication (Resolução CD/ANPD nº 4/2023, Art. 4)
quote: não poderá ser inferior aos valores mínimos previstos no Apêndice II deste Regulamento
conditional_on: when a simple fine is calculated

summary: Upon notice of a blocking sanction, the infringer must immediately notify the processing agents with which it shares data so that they repeat the blocking, unless this is impossible or disproportionate.
applies_from: date of publication (Resolução CD/ANPD nº 4/2023, Art. 4)
quote: O infrator deverá, assim que intimado da sanção de que trata o caput, comunicar imediatamente o bloqueio dos dados
conditional_on: after notice of the blocking sanction

summary: Upon notice of an elimination sanction, the infringer must immediately notify the processing agents with which it shares data so that they repeat the elimination, unless this is impossible or disproportionate.
applies_from: date of publication (Resolução CD/ANPD nº 4/2023, Art. 4)
quote: comunicar imediatamente a eliminação dos dados aos agentes de tratamento
conditional_on: after notice of the elimination sanction

summary: When the period for suspending a database is set, ANPD must consider public interest, the impact on data subjects' rights, the infringement classification and the complexity of regularisation.
applies_from: date of publication (Resolução CD/ANPD nº 4/2023, Art. 4)
quote: a ANPD deverá considerar o interesse público, o impacto aos direitos dos titulares de dados pessoais
conditional_on: when a partial suspension of a database is applied

quote: Poderão habilitar-se ao Padis as pessoas jurídicas que realizem investimento em pesquisa, desenvolvimento e inovação na forma do art. 6º desta Lei e que exerçam no País
conditional_on: Habilitação granted under Art. 5-A; applies to the activities listed in Art. 2 incisos I to IV

summary: A PADIS beneficiary claiming the reduction in Art. 4 inciso III must show in its accounts the revenue, cost, expense and result elements of the sales concerned, segregated from other activities (Art. 4 §3).
provision: Art. 4º §3º (text as amended by Lei nº 14.968, de 2024)
quote: a pessoa jurídica deverá demonstrar em sua contabilidade os elementos que compõem as receitas
conditional_on: Claiming the reduction of Art. 4 inciso III

summary: The tax amount not paid under the Art. 4 reduction may not be distributed to partners and must be kept as a capital reserve usable only to absorb losses or increase capital (Art. 4 §4).
provision: Art. 4º §4º (text as amended by Lei nº 14.968, de 2024)
quote: não poderá ser distribuído aos sócios e constituirá reserva de capital
conditional_on: Tax reduction under Art. 4

summary: The Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation shall carry out a five-yearly evaluation of the policy from 2029, with possible reorientation of goals and instruments under a regulation it issues (Art. 4-A §5); a minimum adaptation period of 24 months applies to any reorientation (§6).
quote: A partir de 2029, será realizada avaliação quinquenal da política
conditional_on: Possible reorientation of goals and instruments

summary: The beneficiary must submit to the Ministry of Science, Technology, Innovation and Communications an investment declaration with the minimum content listed in Art. 4-D, in the form and time limits set by ministry act, only after all R&D investments for the period are made (Art. 4-D §2).
applies_from: Form and deadlines as set by ministry act; submission only after all R&D investment for the period is made
quote: A pessoa jurídica deverá apresentar ao Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia, Inovações e Comunicações
conditional_on: Claiming financial credit under Art. 4-A

summary: When analysing the Art. 4-D declaration, the Ministry must certify that the company is enrolled in the programme, has filed the prior-year compliance report, has no pending R&D debts, and that the credit is consistent with Art. 4-A and gross revenue (Art. 4-D §4); it forwards the certification to the Federal Revenue Service (§6).
quote: deverá certificar que
conditional_on: Analysis of the Art. 4-D declaration

summary: To use the financial credit compensation, the beneficiary must record and keep in its accounts, segregated from other activities, the revenue, cost and expense elements used to compute the credit, and provide them to government bodies on request (Art. 4-E §15).
quote: a pessoa jurídica deverá registrar e manter em sua contabilidade
conditional_on: Use of compensation of financial credits

summary: After remedying the irregularities that led to a suspension or impediment under Art. 4-G, the beneficiary must notify the Ministry of Economy and the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation so it can again compute and use the credit (Art. 4-G §5).
quote: deverá comunicar o saneamento ao Ministério da Economia
conditional_on: Suspension or impediment under Art. 4-G

summary: The Ministry of Economy and the Ministry of Science, Technology, Innovation and Communications shall regulate the Art. 4-G provisions by joint act.
quote: regulamentarão, mediante ato conjunto, as disposições deste artigo

summary: PADIS habilitation is to be granted by a specific act of the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation, conditioned on tax regularity, and the Ministry must decide habilitation requests within 60 days of filing, with the clock suspended when corrections are required (Art. 5-A §4).
quote: deverá ser concedida por ato específico condicionado à regularidade fiscal
conditional_on: Tax regularity of the applicant

summary: The beneficiary must invest in Brazil annually in R&D and innovation at least 5% of the gross revenue base (Art. 6 caput). Art. 6 §2 requires at least 1% of gross revenue, net of taxes, to be applied through agreements with research institutions or Brazilian teaching entities accredited by CATI or CAPDA; §3 requires intellectual property from the R&D to be protected in Brazil by the beneficiary.
provision: Art. 6º (text as amended by Lei nº 14.968, de 2024)
quote: deverá investir no País, anualmente, em atividades de pesquisa, desenvolvimento e inovação, no mínimo, o valor equivalente a 5% (cinco por cento)
conditional_on: Beneficiary of PADIS

summary: By 31 July each year the beneficiary must send the Ministry of Science, Technology and Innovation descriptive reports of prior-year R&D activities and results, and the consolidated report and opinion from an independent auditor (Art. 7 I and II; §5 sets the 31 July deadline).
provision: Art. 7º (text as amended by Lei nº 14.968, de 2024)
quote: deverá encaminhar ao Ministério da Ciência, Tecnologia e Inovação
conditional_on: Beneficiary of PADIS

summary: An independent auditor accredited by the Comissão de Valores Mobiliários and registered with the Ministry prepares a consolidated report and opinion attesting to the accuracy of the beneficiary's information (Art. 7 II); the report is due by 30 September (§6); the auditor fee may be deducted from the 4% complement under §3; the report is mandatory from ano-calendário 2019 (§4) and may be waived for firms below R$ 10,000,000.00 (§2).
provision: Art. 7º II (inserted by Lei nº 13.969, de 2019)
quote: elaborados por auditoria independente credenciada na Comissão de Valores Mobiliários (CVM)
conditional_on: Waiver possible for firms whose annual R&D base is below R$ 10.000.000,00 (§2)

summary: If annual R&D investment does not reach the Art. 6 minimum, the beneficiary must apply the residual amount to the FNDCT, with a 20% fine and SELIC interest (Art. 8 caput); the application is due by the last business day of March of the following year (§1); a failure to apply it triggers the consequences in §2 to §6.
applies_from: By the last business day of March of the year after the shortfall (§1)
quote: deverá aplicar o valor residual no Fundo Nacional de Desenvolvimento Científico e Tecnológico
conditional_on: Annual R&D investment below the Art. 6 minimum

summary: The Ministry of Science and Technology must notify the Federal Revenue Service of cases of non-submission of reports, non-application to the FNDCT, non-approval of reports, or breach of PADIS regulations (Art. 10 I to III); cases under item I must be notified by 30 August each year and others within 30 days after the finding (sole paragraph).
applies_from: By 30 August each year for Art. 10 I cases; within 30 days for other cases
quote: deverá comunicar à Secretaria da Receita Federal os casos de
conditional_on: Occurrence of the listed cases

summary: The Ministries of Science and Technology and of Development, Industry and Foreign Trade must publish a report on the economic and technological results of the Chapter I provisions every three years (Art. 11 caput); the Executive must also publish the incentive modalities and amounts and the R&D spending per company and per project (sole paragraph).
quote: divulgarão, a cada 3 (três) anos, relatório com os resultados econômicos e tecnológicos

summary: Protection of integrated circuit layout topographies depends on registration, which the Instituto Nacional de Propriedade Industrial (INPI) carries out.
quote: A proteção depende do registro, que será efetuado pelo Instituto Nacional de Propriedade Industrial – INPI.
conditional_on: Registration as the basis of protection

summary: A registration application must relate to a single topography and contain a request, a description of the topography and its function, drawings or photographs, a declaration of any prior exploitation, and proof of fee payment; the application and accompanying documents must be in Portuguese (Art. 31 and sole paragraph).
quote: O pedido de registro deverá referir-se a uma única topografia
conditional_on: Application for registration of an integrated circuit layout topography

summary: INPI carries out a formal examination of a registration application and may issue requirements, which must be met in full within 60 days on pain of definitive filing (Art. 33 and sole paragraph).
applies_from: Requirements to be met within 60 days
quote: o Inpi fará exame formal, podendo formular exigências as quais deverão ser cumpridas integralmente no prazo de 60 (sessenta) dias
conditional_on: Filing of a registration application

summary: Where no requirements are outstanding or they are fully met, INPI grants the registration, publishes it in full and issues the certificate (Art. 34).
quote: o Inpi concederá o registro, publicando-o na íntegra e expedindo o respectivo certificado
conditional_on: No requirements outstanding or requirements fully met

summary: Third parties may not, without the holder's consent, reproduce the topography or import, sell or distribute for commercial purposes a protected topography or an integrated circuit or product incorporating it (Art. 36 I to III).
quote: sendo vedado a terceiros sem o consentimento do titular
conditional_on: Protection under the registration; exceptions in Art. 37

summary: INPI makes annotations of assignments, of limitations or encumbrances on the registration, and of changes of the holder's name, seat or address (Art. 42 I to III).
quote: O Inpi fará as seguintes anotações

summary: INPI records licence contracts so that they have effect against third parties (Art. 45).
quote: O Inpi averbará os contratos de licença para produzir efeitos em relação a terceiros.
conditional_on: Licence contracts for topographies

summary: A licensee must begin exploiting the protected object within one year, subject to one extension of equal length and one interruption of equal length, requested from INPI (Art. 53 I and II and §1); if exploitation does not begin, the licence is extinguished (§2).
quote: O licenciado deverá iniciar a exploração do objeto da proteção no prazo de 1 (um) ano
conditional_on: Compulsory or contractual licence of a topography

summary: A person domiciled abroad must appoint and maintain an attorney domiciled in Brazil with powers to represent it administratively and judicially, including to receive service of process (Art. 56).
quote: a pessoa domiciliada no exterior deverá constituir e manter procurador
conditional_on: Person domiciled abroad acting under Chapter III

summary: Amends Lei 8.666/1993 art. 24 by adding inciso XXVIII, which allows public bodies to dispense with bidding for supplies of goods and services produced or provided in Brazil that combine high technological complexity and national defence, on the opinion of a commission designated by the head of the body.
applies_from: From 19 February 2007 for the amended article (Art. 67)
quote: mediante parecer de comissão especialmente designada pela autoridade máxima do órgão
conditional_on: Opinion of a commission specially designated by the head of the body

summary: Development, implementation and use of excessive-risk AI systems is prohibited: harmful behavioural manipulation, exploitation of vulnerabilities, crime-risk assessment from personality or past behaviour, enabling child sexual abuse material, and autonomous weapons. Binds all agents (developers, distributors, deployers).
quote: São vedados o desenvolvimento, a implementação e o uso de sistemas de IA

summary: Public authorities may not use AI to evaluate, classify or rank people by social behaviour or personality through universal scoring for access to goods, services and public policies in an illegitimate or disproportionate way.
quote: pelo poder público, para avaliar, classificar ou ranquear as pessoas naturais, com base no seu comportamento social ou em atributos da sua personalidade, por meio de pontuação universal

summary: Real-time remote biometric identification in publicly accessible spaces is banned except for criminal investigations with prior judicial authorisation, searches for victims and missing persons or imminent threats to life, flagrante delicto of crimes punishable by over 2 years, and recapture of fugitives or execution of warrants; permitted use must be proportional, under judicial control, with review of the algorithmic inference by the responsible official.
quote: em sistemas de identificação biométrica à distância, em tempo real e em espaços acessíveis ao público, com exceção das seguintes hipóteses
conditional_on: One of the exceptions in Art. 13 IV a-d applies

summary: Developers must adopt measures to prevent their systems being used for the prohibited purposes of Art. 13.
quote: Os desenvolvedores de sistemas de IA devem adotar medidas para coibir o uso de seus sistemas para as hipóteses descritas no caput deste artigo.

summary: Persons affected by any AI system have a right to free, accessible information about their interactions with AI, including its automated nature, given with standardised icons or symbols (except cybersecurity and cyberdefence systems).
quote: direito à informação quanto às suas interações com sistemas de IA, de forma acessível, gratuita e de fácil compreensão, inclusive sobre caráter automatizado da interação

summary: AI systems intended for vulnerable groups must be transparent throughout their life cycle, use simple, age- and capacity-appropriate language and be implemented in those groups' best interest.
quote: Os sistemas de IA que se destinem a grupos vulneráveis deverão, em todas as etapas de seu ciclo de vida, ser transparentes e adotar linguagem simples, clara e apropriada à idade e à capacidade cognitiva

summary: Persons affected by high-risk AI have rights to an explanation of decisions, recommendations or predictions, to contest them and to human review; explanations must be free, in simple language and within a reasonable time, under procedures set by the competent authority (simplified for small firms).
quote: A pessoa ou grupo afetado por sistema de IA de alto risco tem os seguintes direitos: I – direito à explicação sobre a decisão, a recomendação ou a previsão feitas pelo sistema

summary: Agents of high-risk AI must inform affected persons, clearly and accessibly, of the procedures for exercising their rights.
quote: Os agentes de IA de alto risco informarão, de forma suficiente, objetiva, clara e acessível, os procedimentos necessários para o exercício dos direitos descritos neste Capítulo.

summary: High-risk AI systems must be subject to human oversight enabling responsible persons to understand, interpret, decide and intervene; where oversight is demonstrably impossible or disproportionate, effective alternative measures are required.
quote: A supervisão humana de sistemas de IA de alto risco buscará prevenir ou minimizar os riscos para direitos e liberdades das pessoas ou grupos afetados

summary: All AI agents (developers, distributors, deployers) must ensure the security of systems and respect for the rights of affected persons, as regulated.
quote: Os agentes de IA deverão garantir a segurança dos sistemas e o atendimento dos direitos de pessoas ou grupos afetados, nos termos de regulamento.

summary: Deployers placing high-risk systems on the market must keep life-cycle documentation, monitor outputs for accuracy, robustness and discriminatory results, document tests and the degree of human oversight, mitigate bias and provide information to interpret results.
quote: o desenvolvedor e o aplicador, ao introduzirem ou colocarem em circulação no mercado sistema de alto risco, adotarão, entre outras, as seguintes medidas de governança
conditional_on: Sectoral authorities may relax or waive these obligations depending on the agent's role in the value chain (Art. 18 §1)

summary: Developers of high-risk systems must keep records of governance measures for deployers, log system operation, test for safety, adopt technical measures for explainability, mitigate bias and be transparent about governance policies.
quote: manutenção de registro das medidas de governança adotadas no desenvolvimento do sistema de IA, para prestação das informações necessárias ao aplicador
conditional_on: Sectoral authorities may relax or waive these obligations depending on the agent's role in the value chain (Art. 18 §1)

summary: Distributors must support and verify that a high-risk AI system complies with the governance measures of the Law before it is placed on the market.
quote: Os distribuidores deverão apoiar e verificar se o sistema de IA cumpre as medidas de governança previstas nesta Lei, antes de o sistema ser colocado em circulação no mercado

summary: Agents in the AI value chain must cooperate, sharing information, technical access and assistance needed for high-risk governance obligations; a deployer or distributor that substantially modifies a system or changes its purpose is treated as its developer.
quote: Os agentes da cadeia de valor de sistema ou aplicação de IA devem cooperar entre si, disponibilizando as informações necessárias

summary: AI systems that generate synthetic content must embed an identifier allowing verification of authenticity, provenance, modification or transmission, considering the state of the art and context of use; artistic works may be labelled in credits or metadata.
quote: Quando o sistema de IA gerar conteúdo sintético, deverá, considerando o estado da arte do desenvolvimento tecnológico e o contexto de uso, incluir identificador em tais conteúdos

summary: The developer that places a high-risk AI system on the market must carry out an algorithmic impact assessment beforehand and update it periodically over the life cycle.
quote: A avaliação de impacto algorítmico de sistemas de IA é obrigação do desenvolvedor ou do aplicador que introduzir ou colocar sistema de IA em circulação no mercado, sempre que o sistema ou o seu uso forem de alto risco
conditional_on: System or its use is high-risk; sectoral authority may relax the assessment (Art. 25 §4)

summary: The deployer that places a high-risk AI system on the market must carry out an algorithmic impact assessment beforehand, according to its role in the chain, and update it periodically.
quote: A avaliação deverá ser realizada em momento prévio e de acordo com o contexto específico da introdução ou colocação em circulação no mercado do sistema de IA.
conditional_on: System or its use is high-risk; sectoral authority may relax the assessment (Art. 25 §4)

summary: Developers of high-risk AI must share their preliminary and algorithmic impact assessments with the sectoral authority.
quote: O desenvolvedor de sistema de IA de alto risco deverá, nos termos de regulamento, compartilhar com a autoridade setorial as avaliações preliminares e de impacto algorítmico

summary: Conclusions of algorithmic impact assessments must be made public, subject to trade secrets; the competent authority keeps a public database of high-risk AI impact assessments (Art. 44).
quote: As conclusões da avaliação de impacto algorítmico serão públicas, observados os segredos industrial e comercial, nos termos de regulamento.

summary: AI agents that learn after market placement of an unexpected and relevant risk to people's rights must notify the sectoral authority and other agents in the chain immediately, and notify affected persons where necessary.
quote: tiverem conhecimento de risco ou impacto inesperado e relevante que o sistema apresente a direitos de pessoas naturais comunicarão o fato imediatamente à autoridade setorial

summary: AI agents must report serious security incidents (risk to life or physical integrity, disruption of critical infrastructure, serious property or environmental damage, serious violations of fundamental rights, information integrity or the democratic process) to the sectoral authority.
applies_from: When the sectoral authority sets the deadline and severity criteria (Art. 42 §1); not before 730 days after publication
quote: O agente de IA comunicará, em prazo a ser estabelecido, à autoridade setorial a ocorrência de grave incidente de segurança
conditional_on: Sectoral authority defines the reporting deadline and severity criteria

summary: Developers of general-purpose and generative AI systems must document development and carry out a preliminary assessment of expected risk levels, including potential systemic risk.
quote: O desenvolvedor de sistemas de IA de propósito geral e generativa deverá realizar, além da documentação pertinente sobre o desenvolvimento do sistema, sua avaliação preliminar
conditional_on: Competent authority may simplify or waive the obligations of Section V (Art. 33)

summary: Before commercial release, developers of general-purpose and generative AI with systemic risk must describe the model, document tests and analyses of foreseeable risks, document residual unmitigable risks, and provide technical documentation and instructions for downstream agents; applies also to open-source and API distribution.
quote: O desenvolvedor de sistemas de IA de propósito geral e generativa com risco sistêmico, deve, antes de sua disponibilização ou introdução no mercado para fins comerciais, garantir o cumprimento dos seguintes requisitos
conditional_on: System has systemic risk

summary: Developers of general-purpose and generative AI with systemic risk must publish a summary of the training dataset.
quote: publicar resumo do conjunto de dados utilizados no treinamento do sistema, nos termos de regulamentação
conditional_on: System has systemic risk

summary: Developers of general-purpose and generative AI with systemic risk may process only datasets collected and processed lawfully and under adequate data governance, especially personal data under the LGPD.
quote: processar e incorporar apenas conjuntos de dados coletados e tratados em conformidade com as exigências legais e sujeitos a uma adequada governança de dados
conditional_on: System has systemic risk

summary: Developers of general-purpose and generative AI with systemic risk must design systems, following applicable standards, to reduce energy and resource use and waste and increase energy efficiency.
quote: reduzir a utilização de energia, a utilização de recursos e os resíduos, bem como para aumentar a eficiência energética e a eficiência global do sistema
conditional_on: System has systemic risk

summary: Developers of general-purpose and generative AI offered to third parties (e.g., via API) must cooperate with downstream agents for risk mitigation and compliance with rights while the service is provided.
quote: como aqueles fornecidos por meio de API ou outros modelos de integração, devem cooperar, na medida de sua participação, com os demais agentes de IA

summary: CADE may order developers to grant access to training, validation and test datasets of high-risk AI systems when investigating concrete indications of infringements of the economic order.
quote: o Cade poderá ordenar aos desenvolvedores que seja concedido acesso aos conjuntos de dados de treinamento, validação e teste utilizados para o desenvolvimento dos sistemas de IA de alto risco
conditional_on: CADE investigation of concrete indications of antitrust infringement

summary: Public and private entities must prioritise AI systems and applications aimed at energy efficiency and rational use of natural resources.
applies_from: On publication (Chapter X Section III, Art. 80 §2 II)
quote: Entidades públicas e privadas devem priorizar a utilização de sistemas e aplicações de IA que visem à eficiência energética e à racionalização do consumo de recursos naturais.

summary: AI developers that use copyright-protected content must publish, on an accessible website, a summary of the protected content used in development (mining, training, retraining, testing, validation, application).
applies_from: On publication (Art. 80 §1 III, immediate effect of Art. 62)
quote: O desenvolvedor de IA que utilizar conteúdo protegido por direitos de autor e conexos deverá informar sobre os conteúdos protegidos utilizados nos processos de desenvolvimento dos sistemas de IA, por meio da publicação de sumário

summary: Text and data mining of protected content for AI research and development by scientific, research and educational organisations, museums, public archives and libraries is not infringement if access was lawful, non-commercial and proportionate; copies must be stored securely and only as long as needed, and works may not be displayed or disseminated. Excludes institutions linked to for-profit AI providers.
quote: Não constitui ofensa aos direitos de autor e conexos a utilização automatizada de conteúdos protegidos em processos de mineração de textos e dados para os fins de pesquisa e desenvolvimento de sistemas de IA

summary: Rightholders may prohibit the use of their content in AI development outside the Art. 63 exception; AI agents remain liable for damages for use after such prohibition.
quote: O titular de direitos de autor e conexos poderá proibir a utilização dos conteúdos de sua titularidade no desenvolvimento de sistemas de IA nas hipóteses não contempladas pelo art. 63 desta Lei.

summary: AI agents that use protected content in mining, training or development must remunerate rightholders, with collective or direct negotiation and remuneration reflecting reasonableness, proportionality, the agent's size and competitive effects; due only to rightholders domiciled in Brazil or in reciprocal countries.
quote: O agente de IA que utilizar conteúdos protegidos por direitos de autor e conexos em processos de mineração, treinamento ou desenvolvimento de sistemas de IA deve remunerar os titulares desses conteúdos em virtude dessa utilização
conditional_on: Rightholder is Brazilian or foreign domiciled in Brazil, or domiciled in a country granting reciprocity (Art. 65 §1)

summary: Use by AI systems of images, audio, voice or video depicting or identifying natural persons must respect personality rights under the Civil Code.
quote: A utilização de conteúdos de imagem, áudio, voz ou vídeo que retratem ou identifiquem pessoas naturais pelos sistemas de IA deverá respeitar os direitos da personalidade

summary: Public authorities developing, contracting or adopting high-risk AI must ensure access to databases and full data portability, and minimum standardisation of data architecture for interoperability.
quote: Ao desenvolver, contratar ou adotar os sistemas de IA de alto risco, o poder público deve garantir

summary: All public administration bodies (and public-service concessionaires, and the Legislative and Judiciary in administrative functions) using high-risk AI must log who used the system and why, guarantee explanation and human review of decisions with relevant legal effects, and publish preliminary assessments.
applies_from: 730 days after publication (Art. 80 caput); existing systems within a period set by the competent authority (Art. 23 §4)
quote: todos os entes da Administração Pública direta e indireta, ao desenvolver ou utilizar sistemas de IA de alto risco, adotarão as seguintes medidas

summary: Public use of biometric systems for identification must be preceded by an algorithmic impact assessment; a system whose risks cannot be eliminated or substantially mitigated must be discontinued.
quote: A utilização de sistemas biométricos para fins de identificação deverá observar os princípios e as medidas de governança previstos nesta Lei e será precedida de avaliação de impacto algorítmico

summary: The federal Executive must set minimum transparency standards for AI systems used by federal public bodies and monitor compliance.
quote: Caberá ao Poder Executivo federal fixar padrões mínimos de transparência para os sistemas de IA utilizados por órgãos e entidades do setor público federal

summary: The SIA must regulate the list of high-risk AI systems and identify new high-risk uses on stated criteria, after social participation and regulatory impact analysis; the competent authority publishes the consolidated list and sectoral authorities set sector lists and receive impact assessments.
quote: Caberá ao SIA regulamentar a classificação da lista dos sistemas de IA de alto risco, bem como identificar novas hipóteses de aplicação de alto risco

summary: As SIA coordinator, the competent authority (ANPD) must represent Brazil internationally, issue binding general norms (information disclosure, impact assessment procedures, incident reporting), receive anonymous complaints and publish annual reports; it is the residual regulator where no sectoral regulator exists.
quote: expedir, em colaboração com os demais integrantes do SIA, normas vinculantes de caráter geral sobre os seguintes temas

summary: Sectoral authorities exercise regulatory, supervisory and sanctioning powers over AI in their sectors, issue specific rules including for high-risk activities, and supervise governance measures for systems they classify as high-risk.
quote: exercer competência regulatória, fiscalizatória e sancionatória, conforme sua esfera de competência outorgada por lei, para desenvolvimento, implementação e uso de sistemas de IA

summary: SIA bodies must immediately pass to CADE any information found during supervision that may be relevant to competition law enforcement.
quote: Os órgãos e entidades integrantes do SIA devem comunicar imediatamente ao Conselho Administrativo de Defesa Econômica (Cade) quaisquer informações identificadas no decurso das atividades de fiscalização

summary: The competent authority must create and maintain a publicly accessible database of high-risk AI containing the public documents of impact assessments.
quote: Cabe à autoridade competente, em colaboração com as autoridades setoriais, a criação e a manutenção de base de dados de IA de alto risco, acessível ao público

summary: The competent authority must regulate, after public consultation and regulatory impact analysis, the procedure and criteria for administrative sanctions and publish dosimetry methodologies.
quote: A autoridade competente definirá, por meio de regulamento próprio, o procedimento de apuração e os critérios de aplicação das sanções administrativas a infrações a esta Lei

summary: The competent authority and sectoral authorities must promote and authorise AI regulatory sandboxes, regulate their procedures, and may waive rules under their competence for participants.
quote: A autoridade competente e as autoridades setoriais que compõem o SIA deverão promover e autorizar o funcionamento de ambiente regulatório experimental para inovação em inteligência artificial (sandbox regulatório de IA)

summary: The competent authority, sectoral authorities and Cria, with the Ministry of Labour, must develop guidelines to mitigate negative impacts of AI on workers (job displacement), enhance positive impacts, value collective bargaining and foster training.
quote: em cooperação com o Ministério do Trabalho, deverão desenvolver diretrizes para, entre outros objetivos

summary: Sectoral authorities must set differentiated criteria for AI systems offered by micro and small enterprises and startups.
applies_from: On publication (Chapter X Section V, Art. 80 §2 II)
quote: As autoridades setoriais deverão definir critérios diferenciados para sistemas de IA ofertados por microempresas, empresas de pequeno porte e startups

summary: Public administration at all levels must implement AI education, training and requalification programmes, digital literacy (prioritising basic education) and support for workers affected by AI.
quote: A administração pública, no âmbito da União, dos Estados, do Distrito Federal e dos Municípios, implementará programas de

summary: The Executive must provide the ANPD with resources within 2 years and define the list of sectoral authorities in the SIA, the composition of Cria and Cecia, and the role of the federal mediation chamber.
applies_from: 730 days after publication (Art. 80 caput); resources within 2 years (start not stated)
quote: definirá a lista de órgãos e entidades que figurarão como autoridades setoriais integrantes do SIA

summary: The SIA must, every four years, carry out studies and send Congress an advisory opinion on the need to update the Law.
quote: promover estudos e emitir parecer opinativo a ser enviado ao Congresso Nacional quanto à necessidade de aprimoramento das normas estabelecidas nesta Lei

summary: Anatel (under the Union) shall regulate the operation and functioning of digital platforms offering services to the Brazilian public, including the discipline and supervision of platforms with essential access control power (Art. 2 §1).
applies_from: on entry into force of the Law (Art. 17)
quote: regular o funcionamento e a operação das plataformas

summary: Inserts Art. 19-A into Lei 9.472/1997: Anatel is given competences over digital platforms, including administrative interpretation of applicable law and disputes, conflict composition between platform operators or professional users, repression of infringements of user rights, and exercise of economic-order powers excluding CADE matters.

conditional_on: Equipment listed in Art. 1 § 1; company with CNAE 6311-9/00 as principal activity

summary: ICMS suspended or deferred under Art. 1 I and II must be paid cumulatively with the tax due on the recipient company's sale, with the sale value as the tax base.
quote: O imposto suspenso ou diferido na forma dos incisos I e II será pago cumulativamente com o devido pela saída realizada pela empresa destinatária
conditional_on: Suspension or deferral under Art. 1, incisos I and II

summary: Companies may benefit only if they meet at least one of six conditions: job creation; non-existing economic activity or product without similar in the State; predominant use of State inputs; strategic status; location in a priority region; or boosting existing logistics infrastructure.
quote: Podem beneficiar-se do disposto neste decreto as empresas que atendam, pelo menos, a uma das seguintes condições
conditional_on: At least one of the conditions in Art. 2 items I to VI

summary: Benefit is conditional on: preferential use of State port and airport infrastructure; import clearance in the State; for expansion projects, expansion or diversification of productive capacity; for revitalization projects, a stoppage of at least 12 months before the special-regime application; and regular standing with competent environmental bodies where applicable (Art. 3 II and III). Art. 3, Parágrafo único clarifies that simple replacement or refurbishment is not an expansion.
quote: II - fica condicionado:
conditional_on: Conditions listed in Art. 3 II a) to d) and III, as applicable

summary: The interested company must apply for a special regime (regime especial) in order for the decree to apply.
quote: a empresa interessada deverá solicitar regime especial
conditional_on: Application for special regime

summary: Intra-party propaganda on the internet must observe, where applicable, arts. 57-C to 57-J of Lei 9.504/1997. Addressees are political parties and federations, for which the vocabulary has no closer role.
quote: A veiculação de propaganda intrapartidária na internet deverá observar, no que for aplicável, as disposições dos arts. 57-C a 57-J da Lei nº 9.504/1997.

summary: Live transmission of party-related acts is limited to profiles and channels of pre-candidates, parties, coalitions and federations; transmission or retransmission by radio or TV broadcasters, or on sites or profiles owned by legal persons, is prohibited. Addressees are broadcasters and legal persons, as the vocabulary has no closer role.
quote: vedada a transmissão ou retransmissão por emissoras de rádio, por emissoras de televisão ou em site, perfil ou canal pertencente a pessoa jurídica

summary: Paid boosting of political content is allowed only where contracted by a party, federation or candidate directly with the provider, with unequivocal identification that the content is boosted and a public repository of boosting data. The text's subject for the repository duty is unclear.
quote: com identificação inequívoca de que se trata de conteúdo impulsionado, devendo manter repositório público com dados sobre o impulsionamento

summary: Use of symbols or images in convoked broadcast networks is prohibited, except those in art. 13 §1 of the Federal Constitution.
quote: é vedada a utilização de símbolos ou imagens, exceto aqueles previstos no § 1º do art. 13 da Constituição Federal
conditional_on: Applies only when broadcast network convocation is permitted.

summary: The person responsible for electoral propaganda using AI-generated or manipulated multimedia synthetic content must explicitly, prominently and accessibly disclose that the content was fabricated or manipulated and which technology was used. Art. 9-B IV extends this to each page or side of printed material.
quote: impõe ao responsável pela propaganda o dever de informar, de modo explícito, destacado e acessível, que o conteúdo foi fabricado ou manipulado e qual tecnologia foi utilizada
conditional_on: Applies when AI or equivalent technology is used to create, replace, omit, merge, alter speed or overlay images or sounds in electoral propaganda.

summary: Publication, republication (even free of charge) and paid boosting of new synthetic content made or altered by AI that uses the image, voice or statements of a candidate or public figure are prohibited, even if labelled, in the window around the election.
applies_from: no période compreendido entre as 72 (setenta e duas) horas que antecedem e as 24 (vinte e quatro) horas que sucedem o término do pleito
quote: Ficam vedadas a publicação e a republicação, ainda que gratuitas, bem como o impulsionamento pago de novos conteúdos sintéticos
conditional_on: Applies only in the window of 72 hours before to 24 hours after the end of the election.

summary: Providers offering paid boosting of political-electoral content must enable a specific field for the propaganda's responsible party to declare the use of AI, without prejudice to the duties in §1.
quote: devem viabilizar campo específico para que o responsável pela propaganda declare o uso de inteligência artificial ou de tecnologia equivalente
conditional_on: Applies to providers that offer boosting of political-electoral content.

summary: When ordering suspension of a profile, the judge must state the validity period of the measure.
quote: indicará o prazo de vigência da medida
conditional_on: Applies when a judge orders suspension of a profile under art. 9-D.

summary: The competent court may, ex officio or on request of the representation's author, order other application providers to be notified to act preventively against the content listed in art. 9-E VI.
quote: poderá, de ofício ou a requerimento do autor da representação, determinar a cientificação dos demais provedores de aplicação
conditional_on: Discretionary power of the competent court, ex officio or on request.

summary: Application providers must implement a specific solution allowing candidates, parties, federations and coalitions to report violations of art. 9-E.
quote: Os provedores de aplicação devem implementar solução específica que permita

summary: Electoral courts may enter agreements with universities and entities with professionals trained in digital-offence forensics and AI for work on election cases. Candidates, parties, federations and coalitions are not obliged to hire such professionals.
quote: Os Tribunais Eleitorais poderão firmar acordos com universidades

summary: Electoral propaganda or electoral harassment in public or private workplaces is prohibited; whoever causes or permits it is responsible under the law in force.
quote: É vedada a propaganda eleitoral ou o assédio eleitoral em ambiente de trabalho público ou privado

summary: For majoritarian-election flyer distribution, a Braille offer is required, in graduated proportion (§3); the Braille printing must follow the share of visually impaired people in the electoral roll of the constituency (§4). Addressees are parties, federations, coalitions or candidates, as the vocabulary has no closer role.
quote: impõe sua oferta em sistema Braille, em proporção escalonada
conditional_on: Applies to flyer or leaflet distribution for majoritarian elections.

summary: The TSE must publish on its website, by 20 July, the percentage of visually impaired people to which the Braille printing duty refers.
quote: O Tribunal Superior Eleitoral publicará, até o dia 20 de julho, na sua página na internet, o percentual

summary: Providers of application that offer AI systems may not, even at user request, rank, recommend, suggest or prioritise candidates, campaigns, parties or coalitions; express electoral opinions or preference; alter sexual or nudity imagery of a candidate; or create electoral advertising representing political violence against women.
quote: É vedado aos provedores de aplicação que ofertem sistemas de inteligência artificial ou por tecnologia equivalente
conditional_on: Applies to application providers that offer AI systems or equivalent technology.

summary: In the cases of §4-A (false information on the electronic voting system, incitement of crimes against the democratic rule of law, subversion of the constitutional order, political violence against women), the provider must make the illicit content unavailable regardless of a court order, and must communicate the reasons for removal to the user and allow appeal.
quote: o provedor de aplicação de internet deve adotar as providências necessárias para tornar indisponível o conteúdo ilícito, independentemente de determinação judicial
conditional_on: Applies to the cases listed in §4-A.

summary: Electoral propaganda on websites or social-network profiles is prohibited, even free of charge. Addressees are the propaganda's promoters, as the vocabulary has no closer role.
quote: é vedada, ainda que gratuitamente, a veiculação de propaganda eleitoral na internet em sítios ou perfis em redes sociais

summary: Paid electoral propaganda includes any contracting, including through competition, ranking or prize mechanisms offering economic advantage to natural or legal persons to publish political-electoral content on their profiles, pages, channels or sites. These forms are prohibited.
quote: Incluem-se entre os tipos de propaganda eleitoral paga vedados pelo caput deste artigo a contratação sob qualquer modalidade

summary: Providers may delete profiles only where they are false, automated or bots; deletion in other cases is not permitted. Removal under art. 38-A is otherwise done in judicial proceedings with due process.
quote: É permitida a exclusão pelos provedores de aplicação apenas nas hipóteses de perfis falsos, automatizados ou robô.

summary: From 15 August of the election year, the Electoral Justice must convene parties, federations, coalitions and broadcasters' representation to prepare, within 5 days before free electoral propaganda starts, a media plan for the free electoral airtime.
applies_from: a partir de 15 de agosto do ano da eleição
quote: a Justiça Eleitoral deve convocar os partidos políticos, as federações, as coligações e a representação das emissoras de rádio e de televisão para elaborar

summary: The media plan must include information on the distribution of time, indicating the percentage allocated to candidacies of women, Black people and Indigenous people. Addressees are the parties and broadcasters that prepare the plan.
quote: informação a respeito da distribuição do tempo, indicando o percentual destinado às candidaturas de mulheres

summary: Electoral propaganda files must be delivered to broadcasters with the Annex IV form, which contains a field for the percentage of the programme allocated to candidacies of women, Black people and Indigenous people.
quote: acompanhados do formulário do Anexo IV desta Resolução

summary: Free airtime is distributed in proportion to the percentage of candidacies of women (Black, non-Black and Indigenous), of men (Black, non-Black and Indigenous), and of Indigenous candidacies (§1-A, §3-A), based on registration requests. Any shortfall in a weekly cycle must be compensated in following weeks until the end of the campaign (§6).
quote: destinação proporcional ao percentual de candidaturas de mulheres negras, não negras e indígenas

summary: Electoral courts must make available on their websites information on free propaganda time allocated to candidacies of women, Black people and Indigenous people, drawn from the party data in Annexes III and IV.
quote: os tribunais eleitorais disponibilizarão, em suas páginas na internet, informação sobre o tempo de propaganda gratuita

summary: The TSE must promote institutional broadcast advertising of up to 5 minutes per day to encourage participation of women, young people and Black and Indigenous people, and to explain the electoral system.
applies_from: entre 1º de abril e 30 de julho dos anos eleitorais
quote: promoverá, em até 5 (cinco) minutos diários, contínuos ou não, requisitados às emissoras de rádio e televisão, propaganda institucional

summary: Internet application providers must prepare a compliance plan to prevent and mitigate risks to electoral integrity and to comply with listed articles (9-B to 40). The plan must contain compliance measures per provision, measurable indicators, and deadlines and expected results (§1). Compliance is a condition for accreditation under art. 27-A §4 and for the registry under art. 29 §9 (§2).
quote: Os provedores de aplicação de internet deverão, nos termos, prazos e diretrizes editados pela Presidência do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral, elaborar plano de conformidade
conditional_on: Under the terms, deadlines and guidelines issued by the TSE Presidency.

summary: The TSE Presidency issues the terms, deadlines and guidelines for the compliance plans. The portaria implementing them is to be published in the Diário de Justiça Eletrônico (§3).
quote: nos termos, prazos e diretrizes editados pela Presidência do Tribunal Superior Eleitoral

summary: If the Act applies to a digital news intermediary, its operator must notify the Commission.
quote: If this Act applies in respect of a digital news intermediary, its operator must so notify the Commission.
conditional_on: If this Act applies in respect of a digital news intermediary (s. 6 applicability)

summary: Any individual or entity operating an online communications platform must, on Commission request, provide information needed to verify or prevent non-compliance with s. 7(1).
quote: must, at the request of the Commission and within the time and in the manner that it specifies, provide the Commission with any information
conditional_on: Upon a Commission request, within the time and manner it specifies

summary: The Commission must maintain and publish on its website a list of digital news intermediaries to which the Act applies, stating each operator's contact information and any s. 11(1) or 12(1) order.
quote: The Commission must maintain a list of digital news intermediaries in respect of which this Act applies.

summary: The Commission must make an exemption order for a digital news intermediary if its operator requests it and the s. 11(1) conditions are met.
quote: The Commission must make an exemption order in relation to a digital news intermediary if its operator requests the exemption
conditional_on: Operator request and the conditions in s. 11(1)(a) and (b) are met
