summary: The Commission must publish on its website its reasons for making or not making exemption orders, interim orders, and for repealing them.
quote: The Commission must publish on its website reasons for

summary: The Commission must publish on its website each exemption order and interim order it makes.
quote: The Commission must publish on its website each exemption order and interim order that it makes.
conditional_on: Upon making an exemption order or interim order

summary: Only a listed eligible news business, or a listed group of eligible news businesses, may initiate the bargaining process with an operator.
quote: Only an eligible news business that is listed under subsection 29(1) or a group of eligible news businesses that are listed under that section may initiate the bargaining process with an operator.
conditional_on: Listing under s. 29(1)

summary: An operator must participate in the bargaining process with the eligible news business or group that initiated it.
quote: An operator must participate in the bargaining process with the eligible news business or group of eligible news businesses that initiated it.
conditional_on: Bargaining process initiated under s. 20

summary: Parties participating in the bargaining process must bargain in good faith.
quote: Parties that are participating in the bargaining process must do so in good faith.
conditional_on: Participation in the bargaining process

summary: At a news business's request, the Commission must by order designate it as eligible if it meets the s. 27(1) criteria.
quote: the Commission must, by order, designate the business as eligible if it
conditional_on: At the request of a news business and the criteria in s. 27(1)(a) to (c) are met

summary: The Commission must by order revoke the eligibility designation of a news business that is subject to the sanctions listed in s. 27(3.1) or headquartered in a relevant foreign state.
quote: the Commission must, by order, revoke the order designating the business as eligible.
conditional_on: Business previously designated as eligible and described in s. 27(3.1)(a) or (b)

summary: The Commission must maintain a list of eligible news businesses (only those that consent) and publish it on its website.
quote: The Commission must maintain a list of eligible news businesses and publish that list on its website.
conditional_on: Business gives consent to be listed

summary: When initiating bargaining, an eligible news business or group must notify the operator of the news outlets that are to be subjects of the bargaining.
quote: must notify the operator of the digital news intermediary in question of the news outlets
conditional_on: Initiation of the bargaining process

summary: A group of eligible news businesses that enters into an agreement with an operator must file a copy with the Commission.
quote: the group must file a copy of the agreement with the Commission within 15 days after the day on which it is entered into.
conditional_on: Agreement entered into as a result of bargaining or mediation

summary: The Commission must publish arbitrator qualifications, maintain a roster of qualified arbitrators, and ensure the roster includes Indigenous persons.
quote: The Commission must publish qualifications for arbitrators on its website and must maintain a roster of arbitrators who meet those qualifications.

summary: The Commission must not appoint an arbitrator who has a conflict of interest.
quote: The Commission must not appoint an arbitrator who has a conflict of interest.

summary: Each individual arbitrator must take all reasonably necessary measures so that confidential information disclosed to them is not disclosed outside the arbitration.
quote: Each individual arbitrator must take all reasonably necessary measures to ensure that confidential information disclosed to them under subsection (1) is not disclosed other than during the arbitration.
conditional_on: Confidential information disclosed under s. 36(1)

summary: The Commission must by regulation establish a code of conduct on bargaining in relation to news content, with mandatory contents in s. 49(3).
quote: The Commission must, by regulation, establish a code of conduct respecting bargaining in relation to news content

summary: In making available news content produced primarily for the Canadian news marketplace by eligible news businesses' outlets, the operator must not unjustly discriminate against, unduly prefer (including itself), or subject to undue disadvantage an eligible news business.
quote: the operator of a digital news intermediary must not act in any way that
conditional_on: Making available news content produced by news outlets operated by eligible news businesses

summary: An operator or news business must, on Commission request, provide information the Commission requires to exercise its powers and duties under the Act.
quote: An operator or news business must, at the request of the Commission and within the time and in the manner that it specifies, provide the Commission with any information
conditional_on: Upon a Commission request, within the time and manner specified

summary: If the Canadian Broadcasting Corporation has an agreement with an operator, it must provide the Commission an annual report on compensation received, its use, and the agreements' contribution to sustainability.
quote: the Corporation must provide the Commission, within the time and in the manner that it specifies, with an annual report
conditional_on: CBC is party to an agreement with an operator

summary: Commission officials, and in s. 55(6) the Commissioner of Competition and related staff, must not knowingly disclose designated confidential information, or use disclosed information outside the permitted purposes.
quote: it is prohibited for an individual described in subsection (3) to knowingly disclose the information
conditional_on: Information designated as confidential under s. 55(1)

summary: Information provided to the Minister under s. 54(1) is only to be used for the purpose of permitting the Minister and the Governor in Council to exercise their powers under the Act.
quote: is only to be used by the Minister for the purpose of permitting the Minister and the Governor in Council to exercise their powers
conditional_on: Information provided to the Minister under s. 54(1)

summary: When a designated person issues a production order, the operator or eligible news business and their directors, officers, employees and agents must give all reasonably required assistance and provide documents, information and data access.
quote: give all assistance that is reasonably required to enable the designated person to exercise their powers
conditional_on: Production order issued by a designated person under s. 58(1)

summary: The Commission must make public the names of entities entering undertakings or deemed or found to have committed violations, with related details and penalty amounts.
quote: The Commission must make public
conditional_on: Entry into an undertaking under s. 65, or a violation deemed or found committed

summary: The Governor in Council may make regulations on the factors in s. 6, notification timing, interpretation of s. 11(1)(a)(i) to (viii), conditions for s. 11(1)(b), and provincial public broadcaster conditions under s. 28.
quote: The Governor in Council may make regulations

summary: The Commission may make regulations on exemption requests, the bargaining process, eligibility requests, the code of conduct, complaints, groups of eligible news businesses, and its procedures.
quote: The Commission may make regulations

summary: The Commission must cause an independent auditor to prepare an annual report on the impact of the Act on the Canadian digital news marketplace, with content set out in s. 86(2).
quote: The Commission must cause an independent auditor to prepare an annual auditor’s report

summary: The Commission must publish the annual auditor's report on its website within 30 days after receiving it.
quote: The Commission must publish the report on its website within 30 days after the day on which it receives it.
conditional_on: Receipt of the auditor's report

summary: The Minister must cause a review of the Act and its operation to be conducted, and a report laid before each House of Parliament, before the fifth anniversary of s. 87's coming into force.
quote: the Minister must cause a review of this Act and its operation to be conducted
conditional_on: Before the fifth anniversary of the day on which s. 87 comes into force

summary: Each broadcasting undertaking shall contribute to the broadcasting policy objectives in a manner appropriate to the nature of its services.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: each broadcasting undertaking shall contribute to the implementation of the objectives of the broadcasting policy set out in this subsection in a manner that is appropriate in consideration of the nature of the services provided by the undertaking

summary: Each Canadian broadcasting undertaking shall employ and make maximum use, and in no case less than predominant use, of Canadian creative and other human resources, subject to an impracticability exception.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: each Canadian broadcasting undertaking shall employ and make maximum use, and in no case less than predominant use, of Canadian creative and other human resources
conditional_on: Unless the nature of the service renders that use impracticable; then greatest practicable use applies.

summary: Each foreign online undertaking shall make the greatest practicable use of Canadian creative and other human resources and contribute equitably to Canadian programming.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: each foreign online undertaking shall make the greatest practicable use of Canadian creative and other human resources

summary: Online undertakings shall clearly promote and recommend Canadian programming in both official languages and in Indigenous languages, and ensure that any control of programming generates results allowing its discovery.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: online undertakings shall clearly promote and recommend Canadian programming

summary: The Commission shall ensure that any broadcasting undertaking that cannot make maximum or predominant use of Canadian creative resources contributes to those resources in an equitable manner (regulatory manner directive).
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: ensures that any broadcasting undertaking that cannot make maximum or predominant use of Canadian creative and other human resources

summary: In regulating and supervising the broadcasting system, the Commission shall enhance the vitality of official language minority communities and support their development.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: the Commission shall enhance the vitality of official language minority communities in Canada

summary: The Commission shall consult official language minority communities when making decisions that could adversely affect them, with listed consultation objectives including feedback after decisions.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: The Commission shall consult with official language minority communities in Canada when making decisions that could adversely affect them.
conditional_on: When making decisions that could adversely affect the communities.

summary: The Minister shall specify in the notice a comment period of at least 30 days and publish the representations made during that period.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: specify in the notice the period — of at least 30 days from the day on which the notice was published under paragraph (1)(a)
conditional_on: Proposed order under the Broadcasting Act section 8 procedure.

summary: The Commission shall, by order, exempt persons from requirements where compliance would not contribute materially to the broadcasting policy (s. 9(4)), and shall repeal or amend an exemption order where doing so would so contribute.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: The Commission shall repeal or amend an exemption order made under subsection (4)
conditional_on: Where the Commission is satisfied, or considers, that the stated policy test is met.

summary: The Commission may make orders imposing conditions on broadcasting undertakings, including Canadian programming proportions, discoverability, carriage of programming services, contract approval, and information provision to the Commission.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: The Commission may, in furtherance of its objects, make orders imposing conditions on the carrying on of broadcasting undertakings
conditional_on: Where the Commission considers the conditions appropriate for the broadcasting policy.

summary: The Commission shall publish on its website a copy of each proposed order and provide a reasonable opportunity for representations (s. 9.1(4)), and shall publish each made order on its website (s. 9.1(5)).
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: A copy of each order that the Commission proposes to make under this section shall be published on the Commission’s website

summary: In making an order for the proportion of original French language programs, the Commission shall ensure that Canadian original French language programs represent a significant proportion of those programs.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: the Commission shall ensure that Canadian original French language programs represent a significant proportion of the original French language programs to be broadcast
conditional_on: When making an order under paragraph 9.1(1)(c).

summary: The Commission shall not make an order on the presentation of programs for selection that would require the use of a specific computer algorithm or source code.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: The Commission shall not make an order under paragraph (1)(e) that would require the use of a specific computer algorithm or source code.
conditional_on: Orders under paragraph 9.1(1)(e).

summary: The online undertaking and the broadcasting undertaking subject to a carriage order under paragraph 9.1(1)(i) shall negotiate the terms for carriage of the programming services in good faith; the Commission may facilitate at a party's request.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: shall negotiate the terms for the carriage of the programming services in good faith
conditional_on: Where an order under paragraph 9.1(1)(i) applies.

summary: The Commission may make regulations respecting standards for programs over which a broadcasting undertaking has programming control and the allocation of broadcasting time; other regulation powers are listed in the amended s. 10(1).
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: respecting standards for programs over which a person carrying on a broadcasting undertaking has programming control and the allocation of broadcasting time
conditional_on: Within the Commission's mission.

summary: In making regulations on Canadian programs the Commission shall consider listed matters (s. 10(1.1)); a copy of each proposed regulation shall be published in the Canada Gazette with a reasonable opportunity for representations (s. 10(3)).
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: In making regulations under paragraph (1)(b), the Commission shall consider the following matters
conditional_on: When making regulations under paragraph 10(1)(b).

summary: The Governor in Council may make regulations prescribing matters that the Commission must consider when making Canadian program regulations.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: The Governor in Council may make regulations prescribing matters that the Commission is required to consider

summary: In regulating and exercising its powers, the Commission shall make orders and regulations in a manner consistent with the freedom of expression of users of social media services provided by online undertakings.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: the Commission shall make orders under subsection 9.1(1) and regulations under subsection 10(1) in a manner that is consistent with the freedom of expression

summary: Fees established for a broadcasting undertaking may only relate to recovery of the Commission's costs under the Act.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: The only fees that may be established with respect to a broadcasting undertaking shall be fees that relate to the recovery of the costs

summary: With Treasury Board approval, the Commission may make regulations establishing schedules of fees payable by broadcasting undertakings of any class.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: with the approval of the Treasury Board, establishing schedules of fees to be paid by persons carrying on broadcasting undertakings of any class
conditional_on: With the approval of the Treasury Board.

summary: The Commission may make regulations respecting expenditures by broadcasting undertakings for listed purposes, including Canadian program development and public-interest participation; orders for a particular undertaking are under s. 11.1(2).
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: The Commission may make regulations respecting expenditures to be made by persons carrying on broadcasting undertakings

summary: Regulations and orders on expenditures for Canadian program production shall prescribe the minimum share allocated to Canadian original French language programs; proposed regulations must be published in the Canada Gazette (s. 11.1(7)).
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: shall prescribe the minimum share of expenditures that are to be allocated to Canadian original French language programs
conditional_on: For broadcasters offering programs in both official languages.

summary: The Commission shall hold a public hearing on the listed matters, including the making of an order under s. 9.1(1) or 11.1(2) and of any regulation, unless it is satisfied a hearing is not required in the public interest.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: The Commission shall also hold a public hearing in connection with the following matters unless it is satisfied that such a hearing is not required in the public interest
conditional_on: Unless satisfied that a hearing is not required in the public interest.

summary: Members of a panel shall consult with the Commission, and may consult officers, to ensure consistent interpretation of the broadcasting policy, regulatory policy, orders and regulations.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: The members of a panel established under subsection (1) shall consult with the Commission

summary: At the Corporation's request the Commission shall consult it on proposed conditions, regulations or orders affecting the Corporation (s. 23(1)), and shall comply with any written directive the Minister issues within 90 days of a referral (s. 23(3)).
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: The Commission shall, at the request of the Corporation, consult with the Corporation
conditional_on: Consultation at the Corporation's request; directive only after a referral by the Corporation.

summary: After a public hearing finds the Corporation has contravened a provision or order, the Commission shall forward a report with the circumstances, findings and recommendations to the Minister.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: the Commission shall forward to the Minister a report setting out the circumstances of the contravention
conditional_on: If the Commission is satisfied, after a public hearing, that the Corporation has contravened the cited provisions.

summary: On request, the Commission shall provide the Minister or the Chief Statistician of Canada with any information submitted to it in respect of a broadcasting undertaking.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: The Commission shall, on request, provide the Minister or the Chief Statistician of Canada with any information submitted to the Commission
conditional_on: On request.

summary: The Commission shall proactively make available for public inspection information submitted in proceedings before it, subject to the confidentiality designation rules in s. 25.3.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: the Commission shall proactively make available for public inspection any information submitted to the Commission in the course of proceedings before it
conditional_on: Subject to section 25.3 (confidential information).

summary: Persons described in subsection 25.3(3) (Commission members and staff, the Commissioner of Competition, and the Minister, Chief Statistician or federal public administration agents) shall not knowingly disclose designated confidential information; the Commissioner of Competition shall not use information disclosed to them except as provided.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: no person described in subsection (3) shall knowingly disclose the information
conditional_on: If a person has designated the information as confidential and has not withdrawn the designation; subject to subsections (4), (5) and (7).

summary: A person shall not carry on a broadcasting undertaking (other than an online undertaking) unless licensed under a licence issued to them or exempt under an order made under s. 9(4).
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: A person shall not carry on a broadcasting undertaking unless
conditional_on: Unless licensed or exempt; online undertakings are excepted under s. 31.1(2).

summary: A person to whom a designated person's information-requirement notice is addressed shall comply with the notice.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: A person to whom any such notice is addressed shall comply with the notice.
conditional_on: Where a designated person under paragraph 34.7(a) requires information by notice to verify a violation.

summary: No person shall knowingly make a material misrepresentation of fact to a person designated under paragraph 34.7(a).
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: It is prohibited for any person to knowingly make a material misrepresentation of fact to a person designated under paragraph 34.7(a).

summary: Every seven years the Commission shall consult interested persons on orders under s. 9.1 and on orders and regulations under s. 11.1, and publish a report on the consultations and its review plan; the first report is due within seven years of the subsection's coming into force.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: Every seven years the Commission shall consult with all interested persons with respect to orders made under section 9.1

summary: The Minister shall cause copies of the Commission's consultation reports published under s. 34.01(1) and (2) to be tabled before each House of Parliament.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: The Minister shall cause a copy of all reports published under subsections (1) and (2) to be tabled before each House of Parliament.

summary: After a public hearing finds the Corporation committed a violation, the Commission shall forward a report to the Minister, who shall lay it before each House of Parliament (s. 34.991(2)).
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: the Commission shall forward to the Minister a report setting out the circumstances of the violation
conditional_on: If the Commission is satisfied, after a public hearing, that the Corporation has committed a violation.

summary: The Governor in Council may make regulations providing for exceptions to the violation prohibitions, increasing maximum AMP amounts, establishing penalty factors, and governing undertakings and service of documents.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: The Governor in Council may make regulations

summary: The Corporation shall, subject to applicable orders and regulations of the Commission, provide an international service in English, French and other languages deemed appropriate, in accordance with Governor in Council directions.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: The Corporation shall, subject to any applicable orders and regulations of the Commission, provide an international service
conditional_on: Subject to any applicable orders and regulations of the Commission; in accordance with directions of the Governor in Council.

summary: The Commission may make orders and regulations, and under s. 9.1 and 11.1 conditions and expenditure requirements, as listed in the amended provisions; the Commission may also make regulations prescribing programs in respect of which the Act applies (s. 4.2(1)).
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: the Commission may make regulations prescribing programs in respect of which this Act applies
conditional_on: In a manner consistent with freedom of expression.

summary: In making regulations prescribing programs to which the Act applies, the Commission shall consider listed matters, including revenue generation, prior broadcast by a licensed undertaking and unique identifiers; regulations shall not prescribe programs without revenue or consisting only of visual images.
applies_from: Not stated in provision (s. 54 defers only s. 40(2) to (4))
quote: In making regulations under subsection (1), the Commission shall consider the following matters
conditional_on: When making regulations under s. 4.2(1).

summary: A committee of the Senate, the House of Commons or both Houses shall undertake a comprehensive review of the amendments made by this Act during the fifth year after royal assent and after each subsequent report, and report within one year.
applies_from: During the fifth year after the day on which this Act receives royal assent, and during the fifth year after a report is submitted under subsection (2).
quote: must be undertaken by the committee of the Senate, of the House of Commons or of both Houses of Parliament

summary: Persons who are not addressed by a specific article but fall within the operator category must observe eleven general principles: human oversight, technical robustness and security, privacy and data governance, transparency and identification, social diversity and fairness, social and environmental well-being, accountability, consumer protection, gender equity, copyright, and explainability.
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: Todos los operadores a los que se aplica la presente ley deberán observar los siguientes principios generales

summary: AI systems must identify themselves as artificial agents each time they interact with humans, so that people know they are communicating with an AI system.
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: deberán identificarse como agentes artificiales en cada oportunidad en que interactúen con seres humanos

summary: Those responsible for placing on the market, putting into service or using AI systems must review the long-term effects of their application on society, democracy and the environment.
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: los responsables de la introducción en el mercado, la puesta en servicio o la utilización de los sistemas de IA deberán revisar los efectos a largo plazo

summary: Operators of AI systems must publish annual reports on environmental impact through their available dissemination channels, including social networks and websites.
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: los operadores de sistemas de IA deberán publicar informes anuales sobre al impacto medioambiental en los canales de difusión de que dispongan

summary: The Ministry of Science, the APDP and the ANCI must incorporate the Article 4 principles into guidance for operators and into their regulation and supervision within their competences. The Secretaría de Gobierno Digital may also issue guidelines on the matter.
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: incorporarán estos principios en las distintas orientaciones destinadas a prestar asistencia al operador en cuanto al modo de desarrollar y utilizar sistemas de IA

summary: Operators of AI systems that generate synthetic audio, image, video or text must ensure that outputs are identifiable as artificially generated or manipulated.
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: velará porque sus resultados o salidas sean identificables como generados o manipulados de manera artificial
conditional_on: operator generates synthetic audio, image, video or text content

summary: Distribution, placing on the market or putting into service of AI systems intended for unacceptable-risk uses is prohibited.
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: Se prohíbe la distribución, introducción en el mercado o puesta en servicio de sistemas de IA destinados a tales usos.
conditional_on: AI system is intended for an unacceptable-risk use as defined in Art. 7

summary: Uses of AI systems that alter behaviour through manipulation or deception, or that exploit characteristics of persons to cause harmful behaviour, are prohibited. Art. 7 also lists further unacceptable categories (sensitive-data categorisation, social scoring, non-selective facial image extraction, emotion inference in listed settings, real-time remote biometric identification in public spaces); the text carries exceptions for therapeutic purposes.
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: En particular, se prohíben los usos de sistemas de IA que, mediante manipulación o engaño

summary: The high-risk use of AI systems must seek to respect the fundamental rights of persons and must prevent the creation of stereotypes and the degradation of persons or groups who interact with the system.
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: El uso de alto riesgo de sistemas de IA deberá procurar el respeto de los derechos fundamentales de las personas.
conditional_on: AI system is used in a high-risk use as defined in Art. 8

summary: High-risk AI systems must be subject to an iterative, continuous risk assessment process throughout the system lifecycle, with periodic reviews and updates, and risk management may be integrated into existing procedures; measures against incidents are to be included.
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: Se someterán a un proceso iterativo continuo de evaluación de riesgos que se llevará a cabo durante todo el ciclo de vida del sistema
conditional_on: AI system is classified as high-risk use under Art. 8

summary: Where high-risk AI systems use model-training techniques with data, they must have data governance appropriate to their purpose and context of use, incorporate data security and protection standards, and include mechanisms for preventing and managing information security incidents.
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: Si utilizan técnicas de entrenamiento de modelos con datos deberán contar con una gobernanza de datos adecuada a su propósito y contexto de uso.
conditional_on: AI system is high-risk and uses model training with data

summary: High-risk AI systems must have functions that log information and security events during operation, stored with safeguards against alteration, loss or unauthorised access and with access restricted to authorised personnel and the competent supervisory authority. Technical documentation must be intelligible and demonstrate compliance with the law.
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: Deberán contar con funciones que permitan registrar información y eventos de seguridad mientras están en funcionamiento.
conditional_on: AI system is high-risk under Art. 8

summary: High-risk AI systems must have technical and operational mechanisms allowing supervision by technically trained natural persons, ensuring use in line with the intended purpose and identifying and mitigating risks of reasonably foreseeable misuse.
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: Deberán contar con mecanismos técnicos y operativos que permitan su supervisión por personas naturales técnicamente capacitadas para esta función
conditional_on: AI system is high-risk under Art. 8

summary: High-risk AI systems must respect security by design and by default, reach an adequate level of accuracy, resilience, security and cybersecurity, and implement security measures aligned with Arts. 3, 7 and 9 of Law 21.663 (cybersecurity framework law).
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: El funcionamiento de estos sistemas deberá respetar el principio de seguridad desde el diseño y por defecto
conditional_on: AI system is high-risk under Art. 8

summary: Where a high-risk use does not comply with the rules, the operator must immediately take the necessary measures to deactivate, withdraw from the market or suspend the system, as set out in its risk management system.
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: el operador adoptará inmediatamente las medidas necesarias para desactivarlo, retirarlo del mercado o suspenderlo.
conditional_on: high-risk use of an AI system does not comply with Art. 9 rules

summary: Operators must establish and document a monitoring system proportionate to the nature and identified risks of their high-risk uses, collecting and analysing data to assess performance over the system's lifetime and, where relevant, interaction with other interconnected AI environments.
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: Los operadores establecerán y documentarán un sistema de seguimiento, que sea proporcional y adecuado a la naturaleza y riesgos identificados en sus usos.
conditional_on: AI system is high-risk under Art. 8

summary: Limited-risk AI systems must ensure transparency and safety conditions proportionate to their risk level, so that people are clearly informed and can recognise that they are interacting with an AI system.
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: Los sistemas de IA de riesgo limitado deberán garantizar condiciones de transparencia y seguridad proporcionales a su nivel de riesgo
conditional_on: AI system is limited-risk under Art. 11

summary: The State, through the Ministries of Science and of Economy, Development and Tourism, must promote measures giving SMEs priority access to existing AI sandboxes (subject to budget availability), and awareness, capacity-building and advanced digital skills initiatives for SMEs, extended to civil society organisations on objective, public and non-discriminatory criteria.
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: propiciará medidas tendientes a:

summary: The Ministry of Science, Technology, Knowledge and Innovation, in coordination with the Ministry of Economy, Development and Tourism, must promote the ethical and responsible development of AI and establish innovation support measures. It must also design and produce programmes on AI literacy and citizen awareness.
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: promoverá el desarrollo ético y responsable de la inteligencia artificial en el país

summary: Persons, companies and state bodies involved in applying the law must respect the confidentiality of information and data obtained from an AI system, protecting in particular intellectual property, trade secrets including source code, personal data, public interest and national security, and the integrity of criminal cases or administrative proceedings.
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: deberán respetar la confidencialidad de la información y los datos obtenidos de un sistema de IA en el ejercicio de sus funciones

summary: Stated in the definition of authorised representative: a Chile-domiciled person accepts a written mandate from an AI provider to comply with the obligations of this law on the provider's behalf.
applies_from: entry into force: first business day of the 12th month after publication in the Diario Oficial (Artículo transitorio)
quote: recibe y acepta el mandato por escrito de un proveedor de un sistema de IA para cumplir con las obligaciones establecidas en esta ley
conditional_on: foreign AI provider appoints a Chile-domiciled authorised representative

summary: Platforms not domiciled or incorporated in Chile that offer services in the national territory must designate a legal representative domiciled in the country, with sufficient powers, to answer to administrative and judicial authorities; the designation is to be accredited before the Agency, and each platform must keep that information up to date. Non-compliance is an infringement.
applies_from: 6 months from publication in the Diario Oficial (transitory article)
quote: deberán designar un representante legal con domicilio en el país
conditional_on: Platform is not domiciled or constituted in Chile but offers services in the national territory

summary: Generating or disseminating realistic but false digital representations of a person's image, body or voice, as described in the law, is prohibited.
applies_from: 6 months from publication in the Diario Oficial (transitory article)
quote: Toda generación o difusión de representaciones digitales verosímiles pero falsas, en los términos descritos en esta ley, se encontrará prohibida.
conditional_on: Content meets the definition of a 'representación digital verosímil pero falsa' and is not exempt under Art. 5

summary: Social media platforms must identify and clearly inform, through visible labels or distinctive marks, any image, audio or video generated or manipulated by AI. Non-compliance is an infringement.
applies_from: 6 months from publication in the Diario Oficial (transitory article)
quote: deberán identificar e informar de manera clara, mediante el uso de etiquetas visibles o sellos distintivos, toda imagen, audio o video que haya sido generado o manipulado mediante IA

summary: Each social media platform must provide a complaint channel on its website or user interface through which affected persons, their heirs or legal representatives can request removal of such representations; the platform must decide within 72 hours of the request, and the channels must operate free of arbitrariness or discrimination. Non-compliance, including unjustified failure to decide within the period, is an infringement.
applies_from: 6 months from publication in the Diario Oficial (transitory article)
quote: cada plataforma digital de redes sociales dispondrá de un canal de denuncias en su página web o interfaz de usuario

summary: Participants (IPI, IPC, PSBI, PSIP) must adopt the measures needed to allow consultation, access, delivery and exchange of information in an expedited and secure manner.
quote: deberán adoptar las medidas necesarias para permitir, según corresponda, la consulta, acceso, entrega e intercambio de información, de forma expedita y segura

summary: Registration in the PSBI Registry must be requested by the legal or contractual representative of the entity, who is personally responsible for the accuracy of the information provided.
quote: La solicitud deberá ser presentada por el representante legal o convencional de la entidad
conditional_on: Voluntary registration as PSBI

summary: The PSBI registration application must contain identification data, corporate data and the listed items; attachments include by-laws, powers of attorney, business plan, organisation chart, client relationship description, consent documentation, personal data treatment description and records of processing activities, sworn statements, policies, security profile certificate, bankruptcy certificate and functional test report.
quote: Se deberá acompañar con la solicitud los siguientes antecedentes:
conditional_on: Application for PSBI registration

summary: A PSBI must report any change to the information provided in its application within five business days of the event or of becoming aware of it; changes of a registry nature also require a registry annotation request and payment of fees.
applies_from: From the date of the application while registered
quote: dentro del plazo de cinco días hábiles de ocurrido el hecho respectivo
conditional_on: While registered in the PSBI Registry

summary: On cancellation, or on CMF-ordered termination, the PSBI must execute a plan ensuring no transactions remain pending, revoke access authorisations, report the measures and timetable to the CMF, and inform its clients of the end of participation.
applies_from: At the date the cancellation takes effect
quote: deberá poner en ejecución un plan destinado a garantizar que no existan transacciones u operaciones pendientes de ejecución
conditional_on: Cancellation of PSBI registration

summary: Only legal persons incorporated under Chilean law with domicile in Chile may apply for PSIP registration; foreign entities may apply only through a Chilean agency set up beforehand.
quote: Podrán solicitar su inscripción en este Registro solo personas jurídicas constituidas conforme a las normas de la República de Chile
conditional_on: Application for PSIP registration

summary: PSIP registration application must include the listed identification, corporate and attachment items, including a business plan, a description of fund protection and claims mechanisms under Law 20.009, a sworn statement on custody of funds, client relationship and consent documentation, personal data treatment description with records of processing, sworn statement on disqualification, policies, security profile certificate, guarantees, bankruptcy certificate and functional test report.
quote: Se deberá acompañar con la solicitud los siguientes antecedentes:
conditional_on: Application for PSIP registration

summary: A PSIP that wishes to hold or temporarily custody client funds must first prove to the CMF compliance with the Central Bank requirements; any temporary custody may not exceed 72 hours from execution of the payment initiation operation.
quote: la custodia de fondos temporal no podrá superar las 72 horas
conditional_on: PSIP model with temporary custody of funds

summary: PSIP must maintain minimum guarantees calculated by a formula with a floor of UF 1.000, updated quarterly; for the first six months after registration the average daily amount factor is zero. Guarantees may take the form of an insurance policy or a bank guarantee.
applies_from: Guarantees are updated quarterly; the first six months after registration use only the base amount
quote: Los PSIP deberán acreditar el cumplimiento de niveles mínimos de garantías en función a sus montos operados

summary: Entities providing payment initiation services with client consent at the time of this norm must apply for registration within twelve months from its entry into force.
applies_from: Twelve months from the entry into force of this norm
quote: deberán dar cumplimiento a la obligación de solicitar su registro ante la Comisión en un plazo que no exceda de doce meses
conditional_on: Entities already providing payment initiation services when the norm enters into force

summary: No payment order or transfer of funds may be initiated without the client's prior authorisation given under this norm and the Annex N°3 standards; recurring payments require consent from the first transaction or from the signing of the recurring charge arrangement.
quote: No se podrán iniciar órdenes de pago o transferencias de fondos sin autorización previa del cliente

summary: A PSIP may not hold or custody the paying client's funds, unless it has previously proven to the CMF compliance with Central Bank rules for temporary custody models.
quote: El PSIP no podrá mantener o custodiar los fondos del cliente ordenante o pagador, salvo acreditación previa ante la CMF
conditional_on: Absent prior proof to the CMF of compliance with Central Bank rules

summary: PSIPs must refrain from requesting from paying clients more information or data than strictly necessary to initiate the payment order, without prejudice to anti-money laundering and terrorist financing duties.
quote: Los PSIP deberán abstenerse de solicitar a los clientes ordenantes o pagadores más información o datos de los estrictamente necesarios

summary: PSIPs must adopt technical and organisational measures to comply with the limitation on use of personal data in Article 20 of the Fintec Law; a PSIP also registered as PSBI may, with client consent, combine payment initiation data with other information for financial review, reconciliation services.
quote: Los PSIP deberán adoptar las medidas técnicas y organizativas necesarias para dar cumplimiento efectivo a la limitación de uso de datos personales

summary: A PSIP must report any change to the information provided in its application within five business days of the event or of becoming aware of it; registry-nature changes also require a registry annotation request and payment of fees.
applies_from: From the date of the application while registered
quote: dentro del plazo de cinco días hábiles de ocurrido el hecho respectivo
conditional_on: While registered in the PSIP Registry

summary: On cancellation or CMF-ordered termination, the PSIP must prepare and report a detailed plan ensuring no pending transactions or claims with payees remain, inform clients, and refrain from providing payment initiation services without a valid registration.
applies_from: At the date the cancellation takes effect
quote: deberá disponer e informar a la Comisión de un plan detallado que garantice y acredite que no existan transacciones
conditional_on: Cancellation of PSIP registration

summary: Incorporation into the IPI and IPC lists is mandatory for entities that the Fintec Law requires to participate in the SFA; it requires disclosure to the Directory of Participants, compliance with interface standards, testing, ARC documentation, a security profile certificate and risk management policies.
quote: La incorporación en esta nómina es obligatoria para las entidades que la Ley Fintec haya definido que deben ser parte del SFA
conditional_on: Entities that the Fintec Law designates as IPI or IPC

summary: For list incorporation, IPI and IPC must obtain a functional testing report and certification of results from a provider of recognised standing, including contingency scenarios, with an unqualified opinion, under the requirements of Annex N°3.
quote: Evidenciar a través de la emisión de un reporte de hallazgos y de certificación de resultados
conditional_on: Incorporation into the IPI or IPC list

summary: IPI and IPC must demonstrate to the CMF the adoption and implementation of the risk management policies in Section III; entities with existing risk policies must supplement them with SFA-specific aspects.
quote: Acreditar ante la Comisión la adopción e implementación de las políticas de gestión de riesgo
conditional_on: Incorporation into the IPI or IPC list

summary: IPIs under Article 18 first subparagraph and IPCs under Article 20 must file their list application within the first 90 days after entry into force; IPIs under Article 18 second subparagraph (a) to (h) have 18 months.
applies_from: Within the first 90 days after entry into force of this norm (IPI first subparagraph and IPC); 18 months after entry into force (other IPI)
quote: Deberán presentar su solicitud dentro de los primeros 90 días de entrada en vigencia de la presente Norma
conditional_on: Entities designated as IPI or IPC by the Fintec Law

summary: Entities registered as PSBI through the list of financial service providers must request inclusion in the PSBI list and demonstrate compliance with the PSBI requirements.
quote: deberán solicitar su incorporación y acreditar ante la Comisión el cumplimiento de los requisitos dispuestos para los PSBI
conditional_on: Voluntary participation as PSBI by IPIs or registered financial service providers

summary: IPIs and IPCs must make APIs available for the SFA, together with the associated technical documentation, to serve data access requests from PSBIs and PSIPs.
quote: Las IPI e IPC deberán poner a disposición APIs para el SFA

summary: Supervised entities may not use mechanisms other than APIs to respond to data access requests, subject to any alternative mechanism regulated by the CMF.
quote: las entidades fiscalizadas no podrán utilizar mecanismos diferentes a las API para atender solicitudes de acceso a datos

summary: Compliance with the API standards in Table N°1 (OpenAPI 3.1, JSON, RESTful, ISO 20022, OAuth 2.0 and OpenID Connect, FAPI 2.0, mTLS) must be demonstrated by a report from an independent third party sent to the CMF; new interface versions should remain backward compatible where technically feasible.
quote: El cumplimiento de estos estándares deberá ser acreditado mediante informe emanado de un tercero independiente y remitido a la Comisión

summary: Data APIs for information categories in Article 17 numerals 1 to 3 must have minimum availability of 95% daily and 99% monthly and process transactions within 4,000 milliseconds; payment initiation APIs must have minimum availability of 95% daily and 99.5% monthly and process within 800 milliseconds; scheduled maintenance is excluded from the availability calculation.
quote: deben estar disponibles para su uso con un tiempo de actividad mínimo del 95% de forma diaria por día calendario

summary: Availability and performance reports must be sent to the CMF monthly, on a weekly basis, in the formats the CMF determines; outsourcing of monitoring does not remove the entity's responsibility for complete and timely reporting.
quote: los reportes a la CMF de los respectivos estándares se deberán enviar mensualmente en base semanal

summary: IPIs and IPCs must maintain an alternative information delivery mechanism to operate when the principal interfaces are unavailable, meeting the technical requirements in Annex N°3 and uniform for all participants.
quote: Las IPI e IPC deberán contar con un mecanismo alternativo de entrega de información
conditional_on: Unavailability of principal interfaces

summary: Each participant is solely responsible for verifying that its own information in the Directory of Participants is correct and has not undergone substantive changes; participants must supply contact, certificate and endpoint information to the Directory.
quote: Será obligación y responsabilidad exclusiva de cada participante el cerciorarse que la información sobre sí mismo contenida en el DP resulte correcta

summary: IPIs and IPCs must carry out periodic random data quality tests at least every six months, including comparability analysis and error source analysis, and report results to the CMF.
quote: Las pruebas serán realizadas al menos con periodicidad semestral y sus resultados serán entregados a la Comisión

summary: IPIs and IPCs must inform the CMF as soon as they become aware of any significant deficiency in the information transmitted through their SFA interfaces, through the operational incident reporting channels.
quote: las IPI e IPC deberán informar a la Comisión tan pronto tomen conocimiento de su existencia, toda deficiencia significativa en la información
conditional_on: Awareness of a significant deficiency in transmitted information

summary: IPIs and IPCs must have processes to handle and resolve API problems affecting other participants, with clear error messages, and must designate a responsible officer (name, position, email and telephone) for communication with participants and the CMF.
quote: Las entidades deben designar un funcionario responsable a quien contactar

summary: The board or equivalent body must approve and authorise risk management and internal control policies at least once a year, set strategic objectives, approve risk policies, assess resources and organisation, and evaluate a risk committee.
quote: es la instancia responsable de aprobar y autorizar las políticas de gestión de riesgos y control interno, como mínimo una vez al año

summary: The risk management function must monitor controls, report directly to the board or equivalent body, report breaches with causes and measures, propose policy changes, and prepare an annual plan; the board must segregate and keep this function independent of business areas.
quote: Esta función deberá reportar directamente al directorio u órgano equivalente.

summary: The risk management function must prepare a risk management plan covering at least business continuity, information security and cybersecurity risks, with mitigation strategies, contingency planning, control mechanisms and continuous improvement, approved by the board at least annually.
quote: El plan deberá contemplar, a lo menos, los riesgos de continuidad operacional, seguridad de la información y ciberseguridad.

summary: Operational risk management must give reasonable assurance of protecting client information, set risk appetite levels approved by the board, and define key risk indicators, adapted to business model, volume and client types.
quote: los Participantes del SFA deberán considerar los elementos que se señalan a continuación

summary: Services provided by third-party suppliers relevant to compliance, continuity, security and service quality must be included in operational risk processes, considering substitution, intervention, subcontracting and concentration risks.
quote: deberán ser considerados en los procesos de gestión de riesgo operacional de la entidad
conditional_on: Outsourcing to suppliers

summary: Operational risk management must include information security and cybersecurity elements: policies and procedures, ICT policies, qualified staff, roles and responsibilities, revocation of access on staff changes, audits, and board reporting.
quote: la gestión de riesgo operacional deberá incluir los siguientes elementos, aplicables a todas las entidades participantes del SFA

summary: Entities must implement information security procedures covering asset inventories and classification, physical and logical access controls, monitoring of privileged users, mobile and remote access, backups, cloud services, authentication for digital channels, and a high-level incident management body with response and recovery procedures updated at least annually.
quote: La entidad deberá considerar los siguientes procedimientos, adaptados a su modelo de negocios

summary: Participants must report operational incidents affecting business continuity, information, client service quality, cyberattacks, malware, data leaks or fraud losses to the CMF; the CMF may require an internal report on causes and measures; a responsible officer and alternate must be designated.
quote: Los actores del SFA deberán comunicar a esta Comisión los incidentes operacionales
conditional_on: Occurrence of an operational incident

summary: Cybersecurity incidents must be reported to the CMF through the Operational Incident Report (RIO) platform within a maximum of 30 minutes from the entity becoming aware of the event, with an initial report and a closing report including the listed fields.
quote: en el plazo máximo de 30 minutos transcurridos desde que la entidad tomó conocimiento del hecho
conditional_on: Occurrence of an incident

summary: Participants must have a business continuity policy covering response to internal or external events, responsibilities, and annual approval by the board or equivalent body, plus a crisis plan with escalation, communication and recovery objectives set in a business impact analysis.
quote: Contar con una política de continuidad de negocio que considere a lo menos lo siguiente

summary: Continuity and disaster recovery plans must be tested annually, supervised by the risk management function, based on plausible severe scenarios including cyberattacks, disasters and health crises, with results reported to the board.
quote: Pruebas anuales del Plan de Continuidad de Negocio y Recuperación de Desastres

summary: API security standards require monitoring of API data requests and responses, backups, keeping event logs for at least five years identifying requester, time, data transmitted and result, encryption according to sensitivity, deletion of data once legal retention limits expire, and contingency sites.
quote: Mantener registro de los eventos propios del SFA

summary: Entities must use the Open ID Connect standard, layered on OAuth 2.0, as described in Annex N°3 for the services and APIs there listed.
quote: Corresponderá utilizar, en lo que corresponda, el estándar Open ID Connect

summary: Strong client authentication (ARC) using two or more independent elements of knowledge, possession and inherence is required for data queries that involve client information subject to consent; after authenticating the PSBI or PSIP, IPIs and IPCs must authenticate the client, including authorisation and payment confirmation.
quote: Se requerirá una Autenticación Reforzada del Cliente -ARC- para la consulta de datos del SFA
conditional_on: Data queries involving client information subject to consent

summary: IPIs and IPCs must receive a digital certificate from the PSBI or PSIP issued by a certification authority meeting the Annex N°3 requirements, compare the certificate permissions and roles against the Directory of Participants, and confirm the validity of each PSBI and PSIP.
quote: Las IPI e IPC deberán recibir un Certificado Digital por parte del PSBI o PSIP

summary: Consent is deemed given only if expressed explicitly by the data subject or authorised representative, implemented through the consent management mechanism, stored on a durable medium, free of undue influence, limited to what is strictly necessary, given in plain language, and accompanied by a control panel; the detailed conditions are listed in letters a to i.
quote: se reputará otorgado el consentimiento por parte del titular de los datos
conditional_on: Data exchange, processing, transfer or payment initiation within the SFA

summary: When requesting consent, the entity must tell the data subject precisely which data, to which institution, for what period or frequency and purpose; the request may not contain other information or request consent for other purposes.
quote: se deberá poner en conocimiento del titular o cliente de manera precisa y clara los datos sobre los cuales consiente
conditional_on: Requesting consent for transmission, processing, transfer or payment initiation

summary: IPIs and IPCs may not alter the consent request formulated by the PSBI or PSIP, request additional consent for the same exchange, adopt practices that discourage consent, or degrade the user experience.
quote: Queda prohibido a la IPI o a la IPC alterar el contenido de la solicitud de consentimiento

summary: PSBIs, PSIPs, IPIs and IPCs must provide data subjects and clients a control panel to know, verify and revoke consents, free of charge, remote and easy to use, with authentication equivalent to Section III.C, showing details of each consent and its status, and with real-time communication of revocations.
quote: Las PSBI, PSIP, IPI e IPC deberán poner a disposición de los titulares de datos y clientes un panel de control

summary: A registration system must preserve, intact and for at least five years, the accesses and interactions of data subjects for CMF supervision, and display all consents granted, revoked or expired during the last five years.
quote: Contar con un sistema o mecanismo de registro que permita preservar, de manera íntegra y por al menos 5 años

summary: If a data subject does not access the control panel for more than one calendar year while valid consents exist, a reminder must be sent to the contact the subject has set within the first five business days after that year.
applies_from: Within the first five business days after one calendar year of inactivity
quote: Dicha comunicación se deberá remitir dentro de los cinco primeros días hábiles inmediatamente posteriores
conditional_on: Inactivity of the data subject on the control panel with valid consents

summary: SFA data must be available on client request, kept current and validated against client status, reflect changes and corrections, and be available equally via the principal and alternative mechanisms; for online balances all current products must be reported, with the date of last available information where updates are periodic.
quote: Los datos del SFA deberán cumplir con las siguientes condiciones

summary: Participants must at all times protect integrity, availability, security and confidentiality of data in each transaction and of client information, in consideration of the Fintec Law and Law 19.628.
quote: Los Participantes del SFA deberán, en todo momento, resguardar la integridad, disponibilidad, seguridad y confidencialidad de los datos

summary: Participants must adopt adequate procedures to channel and manage the exercise of data subject rights over data incorporated into SFA interfaces.
quote: Los Participantes deberán adoptar procedimientos adecuados para canalizar y gestionar el ejercicio de los derechos de los titulares de datos

summary: Client data shared through the SFA may be used by the PSBI or PSIP only for the specific purposes stated when consent was given, without prejudice to another legal basis for processing.
quote: Los datos autorizados a compartir por el Cliente solo pueden ser utilizados por el PSBI y/o por el PSIP

summary: A participant that considers a relevant risk to SFA information assets requiring urgent action must take immediate preventive measures, such as disconnection from the SFA, and send an immediate report to the CMF with the measures and grounds, then correct the situation and inform the CMF when resolved.
quote: deberá enviar de inmediato un reporte a la CMF informando las medidas adoptadas
conditional_on: Relevant risk to SFA information assets requiring urgent action

summary: Banks, card issuers and prepaid card issuers must implement APIs for Terms and Conditions and Channels of Attention within six months of the Norm entering into force.
applies_from: Six months after the Norm enters into force (after the 24-month preparation period)
quote: 6 meses para implementación de APIs sobre Términos y Condiciones Generales y de Canales de Atención
conditional_on: Entity is a bank, credit card issuer or prepaid card issuer

summary: Banks, card issuers and prepaid card issuers must implement APIs for Enrollment, Historical Financial Positions, Transaction History and Current Products for natural persons within 15 months (and credit lines within 18 months) and for legal persons within 18 months; Payment Initiation APIs within 18 months.
applies_from: Fifteen to eighteen months after the Norm enters into force
quote: 15 meses para implementación de APIs sobre Enrolamiento, Posiciones Financieras Históricas, Historial de usos y transacciones, y Productos vigentes
conditional_on: Entity is a bank, credit card issuer or prepaid card issuer

summary: Entities under Article 18 second subparagraph (a) to (h) of the Fintec Law must implement APIs for Terms and Conditions and Channels of Attention within 24 months of the Norm entering into force.
applies_from: 24 months after the Norm enters into force
quote: 24 meses para implementación de APIs sobre Términos y Condiciones Generales y Canales de Atención
conditional_on: Entities listed in Article 18 second subparagraph (a) to (h) of the Fintec Law

summary: Entities under Article 18 second subparagraph (a) to (h) of the Fintec Law must implement APIs for Enrollment, Historical Financial Positions, Transaction History and Current Products for all client types within 36 months of the Norm entering into force.
applies_from: 36 months after the Norm enters into force
quote: 36 meses para implementación de APIs sobre Enrolamiento
conditional_on: Entities listed in Article 18 second subparagraph (a) to (h) of the Fintec Law

summary: IPIs and IPCs may not discriminate against third-party data recipients, for example by prioritising some institutions over others in data extraction, development time, API access or response limits.
quote: Las IPI o IPC no pueden dar un trato discriminatorio a los terceros receptores de datos

summary: After certifying the identity of PSBIs or PSIPs, IPIs and IPCs must provide the authorised services according to user profiles without requiring an agreement between the parties; service conditions must be published.
quote: deberá brindar los servicios respectivos autorizados al usuario de información según sus perfiles, sin necesidad de acuerdo entre las partes
conditional_on: After identity certification of the PSBI or PSIP

summary: IPIs may not charge PSBIs, except the direct incremental costs of serving queries above the volume thresholds set by the CMF; IPCs may not charge clients or PSIPs beyond what is agreed for the account, as stated in the Fintec Law.
quote: De la misma forma, las IPI no podrán efectuar cobros o realizar cargos a los PSBI
conditional_on: Volume thresholds set by the CMF exceeded

summary: Any change to tariff terms must be notified to participants at least 30 days before taking effect; each IPI must also inform PSBIs monthly of the effective consumption of its interfaces and the number of calls exceeding the charging threshold.
applies_from: At least 30 days before the tariff change takes effect
quote: Cualquier modificación en los términos tarifarios deberá ser informada a los Participantes con al menos 30 días de anticipación
conditional_on: Tariff term changes and monthly reporting of consumption

summary: Adds literal d.7 to the first paragraph of art. 60, listing the project's typologies under art. 3 (applicable to its parts, works or actions) as an item of that article's content list. The inserted text contains no express verb of duty.
provision: Artículo único, numeral 3 (inserting art. 60 inciso primero, literal d.7)
quote: d.7 Las tipologías del proyecto o actividad, así como las aplicables a sus partes, obras o acciones, de acuerdo al artículo 3 de este Reglamento.

summary: The Agency shall observe the guiding principles of Article 3 of the Law in conducting the qualification procedure.
quote: El procedimiento dispuesto en el presente reglamento deberá instruirse bajo los principios orientadores establecidos en el artículo 3° de la ley.

summary: The Agency may qualify essential service providers as vital importance operators where they meet the requirements: dependence on computer networks and systems, and significant impact of affectation, interruption or destruction of their services.
quote: La Agencia podrá calificar a los prestadores de servicios esenciales como operadores de importancia vital cuando estos reúnan los siguientes requisitos
conditional_on: Requirements listed in Art. 4 numerals 1 and 2

summary: For determining significant impact, the Agency shall consider one or more criteria: number of potential affected persons, service redundancy, monoprovision, service dependence, and relevance of the institution.
quote: la Agencia deberá considerar uno o más de los siguientes criterios

summary: The Agency may qualify private institutions that are not essential service providers as vital importance operators, where they meet the requirements of Art. 5 of the Law and their qualification is indispensable for a critical role or for exposure to cybersecurity risks.
quote: La Agencia podrá calificar como operadores de importancia vital a instituciones privadas
conditional_on: Indispensability of qualification due to a critical role or degree of exposure to risks

summary: The Agency shall review and update, where appropriate, the qualification of vital importance operators at least every three years, starting the next process at least 180 days before the three-year period expires; it shall publicise the start of the qualification process on its website.
quote: La Agencia deberá revisar y actualizar, si fuere pertinente, la calificación de operadores de importancia vital al menos cada tres años.

summary: For the sectoral public bodies' reports, the Agency shall request a reasoned report from sectoral public bodies with specific regulatory or supervisory powers, referring to the criteria of Art. 4 a) to e); it shall request a report from the Ministry of Economy, Development and Tourism where the institution is a smaller enterprise; these reports shall be evaluated under Art. 37 bis of Law 19.880.
quote: la Agencia deberá requerir informe fundado de los organismos públicos con competencia sectorial
conditional_on: Reports requested for the qualification study only; smaller-enterprise report where the institution is classified as such

summary: Sectoral public bodies shall deliver their requested report within 30 calendar days from receiving the request, individually for each institution in their competence, indicating whether the service depends on computer networks and systems and whether its affectation could have a significant impact.
quote: Los organismos públicos cuyo informe se solicite deberán evacuarlo dentro del plazo de treinta días corridos

summary: The Agency may request voluntary information from private institutions to prepare the preliminary list, setting a period of not less than ten calendar days.
quote: La Agencia podrá solicitar a las instituciones privadas antecedentes voluntarios para elaborar la nómina preliminar

summary: The Agency shall prepare the preliminary list of vital importance operators within 30 calendar days after the period in Art. 8 expires; the list shall be approved by resolution of the Director and published in the Diario Oficial or a national newspaper.
quote: La Agencia deberá elaborar la nómina preliminar de operadores de importancia vital dentro del plazo de treinta días corridos

summary: The preliminary list concerning private institutions shall be subjected to public consultation governed by principles of maximum disclosure, equal treatment, impartiality, transparency and effectiveness.
quote: la nómina preliminar respecto de las instituciones privadas deberá ser sometida a consulta pública

summary: The consultation shall be opened by resolution of the Director, which shall provide a period of dissemination and promotion of not less than ten calendar days from publication of the preliminary list resolution.
quote: la cual dispondrá un periodo de difusión y promoción que no podrá ser inferior a diez días corridos

summary: Institutions in the preliminary list shall be notified under Decreto Supremo 4 of 2020 during the ten-day period, and the notification shall state the right to submit observations and attach documents.
quote: las instituciones incluidas en la nómina preliminar deberán ser notificadas conforme lo dispuesto en el decreto supremo N° 4, de 2020

summary: The Agency shall provide an electronic platform allowing participation in the public consultation.
quote: La Agencia deberá poner a disposición una plataforma electrónica que permita la participación en la consulta pública.

summary: Observations on the preliminary list must be in writing with their grounds; for natural persons they must state name, identity card number and address or email; for legal persons they must be made by a legal representative with a certificate of validity issued within 90 days; they are due within 30 calendar days from publication of the Art. 10 resolution.
quote: serán admisibles aquellas observaciones en que esté debidamente señalado el nombre, cédula de identidad y domicilio o correo electrónico

summary: The Agency shall pronounce on citizen observations directly related to the qualification process.
quote: La Agencia deberá pronunciarse sobre las observaciones ciudadanas que se relacionen directamente con el proceso de calificación respectivo.

summary: The Agency shall make the executive summary and content of the public consultation available to the public on its website within 30 calendar days after the observation period expires.
quote: La Agencia pondrá a disposición del público el resumen ejecutivo y el contenido de la Consulta Pública en el sitio web institucional treinta días corridos después del vencimiento del plazo

summary: The Agency shall prepare the final list of private institutions qualified as vital importance operators within 30 calendar days from publication of the executive summary; the list shall state name, tax identification number (RUT) and legal domicile, and be approved by reasoned resolution and published in the Diario Oficial or a national newspaper.
quote: La Agencia elaborará la nómina final de instituciones privadas calificadas como operadores de importancia vital.

summary: The Agency shall conduct the qualification study for public institutions within the period in Art. 6, applying the criteria of Art. 4.
quote: La Agencia realizará el estudio de calificación de las instituciones públicas en el plazo dispuesto en el artículo 6°

summary: The Agency shall prepare a preliminary list of public institutions and request technical reports under Art. 7, and shall request a report from the Ministry of Finance.
quote: La Agencia deberá confeccionar una nómina preliminar de instituciones y solicitar los informes técnicos

summary: The Agency shall communicate the qualification to the public body previously qualified under Art. 19 of Law 19.880, which must deliver its report.
quote: La Agencia deberá comunicar al órgano previamente calificado de conformidad a lo dispuesto en el artículo 19° de la ley N° 19.880

summary: The final list of public bodies qualified as vital importance operators shall be approved by reasoned resolution of the Director and published in the Diario Oficial or a national newspaper.
quote: será aprobada mediante resolución fundada de su Director o Directora y publicada en el Diario Oficial o en un diario de circulación nacional.

summary: The first qualification of vital importance operators shall begin within 90 days counted from the entry into force of Arts. 5, 8, 9 and Title VII of the Law.
applies_from: 90 days from entry into force of Arts. 5, 8, 9 and Title VII of Law 21.663
quote: La primera calificación de operadores de importancia vital deberá iniciarse en el plazo de 90 días contados desde la entrada en vigencia de los artículos 5°, 8°, 9° y Título VII de la ley
conditional_on: Entry into force of Arts. 5, 8, 9 and Title VII of the Law

summary: Electronic notifications under the regulation shall begin under the gradualidad rules of DFL 1 of 2020; until that regime enters into force, notifications shall be made by certified letter to the institution's domicile.
quote: Las notificaciones electrónicas dispuestas en el presente reglamento comenzarán a practicarse de conformidad a las reglas de gradualidad
conditional_on: Entry into force of the gradualidad regime under DFL 1 of 2020

summary: Dependent platform workers' employment contract must state: nature of services and terms (including personal data treatment and effect of user ratings), pay method and period, zone, contact criteria, and whether working hours are free or subject to general rules.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: el contrato de trabajo de los trabajadores de plataformas digitales dependientes deberá indicar:
conditional_on: dependent platform workers (Art. 152 quáter R)

summary: Designate an official channel for objections and complaints about pay, work records, assignment and client evaluations, with a physical office, local phone and responsible representative; must be attended by a person on request.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: La designación de un canal oficial donde el trabajador pueda presentar sus objeciones, reclamos o requerimientos
conditional_on: dependent platform workers (Art. 152 quáter R)

summary: Inform dependent platform workers in writing of the risks of their work, preventive measures and correct work means for each case.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: deberá informar por escrito al trabajador de plataformas digitales dependiente acerca de los riesgos que entrañan sus labores
conditional_on: dependent platform workers (Art. 152 quáter R)

summary: At its own cost, implement a reliable mechanism recording working time of platform workers providing services in Chile, identifying passive hours separately from effectively worked hours.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: Las plataformas digitales deberán implementar a su costo un mecanismo fidedigno de registro de la jornada
conditional_on: platform workers providing services in the territory
