summary: For dependent workers, verify each payment period that remuneration for services provided meets the hourly minimum (monthly minimum income plus 20%, divided by four times the ordinary weekly maximum hours) and pay any difference.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: deberá verificar que las remuneraciones devengadas por los servicios efectivamente prestados cumplan con estos valores mínimos
conditional_on: dependent platform workers (Art. 152 quáter R)

summary: Where pay is based on services provided to users, the pay statement must include an annex detailing each operation and the calculation method.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: la liquidación de remuneraciones se deberá contener en un anexo, que constituye parte integrante de la misma
conditional_on: remuneration paid per services provided to users

summary: For independent workers, limit its role to coordinating contact between workers and users, while setting general terms and conditions for operating on its systems.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: deberá limitarse a coordinar el contacto entre el trabajador de plataformas digitales independiente y los usuarios
conditional_on: independent platform workers

summary: Independent workers' service contract must be in writing, in clear Spanish, and state items a) to j) (parties, price in Chilean pesos, contact criteria, data protection rules, maximum continuous connection time, cancellation rules, etc.); workers may be enabled only after express acceptance, and modifications require acceptance.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: deberá constar por escrito e indicar, en un lenguaje claro, sencillo y en idioma castellano, a lo menos, lo siguiente
conditional_on: independent platform workers

summary: Deliver a copy of the independent worker contract to the worker and keep another copy available in the platform's system for the parties.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: Una copia del contrato deberá ser entregada, física o electrónicamente, al trabajador de plataformas digitales independiente
conditional_on: independent platform workers

summary: Pay independent workers' fees within a payment period not exceeding one month; hourly fees not below the monthly minimum income plus 20% (divided by 180 hours), with verification and payment of any difference; provide operational facilities for payment.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: deberá pagar al trabajador de plataformas digitales independiente los honorarios que correspondan
conditional_on: independent platform workers

summary: Require independent workers to issue the required tax documentation (such as a boleta de honorarios) for services to users, unless the tax authority sets another method by resolution.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: deberán exigir que el trabajador de plataformas digitales independiente extienda la documentación tributaria que corresponde
conditional_on: independent platform workers

summary: Ensure independent workers have at least 12 continuous hours of disconnection within any 24-hour period.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: deberá resguardar el cumplimiento de un tiempo de desconexión mínimo del trabajador de plataformas digitales independiente de doce horas continuas dentro de un período de veinticuatro horas
conditional_on: independent platform workers

summary: May disconnect an independent worker temporarily only to give effect to the disconnection right; may not impose temporary disconnections or other sanctions based on refusing a service or not connecting for a period.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: no podrá efectuar desconexiones temporales u otras medidas de sanción basadas en hechos como el rechazo
conditional_on: independent platform workers

summary: Give written notice at least thirty days in advance of terminating an independent worker's contract after six or more months of continuous service; no advance notice is required for serious breach by the worker.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: deberá comunicar por escrito el término del contrato al trabajador de plataformas digitales independiente
conditional_on: independent worker with six or more months of continuous service through the platform

summary: Respect the constitutional guarantees of independent platform workers.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: deberá respetar las garantías constitucionales del trabajador de plataformas digitales independiente
conditional_on: independent platform workers

summary: When offering a service and before acceptance, inform the worker of the place of performance, the user's identity and the payment method; for deliveries, the address; for transport, origin and destination.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: deberá informar al trabajador de plataforma digital, al momento de ofrecer un servicio y previo a su aceptación
conditional_on: platform workers, dependent or independent

summary: Worker data is strictly confidential and may be used by the platform only in the context of the services it provides, or released by court order for the purposes requested.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: sólo podrán ser utilizados por la empresa de plataforma digital de servicios en el contexto de los servicios que la misma empresa presta
conditional_on: platform workers, dependent or independent

summary: On the worker's request, deliver access to personal data (especially data on ratings affecting work) within fifteen business days, and enable data portability in a structured, common format.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: Los datos deberán ser entregados por la plataforma en el plazo de quince días hábiles contado desde la fecha de la solicitud.
conditional_on: platform workers, dependent or independent

summary: If required for inspection by competent authorities, allow access to the algorithm's programming, complete explanations of how it makes decisions, the data used to train it, and other relevant factors.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: deberán permitir el acceso a la programación del algoritmo
conditional_on: request by competent authorities

summary: In implementing algorithms, respect equality and non-discrimination, taking all necessary measures to avoid discrimination in work assignment, bonuses, pay calculation and other matters, including apparently neutral conduct with disproportionate effects.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: deberá respetar el principio de igualdad y el de no discriminación
conditional_on: platform workers, dependent or independent

summary: Inform workers about the mechanisms and procedures adopted to comply with the non-discrimination rule.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: deberá informar a sus trabajadores sobre los mecanismos y procedimientos que adopte
conditional_on: platform workers, dependent or independent

summary: Provide the worker with adequate and timely safety training; for two-wheeler workers a helmet, knee and elbow protection; and property damage insurance with minimum annual cover of 50 unidades de fomento.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: La empresa de plataforma digital de servicios deberá proporcionar al trabajador
conditional_on: platform workers; equipment duty applies to two-wheeler users

summary: For calculating statutory severance on termination of a dependent worker's contract, use average remuneration over the last year worked, excluding unworked months, and apply article 163 if that amount is higher; the provision names no addressee.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: se considerará como base de cálculo la remuneración promedio del último año trabajado
conditional_on: termination of a dependent platform worker's contract

summary: When a draft collective agreement is presented to two or more platform companies and each agrees to negotiate, each company must decide whether to negotiate jointly or separately and communicate the decision to the union negotiating committee.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: cada empresa deberá decidir si negocia en forma conjunta o separada
conditional_on: draft collective agreement presented to two or more platform companies

summary: The Dirección del Trabajo supervises compliance with the chapter, especially articles 152 quáter Z and 152 quinquies E, within its competence.
applies_from: from entry into force (Art. primero transitorio)
quote: La Dirección del Trabajo fiscalizará, dentro del ámbito de su competencia, el cumplimiento de las normas de este Capítulo

summary: Platforms that do not meet the requirement of article 19 first paragraph of the Labour Code on the entry-into-force date have three years from publication of the law to comply.
applies_from: three years from publication of the law (Art. segundo transitorio)
quote: tendrán para hacerlo el plazo de tres años, contado desde la publicación de esta ley
conditional_on: platforms not compliant with article 19 inciso primero at entry into force

summary: The Consejo Superior Laboral must issue an annual report during the first three years evaluating implementation and results, especially the effects of the dependent/independent distinction, sent to the President and the labour committees of both chambers.
applies_from: during the first three years of the law's effect (Art. tercero transitorio)
quote: el Consejo Superior Laboral deberá emitir un informe anual

summary: A person who accesses a system without authorisation must, to be exempt from criminal liability, be registered in the register kept by the Agencia Nacional de Ciberseguridad and have informed the Agency in advance of the access.
quote: Que se encuentre inscrito en el registro que al efecto lleve la Agencia Nacional de Ciberseguridad. Que el acceso se haya realizado habiendo informado previamente de ello a la Agencia.
conditional_on: Applies only to the exemption in Art. 2, inciso cuarto (access to a system whose owner is domiciled in Chile), and only if all listed conditions are met.

summary: Report the access and any security vulnerabilities detected, as soon as the access is made, to the system owner and to the Agency; also comply with the Agency's rules on responsible vulnerability disclosure.
quote: Que el acceso y las vulnerabilidades de seguridad detectadas hayan sido reportadas al responsable del sistema informático y a la Agencia, tan pronto se hubiere realizado.
conditional_on: Applies only to the exemption in Art. 2, inciso cuarto, and only if all listed conditions are met.

summary: For the exemption, the access must not be made for appropriating or using information or with fraudulent intent, must not exceed what is needed to verify the vulnerability, must not use denial-of-service, malicious code, social engineering or data alteration or destruction, and must not publicly disclose the vulnerability.
quote: Tampoco podrá haber actuado más allá de lo que era necesario para comprobar la existencia de una vulnerabilidad
conditional_on: Applies only to the exemption in Art. 2, inciso cuarto, and only if all listed conditions are met.

summary: For access to a system that is not of a State administration body, the access requires the consent of the person responsible for the system.
quote: requerirá del consentimiento del responsable del sistema informático
conditional_on: Applies only to the exemption in Art. 2, inciso cuarto, for systems other than those of organismos de la Administración del Estado.

summary: The judge must state in the order the real name or alias and physical or electronic address of the person affected and the type and duration of the measure; the Ministerio Público must present a detailed prior report on the facts and the possible participation.
provision: Art. 12, inciso segundo and inciso primero
quote: deberá indicar circunstanciadamente el nombre real o alias y dirección física o electrónica del afectado por la medida
conditional_on: Applies when investigative techniques under CPP arts. 222 to 226 are requested for the offences in Arts. 1 to 5 and 7.

summary: Electronic investigation records and computer data must be handled according to the preservation or custody standards defined for the procedure.
quote: serán tratados en conformidad a los estándares definidos para su preservación o custodia en el procedimiento respectivo

summary: The Fiscal Nacional issues the general instructions that set the preservation or custody standards for electronic investigation records.
quote: de acuerdo a las instrucciones generales que al efecto dicte el Fiscal Nacional

summary: On request of the Ministerio Público in a criminal investigation, a service provider must preserve specified computer data for 90 days, extendable once, until judicial authorisation for delivery is obtained or 180 days have passed.
applies_from: Art. 18 enters into force six months after publication in the Diario Oficial of a regulation of the Ministry of Transport and Telecommunications (Artículo segundo transitorio).
provision: Art. 18(1) (inserting Código Procesal Penal, Art. 218 bis)
quote: Los datos se conservarán durante un período de 90 días, prorrogable una sola vez, hasta que se autorice la entrega o se cumplan 180 días.
conditional_on: Entry into force depends on publication of the regulation under Artículo segundo transitorio. 'Proveedor de servicio' is defined in Art. 15 c).

summary: The company required under the preservation order must cooperate with the investigation and keep the development of the measure secret.
applies_from: Art. 18 enters into force six months after publication in the Diario Oficial of a regulation of the Ministry of Transport and Telecommunications (Artículo segundo transitorio).
provision: Art. 18(1) (inserting Código Procesal Penal, Art. 218 bis)
quote: La empresa requerida estará obligada a prestar su colaboración y guardar secreto del desarrollo de esta diligencia.
conditional_on: Entry into force depends on publication of the regulation under Artículo segundo transitorio.

summary: The Ministry of Transport and Telecommunications, with the Ministry of the Interior and Public Security, must issue the regulation on which the entry into force of Art. 18 depends, within six months of publication of the law.
applies_from: Six months from publication of this law in the Diario Oficial.
quote: El reglamento señalado en el inciso anterior deberá dictarse dentro del plazo de seis meses, contado desde la publicación de la presente ley en el Diario Oficial.

summary: Persons providing the Fintec services must be registered in the Registro de Prestadores de Servicios Financieros administered by the Commission before providing them professionally.
quote: quienes estén inscritos en el Registro de Prestadores de Servicios Financieros administrado por la Comisión

summary: Registered entities must keep public, on their website, information on the activities the Commission has authorised them to carry out.
quote: deberán mantener a disposición del público y a través de su sitio web información respecto del tipo de actividad o servicio

summary: International companies providing the described services must have a domicile in Chile for those purposes.
quote: Las empresas internacionales que presten los servicios anteriormente descritos deberán tener domicilio en Chile para esos efectos.

summary: Registration is not allowed for legal persons sanctioned or convicted for listed offences in the ten years before the application, or whose principal partners, directors or administrators were sanctioned or convicted in that period.
quote: No procederá la inscripción de las personas jurídicas que, en los diez años anteriores a la fecha de la solicitud

summary: Only legal persons whose exclusive business is one or more of the regulated services may register and provide them.
quote: las personas jurídicas cuyo giro exclusivo sea la prestación de uno o más de tales servicios

summary: The Commission must decide on registration applications within thirty business days of the application date.
quote: La Comisión deberá pronunciarse sobre las solicitudes de inscripción en el Registro dentro del plazo de treinta días hábiles

summary: Before starting each regulated service, a registered entity must obtain the Commission's authorisation, including for services added after registration, and meet the listed requirements for each service.
quote: Previo a iniciar la prestación de los servicios señalados a continuación se deberá contar con la autorización respectiva de la Comisión.

summary: Registered entities must provide to clients or publish to the public the information the Commission sets by general rule, which covers project characteristics, conflicts of interest, system interruptions, economic and legal situation, and methods or criteria used, depending on the service.
quote: aquella información que deberán proveer a sus clientes o difundir al público en general
conditional_on: Information set by Commission general rule

summary: Entities providing the regulated services must report annually to the Servicio de Impuestos Internos on balances of financial instruments held in custody and transactions carried out for clients, in the form and period that agency sets.
quote: deberán informar anualmente al Servicio de Impuestos Internos sobre los saldos de los instrumentos financieros

summary: Persons performing functions for investment and credit advisory entities, and the systems they use, must meet standards of objectivity, coherence and consistency between the recommendation or evaluation and client needs; the Commission sets how this is evidenced.
quote: deberán cumplir con estándares de objetividad, coherencia y consistencia

summary: Intermediation, order routing and custody entities that reach the volume or client number set by the Commission must post one or more guarantees (bank guarantee, insurance policy or cofinanced guarantee) and are liable for slight fault (culpa leve).
quote: deberán constituir una o más garantías, según sea el caso
conditional_on: Volume of business or number of clients set by Commission general rule

summary: Intermediation or custody entities that reach the business volume set by the Commission must permanently hold a minimum equity equal to or above the greater of 5,000 UF or 3% of risk-weighted assets (up to 6% for deficient risk management).
quote: deberán contar permanentemente con un patrimonio mínimo, igual o superior al mayor entre
conditional_on: Business volume set by Commission general rule

summary: If minimum equity falls below the required amount, the entity must notify the Commission immediately and submit a regularisation plan within five calendar days; it must not enter new operations that deepen the deficit.
quote: deberá comunicarlo a la Comisión tan pronto tome conocimiento de ello
conditional_on: Minimum equity falls below the Article 11 amount

summary: Registered entities must design, approve and implement policies, procedures and controls on corporate governance and risk management, and the Commission sets standards that presume compliance, including cybersecurity and information security.
quote: deben diseñar, aprobar e implementar políticas, procedimientos y controles

summary: Listed serious infractions include providing the regulated services without registration or authorisation, failing to post required guarantees, and providing malicious false or misleading information, among others; the list is for the purposes of Articles 6 and 13.
quote: Prestar los servicios regulados por la presente ley, sin estar inscrito en el Registro

summary: Participants in the Open Finance System must observe principles of proportionality, quality, transparency and client information, security and privacy of data, non-discrimination and interoperability.
quote: deberán observar los principios de proporcionalidad, calidad, transparencia e información al cliente

summary: Information provider institutions must take the necessary measures to allow consultation, access, delivery and exchange of client data and products within the scope, time limits and specifications set by the Commission.
quote: deberán adoptar las medidas necesarias para permitir la consulta, acceso, entrega e intercambio de información
conditional_on: Conditions set by Commission general rule

summary: Banks and card issuers, and other institutions the Commission designates, must participate in the Open Finance System as information provider institutions, giving access to and delivering the information requested by information-based service providers.
quote: deberán participar en el Sistema de Finanzas Abiertas en calidad de instituciones proveedoras de información los bancos y emisores de tarjetas

summary: Information-based service providers that committed very serious and repeated infringements of personal data protection obligations within twenty-four months may not register or participate.
quote: No podrán inscribirse en el Registro de Proveedores de Servicios basados en Información

summary: Payment initiation service providers may not access or hold client funds linked to payment orders at any time, nor use client data for purposes other than the regulated service, except transitory holding allowed under Central Bank rules.
quote: no podrán tener acceso ni mantener, en ningún momento, los dineros de los Clientes

summary: Where a payment initiation provider transitorily holds funds under Central Bank rules, the maximum time for payment to beneficiaries may not exceed seventy-two hours.
quote: no podrá superar las setenta y dos horas
conditional_on: Transitory holding of client funds permitted under Central Bank rules

summary: Account provider institutions must execute a payment order transmitted by a payment initiation provider with the client's prior consent, without prior contract and without discrimination; they may not charge the client or the provider for it.
quote: deberá ejecutarse por parte de la Institución Proveedora de Cuenta sin necesidad de que exista una relación contractual previa
conditional_on: Client's prior consent

summary: Information and exchange must be carried out through one or more remote, automated interfaces maintained by participants, with minimum standards, interoperability and a backup mechanism set by the Commission.
quote: deberá efectuarse por medio de una o más interfaces, de acceso remoto y automatizado
conditional_on: Minimum standards set by Commission general rule

summary: For each information request, participants must record at least the identity of the requester, the reason and purpose, the type of data requested and the date of the exchange.
quote: deberán dejar constancia de, al menos, la individualización del requirente, el motivo y el propósito del requerimiento

summary: Participants must adopt the minimum information security, cybersecurity and risk management standards set by the Commission, taking account of the sensitivity of the data.
quote: deberán adoptar las medidas necesarias para cumplir con los estándares mínimos de seguridad de información
conditional_on: Standards set by Commission general rule

summary: Upon security breaches, participants must report security incidents to the Commission without delay and adopt risk mitigation measures.
quote: deberán reportar los incidentes de seguridad a la Comisión sin dilaciones
conditional_on: Breach of the security measures

summary: Information-based service providers and payment initiation providers must use authentication mechanisms and obtain the client's prior and explicit consent before consulting information or initiating payments; for information requests the consent must be free, informed, express and specific.
quote: deberán adoptar mecanismos de autentificación del Cliente y obtener su consentimiento previo y explícito

summary: The client may revoke consent at any time.
quote: Éste podrá revocar en cualquier momento el consentimiento otorgado

summary: After consent is revoked, the information-based service provider or payment initiation provider may not continue using the consent for new information queries or new payment orders.
quote: estará prohibido al Proveedor de Servicios basados en Información
conditional_on: Client revokes consent

summary: Information provider institutions must implement mechanisms to authenticate information-based service providers and payment initiation providers and verify their registration with the Commission.
quote: deberán implementar mecanismos para la autenticación de los Proveedores de Servicios basados en Información

summary: Participants are responsible for the integrity, availability, security and confidentiality of data in each transaction and for client privacy; providers must use data only within the client's authorisation and answer to clients for unauthorised access or loss of data.
quote: serán responsables de resguardar la integridad, disponibilidad, seguridad y confidencialidad de los datos

summary: Information-based service providers and payment initiation providers must stop accessing information and initiating payments as soon as consent is withdrawn or expires, or when vulnerabilities put client data at risk, and in that case notify the client, the Commission and the information provider.
quote: deberán interrumpir el acceso de información y la realización de nuevas órdenes de pago tan pronto el Cliente retire su consentimiento
conditional_on: Consent withdrawn, expired, or vulnerability identified

summary: Participants must handle client queries and complaints about exchanged data and services through client service mechanisms.
quote: deberán disponer de mecanismos de atención de Clientes

summary: Information provider institutions may not charge information-based service providers for communicating client data through the Open Finance interfaces, except reimbursement of incremental direct costs above a volume threshold set by the Commission.
quote: no podrán efectuar cobros a los Proveedores de Servicios basados en Información

summary: Information provider and account provider institutions may not impose restrictions, limitations or obstacles on access by authorised service providers, nor discriminate against their requests relative to the client's own direct transactions.
quote: no podrán establecer restricciones, limitaciones u obstáculos para el intercambio de información

summary: The Commission must issue the regulation and instructions needed for the Open Finance System and supervise compliance by the participating institutions.
quote: Corresponderá a la Comisión dictar la regulación e instrucciones necesarias

summary: Before issuing Open Finance rules, the Commission must carry out public consultation and regulatory impact assessment and request a report from the Fiscalía Nacional Económica.
quote: se deberán llevar a cabo los trámites de consulta pública y evaluación de impacto regulatorio

summary: Covered providers and listed banks and institutions must adopt policies, procedures and controls to avoid offering products that do not match client needs, expectations and risk tolerance; they may request client information and must inform clients of product characteristics and risks.
quote: deberán adoptar políticas, procedimientos y controles tendientes a evitar que se ofrezcan productos que no sean acorde

summary: Information, advertising or promotion of financial products may not contain statements or representations that may mislead the public about nature, prices, returns or other characteristics of the products or providers.
quote: no podrá contener declaraciones, alusiones o representaciones que puedan inducir a error

summary: Banks offering current accounts must set public, objective and non-discriminatory conditions for access to those accounts by regulated providers, card issuers and other institutions the Commission designates.
quote: deberán establecer las condiciones públicas, objetivas y no discriminatorias

summary: A bank that refuses, suspends or closes a current account for an institution must communicate the decision promptly and state the justified reasons, linked to the specific risks or the applicant's non-compliance with the general conditions.
quote: deberá comunicar dicha decisión a la mayor brevedad, y por causa justificada
conditional_on: Refusal, suspension or closure of the account

summary: As amended into Ley 20.950 Art. 5, non-bank issuers of prepaid payment means may use money received from the public only for payments for use of those means, executing transfers instructed by the holder, charges, or reimbursement.
quote: solamente podrá destinarse a efectuar los pagos correspondientes a la utilización de dichos medios

summary: As inserted into Ley 19.913 Art. 3, registered providers of crowdfunding, alternative transaction systems, custody, intermediation and payment initiation services must report to the UAF (anti-money-laundering unit) under the same obligations as the listed entities.
provision: Art. 36, numeral 2 (inserting into Ley 19.913, Art. 3, inciso 1)
quote: quienes estén inscritos en el Registro de Prestadores de Servicios Financieros y en el Registro de Proveedores de Servicios de Iniciación de Pagos

summary: As inserted into Ley 20.009 Art. 4, where a payment initiated through a payment initiation provider is disputed, the emitter must prove that the operation was authorised and recorded, and the provider must prove this within its competence.
provision: Art. 38, numeral 1 (replacing Ley 20.009, Art. 4, inciso quinto)
quote: corresponderá al emisor probar que ella fue autorizada por el usuario y que se encuentra registrada a su nombre
conditional_on: Disputed electronic payment initiated through a payment initiation provider

summary: As replaced in Ley 20.009 Art. 6, card issuers, operators, merchants and other entities involved in electronic payments, including payment initiation providers, must adopt security measures to prevent the listed offences and protect data privacy; issuers must have transaction monitoring, alert procedures and fraud limits.
quote: deberán adoptar las medidas de seguridad necesarias para prevenir la comisión de los ilícitos

summary: As inserted into Ley 21.236 Art. 30, communications between providers in a financial portability process must take place through the remote, automated interfaces of participants in the Open Finance System.
provision: Art. 39 (inserting into Ley 21.236, Art. 30, inciso final)
quote: deberán realizarse a través de las interfaces de acceso remoto y automatizado
conditional_on: Providers are participants in the Open Finance System

summary: As inserted into DFL 251 Art. 3, the Commission must set by general rule the minimum conditions that insurers and insurance intermediaries must meet for public service, including in offices and other channels.
provision: Art. 40, numeral 1 (inserting DFL 251, Art. 3, literal n))
quote: Establecer, mediante norma de carácter general, las condiciones mínimas que deberán cumplir las compañías de seguros

summary: As inserted into Ley 18.876 Art. 20, depositary and custody entities must meet corporate governance and risk management requirements set by the Commission by general rule.
provision: Art. 41, numeral 2 (inserting Ley 18.876, Art. 20, literal i))
quote: Cumplir con las exigencias de gobierno corporativo y gestión de riesgos que determine la Comisión mediante norma de carácter general.

summary: As inserted into DL 3.538 Art. 5 numeral 36, the Commission must set by general rule the minimum conditions that supervised institutions must meet for public service, including in offices and other channels.
quote: Establecer, mediante norma de carácter general, las condiciones mínimas que deberán cumplir las instituciones fiscalizadas en materia de atención al público

summary: Persons providing services under Title II that must be registered must apply for registration and authorisation within twelve months from the entry into force of the Commission's general rule; they may continue until the Commission decides.
applies_from: 12 months from entry into force of the Commission's general rule
quote: deberán dar cumplimiento a la obligación de solicitar su registro y autorización para operar ante la Comisión
conditional_on: Commission general rule issued

summary: Entities that do not apply for registration within the twelve-month period, or do not obtain it, must stop providing services for new operations, conclude existing ones, and notify their clients.
applies_from: 12 months from entry into force of the Commission's general rule
quote: deberán abstenerse de continuar prestando sus servicios para la celebración de nuevas operaciones
conditional_on: Failure to apply or obtain registration within the period

summary: The Commission must issue the regulation needed to implement the Open Finance System within eighteen months of publication of the law.
quote: La Comisión para el Mercado Financiero deberá dictar la normativa necesaria para la implementación del Sistema de Finanzas Abiertas

summary: Entities already providing payment initiation services with client consent when the law enters into force must apply for registration with the Commission, under the CMF general rules, within twelve months from the entry into force of 'estas disposiciones' (most naturally those CMF rules); they may continue until the Commission decides.
applies_from: 12 months from entry into force of 'estas disposiciones' (the CMF general rules on registration, on the most natural reading)
quote: deberán dar cumplimiento a la obligación de solicitar su registro ante la Comisión
conditional_on: Services already provided with client consent at entry into force

summary: During the first five years, the Ministry of Finance must produce an annual report on the law's effects, including registered entities statistics and Open Finance System data, and send it to the Senate and Chamber finance committees before 31 March of the following year.
applies_from: First five years from entry into force
quote: el Ministerio de Hacienda deberá elaborar un informe anual sobre los efectos de la aplicación de la misma

summary: As inserted into Ley 20.009 Art. 5, where a payment initiation service provider is responsible for an unauthorised payment or transfer, it must reimburse the card or account issuer for its losses or the sums refunded to the user, including the amount of the unauthorised operation.
applies_from: entry into force of the law (30 days after publication)
provision: Artículo 38 n°2 (inserting Ley 20.009, Art. 5, inciso séptimo)
quote: éste deberá resarcir al emisor por las pérdidas sufridas o las sumas abonadas para efectuar la devolución al usuario
conditional_on: Unauthorised electronic payment initiated through a payment initiation service provider that is responsible for it

summary: The Agency and the sectoral authorities must perform their functions in coordination, pursue unity of action and avoid duplication or interference of functions.
quote: la Agencia y las autoridades sectoriales deberán cumplir sus cometidos coordinadamente

summary: The Agency establishes by resolution of the Director the providers of essential services that are qualified as operators of vital importance (OIV); it must take into account the size of private institutions, including MSMEs.
quote: La Agencia establecerá mediante resolución dictada por el Director o la Directora Nacional

summary: At least every three years the Agency must review and update the qualification of operators of vital importance; it requests reports from sectoral public bodies and sets a preliminary and final list after consultation.
quote: Al menos cada tres años, la Agencia deberá revisar y actualizar la calificación de operadores de importancia vital

summary: A regulation of the Ministry in charge of public security shall govern the remaining aspects of the OIV qualification procedure.
quote: Un reglamento expedido por el Ministerio encargado de la seguridad pública contemplará los demás aspectos del procedimiento

summary: Obligated institutions must permanently apply technological, organizational, physical or informational measures to prevent, report and resolve cybersecurity incidents, and implement the protocols and standards set by the Agency and sectoral standards.
quote: deberán aplicar de manera permanente las medidas para prevenir, reportar y resolver incidentes de ciberseguridad

summary: The Agency must observe Art. 25 and hold public consultation on security protocols and standards, publishing them with a justification report; it must set differentiated security measures by type of organization, considering SMEs.
quote: La Agencia deberá establecer medidas de seguridad diferenciadas según el tipo de organización de que se trate

summary: All OIV must implement a continuous information security management system to determine risks and to assess both probability and potential impact of incidents.
quote: Implementar un sistema de gestión de seguridad de la información continuo

summary: OIV must keep a record of the actions executed under their information security management system, as set by regulation.
quote: Mantener un registro de las acciones ejecutadas que compongan el sistema de gestión de seguridad de la información

summary: OIV must prepare and implement operational continuity and cybersecurity plans, certified under Art. 28 and reviewed at least every two years; they must also adopt timely measures to reduce the impact and spread of an incident, including restricting access to systems.
quote: Elaborar e implementar planes de continuidad operacional y ciberseguridad

summary: OIV must continuously carry out reviews, exercises, drills and analyses of networks and systems to detect threats, and communicate the results to the national CSIRT.
quote: Realizar continuamente operaciones de revisión, ejercicios, simulacros y análisis de las redes, sistemas informáticos

summary: OIV must hold the certifications required by the law (Art. 28).
quote: Contar con las certificaciones que señala el artículo 28.

summary: OIV must inform potentially affected persons, where they can be identified and when the Agency requires it, of incidents that may seriously compromise their information or systems, especially involving personal data.
quote: Informar a los potenciales afectados, en la medida que puedan identificarse
conditional_on: When the Agency requires it, or when necessary to prevent or manage an incident

summary: OIV must maintain cybersecurity training, education and continuing hygiene programs for workers and collaborators, and must designate a cybersecurity delegate who acts as counterpart of the Agency.
quote: Contar con programas de capacitación, formación y educación continua de sus trabajadores y colaboradores

summary: Public and private institutions under Art. 4 must report to the national CSIRT significant cyberattacks and incidents: an early alert within 3 hours; an update within 72 hours (24 hours for OIV whose essential services are affected); a final report within 15 calendar days; continued reporting if the incident persists; OIV must also report their action plan within 7 days.
quote: tendrán la obligación de reportar al CSIRT Nacional los ciberataques e incidentes de ciberseguridad
conditional_on: Incidents with significant effects under Art. 27

summary: In State bodies, heads of service must require IT service providers to share information on vulnerabilities and incidents affecting State networks and systems.
quote: los jefes de servicio deberán exigir a los proveedores de servicios de tecnologías de la información que compartan la información sobre vulnerabilidades

summary: Service contracts with State bodies may not contain any clause that restricts or hinders the provider from communicating threat information, provided security and data protection are not compromised.
quote: los contratos de prestación de servicios no podrán contener ninguna cláusula que pueda restringir o dificultar de cualquier modo la comunicación de información sobre amenazas

summary: The Agency must issue the instructions needed for the proper making and reception of incident reports, and organize a single window for simultaneous notifications where more than one authority must be notified.
quote: La Agencia dictará las instrucciones que sean necesarias para la debida realización y recepción de los reportes

summary: A regulation of the Ministry in charge of public security shall regulate the content of the different reports under Art. 9.
quote: Un reglamento expedido por el Ministerio encargado de la seguridad pública regulará el contenido de las diversas clases de reportes

summary: In exercising its functions the Agency must always ensure regulatory coherence, so that its actions fit harmoniously in the national regulatory and sanctioning framework.
quote: la Agencia deberá siempre velar por la coherencia normativa

summary: The Agency issues the protocols and standards under Art. 7 and general and particular instructions that are mandatory for public and private institutions obligated by the law, as well as other rules needed for application.
quote: las instrucciones generales y particulares, de carácter obligatorio, para las instituciones, tanto públicas como privadas obligadas por la presente ley

summary: The Agency must create and administer a National Registry of Cybersecurity Incidents; it also qualifies essential services and OIV, certifies compliance by State bodies, and must coordinate a national cybersecurity capability exercise each October.
quote: Crear y administrar un Registro Nacional de Incidentes de Ciberseguridad.

summary: Obligated entities whose services were affected by an incident must provide potentially affected persons with truthful, sufficient and timely information, when the Agency so requires.
quote: que entreguen a los potenciales afectados información veraz, suficiente y oportuna sobre su ocurrencia
conditional_on: When required by the Agency under Art. 8(g)

summary: The supervised entity must cooperate at all times with Agency officials or authorized third parties during inspections and supervision.
quote: La entidad fiscalizada deberá cooperar en todo momento con los funcionarios de la Agencia
conditional_on: Agency inspection, audit or analysis of the supervised entity

summary: Once notified of an Agency instruction for access to networks and systems in a significant incident, the required party must provide all necessary access facilities; a private institution may object, in which case judicial authorization is needed.
quote: Una vez notificado, el requerido deberá proporcionar todas las facilidades de acceso que sean necesarias.
conditional_on: Notified instruction of the Agency's Director in cases of significant-impact incidents

summary: The Director must issue by resolution the regulations that the law assigns to the Agency.
quote: Dictar, mediante resolución, la normativa que de acuerdo a esta ley corresponda dictar a la Agencia.

summary: A Ministry regulation shall determine the internal structure of the Agency, subject to the authorized staffing and maximum personnel.
quote: Un reglamento expedido por el Ministerio encargado de la seguridad pública determinará la estructura interna del Servicio

summary: Each year the Director must issue a resolution, endorsed by the Budget Directorate, setting the Agency's staffing structure and the maximum number of workers.
quote: Una resolución dictada por el Director o la Directora de la Agencia, visada por la Dirección de Presupuestos, establecerá en forma anual la estructura de la dotación

summary: Agency staff may not provide personal services to persons or entities subject to the Agency's supervision, or to their managers or employees.
quote: Prohíbese al personal de la Agencia prestar por sí o a través de otras personas naturales o jurídicas, servicios personales a personas o a entidades sometidas a la fiscalización de la Agencia

summary: The Agency must keep secret vulnerability notifications, their supporting material and the identity of the notifier; the notifier's identity may be disclosed only with express consent.
quote: La Agencia deberá mantener en secreto la notificación, sus antecedentes y la identidad de quien la realice.

summary: The Advisory Council on Cybersecurity must meet at least four times a year; the Agency must provide the technical and administrative support the Council needs.
quote: El Consejo sesionará, a lo menos, cuatro veces al año

summary: The State Secure Connectivity Network (RCSE) provides internet interconnection and connectivity services to State administration bodies.
quote: que proveerá servicios de interconexión y conectividad a internet a los organismos de la Administración del Estado

summary: A regulation of the Ministry in charge of public security, endorsed by the Finance Minister, shall regulate the operation of the RCSE and the special obligations of State bodies.
quote: Un reglamento expedido por el Ministerio encargado de la seguridad pública y visado por el Ministro de Hacienda regulará el funcionamiento de la RCSE

summary: The national CSIRT must respond to significant cyberattacks and incidents, coordinate State CSIRTs and the defence CSIRT, act as liaison with foreign CSIRTs, supervise national incidents, provide training, request anonymized information, and issue early alerts to the community.
quote: Responder ante ciberataques o incidentes de ciberseguridad, cuando éstos sean de efecto significativo.

summary: Before issuing general protocols, technical standards or instructions that affect another sectoral authority's competence, the Agency must send the relevant information to that authority and request a report.
quote: deberá previamente remitir la información relevante a dicha entidad y solicitar un informe
conditional_on: Where the Agency's protocols or instructions affect another sectoral authority's area

summary: The requested sectoral authority must issue its report within 30 calendar days; sectoral authorities issuing general acts with effects on the Agency's areas must send the relevant information to the Agency and request a report, and take into account prior Agency protocols.
quote: La autoridad sectorial requerida deberá evacuar su informe dentro del plazo de treinta días corridos
conditional_on: Request from the Agency or sectoral general acts affecting Agency competence

summary: Supervised institutions must comply with the sectoral authority's general norms and instructions on prevention of cybersecurity incidents when managing their risks; these prevail over Agency norms where equivalent, subject to a joint norm.
quote: Las instituciones supervisadas deberán cumplir obligatoriamente con estas normas e instrucciones en la gestión de sus riesgos
conditional_on: Sectoral norms or instructions issued by a sectoral authority

summary: The Agency and the relevant sectoral authority must first issue a joint general norm setting criteria for assessing the equivalence of effects between Agency and sectoral rules.
quote: la Agencia y la autoridad sectorial correspondiente deberán previamente dictar una norma conjunta de carácter general

summary: State CSIRTs must take the necessary steps to support restoration of an affected service, under the coordination of the national CSIRT.
quote: Los CSIRT que pertenezcan a los organismos de la Administración del Estado tendrán la obligación de tomar las providencias necesarias
conditional_on: Incidents with significant effects under Art. 27

summary: Incident reports must omit all personal data or information, as set out in Art. 2(f) of Law 19.628; IP addresses are not considered personal data for this purpose.
quote: Deberá omitirse en los reportes de incidentes de ciberseguridad todo dato o información personal

summary: The specific procedure for notifying an incident, its form, anonymity conditions, report taxonomy and periodicity are to be set by the regulation of the law.
quote: serán establecidos en el reglamento de la presente ley

summary: OIV must obtain the cybersecurity certifications required by the law and those the Agency determines by regulation, issued only by bodies in the Agency's registry of authorized certifiers.
quote: Los operadores de importancia vital deberán obtener las certificaciones de ciberseguridad que señala esta ley

summary: Certification bodies must meet the requirements set by regulation to join the Agency's registry of authorized certifiers and must continue to meet them to remain in it.
quote: Para formar parte de este registro bastará acreditar el cumplimiento de los requisitos que establezca el reglamento
conditional_on: Registration in the Agency's registry of certifiers

summary: The Defence CSIRT must establish minimum cybersecurity protocols and standards for prevention, detection, containment, recovery and response within the Armed Forces and the Joint General Staff, considering the Agency's guidelines.
quote: Establecer los protocolos y estándares mínimos de ciberseguridad

summary: The Ministry of National Defence shall determine by regulation the functions of the defence institutional CSIRTs, in line with defence cyber policy and the Agency's guidelines.
quote: Las funciones de los CSIRT Institucionales de la Defensa Nacional serán determinadas por la reglamentación que el Ministerio de Defensa Nacional dicte al efecto

summary: All national defence institutions must report significant cyberattacks and incidents to the Defence CSIRT.
quote: Todas las instituciones de la defensa nacional deberán reportar los ciberataques e incidentes de ciberseguridad que puedan tener efectos significativos al CSIRT de la Defensa Nacional.
conditional_on: Incidents that may have significant effects

summary: The Defence CSIRT must report to the Agency all incidents it identifies, unless doing so would endanger national security and defence, as set by regulation.
quote: El CSIRT de la Defensa Nacional reportará a la Agencia todos los incidentes identificados
conditional_on: Where national security and defence are not put at risk

summary: Agency and CSIRT officials, and staff of State bodies who learn of the protected information, must keep its existence and content secret, even after leaving their posts.
quote: estarán obligados a mantener el carácter secreto de su existencia y contenido

summary: The duty of secrecy also applies to persons who, without being officials, learn of requests for special information-gathering procedures and related court rulings.
quote: La obligación de guardar secreto regirá, además, para aquellos que, sin ser funcionarios o funcionarias de la Agencia

summary: The Agency must keep and protect the confidentiality of information it receives in performing its functions, and must respect fundamental rights, including privacy and personal data protection.
quote: La Agencia deberá mantener y cautelar la reserva de la información que llegue a conocer en el desempeño de sus funciones

summary: The head of each State body must ensure the body applies suitable and necessary measures to prevent, report and resolve cybersecurity incidents.
quote: El jefe superior del organismo de la Administración del Estado deberá velar por que el organismo respectivo aplique las medidas idóneas y necesarias

summary: State bodies must adopt the measures the Agency indicates to remedy or prevent the infringements it identifies.
quote: deberán adoptar las medidas tendientes a subsanar o prevenir las infracciones que indique la Agencia
conditional_on: Infringements indicated by the Agency

summary: The Interministerial Committee on Cybersecurity must advise the President on the National Cybersecurity Policy and its implementation, propose legal changes where relevant, support the Agency and consider the Multisectoral Council's recommendations.
quote: En el ejercicio de sus funciones, el Comité deberá:

summary: The Committee has an Executive Secretariat located in the Agency that provides technical, administrative and content support; the Agency's Director convenes, directs and records the sessions and implements agreements.
quote: El Comité contará con una Secretaría Ejecutiva radicada en la Agencia, la que prestará el apoyo técnico, administrativo y de contenidos

summary: A regulation of the Ministry in charge of public security shall set the operating rules of the Committee.
quote: Un reglamento expedido por el Ministerio encargado de la seguridad pública fijará las normas de funcionamiento del Comité.

summary: The Senate, Chamber of Deputies, Judiciary, Comptroller General, Central Bank, Public Prosecutor, Electoral Service and National Television Council must adopt security measures for their networks and systems; their highest authorities may issue rules taking the Agency's recommendations into account.
quote: deberán adoptar las medidas de seguridad de sus redes y sistemas informáticos que sean pertinentes

summary: The autonomous constitutional bodies listed in Art. 53 must agree incident reporting mechanisms and coordination and cooperation arrangements for incident response.
quote: deberán convenir mecanismos de reporte de incidentes de ciberseguridad

summary: Amends Ley 20.424 (Ministry of Defence organic statute), Art. 25, adding a letter k): the Ministry must conduct the Defence CSIRT in coordination with the Undersecretariat of Defence.
quote: Conducir al Equipo de Respuesta a Incidentes de Seguridad Informática de la Defensa Nacional en coordinación con la Subsecretaría de Defensa.

summary: Amends Ley 21.459, Art. 2 (new final paragraph): access to a system whose owner is domiciled in Chile is not criminally sanctioned only if, among other conditions, the person is registered in the Agency's register and informed the Agency of the access beforehand.
provision: Art. 55(1) (inserting Ley 21.459, Art. 2 inciso final, no. 1)
quote: Que se encuentre inscrito en el registro que al efecto lleve la Agencia Nacional de Ciberseguridad.
conditional_on: Conditions for exemption from criminal sanction for security research access

summary: Amends Ley 21.459, Art. 2: the access and the security vulnerabilities detected must be reported to the system's owner and to the Agency as soon as the access is made.
provision: Art. 55(1) (inserting Ley 21.459, Art. 2 inciso final, no. 3)
quote: Que el acceso y las vulnerabilidades de seguridad detectadas hayan sido reportadas al responsable del sistema informático y a la Agencia, tan pronto se hubiere realizado.
conditional_on: Conditions for exemption from criminal sanction for security research access

summary: Amends Ley 21.459, Art. 2: the person must not have publicly disclosed the information on the potential vulnerability.
provision: Art. 55(1) (inserting Ley 21.459, Art. 2 inciso final, no. 5)
quote: Que no haya divulgado públicamente la información relativa a la potencial vulnerabilidad.
conditional_on: Conditions for exemption from criminal sanction for security research access

summary: The President may, within one year of publication in the Official Gazette, issue decrees with force of law to set the Agency's start of activities, staffing, budget and other transitional matters.
applies_from: Within one year of publication in the Diario Oficial
quote: Facúltase al Presidente de la República para que en el plazo de un año de publicada en el Diario Oficial la presente ley

summary: The Ministry of the Interior and Public Security must issue the regulations referred to in the law.
applies_from: 180 days after publication of the law
quote: Dentro del plazo de ciento ochenta días posteriores a la publicación de la ley, el Ministerio del Interior y Seguridad Pública deberá expedir los reglamentos señalados en esta ley.

summary: Honour the data subject's rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, portability and blocking; these rights cannot be waived or limited by contract.
quote: tiene derecho de acceso, rectificación, supresión, oposición, portabilidad y bloqueo de sus datos personales, de conformidad a la presente ley

summary: Data subjects may object to, and not be subject to, decisions based on automated processing (including profiling) with legal or similarly significant effects, unless the decision is needed for a contract, rests on express consent or is authorised by law. In every case the controller must ensure information, explanation, human intervention, the chance to state a view and review.
quote: el responsable deberá adoptar las medidas necesarias para asegurar los derechos y libertades del titular, su derecho a la información y transparencia, el derecho a obtener una explicación, a la intervención humana, a expresar su punto de vista y a solicitar la revisión de la decisión

summary: On access requests, disclose meaningful information about the logic involved when the controller makes automated decisions under art. 8 bis.
quote: La información significativa sobre la lógica aplicada en el caso de que el responsable realice tratamiento de datos de conformidad con el artículo 8° bis

summary: Provide data portability in a structured, commonly used electronic format, and transmit directly to another controller where technically possible, when processing is automated and based on consent.
quote: El titular de datos tiene derecho a solicitar y recibir una copia de los datos personales que le conciernen, que haya facilitado al responsable, en un formato electrónico estructurado, genérico y de uso común

summary: Provide free, simple electronic means for exercising rights; acknowledge and answer requests within 30 calendar days (extendable once by 30); answer temporary-blocking requests within 2 business days.
quote: Recibida la solicitud el responsable deberá acusar recibo de ella y pronunciarse a más tardar dentro de los treinta días corridos siguientes a la fecha de ingreso de la solicitud

summary: Controllers without a domicile in Chile that process data of residents must designate and keep up to date an email address or other contact channel for data subjects and the Agency (for legal persons not incorporated in Chile, notified in writing to the Agency).
quote: El responsable de datos que no tenga domicilio en Chile y que realice tratamiento de datos de personas que residan en el territorio nacional, deberá señalar y mantener actualizado y operativo, un correo electrónico u otro medio de contacto idóneo

summary: Consent must be free, informed, specific, prior and unambiguous, and revocable at any time. Without consent, processing is lawful only on the bases listed in art. 13 (contract, legal obligation, legitimate interest, financial-obligation data, legal claims). The controller bears the burden of proof.
quote: El consentimiento del titular debe ser libre, informado y específico en cuanto a su finalidad o finalidades

summary: Collect data from lawful sources for specific, explicit and lawful purposes, limit processing to those purposes, keep data accurate, and delete or anonymise data obtained for pre-contractual measures.
quote: Asegurar que los datos personales se recojan de fuentes de acceso lícitas con fines específicos, explícitos y lícitos, y que su tratamiento se limite al cumplimiento de estos fines

summary: Keep personal data secret or confidential, including data compiled or combined from public sources, and make staff and processors comply; the duty continues after the relationship ends.
quote: El responsable de datos está obligado a mantener secreto o confidencialidad acerca de los datos personales que conciernan a un titular

summary: Publish permanently on the website: the processing policy, identity and contact details, data categories, recipients, purposes, legal bases, security policy, rights, transfers, retention periods, data sources, and the existence and logic of automated decisions, including profiling.
quote: La existencia de decisiones automatizadas, incluida la elaboración de perfiles. En tales casos, información significativa sobre la lógica aplicada, así como las consecuencias previstas de dicho tratamiento para el titular

summary: Apply data protection by design and by default: technical and organisational measures before and during processing, so that by default only the data strictly necessary are processed.
quote: el responsable debe aplicar medidas técnicas y organizativas adecuadas desde el diseño con anterioridad y durante el tratamiento de los datos personales

summary: Adopt risk-appropriate technical and organisational security measures (e.g., pseudonymisation, encryption, resilience, restoration, regular testing). The controller must prove them if an incident occurs. Processors share the duty.
provision: Art. primero, Ley 19.628 art. 14 quinquies, inc. 2
quote: el responsable y el encargado del tratamiento aplicarán medidas técnicas y organizativas apropiadas para garantizar un nivel de seguridad adecuado al riesgo

summary: Report security breaches posing a reasonable risk to data subjects' rights to the Agency without undue delay, and keep a record of breaches and the measures taken.
provision: Art. primero, Ley 19.628 art. 14 sexies, inc. 1
quote: El responsable deberá reportar a la Agencia, por los medios más expeditos posibles y sin dilaciones indebidas, las vulneraciones a las medidas de seguridad

summary: Also notify affected data subjects in clear language (individually, or by a public notice in national media if that is not possible) when a breach involves sensitive data, data of children under 14 or financial-obligation data.
provision: Art. primero, Ley 19.628 art. 14 sexies, inc. 3
quote: Cuando dichas vulneraciones se refieran a datos personales sensibles, datos relativos a niños y niñas menores de catorce años o datos relativos a obligaciones de carácter económico, financiero, bancario o comercial, el responsable deberá también efectuar esta comunicación a los titulares

summary: Data may be transferred to another controller (cesión) only with consent or another listed basis, in writing, and for the purposes agreed; a transfer that lacked a required consent is void and the recipient must delete the data.
quote: Si se verifica una cesión de datos sin contar con el consentimiento del titular, siendo éste necesario, la cesión será nula

summary: Processors act only on the controller's instructions under a written contract with mandatory terms, may sub-delegate only with written authorisation, must meet the confidentiality and security duties, report breaches to the controller, and delete or return data at the end. A processor that departs from its mandate is treated as a controller.
provision: Art. primero, Ley 19.628 art. 15 bis, inc. 4
quote: El tercero mandatario o encargado deberá cumplir con lo dispuesto en los artículos 14 bis y 14 quinquies

summary: Carry out a data protection impact assessment before processing likely to pose high risk; always required for systematic automated evaluation or profiling with significant legal effects, large-scale processing, systematic monitoring of public areas, and sensitive data processed without consent.
quote: el responsable del tratamiento deberá realizar, previo al inicio de las operaciones del tratamiento, una evaluación del impacto en protección de datos personales

summary: Sensitive personal data require express consent, subject to listed exceptions (made public by the data subject, non-profit members, vital interests, legal claims, employment and social security, legal authorisation).
quote: El tratamiento de los datos personales sensibles sólo puede realizarse cuando el titular a quien conciernen estos datos manifiesta su consentimiento en forma expresa

summary: Processing or transferring health and biological-profile data, or biological samples, is prohibited when collected in employment, education, sport, social, insurance, security or identification settings, unless a law expressly authorises it.
provision: Art. primero, Ley 19.628 art. 16 bis, inc. 3
quote: Se prohíbe el tratamiento y la cesión de los datos relativos a la salud y al perfil biológico de un titular y las muestras biológicas asociadas a una persona identificada o identificable

summary: Biometric data may be processed only with express consent, and only if the data subject is told which biometric system is used, the specific purpose, the period of use, and how to exercise rights.
provision: Art. primero, Ley 19.628 art. 16 ter, inc. 2
quote: Sólo podrán tratarse estos datos cuando se cumpliere con lo dispuesto en el inciso primero del artículo 16 y siempre que el responsable proporcione al titular la siguiente información específica

summary: Children's data must be processed in their best interest; data of children under 14 require consent from parents, legal representatives or carers, unless authorised by law. Schools and anyone processing minors' data have a special duty of care.
provision: Art. primero, Ley 19.628 art. 16 quáter, inc. 2
quote: para tratar los datos personales de los niños y niñas se requiere el consentimiento otorgado por sus padres o representantes legales o por quien tiene a su cargo el cuidado personal del niño o niña

summary: Inform data subjects clearly of the type of geolocation data processed, the purpose and duration, and any sharing with third parties.
provision: Art. primero, Ley 19.628 art. 16 sexies, inc. 2
quote: El titular de datos deberá ser informado de manera clara, suficiente y oportuna, del tipo de datos de geolocalización que serán tratados

summary: Delete information on time-barred (prescribed) financial, banking or commercial obligations from records, without any request needed.
provision: Art. primero No. 9(c), Ley 19.628 art. 17, inc. 8
quote: Los responsables deberán suprimir de sus registros o bases de datos, toda aquella información personal relativa a obligaciones prescritas

summary: International transfers are lawful only to adequate countries, under adequate safeguards (clauses, binding corporate rules, certification), or under listed exceptions for specific, non-habitual transfers. The exporting controller must prove compliance to the Agency.
quote: Corresponderá al responsable de datos que efectuó la transferencia internacional de datos, acreditar ante la Agencia que ésta se practicó de conformidad a las reglas establecidas en esta ley

summary: Mass processing of personal data contained in public bodies' electronic registers of criminal, civil, administrative and disciplinary infringements is prohibited (very serious infringement).
quote: Se prohíbe el tratamiento masivo de los datos personales contenidos en los registros electrónicos de infracciones penales, civiles, administrativas y disciplinarias que lleven los organismos públicos

summary: All controllers, public or private, must take action to prevent the infringements in arts. 34 bis-34 quáter. They may also adopt a voluntary infringement-prevention programme, which the Agency certifies (art. 49).
quote: deberán adoptar acciones destinadas a prevenir la comisión de las infracciones establecidas en los artículos 34 bis, 34 ter y 34 quáter

summary: Public bodies may process data without consent for their legal functions, are bound by the principles and core controller duties, and must publish monthly on their websites their data-sharing agreements.
quote: Los organismos públicos deberán informar mensualmente a través de su página web institucional los convenios suscritos con otros organismos públicos y con entidades privadas relativos a cesión o transferencia de datos personales

summary: The head of each public body must ensure that the body's processing complies with the principles, rights and obligations of Title IV.
quote: El jefe superior de un órgano público deberá velar por que el órgano respectivo realice sus operaciones y actividades de tratamiento de los datos personales con arreglo a los principios

summary: The Agency issues binding general instructions (after public consultation), supervises, sanctions, resolves complaints, certifies prevention models and keeps the Registro Nacional de Sanciones y Cumplimiento.
quote: Dictar instrucciones y normas generales y obligatorias con el objeto de regular las operaciones de tratamiento de datos personales conforme a los principios establecidos en esta ley

summary: The Agency determines which countries offer adequate protection, may approve model clauses and binding corporate rules, and publishes the list of adequate countries and the model clauses.
quote: La Agencia determinará fundadamente los países que poseen niveles adecuados de protección de datos

summary: The Agency publishes an indicative list of processing operations that do or do not require an impact assessment, together with minimum guidance for carrying one out.
provision: Art. primero, Ley 19.628 art. 15 ter, inc. 3
quote: La Agencia de Protección de Datos Personales establecerá y publicará una lista orientativa de los tipos de operaciones de tratamiento que requieran o no una evaluación de impacto

summary: The Agency sets, by general instruction, minimum information and security standards differentiated by data type, firm size, activity and data volume.
provision: Art. primero, Ley 19.628 art. 14 septies, inc. 2
quote: serán determinados por la Agencia mediante instrucción general

summary: The Agency and the Consejo para la Transparencia must consult each other, with a 30-day report, before issuing general instructions that affect each other's remit.
quote: El Consejo para la Transparencia deberá evacuar el informe solicitado dentro del plazo de treinta días corridos

summary: The Agency's Consejo Directivo publishes an annual public account of its work within the first four months of each year.
quote: Elaborar, dentro del primer cuatrimestre de cada año, una cuenta pública anual

summary: The Executive must issue the implementing regulations within six months of publication; the Art. 26 regulation on public-sector data sharing is due within six months of entry into force, after an Agency report.
quote: Los reglamentos referidos en la presente ley deberán dictarse dentro de los seis meses siguientes a la publicación de esta ley en el Diario Oficial

summary: The President designates the first three councillors with Senate approval six months before entry into force; the Senate is deemed to approve if it does not decide in time. Before entry into force the council may exercise only limited functions.
quote: En caso de que el Senado no se pronuncie sobre la propuesta del Presidente de la República antes del vencimiento del plazo señalado en el inciso primero, dicha propuesta se entenderá aceptada sin más trámite

summary: The Servicio de Registro Civil e Identificación must eliminate the old registry of personal databases within the 60 days before entry into force.
quote: el Servicio de Registro Civil e Identificación deberá eliminar el registro de los bancos de datos personales contemplado en el actual artículo 22 de la ley N° 19.628

summary: Congress, the Judiciary, the Contraloría, the Ministerio Público, the Tribunal Constitucional, the Banco Central, Servel and the electoral and special courts must issue internal data-protection policies within 18 months of publication, and they exercise disciplinary power over their own officials.
quote: Las autoridades superiores de los órganos internos de estas instituciones deberán dictar las políticas, normas e instrucciones necesarias para dar cumplimiento a los principios y obligaciones establecidos en esta ley

summary: Public bodies that appoint a prevention officer or data protection delegate must choose an existing staff member.
quote: Los órganos públicos que establezcan un encargado de prevención o delegado de protección de datos personales deberán designar para ello a un funcionario de la dotación vigente del respectivo organismo
conditional_on: The public body chooses to appoint a prevention officer or data protection delegate

summary: Article 3 states that persons conducting AI scientific and technology activities shall apply ethics requirements throughout the whole process, following listed ethical principles. The addressee is implied (activity conductors); the article is a principle statement with an identifiable conduct.
quote: 开展人工智能科技活动应将科技伦理要求贯穿全过程

summary: Article 4 states that the standard system for AI technology ethics shall be established and improved, and that standards be formulated; the subject is not named in the clause. Encouragement of participation by universities, research and medical institutions, enterprises and social organisations in standard-making is a separate encouraged conduct (see the same article).
quote: 建立和完善人工智能科技伦理标准体系

summary: Universities, research institutions, medical and health institutions, enterprises and science associations are encouraged to participate in formulating, verifying and promoting AI ethics standards.
quote: 参与人工智能科技伦理标准的制定

summary: Article 5 requires advancing the AI ethics service system (risk monitoring, assessment, certification, consultancy) and increased support and services for review by micro, small and medium enterprises; the subject is not named.
quote: 加大对中小微企业人工智能科技伦理审查的支持

summary: Entities listed are encouraged to carry out AI ethics review research, support technical innovation in review, open high-quality datasets, develop risk management and audit tools, and promote ethically compliant AI products and services.
quote: 开展人工智能科技伦理审查研究

summary: Article 7 requires AI ethics publicity and education (subject not named), with public participation encouraged and mass media guided to carry such education.
quote: 开展人工智能科技伦理宣传教育

summary: Universities, research institutions, medical institutions and enterprises are encouraged to carry out AI ethics education and training and to develop talent.
quote: 开展人工智能科技伦理相关教育与培训

summary: Responsible entities (universities, research institutions, medical institutions, enterprises) shall establish an AI ethics committee under the Ethics Measures' Article 4, provide it with staff, premises and funds, and take measures to guarantee its independence. Certification of the ethics management system is encouraged.
quote: 应按照《伦理办法》第四条有关要求

summary: The committee's charter, composition and members' duties follow Articles 5 to 8 of the Ethics Measures; the committee shall include experts in AI technology, application, ethics and law.
quote: 委员会组成应包括人工智能

summary: A service centre shall not provide both review and re-review services for the same AI scientific and technology activity.
quote: 服务中心不得对同一人工智能科技活动同时提供审查和复核服务

summary: Service centres shall establish standardised management rules and procedures, have full-time staff with AI ethics review capability, and accept supervision by local or competent authorities.
quote: 服务中心应建立规范的管理制度和程序

summary: The leader of an AI activity shall apply to the unit's committee (or an entrusted service centre where no committee exists) and submit application materials: activity plan, ethics risk assessment and response plan, and a written commitment to comply with ethics and research integrity requirements.
quote: 人工智能科技活动负责人应向本单位委员会申请
conditional_on: Activities within the scope of Art. 2

summary: Application materials must include an assessment of potential ethics risks from the planned AI application, monitoring and early-warning measures, and prevention and control plans; this is listed among the application materials in Art. 12(2).
quote: 潜在科技伦理风险评估
conditional_on: Activities within the scope of Art. 2

summary: The committee or service centre decides whether to accept an application and notifies the applicant; on acceptance it specifies the general, simplified or emergency procedure; where materials are incomplete it must inform the applicant of all missing materials in one notice.
quote: 材料不齐全的应一次性完整告知需补充的材料

summary: Ethics review meetings are chaired by the committee director or designated deputy and require at least 5 attending members including members of the different categories in Art. 10; non-conflicted advisory experts may be consulted but do not vote.
quote: 到会委员应不少于 5 人

summary: Review focuses on human welfare, fairness and justice (including bias prevention), controllability and trustworthiness, transparency and explainability, accountability and traceability, and privacy protection.
quote: 重点关注以下方面

summary: Decision within 30 days after acceptance (extension possible in complex cases) on approval, re-review after modification, or refusal; for modification or refusal, the committee shall give suggestions or reasons. Applicants may appeal within 3 working days, and the committee re-decides within 7 working days if the appeal has sufficient grounds.
quote: 应在申请受理后的 30 日内

summary: The activity leader shall promptly identify changes in ethics risk and report them to the committee or service centre.
quote: 人工智能科技活动负责人应及时识别科技伦理风险变化

summary: The committee or service centre conducts follow-up review of approved activities under Art. 19 of the Ethics Measures, at intervals generally not exceeding 12 months; it may suspend or terminate activities when necessary.
quote: 跟踪审查间隔一般不超过 12 个月

summary: Where several units cooperate on an AI activity, they may mutually recognise each other's ethics review results.
quote: 可根据实际情况开展单位间人工智能科技伦理审查结果互认
conditional_on: Multi-unit cooperation

summary: The simplified procedure may be used where (1) ethics risk is no higher than ordinary daily-life risk, (2) a minor change is made to an approved plan without raising the risk-benefit ratio, or (3) follow-up review of an activity with no major adjustment.
quote: 有下列情形之一的可以适用简易程序
conditional_on: Conditions listed in Art. 19(1) to (3)

summary: The committee or service centre shall formulate work rules and follow-up frequency for simplified review; the simplified review is conducted by at least two designated members; it must switch to the general procedure if a negative opinion, doubt or disagreement arises.
quote: 委员会或服务中心应制定适用简易程序审查的工作规程和跟踪频度

summary: The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the Ministry of Science and Technology, with relevant departments, formulate and publish the list of AI activities requiring expert review, adjusted dynamically as needed.
quote: 工业和信息化部、科技部会同有关部门

summary: After initial review of a listed activity, the unit applies for expert review; in multi-unit projects the lead unit applies; central enterprises and central institutions report directly to the competent ministry, others to the local authority.
quote: 由本单位申请开展专家复核
conditional_on: Activity is on the list under Art. 21

summary: The undertaking unit shall submit expert review materials under Art. 27 of the Ethics Measures.
quote: 应依照《伦理办法》第二十七条规定提交专家复核材料
conditional_on: Activity is on the list under Art. 21

summary: Local or competent authorities organise a review expert panel under Arts. 28 to 30 of the Ethics Measures, and feed back review opinions to the applicant unit within 30 days of receiving the request; they may entrust a service centre with the review.
quote: 在收到复核申请后 30 日内向申请单位反馈复核意见

summary: The committee or service centre makes the ethics review decision based on the expert review opinions.
quote: 委员会或服务中心应根据专家复核意见
