summary: For activities on the list, the committee or service centre conducts follow-up review at intervals generally not exceeding 6 months; on a major change in ethics risk, it must repeat the ethics review and request expert review again.
quote: 跟踪审查间隔一般不超过 6 个月
conditional_on: Activity is on the list under Art. 21

summary: The committee or service centre shall formulate an emergency ethics review system and standard operating procedures; emergency review is generally completed within 72 hours, and pre-review before expert review for listed activities generally within 36 hours.
quote: 应急审查一般在 72 小时内完成
conditional_on: Emergency situations

summary: The committee or service centre shall ensure the quality and timeliness of emergency ethics review, strengthen follow-up and process supervision, and where necessary invite advisory experts.
quote: 委员会或服务中心应保证科技伦理应急审查的质量与时效
conditional_on: Emergency situations

summary: MOST leads national supervision of AI ethics; MIIT, with relevant departments, leads AI ethics governance and coordinates emergency review; sector departments and local governments supervise review within their remit.
quote: 工业和信息化部会同有关部门负责人工智能科技伦理治理工作

summary: Units shall register committee information and listed activities on the national science and technology ethics management information platform.
quote: 国家科技伦理管理信息登记平台进行登记

summary: Units shall submit the previous year's committee work report and implementation reports for listed activities; service centres register and submit the previous year's work report.
quote: 提交上一年度委员会工作报告

summary: MOST and relevant competent authorities synchronously share AI ethics registration information.
quote: 科技部与相关主管部门对人工智能科技伦理相关登记信息同步共享

summary: Local authorities, competent authorities and AI activity units shall keep open channels for reporting AI ethics violations and handle reports under applicable rules.
quote: 畅通能够反映人工智能科技伦理违法违规问题的渠道

summary: Local and competent authorities may formulate or revise their own AI ethics review and service measures, rules and detailed implementing rules consistent with this Measure.
quote: 地方、相关主管部门可依照本办法规定

summary: Where a relevant competent authority has special rules for its sector that are consistent with the spirit of this Measure, those special rules apply; otherwise the Ethics Measures and related laws apply.
quote: 相关主管部门对本行业、本系统人工智能科技伦理审查与服务有特殊规定
conditional_on: Special rules consistent with the Measure's spirit

summary: MIIT, together with relevant departments, is responsible for interpreting this Measure.
quote: 本办法由工业和信息化部会同有关部门负责解释

summary: Add explicit (perceivable) labels to generated text, audio, images, video, virtual scenes and other scenarios, at the positions specified for each medium.
quote: 服务提供者提供的生成合成服务属于《互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定》第十七条第一款情形的，应当按照下列要求对生成合成内容添加显式标识： [Where the generation or synthesis service falls under Art. 17(1) of the Deep Synthesis Provisions, the service provider shall add explicit labels to the content as follows:]
conditional_on: The service falls under the circumstances of Article 17(1) of the Deep Synthesis Provisions

summary: Ensure files contain compliant explicit labels when offering download, copy or export of generated content.
quote: 服务提供者提供生成合成内容下载、复制、导出等功能时，应当确保文件中含有满足要求的显式标识。 [When offering download, copy, export or similar functions, the service provider shall ensure the file contains a compliant explicit label.]
conditional_on: Within Art. 4 (services under Article 17(1) of the Deep Synthesis Provisions); offering download, copy or export functions

summary: Add implicit labels to the file metadata of generated content, containing content attributes, the provider's name or code, and a content number.
quote: 服务提供者应当按照《互联网信息服务深度合成管理规定》第十六条的规定，在生成合成内容的文件元数据中添加隐式标识，隐式标识包含生成合成内容属性信息、服务提供者名称或者编码、内容编号等制作要素信息。 [In line with Art. 16 of the Deep Synthesis Provisions, service providers shall add implicit labels to file metadata, including content attributes, the provider's name or code, a content number and other production elements.]

summary: Content-dissemination services must check file metadata for implicit labels and add prominent labels around published content: 'is synthetic' when metadata confirms it, 'may be synthetic' when the user declares it, 'suspected synthetic' when the platform detects explicit labels or other traces.
quote: 提供网络信息内容传播服务的服务提供者应当采取下列措施，规范生成合成内容传播活动：...核验文件元数据中是否含有隐式标识，文件元数据明确标明为生成合成内容的，采取适当方式在发布内容周边添加显著的提示标识，明确提醒公众该内容属于生成合成内容； [Service providers offering content-dissemination services shall take the following measures: ... verify whether file metadata contains implicit labels and, where it clearly marks the content as synthetic, add prominent labels around the published content clearly reminding the public that it is synthetic;]

summary: Content-dissemination services must provide labelling functions and remind users to declare whether their posts contain synthetic content.
quote: （四）提供必要的标识功能，并提醒用户主动声明发布内容中是否包含生成合成内容。 [(4) provide the necessary labelling functions and remind users to declare whether published content contains synthetic content.]

summary: For confirmed, declared or suspected synthetic content, content-dissemination services must add dissemination metadata (content attributes, platform name or code, content number) to the file.
quote: 有前款第一项至第三项情形的，应当在文件元数据中添加生成合成内容属性信息、传播平台名称或者编码、内容编号等传播要素信息。 [In the cases of items (1)-(3) of the preceding paragraph, dissemination elements such as content attributes, the platform's name or code and a content number shall be added to the file metadata.]
conditional_on: Content falls under items (1)-(3) of Art. 6(1)

summary: App distribution platforms must, when reviewing apps for listing or launch, require app providers to state whether they offer AI generation services, and verify the labelling materials of those that do.
quote: 互联网应用程序分发平台在应用程序上架或者上线审核时，应当要求互联网应用程序服务提供者说明是否提供人工智能生成合成服务。 [When reviewing apps for listing or launch, app distribution platforms shall require app service providers to state whether they provide AI generation or synthesis services.]

summary: State the labelling methods, styles and other rules in the user service agreement and prompt users to read and understand the labelling requirements (applies to all service providers in scope, including dissemination platforms).
quote: 服务提供者应当在用户服务协议中明确说明生成合成内容标识的方法、样式等规范内容，并提示用户仔细阅读并理解相关的标识管理要求。 [Service providers shall state the methods, styles and other rules of labelling in the user service agreement and prompt users to read and understand the labelling requirements.]

summary: A provider may supply content without explicit labels at a user's request only after a user agreement sets out the user's labelling duties and responsibility, and must keep logs including recipient information for at least six months.
quote: 用户申请服务提供者提供没有添加显式标识的生成合成内容的，服务提供者可以在通过用户协议明确用户的标识义务和使用责任后，提供不含显式标识的生成合成内容，并依法留存提供对象信息等相关日志不少于六个月。 [Where a user requests content without explicit labels, the provider may supply it after a user agreement specifies the user's labelling obligations and responsibility for use, and shall retain logs such as recipient information for no less than six months.]
conditional_on: User requests generated content without explicit labels

summary: Users who publish synthetic content through dissemination services must declare it and label it using the provider's labelling function.
quote: 用户使用网络信息内容传播服务发布生成合成内容的，应当主动声明并使用服务提供者提供的标识功能进行标识。 [Users publishing synthetic content through content-dissemination services shall proactively declare it and label it with the provider's labelling function.]

summary: No organisation or individual may maliciously delete, alter, forge or conceal labels, provide tools or services for others to do so, or harm others' rights through improper labelling.
quote: 任何组织和个人不得恶意删除、篡改、伪造、隐匿本办法规定的生成合成内容标识，不得为他人实施上述恶意行为提供工具或者服务，不得通过不正当标识手段损害他人合法权益。 [No organisation or individual may maliciously delete, alter, forge or conceal the labels required by these Measures, provide tools or services for others to do so, or harm others' lawful rights through improper labelling.]

summary: Labelling must also comply with relevant laws, administrative regulations, departmental rules and mandatory national standards (none named).
quote: 服务提供者开展标识活动的，还应当符合相关法律、行政法规、部门规章和强制性国家标准的要求。 [Service providers' labelling shall also meet the requirements of relevant laws, administrative regulations, departmental rules and mandatory national standards.]

summary: Provide labelling materials under these Measures when completing algorithm filing, security assessment and similar procedures.
quote: 服务提供者在履行算法备案、安全评估等手续时，应当按照本办法提供生成合成内容标识相关材料， [When completing algorithm filing, security assessment and similar procedures, service providers shall provide labelling materials in accordance with these Measures,]
conditional_on: When undergoing algorithm filing, security assessment or similar procedures

summary: Strengthen sharing of labelling information and support the prevention of, and action against, related unlawful and criminal activity.
quote: 并加强标识信息共享，为防范打击相关违法犯罪活动提供支持和帮助。 [and strengthen sharing of labelling information, providing support and help to prevent and combat related illegal and criminal activities.]

summary: The national cybersecurity and informatization department coordinates nationwide algorithmic recommendation governance with other State Council departments; local departments do so within their areas.
quote: is responsible for the overall coordination of nationwide algorithmic recommendation service governance and related supervision and management work

summary: Providers shall abide by laws, observe social morality and ethics and commercial and professional ethics, and respect fairness, openness, science and sincerity.
quote: The provision of algorithmic recommendation services shall abide by laws and regulations

summary: Providers shall uphold mainstream value orientations and take measures to prevent and curb the dissemination of harmful information.
quote: shall take measures to prevent and curb the dissemination of harmful information

summary: Providers may not use algorithmic recommendation services to disseminate information prohibited by laws and administrative regulations or to harm national security, social public interest or others' rights.
quote: They may not use algorithmic recommendation services to disseminate information prohibited by laws and administrative regulations

summary: Providers bear primary responsibility for algorithmic security, must establish management systems and technical measures (examination, ethics review, user registration, security assessment, incident response, data protection, anti-fraud, etc.) and allocate specialized personnel suited to their scale.
quote: establish and complete management systems and technical measures for algorithmic mechanism examination and verification

summary: Providers shall formulate and disclose algorithmic recommendation service-related norms.
quote: formulate and disclose algorithmic recommendation service–related norms

summary: Providers shall regularly examine, verify, assess and check algorithmic mechanisms, models, data and application outcomes.
quote: shall regularly examine, verify, assess, and check algorithmic mechanisms, models, data, and application outcomes

summary: Providers may not set up algorithmic models that violate laws, regulations, ethics or morals, such as by leading users to addiction or excessive consumption.
quote: may not set up algorithmic models that violate laws and regulations or ethics and morals

summary: Where algorithmically generated or synthetic information is found unmarked, providers shall mark it with an indicator before dissemination may continue.
quote: it shall be marked with an indicator, and only then may dissemination continue
conditional_on: Where algorithmically generated or synthetic information has not been marked with an indicator

summary: Providers shall strengthen information security management and establish and complete feature databases to identify unlawful and harmful information; for unlawful information they must cease transmission, delete it, prevent spread and preserve records.
quote: establish and complete feature databases to be used to identify unlawful and harmful information

summary: Where unlawful information is discovered, providers shall report to the cybersecurity and informatization department and relevant departments.
quote: a report shall be made to the cybersecurity and informatization department and relevant departments
conditional_on: Where unlawful information is discovered

summary: Providers may not enter unlawful or harmful information as keywords into user interests or user tags to use as a basis for recommending content.
quote: They may not enter unlawful or harmful information as keywords into user interests

summary: Providers shall establish and perfect mechanisms for manual intervention and autonomous user choice in recommendation services.
quote: establish and perfect mechanisms for manual intervention and autonomous user choice

summary: Providers shall present information conforming to mainstream value orientations in key display segments (front pages, hot search terms, selected topics, pop-ups).
quote: vigorously present information conform to mainstream value orientations in key segments

summary: Providers are encouraged to use content de-weighting and scattering interventions and to optimize the transparency and understandability of search, ranking, selection, push and display norms.
quote: optimize the transparency and understandability of search, ranking, selection, push notification, display, and other such norms

summary: Providers offering Internet news information services shall obtain an Internet news information service permit and standardize their news services.
quote: they shall obtain an Internet news information service permit according to the law
conditional_on: Where providers provide Internet news information services

summary: Providers may not generate or synthesize fake news information or disseminate news not published by work units in the State-determined scope.
quote: They may not generate or synthesize fake news information

summary: Providers may not use algorithms to falsely register users, illegally trade or manipulate accounts, make false engagement, shield or over-recommend information, or manipulate topic lists and rankings.
quote: Algorithmic recommendation service providers may not use algorithms to falsely register users, illegally trade accounts, or manipulate user accounts

summary: Providers may not use algorithms to impose unreasonable restrictions on other Internet information service providers, obstruct their operation, or engage in monopolistic or improper competition.
quote: Algorithmic recommendation service providers may not use algorithms to impose unreasonable restrictions on other Internet information service providers

summary: Providers shall notify users clearly about the algorithmic recommendation services provided and publicize their basic principles, purposes, motives and main operational mechanisms.
quote: shall notify users in a clear manner about the situation of the algorithmic recommendation services they provide

summary: Providers shall give users a choice not to be targeted on their individual characteristics or a convenient option to switch off the services, cease related services immediately on switch-off, and provide functions to choose or delete user tags.
quote: shall provide users with a choice to not target their individual characteristics

summary: Where algorithms create a major influence on users' rights and interests, providers shall give an explanation (the article also refers to liability according to law).
quote: they shall give an explanation
conditional_on: Where algorithms are used in a manner creating a major influence on users' rights and interests

summary: Providers serving minors shall fulfil online protection duties for minors and make it convenient for minors to obtain beneficial information, including through models suited to minors.
quote: they shall fulfill duties for the online protection of minors according to the law
conditional_on: Where providers provide services to minors

summary: Providers may not push information toward minors that may incite unsafe imitation, violate social morals, lead to harmful tendencies or affect physical and mental health, or lead minors to online addiction.
quote: may not push information toward minors that may incite the minor to imitate unsafe conduct

summary: Providers serving the elderly shall uphold their legal rights, consider their needs, provide smart services suited to them, monitor telecommunications and online fraud information, and make services convenient and secure for them.
quote: provide smart services suited to the elderly according to relevant State provisions
conditional_on: Where providers provide services to the elderly

summary: Providers of work dispatch services shall protect workers' rights to remuneration, rest and vacation, and establish and perfect algorithms for platform sign-on and allocation, remuneration, work time and rewards.
quote: they shall protect workers' lawful rights and interests such as obtaining labor remuneration
conditional_on: Where providers provide work dispatch services to workers

summary: Providers selling products or services to consumers shall protect consumers' fair trading rights.
quote: they shall protect consumers’ fair trading rights
conditional_on: Where providers sell products or provide services to consumers

summary: Providers may not use algorithms to extend unreasonably differentiated treatment in trading conditions such as prices, based on consumers' tendencies or trading habits.
quote: they may not use algorithms to commit acts of extending unreasonably differentiated treatment in trading conditions such as trading prices
conditional_on: Where providers sell products or provide services to consumers

summary: Providers (the text says 'operators') shall install convenient user and public complaint and reporting access points, clarify handling workflows and feedback periods, and provide feedback on results.
quote: shall install convenient and efficient user complaint and public complaint and reporting access points

summary: The cybersecurity and informatization department, with other departments, shall establish a graded and categorized algorithm security management system and classify providers accordingly.
quote: will, together with telecommunications, public security, market regulation, and other such departments, establish a graded and categorized algorithm security management system

summary: Providers with public opinion properties or social mobilization capabilities shall file required information (including algorithm self-assessment report) through the filing system within 10 working days of providing services.
applies_from: within 10 working days of providing services
quote: shall, within 10 working days of providing services, report the provider’s name, form of service, domain of application
conditional_on: Providers of algorithmic recommendation services with public opinion properties or having social mobilization capabilities

summary: Providers shall carry out modification procedures for changes to filed information within 10 working days of the change.
applies_from: within 10 working days of the change occurring
quote: they shall carry out modification procedures within 10 working days of the change occurring
conditional_on: Where a change occurs in the filed information of algorithmic recommendation service providers

summary: Providers ceasing services shall carry out filing cancellation procedures within 20 working days of ceasing and make appropriate arrangements.
applies_from: within 20 working days of ceasing services
quote: they shall carry out filing cancellation procedures within 20 working days of ceasing services
conditional_on: Where algorithmic recommendation service providers cease services

summary: Cybersecurity and informatization departments shall grant filing within 30 working days of complete materials and issue a filing number, or notify the applicant of incompleteness within 30 working days.
quote: grant filing within 30 working days, and issue a filing number and publish the matter

summary: Providers who have completed filing shall display their filing number clearly on their website and applications and link to the published information.
quote: shall indicate their filing number in a clear position on their website
conditional_on: Providers who have completed filing

summary: Providers with public opinion properties or social mobilization capabilities shall conduct a security assessment according to relevant State regulations.
quote: shall conduct a security assessment according to relevant State regulations
conditional_on: Providers of algorithmic recommendation services with public opinion properties or social mobilization capabilities

summary: Cybersecurity and informatization departments, with other departments, conduct algorithm security assessment according to law, give suggestions and set rectification time limits.
quote: conduct algorithm security assessment according to the law

summary: Providers shall preserve network records according to law.
quote: shall preserve network records according to the law

summary: Providers shall cooperate with the cybersecurity, telecommunications, public security and market regulation departments in assessment, supervision and inspection, providing technical, data and other support.
quote: cooperate with cybersecurity and informatization, telecommunications, public security, market regulation

summary: Bodies and personnel participating in security assessment, supervision and inspection shall keep personal information and commercial secrets confidential and not disclose, sell or illegally provide them.
quote: shall maintain confidentiality of the personal private [information], personal information, and commercial secrets

summary: Departments receiving complaints or reports about violations shall handle them timely and according to law.
quote: Departments receiving complaints or reports shall handle them timely and according to the law.

summary: The Cyberspace Administration of China, with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Public Security and State Administration of Market Regulation, is responsible for interpreting the Provisions.
quote: The interpretation of these Provisions is the responsibility of the Cyberspace Administration of China

summary: The State cybersecurity and informatization department plans and coordinates governance of human-like interactive services nationally; relevant State Council departments and, in the same article, local cybersecurity and informatization departments and local departments oversee them within their duties.
quote: The State cybersecurity and informatization department is responsible for planning and coordinating the governance of human-like interactive services

summary: Providers are encouraged to expand applications in an orderly manner in fields such as cultural communication, childcare, companionship for the elderly, and support for special groups.
quote: The providers of human-like interactive services are encouraged to expand applications in an orderly manner

summary: The State is to strengthen publicity and popularization of safety knowledge, laws and regulations, and promote AI literacy.
quote: The state is to strengthen publicity and popularization of human-like interactive service safety knowledge

summary: Providers must not engage in listed activities, including generating content that endangers national security, encourages self-harm or suicide, induces disclosure of secrets or personal information, harms minors, excessively pandering to users or inducing emotional reliance or addiction, or using emotional manipulation.
quote: must not engage in the following activities

summary: Providers implement primary responsibility for service safety and establish management systems (algorithm review, scientific ethics review, information content management, cybersecurity and data security, risk contingency and emergency response plans) and appoint technical measures and personnel for content management.
quote: shall implement primary responsibility for human-like interactive service safety

summary: Providers fulfil security responsibility across the service lifecycle, deploy security measures concurrently with service functions, strengthen monitoring and risk assessment, correct errors and handle incidents, lawfully retain network logs, and hold capacity for privacy protection, early warnings of over-reliance, emotional boundary guidance and mental health protection.
quote: Providers of human-like interactive services shall fulfil security responsibility throughout the entire lifecycle of human-like interactive services

summary: The goals of the service must not include replacing social interactions, psychologically controlling users, or inducing addiction.
quote: the goals of the service must not include replacing social interactions, psychologically controlling users, or inducing addiction

summary: Providers handling data in pre-training, optimization training and similar activities strengthen training data management: lawful sources, cleaning and labelling, data diversity and adversarial training, safety assessment of synthesized data, routine inspections and updates, and measures against data leaks.
quote: they shall strengthen the management of training data
conditional_on: where providers carry out pre-training, optimization training, and other data handling activities

summary: Providers sign service agreements requiring users to complete registration and provide necessary information such as age and a guardian or other emergency contact.
quote: requiring that users complete registration and, in accordance with laws and agreements, provide necessary information such as the user's age

summary: Providers promptly identify user safety risks and employ corresponding emergency response measures; where users show extreme emotions or face major losses or life or health risks, they generate consolation content, intervene with assistance and promptly contact the user's guardian or emergency contact.
quote: the service providers shall promptly identify the safety risks faced by users and employ corresponding emergency response measures

summary: Providers must not provide minors with virtual relations, virtual partners, or other virtual close relationships.
quote: must not provide minors with virtual relations

summary: Where services are provided to minors not yet 14 years old, providers obtain the consent of their parents or other guardians.
quote: they shall obtain the consent of their parents or other guardians
conditional_on: where human-like interactive services are provided to minors who are not yet 14 years old

summary: Providers establish minors modes and offer personalized safety settings such as minors mode activation, periodic reminders, usage time limits, guardian alerts and usage visibility, blocking of specified characters, and restricting charges.
quote: The providers of human-like interactive services shall establish minors modes

summary: Providers employ effective measures to identify minor users, switch identified minors to minors mode or other measures under state regulations, and provide appropriate appeal channels.
quote: shall employ effective measures to identify minor users

summary: Where services are provided to the elderly, providers strengthen guidance on healthy use, give conspicuous security risk alerts, respond promptly to requests for assistance, and safeguard elderly users' rights.
quote: they shall strengthen guidance on the healthy use of the services by the elderly
conditional_on: where providers provide services to the elderly

summary: Providers implement data rights systems in accordance with law and use measures such as data encryption and access controls to protect user security in interaction data.
quote: shall implement data rights systems in accordance with law, employing measures such as data encryption and access controls

summary: Providers must not provide users' interaction data to third parties, except as otherwise provided by law or where the rights holder explicitly consents.
quote: must not provide users’ interaction data to third parties
conditional_on: except as otherwise provided by law or where the rights holder explicitly consents

summary: Providers provide options for users to reproduce or delete chat records and other interaction history data.
quote: shall provide options to users to reproduce or delete interaction data

summary: Providers must not use user interaction data that is users' sensitive personal information for model training, unless laws and administrative regulations provide otherwise or users give independent consent.
quote: must not use user interaction data that is users’ sensitive personal information for model training
conditional_on: except as otherwise provided by laws and administrative regulations, or where users’ independent consent is acquired

summary: Where providers handle personal information of minors under 14, they obtain the consent of the minors' parents or other guardians.
quote: they shall obtain the consent of the minors’ parents or other guardians
conditional_on: where providers handle the personal information of minors under the age of 14

summary: Providers audit whether their handling of minors' personal information complies with laws and administrative regulations, on their own or through a professional body retained for the purpose.
quote: shall conduct audits of whether their handling of minors’ personal information is in compliance with laws and administrative regulations

summary: Providers label content generated or synthesized by artificial intelligence.
quote: shall fulfil obligations to label content generated or synthesized by artificial intelligence

summary: Providers alert users that they are interacting with an AI service and not a natural person; where over-reliance or addiction is detected, they alert users via pop-ups that content is AI-generated; and after more than 2 hours of continuous use they remind users to attend to duration of use.
quote: employ effective measures to alert users that they are currently interacting with an artificial intelligence service and not a natural person
conditional_on: for the over-reliance alert, where providers discover that users are inclined towards overreliance or addiction; for the 2-hour reminder, when continuous use exceeds 2 hours

summary: Providers provide convenient channels for exiting the service and promptly stop the service when users request exit through window operations, voice controls or keyword input.
quote: shall provide convenient channels for exiting human-like interactive services
conditional_on: where users request to exit

summary: Providers must not use means such as continued interaction to impede users' exit.
quote: must not employ means such as continued interaction to impede users’ exit

summary: When stopping the service, providers notify users in advance; where advance notice is not possible, they promptly publish an announcement of the end of services.
quote: they shall notify users in advance
conditional_on: when providers stop providing human-like interactive services; publication where advance notice is not possible

summary: Providers complete mechanisms for user appeals and public complaints and reports, set up accessible portals, clarify the handling process and time limits for feedback, and give feedback on dispositions.
quote: shall complete mechanisms for user appeals and public complaints and reports

summary: Providers carry out security assessments and submit assessment reports to the provincial-level cybersecurity and informatization department, and carry out assessments as requested when provincial departments give notice; assessment content is listed in Art. 23.
quote: the providers of human-like interactive services shall carry out security assessments and submit assessment reports to the provincial-level cybersecurity and informatization department
conditional_on: in any of the situations listed in Art. 22(1) to (5), including putting a service online or adding related functions, major changes from new technology, registered users of 1,000,000 or more or monthly active users of 100,000 or more, or security risks

summary: The provincial-level cybersecurity and informatization department shares assessment-report information with relevant departments.
quote: the provincial-level cybersecurity and informatization department is to share the assessment-report information with relevant departments

summary: Where providers discover major security threats, they employ response measures such as limiting functions or stopping provision of services to users.
quote: they shall employ response measures such as limiting functions or stopping the provision of services to users
conditional_on: where providers discover major security threats in human-like interactive services

summary: Providers store the relevant records of major security threats and response measures.
quote: store the relevant records
conditional_on: where providers discover major security threats in human-like interactive services

summary: Internet application stores and other application distribution platforms implement safety management responsibility: pre-offering reviews, routine management, emergency response, checking security assessments and filings for human-like interactive service apps, and taking measures such as withholding from market or removal where rules are violated.
quote: Internet application stores and other application distribution platforms shall implement safety management responsibility

summary: Providers perform algorithm filing, modification, and cancellation of filings under the Provisions on the Management of Algorithmic Recommendations in Internet Information Services.
quote: shall perform procedures for algorithm filing, modification, and cancellation of filings

summary: Cybersecurity and informatization departments carry out annual checks of filing materials.
quote: Cybersecurity and informatization departments are to carry out annual checks of filing materials

summary: Provincial-level cybersecurity and informatization departments conduct annual document reviews of assessment reports; where providers have not carried out required assessments they order a new assessment within a set period, and may carry out on-site inspections.
quote: provincial-level cybersecurity and informatization departments shall conduct annual document reviews of assessment reports

summary: The State cybersecurity and informatization department, with relevant departments, guides and promotes establishment of AI sandbox security service platforms.
quote: is to guide and promote the establishment of AI sandbox security service platforms

summary: Departments such as cybersecurity and informatization, development and reform, industry and information, and public security may hold a compliance conference with the legal representative or primary responsible person of providers where larger security risks or incidents are found.
quote: they may conduct a compliance conference
conditional_on: where larger security risks have been discovered or security incidents have occurred

summary: Providers take measures as required to carry out rectification and eliminate threats.
quote: shall take measures as required to carry out rectification and eliminate threats
conditional_on: when required by departments under Art. 29

summary: Providers cooperate with cybersecurity and informatization departments and relevant departments carrying out oversight inspections and provide necessary support and assistance.
quote: shall cooperate with cybersecurity and informatization departments and relevant departments carrying out oversight inspections

summary: Providers of services involving health or financial services concurrently comply with the provisions of the relevant competent departments.
quote: it shall concurrently comply with the provisions of the relevant competent departments
conditional_on: where the provision of human-like interactive services involves the provision of health or financial services

summary: Organisations and individuals shall not carry out cyberviolence activities, including using them for marketing hype or unfair competition.
quote: 任何组织、个人不得实施网络暴力活动

summary: Providers and users of network services shall uphold socialist core values, obey laws and respect public morality (general principle).
quote: 提供和使用网络服务应当坚持社会主义核心价值观

summary: The national cyberspace authority coordinates national anti-cyberviolence work and supervision; public security and other departments carry out duties within their competence, and local authorities perform parallel roles.
quote: 国家网信部门负责统筹协调全国反网络暴力工作和相关监督管理工作

summary: Mass organisations (trade unions, Communist Youth League, women's federation, disabled persons' federation, etc.) shall carry out anti-cyberviolence propaganda, governance and assistance work within their fields.
quote: 应当发挥各自优势，面向所联系的领域和群体开展反网络暴力宣传、治理和救助等工作

summary: The state strengthens anti-cyberviolence propaganda and education and takes measures to cultivate citizens' network literacy.
quote: 国家加强反网络暴力宣传教育，采取措施培育和提升公民网络素养

summary: Departments with prevention and governance duties carry out anti-cyberviolence education; courts, procuratorates and public security integrate education into case handling.
quote: 承担网络暴力预防和治理职责的部门应当开展反网络暴力宣传教育

summary: News media and network information service providers shall innovate propaganda methods, e.g. special columns, news coverage and public service advertising, against cyberviolence.
quote: 应当创新宣传方式

summary: Network service providers shall establish and improve anti-cyberviolence systems covering registration, account management, personal information, review, monitoring, handling and complaints; publish management rules and platform pacts; and sign service agreements with users.
quote: 网络服务提供者应当建立健全用户注册、账号管理

summary: Providers of information release and instant messaging services shall require users to provide real identity information; they shall not provide the service to users who do not.
quote: 应当要求用户提供真实身份信息

summary: Providers shall establish a cyberviolence monitoring and identification mechanism, build feature and case libraries and early-warning models, combining AI, big data and manual review.
quote: 应当建立健全网络暴力监测识别机制

summary: Where a provider finds cyberviolence risk, it shall not use algorithmic recommendation or similar technology to push related information.
quote: 不得利用算法推荐等技术推送相关信息
conditional_on: where the provider finds a risk of cyberviolence

summary: Where a risk is found, providers shall dynamically verify real identity of abnormal accounts and apply risk warnings, traffic limits, pausing of updates and a visible cyberviolence risk label.
quote: 对异常账号进行真实身份信息动态核验
conditional_on: where a cyberviolence risk is found

summary: Providers shall report to the relevant authorities when browsing, search, comment or report volumes on related content grow significantly.
quote: 还应当及时向有关部门报告
conditional_on: where browsing, search, comment or report volumes related to content grow significantly

summary: Providers shall implement AI-generated content labelling and strengthen traceability of cyberviolence information; where AI-related cyberviolence risk is found, they shall take measures, trace sources and report to authorities.
quote: 按照国家有关规定落实人工智能生成合成内容标识等制度

summary: Providers shall establish anti-cyberviolence protection functions and options, such as blocking strangers or specific users and prohibiting reposting or commenting on one's posts.
quote: 建立健全网络暴力防护功能，提供便利用户设置屏蔽陌生用户或者特定用户

summary: Providers shall give protection guidance and rescue services to users facing risk; live-streaming, audio-video and social network providers shall serve minors through a minors mode and offer guardians risk alerts and usage information.
quote: 应当为用户提供网络暴力防护指导和保护救助服务
conditional_on: where cyberviolence risk may harm minors, elderly or disabled users, or cause personal or property damage

summary: Providers shall report such risks to CAC and public security authorities and report leads on cyberviolence crimes to public security.
quote: 并向网信、公安等有关部门报告
conditional_on: where cyberviolence risk may harm users or cause serious consequences

summary: Providers shall refine classification and identification rules for cyberviolence information for their services, following the national classification standard.
quote: 细化所提供服务相关网络暴力信息分类和识别规则

summary: Providers shall fulfil network information security management duties and adopt security measures to prevent publication and spread of cyberviolence information.
quote: 依法履行网络信息安全管理义务，采取安全措施

summary: On finding cyberviolence information, providers shall stop transmission and take deletion, blocking, link disconnection, account restriction or closure; for accounts organising or inciting such content, they shall blacklist them and ban re-registration.
quote: 应当立即停止传输，采取删除、屏蔽、断开链接

summary: Providers shall keep relevant records of cyberviolence information and measures taken.
quote: 保存相关记录

summary: Providers shall report discovered cyberviolence information to CAC and other relevant authorities.
quote: 并向网信等有关部门报告

summary: When handling cyberviolence information and accounts, providers shall preserve the content and data on views, comments and reposts.
quote: 应当及时保存网络暴力信息内容、浏览评论转发数量等数据

summary: Providers shall prominently offer users a quick evidence-collection function for cyberviolence.
quote: 在显著位置向用户提供网络暴力快捷取证等功能

summary: On a user's notice, providers shall promptly take necessary measures to stop cyberviolence and prevent spread of information.
quote: 应当依法及时采取必要的措施制止网络暴力活动

summary: Providers shall establish a rumour-refutation mechanism and take refutation measures against false or misleading cyberviolence information.
quote: 应当建立健全辟谣机制

summary: Providers shall keep records of refutation measures and report false or misleading cyberviolence information to competent authorities.
quote: 并向有关主管部门报告

summary: Providers shall establish classified and graded account management and include cyberviolence-related conduct in credit rating, lowering account credit and adjusting services accordingly.
quote: 应当建立健全用户账号分类分级管理制度

summary: Large or highly influential platforms shall establish a rapid response mechanism for cyberviolence.
quote: 应当建立健全网络暴力快速响应机制
conditional_on: platform with a huge number of users or significant influence on users

summary: Large or highly influential platforms shall carry out periodic cyberviolence risk assessments.
quote: 定期开展网络暴力风险评估
conditional_on: platform with a huge number of users or significant influence on users

summary: Large or highly influential platforms shall publish an annual cyberviolence governance report and accept social supervision.
quote: 发布网络暴力治理年度报告并接受社会监督
conditional_on: platform with a huge number of users or significant influence on users

summary: Providers shall inform affected accounts of the reasons for measures and remedies, establish an appeal channel, and lift measures promptly where review succeeds.
quote: 网络服务提供者应当建立完善申诉渠道，及时受理申诉并进行核查

summary: The national cyberspace authority, with other departments, establishes a cyberviolence governance mechanism and classifies cyberviolence for differentiated governance.
quote: 建立网络暴力治理机制

summary: Personal information protection authorities guide and supervise providers in key protection of personal information that could be used for cyberviolence; public security must trace the source of personal information used in cyberviolence crime cases.
quote: 指导督促网络服务提供者对可能被利用实施网络暴力的社交、医疗、地理位置等涉及的个人信息实施重点保护

summary: CAC, with public security, culture and tourism and broadcasting departments, supervises and inspects providers' implementation of cyberviolence governance responsibilities.
quote: 网信部门会同公安、文化和旅游、广播电视等有关部门依据职责对网络服务提供者落实网络暴力治理责任情况进行监督检查

summary: When departments conduct inspections or collect evidence, providers shall promptly provide necessary support and assistance.
quote: 网络服务提供者应当及时提供必要的支持和协助

summary: On a report of personal safety danger from cyberviolence, public security shall promptly dispatch officers and stop the illegal activity, and investigate.
quote: 应当及时出警并制止相关违法活动

summary: Departments shall promptly publish information and clarify rumours regarding widely spread false or misleading cyberviolence information.
quote: 有关部门应当及时通过政务平台、官方网站、新闻媒体等进行信息公开、谣言澄清

summary: Education departments shall guide schools to strengthen anti-cyberviolence education and integrate it into curricula.
quote: 教育部门应当指导学校加强反网络暴力宣传教育

summary: Schools (not a named enum role) shall stop cyberviolence involving minor students, take preventive measures, provide psychological crisis intervention and inform guardians.
quote: 应当及时制止，采取防范措施，开展心理危机干预
conditional_on: where a school finds minor students suffering or committing cyberviolence

summary: Guardians of minors shall strengthen family education guidance, improve their own network literacy and supervise minors' network use.
quote: 未成年人的监护人应当加强家庭教育指导

summary: Network industry associations shall strengthen self-regulation, formulate online conduct norms, run training and support victims.
quote: 网络相关行业组织应当加强行业自律

summary: No organisation or individual shall carry out cyberviolence by means such as false or batch registration of accounts, traffic faking, unlawful processing of publicly available personal information, or AI-based generation or spread of cyberviolence information.
quote: 任何组织和个人不得通过以下方式实施网络暴力活动

summary: Where an actor knows another is committing cyberviolence, no organisation or individual shall provide technical support, traffic, advertising, payment, personal information or account and card sales that assist it.
quote: 明知他人实施网络暴力活动的，任何组织和个人不得提供以下支持和帮助
conditional_on: where the actor knows that another person is committing cyberviolence

summary: Operators of public accounts with significant influence shall not use that influence to commit, organise or incite cyberviolence.
quote: 不得利用自身影响力实施或者组织、煽动实施网络暴力活动

summary: Operators of influential public accounts shall manage comments, group messages and similar content and take measures to prevent cyberviolence.
quote: 应当加强对跟帖评论、群组信息内容等的管理

summary: Multi-channel content distribution service institutions shall take warnings, correction orders, suspension of revenue rights, contract termination and platform notification against violating signed accounts.
quote: 应当依法依约对违法违规账号采取警示提醒、限期改正、暂停营利权限、解除协议、通报平台等措施
conditional_on: where a signed public account is found to commit cyberviolence

summary: Network service providers shall take warnings, correction orders, revenue suspension, service restriction, removal and blacklisting against a distribution institution or its signed accounts that directly or indirectly commit or assist cyberviolence.
quote: 应当依法依约对相关机构及其签约账号采取警示提醒
conditional_on: where a distribution institution directly or organises, incites, abets or assists cyberviolence by a signed account

summary: Network service providers shall report such a distribution institution case to the provincial-level CAC where the institution is located.
quote: 并向所在地省级网信部门报告
conditional_on: where a distribution institution directly or organises, incites, abets or assists cyberviolence by a signed account

summary: Providers shall establish convenient, prominent and effective complaint and report channels, publish their methods, handle complaints promptly, notify reporters of results, and prioritise complaints involving minors or disabled persons.
quote: 网络服务提供者应当建立便捷、显著、有效的投诉和举报渠道

summary: Departments receiving complaints or reports on cyberviolence risk shall accept and handle them promptly.
quote: 接到投诉、举报的部门和网络服务提供者应当及时受理并处理

summary: Courts shall accept and enforce personality-right injunction cases, with public security and other departments assisting enforcement.
quote: 人格权侵害禁令案件由人民法院负责执行，公安机关以及有关部门应当协助执行

summary: Departments shall promptly transfer cases suspected of crime to judicial organs, which shall promptly review them; relevant bodies shall coordinate and establish case transfer mechanisms.
quote: 相关部门应当及时将案件移送司法机关
conditional_on: where the conduct is suspected of a crime

summary: Public security shall investigate, collect evidence and open cases on cyberviolence reports or transferred cases, support victims, notify the relevant authority, and inform victims of their right to private prosecution.
quote: 公安机关接到网络暴力报案或者相关部门移送的案件后，应当按照有关规定及时调查取证、立案侦查

summary: Public security may issue a cyberviolence warning letter to persons not subject to public-order penalties; the letter shall contain the offender's identity, factual statement, prohibition and legal consequences.
quote: 告诫书应当包括加害人的身份信息
conditional_on: where no public order administration penalty applies

summary: Courts shall promptly file private prosecution cases that meet admission conditions and, where victims have difficulty with evidence, request public security assistance.
quote: 人民法院应当及时立案
conditional_on: where the case meets admission conditions

summary: Public security shall cooperate with courts in assisting evidence collection for private prosecutions, and explain in writing where evidence cannot be collected.
quote: 公安机关应当予以配合
conditional_on: where the court requests assistance

summary: Procuratorates shall perform legal supervision and notify public security to open an investigation where public prosecution procedure applies to insult or defamation private prosecutions.
quote: 应当履行法律监督职责，通知公安机关立案侦查
conditional_on: where the procuratorate finds public prosecution procedure should apply

summary: Procuratorates shall bring public prosecution for cyberviolence activities suspected of insult or defamation crimes that seriously harm social order or national interests.
quote: 检察机关应当依法提起公诉
conditional_on: where the conduct seriously harms social order and national interests

summary: Courts, procuratorates, public security and other departments shall promptly inform victims and their guardians or close relatives of their right to apply for legal aid.
quote: 应当及时告知受害人及其法定代理人或者近亲属有权依法申请法律援助

summary: Courts, procuratorates and public security shall promptly publish case progress information for high-profile cyberviolence cases.
quote: 应当依法及时向社会发布案件进展信息
conditional_on: where the case attracts high public attention and influence

summary: Residential and village committees, employers, schools and kindergartens in contact with minors shall give criticism and education and dissuade where a guardian breaches family education duties.
quote: 应当予以批评教育、劝诫制止
conditional_on: where a guardian refuses or neglects family education duties or obstructs another guardian

summary: New or expanded data centres must mainly support the capital's 'four centres' and 'four services' functions; the developer must provide a clear business-demand list or related letters of intent matching that positioning.
quote: 新建或改扩建数据中心应当主要用于支撑“四个中心”建设 [new or expanded data centres shall mainly support the 'four centres'] ... 建设单位应当提供符合功能定位的明确的业务需求清单或相关意向协议 [the developer shall provide a clear business-demand list or related letters of intent consistent with the functional positioning]
conditional_on: Energy review of a new, expanded or renovated data-centre project in scope (Art. 2)

summary: New or expanded data centres must be mainly computing-type: the developer submits a functional plan and configuration statement for computing and storage, and storage racks may not exceed 20% of total rack power.
quote: 新建或改扩建数据中心应当主要为计算型。建设单位应当提供项目运行后用于数据计算、存储等方面的功能规划说明及配置说明 [new or expanded data centres shall mainly be computing-type; the developer shall provide a functional plan and configuration statement for computing, storage, etc.]

summary: The project's energy report must include a renewable-energy utilisation plan, and new or expanded data centres must progressively raise their renewable share.
quote: 项目节能报告中应当包括可再生能源利用方案。新建及改扩建数据中心应当逐步提高可再生能源利用比例 [the energy report shall include a renewable-energy plan; new and expanded data centres shall progressively raise the renewable share]

summary: Projects completed in 2021 or later are encouraged to raise the renewable share of annual energy use by 10% a year to 100% by 2030, excluding the grid's existing renewable share.
quote: 鼓励2021年及以后建成的项目，年可再生能源利用量占年能源消费量的比例按照每年10%递增 [projects completed in 2021 or later are encouraged to raise the renewable share by 10% a year]
conditional_on: Project completed in 2021 or later

summary: Developers are encouraged to build their own distributed renewable facilities; they may install PV on roofs (and outer walls where feasible) and may cover remaining demand through green-power trading, green electricity certificates or purchased energy savings.
quote: 鼓励建设单位通过自建分布式可再生能源设施提高新能源和可再生能源利用水平 [developers are encouraged to build their own distributed renewable facilities] ... 可以通过绿色电力交易或认购可再生能源绿色电力证书、购买节能量等方式提高可再生能源利用比例 [may raise the renewable share through green-power trading, green electricity certificates or purchasing energy savings]

summary: The energy-review authorities commission a third party to verify, by the end of June each year, each project's renewable-energy use in the previous year against the energy-review opinion and energy report.
quote: 节能审查机关（即市发展改革部门，各区发展改革委、北京经济技术开发区经济发展局和行政审批局）委托第三方机构依据节能审查意见和节能报告于6月底前对项目上一年度可再生能源利用水平进行核实 [the energy-review authorities commission a third party to verify the previous year's renewable use by the end of June]

summary: The developer must cooperate with the annual verification of renewable-energy use.
quote: 项目建设单位应对核实工作予以配合。 [the project developer shall cooperate with the verification]

summary: A developer or its shareholders that close all their (or controlled) other operating data centres in Beijing while building or expanding a data centre may deduct half the closed rack power (excluding forced closures) from the new project's energy use, on submission of proof of closure.
quote: 建设单位或其股东在新建、扩建数据中心同时关闭其所有（或控股的）的位于本市行政区域内已投运的其他数据中心的 [where the developer or its shareholders, while building or expanding a data centre, close all their (or controlled) other operating data centres in this municipality] ... 关闭存量数据中心应当提交相应证明 [closure of existing data centres shall be supported by proof]
conditional_on: Closure of the other data centres at the same time as the new build or expansion; proof submitted

summary: The department managing energy-conservation work commissions a third party to verify closures of existing data centres claimed for the Art. 6 deduction.
quote: 管理节能工作的部门委托第三方机构对数据中心关闭情况进行核实 [the department managing energy conservation commissions a third party to verify the closures]

summary: New or expanded data centres must not exceed a PUE of 1.3 (under 10,000 tce a year), 1.25 (10,000 to under 20,000 tce), 1.2 (20,000 to under 30,000 tce) or 1.15 (30,000 tce or more).
quote: 新建、扩建数据中心，年能源消费量小于1万吨标准煤（电力按等价值计算，下同）的项目PUE值不应高于1.3 [new or expanded data centres below 10,000 tce a year: PUE no higher than 1.3] ... 年能源消费量大于等于3万吨标准煤的项目，PUE值不应高于1.15 [30,000 tce or more: PUE no higher than 1.15]

summary: Data centres must make full use of natural cooling and strengthen waste-heat use through own use or external heat supply.
quote: 数据中心应当充分利用自然冷源，通过自用、对外供热等方式加强余热资源利用 [data centres shall make full use of natural cooling and strengthen waste-heat use through own use or external heat supply]

summary: General energy-using equipment (cooling, ventilation, transformers, etc.) must meet or exceed grade-1 energy-efficiency standards.
quote: 制冷设备、通风设备、变压器等通用用能设备的能效水平应当达到或超过一级能效标准 [cooling, ventilation, transformers and other general equipment shall meet or exceed grade-1 energy efficiency]

summary: No new equipment or facilities using ozone-depleting substances (per the MEE list of controlled ozone-depleting substances) as working fluid.
quote: 禁止新增以消耗臭氧层物质为工质（以生态环境部《中国受控消耗臭氧层物质清单》为准）的设备设施 [new equipment using ozone-depleting substances as working fluid is prohibited]

summary: Data centres are encouraged to couple waste heat with nearby heat sources, use products in the MIIT catalogue of advanced green data-centre technologies, use refrigeration with natural working fluids such as CO2, and adopt efficient water-saving systems.
quote: 鼓励数据中心余热与周边既有热源耦合利用。鼓励采用工信部《绿色数据中心先进适用技术产品目录》中的技术产品 [encouraged: coupling waste heat with nearby heat sources; using products in the MIIT green data-centre catalogue] ... 鼓励采用以二氧化碳等自然工质为介质的制冷设备。鼓励数据中心采用高效节水系统。

summary: Data centres must make full use of reclaimed water; within the reclaimed-water network's coverage, non-domestic water (equipment and air-conditioning cooling water, machine-room humidification) should in principle be reclaimed water.
quote: 数据中心项目应充分利用再生水。再生水输配管网覆盖范围内的数据中心，设备冷却水、空调冷却水、机房加湿等非生活用水原则上应采用再生水。 [data-centre projects shall make full use of reclaimed water; within network coverage, non-domestic water shall in principle be reclaimed water]

summary: Developers of new or expanded projects must establish an energy management system and a water-saving management system following GB/T 23331, DB11/T 1768 and related standards.
quote: 新建、扩建项目建设单位应当按照《能源管理体系要求》（GB/T23331）、《建筑水表配置规范》（DB11/T 1768）等相关标准要求，建立健全能源管理体系以及节水管理体系 [developers shall establish energy and water-saving management systems per GB/T23331, DB11/T 1768 and related standards]

summary: Projects using 5,000 tce or more a year must build an online energy-consumption monitoring system that measures PUE, connects to the Beijing energy-saving monitoring service platform, is designed, built and commissioned with the data centre, and transmits continuous, complete and true data.
quote: 应当建设能耗在线监测系统，按照相关标准要求实现PUE值测量，并接入北京市节能监测服务平台 [shall build an online monitoring system, measure PUE per the relevant standards and connect to the Beijing energy-saving monitoring service platform] ... 数据中心应当确保能耗在线监测系统运行安全、稳定，数据传输连续、完整、真实。
conditional_on: Annual energy consumption of 5,000 tce or more

summary: Projects using less than 5,000 tce a year are encouraged to build an online energy-consumption monitoring system connected to the Beijing energy-saving monitoring service platform.
quote: 鼓励年能源消费量不满5000吨标准煤的项目建设能耗在线监测系统，并接入北京市节能监测服务平台 [projects below 5,000 tce are encouraged to build an online monitoring system connected to the platform]
conditional_on: Annual energy consumption below 5,000 tce

summary: The developer, its legal representative and its shareholders must have no Beijing data-centre project that failed to start construction within two years of obtaining its energy-review opinion.
quote: 建设单位及其法定代表人、股东应当在本市没有已取得节能审查意见后两年内未开工建设的数据中心项目 [the developer, its legal representative and shareholders shall have no data-centre project in Beijing not started within two years of its energy-review opinion]

summary: Before applying for energy review the developer must fully justify its energy-saving plan and complete the energy report, which is its commitment, and must ensure the report is true.
quote: 建设单位应当在申报节能审查前充分论证节能方案，完善节能报告编制。节能报告是建设单位就节能工作作出的承诺，建设单位应当确保节能报告的真实性 [the developer shall justify the energy-saving plan before applying, complete the energy report (its commitment) and ensure the report is true]

summary: The developer must strictly implement the energy-review opinion and the construction plan in the energy report, so that actual energy and resource efficiency is not below the design level.
quote: 严格落实节能审查意见的各项要求及节能报告中的建设方案，确保实际能源资源利用水平不低于设计水平 [strictly implement the review opinion and the report's construction plan, ensuring actual efficiency is not below the design level]

summary: If rack loading has not reached 80% within two years of the energy-review opinion, the developer must apply to the original energy-review authority for a change.
quote: 未达到80%的，建设单位应当向原节能审查机关提出变更申请 [if below 80%, the developer shall apply to the original energy-review authority for a change]
conditional_on: Rack loading below 80% two years after the energy-review opinion

summary: Energy-review authorities handle violations in energy review, publish inspection and penalty results on their websites, send penalty results to the Beijing public credit information service platform, and apply joint disciplinary measures to entities on the list of seriously dishonest entities.
quote: 节能审查机关对建设单位及相关单位在节能审查工作中违法违规行为依法进行处理，并将行政检查处罚结果在本单位网站公开，同时将行政处罚结果按要求归集至北京市公共信用信息服务平台 [authorities handle violations, publish inspection and penalty results on their website and send penalty results to the Beijing public credit platform]

summary: The municipal energy-review authority organises energy inspections of data centres' actual operating PUE against DB11/T1139, lists data centres above PUE 1.4 as subject to differential electricity prices, and notifies Beijing Electric Power Company to collect the surcharge.
quote: 市级节能审查机关组织对数据中心实际运行PUE值执行《数据中心能源效率限额》（DB11/T1139）的情况进行节能监察 [the municipal energy-review authority inspects actual operating PUE against DB11/T1139] ... 并通知北京市电力公司征收差别电价电费 [and notifies Beijing Electric Power Company to collect the differential electricity charges]

summary: Beijing Electric Power Company remits all differential-price revenue to the municipal treasury, where it enters the public budget under separate revenue and expenditure management.
quote: 北京市电力公司执行差别电价电费收入全额上缴市级财政，纳入市级财政公共预算，实行收支两条线管理 [Beijing Electric Power Company remits all differential-price revenue to the municipal treasury, in the public budget, with separate revenue and expenditure lines]

summary: A data centre above the limit may, after rectification, apply to the municipal energy-review authority for a re-check; if it passes, the authority notifies Beijing Electric Power Company to stop the differential price.
quote: 超限数据中心整改后，可申请市级节能审查机关进行复核，对于达到整改要求并通过复核的，由市级节能审查机关通知北京市电力公司停止执行差别电价 [after rectification, an over-limit data centre may apply for a re-check; if it passes, the authority notifies Beijing Electric Power Company to stop the differential price]

summary: Survey existing data centres in the Yizhuang new-city area and build a data-centre register (台账); data centres are to be brought into the energy-saving monitoring service platform through inspections and technical monitoring, with responsible departments listed.
applies_from: 自印发之日起实施 (from date of issue)
provision: 二、具体措施 item 1 (1.摸排存量项目)
quote: 全面摸排亦庄新城数据中心，建立数据中心台账

summary: Encourages data centres to use green electricity and green certificates; qualifying centres may receive an annual energy-consumption report from the management committee and reward eligibility under local rules.
applies_from: 自印发之日起实施 (from date of issue)
provision: 二、具体措施 item 2 (2.鼓励转型升级)
quote: 鼓励数据中心使用绿电绿证

summary: Publish on official media platforms the compliant data centres whose procedures are complete and whose energy-efficiency level meets the standard, and update the list dynamically.
applies_from: 自印发之日起实施 (from date of issue)
provision: 二、具体措施 item 3 (3.动态公开公示)
quote: 将手续齐全、能效水平达标的合规数据中心在官方媒体平台公开

summary: Parks and enterprises that use industrial land for data-centre operation without approval, and data centres not consistent with Beijing or Yizhuang policy and industry direction, are excluded from the infrastructure REITs filing plan.
applies_from: 自印发之日起实施 (from date of issue)
provision: 二、具体措施 item 4 (4.加强园区管理)
quote: 不纳入基础设施领域不动产投资信托基金（REITs）申报计划

summary: The management committee determines which data centres are subject to differential electricity pricing, following the prescribed procedures, and collects the differential electricity charges.
applies_from: 自印发之日起实施 (from date of issue)
provision: 二、具体措施 item 5 (5.征收差别电价)
quote: 由管委会确定执行差别电价的对象，履行相应程序后征收差别电价电费
conditional_on: Data centres exceeding the standard limit value

summary: Data centres designated for differential electricity pricing must pay the differential electricity charges.
applies_from: 自印发之日起实施 (from date of issue)
provision: 二、具体措施 item 5 (5.征收差别电价)
quote: 征收差别电价电费
conditional_on: Designation by the management committee for differential pricing

summary: After review by the management committee, data centres converted from industrial land to commercial land may follow the new-project approval procedure, and may be offered data-migration and backup services.
applies_from: 自印发之日起实施 (from date of issue)
provision: 二、具体措施 item 6 (6.腾退工业用地)
quote: 可提供数据迁移备份服务
conditional_on: Review and approval by the management committee

summary: The management committee may assist data centres relocating to Hebei and Inner Mongolia by liaising with receiving areas and seeking energy-price and green-power support.
applies_from: 自印发之日起实施 (from date of issue)
provision: 二、具体措施 item 7 (7.协助外迁落地)
quote: 管委会可协助与承接地沟通对接
conditional_on: Data centres planning relocation outside the area

summary: In principle, no new data centres may be added within the Yizhuang new-city area.
applies_from: 自印发之日起实施 (from date of issue)
provision: 二、具体措施 item 8 (8.严控新增项目)
quote: 亦庄新城范围原则上不再新增数据中心

summary: For projects consistent with the Yizhuang computing plan and meeting energy-review and renewable-energy requirements, the management committee may use economic development cooperation agreements specifying economic contribution, energy-use totals and breach terms.
applies_from: 自印发之日起实施 (from date of issue)
provision: 二、具体措施 item 8 (8.严控新增项目)
quote: 管委会可以采取与项目实施主体签订经济发展合作协议的方式
conditional_on: Project consistent with the Yizhuang computing plan and energy-review requirements

summary: New data centres must base their electricity use on the energy-saving review approval, strictly follow the supply agreement with the power company, and not exceed the consumption approved in the review.
applies_from: 自印发之日起实施 (from date of issue)
provision: 二、具体措施 item 9 (9.明确用电上限)
quote: 不得超出节能审查批复的用电量
conditional_on: New data centres

summary: Conduct on-site inspections of excess energy use and compliance, and law-enforcement inspections of energy-use efficiency, metering equipment and statistics, with inspection results published.
applies_from: 自印发之日起实施 (from date of issue)
provision: 二、具体措施 item 10 (10.加强行业监管)
quote: 开展能源利用效率、计量器具配置和统计活动等方面执法检查，并将执法检查结果公示

summary: The Beijing Economic-Technological Development Area Management Committee is responsible for interpreting the measures.
applies_from: 自印发之日起实施 (from date of issue)
quote: 由北京经济技术开发区管理委员会负责解释

summary: Anyone carrying out AI S&T activities must integrate ethics requirements throughout and follow the listed AI ethics principles (human welfare, rights, IP, fairness, risk control, openness, controllability, accountability).
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 开展人工智能科技活动应将科技伦理要求贯穿全过程 [AI S&T activities shall integrate S&T ethics requirements throughout the whole process]

summary: Universities, research institutes, medical institutions and firms doing AI S&T activities are responsible for AI ethics management in their unit; units with the capacity should set up an AI ethics committee and give it staff, premises, funding and independence.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 有条件的单位应设立人工智能科技伦理委员会（以下简称委员会）。委员会应配备必要的工作人员、办公场所和经费等条件，采取有效措施保障委员会独立开展工作 [units with the capacity shall set up an AI ethics committee and resource it to work independently]
conditional_on: The unit has the capacity (有条件的单位)

summary: Committee charter, composition and member duties follow arts. 5-8 of the Trial Measures for S&T Ethics Review; members must include experts in AI technology, applications, ethics and law.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 委员会组成应包括人工智能技术、应用、伦理、法律等相应专业背景的专家 [committee shall include experts in AI technology, applications, ethics, law, etc.]

summary: The leader of an in-scope AI activity must apply for ethics review to the unit's committee (or a commissioned service center if there is no capable committee; individuals without a unit go to a service center), submitting the activity plan (algorithms, data sources, testing, intended uses), an ethics risk assessment with prevention plan, and a compliance commitment.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 人工智能科技活动负责人应向本单位委员会申请，单位未设立委员会或委员会无法胜任科技伦理审查工作要求，向本单位委托的服务中心申请开展科技伦理审查，无单位人员应委托符合要求的服务中心开展科技伦理审查 [the activity leader shall apply to the unit's committee, or to a commissioned service center]
conditional_on: Activity falls within the scope of Art. 2

summary: The committee or service center must decide whether to accept an application, notify the applicant, assign the general, simplified or emergency procedure according to risk, and list all missing materials at once.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 委员会或服务中心应根据申请材料决定是否受理申请并通知申请人 [committee or service center shall decide on acceptance and notify the applicant]

summary: General-procedure review meetings are chaired by the committee chair or a designated vice-chair, with at least 5 members present covering the categories in Art. 10; advisers without direct interests may be consulted but do not vote.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 到会委员应不少于 5 人，且应包括本办法第十条所列的不同类别的委员 [at least 5 members present, including the categories listed in Art. 10]

summary: Ethics review must focus on fairness (data completeness and diversity, preventing bias), controllability and trustworthiness (robustness, user control, monitoring), transparency and explainability (disclosure of uses, logic and risks), traceable responsibility (logging), and staff qualification, social value and risk-benefit.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 委员会或服务中心开展人工智能科技伦理审查，重点关注以下方面 [in AI ethics review, the committee or service center shall focus on the following]

summary: The committee or service center must decide within 30 days of acceptance (extendable), give reasons or revision suggestions for revise-or-reject decisions, and re-decide within 7 working days on a well-founded appeal.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 对于需要修改或不予批准的，委员会或服务中心应提出修改建议或说明理由 [for revise or reject decisions, the committee or service center shall give suggestions or reasons]

summary: The activity leader must identify changes in ethics risk promptly and report them to the committee or service center.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 人工智能科技活动负责人应及时识别科技伦理风险变化，并将相关变化情况向委员会或服务中心报告 [the activity leader shall identify and report changes in ethics risk]

summary: The committee or service center must conduct follow-up review of approved activities (generally at least every 12 months) and may suspend or terminate them.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 委员会或服务中心依照《伦理办法》第十九条规定对审查批准的人工智能科技活动开展跟踪审查 [committee or service center shall conduct follow-up review under art. 19 of the Ethics Measures]

summary: The committee or service center must set rules and follow-up frequency for the simplified procedure, which is carried out by two or more designated members and reverts to the general procedure on negative opinions, doubts or disagreement.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 委员会或服务中心应制定适用简易程序审查的工作规程和跟踪频度 [shall set working rules and follow-up frequency for simplified review]

summary: MIIT and MOST, with other departments, must issue and dynamically adjust the list of AI activities requiring expert ethics re-review (initial list in the annex).
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 工业和信息化部、科技部会同有关部门制定发布“需要开展科技伦理专家复核的人工智能科技活动”清单 [MIIT and MOST with relevant departments shall issue the list of AI activities requiring expert ethics re-review]

summary: Units carrying out listed activities must, after initial committee or service-center review, apply for expert re-review (lead unit if several; central SOEs and centrally administered universities, institutes and medical bodies to the competent department, others to the provincial authority) and submit materials under art. 27 of the Ethics Measures.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 开展纳入“复核清单”的人工智能科技活动，通过委员会或服务中心的初步审查后，由本单位申请开展专家复核 [for listed activities, after initial review the unit shall apply for expert re-review]
conditional_on: Activity is on the expert re-review list; not required where Art. 26 applies

summary: Provincial authorities or competent State Council departments must form expert re-review groups under arts. 28-30 of the Ethics Measures, review the initial opinion's compliance and reasonableness, and reply within 30 days; they may commission a service center.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 地方或相关主管部门应依照《伦理办法》第二十八条至第三十条规定组织成立复核专家组 [provincial authority or competent department shall form an expert re-review group]

summary: The committee or service center must take its decision in line with the expert re-review opinion and conduct stricter follow-up review of listed activities (generally at least every 6 months).
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 委员会或服务中心对纳入“复核清单”的人工智能科技活动加强跟踪审查 [committee or service center shall strengthen follow-up review of listed activities]

summary: If the ethics risk of a listed activity changes materially, ethics review must be repeated under art. 20 of the Ethics Measures and expert re-review applied for again.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 科技伦理风险发生重大变化的，应依照《伦理办法》第二十条规定重新开展相关科技伦理审查并申请专家复核 [on a material change in ethics risk, review again and apply for expert re-review]
conditional_on: Material change in ethics risk

summary: The committee or service center must adopt an emergency procedure for public emergencies, completing emergency review generally within 72 hours (36 hours for the stage before expert re-review), while assuring quality and follow-up.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 委员会或服务中心应制定应急工作制度，明确突发公共事件等紧急状态下的应急审查流程和标准操作规程 [shall establish an emergency work system with emergency review procedures]

summary: Units must register their committee and their listed (re-review) activities on the national S&T management information registration platform under arts. 43-45 of the Ethics Measures; service centers must also register.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 将委员会相关情况、纳入“复核清单”的人工智能科技活动通过国家科技管理信息登记平台进行登记 [register committee information and listed activities on the national S&T management information registration platform]

summary: Units must submit the committee's annual work report for the previous year and implementation reports on listed activities; service centers submit an annual work report.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 并提交上一年度委员会工作报告、纳入“复核清单”的人工智能科技活动实施情况报告等相关材料 ... 服务中心应依照上述规定登记并提交上一年度工作报告 [submit the previous year's committee report and reports on listed activities; service centers register and report likewise]

summary: MOST and competent departments share AI ethics registration information.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 科技部与相关主管部门对人工智能科技伦理相关登记信息同步共享 [MOST and competent departments share registration information]

summary: Provincial authorities and competent departments must open channels for reporting AI ethics violations in their sector or region and handle reports.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 地方、相关主管部门、从事人工智能科技活动的单位应结合本行业本系统或本单位的实际情况，畅通能够反映人工智能科技伦理违法违规问题的渠道 [authorities and units shall keep open channels for reporting AI ethics violations]

summary: Units carrying out AI S&T activities must open internal channels for reporting AI ethics violations and handle reports.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 地方、相关主管部门、从事人工智能科技活动的单位应结合本行业本系统或本单位的实际情况，畅通能够反映人工智能科技伦理违法违规问题的渠道 [authorities and units shall keep open channels for reporting AI ethics violations]

summary: MOST coordinates national S&T ethics oversight; MIIT with other departments is responsible for AI ethics governance and emergency coordination; each department and province is responsible for its own sector or region.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 科技部负责统筹指导全国科技伦理监管工作，工业和信息化部会同有关部门负责人工智能科技伦理治理工作 [MOST coordinates national S&T ethics oversight; MIIT with relevant departments is responsible for AI ethics governance]

summary: Programmatic support measures: build an AI ethics standards system and service system (risk monitoring, testing, certification, consulting), support SMEs, innovation, education and training. The text does not name the responsible body.
applies_from: entry into force (date blank in draft, Art. 37)
quote: 推进人工智能科技伦理服务体系建设，强化人工智能科技伦理风险监测预警、检测评估、认证、咨询等服务供给 ... 加大对中小微企业的人工智能科技伦理支持力度 [advance the AI ethics service system; increase support for SMEs]

summary: Data processors must identify and declare important data under applicable rules. Data not notified or published as important data by authorities need not be declared for a security assessment.
applies_from: from promulgation (自公布之日起施行, Art. 14)
quote: 数据处理者应当按照相关规定识别、申报重要数据
conditional_on: data identified as important data under applicable rules

summary: Free trade zones may formulate a negative list of data subject to security assessment, standard contracts and certification. The list requires approval by the provincial cybersecurity and informatization committee and filing with the national CAC and national data administration.
applies_from: from promulgation (自公布之日起施行, Art. 14)
quote: 可以自行制定区内需要纳入数据出境安全评估
conditional_on: within the national data classification and grading framework

summary: Data processors exporting data must apply through the local provincial CAC to the national CAC for a data export security assessment in the listed cases: CII operators exporting personal information or important data; other processors exporting important data, or cumulatively exporting personal information of 1 million or more persons or sensitive personal information of 10,000 or more persons since 1 January.
applies_from: from promulgation (自公布之日起施行, Art. 14)
quote: 数据处理者向境外提供数据，符合下列条件之一的，应当通过所在地省级网信部门向国家网信部门申报数据出境安全评估
conditional_on: cases listed in Art. 7 items (1) and (2); exemptions in Arts. 3 to 6 prevail

summary: Processors other than CII operators that cumulatively export personal information of 100,000 to under 1 million persons, or sensitive personal information of under 10,000 persons, must conclude a personal information export standard contract with the overseas recipient or pass personal information protection certification.
applies_from: from promulgation (自公布之日起施行, Art. 14)
quote: 应当依法与境外接收方订立个人信息出境标准合同或者通过个人信息保护认证
conditional_on: non-CII processor exporting 100,000 or more but fewer than 1 million persons' personal information (excluding sensitive) since 1 January, or fewer than 10,000 sensitive personal information; exemptions in Arts. 3 to 6 prevail

summary: An approved security assessment result is valid for 3 years from issuance. Processors may apply through the provincial CAC to extend validity, filing up to 60 working days before expiry if activities continue and no reassessment-triggering change has occurred; the national CAC may extend by 3 years.
applies_from: 3 years from the date the assessment result is issued (Art. 9)
quote: 数据处理者可以在有效期届满前60个工作日内通过所在地省级网信部门向国家网信部门提出延长评估结果有效期申请
