summary: Ensure electricity capacity and power facility needs of data centres in the Gansu hub; encourage integrated source-grid-load-storage projects.
quote: 保障甘肃枢纽内数据中心的用电容量和用电设施需求

summary: Include qualifying big data enterprises in provincial medium- and long-term electricity trading and waive deviation assessment fees for participants.
quote: 将符合条件的大数据企业纳入省内电力中长期交易

summary: Exempt production electricity of big data enterprises from demand (capacity) charges until the end of 2025.
quote: 2025年底前，对大数据企业生产用电免收需量（容量）电费。

summary: Convert indirect to direct power supply for eligible urban data centres and edge computing centres meeting national Grade A or international T4 standards.
quote: 对具备转供电改直供电条件且符合国标A级或国际T4建设标准的城市数据中心、边缘计算中心实施转供电改直供电。

summary: Coordinate energy-consumption indicators; deduct single-listed national project energy use in dual-control assessment; prioritise indicators for Qingyang projects using new energy.
quote: 能耗指标由省、市有关部门加强统筹、优先保障

summary: Encourage data centres to use wind, solar and other renewable electricity through bilateral trading and dedicated renewable supply lines.
quote: 鼓励使用风能、太阳能等可再生能源，通过双边交易，提升数据中心绿色电能使用水平。

summary: Optimise communications network structure and build direct links from the Qingyang cluster to major cities in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, Yangtze River Delta and Greater Bay Area.
quote: 优化通信网络结构，布局建设庆阳集群与京津冀、长三角、粤港澳大湾区等地区主要城市的直联通道

summary: Upgrade direct links between the Lanzhou, Jinchang, Zhangye, Jiuquan and Jiayuguan nodes and the Qingyang cluster.
quote: 升级改造兰州、金昌、张掖、酒泉、嘉峪关等节点与庆阳集群的直联通道

summary: Optimise routing for overseas data access and provide data backup services for Belt and Road countries.
quote: 为“一带一路”沿线国家提供数据备份服务

summary: Establish the East Data West Computing industry research institute to advise on data-centre and big data policy.
quote: 设立东数西算产业研究院

summary: Encourage provincial universities and vocational colleges to adjust programmes in digital economy, AI, big data and related fields and to set up joint institutes and training bases.
quote: 鼓励省内高校、职业院校优化既有专业设置

summary: Encourage invitations of well-known domestic and foreign institutions to provide digital-sector training to officials.
quote: 鼓励各市州及数字领域相关部门邀请国内外知名机构来甘开展数字领域相关培训

summary: Open a green channel for urgently needed special talents and support recruitment of composite and scarce talents in big data and AI.
quote: 开辟急需特殊人才绿色通道

summary: Explore establishing a high-level digital talent support programme with grants for awards, work subsidies, living allowances and housing support.
quote: 探索建立数字领域高层次人才支持计划

summary: Grant household registration, social insurance, tax relief, settlement subsidy, schooling, spouse placement and medical benefits to qualifying digital talents.
quote: 给予户籍办理、社保办理、税收减免、安家补贴、子女入学、配偶安置、就医保障等方面的优惠政策和便利服务

summary: Qualifying high-end and core digital talents are eligible for the Measure 21 benefits once recognised by municipal organisation departments.
quote: 对符合条件的数字领域高端人才和骨干人才，经各市州组织部门认定
conditional_on: Recognition (认定) by the municipal organisation department

summary: Actively recommend digital high-level talent for national talent programmes and select provincial high-level talent.
quote: 积极推荐数字领域高层次人才申报政府特殊津贴

summary: Separate the performance-pay total for urgently needed digital professionals in public institutions and allow flexible pay schemes.
quote: 实行绩效工资总量单列政策

summary: Actively seek national special funds for the Gansu hub and coordinate provincial industry-chain special funds to prioritise the Qingyang municipality.
quote: 积极争取国家专项资金支持甘肃枢纽建设

summary: Qingyang municipal government to use the local retained share of VAT paid by newly introduced big data enterprises for investment attraction and infrastructure.
quote: 所缴纳增值税地方留成部分由当地政府统筹使用

summary: Relevant departments may provide funding support to enterprises or projects meeting criteria (1) to (4), including compute trading, major investment projects, listed firms and university-enterprise training bases.
quote: 对符合下列条件的企业或项目，相关部门或市州在政策范围内，可统筹给予资金支持。
conditional_on: Criteria (1) to (4) in Measure 26

summary: Strictly implement national tax and fee support policies and provide convenient tax services to big data enterprises.
quote: 严格落实国家出台的税费支持政策

summary: Big data enterprises in listed industries whose main business revenue exceeds 60% of total revenue in the Qingyang cluster are taxed at 15% corporate income tax.
quote: 且其主营业务收入占企业收入总额60%以上的大数据企业
conditional_on: Main business revenue above 60% of total enterprise revenue

summary: Qualifying big data enterprises receive a 50% reduction in listed resource, urban maintenance, property, land use, stamp, farmland occupation and education surcharges.
quote: 自2022年1月1日至2024年12月31日，对符合条件的大数据企业按照50%税额幅度减征资源税
conditional_on: Qualifying big data enterprises

summary: Use fiscal funds and the provincial green data industry fund to guide and expand credit support for Qingyang cluster firms.
quote: 充分发挥财政资金和省绿色生态数据信息产业发展基金的引导、带动和放大作用

summary: Encourage financial institutions to innovate IP, equity and receivables pledge loans and bank-tax interactive loans for big data firms.
quote: 鼓励金融机构针对大数据企业特点，创新开展知识产权、股权、应收账款等质押贷款和银税互动贷款

summary: Encourage financing guarantee companies to reduce guarantee fees for big data firms; support eligible data-centre projects in REITs.
quote: 鼓励融资担保公司降低大数据企业担保费

summary: Establish a government credit performance mechanism to fulfil investment-attraction policy support in a timely manner and hold responsible officials accountable.
quote: 建立政府诚信履约机制

summary: Pursue industry-chain and specialised investment attraction and vigorously attract leading digital-sector enterprises.
quote: 大力引进数字领域头部企业

summary: Implement extremely simplified approval, not-seen approval and fault-tolerant acceptance in data-centre construction; keep business registration within 3 working days; provide full-process dedicated service.
quote: 将企业开办时间控制在3个工作日以内

summary: Fully implement commitment-based investment project approval, regional assessment, proxy services, simulated approval and fault-tolerant acceptance in the Qingyang cluster; apply commitment-based licensing to enterprise permits.
quote: 在庆阳集群内，全面推行企业投资项目承诺制

summary: Encourage data centres to adopt multi-line network access.
quote: 鼓励数据中心采用多线接入网络

summary: Basic telecommunications enterprises may not adopt monopolistic policies affecting fair competition or charge significantly above normal discriminatory prices to third-party data centres.
quote: 基础电信企业不得对第三方数据中心出台影响市场公平竞争的垄断性政策或进行明显高于正常水平的歧视性定价

summary: Build a provincial data-centre operation monitoring platform and energy-consumption monitoring mechanism; track utilisation, energy and related indicators.
quote: 建设全省数据中心运行监测平台

summary: New or expanded data centres must complete monitoring equipment configuration and connect to the monitoring platform at the same time; existing centres connect in batches.
quote: 新建（扩建）数据中心应同步完成监测设备配置并接入监测平台

summary: No data centre may participate in virtual currency mining projects.
quote: 严禁任何数据中心参与虚拟货币“挖矿”项目

summary: Establish a primary responsibility system and a project commitment system; commitments cover avoiding project splitting and false project approval, and investment scale, construction schedule, technical standards, tax compliance and green energy saving.
quote: 建立数据中心企业主体责任制，推行数据中心项目承诺制

summary: During a two-year inclusive period for newly established new-business-form enterprises, supervise through administrative guidance and other flexible supervision methods.
quote: 在包容期内通过行政指导等柔性监管方式
conditional_on: Enterprises newly established as new-format, new-model or new-industry enterprises

summary: The national cyberspace authority coordinates network security and supervises internet information content nationwide; telecom, public security and national security bodies have their own supervisory roles under Art. 4.
quote: 国家网信部门负责统筹协调全国网络安全工作和相关监督管理工作，对全国互联网信息内容实施监督管理执法。

summary: The state takes measures to monitor, prevent and handle illegal activities harming national security, public interest or lawful rights through internet information services.
quote: 国家采取措施，监测、防范、处置利用中华人民共和国境内外的互联网信息服务实施的损害中华人民共和国国家安全、公共利益或者公民、组织合法权益的违法犯罪活动

summary: Internet information service providers must comply with law, perform network security duties, bear social responsibility and accept government and social supervision.
quote: 从事互联网信息服务，应当遵守法律和行政法规，履行网络安全义务，承担社会责任

summary: Internet information service providers must obtain approval (核准) from the telecom authority; unapproved provision is prohibited.
quote: 应当依法取得电信主管部门核准。未经核准，不得从事互联网信息服务。

summary: Providers of telecom business must apply to the telecom authority for a telecom business operating permit.
quote: 属于经营电信业务的，应当向电信主管部门申请取得相关电信业务经营许可。
conditional_on: where the service constitutes operating telecom business

summary: The telecom authority decides approval applications, cancels permits after two years of inactivity or loss of eligibility, and establishes classified management and market monitoring.
quote: 电信主管部门建立电信业务分类管理、市场监测制度

summary: Providers must report network resource and telecom business information as required.
quote: 相关互联网信息服务提供者应当按要求报送网络资源、电信业务经营等信息。

summary: Providers must use network resources meeting telecom authority requirements, maintain network and information security management systems and technical safeguards, and meet mandatory national standards.
quote: 应当使用符合电信主管部门要求的网络资源，具备符合法律、行政法规和国家规定的网络安全与信息安全管理制度和技术保障措施。

summary: Where law requires competent-authority permission for news, culture, publishing, audiovisual, education, religious or financial internet services, that permission must be obtained before filing or applying for a telecom permit.
quote: 在履行核准手续或者申请电信业务经营许可前，应当取得有关主管部门的许可。
conditional_on: where law requires competent-authority permission

summary: Internet news information service practitioners must hold appropriate qualifications and receive training and assessment; practitioners must also follow political direction and professional ethics; qualification rules are to be made by press, publication and cyberspace authorities.
quote: 互联网新闻信息服务相关从业人员应当取得相应资质，接受相应培训、考核。
conditional_on: internet news information services

summary: Providers must strengthen management and training of service practitioners, especially information security reviewers, per national rules.
quote: 互联网信息服务提供者应当按照国家有关规定，加强互联网信息服务从业人员特别是信息安全审核人员的管理和培训。

summary: Providers must cancel permits or approvals when ceasing service, and file change procedures with the original licensing authority after mergers or acquisitions changing the licensed principal.
quote: 互联网信息服务提供者不再从事互联网信息服务的，应当及时办理相关许可或者核准的注销手续。

summary: Access providers must check approval numbers and permits of information service providers and must not serve unapproved providers.
quote: 互联网接入服务提供者应当及时查验，不得为未取得核准编号及相应许可证件的互联网信息服务提供者提供服务。

summary: Operating domain root servers or root server operators, domain registry or registrar services, or domain recursive resolution requires telecom authority licence.
quote: 设立域名根服务器及域名根服务器运行机构、域名注册管理机构、域名注册服务机构，以及提供域名递归解析服务，应当依法取得电信主管部门的许可。

summary: Providers shall not use their domain names for illegal acts; domain names must be lawfully registered and changes or cancellations filed.
quote: 互联网信息服务提供者不得将所使用域名用于实施违法行为。

summary: Access providers must verify filed IP address information before providing access and must not serve unregistered or false IP addresses.
quote: 互联网接入服务提供者提供接入服务前，应当核验相应互联网协议地址备案信息，不得为未实名或者虚假的互联网协议地址提供服务。

summary: IP address allocation bodies must promptly report IP address information to the telecom authority.
quote: 互联网协议地址分配机构应当及时向电信主管部门报备互联网协议地址信息。

summary: Providers must file with the designated public security receiving body within 30 days after the network is formally connected; access providers must assist.
applies_from: 30 days after the network is formally connected
quote: 应当自网络正式联通之日起30日内，到所在地的省、自治区、直辖市人民政府公安机关指定的受理机关办理备案手续

summary: Providers must display the networking filing number at a readily accessible location.
quote: 互联网信息服务提供者应当在方便查询位置明示联网备案编号。

summary: Providers must display licence and approval numbers at a readily accessible location while providing services.
quote: 互联网信息服务提供者在提供服务时应当在方便查询位置明示依据本办法第八条、第九条、第十一条取得的许可证编号、核准编号。

summary: Providers shall provide services only within the scope of their permitted or approved projects.
quote: 不得超出许可或者核准的项目范围提供服务

summary: Providers must establish user registration, account management, publication management, public information patrol, emergency response and content orientation systems; sign service agreements with users; and have staff and technical capacity suited to scale.
quote: 应当建立健全用户注册、账号管理、信息发布管理、公共信息巡查、应急处置和内容导向管理等制度，与用户依法签订服务协议

summary: Providers must dynamically verify registered account information and refuse registration or suspend services where prohibited information is found.
quote: 及时对账号信息进行动态核验

summary: Providers must verify qualification documents of users offering services that require qualifications and must not serve users without legal qualifications.
quote: 应当查验用户的证明文件，不得为未取得合法资质的用户提供相应服务。
conditional_on: where user services require qualifications

summary: Access, internet information, domain registration and resolution providers must require users to provide real identity information and must not serve users who refuse.
quote: 应当依法要求用户提供真实身份信息；用户不提供真实身份信息的，不得为其提供相关服务。

summary: Providers must authenticate user real identity through national online identity authentication, ID number or unified social credit code, record the information, and retain it during and after service.
quote: 应当基于国家网络身份认证公共服务、身份证件号码或者统一社会信用代码等方式，依法对用户进行真实身份信息认证，并记录相关信息。

summary: Internet information service providers must verify the real identity of minor users by necessary means.
quote: 互联网信息服务提供者应当依法通过必要手段核验未成年人用户真实身份信息。

summary: No person or organisation may evade real-identity authentication by using false or others' identity information, illegally using others' accounts, or providing technical support for evasion.
quote: 任何组织和个人不得通过实施下列行为，规避真实身份信息认证

summary: Providers must establish dynamic verification of existing internet accounts; for accounts inconsistent with identity or unused for six months, they must give reasonable prompts and may restrict, suspend or terminate accounts.
quote: 互联网信息服务提供者应当建立互联网账号信息动态核验制度，适时核验存量账号信息

summary: Providers must support unbinding a mobile phone number from a previous user's internet account when the number's user changes.
quote: 应当支持解除移动电话号码与原用户互联网账号的绑定关系
conditional_on: where the mobile phone number user changes

summary: Access, internet information, domain registration and resolution providers must take technical and other measures to prevent, detect and stop use of their services for illegal crimes.
quote: 应当采取技术措施和其他必要措施，防范、发现和制止所提供的服务被用于实施违法犯罪

summary: On discovering illegal network activity, these providers must preserve records and report to public security and other competent authorities.
quote: 发现网络违法犯罪行为的，应当保存有关记录，并向公安等有关主管部门报告。

summary: The state encourages providers and users to create and disseminate content promoting socialist core values, advanced culture and related themes.
quote: 国家鼓励互联网信息服务提供者和使用者制作、复制、发布、传播含有弘扬社会主义核心价值观

summary: Providers and users shall not create, copy, publish or disseminate information containing the nine categories of listed prohibited content.
quote: 互联网信息服务提供者和使用者不得制作、复制、发布、传播含有下列内容的信息

summary: Providers must take measures to prevent and resist undesirable information, including content hyping major policy, emergencies or major cases, or likely to affect minors' health.
quote: 应当采取措施，防范和抵制制作、复制、发布、传播含有炒作重大形势政策、突发事件、重大案件

summary: Providers shall not display undesirable information in prominent product or service positions or key links likely to attract user attention.
quote: 不得在产品或者服务醒目位置、易引起互联网信息服务使用者关注的重点环节呈现前款规定的不良信息。

summary: Providers are encouraged to cooperate with press and publication institutions to improve content management.
quote: 鼓励互联网信息服务提供者与新闻出版机构等开展合作，提升内容管理水平。

summary: No person or organisation may carry out listed acts disrupting internet information service order, such as fake or bulk registrations, traffic manipulation and evading technical controls.
quote: 任何组织和个人不得实施下列行为，扰乱互联网信息服务秩序

summary: Providers must take abnormal-data monitoring and manual review measures to prevent and monitor the listed disruptive acts.
quote: 互联网信息服务提供者应当采取异常数据监测、人工复审复核等措施，加强对前款规定行为的预防和监测。

summary: On discovering violating information, providers must immediately stop transmission, delete, block, disconnect links, restrict account functions or close accounts, preserve records and report to cyberspace and other authorities.
quote: 应当立即停止传输，采取删除、屏蔽、断开链接、限制账号功能及其营利权限、关闭账号等处置措施

summary: Email-sending and app-download service providers with security duties must, on knowing of user violations, stop transmission, take removal measures, preserve records and report.
quote: 应当立即停止传输，采取删除、屏蔽、断开链接等处置措施，防止信息扩散
conditional_on: where they know that their users violate Art. 24, 25 or 26

summary: Access providers discovering violating information must stop transmission, take removal measures, preserve records and report to cyberspace, telecom and public security authorities.
quote: 应当立即停止传输，采取消除等处置措施，防止信息扩散

summary: Competent authorities must require providers and access providers to handle violating information under Art. 27 and 28, and those providers must cooperate.
quote: 应当依据职责要求互联网信息服务提供者、互联网接入服务提供者按照本办法第二十七条第一款、第二十八条的规定予以处理

summary: State authorities may take necessary measures against foreign organisations or individuals disseminating prohibited information that harms national security or public interest.
quote: 国家有关部门可以依照有关法律法规对该组织、个人采取必要措施。

summary: No person may provide data, technology, tools, advertising, services or payment support to another knowing that the other is violating the Measures' content or order rules.
quote: 任何组织和个人不得为其提供数据、技术、程序、工具、软件、广告、服务、支付结算等方面的支持、协助或者其他帮助
conditional_on: where the person knows of the violation

summary: Providers must establish a rumour-refutation mechanism; on detecting false information they must take refutation measures, preserve records and report to cyberspace and other authorities.
quote: 应当建立健全辟谣机制，发现制作、复制、发布、传播虚假信息的，应当及时采取辟谣措施

summary: Providers must promptly report suspected crimes to public security authorities.
quote: 发现涉嫌犯罪的，应当及时向公安机关报案。
conditional_on: where suspected crime is found

summary: Providers shall not infringe other providers' lawful rights, such as interfering with their services, blocking them without reason, or inducing users to visit their own services.
quote: 互联网信息服务提供者不得实施下列侵犯其他互联网信息服务提供者合法权益的行为

summary: Providers must truthfully and comprehensively inform users of service information and charging standards.
quote: 应当真实、全面地向用户告知服务信息和收费标准

summary: Providers shall not add, order or change services for users without authorisation, or provide services through misleading, deceptive or bundling practices.
quote: 不得擅自为用户添加、订购、变更相关服务，或者以误导、欺骗、捆绑服务等方式向用户提供服务。

summary: Providers must strengthen service quality management and conduct service quality monitoring and evaluation.
quote: 应当加强服务质量管理，开展服务质量监测和评价。

summary: Providers must establish public complaint, reporting and user appeal systems, publish the methods, provide human customer service and handle and feed back on complaints.
quote: 应当建立公众投诉、举报和用户申诉制度

summary: The state encourages providers to develop minor modes and minor zones suited to minors' development.
quote: 国家鼓励和支持互联网信息服务提供者研发和提供适应未成年人身心健康发展规律和特点的未成年人模式

summary: Providers must perform online protection duties for minors, including technical and management measures against cyberbullying and against excessive dependence or addiction.
quote: 应当依法履行未成年人网络保护义务，采取必要的技术手段和管理措施，防范针对未成年人的网络欺凌行为

summary: Providers must protect the lawful rights of elderly and disabled people and provide age-appropriate, safe and accessible services per national rules.
quote: 应当依法保障老年人、残疾人的合法权益

summary: Providers of internet information services with public opinion attributes or social mobilisation capacity must conduct security assessments per national rules.
quote: 应当按照国家有关规定开展安全评估
conditional_on: where the service has public opinion attributes or social mobilisation capacity

summary: Competent authorities conduct security assessments of such services per national rules.
quote: 有关主管部门按照国家有关规定对具有舆论属性或者社会动员能力的互联网信息服务开展安全评估。

summary: Eligible internet news and publishing media providers implement a special management share system per national rules.
quote: 符合条件的新闻出版传媒领域互联网信息服务提供者按照国家有关规定实行特殊管理股制度
conditional_on: eligible providers in the news publishing and media field

summary: Providers must record and retain published information, user registration information, posting records and other network logs for at least six months; where access resources are shared, address translation logs must also be recorded.
quote: 应当记录并留存其发布的信息、用户注册信息、用户发布信息记录和其他网络日志信息，并保存不少于6个月。

summary: The state encourages providers to prioritise open-source operating systems in application development.
quote: 鼓励互联网信息服务提供者优先采用开源操作系统进行应用程序开发。

summary: Interconnection between providers must not harm third parties' lawful rights and must not publish or disseminate prohibited content.
quote: 不得损害第三方合法权益，不得发布、传播含有法律、行政法规禁止内容的信息。

summary: Platform information service providers must continuously and prominently publish platform rules or links on their homepage or app, with rules expressly requiring users to comply with law.
quote: 应当在网站首页或者应用程序显著位置，持续公示平台规则或者平台规则的链接标识

summary: New or changed platform rules must be publicised and relevant parties' opinions fully sought.
quote: 平台信息服务提供者新增或者变更平台规则的，应当进行公示并充分征求相关主体意见。
conditional_on: where platform rules are added or changed

summary: Competent authorities order platform providers to rectify platform rules that violate law.
quote: 有关主管部门应当在职责范围内责令互联网信息服务提供者作出相应整改。

summary: Platform providers must establish an account credit record system, grade accounts by credit and provide services accordingly.
quote: 应当建立互联网账号信用记录制度，根据互联网账号使用情况合理确定信用等级

summary: Platform providers must periodically report account credit information to cyberspace and other competent authorities.
quote: 并将相关情况定期报告网信等有关主管部门。

summary: For public accounts producing content in licensed or sensitive fields, platforms must require professional background and qualifications, verify them, and label the accounts.
quote: 应当要求互联网用户公众账号生产运营者提供其在上述领域的生产运营相关专业背景情况
conditional_on: accounts applying to produce content in listed fields such as news, finance, education, health, law, military, religion

summary: Platforms must display on public account pages the operator's identity, unified social credit code, contact details, IP location and content distribution organisation.
quote: 应当在互联网用户公众账号页面展示公众账号的运营主体、统一社会信用代码、有效联系方式

summary: Operators of influential public accounts shall not create, copy, publish or disseminate content violating Art. 24 or 25.
quote: 不得制作、复制、发布、传播违反第二十四条和第二十五条第一款、第二款规定的信息
conditional_on: accounts with greater influence

summary: Platforms must take graduated measures against violating influential accounts, such as warnings, suspension, function restriction, closure and bans on re-registration, and report to authorities.
quote: 平台信息服务提供者应当依法依约对账号采取警示整改、暂停更新、限期改正、限制功能
conditional_on: where an influential account violates Art. 45 first paragraph

summary: The cyberspace authority, with press, publication, culture, tourism, broadcasting and public security authorities, is to formulate criteria for identifying influential accounts.
quote: 由国家网信部门会同国家新闻出版和国务院文化和旅游、广播电视、公安等有关主管部门制定

summary: Platforms must file the names, operators and distribution organisations of influential public accounts per national rules.
quote: 平台信息服务提供者应当将具有较大影响力的互联网用户公众账号的名称、生产运营者、所属互联网信息内容多渠道分发服务机构等信息，按照国家有关规定进行备案。

summary: Live streaming platform providers must file with the provincial cyberspace authority within 30 days of starting service.
applies_from: 30 days from the date service is provided
quote: 互联网直播平台服务提供者应当自提供服务之日起30日内向所在地省级网信部门备案

summary: Platforms must build cyberviolence feature and sample libraries and identify and monitor cyberviolence using technology and human review, with early-warning models.
quote: 应当建立健全网络暴力信息特征库和典型案例样本库

summary: Where cyberviolence risk is found and related views, comments or reports rise markedly, platforms must report to competent authorities.
quote: 还应当及时向有关主管部门报告
conditional_on: where views, comments or reports of relevant content rise significantly

summary: Platforms must offer user protection options such as blocking specific persons, banning reposts or comments, refusing all private messages, and rapid evidence collection.
quote: 应当支持用户加强网络暴力信息防护

summary: Platforms must periodically self-assess their compliance with internet information service management duties and laws.
quote: 平台信息服务提供者还应当定期对其履行互联网信息服务管理义务和遵守法律、行政法规的情况进行自评估。

summary: Platforms shall not disrupt internet information service order or evade supervision, contrary to Art. 26.
quote: 不得违反本办法第二十六条第一款的规定，实施扰乱互联网信息服务秩序或者规避监督管理的行为

summary: Platforms shall not abuse their influence, platform rules, user agreements or the pretext of legal duties to disrupt order or evade supervision.
quote: 平台信息服务提供者不得滥用自身影响力、平台规则、用户协议等或者以履行法定义务为由，扰乱互联网信息服务秩序或者规避监督管理。

summary: Live streaming platforms must establish dynamic real-identity verification for broadcast accounts and classified management by content category and user scale.
quote: 应当建立互联网直播发布账号真实身份信息动态核验机制

summary: Live streaming platforms must strengthen real-time management of interactive segments such as comments and barrage.
quote: 并加强对评论、弹幕等直播互动环节的实时管理

summary: App distribution platforms must file per national rules and provide app distribution services.
quote: 应用程序分发平台服务提供者应当按照法律、行政法规和国家有关规定进行备案，并提供应用程序分发服务。

summary: App distribution platforms must increase display and push efforts for apps that disseminate the content in Art. 23 and maintain network order.
quote: 应当加强对平台应用程序管理，对积极传播本办法第二十三条相关内容、自觉维护网络秩序的应用程序加大展示、推送力度

summary: App distribution platforms must register and verify app qualifications, main functions and developer information, patrol apps dynamically, and stop distribution of apps with serious violations.
quote: 应当登记并核验应用程序的资质情况、主要功能及开发者基本信息等

summary: App distribution platforms and app providers shall not induce downloads through false promotion, bundling, rank or traffic manipulation, or prohibited content.
quote: 不得通过虚假宣传、捆绑下载、刷榜、刷量、刷单、控评

summary: Multi-channel content distribution organisations must register as business entities, appoint a content management head, have a content review team and publish content management rules.
quote: 互联网信息内容多渠道分发服务机构应当依法办理经营主体登记，设立内容管理负责人

summary: Platforms must verify multi-channel distribution organisations before admission and file them per national rules.
quote: 平台信息服务提供者应当加强互联网信息内容多渠道分发服务机构入驻管理，按照法律、行政法规和国家有关规定对互联网信息内容多渠道分发服务机构进行核验

summary: Distribution organisations must set out content management responsibilities in service agreements and perform information security management duties.
quote: 应当在服务协议中明确互联网信息内容管理责任，并依法依约履行信息安全管理义务

summary: Distribution organisations shall not directly, or by organising, inciting, entrusting or assisting contracted accounts, engage in violations of the Measures or other laws.
quote: 互联网信息内容多渠道分发服务机构不得直接或者组织、煽动、教唆、委托、协助签约互联网用户公众账号实施违反本办法及其他法律、行政法规规定的行为

summary: Distribution organisations must take warnings, rectification orders, suspension of revenue rights, contract termination or platform notification against violating accounts.
quote: 应当依法依约对违法违规账号采取警示提醒、限期改正、暂停营利权限、解除协议、通报平台等措施

summary: Platforms must take graduated measures against violating distribution organisations and accounts, including restricting services, removal from the platform and blacklisting, and report to authorities.
quote: 平台信息服务提供者应当依法依约采取警示提醒、限期改正、暂停营利权限、限制提供服务、入驻清退、纳入黑名单等处置措施，并按照国家有关规定向有关主管部门报告

summary: Large platforms must establish a compliance management system and risk control measures, a dedicated compliance department and officer, conduct regular security assessments and publish their operating status.
quote: 建立互联网信息服务合规管理体系和风险防控措施
conditional_on: large internet platform as defined in Art. 90(10)

summary: Large platforms must publish special platform rules protecting merchants, workers and remedies, and publish social responsibility reports and operating status of security, personal information and minors' protection.
quote: 制定并公开专门的平台规则
conditional_on: large internet platform as defined in Art. 90(10)

summary: Large platforms must handle complaints, reports and appeals about illegal or undesirable content within 24 hours.
quote: 在24小时内及时处理含有法律、行政法规禁止内容的信息和不良信息相关投诉、举报和申诉
conditional_on: large internet platform as defined in Art. 90(10)

summary: Large platforms must report to the local cyberspace authority changes in main business, main shareholders or actual controllers and major emergencies.
quote: 及时向属地网信部门报告主要业务、主要股东、实际控制人变动以及重大突发情况等
conditional_on: large internet platform as defined in Art. 90(10)

summary: Large platforms shall not use data, algorithms, technology, platform rules or user agreements to harm the lawful rights of other operators or consumers.
quote: 不得利用数据、算法、技术以及平台规则、技术手段、用户协议等，损害其他经营者、消费者等主体的合法权益
conditional_on: large internet platform as defined in Art. 90(10)

summary: Smart information service providers must publicly disclose the basic principles, purpose, main operating mechanisms and training data sources of the technology, following fair, transparent and honest principles.
quote: 按照国家有关规定公示公开其相关技术的基本原理、目的意义、主要运行机制、训练数据来源等信息

summary: Smart information providers of services with public opinion attributes or social mobilisation capacity must conduct security assessments per national rules.
quote: 应当按照国家有关规定开展安全评估，并履行算法备案和变更、注销备案手续
conditional_on: where the service has public opinion attributes or social mobilisation capacity

summary: Smart information providers of such services must file, change and cancel algorithm filings.
quote: 履行算法备案和变更、注销备案手续
conditional_on: where the service has public opinion attributes or social mobilisation capacity

summary: Telecom and cyberspace authorities organise compatibility tests of app services with smart terminals.
quote: 电信、网信部门依据职责组织对其与智能终端的适配性进行测试
conditional_on: app services calling smart terminal system permissions

summary: Providers must use lawfully sourced data and base models, improve training data quality and not infringe others' intellectual property; corpus training must meet law and core values, and news corpora must come from designated units.
quote: 应当使用具有合法来源的数据和基础模型，采取有效措施提高训练数据质量，不得侵害他人依法享有的知识产权

summary: Generative and synthetic service providers must manage generated and synthetic content through technical and human measures.
quote: 应当采取技术、人工等方式，加强对生成合成信息内容的管理

summary: Providers of generative synthesis services must label AI-generated and synthetic content per laws, regulations and mandatory national standards.
quote: 应当按照法律、行政法规以及国家有关规定、强制性国家标准对人工智能生成合成内容进行标识
conditional_on: providers offering generative synthesis services

summary: No person or organisation may maliciously delete, alter, forge or conceal generated content labels.
quote: 任何组织和个人不得恶意删除、篡改、伪造、隐匿生成合成内容标识

summary: Algorithmic recommendation providers must establish human intervention and user choice mechanisms, offer non-personalised options or easy refusal, and must not force users to use smart information services.
quote: 应当按照国家有关规定建立完善人工干预和用户自主选择机制
conditional_on: providers of algorithmic recommendation services

summary: Algorithmic recommendation providers must formulate flow rules and algorithm standards with positive value guidance, file them with authorities and publicise them.
quote: 应当制定具有积极价值引导功能的流量规则和算法标准，按照国家有关规定向有关部门备案并公示相关信息
conditional_on: providers of algorithmic recommendation services

summary: Algorithmic recommendation providers must not use algorithms to block information, over-recommend, manipulate rankings or hot lists, or recommend prohibited content.
quote: 不得利用算法屏蔽信息、过度推荐、操纵榜单或者检索结果排序
conditional_on: providers of algorithmic recommendation services

summary: Providers offering work scheduling services to workers must obtain worker-related data only on lawful, legitimate and necessary grounds.
quote: 应当遵循合法、正当和必要的原则获取劳动者相关数据
conditional_on: where providing work scheduling or similar services to workers

summary: Providers must keep order allocation, pay and working hour algorithms transparent, fair and reasonable, and protect workers' equal employment, pay and rest rights.
quote: 确保订单分配、报酬支付、工作时间等算法透明、公平、合理
conditional_on: where providing work scheduling or similar services to workers

summary: Before adding or changing main algorithm rules, providers must consult workers publicly, assess the impact on their rights, and publish the rules prominently before implementation.
applies_from: before implementation of the new or changed rules
quote: 智能信息服务提供者新增或者变更主要算法规则，应当向劳动者公开征求意见
conditional_on: where providing work scheduling or similar services to workers

summary: Agent service providers must use agents that meet national rules and establish security management systems and technical controls; agent distribution providers must establish agent security management systems.
quote: 应当使用符合国家规定的智能体，建立安全管理制度及相应技术管控能力
conditional_on: providers offering agent services or agent distribution services

summary: Agent service and distribution providers must not use agents for activities endangering national security, public interest or violating laws.
quote: 不得利用智能体从事危害国家安全、损害社会公共利益和其他违反法律、行政法规的活动
conditional_on: providers offering agent services or agent distribution services

summary: On discovering major safety risks or prohibited generated content, providers must immediately stop generation or transmission, delete, suspend services or close functions.
quote: 应当立即采取停止生成、停止传输、消除、暂停服务、关闭相关功能等处置措施
conditional_on: where a major safety risk or listed prohibited content is found

summary: Providers must rectify through model optimisation training and similar measures and report to cyberspace and other competent authorities.
quote: 并向网信等有关主管部门报告
conditional_on: where a major safety risk or listed prohibited content is found

summary: Cyberspace, telecom and public security authorities supervise and inspect internet information services within their remits and take action against violations.
quote: 网信、电信、公安等主管部门应当依据各自职责，对互联网信息服务进行监督检查，及时查处违反本办法规定的行为

summary: Internet information service providers and access providers must cooperate with inspections and must not refuse or obstruct them.
quote: 应当予以配合，不得拒绝、阻挠

summary: Competent authorities must coordinate, share information, establish joint enforcement and transfer criminal cases to judicial organs.
quote: 应当加强协同配合、信息沟通，建立监督管理信息共享、信息通报和案件移送制度

summary: The telecom authority must notify access and domain resolution providers to stop servicing an operator whose telecom permit or code has been revoked or cancelled.
quote: 由电信主管部门通知相关互联网接入服务提供者和域名解析服务提供者停止为其提供服务
conditional_on: where a telecom permit or approval number is revoked or cancelled

summary: Competent authorities must handle reports and complaints lawfully and promptly, and forward matters outside their remit.
quote: 应当及时依法作出处理；不属于本部门职责的，应当及时告知举报者、控告者或者移送有关主管部门处理

summary: When supervising platform providers, authorities must focus on listed matters including complaint handling, disposal of illegal accounts, and platform rules.
quote: 有关主管部门开展对平台信息服务提供者的监督检查的，应当重点监督检查以下事项

summary: Where authorities identify major safety risks or incidents, providers must take required measures to rectify and remove hidden dangers.
quote: 互联网信息服务提供者应当按照要求采取措施，进行整改，消除隐患。
conditional_on: where major safety risks or incidents occur

summary: In supervision and inspection, authorities may question parties, copy logs, conduct on-site inspections and seal or seize equipment.
quote: 在依照本办法实施监督检查过程中，可以依法采取下列措施

summary: Authorities and their staff must keep confidential state, work, commercial secrets, privacy and personal information acquired in supervision, use it only for supervision and enforcement, and not disclose or sell it.
quote: 应当予以保密，只能用于相关监督管理和执法工作的需要，不得泄露、篡改或者非法毁损

summary: Access, internet information, domain registration and resolution providers must support cyberspace and telecom authorities and provide technical support to public security and national security bodies.
quote: 应当为网信部门、电信主管部门依法履行互联网信息服务监督管理职责提供必要的支持和协助

summary: With State Council approval, cyberspace, telecom and public security authorities may impose temporary control measures, such as restrictions, on applications or functions with public opinion attributes.
quote: 可以在特定时间或者特定区域内，对具有舆论属性或者社会动员能力的网络应用或者其功能采取限制等临时管控措施
conditional_on: with State Council approval, for serious network security incidents

summary: Foreign-invested enterprises providing internet information services must meet foreign investment law requirements.
quote: 外商投资企业从事互联网信息服务的，还应当符合外商投资相关法律、行政法规和国家有关规定的相关要求
conditional_on: foreign-invested enterprises

summary: Foreign organisations and individuals providing or using internet information services in China must comply with laws, regulations and national rules.
quote: 境外的组织、个人向中华人民共和国境内提供互联网信息服务，或者使用中华人民共和国境内的互联网信息服务的，应当遵守法律、行政法规和国家有关规定
conditional_on: foreign organisations and individuals providing or using such services in China

summary: Services touching network operation security, data security, personal information protection, unfair competition, consumer rights, news and media management must also comply with the relevant laws; services involving state secrets must also comply with secrecy laws.
quote: 还应当遵守有关法律、行政法规的规定

summary: Designation as a large personal information handler is assessed on combined conditions: handling personal information of 10 million or more natural persons; providing important online services involving personal information handling, or multi-business operations involving such handling; and handling with important impact on national security, economic operation, social stability, public health and safety.
quote: 对大型个人信息处理者的认定，应当综合考虑下列条件

summary: Handlers meeting the 10 million threshold, or self-assessed as meeting the second or third condition, must declare large-handler designation through the provincial network department to the national network department, with required materials.
quote: 应当通过所在地省级网信部门向国家网信部门申报大型个人信息处理者认定
conditional_on: Handling personal information of 10 million or more natural persons, or self-assessment meeting Art. 2 para. 2 items 2 or 3

summary: Provincial network departments must complete completeness checks within 15 working days of receiving declaration materials, forwarding complete files with a preliminary opinion or returning incomplete files with a one-time list of missing items.
applies_from: 15 working days from receipt of declaration materials
quote: 省级网信部门应当自收到申报材料之日起15个工作日内完成完备性查验

summary: Network, telecommunications, public security and other personal information protection authorities must urge unlisted handlers that meet the criteria to declare designation.
quote: 应当督促其申报认定
conditional_on: Authorities find a handler meets the criteria but has not declared

summary: The national network department, with telecommunications and public security departments, determines and publishes the list of large personal information handlers.
quote: 国家网信部门会同国务院电信主管部门、公安部门等履行个人信息保护职责的部门依据认定条件，研究确定大型个人信息处理者清单，并向社会公告

summary: A designated handler that believes it has not met the criteria for 6 consecutive months may apply through the provincial network department to change its designation.
quote: 可以通过所在地省级网信部门向国家网信部门提出变更认定申请
conditional_on: Handler has not met the criteria for 6 consecutive months

summary: Network, telecommunications, public security and other personal information protection authorities must share information on large handlers and coordinate their work.
quote: 网信部门、电信主管部门、公安机关等履行个人信息保护职责的部门应当加强大型个人信息处理者有关信息的共享和工作协同

summary: Large handlers must adopt encryption, de-identification, access control and anonymization measures to protect processed personal information; use of the national online identity authentication service, data labelling and personal information protection certification are permitted or encouraged.
quote: 应当采取加密、去标识化、访问控制、匿名化等措施保障所处理个人信息安全

summary: Large handlers are encouraged to innovate in personal information protection technologies, products and services, and to take part in international standard-setting and mutual recognition of rules.
quote: 鼓励大型个人信息处理者开展个人信息保护相关技术、产品、服务创新

summary: The national network department may list overseas organizations or individuals that infringe citizens' personal information rights or endanger national security or public interest on a restricted or prohibited provision list and take restriction or prohibition measures.
quote: 国家网信部门可以将其列入限制或者禁止个人信息提供清单，予以公告
conditional_on: Overseas organization or individual engages in infringing or endangering personal information processing

summary: Large handlers must process personal information following the principles of lawfulness, propriety, necessity and good faith, comply with laws and administrative regulations, and respect social morality and ethics.
quote: 应当遵循合法、正当、必要和诚信原则

summary: Large handlers must apply the principle of minimum necessity when collecting personal information, limited to what is necessary to provide products or services, and must not over-collect personal information.
quote: 收集个人信息，应当坚持最小必要原则

summary: Large handlers must publish personal information processing rules in clear language, itemising the listed matters (identity and contact of the handler and protection officer, per-function purposes and methods, embedded SDKs, recipients, retention, rights exercise channels and other legally required items); changes must be notified to individuals.
quote: 制定公开个人信息处理规则，应当通过清晰易懂的语言，真实、准确、完整、逐项列明下列事项

summary: Where processing relies on consent, large handlers must obtain separate consent for disclosure to other handlers, cross-border provision, public disclosure, processing of sensitive personal information, and other cases set by law or regulation, using the least intrusive method.
quote: 有下列情形之一的，应当取得个人的单独同意
conditional_on: Processing based on individual consent in one of the listed situations

summary: For personal information of minors under 14, large handlers must obtain consent from parents or other guardians and provide a convenient channel for guardians to consent and withdraw consent.
quote: 应当取得未成年人的父母或者其他监护人的同意
conditional_on: Processing personal information of minors under 14

summary: Where the purpose, method or categories of consent-based processing change, large handlers must obtain fresh consent.
quote: 应当重新取得个人同意
conditional_on: Purpose, method or categories of consent-based processing change

summary: For consent-based processing, large handlers must offer a convenient way to withdraw consent and a structured list of consented categories, purposes and methods.
quote: 应当提供便捷的撤回同意的方式
conditional_on: Processing based on individual consent

summary: Large handlers must store personal information collected and generated during operations within the People's Republic of China domestically.
quote: 应当将在中华人民共和国境内运营中收集和产生的个人信息存储在境内

summary: Large handlers must select data centres for domestic storage that are located in China, whose legal representative or actual controller is a Chinese national, and that meet national policy and standard requirements.
quote: 应当选择符合下列条件的数据中心，存储在中华人民共和国境内运营中收集和产生的个人信息

summary: Data centre management institutions must establish internal management systems and operating procedures and assist the handler in fulfilling protection duties, including an emergency plan for personal information security incidents.
quote: 应当建立健全内部管理制度和操作规程，协助大型个人信息处理者履行个人信息保护义务

summary: On a personal information security incident, data centre management institutions must immediately notify the handler, activate the emergency plan, and report to the designated authorities; they must also remediate security defects and follow authority requirements.
quote: 应当立即通报大型个人信息处理者
conditional_on: Personal information security incident occurs

summary: When entrusting personal information processing to a third-party data centre management institution, the handler must sign a written contract covering purpose, term, method, storage location, scale, categories, safeguards and rights and duties, and require compliance with Art. 14 and 15; the entrusted party must assist security management.
quote: 应当与其签订书面合同
conditional_on: Entrusting personal information processing to a third-party data centre management institution

summary: For personalised push or marketing by automated decision-making, large handlers must provide an easy-to-use option to turn off personalised recommendations, stop using data for them after opt-out, and offer deletion of user profile tags.
quote: 设置易于理解、便于访问和操作的个性化推荐关闭选项
conditional_on: Personal information is pushed or used for marketing through automated decision-making

summary: Where aggregation or fusion yields information that falls under PIPL Art. 28 sensitive personal information, the handler must identify and protect it as sensitive personal information.
quote: 应当按照敏感个人信息进行识别与保护
conditional_on: Processed personal information meets PIPL Art. 28 sensitive criteria after aggregation or fusion

summary: For qualifying portability requests, large handlers must transfer personal information in a common or machine-readable format within 30 working days after identity and request verification, notify the result, and explain if no transfer route exists; the period may be extended by up to 30 working days with reasons given.
applies_from: 30 working days after completing identity and request verification
quote: 应当自完成个人身份验证和请求验证后30个工作日内采取通用或者机器可读的格式转移个人信息
conditional_on: Portability request meeting Regulations on Network Data Security Management Art. 25

summary: Portability transfers must use identity verification and encrypted transmission, and handlers should support application programming interfaces or other standardized transfer routes.
quote: 应当采取身份验证、加密传输等安全措施保障个人信息转移安全
conditional_on: Personal information portability

summary: Where cross-border provision is needed, large handlers must apply for data export security assessment, conclude a personal information export standard contract, or obtain protection certification as national rules provide, and strengthen related technical and management measures.
quote: 应当按照国家有关规定申报数据出境安全评估、订立个人信息出境标准合同或者通过个人信息保护认证等
conditional_on: Business needs require providing personal information outside China

summary: Large handlers must assess the management and technical measures of overseas recipients and must suspend provision of personal information to a recipient that cannot fulfil its protection duties.
quote: 应当对境外接收方的管理和技术措施进行评估
conditional_on: Cross-border provision of personal information

summary: When providing personal information to another handler, large handlers must first apply de-identification or aggregated statistics where possible.
quote: 应当优先采取去标识化、聚合统计等措施
conditional_on: Providing personal information to another personal information handler

summary: When providing personal information to another handler, large handlers must notify individuals of the recipient's name, contact, purpose, method and categories of information.
quote: 向个人告知接收方的名称或者姓名、联系方式、处理目的、处理方式和个人信息的种类
conditional_on: Providing personal information to another personal information handler

summary: Large handlers must monitor and record outbound personal information transfers under the Cybersecurity Law Art. 23 and keep the related logs for at least six months.
quote: 留存相关日志不少于六个月
conditional_on: Providing personal information to another personal information handler

summary: Where a recipient changes the original processing purpose or method, the recipient must obtain fresh individual consent; the recipient processes only within the notified scope.
quote: 接收方变更原先的处理目的、处理方式的，应当重新取得个人同意
conditional_on: Recipient changes original processing purpose or method

summary: Large handlers must not disclose personal information they process, except with separate individual consent; public disclosure must be limited to the minimum needed and use de-identification.
quote: 不得公开其处理的个人信息，取得个人单独同意的除外
conditional_on: Public disclosure of processed personal information

summary: Before publicly disclosing personal information, large handlers must conduct a personal information protection impact assessment.
quote: 公开个人信息前，应当开展个人信息保护影响评估
conditional_on: Before public disclosure of personal information

summary: Large handlers must provide a convenient way for individuals to refuse processing of personal information they have already made public; processing of such information with major rights impact also requires consent under law.
quote: 应当为个人拒绝处理其已公开个人信息提供便捷途径
conditional_on: Processing of personal information already made public

summary: Retention must be limited to the shortest period needed for products or services; large handlers must actively delete personal information when the purpose is achieved or no longer necessary, the service ends or retention expires, consent is withdrawn, or processing violates law or agreement; if retention is required by law or deletion is technically impossible, processing is limited to storage and security protection.
quote: 处理个人信息的保存期限应当限于提供产品或者服务所必需的最短时限
conditional_on: Purpose achieved, service ended, consent withdrawn, unlawful processing or other listed circumstances

summary: On an individual's deletion request, large handlers must delete promptly, or if deletion is not possible for good reason, reply within 15 working days.
quote: 个人请求删除个人信息的，大型个人信息处理者应当及时删除
conditional_on: Individual requests deletion of personal information

summary: Large handlers must establish internal management systems and operating procedures across processing, rights response and security duties, with monitoring, early warning and incident handling; the minimum content covers classification management, storage and access controls, impact assessment and compliance audit, minors' protection, complaints handling, and training.
quote: 应当围绕个人信息处理活动、个人行使权利响应、安全义务履行等环节，建立健全内部管理制度和操作规程

summary: Large handlers must designate a management-level member as personal information protection officer and publish the officer's contact details.
quote: 应当按照法律、行政法规的规定指定一名管理层成员担任个人信息保护负责人，并公开个人信息保护负责人的联系方式

summary: The protection officer must organise internal rules, participate in decisions with security risk, supervise processing, organise remedial measures and reports, prepare special rules for under-14 minors, and report regularly to the supervisory committee; the handler must support the officer in performing these duties.
quote: 个人信息保护负责人应当履行下列职责

summary: When a personal information leak, tampering or loss occurs, or a major violation risks large-scale rights harm, the protection officer must immediately organise remediation and report to the provincial network, telecommunications and public security authorities; suspected crimes are reported to public security and possible national security risks to state security organs.
quote: 应当立即组织采取补救措施，并向所在地省级网信部门和电信主管部门、公安机关等履行个人信息保护职责的部门报告
conditional_on: Security incident or major violation that may cause large-scale rights harm occurs or may occur

summary: Large handlers must designate personnel in business departments with personal information compliance audit capability to handle protection work, with staffing proportionate to business scale and protection duties, under the officer's guidance.
quote: 应当明确业务部门具备个人信息保护合规审计能力的人员负责个人信息保护工作

summary: Staff operating permissions must be granted on the principle of least authorization needed for business functions.
quote: 应当以实现业务功能所需的最小授权为原则，为工作人员配置个人信息处理的操作权限

summary: Operation records and permission approval records must be kept for at least six months; records of protection impact assessment reports and processing status must be kept for at least three years.
quote: 个人信息处理操作记录、权限审批记录等至少保存六个月

summary: Large handlers providing network platform services must set out rules, permissions and protection duties for in-platform product or service providers and urge them to establish internal protection systems.
quote: 应当明确平台内产品或者服务提供者处理个人信息的规范、权限和保护个人信息的义务
conditional_on: Large handler provides network platform services

summary: When an in-platform provider seriously violates law in processing personal information, the platform handler must immediately take measures such as suspending service and report to the provincial-level or higher network authority.
quote: 应当立即采取停止提供服务等处置措施，并向省级以上网信部门等履行个人信息保护职责的部门报告
conditional_on: Handler discovers an in-platform provider seriously violating law in personal information processing

summary: Large handlers must prepare each year and publish in the first half of the year a social responsibility report on personal information protection for the prior year, covering the listed matters.
quote: 应当每年编制并于上半年发布上一年度个人信息保护社会责任报告

summary: Before launching products or services or functions involving automated decision-making or sensitive personal information that may have major rights impact, large handlers must conduct a protection impact assessment and file the report with the national network department through the provincial department within 15 working days after completion.
applies_from: Before launch; filing within 15 working days after assessment completion
quote: 应当事前开展个人信息保护影响评估，并在评估完成后的15个工作日内通过所在地省级网信部门将影响评估报告报国家网信部门备案
conditional_on: Launch of products, services or functions involving automated decision-making or sensitive personal information processing with major rights impact

summary: Large handlers must strictly protect minors' personal information, identify minors through the national online identity authentication service, and designate dedicated, specially trained personnel for minors' protection.
quote: 应当严格保护未成年人个人信息，通过国家网络身份认证公共服务等方式识别未成年人

summary: Large handlers must carry out an annual compliance audit of minors' personal information protection under the Minors Network Protection Regulations.
quote: 每年开展未成年人个人信息保护合规审计

summary: Large handlers must conduct a personal information protection compliance audit at least once every two years; public display of audit and risk assessment results is encouraged and identified problems must be rectified.
quote: 应当每两年至少开展一次个人信息保护合规审计

summary: Large handlers must carry out a personal information processing risk assessment every year.
quote: 每年对其个人信息处理活动开展风险评估

summary: When entrusting audits or risk assessments to a third-party professional institution, the handler must cooperate and provide necessary access to network data facilities, systems and operation logs.
quote: 应当配合第三方专业机构履行职责，为第三方专业机构开展工作提供必要保障
conditional_on: Entrusting audit or risk assessment to a third-party professional institution

summary: A third-party professional institution performing audits or risk assessments for a large handler must be registered within China.
quote: 应当注册在中华人民共和国境内
conditional_on: Engaged by a large handler for audits or risk assessments

summary: A third-party institution that finds a large security risk in the handler's processing must promptly notify the handler and propose rectification.
quote: 应当及时通报大型个人信息处理者并提出整改建议
conditional_on: Finds a larger security risk in the handler's processing

summary: Large handlers must establish convenient complaint and reporting channels, state them in processing rules, and handle complaints within a committed period not exceeding 15 working days.
quote: 应当建立便捷的个人信息投诉、举报渠道

summary: Within 30 working days of designation, large handlers must report to the municipal network department the protection officer's details, measures ensuring the officer's duties, and data centre information including any entrusted contracts.
quote: 应当自被认定之日起30个工作日内向所在地设区的市级网信部门报送下列信息

summary: Changes in protection officer or data centre basic information must be reported within 30 working days of the change.
quote: 应当自变化之日起30个工作日内报送变更信息
conditional_on: Basic information of protection officer or data centres changes

summary: Within 6 months of designation, large handlers must set up a personal information protection supervisory committee mainly of external members, with an odd number of at least 7 members, at least two-thirds external, and an external head; they must also adopt work rules per the annex.
quote: 应当自被认定之日起6个月内成立主要由外部成员组成的个人信息保护监督委员会

summary: Large handlers must submit to the national network department, through the provincial department, the committee's establishment, work rules and member list.
quote: 通过所在地省级网信部门向国家网信部门报送监督委员会成立情况、工作规则、成员名单等基本信息

summary: External committee members must meet listed conditions, including independence, serving no more than 3 handlers, at least 3 years of protection experience, good reputation, and no adverse records.
quote: 外部成员应当符合下列条件

summary: Large handlers engaging external members must conduct a security background check, and may request public security assistance.
quote: 应当对外部成员进行安全背景审查
conditional_on: Engaging external members

summary: External members must maintain independence in their identity and duties; persons related to the handler, major shareholders or senior shareholders in the past year are excluded.
quote: 外部成员应当保持身份和履行职责的独立性

summary: External members must self-check independence annually and report to the board or its authorised body, which must assess each serving member annually, issue a special opinion and disclose it in the social responsibility report.
quote: 应当每年对在任外部成员独立性情况进行评估并出具专项意见

summary: Large handlers must set out external members' allowances in the committee's work rules; allowance standards are approved by the board or its authorised body.
quote: 大型个人信息处理者应当通过监督委员会工作规则明确外部成员津贴

summary: The supervisory committee must focus its oversight on the handler's compliance system, processing rules, sensitive and minors' data, impact and compliance assessments, incidents, cross-border compliance, automated decision-making, rights requests and complaints, officer performance and the social responsibility report.
quote: 监督委员会重点对大型个人信息处理者下列事项进行监督

summary: The national network department and other personal information protection authorities may supervise the establishment and operation of the supervisory committee.
quote: 依法对大型个人信息处理者设立、运行监督委员会的活动进行监督管理

summary: Large handlers must cooperate with authorities' supervision of the committee, including providing explanations and materials on its establishment and operation.
quote: 大型个人信息处理者应当予以配合
conditional_on: Authority requests explanations or materials on committee establishment or operation

summary: Each year in the first quarter, large handlers must report the committee's prior-year performance through the provincial department; at least every two years they must also report a personal information protection compliance audit report.
quote: 应当于每年第一季度通过所在地省级网信部门向国家网信部门报送监督委员会上一年度履职情况

summary: The national network department must share relevant information on committee reports and audits with the telecommunications and public security departments.
quote: 国家网信部门将相关情况通报国务院电信主管部门、公安部门

summary: Authorities receiving complaints or reports against handlers, committees or members must handle them promptly under law and inform the complainant of the outcome.
quote: 收到投诉、举报的部门应当依法及时处理，并将处理结果告知投诉、举报人
conditional_on: Receipt of a complaint or report

summary: Staff of authorities, committees, third-party professional institutions and data centre management institutions must keep confidential the personal, personal information, trade secret and business information they learn in their work.
quote: 应当对工作中知悉的个人隐私、个人信息、商业秘密、保密商务信息等依法予以保密，不得泄露或者非法向他人提供

summary: Large handlers must implement data classification and grading protection, multi-level cybersecurity protection, and commercial cryptography protection requirements.
quote: 大型个人信息处理者应当落实数据分类分级保护、网络安全等级保护、商用密码保护有关要求

summary: Large handlers that are critical information infrastructure operators must also comply with national rules on critical information infrastructure security.
quote: 还应当遵守国家关于关键信息基础设施安全的有关规定
conditional_on: Large handler is a critical information infrastructure operator

summary: Annex: work rules of the supervisory committee must at least meet the listed requirements, covering independence, composition, term limits, meetings, voting, reporting and the handler's support duties.
quote: 工作规则至少应当符合以下要求
conditional_on: Handler establishes a personal information protection supervisory committee

summary: Annex item 11: the committee must hold a regular meeting at least every 6 months and may hold an extraordinary meeting on proposal of one third or more of its members when evidence of unlawful processing exists.
quote: 监督委员会至少每6个月召开一次定期会议

summary: Annex item 16: in performing its duties the committee must not interfere with the handler's normal operation or obtain information beyond its duties, and must keep learned information confidential.
quote: 不得干预大型个人信息处理者正常运营

summary: Annex item 17: the handler's bodies and personnel must cooperate with the committee's lawful supervision and must not obstruct it, refuse it in bad faith, conceal information or interfere with its independence.
quote: 大型个人信息处理者有关机构、人员应当对监督委员会依法开展的监督予以配合
conditional_on: Committee performs lawful supervision

summary: Annex item 17: each committee member must submit a report on the prior year's performance to the handler's board or its authorised body in the first quarter of each year.
quote: 监督委员会成员应当于每年第一季度向大型个人信息处理者董事会等决策机构或者其授权机构提交上一年度履职情况报告

summary: Network service providers, smart terminal manufacturers and app distribution platform providers must adhere to the principle of the best interests of minors, assess potential impact on minors, set service targets and methods, and provide a minors mode. Encouragement of minors-oriented devices and cooperation (second paragraph) is not coded as an obligation.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 网络服务提供者、智能终端产品制造者、应用程序分发平台服务提供者应当坚持最有利于未成年人的原则

summary: Network service providers may not provide to minors: stranger social networking (except for minors aged 16+ who earn their main living income), virtual intimate relationship services such as virtual relatives or partners, services inducing addiction or harming minors, live-streaming publishing services for minors under 16, and other services specified by law or regulation.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 网络服务提供者不得向未成年人提供下列网络服务：

summary: Network service providers offering online live-streaming (other than audio-video and live-publishing services), online games, social networking or artificial intelligence services that may affect cognition, or other services with major impact, to users under 16 must provide them through the minors mode.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 网络服务提供者向未满十六周岁的未成年人提供下列网络服务的，应当通过未成年人模式提供
conditional_on: Service provided to minors under 16

summary: Network service providers must have the ability to identify minor users, using legal identity documents, national online identity authentication, distributed digital identity authentication, one-time non-stored facial verification, behavioural feature recognition or similar methods, and must take necessary measures to protect minors' personal information.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 网络服务提供者应当具备未成年人用户识别能力

summary: Telecommunications business operators must register the real identity information of minor mobile phone card users, as provided by law.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 电信业务经营者应当依法登记未成年人用户的真实身份信息
conditional_on: Minors without full or limited civil capacity acquiring a phone card

summary: Network service providers must strengthen management of information published by users and, on discovering harmful or potentially harmful online information, take the measures provided by law; in minors mode they must not present harmful information.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 网络服务提供者应当加强对用户发布信息的管理

summary: On discovering that a minor user is in an extreme situation threatening life or health, such as self-harm or suicide, the network service provider must take necessary intervention measures and promptly contact the user's guardian or emergency contact.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 发现未成年人用户存在自残自杀等威胁其生命健康的极端情境的，应当采取必要措施予以干预，并及时联络用户监护人或者紧急联系人
conditional_on: Discovery of an extreme situation threatening a minor user's life or health

summary: Network service providers must fulfil minors online protection duties, establish and improve systems for algorithm mechanism review, technology ethics review, content management, and network and data security, and provide content management technical measures and staff suited to their service type, scale and minor users.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 网络服务提供者应当依法履行未成年人网络保护义务，建立健全算法机制机理审核、科技伦理审查、信息内容管理、网络和数据安全管理等制度

summary: Network service providers may not set up algorithmic models that induce minor users to develop emotional dependence, addiction or excessive consumption.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 不得设置诱导未成年人用户情感依赖、沉迷以及过度消费等的算法模型

summary: For users verified by real-name authentication or identified as minors, network service providers may not provide the services prohibited for minors under Article 4.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 对经实名认证或者识别为未成年人用户的，网络服务提供者不得向其提供本规定第四条规定的网络服务
conditional_on: User verified by real-name authentication or identified as a minor

summary: For verified or identified minor users, network service providers must switch the services listed in Article 5 to the minors mode.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 提供本规定第五条规定的网络服务的，应当按照规定将相关服务切换至未成年人模式
conditional_on: User verified by real-name authentication or identified as a minor

summary: Network service providers must provide an appeal channel, accept and verify user appeals promptly, and promptly lift measures for users found to meet the requirements.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 网络服务提供者应当提供相应申诉渠道

summary: Smart terminal product manufacturers must set up minors mode linkage, one-key switching, exit verification, anti-circumvention, and usage time, duration, function and content management functions in their products.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 智能终端产品制造者应当为智能终端产品设置未成年人模式联动、一键切换、退出核验、防绕过以及使用时段、时长、功能和内容管理等功能

summary: Application distribution platform providers must implement listing review, daily management and emergency handling; scientifically assess the age range of applications, strictly review applications seeking listing or updates in minors mode, and restrict download and installation of applications unsuitable for the applicable age.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 应用程序分发平台服务提供者应当落实上架审核、日常管理、应急处置等安全管理责任

summary: Smart terminal manufacturers and application distribution platform providers must comply with the rules for network service providers in Articles 4 and 5, and set up the minors mode and perform minors online protection duties in line with the regulation, national rules and standards.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 智能终端产品制造者、应用程序分发平台服务提供者应当遵守本规定第四条、第五条对网络服务提供者作出的规定

summary: The minors mode must comply with national rules and standards and have functions to effectively identify harmful online information, protect minors' personal information rights, prevent addiction to the internet, and facilitate guardians' supervision duties.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 未成年人模式应当符合国家有关规定和标准，具备有效识别危害或者可能影响未成年人身心健康的网络信息

summary: The national cyberspace authority, together with relevant State Council departments, must establish and improve technical standards and norms for the minors mode as needed.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 国家网信部门会同国务院有关部门根据未成年人网络保护工作需要，建立健全未成年人模式相关技术标准和规范

summary: The national cyberspace authority establishes a minors mode filing mechanism and conducts annual verification of filed materials. The telecom authority includes mobile terminal minors mode in telecom equipment access testing, and the press and publication authority leads anti-addiction work on online games.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 国家网信部门建立未成年人模式备案机制

summary: Smart terminal manufacturers and network service providers that provide minors mode must file the minors mode settings and functions with the provincial cyberspace authority.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 提供未成年人模式的智能终端产品制造者和网络服务提供者应当将未成年人模式设置及功能情况向省级网信部门备案
conditional_on: Provision of a minors mode

summary: Network platform service providers with very large numbers of minor users, or significant impact on the minor group, must file through the provincial cyberspace authority with the national cyberspace authority and submit a report on minors mode construction and service use.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 应当通过省级网信部门向国家网信部门备案，并提交未成年人模式建设和服务使用情况报告
conditional_on: Very large number of minor users or significant impact on the minor group

summary: Providers of online game services to minors must comply with the Regulation on Protection of Minors Online and the press and publication authority's rules on online game management.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 向未成年人提供网络游戏服务的，应当遵守《未成年人网络保护条例》和国家新闻出版部门关于网络游戏管理的有关规定
conditional_on: Provision of online game services to minors

summary: Education authorities must guide and support schools in cultivating minors' online safety awareness and skills, and regulate management of minors bringing smart terminal products into schools.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 教育部门应当指导、支持学校培育未成年人网络安全意识

summary: Public security organs must stop crimes infringing minors and combat, under law, online violence, dissemination of obscene material and infringement of citizens' personal information involving minors.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 公安机关应当制止侵害未成年人的犯罪行为

summary: Named youth, women's, trade union, disability, and other people's organisations, social organisations and grassroots self-governing bodies must coordinate on education guidance for minors' appropriate internet use, promotion of minors mode, and protection of minors' lawful rights.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 协同做好未成年人合理使用网络教育引导

summary: Schools must strengthen guidance and training for teachers, improve early identification and intervention for students prone to internet addiction, regulate management of minors bringing smart terminal products into school, and guide use of minors mode.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 学校应当加强对教师的指导和培训

summary: Schools must promptly notify the guardians of minor students who show a tendency towards internet addiction, and jointly guide reasonable internet use.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 对于有沉迷网络倾向的未成年学生，学校应当及时告知其监护人
conditional_on: Student shows a tendency towards internet addiction

summary: Guardians of minors must strengthen family education and digital literacy, model and supervise minors' internet use, and assist in enabling and guiding minors' use of the minors mode.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 协助开启并引导未成年人使用未成年人模式

summary: The national cyberspace authority, with relevant State Council departments, may adjust over time the categories of network services listed in Articles 4 and 5 as needed.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 国家网信部门可以会同国务院有关部门根据保障未成年人健康安全使用网络的需要，对本规定第四条、第五条所列网络服务类型适时予以调整
conditional_on: Need to protect minors' safe online use

summary: Network service providers are encouraged to provide network services to minors aged 16 and over through the minors mode.
applies_from: Draft: entry-into-force date left blank (Art. 25); no start date stated
quote: 鼓励通过未成年人模式向十六周岁以上的未成年人提供网络服务

summary: Listed gallium- and germanium-related items may not be exported without a licence (Pt. 1 (一) lists gallium items 1-8 and germanium items 1-6 with reference customs codes).
quote: 未经许可，不得出口

summary: Exporters must complete export licence procedures under the applicable rules, applying through the provincial commerce department to MOFCOM on the dual-use export application form with listed documents (contract, technical description or test report, end-user and end-use certificates, importer and end-user information, identity documents of legal representatives and operators).
quote: 出口经营者应按照相关规定办理出口许可手续，通过省级商务主管部门向商务部提出申请

summary: MOFCOM must review applications within the received-application period, alone or with other departments, and decide within the statutory time limit whether to grant or refuse a licence. For exports with a major impact on national security, MOFCOM, together with other departments, reports to the State Council for approval.
quote: 商务部应当自收到出口申请文件之日起进行审查，或者会同有关部门进行审查，并在法定时限内作出准予或者不予许可的决定

summary: Where a licence is granted, MOFCOM issues the dual-use items and technology export licence certificates (the export licence certificates).
quote: 经审查准予许可的，由商务部颁发两用物项和技术出口许可证件
conditional_on: Licence granted after review under Pt. 3

summary: Licence issuance and signing procedures, special-case handling and document retention periods are governed by the referenced 2005 Order No. 29 (Measures for Licence Administration of Dual-Use Items and Technologies Import and Export); the announcement does not restate these duties.
quote: 依照商务部、海关总署令2005年第29号（《两用物项和技术进出口许可证管理办法》）的相关规定执行

summary: Exporters must present the export licence certificates to customs, complete customs formalities under the Customs Law and accept customs supervision.
quote: 出口经营者应当向海关出具出口许可证件

summary: Customs releases goods on the basis of the export licence certificates issued by MOFCOM.
quote: 海关凭商务部签发的出口许可证件办理验放手续

summary: Prohibits export of dual-use items to US military users or for US military end-uses.
applies_from: 从公布之日起正式实施 (effective from the date of publication, per the final paragraph)
quote: 禁止两用物项对美国军事用户或军事用途出口。

summary: In principle, licences are not to be granted for export to the US of dual-use items related to gallium, germanium, antimony and superhard materials; graphite dual-use items to the US are subject to stricter end-user and end-use review. Single row covering both sub-rules.
applies_from: 从公布之日起正式实施 (effective from the date of publication, per the final paragraph)
quote: 原则上不予许可镓、锗、锑、超硬材料相关两用物项对美国出口；对石墨两用物项对美国出口，实施更严格的最终用户和最终用途审查。

summary: Exporters must apply to the State Council commerce department for a licence before exporting the listed controlled items (samarium, gadolinium, terbium, dysprosium, lutetium, scandium and yttrium items under 1C902-1C908). The export controls are imposed under the announcement's operative decision.
applies_from: from the date of publication, 2025-04-04 (the announcement states it takes effect on the date of issue)
provision: Unnumbered closing paragraph after the item list and 说明 notes
quote: 出口经营者出口上述物项应当依照《中华人民共和国出口管制法》《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》的相关规定向国务院商务主管部门申请许可。

summary: Exporters must strengthen identification of controlled items and, when declaring to customs, state in the remarks column whether the goods are controlled items and, if so, list the dual-use export control code.
applies_from: from the date of publication, 2025-04-04 (the announcement states it takes effect on the date of issue)
provision: Unnumbered paragraph after the licensing paragraph
quote: 出口经营者应加强物项识别，报关时应在备注栏中注明是否属于管制物项，属于管制物项的应列明两用物项出口管制编码。

summary: Customs will query declarations where the exporter's declared information is disputed, and goods are not released while the query is pending.
applies_from: from the date of publication, 2025-04-04 (the announcement states it takes effect on the date of issue)
provision: Unnumbered paragraph on customs declaration (after the licensing paragraph)
quote: 海关将依法质疑，质疑期间出口货物不予放行。
conditional_on: where the customs authority has doubts about the declared information

summary: The dual-use items export control list is to be updated at the same time as this announcement.
applies_from: from the date of publication, 2025-04-04 (the announcement states it takes effect on the date of issue)
provision: Final paragraph (effective-date clause, before the signature block)
quote: 《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制清单》同步予以更新。

summary: Foreign specified exporters must obtain a Chinese dual-use export licence before exporting listed items made abroad that contain Chinese-origin Annex 1 Part 1 items at a value share of 0.1% or more (一（一）), or that are produced using listed Chinese-origin technologies (一（二）).
applies_from: 自2025年12月1日起实施 (Art. 八 applies 一（一）and 一（二）from 2025-12-01)
quote: 必须获得中国商务部颁发的两用物项出口许可证件
conditional_on: Items covered by 一（一）or 一（二)

summary: Foreign specified exporters must obtain a Chinese dual-use export licence before exporting Chinese-origin Annex 1 items under 一（三).
applies_from: 自公布之日起实施 (Art. 八; publication date 2025-10-09 per document header)
quote: 原产于中国的本公告附件1所列物项
conditional_on: Chinese-origin items listed in Annex 1

summary: Export licence applications are in principle not to be granted for exports to foreign military end users and to importers and end users on the control and concern lists, including subsidiaries and branches at 50% or more ownership.
applies_from: not stated (Art. 八 gives dates only for 一（一）-（三）)
quote: 对向境外军事用户的出口申请，以及向出口管制管控名单和关注名单所列的进口商和最终用户（包括其控股50%及以上的子公司、分公司等分支机构）的出口申请，原则上不予许可
conditional_on: Applications for exports to foreign military users, or to listed importers and end users

summary: Export licence applications are in principle not to be granted where the end use is or may be for weapons of mass destruction and their delivery vehicles, terrorism, or military use or enhancing military potential.
applies_from: not stated (Art. 八 gives dates only for 一（一）-（三）)
quote: 用于或者可能用于以下最终用途的出口申请，原则上不予许可
conditional_on: End use is or may be one of the listed end uses

summary: Export applications for end uses of R&D, production or use of logic chips at 14nm or below, memory chips at 256 layers or above, related manufacturing equipment, test equipment and materials, or AI with potential military use are to be reviewed case by case.
applies_from: not stated (Art. 八 gives dates only for 一（一）-（三）)
quote: 出口申请，逐案审批
conditional_on: Listed advanced-semiconductor or AI end uses
