summary: Exporters of humanitarian-end-use items that are exempt from licence must report the export to MOFCOM by email within 10 working days after export, and commit that the items will not be used in ways harming China's national security and interests.
applies_from: 不晚于出口后10个工作日 (no later than 10 working days after export)
quote: 应当在不晚于出口后10个工作日通过电子邮件（jingwaibaogao@mofcom.gov.cn）报告中国商务部
conditional_on: Export for emergency medical care, public health emergencies, natural disaster relief or other humanitarian rescue

summary: Applicants for dual-use export licences must submit the required documents under Article 16 of the Dual-Use Export Control Regulations and the MOFCOM licensing system requirements, with Chinese-language documents prevailing; applicants may act directly or through an entrusted Chinese entity or intermediary.
applies_from: not stated (Art. 八 gives dates only for 一（一）-（三）)
quote: 应当按照《中华人民共和国两用物项出口管制条例》第十六条和中国商务部两用物项出口许可审批系统的要求提交有关文件
conditional_on: Application for a dual-use export licence

summary: Domestic exporters of Annex 1 Part 1 dual-use items must state the final destination country or region when declaring the export to customs.
applies_from: not stated (Art. 八 gives dates only for 一（一）-（三）)
quote: 应当在出口报关时按照要求填报最终目的国或者地区
conditional_on: Export of Annex 1 Part 1 items by a domestic exporter

summary: Domestic exporters must issue a Compliance Notice (合规告知书) to foreign importers and end users under the attached guidance; foreign exporters must issue one to the next recipient when transferring or exporting controlled items.
applies_from: not stated (Art. 八 gives dates only for 一（一）-（三）)
quote: 并按照本公告所附合规指引，向境外进口商、最终用户出具《合规告知书》
conditional_on: Export or transfer of items controlled under this announcement

summary: The State classifies and grades network data by importance and by the harm a breach could cause, and protects it accordingly.
quote: 对网络数据实行分类分级保护

summary: No person or organisation may use network data for illegal activities, or steal, illegally sell or illegally provide network data; no one may provide tools dedicated to such activities or knowingly give technical support, hosting, payment or advertising help for them.
quote: 任何个人、组织不得利用网络数据从事非法活动

summary: Network data processors must strengthen data security protection on the basis of multi-level cybersecurity protection, establish management systems, adopt encryption, backup, access control and authentication measures, handle security incidents, and bear primary responsibility for the security of the data they process.
quote: 并对所处理网络数据的安全承担主体责任

summary: Network products and services provided by network data processors must meet the mandatory requirements of relevant national standards.
quote: 网络数据处理者提供的网络产品、服务应当符合相关国家标准的强制性要求

summary: On discovering security defects or vulnerabilities, take immediate remedial measures, notify users as required and report to the competent authority; where national security or public interest is endangered, report within 24 hours.
quote: 应当立即采取补救措施，按照规定及时告知用户并向有关主管部门报告

summary: Maintain an emergency response plan for network data security incidents; on an incident, activate the plan immediately, contain harm, eliminate hidden risks, and report to the competent authorities as required. Where suspected criminal clues arise, report to public security or state security organs and cooperate with investigation.
quote: 并按照规定向有关主管部门报告

summary: Where an incident harms the lawful rights of individuals or organisations, promptly notify interested parties of the incident, risks, consequences and remedial measures, by telephone, SMS, instant messaging, email or public announcement, unless laws or regulations provide otherwise.
quote: 应当及时将安全事件和风险情况、危害后果、已经采取的补救措施等
conditional_on: 网络数据安全事件对个人、组织合法权益造成危害的

summary: When providing or entrusting the processing of personal information or important data to another processor, agree purposes, methods, scope and security duties by contract and supervise the recipient's compliance; where two or more processors jointly decide purposes and means, agree on their respective rights and duties.
quote: 应当通过合同等与网络数据接收方约定处理目的、方式、范围以及安全保护义务
conditional_on: providing or entrusting processing of personal information or important data to another network data processor

summary: Keep records of the provision or entrusted processing of personal information and important data to other processors for at least 3 years.
quote: 处理情况记录，应当至少保存3年
conditional_on: providing or entrusting processing of personal information or important data to another network data processor

summary: The recipient of network data must perform network data security protection duties and process the data only within the agreed purposes, methods and scope.
quote: 网络数据接收方应当履行网络数据安全保护义务

summary: Undergo national security review where network data processing affects or may affect national security.
quote: 应当按照国家有关规定进行国家安全审查
conditional_on: processing that affects or may affect national security

summary: Where network data is transferred due to merger, division, dissolution or bankruptcy, the receiving party must continue to perform the network data security protection duties.
quote: 网络数据接收方应当继续履行网络数据安全保护义务
conditional_on: transfer of network data due to merger, division, dissolution or bankruptcy

summary: State organs entrusting others to build, operate or maintain e-government systems or store and process government data must follow a strict approval procedure, define the entrusted party's processing authority and protection duties, and supervise its compliance.
quote: 明确受托方的网络数据处理权限、保护责任等，监督受托方履行网络数据安全保护义务
conditional_on: entrusting e-government systems or government data processing to others

summary: Processors serving state organs, critical information infrastructure operators, or taking part in public infrastructure or public service systems must perform network data security duties under law and contract and provide secure, stable and continuous services.
quote: 应当依照法律、法规的规定和合同约定履行网络数据安全保护义务
conditional_on: providing services to state organs or critical information infrastructure operators, or participating in public infrastructure or service systems

summary: Without consent of the entrusting party, must not access, obtain, retain, use, disclose or provide network data to others, and must not perform correlation analysis on it.
quote: 未经委托方同意，不得访问、获取、留存、使用、泄露或者向他人提供网络数据
conditional_on: processing network data for state organs or critical information infrastructure operators

summary: Information systems providing services to state organs must strengthen network data security management by reference to the management requirements for e-government systems.
quote: 应当参照电子政务系统的管理要求加强网络数据安全管理
conditional_on: providing services to state organs

summary: Processors using automated tools to access or collect network data must assess the impact on network services.
quote: 应当评估对网络服务带来的影响
conditional_on: using automated tools to access or collect network data

summary: When using automated tools to access or collect network data, must not illegally intrude into others' networks or interfere with the normal operation of network services.
quote: 不得非法侵入他人网络，不得干扰网络服务正常运行
conditional_on: using automated tools to access or collect network data

summary: Providers of generative AI services must strengthen security management of training data and training data processing activities and take effective measures against network data security risks.
quote: 应当加强对训练数据和训练数据处理活动的安全管理
conditional_on: providing generative artificial intelligence services

summary: Processors offering products or services to the public must accept social oversight, set up accessible complaint and reporting channels, publish how to use them, and handle complaints and reports promptly.
quote: 建立便捷的网络数据安全投诉、举报渠道
conditional_on: offering products or services to the public

summary: Personal information processing rules must be displayed centrally, easy to access and prominently placed, and must state clearly and specifically the controller's name and contacts, purposes, methods, categories, retention periods, the methods for exercising data subject rights, and the recipients (listed as a list).
quote: 个人信息处理规则应当集中公开展示、易于访问并置于醒目位置
conditional_on: informing individuals of personal information processing through processing rules

summary: Must formulate specific personal information processing rules for minors under 14 years of age.
quote: 应当制定专门的个人信息处理规则
conditional_on: processing personal information of minors under 14 years of age

summary: When processing on the basis of consent, must not collect personal information beyond what is necessary for the product or service, must not obtain consent by deception, fraud or coercion, must not exceed the consented purposes, methods, types or retention periods, and must not repeatedly seek consent after an individual has clearly refused.
quote: 不得超范围收集个人信息
conditional_on: processing personal information on the basis of individual consent

summary: Obtain separate consent for processing sensitive personal information, including biometric, religious, specific identity, medical health, financial account and whereabouts information.
quote: 应当取得个人的单独同意
conditional_on: processing sensitive personal information

summary: Re-obtain individual consent when the purposes, methods or types of personal information processing change.
quote: 应当重新取得个人同意
conditional_on: change in purposes, methods or types of personal information processing

summary: Obtain the consent of the parents or other guardians before processing personal information of minors under 14 years of age.
quote: 应当取得未成年人的父母或者其他监护人的同意
conditional_on: processing personal information of minors under 14 years of age

summary: Promptly accept requests from individuals to access, copy, correct, supplement, delete or restrict processing of their personal information, to withdraw consent or cancel accounts, and provide convenient means to exercise these rights without unreasonable conditions.
quote: 网络数据处理者应当及时受理，并提供便捷的支持个人行使权利的方法和途径

summary: Delete or anonymise personal information collected unnecessarily or without lawful consent, and upon account cancellation; where deletion or anonymisation is technically impossible, stop processing other than storage and necessary security measures.
quote: 应当删除个人信息或者进行匿名化处理

summary: Where an individual's request for transfer of personal information meets the listed conditions, provide the designated processor with access to and retrieval of the information.
quote: 网络数据处理者应当为个人指定的其他网络数据处理者访问、获取有关个人信息提供途径
conditional_on: transfer request that meets the conditions in Art. 25(1) to (4)

summary: Overseas processors that establish a dedicated body or designate a representative in China must report the name of the body or the representative's name and contact details to the municipal-level CAC office where it is located.
quote: 应当将有关机构的名称或者代表的姓名、联系方式等报送所在地设区的市级网信部门
conditional_on: overseas processing of personal information of natural persons in China, with a dedicated body or representative under the PIPL Art. 53

summary: Periodically carry out compliance audits of personal information processing for compliance with laws and administrative regulations, either internally or through a professional institution.
quote: 应当定期自行或者委托专业机构对其处理个人信息遵守法律、行政法规的情况进行合规审计

summary: Processors handling personal information of more than 10 million persons must also comply with the rules for important data processors in Art. 30 and Art. 32.
quote: 处理1000万人以上个人信息的，还应当遵守本条例第三十条、第三十二条
conditional_on: processing personal information of more than 10 million persons

summary: The national data security coordination mechanism coordinates departments in drafting the catalogue of important data; regional and sectoral authorities determine their own detailed catalogues and protect listed data.
quote: 国家数据安全工作协调机制统筹协调有关部门制定重要数据目录

summary: Identify and declare important data in accordance with national rules.
quote: 网络数据处理者应当按照国家有关规定识别、申报重要数据

summary: The State encourages network data processors to use technical and product tools such as data labelling to improve management of important data.
quote: 国家鼓励网络数据处理者使用数据标签标识等技术和产品

summary: Processors of important data must designate a network data security lead and a network data security management body; the body must implement policies, operating procedures and emergency plans, carry out risk monitoring, assessment, drills and training, and handle complaints; processors of specified categories or scales must run background checks on the lead and key staff.
quote: 应当明确网络数据安全负责人和网络数据安全管理机构
conditional_on: processing important data

summary: Before providing, entrusting or jointly processing important data, conduct a risk assessment covering legality, risks of tampering, leakage or misuse, the recipient's integrity, contract terms and technical and management measures; exempt where performing statutory duties.
quote: 应当进行风险评估，但是属于履行法定职责或者法定义务的除外
conditional_on: providing, entrusting or jointly processing important data

summary: On merger, division, dissolution or bankruptcy that may affect important data security, take protective measures and report the disposal plan and recipient details to the provincial-level or higher competent authority.
quote: 并向省级以上有关主管部门报告重要数据处置方案、接收方的名称或者姓名和联系方式等
conditional_on: merger, division, dissolution or bankruptcy that may affect important data security

summary: Important data processors must assess their network data processing activities annually and submit a risk assessment report to the provincial-level or higher competent authority, covering the items listed in Art. 33(2) to (7).
quote: 应当每年度对其网络数据处理活动开展风险评估，并向省级以上有关主管部门报送风险评估报告
conditional_on: processing important data

summary: Large online platforms processing important data must also explain key business and supply chain network data security in their annual risk assessment report.
quote: 还应当充分说明关键业务和供应链网络数据安全等情况
conditional_on: large online platform processing important data

summary: The CAC coordinates the relevant departments in establishing a special working mechanism for national data export security management.
quote: 国家网信部门统筹协调有关部门建立国家数据出境安全管理专项工作机制

summary: Personal information may be provided abroad only where one of the listed conditions is met: CAC security assessment, professional certification, standard contract, contract performance, HR management under labour rules, legal duties, emergencies, or other conditions set by law or CAC.
quote: 符合下列条件之一的，网络数据处理者可以向境外提供个人信息
conditional_on: provision of personal information abroad under one of the listed conditions

summary: Important data collected and generated in operations within China that must be provided abroad requires a data export security assessment organised by the CAC; processors not informed of or publicly notified as holding important data are not required to declare it for assessment.
quote: 应当通过国家网信部门组织的数据出境安全评估
conditional_on: important data collected and generated in China that must be provided abroad

summary: After passing an export assessment, must not provide personal information or important data abroad beyond the purposes, methods, scope, types and volume stated in the assessment.
quote: 不得超出评估时明确的数据出境目的、方式、范围和种类、规模等
conditional_on: providing personal information or important data abroad after passing an export assessment

summary: The State takes measures to prevent and handle cross-border network data security risks and threats.
quote: 国家采取措施，防范、处置网络数据跨境安全风险和威胁

summary: No person or organisation may provide programs or tools dedicated to destroying or circumventing technical measures, nor technical support or assistance to those who do so.
quote: 任何个人、组织不得提供专门用于破坏、避开技术措施的程序、工具等

summary: Network platform service providers must specify, through platform rules or contracts, the network data security duties of third-party product and service providers that access the platform and urge them to strengthen data security management; producers of smart terminals with pre-installed apps are subject to the same rule.
quote: 应当通过平台规则或者合同等明确接入其平台的第三方产品和服务提供者的网络数据安全保护义务

summary: The State encourages insurers to develop network data damage liability insurance products.
quote: 国家鼓励保险公司开发网络数据损害赔偿责任险种

summary: Application distribution platforms must establish app verification rules and carry out network data security verification; on finding non-compliant apps, take warning, non-distribution, suspension or termination measures.
quote: 应当建立应用程序核验规则并开展网络数据安全相关核验
conditional_on: providing application distribution services

summary: Platforms that push information to individuals through automated decision-making must provide an easy-to-use option to turn off personalised recommendations, refuse push information, and delete user tags based on personal characteristics.
quote: 应当设置易于理解、便于访问和操作的个性化推荐关闭选项
conditional_on: pushing information to individuals through automated decision-making

summary: The State promotes the development of public network identity authentication services, applied on a government-guided, user-voluntary basis.
quote: 国家推进网络身份认证公共服务建设

summary: Network platform service providers are encouraged to support users in using the national network identity authentication service to register and verify real identity information.
quote: 鼓励网络平台服务提供者支持用户使用国家网络身份认证公共服务登记、核验真实身份信息

summary: Large online platforms must publish an annual personal information protection social responsibility report, covering protection measures and outcomes, handling of individual rights requests, and the work of a personal information protection oversight body composed mainly of external members.
quote: 大型网络平台服务提供者应当每年度发布个人信息保护社会责任报告
conditional_on: large online platform (defined in Art. 62(8))

summary: Large online platforms transferring network data abroad must comply with national data cross-border security requirements and strengthen technical and management measures against cross-border risks.
quote: 应当遵守国家数据跨境安全管理要求，健全相关技术和管理措施
conditional_on: large online platform transferring network data abroad

summary: Large online platforms must not use network data, algorithms or platform rules to misleadingly or coercively process user data, unreasonably restrict users' access to or use of their platform data, unreasonably discriminate against users, or engage in other prohibited activities.
quote: 不得利用网络数据、算法以及平台规则等从事下列活动
conditional_on: large online platform

summary: The CAC coordinates network data security supervision; public security and state security organs supervise within their remits; the national data administration performs data security duties in data management; regions and departments are responsible for the data they collect.
quote: 国家网信部门负责统筹协调网络数据安全和相关监督管理工作

summary: Sectoral competent authorities must designate a network data security body for their sector, formulate and implement sector incident response plans, carry out sectoral risk assessments, and supervise and inspect processors' compliance and rectification.
quote: 应当明确本行业、本领域网络数据安全保护工作机构

summary: The CAC coordinates the relevant authorities in timely collecting, analysing, sharing and publishing network data security risk information and handling incidents.
quote: 统筹协调有关主管部门及时汇总、研判、共享、发布网络数据安全风险相关信息

summary: Network data processors must cooperate with competent authorities' lawful network data security inspections, including providing explanations, documents and records, and allowing checks of measures and equipment.
quote: 网络数据处理者应当对有关主管部门依法开展的网络数据安全监督检查予以配合

summary: Competent authorities must conduct network data security inspections objectively and impartially and must not charge fees to the inspected entities.
quote: 应当客观公正，不得向被检查单位收取费用

summary: During inspections, competent authorities must not access or collect business information unrelated to network data security, and must use information obtained only for network data security purposes.
quote: 不得访问、收集与网络数据安全无关的业务信息

summary: Competent authorities must coordinate and exchange information in inspections, set inspection frequency and methods reasonably, avoid unnecessary and duplicate inspections, and coordinate personal information compliance audits, important data risk assessments and export security assessments to avoid duplication.
quote: 应当加强协同配合、信息沟通，合理确定检查频次和检查方式

summary: Competent authorities and their staff must keep confidential personal privacy, personal information, trade secrets and confidential business information learned in their duties, and must not disclose or unlawfully provide them to others.
quote: 应当依法予以保密，不得泄露或者非法向他人提供

summary: New large and very large data centres (3000+ standard racks) should in principle be sited within the Hohhot Horinger data centre cluster; projects not meeting the siting requirement do not receive the support policies.
quote: 新建大型、超大型数据中心（折合标准机架3000架及以上）原则上要布局在和林格尔数据中心集群内
conditional_on: new large or very large data centre (3000 or more standard racks)

summary: The autonomous region implements window guidance (窗口指导) on the siting of large data centres.
quote: 自治区实行窗口指导

summary: Coordinate computing-industry development planning with grid development planning and new-energy planning, and reserve new-energy sites and plan grid construction with appropriate foresight.
quote: 加强算力产业发展规划与电网发展规划、新能源规划的统筹衔接

summary: Data centre electricity users may enjoy the relevant policies (per the strategic emerging industries catalogue) on condition of lawful compliance and a green-electricity share of not less than 80%.
quote: 依法依规享受相关政策，稳定保障低成本电价优势，绿电比例不低于80%
conditional_on: compliance with the Inner Mongolia strategic emerging industries catalogue and lawful compliance

summary: Encourages new-energy generation enterprises to conclude multi-year electricity trading contracts with intelligent computing centres on their own initiative.
quote: 鼓励新能源发电企业与智算中心自主签订多年度电力交易合同

summary: Intelligent computing centre projects with fixed-asset investment of 10 billion yuan or more and computing capacity above 10000P, after completion and commissioning, may be allocated security new-energy quotas (appropriately).
applies_from: after completion and commissioning of the project
quote: 对一次性固定资产投资达到100亿元以上且算力规模超过10000P的智算中心项目
conditional_on: one-time fixed-asset investment of 100 million yuan or more and computing capacity above 10000P

summary: Green retrofit of existing data centres; orderly phase-out of backward data centres with annual average PUE above 1.5; new data centres must keep PUE strictly controlled at 1.2 or below.
quote: 新建数据中心PUE值严格控制在1.2以下

summary: Promote green computing application pilots and demonstration zones, enterprises and projects; select typical cases and release catalogues of innovative products and solutions from time to time.
quote: 遴选典型案例，适时发布创新产品与解决方案目录

summary: A personal information processor that conducts its own compliance audit must have it done by an internal body or by a commissioned professional institution, on a regular basis, covering compliance with laws and administrative regulations.
quote: 个人信息处理者自行开展个人信息保护合规审计的，应当由个人信息处理者内部机构或者委托专业机构定期对其处理个人信息遵守法律、行政法规的情况进行合规审计。
conditional_on: Processor conducts its own personal information protection compliance audit

summary: Processors handling personal information of more than 10 million persons must conduct a compliance audit at least once every two years.
quote: 处理超过1000万人个人信息的个人信息处理者，应当每两年至少开展一次个人信息保护合规审计。
conditional_on: Processor handles personal information of more than 10 million persons

summary: When a protection department requires it in one of the listed situations (serious risk, possible infringement of many persons, or a security incident affecting large numbers of persons), the processor must have a compliance audit carried out by a professional institution.
quote: 可以要求个人信息处理者委托专业机构对个人信息处理活动进行合规审计
conditional_on: Protection department requires an audit in a situation listed in Art. 5(1)-(3)

summary: The same personal information security incident or risk may not be used to repeatedly require a processor to commission a professional institution for a compliance audit.
quote: 对同一个人信息安全事件或者风险，不得重复要求个人信息处理者委托专业机构开展个人信息保护合规审计。
conditional_on: Same personal information security incident or risk

summary: A processor that audits itself or is audited by a commissioned institution at the protection department's request must refer to the Personal Information Protection Compliance Audit Guidelines annexed to the Measures.
quote: 个人信息处理者自行开展或者按照保护部门要求委托专业机构开展个人信息保护合规审计的，应当参照本办法附件《个人信息保护合规审计指引》。
conditional_on: Self-conducted audit, or audit by a commissioned institution at the protection department's request

summary: A professional institution must have the capability to conduct personal information protection compliance audits, including auditing staff, premises, facilities and funds suited to its services.
quote: 专业机构应当具备开展个人信息保护合规审计的能力，有与服务相适应的审计人员、场所、设施和资金等。
conditional_on: Professional institution conducts personal information protection compliance audits

summary: Relevant professional institutions are encouraged to obtain certification, which follows the certification regulations cited in the Article.
quote: 鼓励相关专业机构通过认证。

summary: A processor auditing at the protection department's request must give necessary support to the professional institution and bear the audit fees.
quote: 个人信息处理者按照保护部门要求开展个人信息保护合规审计的，应当为专业机构正常开展个人信息保护合规审计工作提供必要支持，并承担审计费用。
conditional_on: Audit carried out at the protection department's request

summary: A processor auditing at the protection department's request must select the professional institution as the department requires and complete the audit within the time limit; the department may approve an extension for complex cases.
applies_from: within the time limit set by the protection department (Art. 9)
quote: 应当按照保护部门要求选定专业机构，在限定时间内完成个人信息保护合规审计
conditional_on: Audit carried out at the protection department's request

summary: After completing an audit at the protection department's request, the processor must submit the professional institution's audit report to the department.
quote: 应当将专业机构出具的个人信息保护合规审计报告报送保护部门。
conditional_on: Audit carried out at the protection department's request

summary: The audit report must be signed by the institution's main responsible person and the compliance audit lead and bear the institution's seal.
quote: 个人信息保护合规审计报告应当由专业机构主要负责人、合规审计负责人签字并加盖专业机构公章。

summary: A processor must rectify problems identified in the audit as the protection department requires.
quote: 应当按照保护部门要求对合规审计中发现的问题进行整改。
conditional_on: Audit carried out at the protection department's request

summary: After rectification, the processor must submit a rectification report to the protection department.
applies_from: 15 working days after rectification is completed (Art. 11)
quote: 在整改完成后15个工作日内，向保护部门报送整改情况报告。
conditional_on: Audit carried out at the protection department's request

summary: Processors handling personal information of more than one million persons must designate a personal information protection officer responsible for the compliance audit work.
quote: 处理100万人以上个人信息的个人信息处理者应当指定个人信息保护负责人，负责个人信息处理者的个人信息保护合规审计工作。
conditional_on: Processor handles personal information of more than 1,000,000 persons

summary: Processors providing important internet platform services with large user numbers and complex business must set up an independent body, mainly of external members, to supervise the compliance audit.
quote: 应当成立主要由外部成员组成的独立机构对个人信息保护合规审计情况进行监督。
conditional_on: Processor provides important internet platform services with huge user numbers and complex business types

summary: A professional institution must comply with law, act with integrity, and make objective and impartial professional judgements in audits.
quote: 专业机构在从事个人信息保护合规审计活动时，应当遵守法律法规，诚信正直，公正客观地作出合规审计职业判断
conditional_on: Professional institution conducts a compliance audit

summary: A professional institution must keep confidential the personal information, trade secrets and confidential business information obtained in audit work and must not disclose or unlawfully provide them to others.
quote: 对在履行个人信息保护合规审计职责中获得的个人信息、商业秘密、保密商务信息等应当依法予以保密，不得泄露或者非法向他人提供
conditional_on: Information obtained in performing audit duties

summary: A professional institution must promptly delete the relevant information after the audit work ends.
quote: 在合规审计工作结束后及时删除相关信息
conditional_on: Compliance audit work has ended

summary: A professional institution may not sub-contract the compliance audit to other institutions.
quote: 专业机构不得转委托其他机构开展个人信息保护合规审计。

summary: The same institution, its affiliates, and the same compliance audit lead may not audit the same audit object more than three consecutive times.
quote: 同一专业机构及其关联机构、同一合规审计负责人不得连续三次以上对同一审计对象开展个人信息保护合规审计。
conditional_on: Same audit object

summary: The protection departments supervise and inspect processors' compliance audits.
quote: 保护部门对个人信息处理者开展个人信息保护合规审计情况进行监督检查。

summary: A department receiving a complaint or report about unlawful activity in compliance audits must handle it promptly under the law and inform the complainant of the result.
quote: 收到投诉、举报的部门应当依法及时处理，并将处理结果告知投诉、举报人。
conditional_on: Complaint or report about unlawful activity in a compliance audit

summary: Processors must respond to individuals' requests and explain their personal information processing rules (Annex, point 18).
quote: 个人信息处理者应当响应个人申请，对其个人信息处理规则进行解释说明
conditional_on: Individual requests explanation of processing rules

summary: Processors must formulate internal management systems and operating procedures, with organisational structure and responsibilities, in accordance with laws and administrative regulations (Annex, point 19).
quote: 个人信息处理者应当依照法律、行政法规的规定制定内部管理制度和操作规程

summary: Processors must adopt security technical measures proportionate to the scale and type of personal information processed (Annex, point 20).
quote: 个人信息处理者应当采取与所处理个人信息规模、类型相适应的安全技术措施

summary: Processors must formulate a personal information security incident emergency plan (Annex, point 24).
quote: 个人信息处理者应当制定个人信息安全事件应急预案

summary: The National Cyberspace Administration, together with the national data management department and other relevant departments, formulates standards and technical specifications for outbound personal information certification.
quote: 国家网信部门会同国家数据管理部门和其他有关部门制定个人信息出境认证相关标准、技术规范

summary: A personal information processor providing personal information abroad through certification must simultaneously meet the listed conditions: not a critical information infrastructure operator, and cumulative outbound volume of 100,000 or more but fewer than 1 million individuals' personal information (excluding sensitive personal information), or fewer than 10,000 individuals' sensitive personal information, counted from 1 January of the current year. Important data is excluded.
quote: 个人信息处理者通过个人信息出境认证的方式向境外提供个人信息的，应当同时符合下列情形
conditional_on: Unless laws, administrative regulations or the national cyberspace authority provide otherwise

summary: A personal information processor may not use quantity-splitting or similar means to route personal information that must pass an outbound security assessment through the certification route.
quote: 个人信息处理者不得采取数量拆分等手段

summary: Before applying for certification for outbound provision, the processor must conduct a personal information protection impact assessment covering six listed matters (purpose and lawfulness, scale and sensitivity, overseas recipient's obligations and capabilities, risks after transfer, foreign legal environment, other matters).
quote: 应当按照法律、行政法规的规定履行告知、取得个人单独同意、进行个人信息保护影响评估等义务
conditional_on: Before applying for certification

summary: Before applying for certification for outbound provision, the processor must obtain individuals' separate consent, as required by laws and administrative regulations.
quote: 取得个人单独同意
conditional_on: Before applying for certification

summary: Before applying for certification for outbound provision, the processor must give notice as required by laws and administrative regulations.
quote: 履行告知
conditional_on: Before applying for certification

summary: A processor providing personal information abroad through certification must apply to a professional certification body for outbound certification.
quote: 个人信息处理者通过认证方式向境外提供个人信息的，应当向专业认证机构申请个人信息出境认证
conditional_on: When providing personal information abroad through the certification method

summary: A personal information processor located outside the PRC must apply through a dedicated institution or designated representative established within the PRC.
quote: 中华人民共和国境外的个人信息处理者申请个人信息出境认证的，应当由其在境内设立的专门机构或者指定代表协助进行申请
conditional_on: Processor located outside the PRC

summary: The professional certification body must carry out outbound certification under the basic certification norms and the certification rules, and must promptly issue a certificate to conforming applicants. Certificates are valid for 3 years.
quote: 专业认证机构应当按照认证基本规范、个人信息保护认证规则开展个人信息出境认证活动
conditional_on: Applicant meets certification requirements

summary: To continue use after certificate expiry, the processor must apply for renewal at least 6 months before the certificate's validity period ends.
quote: 证书到期需继续使用的，个人信息处理者应当在有效期届满前6个月提出认证申请
conditional_on: Certificate expiring and continued use required; applies 6 months before expiry

summary: The certification body must report certificate information (certificate number, certified processor name, certification scope, status changes) to the national certification and accreditation public information platform within 5 working days of issuing or changing a certificate's status.
quote: 专业认证机构应当在出具认证证书或者认证证书状态发生变化后5个工作日内，向全国认证认可信息公共服务平台报送
conditional_on: Upon issuance of a certificate or change in certificate status

summary: The State Administration for Market Regulation and the cyberspace authority must establish a certification information sharing mechanism.
quote: 国家市场监督管理部门与国家网信部门建立认证信息共享机制

summary: Where the certification body finds that a certified processor's outbound activity is inconsistent with the certification scope, or that it no longer meets certification requirements, it must suspend the certificate's use until the certificate is revoked. Under the second paragraph, the body must cooperate when the cyberspace authority or other departments find such a situation.
quote: 不再符合认证要求的，应当暂停其使用直至撤销相关认证证书
conditional_on: Outbound activity inconsistent with certification scope, or processor no longer meets certification requirements

summary: The situations under the first two paragraphs of Art. 10 must be published on the national certification and accreditation public information platform. The text does not name the body that publishes.
quote: 应当通过全国认证认可信息公共服务平台予以公布
conditional_on: Situations under Art. 10 first and second paragraphs

summary: If the certification body finds that outbound personal information activity violates laws, administrative regulations or national rules, it must promptly report to the cyberspace authority and other relevant departments.
quote: 应当及时向国家网信部门和有关部门报告
conditional_on: Certification body discovers a violation during certification activities

summary: A certification body approved to issue personal information protection certification must file with the cyberspace authority within 10 working days of approval, submitting listed materials (qualifications, experience, staff background review, implementation rules, risk mechanisms, ongoing supervision, complaint mechanism, other materials) and ensuring their authenticity.
applies_from: Within 10 working days after the date of approval by the market regulation department
quote: 应当自国家市场监督管理部门批准取得个人信息保护认证资质之日起10个工作日内向国家网信部门办理备案手续
conditional_on: Certification body approved by the State Administration for Market Regulation

summary: On receiving a filing from a certification body, the cyberspace authority, with the national data management department, reviews the materials; complete filings are recorded and publicly announced within 30 working days, and incomplete ones are rejected with notice and reasons within 30 working days.
quote: 材料齐全的，应当在30个工作日内予以备案并进行公示
conditional_on: Receipt of a certification body's filing materials

summary: The State Administration for Market Regulation and the cyberspace authority supervise outbound certification activities, conduct regular or unannounced inspections, sample-check certification processes and results, and inspect and evaluate certification bodies.
quote: 国家市场监督管理部门和国家网信部门对个人信息出境认证活动进行监督

summary: State organs, certification bodies and their staff must keep confidential the privacy, personal information, trade secrets and confidential business information they learn in performing duties, and must not disclose, unlawfully provide or unlawfully use them.
quote: 应当依法予以保密，不得泄露或者非法向他人提供、非法使用

summary: A certified processor that is summoned by the cyberspace authority or other departments for a high-risk or security incident must rectify as required and eliminate hidden dangers.
quote: 获证个人信息处理者应当按照要求整改，消除隐患
conditional_on: Summons under Art. 16 following significant outbound risk or a personal information security incident

summary: A personal information processor transferring abroad under a standard contract must meet all listed conditions: not a critical information infrastructure operator; fewer than 1 million individuals' personal information processed; cumulative outbound transfer of personal information of fewer than 100,000 individuals since 1 January of the previous year; cumulative outbound transfer of sensitive personal information of fewer than 10,000 individuals since 1 January of the previous year.
quote: 个人信息处理者通过订立标准合同的方式向境外提供个人信息的，应当同时符合下列情形
conditional_on: Transfer made by entering into a standard contract with an overseas recipient

summary: A processor shall not use volume-splitting or similar means to route personal information that must pass an outbound security assessment through a standard contract instead.
quote: 个人信息处理者不得采取数量拆分等手段
conditional_on: Personal information that by law must pass an outbound security assessment

summary: Before providing personal information overseas, the processor shall carry out a personal information protection impact assessment covering the listed matters (legality of purpose and scope, scale and sensitivity, overseas recipient's obligations and safeguards, risks after transfer, foreign data protection environment, other relevant matters).
quote: 个人信息处理者向境外提供个人信息前，应当开展个人信息保护影响评估
conditional_on: Outbound transfer of personal information

summary: The standard contract shall be concluded strictly in accordance with the annex to the Measures; the processor may agree other terms with the overseas recipient provided they do not conflict with the standard contract.
quote: 标准合同应当严格按照本办法附件订立。
conditional_on: Conclusion of a standard contract

summary: Outbound transfer of personal information may only begin after the standard contract takes effect; transfer before effect is not permitted.
applies_from: After the standard contract takes effect
quote: 标准合同生效后方可开展个人信息出境活动。
conditional_on: Transfer under a standard contract

summary: The national cyberspace authority may adjust the annex to the standard contract according to actual circumstances.
quote: 国家网信部门可以根据实际情况对附件进行调整。

summary: The processor shall file the standard contract and its personal information protection impact assessment report with the provincial-level cyberspace authority of its location, and is responsible for the truthfulness of the filed materials.
applies_from: Within 10 working days after the standard contract takes effect
quote: 个人信息处理者应当在标准合同生效之日起10个工作日内向所在地省级网信部门备案。
conditional_on: Standard contract entered into

summary: Upon the listed changes during the contract term, the processor shall redo the impact assessment and supplement or re-sign the standard contract.
applies_from: During the validity of the standard contract
quote: 应当重新开展个人信息保护影响评估，补充或者重新订立标准合同
conditional_on: Changes in purpose, scope, type, sensitivity, method, storage location or recipient's processing use or method (including extended retention); changes in the recipient country's data protection laws or policies; other matters affecting personal information rights

summary: Upon the changes listed in Art. 8, the processor shall complete the corresponding filing procedures again.
applies_from: During the validity of the standard contract
quote: 并履行相应备案手续
conditional_on: Changes listed in Art. 8(1) to (3)

summary: Cyberspace authorities and their staff shall keep confidential the personal privacy, personal information, trade secrets and confidential business information they learn in performing their duties, and shall not disclose or unlawfully provide or use them.
quote: 网信部门及其工作人员对在履行职责中知悉的个人隐私、个人信息、商业秘密、保密商务信息等应当依法予以保密
conditional_on: Knowledge acquired in performing duties

summary: After being summoned (约谈) by a provincial-level or higher cyberspace authority, the processor shall rectify as required and eliminate hidden dangers.
quote: 个人信息处理者应当按照要求整改，消除隐患。
conditional_on: Higher risk of outbound transfer or a personal information security incident, and the authority's summons

summary: Outbound transfers already carried out before the Measures took effect that do not comply with them shall be rectified within 6 months of the effective date.
applies_from: Within 6 months from the effective date of the Measures (施行 on 2023年6月1日)
quote: 应当自本办法施行之日起6个月内完成整改
conditional_on: Outbound transfers carried out before the Measures took effect that do not comply with them

summary: Any organization or individual must not infringe natural persons' personal information rights and interests.
quote: 任何组织、个人不得侵害自然人的个人信息权益

summary: Processing must be lawful, legitimate, necessary and in good faith; personal information must not be processed by misleading, fraudulent or coercive means.
quote: 不得通过误导、欺诈、胁迫等方式处理个人信息

summary: Processing must use the least impact on rights; collection is limited to the minimum scope needed for the purpose and must not be excessive.
quote: 不得过度收集个人信息

summary: Publish personal information processing rules and state the purpose, method and scope of processing.
quote: 公开个人信息处理规则，明示处理的目的、方式和范围

summary: Ensure the quality of personal information so that inaccuracy or incompleteness does not harm individuals' rights.
quote: 处理个人信息应当保证个人信息的质量

summary: Be responsible for processing activities and take necessary measures to ensure the security of personal information processed.
quote: 个人信息处理者应当对其个人信息处理活动负责，并采取必要措施保障所处理的个人信息的安全

summary: No organization or individual may unlawfully collect, use, process, transmit, trade, provide or disclose others' personal information, or carry out processing that endangers national security or public interest.
quote: 任何组织、个人不得非法收集、使用、加工、传输他人个人信息

summary: The State establishes and improves the personal information protection system, prevents infringing acts and promotes education.
quote: 国家建立健全个人信息保护制度

summary: The State actively participates in formulating international personal information protection rules and promotes mutual recognition of rules and standards.
quote: 国家积极参与个人信息保护国际规则的制定

summary: Where processing relies on other grounds of Art. 13 (paras 2-7) consent is not required; otherwise processing requires the individual's consent.
quote: 依照本法其他有关规定，处理个人信息应当取得个人同意
conditional_on: Processing not based on Art. 13(1)-(7) grounds

summary: Consent must be given voluntarily, explicitly and with full knowledge; processing purpose, method or categories changed requires new consent; separate or written consent where law requires.
quote: 该同意应当由个人在充分知情的前提下自愿、明确作出
conditional_on: Processing based on consent

summary: Provide a convenient way for individuals to withdraw consent; withdrawal does not affect prior processing.
quote: 个人信息处理者应当提供便捷的撤回同意的方式
conditional_on: Processing based on consent

summary: Must not refuse products or services because an individual refuses or withdraws consent, unless processing is necessary for providing the product or service.
quote: 个人信息处理者不得以个人不同意处理其个人信息或者撤回同意为由，拒绝提供产品或者服务

summary: Before processing, notify individuals of controller identity and contact, purpose, method, data categories, retention period and how to exercise rights; notify changes; publish processing rules.
quote: 应当以显著方式、清晰易懂的语言真实、准确、完整地向个人告知下列事项

summary: Where emergency circumstances prevented timely notice, notify individuals promptly after the emergency ends.
quote: 应当在紧急情况消除后及时告知
conditional_on: Emergency protecting life, health or property where notice was not possible in time

summary: Retention period must be the shortest necessary to achieve the processing purpose, unless law provides otherwise.
quote: 个人信息的保存期限应当为实现处理目的所必要的最短时间

summary: Joint controllers must agree their respective rights and duties; they bear joint liability for harm (liability not coded here).
quote: 应当约定各自的权利和义务
conditional_on: Two or more controllers jointly determine purposes and methods

summary: When entrusting processing, agree purpose, period, method, data categories and protection measures with the processor and supervise it.
quote: 应当与受托人约定委托处理的目的、期限、处理方式
conditional_on: Processing entrusted to a processor

summary: Entrusted processor must process only as agreed, must not exceed agreed purpose or method, must return or delete data when the contract ends, and must not sub-entrust without consent.
quote: 受托人应当按照约定处理个人信息，不得超出约定的处理目的、处理方式等处理个人信息
conditional_on: Processing entrusted by a controller

summary: On merger, division, dissolution or bankruptcy, notify individuals of the recipient's name and contact; the recipient must continue the obligations and obtain new consent for changed purposes.
quote: 应当向个人告知接收方的名称或者姓名和联系方式
conditional_on: Transfer of personal information due to merger, division, dissolution or bankruptcy

summary: When providing personal information to another processor, notify individuals of the recipient and processing details and obtain separate consent; the recipient must process within the agreed scope.
quote: 并取得个人的单独同意
conditional_on: Provision of processed personal information to another processor

summary: Automated decision-making must ensure transparency and fair, impartial results; must not impose unreasonable differential treatment on transaction prices or conditions.
quote: 应当保证决策的透明度和结果公平、公正
conditional_on: Use of automated decision-making

summary: For automated push or marketing, offer an option not targeting personal characteristics or an easy refusal; for decisions with major impact, explain them and let individuals refuse decisions made solely by automation.
quote: 应当同时提供不针对其个人特征的选项，或者向个人提供便捷的拒绝方式
conditional_on: Use of automated decision-making

summary: Must not publicly disclose processed personal information unless separate consent is obtained.
quote: 个人信息处理者不得公开其处理的个人信息

summary: Image-collection or identification devices in public places must be necessary for public safety, comply with state rules and display prominent notices; collected data used only for public safety.
quote: 并设置显著的提示标识
conditional_on: Installation of image collection or identity recognition devices in public places

summary: For publicly available personal information with major impact on rights, obtain consent as required by the law; individuals may refuse.
quote: 对个人权益有重大影响的，应当依照本法规定取得个人同意
conditional_on: Processing of publicly disclosed personal information with major impact on rights

summary: Sensitive personal information may be processed only for a specific purpose, with sufficient necessity and strict protection measures.
quote: 只有在具有特定的目的和充分的必要性，并采取严格保护措施的情形下，个人信息处理者方可处理敏感个人信息
conditional_on: Processing of sensitive personal information

summary: Processing sensitive personal information requires separate consent, or written consent where law requires.
quote: 处理敏感个人信息应当取得个人的单独同意
conditional_on: Processing of sensitive personal information

summary: For sensitive personal information, notify individuals in addition to Art. 17 of the necessity of processing and its impact on their rights.
quote: 还应当向个人告知处理敏感个人信息的必要性以及对个人权益的影响
conditional_on: Processing of sensitive personal information

summary: For personal information of minors under fourteen, obtain consent of a parent or other guardian.
quote: 应当取得未成年人的父母或者其他监护人的同意
conditional_on: Processing personal information of minors under 14

summary: Processing personal information of minors under fourteen requires dedicated processing rules.
quote: 应当制定专门的个人信息处理规则
conditional_on: Processing personal information of minors under 14

summary: State organs processing personal information to perform statutory duties must act within the powers and procedures set by law and must not exceed the necessary scope.
quote: 应当依照法律、行政法规规定的权限、程序进行
conditional_on: Processing by state organs for statutory duties

summary: State organs processing personal information to perform statutory duties must give the notice required by this Law, subject to exceptions in Art. 18(1) or where notice would impede their duties.
quote: 应当依照本法规定履行告知义务
conditional_on: Processing by state organs for statutory duties

summary: Personal information processed by state organs must be stored within mainland China; overseas provision requires a security assessment.
quote: 国家机关处理的个人信息应当在中华人民共和国境内存储
conditional_on: Processing by state organs

summary: Before providing personal information outside China, the processor must meet one of the listed conditions: security assessment, professional certification, standard contract or other conditions; treaty rules may apply; must take measures so that the overseas recipient meets the Law's standard.
quote: 应当具备下列条件之一
conditional_on: Provision of personal information to recipients outside China

summary: Before providing personal information abroad, notify individuals of the overseas recipient's details, processing purpose, method, data categories and how to exercise rights, and obtain separate consent.
quote: 应当向个人告知境外接收方的名称或者姓名、联系方式
conditional_on: Provision of personal information outside China

summary: Critical information infrastructure operators and processors reaching the volume set by the CAC must store domestically collected personal information in China; overseas provision requires a security assessment unless exempted by rules.
quote: 应当将在中华人民共和国境内收集和产生的个人信息存储在境内
conditional_on: Critical information infrastructure operators, or processors reaching the volume set by the national cyberspace authority

summary: Must not provide personal information stored in China to foreign judicial or law enforcement bodies without approval from the competent authority.
quote: 非经中华人民共和国主管机关批准，个人信息处理者不得向外国司法或者执法机构提供存储于中华人民共和国境内的个人信息
conditional_on: Request from a foreign judicial or law enforcement body

summary: The national cyberspace authority may list overseas organizations or individuals that infringe personal information rights or endanger national security in a restricted or prohibited provision list and take restrictive measures.
quote: 国家网信部门可以将其列入限制或者禁止个人信息提供清单
conditional_on: Overseas organizations or individuals infringing rights of Chinese citizens or endangering national security or public interest

summary: China may take reciprocal measures against a country or region that adopts discriminatory measures on personal information protection.
quote: 中华人民共和国可以根据实际情况对该国家或者地区对等采取措施
conditional_on: Discriminatory prohibitions or restrictions by another country or region

summary: Promptly provide individuals access to and copies of their personal information, and provide a route for transfer to a designated processor where CAC conditions are met.
quote: 个人请求查阅、复制其个人信息的，个人信息处理者应当及时提供
conditional_on: Individual request

summary: Verify and promptly correct or supplement inaccurate or incomplete personal information upon individual request.
quote: 个人信息处理者应当对其个人信息予以核实，并及时更正、补充
conditional_on: Individual request

summary: Must proactively delete personal information in listed circumstances (purpose achieved, service ended, consent withdrawn, unlawful processing); where deletion is not technically feasible, stop processing other than storage and security.
quote: 有下列情形之一的，个人信息处理者应当主动删除个人信息
conditional_on: Listed circumstances in Art. 47(1)-(5)

summary: Explain processing rules to an individual who requests explanation.
quote: 个人有权要求个人信息处理者对其个人信息处理规则进行解释说明
conditional_on: Individual request

summary: Establish a convenient mechanism to receive and handle requests to exercise rights; reasons must be given for refusals.
quote: 应当建立便捷的个人行使权利的申请受理和处理机制

summary: Based on purpose, method, data categories, impact and security risk, adopt internal management rules, data classification, encryption or de-identification, staff training, and an emergency plan.
quote: 个人信息处理者应当根据个人信息的处理目的

summary: Processors reaching the volume set by the CAC must appoint a personal information protection officer to supervise processing and protective measures.
quote: 处理个人信息达到国家网信部门规定数量的个人信息处理者应当指定个人信息保护负责人
conditional_on: Processors reaching the volume set by the national cyberspace authority

summary: Publish the officer's contact details and report the officer's name and contact details to the authority performing personal information protection duties.
quote: 并将个人信息保护负责人的姓名、联系方式等报送履行个人信息保护职责的部门
conditional_on: Processors reaching the volume set by the national cyberspace authority

summary: Overseas processors subject to Art. 3(2) must establish a dedicated body or designate a representative in China for personal information protection and report it to the authority.
quote: 应当在中华人民共和国境内设立专门机构或者指定代表
conditional_on: Overseas processors subject to Art. 3(2)

summary: Periodically conduct compliance audits of personal information processing against laws and administrative regulations.
quote: 应当定期对其处理个人信息遵守法律、行政法规的情况进行合规审计

summary: Conduct a personal information protection impact assessment before sensitive processing, automated decision-making, entrusted processing, provision to others, public disclosure, overseas provision or other major-impact processing, and keep processing records.
quote: 应当事前进行个人信息保护影响评估，并对处理情况进行记录
conditional_on: Sensitive processing, automated decisions, entrusted or onward provision, public disclosure, overseas provision, or other major-impact processing

summary: The impact assessment report and processing records must be kept for at least three years; the assessment must cover legality, impact and risk, and adequacy of protective measures.
quote: 个人信息保护影响评估报告和处理情况记录应当至少保存三年
conditional_on: Processing subject to Art. 55 impact assessment

summary: On actual or possible leakage, tampering or loss, take remedial measures immediately and notify the authority and individuals with listed content; notice to individuals may be omitted where measures effectively avoid harm.
quote: 应当立即采取补救措施，并通知履行个人信息保护职责的部门和个人
conditional_on: Actual or possible leakage, tampering or loss of personal information

summary: Platforms providing important internet services with very large user numbers and complex business must establish a personal information compliance system with an independent body mainly of external members.
quote: 按照国家规定建立健全个人信息保护合规制度体系
conditional_on: Important internet platform services, very large user numbers and complex business types

summary: Such platforms must set platform rules governing on-platform providers' processing, and stop services to on-platform providers that seriously violate the law.
quote: 对严重违反法律、行政法规处理个人信息的平台内的产品或者服务提供者，停止提供服务
conditional_on: Important internet platform services, very large user numbers and complex business types

summary: Such platforms must regularly publish a personal information protection social responsibility report and accept public oversight.
quote: 定期发布个人信息保护社会责任报告
conditional_on: Important internet platform services, very large user numbers and complex business types

summary: Entrusted processors must take necessary measures to secure the personal information they process and assist the controller in meeting its obligations.
quote: 应当依照本法和有关法律、行政法规的规定，采取必要措施保障所处理的个人信息的安全
conditional_on: Processing entrusted by a controller

summary: The national cyberspace authority coordinates personal information protection and related supervision; other departments perform supervision within their own remits.
quote: 国家网信部门负责统筹协调个人信息保护工作和相关监督管理工作

summary: Authorities performing personal information protection duties must promote education, receive complaints, evaluate applications and publish results, and investigate unlawful processing.
quote: 履行个人信息保护职责的部门履行下列个人信息保护职责

summary: The national cyberspace authority coordinates other departments in advancing specified work: formulating detailed rules and standards, special rules for small processors, sensitive information and new technologies such as face recognition and AI, electronic identity, service systems and complaint mechanisms.
quote: 国家网信部门统筹协调有关部门依据本法推进下列个人信息保护工作

summary: Authorities performing personal information protection duties may inquire, review and copy records, conduct on-site inspections and, with approval, seize equipment used for unlawful processing.
quote: 履行个人信息保护职责的部门履行个人信息保护职责，可以采取下列措施

summary: Parties must assist and cooperate with the authority in its investigations and must not refuse or obstruct it.
quote: 当事人应当予以协助、配合，不得拒绝、阻挠
conditional_on: Investigation by the authority performing personal information protection duties

summary: Where the authority finds major risk or a security incident, the processor must take measures to rectify and remove hazards, and may be required to commission a professional compliance audit.
quote: 应当按照要求采取措施，进行整改，消除隐患
conditional_on: Authority finds major risk or a personal information security incident

summary: Where the authority finds personal information processing suspected of crime, it must promptly transfer the case to the public security organ.
quote: 应当及时移送公安机关依法处理
conditional_on: Suspected crime in personal information processing

summary: Authorities must handle complaints and reports promptly, inform complainants of results, and publish contact details for complaints and reports.
quote: 收到投诉、举报的部门应当依法及时处理，并将处理结果告知投诉、举报人

summary: Encourages platform operators and in-platform operators to innovate technology and business models; no further conduct specified.
quote: 鼓励平台经营者、平台内经营者创新技术和商业模式

summary: Platform operators may not impose unreasonable restrictions on in-platform operators' pricing through fee increases, deductions, traffic limits, search demotion, delisting or similar measures, including forced discounts, price parity and forced automatic price-matching systems.
quote: 平台经营者不得违反《中华人民共和国电子商务法》第三十五条规定

summary: Before adding or changing fee items, rules or standards, platform operators must publicly seek opinions from in-platform operators on the homepage for at least seven days and adopt transition measures where material.
quote: 应当在首页显著位置公开征求平台内经营者的意见，征求意见时间不少于七日

summary: Platform operators must set fee standards for in-platform operators reasonably and publish them, may not charge unreasonable fees, and may not prevent in-platform operators that reject changes from exiting the platform.
quote: 平台经营者不得阻止

summary: Platform operators and in-platform operators must mark prices and fees clearly (item name, price, unit, service content, and shipping, delivery, payment and unavoidable fees prominently).
quote: 应当对销售的商品或者提供的服务实行明码标价

summary: Platform operators and in-platform operators may not add charges above the marked price or collect unmarked fees.
quote: 在标价之外加价、收取任何未予标明的费用

summary: Differential pricing for consumers under different transaction conditions and dynamic pricing (e.g., time-based) must have rules publicly disclosed on the service page, with factors affecting prices explained and extra service fees shown separately; rules must be updated when changed.
quote: 应当在服务页面显著位置公开相关规则，如有变动应当及时更新

summary: Paid ancillary services sold with goods (e.g., moving, installation, extended warranty) must be priced prominently; services not provided by the seller must be marked as such.
quote: 应当在显著位置对附带服务进行明码标价

summary: Promotional prices or promotion rules must be marked in a way consumers can readily understand; promotion rules, periods and scope must be disclosed prominently, true base prices stated, and points or vouchers' offset methods specified.
quote: 应当以方便消费者认知的方式标明促销价格或者价格促销规则

summary: Platform operators may not falsely or exaggeratedly advertise subsidy amounts or strength; subsidy promotions must also disclose subsidy rules, targets, methods, conditions and periods on the activity page.
quote: 不得虚假、夸大宣传补贴金额和力度

summary: Estimated prices must disclose their composition and prominently warn that they may differ from the final settlement price; payment or other restrictions must be shown in advance.
quote: 应当公开预估价格的构成

summary: Search results must be displayed by price, sales, credit or other factors; paid ranking must be marked as advertising, and ranking, recommendation and bidding rules must be disclosed to participating operators.
quote: 对于竞价排名的商品或者服务，应当显著标明“广告”

summary: Below-cost sales aimed at excluding competitors or monopolising a market and disrupting normal business order are prohibited; platforms may not force in-platform operators to price below cost; long-term free business models are carved out under conditions.
quote: 以排挤竞争对手或者独占市场为目的，以低于成本的价格销售商品或者提供服务

summary: Setting different prices for the same goods or services under the same transaction conditions by using data and algorithms without consumers' knowledge is prohibited; platform operators may not price-discriminate against in-platform operators.
quote: 在同等交易条件下设置不同的价格或者收费标准

summary: Using platform rules, data and algorithms to collude with others and manipulate market prices, harming other operators or consumers, is prohibited.
quote: 利用平台规则、数据和算法等手段，相互串通，操纵市场价格

summary: Fabricating or spreading price-increase information, hoarding goods, forced bundling and similar acts to inflate prices are prohibited; for emergency and essential goods during emergencies, sharp unjustified price or transport-fee increases are prohibited.
quote: 捏造、散布涨价信息，哄抬价格，推动商品价格过高上涨

summary: Price fraud is prohibited, including falsely claiming government pricing, low-price baiting, false discounts, deceptive price displays, refusing price commitments, and refusing to honour points or vouchers.
quote: 谎称商品和服务价格为政府定价或者政府指导价

summary: Platform operators may not display prices on the homepage or prominent positions lower than the price on the detail page, may not misstate promotion scope or rules, and may not compel false price displays.
quote: 在平台首页或者其他显著位置标示的商品或者服务的价格低于在详情页面标示的价格

summary: For password-free (免密) payment, bundled extra services and auto-renewal or auto-deduction, options must be shown prominently with an easy cancellation path; before each auto-deduction consumers must be notified of time, amount and cancellation method, and cancellation must be allowed at any time.
quote: 应当以显著方式向消费者展示相关选项，并提供便捷的取消途径

summary: Disguised price changes through raising or lowering grades, falsely increasing quantity or duration, or similar means are prohibited.
quote: 不得违反《中华人民共和国价格法》第十四条第六项规定

summary: Platform operators are encouraged to establish an online price-dispute resolution mechanism with published rules, and to establish quality commitment and guarantee systems.
quote: 鼓励平台经营者建立价格争议在线解决机制

summary: The development and reform, market regulation and cyberspace authorities supervise price conduct in the platform economy; they may warn, admonish and summon operators, investigate operating conditions, and market regulators conduct inspections and penalise violations.
quote: 发展改革、市场监管、网信部门依职责对平台经济领域价格行为开展监管

summary: Platform operators and in-platform operators must truthfully provide information required by the development and reform, market regulation and cyberspace authorities.
quote: 应当按照发展改革、市场监管、网信部门的要求，如实提供所需信息

summary: Platform operators must establish and improve price-conduct compliance management, including internal rules, platform rules guiding in-platform compliance, price supervisors, product quality controls and personal-data handling in price conduct.
quote: 建立健全价格行为合规管理制度

summary: Platform operators must establish and publicise a channel for price complaints and take necessary measures promptly to stop violations.
quote: 设立、公示价格问题投诉渠道

summary: Platform operators must properly retain price and transaction information within the platform and assist market regulators in investigating price violations.
quote: 妥善保存平台内有关价格和交易信息

summary: Platform operators must carry out legally required algorithm filing procedures for price conduct and cooperate with cyberspace and other authorities on security assessment and supervision.
quote: 依法履行价格行为有关算法备案手续

summary: The National Development and Reform Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation and Cyberspace Administration of China are responsible for interpreting the rules within their respective duties.
quote: 依职责负责解释

summary: Before using facial recognition to process facial information, inform individuals in a prominent manner of the processor's name and contact, purpose, method and retention period, necessity and impact, and rights procedures; notify individuals of any changes.
applies_from: Before using facial recognition technology to process facial information
quote: Before using facial recognition technology to process facial information, personal information processors shall, in a prominent manner and in clear, easy-to-understand language, truthfully, accurately, and fully inform individuals of the following

summary: Use facial recognition only for a specific purpose with sufficient necessity, adopting the method that minimizes impact on individuals' rights and interests, and implement strict protection measures.
quote: shall have a specific purpose and sufficient necessity, adopt the method that minimizes the impact on the rights and interests of individuals

summary: Where processing is based on individual consent, obtain it separately and voluntarily under fully informed circumstances; written consent where laws require it.
quote: such consent must be obtained separately and voluntarily under fully informed circumstances
conditional_on: processing based on individual consent

summary: Provide a convenient and fast means for individuals to withdraw consent; withdrawal does not affect prior processing.
quote: Personal information processors shall provide a convenient and fast means for withdrawing consent.
conditional_on: processing based on individual consent

summary: For facial information of minors under 14 processed on consent, obtain consent from the minor's parents or other guardians.
quote: consent must be obtained from the minor’s parents or other guardians
conditional_on: facial information of a minor under 14 processed on individual consent

summary: For facial information of minors under 14, formulate dedicated processing rules for storage, use, transfer and disclosure, and lawfully safeguard it.
quote: shall formulate dedicated processing rules for the storage, use, transfer, and disclosure of such information
conditional_on: processing facial information of minors under 14

summary: Unless laws or regulations provide otherwise or separate individual consent is obtained, store facial information within facial recognition devices and do not transmit it externally via the internet.
quote: facial information shall be stored within facial recognition devices and shall not be transmitted externally via the internet
conditional_on: absence of laws or administrative regulations otherwise providing, and of separate individual consent

summary: Unless laws or regulations provide otherwise, facial information retention shall not exceed the minimum duration necessary for the processing purpose.
quote: the retention period for facial information shall not exceed the minimum duration necessary to achieve the purpose of processing
conditional_on: absence of laws or administrative regulations otherwise providing

summary: Conduct a personal information protection impact assessment in advance covering lawfulness and necessity, impact on rights, leakage and misuse risks, and proportionality of measures; repeat it on change of purpose or method or after a major security incident.
applies_from: In advance of applying facial recognition technology
quote: shall conduct a personal information protection impact assessment in advance

summary: Keep records of processing activities; retain the impact assessment report and processing records for at least three years.
quote: The personal information protection impact assessment report and the processing records shall be retained for at least three years

summary: Where equivalent non-facial methods exist, do not use facial recognition as the sole means of identity verification; where an individual does not consent, provide other reasonable, convenient and fast alternatives.
quote: facial recognition technology shall not be used as the sole means of identity verification
conditional_on: other methods exist that achieve the same purpose or equivalent business requirements

summary: Do not mislead, defraud or coerce individuals into accepting facial recognition identity verification on grounds of business processing or service quality.
quote: No organization or individual shall mislead, defraud, or coerce individuals into accepting identity verification via facial recognition technology

summary: Installation of facial recognition equipment in public spaces must be necessary for public security; the collection area must be lawfully and reasonably defined and clear signage displayed.
quote: clear signage must be displayed
conditional_on: installation of facial recognition equipment in public spaces

summary: Do not install facial recognition equipment inside private areas of public places, such as hotel guest rooms, public baths, changing rooms or restrooms.
quote: No organization or individual shall install facial recognition equipment inside private areas of public places

summary: Adopt measures such as data encryption, security audits, access controls, authorization management, intrusion detection and prevention; fulfil graded cybersecurity protection and critical information infrastructure obligations where applicable.
quote: Systems applying facial recognition technology shall adopt measures such as data encryption, security audits, access controls

summary: File with the provincial-level or higher cyberspace administration with basic information, purpose and method, quantity and protection measures, processing rules, and the impact assessment report; file amendments on substantive changes within 30 business days and cancellation on termination within 30 business days.
applies_from: Within 30 business days from the date the stored volume reaches 100,000 individuals
quote: shall, within 30 business days from that date, complete filing procedures with the local cyberspace administration (网信部门) at the provincial level or above
conditional_on: volume of stored facial information reaches 100,000 individuals

summary: Cyberspace administrations, with public security authorities and other personal information protection departments, establish information sharing and notification mechanisms and jointly carry out related work.
quote: shall establish and improve mechanisms for information sharing and notification, and shall jointly carry out related work

summary: Cooperate with supervision and inspection of facial recognition processing activities in accordance with the law.
quote: Personal information processors shall cooperate in accordance with the law.

summary: Departments receiving complaints or reports on unlawful use of facial recognition must handle them promptly and in accordance with the law and notify the complainant of the outcome.
quote: Departments receiving such complaints or reports shall handle them promptly and in accordance with the law

summary: Issue 600 million yuan of compute vouchers and strengthen the compute scheduling platform; give compute-renting entities municipal rent subsidies of up to 30%, and joint municipal-district rent subsidies of up to 1 year and up to 100%; give up to 10% construction support for self-built compute facilities.
quote: 发放6亿元算力券 [issue 600 million yuan compute vouchers]
conditional_on: Applies to entities that rent intelligent compute or deploy self-owned compute facilities, subject to the measure's support limits.

summary: Issue 300 million yuan of model vouchers; give subsidies of up to 50% of the approved contract value, up to 5 million yuan, for calling third-party large models on cloud platforms or privately deploying them.
quote: 给予核定合同额最高50%、最高500万元补贴
conditional_on: Applies to entities advancing vertical large-model applications, as specified in the measure.

summary: Issue 100 million yuan of corpus vouchers and strengthen the corpus public service platform; give procurement subsidies of up to 30% of the approved contract value, up to 5 million yuan, for purchasing corpora from unrelated parties.
quote: 给予核定合同额最高30%、最高500万元采购补贴
conditional_on: Applies to entities purchasing non-affiliated corpora for model, vertical application or agent R&D.

summary: Support technical innovation in listed key frontier areas, giving up to 30% of approved total project investment, up to 50 million yuan; support participation in national projects and municipal matching projects up to 50 million yuan; up to 50% for strategic or public-interest projects with municipal government approval.
quote: 按照核定项目总投资给予最高30%、最高5000万元支持
conditional_on: Support is based on approved project investment; the 50% tier requires municipal government approval.

summary: Organise implementation of a citywide scientific intelligence '100 teams, 100 projects' programme, aiming (per the text's stated goal of 'striving') for at least 100 teams and 100 projects within 2 years; give up to 70% of approved total investment, up to 50 million yuan, for qualifying projects.
quote: 组织实施全市科学智能“百团百项”工程
conditional_on: Aspirational wording ('力争') for the 2-year target; funding applies to qualifying projects.

summary: Give continuous support of 3 to 5 years, up to 500 million yuan, to new AI R&D institutions led by strategic leading talent; give up to 50% of approved total investment, up to 20 million yuan, to platforms for AI safety governance, testing and evaluation, pilot verification and similar services.
quote: 给予3-5年、最高5亿元的连续性支持
conditional_on: Applies to institutions and platforms meeting the measure's criteria.

summary: Give awards of 5% of approved contract value, up to 5 million yuan, for sales or rental of AI products such as embodied intelligent robots reaching a certain scale; give up to 30% of approved contract value, up to 20 million yuan, for first-edition application demonstrations of AI software products.
quote: 按核定合同额的5%给予最高500万元奖励
conditional_on: The scale threshold for robot sales or rental is not specified in the text ('一定规模').

summary: Co-organise with industry competent departments the collection of demonstration scenarios in key fields, to build replicable and extendable typical scenarios; give up to 20% of approved total investment, up to 10 million yuan, for demonstration scenario projects.
quote: 会同各行业主管部门，组织重点领域示范场景征集
conditional_on: Applies to demonstration scenario projects.

summary: Give subsidies in the form of 1 million yuan each of compute, model and corpus vouchers to qualifying innovative enterprises, up to 100% support, under joint municipal-district arrangements; actively promote 'apply-free, enjoy-immediately' ('免申即享') subsidies; give rent reductions of 6 months to 3 years or one-time setup fees to qualifying AI talent start-up teams.
quote: 积极推动补贴“免申即享”
conditional_on: Applies to enterprises and teams that meet the eligibility conditions, as stated in the text.

summary: Provide long-term stable career and staffing support funding to high-level talent and teams; implement a 'talent plus project plus industry' support mechanism granting talent autonomy over technical routes, team formation and funding use; implement special awards of up to 300,000 yuan per individual for talent at high-quality AI enterprises.
quote: 对人工智能优质企业相关人才实施专项奖励，给予最高30万元个人奖励
conditional_on: Awards apply to talent at AI enterprises meeting the text's criteria.

summary: Give play to the guiding role of the national AI industry investment fund and the municipal AI pilot industry parent fund, jointly with district investment funds and social capital, in early, small and long-term investment; support qualifying enterprises in establishing venture capital funds and thematic sub-funds.
quote: 发挥国家人工智能产业投资基金、市级人工智能先导产业母基金等引导作用
conditional_on: Applies to investment in the key areas listed in the measure (compute, corpora, large models, embodied intelligence, scientific intelligence).

summary: Give awards of up to 5 million yuan to open-source communities with clear impact and to open-source models and corpora with high downloads, performance and influence; continue to use international AI conferences and developer platforms for international cooperation and open sharing.
quote: 给予最高500万元奖励
conditional_on: Applies to open-source communities and products meeting the stated impact criteria.

summary: Use the World AI Conference and the Global Developers Pioneer Conference to promote international cooperation and open sharing in AI.
quote: 持续用好世界人工智能大会、全球开发者先锋大会等平台

summary: The text encourages enterprises to actively join the global open-source ecosystem; the encouragement names enterprises as addressees.
quote: 鼓励企业积极融入全球开源生态

summary: Municipal government must establish a coordination mechanism and policy measures for smart connected vehicle industry development; municipal departments must set up a promotion mechanism for testing and application.
quote: 市人民政府应当建立完善促进智能网联汽车产业发展的工作协调机制和政策措施

summary: Pudong science and economy department and Lingang管委会 must establish a working mechanism for innovation application of driverless vehicles and supervise it; Art. 4 also assigns coordination duties to other municipal and district bodies.
quote: 应当建立促进智能网联汽车创新应用的工作机制

summary: Firms conducting driverless road testing, demonstration application or demonstration operation must apply for confirmation of a safety self-declaration; vehicles need confirmation before plates or road operation.
quote: 开展无驾驶人智能网联汽车道路测试、示范应用、示范运营的企业应当申请安全性自我声明的确认

summary: Applicant firms for safety self-declaration confirmation must be independent legal persons with technical capability, suitable vehicles, remote monitoring and emergency takeover staff trained and licensed, and compulsory or committed insurance.
quote: 申请安全性自我声明确认的企业应当符合以下要求

summary: Vehicles for road testing must have a minimum risk operation mode, meet functional and information safety standards, carry driverless-state display and warning devices, and have passed prior testing with a manual takeover rate within the prescribed value; high-risk testing requires prior low-risk testing.
quote: 申请安全性自我声明确认的车辆应当符合以下要求

summary: Vehicles for demonstration application with passengers or cargo must have completed prescribed road testing without traffic violations or vehicle-caused accidents, with manual takeover rate within the prescribed value.
quote: 申请安全性自我声明确认的车辆应当经过规定里程或者时间的道路测试

summary: Vehicles for demonstration operation with passengers, cargo or special-scenario work must meet technical, dimensional, axle, mass and safety standards and complete prescribed demonstration application with the required safety record.
quote: 申请安全性自我声明确认的车辆应当符合以下要求
