summary: Designated departments organise confirmation of the safety self-declaration with third parties and experts; the Pudong science and economy department and Lingang管委会 collect declarations and notify decisions in writing; cross-district coordination is required.
quote: 对相应阶段的安全性自我声明进行确认

summary: For batch confirmation of same-stage same-model vehicles, the competent authority must organise third-party consistency spot checks and decide on the basis of the results. Authority may accept test results from outside Pudong (permission, not coded).
quote: 有关主管部门应当组织第三方机构进行一致性抽查

summary: Vehicles on road testing may not carry persons unrelated to the testing or cargo other than ballast.
quote: 不得搭载与测试活动无关的人员和用于配重以外的货物

summary: When carrying persons or cargo under demonstration application, the firm must clearly disclose possible risks to service recipients and take necessary safety measures.
quote: 应当向服务对象明示可能存在的风险

summary: Vehicles in demonstration application may not exceed rated passenger or approved load capacity and may not carry dangerous goods.
quote: 不得超出车辆的额定乘员和核定载质量，不得搭载危险货物

summary: Firms conducting demonstration operation must hold or have conditions for road transport operating qualification (or cooperate with a qualified firm), have inspected vehicles, set fixed operating areas and periods, and have sound safety management rules.
quote: 开展无驾驶人智能网联汽车示范运营活动的企业，应当符合以下要求

summary: Demonstration operation with driverless vehicles is permitted only after the vehicle operating certificate is obtained from the Pudong construction and transport department or Lingang管委会 on the basis of the confirmed self-declaration and plates.
quote: 取得前款规定的车辆营运证件的，可以利用无驾驶人智能网联汽车从事示范运营活动

summary: Fee standards must be stated in the operating plan; where fees are charged to the general public, the fee standards must be publicly announced. Government-priced fees follow government pricing.
quote: 收费标准应当在运营方案中载明

summary: Public security traffic management registers qualifying driverless vehicles for licence plates and driving registration documents.
quote: 经公安机关交通管理部门登记，可以取得车辆号牌、行驶证等登记凭证

summary: Firms using registered driverless vehicles for commercial operation must obtain road transport operating qualification; vehicles must suit the business, pass inspection and obtain operating certificates.
quote: 利用符合前款要求的无驾驶人智能网联汽车从事商业化运营的企业，应当取得道路运输经营资质

summary: Pudong science and economy department and Lingang管委会 must strengthen daily supervision of driverless vehicle operation and reinforce back-end monitoring.
quote: 浦东新区科技经济部门和临港新片区管委会应当加强对无驾驶人智能网联汽车运行的日常监督管理

summary: Firms must install monitoring devices, connect data to the designated platform with real-time upload to the municipal platform, and submit periodic innovation application reports to the Pudong or Lingang authority.
quote: 定期向浦东新区科技经济部门或者临港新片区管委会提交创新应用情况报告

summary: Municipal transport department with public security, economy and informatisation and communications authorities designates road sections and areas for application, organises acceptance, publishes them and sets signs and safety notices.
quote: 由市交通部门会同市公安、经济信息化、通信管理等部门根据道路基础条件和实际需要划定并组织开展验收

summary: Pudong science and economy and construction and transport departments and Lingang管委会 must plan and promote vehicle-road cooperative infrastructure and cloud control platforms.
quote: 浦东新区科技经济、建设交通部门和临港新片区管委会应当统筹规划、协调推动建设车路协同基础设施和车路协同云控平台

summary: Vehicle-road cooperative infrastructure and cloud control platforms must provide encrypted data exchange, network protection and real-time security monitoring against tampering, leakage and cyber attacks; the addressee is not named in the text.
quote: 车路协同基础设施和车路协同云控平台应当实现数据交互加密、通信网络防护、实时安全监测

summary: Municipal and Pudong planning and resources department must guide and supervise pilot application of high-precision maps.
quote: 市和浦东新区规划资源部门应当加强对高精度地图应用试点工作的指导和监督管理

summary: Firms applying smart connected vehicle innovation must strictly protect high-precision map data security under the relevant rules.
quote: 严格保护高精度地图数据安全

summary: Firms must report software upgrades (including remote) or hardware changes that may affect vehicle function or performance to the Pudong science and economy department or Lingang管委会.
quote: 应当向浦东新区科技经济部门或者临港新片区管委会报告

summary: For major upgrades or changes affecting vehicle safety, the firm must submit a new safety self-declaration for re-confirmation.
quote: 企业应当提交新的安全性自我声明进行再次确认

summary: Driverless vehicles on road must bear a conspicuous marking, display the temporary plate and vehicle identification plate as required, and comply with road traffic rules.
quote: 应当具有显著标识

summary: Firms must strengthen remote dynamic supervision of vehicles, adjust operating plans as required in adverse conditions, and immediately take avoidance, suspension or termination measures on public security instructions.
quote: 开展无驾驶人智能网联汽车创新应用的企业应当加强车辆远程动态监管

summary: Firms must establish cybersecurity management rules, implement the cybersecurity classified protection system and adopt technical and other necessary measures.
quote: 建立网络安全管理制度，落实网络安全等级保护制度

summary: Firms must establish full-process data security and personal information protection management rules and assign responsibility.
quote: 建立健全全流程数据安全和个人信息保护管理制度

summary: On data leakage or loss involving personal information or national security, firms must take remedial measures, promptly notify users and report to the competent authority.
quote: 按照规定及时告知用户并向有关主管部门报告

summary: Important data collected in innovation application must be stored domestically; where provision abroad is needed, a security assessment under national rules is required; personal information export follows applicable laws.
quote: 开展创新应用过程中收集和产生的重要数据，应当依法在境内存储

summary: On a vehicle fault during innovation application, the firm must judge it under technical requirements and take measures to ensure the vehicle is in a safe state.
quote: 采取相应措施确保车辆处于安全状态

summary: Fault information must be transmitted to the designated supervision platform.
quote: 创新应用企业应当将相关故障信息传输至指定的监管平台

summary: Fault information must be retained for at least one year.
quote: 并保存至少一年

summary: On a traffic accident, the firm must immediately suspend the vehicle, activate hazard warnings, raise the alarm and send staff to the scene as appropriate; within two hours it must upload at least 90 seconds of pre-accident video to the designated platform; it must also run a technical analysis with authorities present and submit an accident analysis report to the Pudong public security traffic authority.
quote: 企业应当立即暂停车辆运行、开启危险警示装置，报警并视情派员现场处置

summary: Accident information and the accident analysis report must be retained for at least one year.
quote: 事故分析报告应当及时报送浦东新区公安机关交通管理部门，并保存至少一年

summary: Firms doing road freight transport with driverless vehicles must buy carrier liability insurance; firms doing passenger transport must buy on-board occupant liability insurance.
quote: 企业应当投保承运人责任保险

summary: Industry organisations and firms are encouraged to jointly establish risk funds; insurers are encouraged to develop products suited to driverless vehicles.
quote: 鼓励相关行业组织、企业等联合设立风险基金

summary: Pudong and Lingang管委会, under guidance from the relevant municipal authority, are to make detailed rules for road testing and demonstration operation of unmanned driving equipment.
quote: 无人驾驶装备道路测试、示范运营等具体管理规定，由浦东新区、临港新片区管委会在市有关主管部门的指导下制定

summary: City government shall give support to enterprises' computing-power key technology R&D under existing policies; the measure sets grants of 25% of actual received national or provincial funding, capped at 5 million yuan.
quote: 市级按照有关政策给予支持

summary: Encourages enterprises to carry out R&D on key computing-power technologies and to undertake national and provincial key R&D tasks.
quote: 鼓励企业开展算力关键技术研发攻关

summary: Public finance shall provide interest subsidies for loans to new computing-infrastructure projects, up to 1.5 percentage points and capped at 50% of interest paid and 10 million yuan per enterprise per year.
quote: 财政资金给予贴息支持

summary: Interest subsidy applies to computing-infrastructure projects included in the government unified layout with total investment of at least 5 million yuan.
quote: 算力基础设施建设项目（总投资规模不低于 5000 万元）

summary: Municipal economic and information authority shall expand computing-power vouchers to a total of 250 million yuan per year, subsidising user enterprises at up to 30% or 20% of contract fees depending on the facility used; single-enterprise annual claims are capped at 8 million yuan.
quote: “算力券”按不超过算力合同费用的 30%给予用户企业补贴

summary: Shall give a one-off reward of up to 500,000 yuan to enterprises whose generative multimodal model obtained the central cyberspace administration filing, based on model evaluation costs.
quote: 给予不超过 50 万元的一次性奖励

summary: One-off reward applies to enterprises that obtained the generative AI model filing from the central cyberspace administration.
quote: 对获得中央网信办生成式人工智能模型备案的企业

summary: Shall reward up to 10 developer enterprises selected for download volume, model performance ranking and community contribution, with tiered awards of 200,000 to 1,000,000 yuan each.
quote: 给予每家 20 万元—100 万元分档奖励

summary: Shall increase policy support for AI competitions and events, with winners eligible to be recognised at corresponding talent levels.
quote: 加大对人工智能赛事的政策支持力度

summary: Shall fund platform construction and R&D for certified future-industry municipal manufacturing innovation centres at up to 50% of approved investment, capped at 5 million yuan and 3 years within the policy validity period.
quote: 按不超过审核确定投入的 50%给予资助

summary: Shall reward up to 5 outstanding AI-large-model solutions achieving first application in manufacturing sub-sectors, with awards capped at 5 million yuan in total.
quote: 实现首次应用的优秀方案给予奖励

summary: Shall foster industry clusters in AI sub-sectors such as high-performance chips, high-speed optical networks, liquid-cooled servers, AI algorithms and multimodal datasets.
quote: 培育高性能芯片、高速光网络、高性能液冷服务器

summary: Shall support eligible enterprises in applying for Hangzhou headquarters status and give policy rewards to newly certified single-champion, specialised-and-sophisticated 'little giant' and hidden-champion enterprises.
quote: 支持符合条件的企业申报杭州总部企业

summary: Districts and counties are encouraged to give rent reductions and team start-up subsidies; the municipality shall give model filing guidance and data-element use services.
quote: 鼓励区、县（市）给予租金减免、团队创业补贴等政策支持

summary: Shall add an AI track within the 'Xihu Mingzhu' talent programme and increase support for AI start-up projects in university student entrepreneurship funding.
quote: 在“西湖明珠工程”中单列人工智能赛道

summary: Shall select outstanding AI growth-stage enterprises and grant them special talent authorisation.
quote: 评选一批优质人工智能成长型企业

summary: Shall support the AI industry alliance in exploring an open training platform; also shall encourage young people and students to learn AI skills.
quote: 支持人工智能产业联盟探索建立开放式培养平台

summary: Encourages enterprises to jointly build school-enterprise AI research institutes and AI talent training bases with universities and research institutes in Hangzhou.
quote: 鼓励企业与在杭高校院所共建校企人工智能研究院

summary: The municipal economic and information authority leads implementation; the funding standards are maximum standards, with city and district governments jointly bearing the funds under the fiscal system. Measures run from 2024-08-19 to 2027-12-31.
quote: 由市经信局负责牵头组织实施

summary: Principle of data quality for all administrators: prohibits recording and disclosure of partial, incomplete, split or misleading data.
quote: Se prohíbe el registro y divulgación de datos parciales, incompletos, fraccionados o que induzcan a error

summary: The purpose of personal data administration must be disclosed to the holder before or at the time authorization is given, where necessary or on request.
quote: La finalidad debe informársele al titular de la información previa o concomitantemente con el otorgamiento de la autorización

summary: Information may not be provided to users or third parties once it ceases to serve the purpose of the database (temporality principle).
quote: La información del titular no podrá ser suministrada a usuarios o terceros cuando deje de servir para la finalidad del banco de datos

summary: Personal data that is not public may not be accessible over the Internet or mass media unless access is technically controlled for restricted holders or authorized users.
quote: Los datos personales, salvo la información pública, no podrán ser accesibles por Internet o por otros medios de divulgación o comunicación masiva

summary: Persons involved in administering non-public personal data must keep the information confidential at all times, including after their relationship ends, and disclose it only as the law allows.
quote: están obligadas en todo tiempo a garantizar la reserva de la información

summary: Administration of semi-private and private data requires prior and express consent of the holder, except financial, credit, commercial and service data and data from third countries.
quote: La administración de datos semiprivados y privados requiere el consentimiento previo y expreso del titular de los datos
conditional_on: Applies to semi-private and private data, not public data or financial credit data

summary: Operators must guarantee at all times the full exercise of habeas data and the right of petition, including access to, updating and correction of the information.
quote: Garantizar, en todo tiempo al titular de la información, el pleno y efectivo ejercicio del derecho de hábeas data

summary: Operators must adopt an internal manual of policies and procedures to ensure compliance, including handling of consultations and claims.
quote: Adoptar un manual interno de políticas y procedimientos para garantizar el adecuado cumplimiento de la presente ley

summary: Operators must keep stored records with due security to prevent deterioration, loss, alteration, unauthorized or fraudulent use.
quote: Conservar con las debidas seguridades los registros almacenados para impedir su deterioro, pérdida, alteración, uso no autorizado o fraudulento.

summary: Operators must periodically and promptly update and rectify data whenever sources report changes.
quote: Realizar periódica y oportunamente la actualización y rectificación de los datos, cada vez que le reporten novedades las fuentes

summary: Operators must process petitions, consultations and claims from holders within the periods set by the law.
quote: Tramitar las peticiones, consultas y los reclamos formulados por los titulares de la información

summary: Operators must comply with instructions and requirements of the supervisory authority.
quote: Cumplir las instrucciones y requerimientos que la autoridad de vigilancia imparta

summary: Sources must ensure that information supplied to operators or users is truthful, complete, accurate, up to date and verifiable (Art. 8(1)); periodically and promptly report all changes, rectify incorrect information and inform operators (Art. 8(2)-(4)).
quote: Garantizar que la información que se suministre a los operadores de los bancos de datos o a los usuarios sea veraz, completa, exacta, actualizada y comprobable

summary: Sources must request and keep copy or evidence of holder authorization, and must not supply data whose supply is not authorized where authorization is required.
quote: Solicitar, cuando sea del caso, y conservar copia o evidencia de la respectiva autorización otorgada por los titulares de la información
conditional_on: Where authorization is required by the law

summary: Sources must certify to the operator every six months that the information supplied has authorization.
quote: Certificar, semestralmente al operador, que la información suministrada cuenta con la autorización

summary: Sources must resolve holders claims and petitions in the manner the law regulates.
quote: Resolver los reclamos y peticiones del titular en la forma en que se regula en la presente ley

summary: Sources must inform the operator when a holder has disputed information under a pending rectification or update request, so the operator records it.
quote: Informar al operador que determinada información se encuentra en discusión por parte de su titular

summary: Sources must comply with instructions of the control authority.
quote: Cumplir con las instrucciones que imparta la autoridad de control en relación con el cumplimiento de la presente ley

summary: Sources must report negative information about holders no later than 18 months after the holder is placed in default (added by Ley 2157 de 2021).
quote: Reportar la información negativa de los titulares, máximo (18) meses después de la constitución en mora del titular.

summary: Users must keep information received confidential and use it only for the purposes for which it was supplied.
quote: utilizar la información únicamente para los fines para los que le fue entregada

summary: Users must inform holders, on request, about how they are using the information.
quote: Informar a los titulares, a su solicitud, sobre la utilización que le está dando a la información
conditional_on: On request of the holder

summary: Users must keep received information with due security against deterioration, loss, alteration, unauthorized or fraudulent use (Art. 9(3)); comply with instructions of the control authority (Art. 9(4)).
quote: Conservar con las debidas seguridades la información recibida para impedir su deterioro, pérdida, alteración, uso no autorizado o fraudulento.

summary: Users must not base credit decisions solely on negative default information from operators; they must weigh it with other risk factors (amended by Ley 2157 de 2021). Use must favour expansion and democratization of credit.
quote: no podrán basarse exclusivamente en la información relativa al incumplimiento de obligaciones suministrada por los operadores

summary: Consultation of financial and credit information by the holder must be free, in every occasion and by every means (amended by Ley 2157 de 2021).
quote: será gratuita

summary: Operators that are independent of sources must be organized as commercial companies, non-profit entities or cooperatives.
quote: Deberán constituirse como sociedades comerciales, entidades sin ánimo de lucro, o entidades cooperativas.
conditional_on: Operators that function as entities independent of sources

summary: Independent operators must have a service area for holders petitions, consultations and claims.
quote: Deberán contar con un área de servicio al titular de la información, para la atención de peticiones, consultas y reclamos.
conditional_on: Operators that function as entities independent of sources

summary: Independent operators must have a security system and technical conditions to keep records secure, accurate and up to date.
quote: Deberán contar con un sistema de seguridad y con las demás condiciones técnicas suficientes
conditional_on: Operators that function as entities independent of sources

summary: Independent operators must update information reported by sources no less often than every ten calendar days from receipt.
quote: Deberán actualizar la información reportada por las fuentes con una periodicidad no superior a diez (10) días calendario
conditional_on: Operators that function as entities independent of sources

summary: Sources must update the information supplied to operators monthly.
quote: Las fuentes deberán actualizar mensualmente la información suministrada al operador

summary: A source may report negative information only after prior communication to the holder, who may pay or dispute the obligation; the communication may be included in periodic statements. The source may report 20 calendar days after sending the communication to the holder's last registered address.
quote: sólo procederá previa comunicación al titular de la información
conditional_on: Negative reports on non-performance of obligations

summary: Operators must remove default data from their databases after the retention term, so users cannot access it; positive data is retained indefinitely; default data expires after the term set in the article (amended by Ley 2157 de 2021). Scores must be updated when negative data is removed (Parágrafo 3).
quote: deberá ser retirada de los bancos de datos por el operador, de forma que los usuarios no puedan acceder o consultar dicha información

summary: For obligations of up to 15% of the monthly minimum wage, negative data may be reported only after at least two communications on different days, with 20 calendar days between the last communication and the report.
quote: solo será reportado después de cumplirse con al menos dos comunicaciones, ambas en días diferentes
conditional_on: Obligations up to 15% of one monthly legal minimum wage

summary: Negative information linked to scores or financial, commercial or credit measurements must be updated at the same time as the negative data is removed or the cause of the reduction ceases.
quote: deberá ser actualizada de manera simultánea con el retiro del dato negativo

summary: The National Government must establish the format in which databases present holder information, identifying among other things the debtor, the amount owed, the arrears and payment date.
quote: El Gobierno Nacional establecerá la forma en la cual los bancos de datos

summary: When a user consults a holder status, the databases must give exact information on current status: positive for those up to date, negative for those in arrears.
quote: estas tendrán que dar información exacta sobre su estado actual
conditional_on: Upon user consultation of a holder status

summary: Processing personal data that contains exclusively unfavourable information is prohibited.
quote: Se prohíbe la administración de datos personales con información exclusivamente desfavorable.

summary: Users may access financial and credit information only for the listed purposes: contract analysis and risk evaluation, market or statistical studies, procedures before authorities or private persons, and other purposes with authorization.
quote: podrá ser accedida por los usuarios únicamente con las siguientes finalidades

summary: Consultations must be answered within ten business days from receipt; if not possible, the holder must be informed of the reasons and the date, not beyond five further business days.
quote: La petición o consulta será atendida en un término máximo de diez (10) días hábiles contados a partir de la fecha de recibo de la misma.

summary: After a complete claim is received, the operator must add a dispute legend (reclamo en trámite) to the individual record within two business days, and keep it until the claim is decided. For claims filed with a source, the source must notify the operator within two business days.
quote: el operador incluirá en el registro individual en un término no mayor a dos (2) días hábiles una leyenda
conditional_on: Claims for correction or update of the individual record

summary: Claims must be resolved within fifteen business days from receipt, extendable by eight business days (amended by Ley 2573 de 2026). The operator must forward the claim to an independent source within two business days; the source must answer within ten business days. The operator must make a full verification.
quote: El término máximo para atender la petición o reclamo será de quince (15) días hábiles
conditional_on: Claims for correction or update of the individual record

summary: In identity-theft cases the source must, within ten business days of the request, compare the disputed documents with those supplied by the holder, modify the negative data and scores, add a Victim of Personal Forgery legend, and file a complaint for fraud (amended by Ley 2573 de 2026).
quote: deberá cotejar, dentro de los diez (10) días hábiles siguientes, los documentos utilizados para adquirir la obligación
conditional_on: Holder reports being a victim of personal forgery and is asked to pay obligations

summary: The Superintendence of Industry and Commerce and the Superintendence Financiera may issue instructions and orders on how the law must be complied with, and may order external system audits at the cost of operators, sources or users.
quote: Impartir instrucciones y órdenes sobre la manera como deben cumplirse las disposiciones de la presente ley

summary: Operators, sources or users must undergo external system audits when the supervisory authority orders them to verify compliance.
quote: Ordenar a cargo del operador, la fuente o usuario la realización de auditorías externas de sistemas
conditional_on: When ordered by the supervisory authority

summary: Operators, sources and users must be able to demonstrate appropriate, effective and verifiable measures to comply, proportional to their legal nature, size, data type, processing type and risks. Those processing data must supply evidence of effective implementation.
quote: deben ser capaces de demostrar que han implementado medidas apropiadas, efectivas y verificables

summary: The effective measures must ensure an administrative organization proportional to the firm, policies consistent with the law, internal mechanisms for implementation and training, and processes for responding to holder consultations, petitions and claims, with special emphasis on data quality, prior notice, confidentiality and security.
quote: las medidas efectivas y apropiadas implementadas por los operadores, fuentes y usuarios de información deberán garantizar

summary: The Superintendence of Industry and Commerce and the Superintendence Financiera must assume the supervisory functions, and the National Government must take the necessary measures to adapt the structure of the Superintendence with budget and technical capacity.
applies_from: Six months after entry into force of the law
quote: adoptará las medidas necesarias para adecuar la estructura de la Superintendencia

summary: Persons already carrying out regulated activities at entry into force have up to six months to adapt their operations to the law. Transitional rules on retention of negative data apply (Art. 21, paragraphs 2-4).
applies_from: Six months after entry into force of the law
quote: tendrán un plazo de hasta seis (6) meses para adecuar su funcionamiento a las disposiciones de la presente ley
conditional_on: Persons already carrying out regulated activities at entry into force

summary: Where personal databases exempted under Art. 2(a) are to be supplied to third parties, the controller must inform the data subject in advance and request authorization.
quote: Cuando estas bases de datos o archivos vayan a ser suministrados a terceros se deberá, de manera previa, informar al Titular y solicitar su autorización.
conditional_on: Databases or files that will be supplied to third parties

summary: Principles apply to all databases, including those exempted under Art. 2, within the limits of the law.
quote: Los principios sobre protección de datos serán aplicables a todas las bases de datos, incluidas las exceptuadas en el presente artículo

summary: The purpose of the processing must be legitimate under the Constitution and the law and must be informed to the data subject (principle of purpose).
quote: El Tratamiento debe obedecer a una finalidad legítima de acuerdo con la Constitución y la Ley, la cual debe ser informada al Titular

summary: Processing may only take place with the prior, express and informed consent of the data subject; personal data may not be obtained or disclosed without prior authorization unless legally or judicially excused (principle of liberty).
quote: El Tratamiento sólo puede ejercerse con el consentimiento, previo, expreso e informado del Titular.

summary: Processing of partial, incomplete, fragmented or misleading data is prohibited (principle of veracity or quality).
quote: Se prohíbe el Tratamiento de datos parciales, incompletos, fraccionados o que induzcan a error

summary: Personal data, except public information, may not be made available on the internet or other mass media unless access is technically controllable and restricted to data subjects or authorized third parties.
quote: Los datos personales, salvo la información pública, no podrán estar disponibles en Internet u otros medios de divulgación o comunicación masiva
conditional_on: Unless access is technically controllable for restricted knowledge

summary: Information must be handled with technical, human and administrative measures necessary to secure records against tampering, loss, unauthorized or fraudulent access or use (principle of security).
quote: se deberá manejar con las medidas técnicas, humanas y administrativas que sean necesarias para otorgar seguridad a los registros

summary: All persons involved in processing non-public personal data must keep the information confidential, even after their relationship with the processing ends (principle of confidentiality).
quote: están obligadas a garantizar la reserva de la información, inclusive después de finalizada su relación con alguna de las labores que comprende el Tratamiento

summary: Processing of sensitive data is prohibited except in the listed cases, including explicit authorization of the data subject and historical, statistical or scientific purposes with identity removed.
quote: Se prohíbe el Tratamiento de datos sensibles, excepto cuando:
conditional_on: Exceptions listed in lits. a) to e)

summary: Processing of personal data of children and adolescents is prohibited, except public data.
quote: Queda proscrito el Tratamiento de datos personales de niños, niñas y adolescentes, salvo aquellos datos que sean de naturaleza pública.
conditional_on: Except data of public nature

summary: The State and educational entities must provide information and train legal representatives and guardians on the risks of improper processing of children's and adolescents' data and on responsible use.
quote: Es tarea del Estado y las entidades educativas de todo tipo proveer información y capacitar a los representantes legales y tutores

summary: The National Government must regulate the matter of children's and adolescents' data protection within six months after promulgation.
applies_from: within six (6) months after promulgation of the law
quote: El Gobierno Nacional reglamentará la materia, dentro de los seis (6) meses siguientes a la promulgación de esta ley.

summary: Data subjects are granted rights to know, update and rectify their data, to request proof of authorization, to be informed on use on request, to complain to the SIC, to revoke authorization or request deletion in the stated cases, and to access their data free of charge.
quote: El Titular de los datos personales tendrá los siguientes derechos:

summary: Processing requires prior and informed authorization of the data subject, obtainable by any means that allows later consultation, subject to the exceptions in the law.
quote: en el Tratamiento se requiere la autorización previa e informada del Titular, la cual deberá ser obtenida por cualquier medio que pueda ser objeto de consulta posterior.
conditional_on: Subject to exceptions in the law (Art. 10)

summary: Any person who accesses personal data without prior authorization, under the exceptions in Art. 10, must still comply with the provisions of the law.
quote: Quien acceda a los datos personales sin que medie autorización previa deberá en todo caso cumplir con las disposiciones contenidas en la presente ley.
conditional_on: Access without prior authorization under Art. 10

summary: Information provided to the data subject must be easy to read, without technical barriers to access, and must correspond fully to the information in the database; information may be supplied by any means, including electronic.
quote: La información deberá ser de fácil lectura, sin barreras técnicas que impidan su acceso

summary: The National Government must establish the manner in which controllers and processors supply information to data subjects.
applies_from: within one year after promulgation of the law
quote: Esta reglamentación deberá darse a más tardar dentro del año siguiente a la promulgación de la presente ley.

summary: When requesting authorization, the controller must clearly and expressly inform the data subject of the processing and its purpose, the optional nature of answers on sensitive data or children's data, the data subject's rights, and the controller's identity and contact details.
applies_from: at the time the authorization is requested
quote: El Responsable del Tratamiento, al momento de solicitar al Titular la autorización, deberá informarle de manera clara y expresa lo siguiente:

summary: The controller must keep proof of compliance with the information duty of Art. 12 and provide a copy to the data subject on request.
quote: deberá conservar prueba del cumplimiento de lo previsto en el presente artículo

summary: Controllers and processors must supply the data subject with all information in the individual record or linked to identification in response to a consultation; the consultation must be answered within ten business days, extendable by up to five further business days with notice.
quote: deberán suministrar a estos toda la información contenida en el registro individual o que esté vinculada con la identificación del Titular.

summary: Claims are handled in steps: incomplete claims are returned within five days; a claim-in-process legend is added to the database within two business days of receipt of a complete claim; the claim must be resolved within fifteen business days, extendable by up to eight further business days with notice; claims forwarded to a competent recipient within two business days.
quote: Una vez recibido el reclamo completo, se incluirá en la base de datos una leyenda que diga “reclamo en trámite” y el motivo del mismo, en un término no mayor a dos (2) días hábiles.

summary: A data subject may file a complaint with the SIC only after exhausting the consultation or claim procedure before the controller or processor.
quote: sólo podrá elevar queja ante la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio una vez haya agotado el trámite de consulta o reclamo

summary: Controllers must guarantee the full and effective exercise of habeas data at all times (Art. 17(a)); the same article also requires that only authorized data be supplied to processors, that information be kept accurate and updated, and that disputed information be notified to the processor.
quote: Garantizar al Titular, en todo tiempo, el pleno y efectivo ejercicio del derecho de hábeas data;

summary: Controllers must request and keep a copy of the data subject's authorization and supply to processors only data whose processing is previously authorized.
quote: Solicitar y conservar, en las condiciones previstas en la presente ley, copia de la respectiva autorización otorgada por el Titular;

summary: Controllers must inform the data subject of the purpose of collection and the rights arising from the authorization; under Art. 17(m) they must also inform the data subject on request about the use of the data.
quote: Informar debidamente al Titular sobre la finalidad de la recolección y los derechos que le asisten por virtud de la autorización otorgada;

summary: Controllers must keep information under the security conditions necessary to prevent tampering, loss, unauthorized or fraudulent consultation, use or access.
quote: Conservar la información bajo las condiciones de seguridad necesarias para impedir su adulteración, pérdida, consulta, uso o acceso no autorizado o fraudulento;

summary: Controllers must rectify incorrect information and inform the processor; under Art. 17(e) to (l) they must also keep information accurate and update it, and notify the processor when information is under dispute.
quote: Rectificar la información cuando sea incorrecta y comunicar lo pertinente al Encargado del Tratamiento;

summary: Controllers must process consultations and claims under the terms set out in the law.
quote: Tramitar las consultas y reclamos formulados en los términos señalados en la presente ley;

summary: Controllers must adopt an internal manual of policies and procedures to ensure compliance, in particular for handling consultations and claims.
quote: Adoptar un manual interno de políticas y procedimientos para garantizar el adecuado cumplimiento de la presente ley y, en especial, para la atención de consultas y reclamos;

summary: Controllers must inform the data protection authority when security code violations occur and there are risks in the administration of data subjects' information.
quote: Informar a la autoridad de protección de datos cuando se presenten violaciones a los códigos de seguridad y existan riesgos en la administración de la información de los Titulares.

summary: Controllers must comply with the instructions and requirements issued by the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio.
quote: Cumplir las instrucciones y requerimientos que imparta la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio.

summary: Processors must guarantee the full and effective exercise of habeas data at all times; they must also update information reported by controllers within five business days of receipt.
quote: Garantizar al Titular, en todo tiempo, el pleno y efectivo ejercicio del derecho de hábeas data;

summary: Processors must keep information under the security conditions necessary to prevent tampering, loss, unauthorized or fraudulent access; under Art. 18(j) they must permit access only to persons who may have access.
quote: Conservar la información bajo las condiciones de seguridad necesarias para impedir su adulteración, pérdida, consulta, uso o acceso no autorizado o fraudulento;

summary: Processors must carry out timely updating, rectification or deletion of data; under Art. 18(d) they must update information reported by controllers within five business days of receipt.
quote: Actualizar la información reportada por los Responsables del Tratamiento dentro de los cinco (5) días hábiles contados a partir de su recibo;

summary: Processors must process consultations and claims from data subjects under the terms set out in the law.
quote: Tramitar las consultas y los reclamos formulados por los Titulares en los términos señalados en la presente ley;

summary: Processors must adopt an internal manual of policies and procedures to ensure compliance, in particular for handling consultations and claims.
quote: Adoptar un manual interno de políticas y procedimientos para garantizar el adecuado cumplimiento de la presente ley y, en especial, para la atención de consultas y reclamos por parte de los Titulares;

summary: Processors must record the claim-in-process legend and insert the judicial-discussion legend in the database when notified by the competent authority.
quote: Insertar en la base de datos la leyenda “información en discusión judicial”

summary: Processors must refrain from circulating information disputed by the data subject where blocking has been ordered by the SIC.
quote: Abstenerse de circular información que esté siendo controvertida por el Titular
conditional_on: Where blocking has been ordered by the SIC

summary: Processors must inform the SIC when security code violations occur and there are risks in the administration of data subjects' information.
quote: Informar a la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio cuando se presenten violaciones a los códigos de seguridad y existan riesgos en la administración de la información de los Titulares;

summary: Processors must comply with the instructions and requirements issued by the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio.
quote: Cumplir las instrucciones y requerimientos que imparta la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio.

summary: The Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio, through a Delegatura for Personal Data Protection, exercises surveillance to ensure that the principles, rights, guarantees and procedures of the law are respected in processing.
quote: La Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio, a través de una Delegatura para la Protección de Datos Personales, ejercerá la vigilancia

summary: The National Government must incorporate within the SIC structure a Superintendente Delegado post to exercise the functions of data protection authority within six months.
applies_from: within six (6) months from the date of entry into force of the law
quote: El Gobierno Nacional en el plazo de seis (6) meses, contados a partir de la fecha de entrada en vigencia de la presente ley incorporará dentro de la estructura de la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio un despacho

summary: The SIC exercises the enumerated functions, including ensuring compliance, investigating and ordering measures, issuing instructions, requesting information, issuing conformity declarations on international transfers, administering the National Public Register of Databases, and recommending regulatory adjustments.
quote: La Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio ejercerá las siguientes funciones:

summary: Those registering databases must submit their information processing policies to the SIC; these policies bind controllers and processors and cannot fall below the duties of the law.
quote: Para realizar el registro de bases de datos, los interesados deberán aportar a la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio las políticas de tratamiento de la información

summary: The SIC administers the National Register of Databases, which is open to free public consultation.
quote: El registro será administrado por la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio

summary: The National Government must regulate, within one year after promulgation, the minimum information the Register must contain and the terms of registration of controllers.
applies_from: within one year after promulgation of the law
quote: El Gobierno Nacional reglamentará, dentro del año siguiente a la promulgación de la presente ley, la información mínima que debe contener el Registro

summary: Transfers of personal data of any kind to countries without adequate levels of data protection are prohibited, subject to the exceptions listed in Art. 26 lits. a) to f).
quote: Se prohíbe la transferencia de datos personales de cualquier tipo a países que no proporcionen niveles adecuados de protección de datos.
conditional_on: Subject to the exceptions in Art. 26 lits. a) to f)

summary: The SIC issues the conformity declaration on international transfers in cases not covered by the exceptions and may request information for that purpose.
quote: corresponderá a la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio, proferir la declaración de conformidad relativa a la transferencia internacional de datos personales.
conditional_on: Cases not contemplated as exceptions in Art. 26

summary: The National Government regulates processing of personal data requiring special provisions, provided such regulation is not contrary to the law.
quote: El Gobierno Nacional regulará lo concerniente al Tratamiento sobre datos personales que requieran de disposiciones especiales.

summary: The National Government must issue regulation on binding corporate rules for certification of good practices in data protection and their transfer to third countries.
quote: El Gobierno Nacional expedirá la reglamentación correspondiente sobre Normas Corporativas Vinculantes para la certificación de buenas prácticas en protección de datos personales

summary: The DAS, or whoever exercises its functions, maintains and updates criminal and national identification records, must omit fully served or time-barred records from certificates, and must keep electronic criminal-record certificate information freely and permanently available online.
quote: mantendrá y actualizará los registros delictivos y de identificación nacional de acuerdo con los informes y avisos

summary: Intelligence and counter-intelligence databases must follow strictly the data processing parameters set in the National Intelligence Plan and the Joint Intelligence Board; a public official refusing information on reserve grounds must do so with reasons stated.
quote: deberán guiarse estrictamente por los parámetros de tratamiento de datos establecidos en el Plan Nacional de Inteligencia y por la Junta de Inteligencia Conjunta

summary: Reserve must be guaranteed to protect the identity of persons subject to intelligence reports, of intelligence officials, and their methods and sources; intelligence reports have no evidentiary value in judicial proceedings.
quote: En todo caso se garantizará la reserva para proteger la identidad de quienes son objeto de dichos informes

summary: Persons already carrying out regulated activities on the law's entry into force have a grace period of up to six months to adapt to its provisions.
applies_from: six months after entry into force of the law (up to)
quote: tendrán un plazo de hasta seis (6) meses para adecuarse a las disposiciones contempladas en esta ley.
conditional_on: Persons already carrying out regulated activities at entry into force

summary: Where personal databases or archives exempted under Art. 2(a) are to be supplied to third parties, the holder must be informed in advance and its authorisation requested; the responsible and processing parties then become subject to the law.
quote: Cuando estas bases de datos o archivos vayan a ser suministrados a terceros se deberá, de manera previa, informar al Titular y solicitar su autorización.
conditional_on: Personal databases or archives kept in an exclusively personal or domestic sphere are to be supplied to third parties

summary: The data protection principles of the law apply to all databases, including those excepted under Art. 2, within the limits of the law and without conflicting with data subject to legal reserve; where special rules for excepted databases provide principles, these apply concurrently.
quote: Los principios sobre protección de datos serán aplicables a todas las bases de datos, incluidas las exceptuadas en el presente artículo

summary: Processing must pursue a legitimate purpose under the Constitution and the law, and the purpose must be disclosed to the data subject (purpose principle).
quote: el tratamiento debe obedecer a una finalidad legítima de acuerdo con la Constitución y la ley, la cual debe ser informada al titular.

summary: Processing may only take place with the prior, express and informed consent of the data subject (freedom principle).
quote: el tratamiento sólo puede ejercerse con el consentimiento, previo, expreso e informado del titular.
conditional_on: Absent a legal or judicial mandate that waives consent

summary: Personal data may not be obtained or disclosed without prior authorisation, or without a legal or judicial mandate that overrides consent.
quote: Los datos personales no podrán ser obtenidos o divulgados sin previa autorización
conditional_on: Absent a legal or judicial mandate that overrides consent

summary: Information subject to processing must be truthful, complete, accurate, up to date, verifiable and comprehensible (accuracy principle); processing of partial, incomplete, fractionated or misleading data is prohibited.
quote: la información sujeta a tratamiento debe ser veraz, completa, exacta, actualizada, comprobable y comprensible.

summary: The controller or processor must guarantee the data subject's right to obtain, at any time and without restrictions, information on the existence of data concerning them (transparency principle).
quote: debe garantizarse el derecho del titular a obtener del responsable del tratamiento o del encargado del tratamiento

summary: Personal data other than public information may not be available on the internet or other mass media unless access is technically controllable and restricted to data subjects or authorised third parties.
quote: no podrán estar disponibles en internet u otros medios de divulgación o comunicación masiva
conditional_on: Unless access is technically controllable for restricted knowledge

summary: Information subject to processing must be handled with the technical, human and administrative measures necessary to secure records against tampering, loss, unauthorised consultation, use or access.
quote: se deberá manejar con las medidas técnicas, humanas y administrativas que sean necesarias para otorgar seguridad a los registros

summary: All persons involved in processing non-public personal data must keep the information confidential, including after their involvement ends, and may disclose it only as the law allows (confidentiality principle).
quote: están obligadas a garantizar la reserva de la información
conditional_on: Data that do not have public character

summary: For sensitive data processed for historical, statistical or scientific purposes, measures leading to suppression of the identity of the holders must be adopted.
quote: deberán adoptarse las medidas conducentes a la supresión de identidad de los Titulares.
conditional_on: Processing for historical, statistical or scientific purposes under Art. 6(e)

summary: Processing of personal data of children and adolescents must ensure respect for their prevailing rights.
quote: En el Tratamiento se asegurará el respeto a los derechos prevalentes de los niños, niñas y adolescentes.

summary: Responsables and Encargados must enable the data subject's rights to know, update and rectify data, request proof of authorization, be informed on use on request, lodge complaints before the SIC, revoke authorization or request deletion in listed cases, and access data free of charge.
quote: Conocer, actualizar y rectificar sus datos personales frente a los Responsables del Tratamiento o Encargados del Tratamiento.
conditional_on: Exercised on the request of the data subject

summary: Whoever accesses personal data without prior authorization in the cases of Art. 10 must nevertheless comply with the provisions of the law.
quote: Quien acceda a los datos personales sin que medie autorización previa deberá en todo caso cumplir con las disposiciones contenidas en la presente ley.
conditional_on: Access without prior authorization under Art. 10

summary: The Responsable must keep proof of compliance with the duty to inform and give a copy to the holder on request.
quote: El Responsable del Tratamiento deberá conservar prueba del cumplimiento de lo previsto en el presente artículo
conditional_on: Copy to be given on request of the holder

summary: Consultations must be answered within a maximum of ten business days from receipt; if not possible, the holder must be informed of the reasons and a date no later than five further business days.
quote: La consulta será atendida en un término máximo de diez (10) días hábiles contados a partir de la fecha de recibo de la misma.

summary: Claims (reclamos) must be processed: incomplete claims are returned for correction within five days, a 'reclamo en tramite' legend is added within two business days and kept until decided, and claims are answered within fifteen business days, extendable by up to eight business days with notice.
quote: el termino máximo para atender el reclamo será de quince (15) días hábiles

summary: The holder may complain to the SIC only after exhausting the consultation or claim procedure before the Responsable or Encargado.
quote: El titular o causahabiente sólo podrá elevar queja ante la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio una vez haya agotado el tramite de consulta o reclamo ante el Responsable del Tratamiento o Encargado del Tratamiento.
conditional_on: Prior exhaustion of consultation or claim procedure

summary: Responsables must guarantee the holder the full and effective exercise of habeas data at all times, and inform the holder on request about the use of their data.
quote: Garantizar al Titular, en todo tiempo, el pleno y efectivo ejercicio del derecho de hábeas data.
conditional_on: Inform on use only upon request of the holder

summary: Responsables must request and keep a copy of the holder's authorization under the law's conditions.
quote: Solicitar y conservar, en las condiciones previstas en la presente ley, copia de la respectiva autorización otorgada por el Titular.

summary: Responsables must duly inform the holder about the purpose of collection and the rights arising from the authorization.
quote: Informar debidamente al Titular sobre la finalidad de la recolección y los derechos que le asisten por virtud de la autorización otorgada.

summary: Responsables must keep information under security conditions preventing alteration, loss, unauthorised or fraudulent access, and must require the Encargado to respect security and privacy conditions.
quote: Conservar la información bajo las condiciones de seguridad necesarias para impedir su adulteración, pérdida, consulta, uso o acceso no autorizado o fraudulento.

summary: Responsables must ensure information given to the Encargado is accurate, complete, updated, verifiable and understandable; update and rectify it and notify the Encargado; and supply only data whose processing is authorized.
quote: Garantizar que la información que se suministre al Encargado del Tratamiento sea veraz, completa, exacta, actualizada, comprobable y comprensible.

summary: Responsables must process consultations and claims within the terms set by the law.
quote: Tramitar las consultas y reclamos formulados en los términos señalados en la presente ley.

summary: Responsables must adopt an internal manual of policies and procedures ensuring compliance with the law, especially for handling consultations and claims.
quote: Adoptar un manual interno de políticas y procedimientos para garantizar el adecuado cumplimiento de la presente ley

summary: Encargados must guarantee the holder the full and effective exercise of habeas data at all times and carry out timely updating, rectification or deletion of data.
quote: Garantizar al Titular, en todo tiempo, el pleno y efectivo ejercicio del derecho de hábeas data.

summary: Encargados must keep information under security conditions preventing alteration, loss, unauthorised or fraudulent access, and allow access only to persons entitled to it.
quote: Conservar la información bajo las condiciones de seguridad necesarias para impedir su adulteración, pérdida, consulta, uso o acceso no autorizado o fraudulento.

summary: Encargados must update information reported by Responsables within five business days of receipt; register the legends required by the law; and refrain from circulating information that is contested and whose blocking the SIC has ordered.
quote: Actualizar la información reportada por los Responsables del Tratamiento dentro de los cinco (5) días hábiles, contados a partir de su recibo.

summary: Encargados must process consultations and claims from holders within the terms set by the law.
quote: Tramitar las consultas y los reclamos formulados por los Titulares en los términos señalados en la presente ley.

summary: Encargados must adopt an internal manual of policies and procedures ensuring compliance with the law, especially for handling holders' consultations and claims.
quote: Adoptar un manual interno de políticas y procedimientos para garantizar el adecuado cumplimiento de la presente ley

summary: Encargados must inform the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio when security code violations occur and risks arise for holders' information.
quote: Informar a la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio cuando se presenten violaciones a los códigos de seguridad
conditional_on: Security code violations and risks to holders' information

summary: The Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio, through a Delegatura for personal data protection, exercises oversight to ensure that personal data processing respects the principles, rights, guarantees and procedures of the law.
quote: ejercerá la vigilancia para garantizar que en el Tratamiento de datos personales se respeten los Principios, derechos, garantías y procedimientos previstos en la presente ley

summary: The national government must incorporate a Superintendente Delegado post within the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio to exercise the functions of data protection authority.
applies_from: within six (6) months from the date of entry into force of the law
quote: El gobierno Nacional en el plazo de seis (6) meses contados a partir de la fecha de entrada en vigencia de la presente ley incorporará dentro de la estructura de la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio un despacho de Superintendente Delegado

summary: The Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio exercises listed functions: monitoring compliance; investigating and ordering measures to make habeas data effective; ordering temporary blocking of data; promoting data subject rights and public awareness campaigns; issuing instructions on measures for controllers and processors to comply; requesting information from controllers and processors; issuing conformity declarations on international transfers; administering the national registry of databases; recommending legal adjustments; and requesting cooperation from foreign entities.
quote: Velar por el cumplimiento de la legislación en materia de protección de datos personales.

summary: Persons registering databases must submit their data processing policies to the Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio; these policies bind controllers and processors and may not fall below the duties of the law.
quote: los interesados deberán aportar a la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio las políticas de tratamiento de la información
conditional_on: when registering databases in the National Registry of Databases

summary: The national government must regulate the minimum information the National Registry of Databases must contain and the terms and conditions for registration of controllers.
applies_from: within one year after promulgation of the law
quote: El Gobierno nacional reglamentará, dentro del año siguiente a la promulgación de la presente Ley, la información mínima que debe contener el Registro

summary: The Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio issues conformity declarations for international transfers in cases not covered by the exceptions, and may request information and carry out proceedings to verify compliance.
quote: corresponderá a la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio, proferir la declaración de conformidad relativa a la transferencia internacional de datos personales
conditional_on: cases not covered by the exceptions of Art. 26

summary: The national government is to issue regulations on binding corporate rules for certification of good practices in personal data protection and their transfer to third countries.
quote: El Gobierno Nacional expedirá la reglamentación correspondiente sobre Normas Corporativas Vinculantes para la certificación de buenas prácticas en protección de datos personales y su transferencia a terceros países.

summary: Persons already carrying on activities regulated by the law at its entry into force must adapt to its provisions within a transition period of up to six months.
applies_from: from the date of entry into force of the law, with up to six (6) months to adapt
quote: tendrán un plazo de hasta seis (6) meses para adecuarse a las disposiciones contempladas en esta ley

summary: Employer may not agree a penalty on a worker who omits the 30-day notice required for indefinite-term contract termination.
quote: En ningún caso se podrá pactar sanción para el empleado que omita el preaviso aquí descrito.

summary: Fixed-term and work-or-task contracts must be in writing; otherwise they are deemed indefinite-term from the start of the relationship.
quote: El contrato de trabajo a término fijo deberá celebrarse por escrito.

summary: Disciplinary sanction proceedings must observe minimum due-process steps (written notice, evidence transfer, response period of at least 5 days, reasoned decision, right to appeal); micro and small employers of fewer than 10 workers only must hear the worker beforehand.
quote: En todas las actuaciones para aplicar sanciones disciplinarias, se deberán aplicar las garantías del debido proceso

summary: Employer must update the internal work regulations to the disciplinary procedure parameters.
quote: El empleador deberá actualizar el Reglamento Interno de Trabajo, acorde con los parámetros descritos dentro de los doce (12) meses siguientes a la entrada en vigencia de la presente Ley

summary: Ministry of Labour must promote an accompaniment and strengthening programme for micro and small firms on due process.
quote: Dentro de los doce (12) meses siguientes a la entrada en vigencia de la presente ley, el Ministerio del Trabajo impulsará un programa de acompañamiento y fortalecimiento a micro y pequeñas empresas

summary: Employer must publish the work regulations by posting two legible copies in two places and through a virtual medium accessible to workers at any time; optional digital dispatch.
quote: el empleador debe publicar el reglamento de trabajo

summary: National Government must implement programmes for job generation and protection (Art. 160 paragraph 1).
quote: El Gobierno nacional implementará programas dirigidos a la generación y protección de empleos

summary: Maximum ordinary working day of 8 hours and 42 hours per week; night-shift work carries a night surcharge; subject to the gradual application under Law 2101 of 2021 and the listed exceptions (flexible schedules, minors, shift work).
quote: tendrá derecho al pago de recargo nocturno

summary: Government may order a reduction of working hours in especially unhealthy or dangerous work, according to expert opinions.
quote: el Gobierno puede ordenar la reducción de la jornada de trabajo

summary: Employer must keep an overtime record per worker, give the worker a statement on request with payment proof, and provide the record to judicial and administrative authorities when required.
quote: El empleador deberá llevar un registro del trabajo suplementario de cada trabajador

summary: Overtime may not exceed 2 hours per day and 12 per week.
quote: En ningún caso las horas extras de trabajo, diurnas o nocturnas, podrán exceder de dos (2) horas diarias y doce (12) semanales.

summary: Work on compulsory rest days is paid with a surcharge: 80% from 1 July 2025.
quote: A partir del primero de julio de 2025, se incrementará el recargo por laborar en día de descanso obligatorio a 80%.

summary: Work on compulsory rest days is paid with a surcharge: 90% from 1 July 2026.
quote: A partir del primero de julio de 2026, se incrementará el recargo por laborar en día de descanso obligatorio a 90%.

summary: Full 100% surcharge for work on compulsory rest days applies from 1 July 2027.
quote: A partir del primero de julio de 2027, se dará plena aplicación al recargo por laborar día de descanso obligatorio

summary: Employer must grant paid leave for listed cases (voting, official duties, domestic calamity, union duties, urgent medical appointments, school duties, judicial summons, bicycle commuting day).
quote: Conceder al trabajador y trabajadora las licencias remuneradas necesarias para los siguientes casos:

summary: Employer must implement reasonable accommodations for workers with disabilities at the workplace.
quote: Implementar ajustes razonables para garantizar el goce y ejercicio de los derechos de las personas con discapacidad

summary: Employer must implement actions guided by the Public Employment Service Unit within 12 months to remove barriers to access and retention of employment.
quote: Implementar acciones guiadas por la Unidad del Servicio Público de Empleo, en un término de doce (12) meses

summary: Employer must grant preferential relocation within the company to women workers who are victims of partner or family violence, as far as possible.
quote: Otorgar en la medida de sus posibilidades el derecho preferente de reubicación en la empresa

summary: Employers with up to 500 workers must hire or keep at least two workers with disabilities per 100 workers; above 500 workers, one additional per each block of 100. Obligation is optional in the first year and mandatory from the second year.
applies_from: second year after entry into force (optional in the first year)
provision: Art. 15 num. 17 and par. 3 (adding Art. 57 CST)
quote: deberán contratar o mantener contratados, según corresponda, al menos dos (2) trabajadores con discapacidad por cada 100 trabajadores.

summary: Employer must report contracts with workers with disabilities to the Ministry of Labour within 15 days of signing.
applies_from: second year after entry into force (per Art. 15 par. 3)
quote: El empleador deberá reportar los contratos de trabajo celebrados con personas con discapacidad, dentro de los quince días siguientes a su celebración

summary: Managerial powers of subordination may not be used as a factor of discrimination on listed grounds (sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, disability, health condition, political or religious preferences, union membership, among others).
quote: Aquellas facultades no pueden constituirse en un factor de discriminación

summary: Ministry of Labour must carry out administrative actions and sanctions for discriminatory use of subordination powers.
quote: El Ministerio del Trabajo adelantará las actuaciones administrativas correspondientes y sancionará de acuerdo con las normas vigentes

summary: Employers must guarantee that pregnant workers are not required to perform physically strenuous tasks and must keep or relocate them to suitable work without salary reduction.
quote: es obligación de los empleadores garantizar la permanencia y la reubicación en un puesto de trabajo acorde con su estado

summary: Employer may not discriminate against workers who are victims of gender-based violence (num. 12), dismiss or pressure resignation on religious, political, racial, ethnic or mental-health grounds (nums. 13, 15), or limit religious or political freedom (num. 14).
quote: Despedir o presionar la renuncia de las personas trabajadoras por razones de carácter religioso, político, racial y/o étnico.

summary: Prevention and care actions, protocols, committees and mechanisms must be guaranteed against violence and harassment in the world of work, including gender-based violence and sexual harassment; the addressee is not named in the text.
quote: Se garantizarán acciones de prevención y atención, con protocolos, comités, herramientas y mecanismos necesarios

summary: Ministry of Labour must supervise compliance with the anti-harassment rules and sanction non-compliance under Laws 1010/2006, 1257/2008 and 2365/2024; the National Government must comply with Art. 12 of Law 1257/2008.
quote: El Ministerio del Trabajo vigilará y sancionará su incumplimiento

summary: Ministry of Labour must formulate a public policy with protocols, plans, programmes and strategies against violence, harassment and discrimination at work.
quote: formulará una política pública que contemple unos protocolos, planes, programas y estrategias

summary: In every labour relation, public or private, equal working conditions without discrimination must be guaranteed to reintegrated and reincorporated persons from the armed conflict.
quote: En toda relación laboral, pública o privada, se deberá garantizarla igualdad de condiciones laborales sin discriminación alguna

summary: Ministry of Labour with other bodies must develop strategies and measures to promote formal employment of reintegrated persons.
quote: desarrollarán, promoverán y adoptarán estrategias y medidas orientadas a fomentar la inserción laboral formal de esta población

summary: Ministry of Labour must issue the regulation recognising productive and occupational activities in prisons as prior work experience.
quote: El Ministerio de Trabajo en un término de 6 meses expedirá la reglamentación necesaria

summary: Sponsoring company must pay apprentices a monthly support of at least 75% of the minimum wage in the first year and 100% in the second for dual training, and at least 75%/100% for lective/practical phases of traditional training; health coverage and risk affiliation as dependent employees.
quote: el aprendiz recibirá de la empresa un apoyo de sostenimiento mensual

summary: Practical or dual phase time of apprentices must be certified by the company and recognised as work experience.
quote: El tiempo correspondiente a la fase práctica o dual deberá ser certificado por la empresa

summary: ADRES must pay the monthly remuneration of medical interns during the compulsory rotating internship; contributions are based on one minimum monthly wage.
quote: el cual será pagado por la Administradora de los Recursos del Sistema General de Seguridad Social en Salud (ADRES)

summary: Companies obliged to meet the apprenticeship quota must pay SENA a monthly amount of 1.5 minimum monthly wages per apprentice not hired, pro rata for partial monetisation.
quote: tendrán que cancelar al SENA un valor mensual

summary: SENA must submit an annual report to the seventh committees of Congress on beneficiaries and allocation of monetisation resources, with a copy to the Comptroller General.
quote: el SENA deberá rendir un informe anual a las comisiones séptimas del Congreso

summary: Platform companies must clearly inform delivery workers, in plain language, of the scope of their working modality (dependent or independent), and give prior notice of any material contract change with reasons and a chance to comment.
applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation and implementation required by Art. 67
quote: deberán informar de manera clara y en un lenguaje sencillo a los trabajadores digitales en servicios de reparto el alcance de la modalidad de trabajo
conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

summary: Exclusivity clauses may not be agreed for delivery activities in the independent modality; platform companies must guarantee the right to rest.
applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation required by Art. 67
quote: no podrán pactarse cláusulas de exclusividad para el desarrollo de las actividades de reparto
conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

summary: Platform companies must create a full-identity recognition mechanism for each delivery worker and a record of subscription or terms, respecting habeas data.
applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation required by Art. 67
quote: deberán crear un mecanismo de reconocimiento de identidad plena que permita individualizar al trabajador digital en servicios de reparto
conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

summary: ICT Ministry must support and create technical tools needed by the Labour Ministry for labour inspection; the coordination must be regulated within 12 months.
quote: apoyará y creará las herramientas técnicas especializadas que requiera el Ministerio del Trabajo

summary: For dependent delivery workers, platform companies must pay social security contributions in the statutory proportions; for independent workers, the platform pays 60% of health and pension contributions and all occupational risk cover, with the contribution base at 40% of platform income.
applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation required by Art. 67
quote: la empresa de plataforma digital de reparto concurrirá en el pago de aportes a salud y pensión en 60%
conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

summary: Platform companies must generate effective-service hour reports for the collection entities, and deliver them to each worker at the end of every month.
applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation required by Art. 67
quote: Esta información deberá ser entregada al trabajador digital en servicios de reparto al final de cada mes.
conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

summary: Labour and Health Ministries must regulate the contribution method for independent delivery workers earning less than the minimum daily wage per month.
quote: El Ministerio del Trabajo y el Ministerio de Salud y Protección Social reglamentará la forma de cotización

summary: Every platform company must register with the Labour Ministry and report quarterly the number of active workers in dependent and independent modalities.
applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation required by Art. 67
quote: Toda empresa de plataformas digitales de reparto tendrá que realizar su inscripción ante el Ministerio del Trabajo
conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

summary: Platforms must inform delivery workers about automated monitoring systems and automated decision systems affecting working conditions (access to orders, income, OSH, working time, promotion, account suspension), in a concise, plain-language document.
applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation required by Art. 67
quote: Las empresas de plataformas digitales de reparto deberán informar a los trabajadores y trabajadoras digitales sobre:
conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

summary: Platforms may process personal data of delivery workers only for purposes included in the data processing authorisation accepted by the worker, presented in plain language.
applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation required by Art. 67
quote: solamente tratarán datos personales de los trabajadores y trabajadoras digitales en servicios de reparto para finalidades que estén contempladas en la autorización
conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

summary: Platforms must periodically supervise and evaluate the impact on working conditions of individual decisions taken or supported by automated systems.
applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation required by Art. 67
quote: supervisarán y evaluarán periódicamente el impacto que tienen en las condiciones de trabajo las decisiones individuales
conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

summary: Delivery workers have the right to request human review of any decision made or supported by an automated decision system affecting their service conditions.
applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation required by Art. 67
quote: tendrán derecho a solicitar revisión humana de cualquier decisión hecha o soportada por un sistema automatizado de toma de decisiones
conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

summary: Platforms may not suspend, restrict or cancel a delivery worker's account, or withhold remuneration, without justification; terms may not discriminate on listed grounds (health, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, politics, nationality, union membership).
applies_from: 12 months after Government completes the regulation required by Art. 67
quote: no podrá ser suspendido, restringido o cancelado de la plataforma o retenida su remuneración injustificadamente
conditional_on: Government regulation and implementation under Art. 67

summary: Labour Ministry through SENA, with other ministries, must design, formulate and implement a rural work training programme to certify ancestral and empirical knowledge.
quote: diseñarán, formularán e implementarán un programa de formación para el trabajo rural

summary: Domestic workers must be engaged under a written employment contract and registered in PILA; PILA registration has publicity effects only and is not a condition of validity.
quote: los trabajadores y las trabajadoras del servicio doméstico deben ser vinculadas mediante contrato de trabajo escrito

summary: ICT Ministry must develop guidelines for an information system to register domestic workers within 12 months.
quote: desarrollará los lineamientos para crear un sistema de información para dicho registro

summary: Microenterprises using partial-time social security contributions must register at their Chamber of Commerce, keep accounting books of income and expenses, and keep an internal register of employment contracts.
quote: creando libros de contabilidad en los que registre ingresos y gastos

summary: National Government must prioritise and protect listed sectors (hotels, restaurants, bars, agriculture, tourism, transport, pharmacies) in the partial-time contribution scheme.
quote: El Gobierno nacional priorizará y protegerá a los sectores de hotelería, restaurantes, bares, agricultura, turismo y transporte

summary: Employers with up to 50 employees, or larger firms whose sales growth over two years is at or below CPI, may receive the CREA EMPLEO benefit for new full-time jobs, subject to listed conditions.
quote: Podrán ser beneficiarias aquellas Empresas con hasta 50 empleados al momento de la postulación
conditional_on: Benefit for up to six months per new job; subject to unemployment rate above OECD average

summary: Financial institutions carry out the disbursement of CREA EMPLEO resources in coordination with the Labour Ministry; employers apply through their deposit-account institution with listed documents.
quote: Las entidades financieras realizarán la dispersión de los recursos en coordinación con el Ministerio del Trabajo.

summary: Health Ministry, DIAN, Civil Registry and Chambers of Commerce must send listed databases to UGPP to validate applicants for the CREA EMPLEO benefit.
quote: deberán enviar la información correspondiente a la Unidad Administrativa Especial de Gestión Pensional y Contribuciones Parafiscales de la Protección Social (UGPP)

summary: Labour Ministry must issue a binding operating manual setting the calendar, transfer mechanism, certification and restitution procedures for CREA EMPLEO.
quote: El Ministerio del Trabajo, mediante un Manual Operativo vinculante, establecerá el calendario

summary: Government must formulate a public policy supporting agricultural work within the first year after entry into force, and present a bill regulating agricultural contracts within 6 months.
applies_from: first year after entry into force
quote: el estado formulará una política pública de apoyo al trabajo agropecuario

summary: Government must present to Congress, within 6 months, a bill regulating agricultural contracts and the agricultural day wage.
quote: presentará al Congreso de la República un proyecto de ley que regule los contratos agropecuarios

summary: Employment must facilitate migration regularisation for foreign workers once a contract is signed; the Foreign Ministry must regulate the process within 6 months.
quote: se facilitará la regulación migratoria de la persona trabajadora

summary: Foreign workers in regulated professions must prove academic and professional suitability before the Education Ministry, as set out by the Ministry.
quote: quienes deberán acreditar su idoneidad académica y profesional de acuerdo con los estándares internacionales ante el Ministerio de Educación Nacional

summary: Entities running emergency-response, reforestation and afforestation policies must fill at least 50% of required jobs with local or specially protected persons; the addressee is described generically in the text.
quote: deberán contar con un mínimo del 50% de los puestos de trabajo que se requieran cubiertos por personal de la región

summary: Professional sports clubs and organisations must engage professional athletes and technical staff under a special employment contract.
