quote: deberán ser vinculados y vinculadas por estas mediante contrato de trabajo especial

summary: Labour and Interior Ministries must promote participation spaces within 12 months to build the instrument for decent work of ethnic communities.
quote: los Ministerios de Trabajo e Interior propiciarán los espacios de participación

summary: Contracts for arts and culture workers must be in writing, specify object, duration, pay and pay days, and carry the same rights as labour contracts; without express written terms the relationship is indefinite.
quote: Debe formalizarse por escrito en cualquiera de sus modalidades

summary: Employers of journalists and media workers must grant a compensatory rest day when the mandatory rest day is not enjoyed, and provide everything needed with occupational safety and health conditions.
quote: el empleador deberá concederle el correspondiente día de descanso compensatorio

summary: Labour Ministry with the Commerce Ministry must create first-job and last-job programmes with incentives for firms, within 6 months.
quote: dentro de los seis (6) meses posteriores a la entrada en vigencia de la presente Ley

summary: User companies may not conclude commercial contracts with temporary service companies for situations other than those set out in the article, nor extend a specific service once its cause subsists.
provision: Art. 45 par. 1 (adding to Art. 77 Law 50 of 1990)
quote: Las empresas usuarias no podrán celebrar contratos comerciales con las empresas de servicios temporales para desarrollar situaciones diferentes

summary: Contracts with workers placed by temporary service companies must specify the cause that gave rise to the placement.
quote: En el contrato con el trabajador en misión, se debe especificar la causa que dio lugar a su vinculación

summary: Employer must respond within 15 working days to a request for flexible hours or remote work by workers with caregiving responsibilities, either accepting with an implementation process or refusing with justification or proposing an alternative.
quote: estará obligado a otorgar una respuesta en un término máximo de quince (15) días hábiles

summary: Employer may not use fraudulently the differentiated prerogatives granted to certain sectors or to micro and small firms in order to undermine labour rights.
quote: se prohíbe al empleador el uso fraudulento de las prerrogativas diferenciadas

summary: Labour and Interior Ministries, with the Victims Unit, must create, regulate and implement a labour-agreements programme for conflict victims within 12 months.
quote: creará, reglamentará e implementará el programa de convenios laborales con enfoque diferencial

summary: Public entities and contractors of publicly funded projects are to seek a minimum of 10% of required jobs filled by local personnel, prioritising conflict victims, PDET and ZOMAC municipalities.
quote: procurarán, contar con un mínimo del 10% de sus puestos de trabajo que se requieran cubiertos por personal de la región

summary: Labour Ministry must set, within 12 months, guidelines for green-growth labour skills, including worker training in sustainable practices.
quote: en el término de doce (12) meses contados a partir de la entrada en vigencia de la presente Ley, los lineamientos

summary: Labour Ministry through SENA must train and build capacity of workers for green and blue jobs, with priority to sectors in transition and to women, youth and older adults.
quote: El Ministerio del Trabajo a través del SENA formará y capacitará a los trabajadores y trabajadoras

summary: For transnational telework (work from abroad under a Colombian contract), the employer must hold insurance covering at least health care benefits in case of accident or illness.
provision: Art. 52 (replacing Art. 2 Law 1221 of 2008, lit. d)
quote: responsabilidad del empleador contar con un seguro que cubra al menos las prestaciones asistenciales en salud

summary: Employer must grant a connectivity allowance to teleworkers earning less than two minimum wages, replacing the transport allowance; only one such allowance may be received.
quote: El empleador deberá otorgar el reconocimiento de un auxilio de conectividad

summary: Occupational risk administrators must guarantee coverage of work accidents and occupational diseases of transnational teleworkers in the country where they work.
provision: Art. 54 (adding num. 14 to Art. 6 Law 1221 of 2008)
quote: Las Administradoras de Riesgos Laborales deberán garantizar la cobertura

summary: Employer must provide training programmes for teleworkers on technological tools, time management and remote communication skills.
provision: Art. 54 (adding num. 15 to Art. 6 Law 1221 of 2008)
quote: El empleador deberá proporcionar programas de formación y capacitación para teletrabajadores

summary: National Government must regulate incentives for remote work modalities within one year after the law's approval.
applies_from: 1 year after approval of the law
quote: los incentivos reglamentados por el Gobierno nacional dentro del año siguiente a la aprobación de la presente Ley

summary: Employer must permit the entry of assistance, emotional support or therapeutic animals when the worker presents a certificate issued by a psychologist or psychiatrist.
quote: El ingreso de animales de asistencia, apoyo emocional o uso terapéutico deberá ser permitido por el empleador
conditional_on: Worker presents certificate of need

summary: Labour and Health Ministries must issue guidelines within 12 months for responsible animal keeping in workplaces.
quote: expedirá dentro de los doce (12) meses siguientes a la entrada en vigencia de la presente ley, los lineamientos

summary: The State, through the Labour Ministry, must implement a public policy on labour protection and transition in the face of automation.
quote: implementará una política pública de protección y transición laboral ante la automatización

summary: State, in coordination with mining, oil and energy firms, must promote and support closure plans and labour protection for workers affected by decarbonisation; the policy must include incentives, protection mechanisms, reconversion and financing.
quote: promoverá y respaldará la formulación de planes de cierre y protección de derechos laborales para todos los trabajadores

summary: Health and Labour Ministries must make technical adjustments to PILA within 6 months to allow partial-time and concurrent contributions.
applies_from: 6 months after expedition of the law
quote: deberán reglamentar lo dispuesto en el presente artículo en un término de seis (6) meses

summary: Government must regulate within 6 months the mechanisms guaranteeing social security affiliation for agricultural employers and their dependent workers.
quote: reglamentará, en un plazo no mayor a seis (6) meses

summary: Labour Ministry must promote within 12 months a support programme for micro and small firms and a programme to promote labour formalisation.
quote: el Ministerio del Trabajo impulsará un programa de acompañamiento y fortalecimiento a micro y pequeñas empresas

summary: Employer may deposit monthly into the severance fund 8.33% of the base salary as an advance deposit, and parties may agree to monthly payment of severance interest of 1%.
provision: Art. 64 (adding par. 1 to Art. 99 Law 50 of 1990)
quote: El empleador podrá aportar mensualmente con destino al fondo de cesantías el 8.33%

summary: Dependent workers in extreme poverty, moderate poverty or vulnerability may remain in the subsidised health regime for 6 months while formalised.
quote: podrán permanecer en el régimen subsidiado de salud por un plazo de 6 meses
conditional_on: Population in extreme poverty, moderate poverty or vulnerability per government targeting

summary: Labour Ministry through the Public Service Unit must promote an employability programme creating placement services for those completing qualification programmes.
quote: fomentará un programa para la promoción de la empleabilidad

summary: The employability programme must present an annual report to the Permanent Concertation Commission on goal fulfilment and impact measurement.
quote: se presentará un informe anual sobre el cumplimiento de metas y medición de impacto

summary: ICBF must progressively employ community mothers, childcare-centre workers and substitute mothers, with a progression schedule set within 12 months; full implementation targeted for 2029 subject to budget.
applies_from: 12 months after entry into force (progression schedule)
quote: El ICBF establecerá la progresividad para la vinculación de las y los trabajadores en un término no mayor a doce (12) meses
conditional_on: Subject to budget availability

summary: The School Feeding Programme operator must ensure that food handlers are formalised as workers, in four annual stages: 25% in 2025.
quote: En el año 2025, se formalizarán hasta el 25% del total de personas manipuladoras de alimentos
conditional_on: Subject to the Medium-Term Fiscal Framework

summary: Food handlers formalised: up to 50% in 2026.
quote: En el año 2026, se formalizarán hasta el 50% del total de personas manipuladoras de alimentos
conditional_on: Subject to the Medium-Term Fiscal Framework

summary: Food handlers formalised: up to 75% in 2027.
quote: En el año 2027, se formalizarán hasta el 75% del total de personas manipuladoras de alimentos
conditional_on: Subject to the Medium-Term Fiscal Framework

summary: Food handlers formalised: up to 100% in 2028.
quote: En el año 2028, se formalizarán hasta el 100% del total de personas manipuladoras de alimentos
conditional_on: Subject to the Medium-Term Fiscal Framework

summary: Superintendence of Private Security must issue within 30 days an act updating the regulated minimum tariff for private security services to reflect the labour changes.
quote: deberá expedir el acto administrativo correspondiente que actualice la tarifa mínima regulada

summary: The SIC's analysis of whether a receiving country offers an adequate level of protection must be oriented to whether that country guarantees protection, based on standards (a) to (f) listed in section 3.1.
applies_from: from publication in the Diario Oficial (Sec. 4)
quote: estará orientado a determinar si dicho país garantiza la protección de los mismos, con base en los siguientes estándares

summary: The SIC exercises its regulatory capacity at any time to review the list of countries with an adequate level of protection and to add or exclude countries.
applies_from: from publication in the Diario Oficial (Sec. 4)
quote: La Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio ejercerá, en cualquier tiempo, su capacidad regulatoria para revisar la lista anterior

summary: Even when transferring to a country with an adequate level of protection, controllers must be able to demonstrate appropriate and effective measures to ensure proper processing of the transferred data and security of the records at the time of transfer.
applies_from: from publication in the Diario Oficial (Sec. 4)
quote: los Responsables del Tratamiento, en virtud del principio de responsabilidad demostrada, deben ser capaces de demostrar que han implementado medidas apropiadas y efectivas
conditional_on: transfer to a country on the adequate-protection list in num. 3.2

summary: For a transfer to a country not on the list, the controller making the transfer must verify whether the operation falls within an exception in Article 26 of Law 1581 of 2012, or whether the country meets the standards in num. 3.1; if neither applies, it must request a declaration of conformity from the SIC.
applies_from: from publication in the Diario Oficial (Sec. 4)
quote: corresponderá al Responsable del tratamiento que efectuará la transferencia verificar si la operación está comprendida dentro de una de las causales de excepción
conditional_on: transfer to a country not on the list in num. 3.2

summary: To request a declaration of conformity, the controller must file a petition with the SIC, providing the information in the SIC's published guide; supporting documents sent must be translated into Spanish.
applies_from: from publication in the Diario Oficial (Sec. 4)
quote: el Responsable del tratamiento deberá radicar una petición ante la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio
conditional_on: request for a declaration of conformity

summary: Where the controller signs a transfer contract or other legal instrument setting conditions and guarantees, the transfer may proceed after prior communication to the SIC's Delegatura para la Protección de Datos Personales describing the operation and declaring that the contract or instrument has been signed; the operation is then presumed viable.
applies_from: from publication in the Diario Oficial (Sec. 4)
quote: previa comunicación remitida a la Delegatura para la Protección de Datos Personales de la Superintendencia de Industria y Comercio
conditional_on: controller has signed a transfer contract or other legal instrument ensuring protection

summary: Data centres that started operation before 1 July 2026 must be built and operated to reach an annual-average PUE of at most 1.5 from 1 July 2027 and 1.3 from 1 July 2030.
quote: Rechenzentren, die vor dem 1. Juli 2026 den Betrieb aufnehmen oder aufgenommen haben, sind so zu errichten und zu betreiben, dass sie
conditional_on: Exemptions for climate-neutral firms may be set by ordinance under § 18

summary: Data centres starting operation from 1 July 2026 must reach PUE of at most 1.2 and a reused-energy share of at least 10% (planned 15% from July 2027 and 20% from July 2028 vintages), permanently as annual average within two years of commissioning.
quote: Die Anforderungen nach Satz 1 sind spätestens zwei Jahre nach Inbetriebnahme im Jahresdurchschnitt dauerhaft zu erreichen.
conditional_on: Reused-energy share not required where the operator proves a § 11(3) case (subsequent events without fault, heat-network agreement, or offer at cost not accepted within six months)

summary: To be relieved of the reused-energy share, the operator must prove one of three cases: shortfall from later events without fault, a qualifying waste-heat agreement with a municipality or heat-network operator (with investment plan, cost and price terms), or a heat-network operator not accepting an at-cost offer within six months.
quote: Die Anforderungen nach Absatz 2 Satz 1 Nummer 2 sind nicht anzuwenden, wenn der Betreiber des Rechenzentrums nachweist, dass eine der nachfolgenden Voraussetzungen erfüllt ist

summary: A heat-network operator that receives an offer from a data-centre operator to use reused energy must inform the data-centre operator of the heat network's capacity.
quote: Der Betreiber des Wärmenetzes, dem vom Betreiber des Rechenzentrums ein Angebot zur Nutzung wiederverwendeter Energie nach Satz 1 Nummer 3 unterbreitet wird, ist verpflichtet, den Betreiber des Rechenzentrums über die Kapazität des Wärmenetzes zu informieren.

summary: The general waste-heat avoidance and reuse duties of § 16 apply correspondingly to data centres, unless Section 4 sets more specific requirements.
quote: Die Anforderungen nach § 16 sind für Rechenzentren entsprechend anzuwenden, soweit in diesem Abschnitt keine spezielleren Anforderungen gestellt sind.

summary: Data-centre operators must cover the electricity consumption of their data centres on a balance-sheet basis with renewable electricity: 50% from 1 January 2024 and 100% from 1 January 2027.
quote: Betreiber von Rechenzentren decken den Stromverbrauch in ihren Rechenzentren bilanziell

summary: Data-centre operators must set up an energy or environmental management system by 1 July 2025, including continuous measurement of electrical power and energy demand of main components and measures to improve energy efficiency continuously.
quote: kontinuierliche Messungen zur elektrischen Leistung und zum Energiebedarf der wesentlichen Komponenten des Rechenzentrums durchzuführen
conditional_on: Exempt if at least 50% of reused energy goes into a heat network and average consumption is at most 7.5 GWh (§ 12(4)), or if scheduled out of operation before 1 July 2027 (§ 12(6))

summary: From 1 January 2026, the management system must be validated or certified for data centres of 1 MW or more, and for publicly owned or publicly operated data centres of 300 kW or more.
quote: besteht ab dem 1. Januar 2026 die Pflicht zur Validierung oder Zertifizierung des Energie- oder Umweltmanagementsystems
conditional_on: Not applicable if scheduled out of operation before 1 July 2027 (§ 12(6))

summary: IT operators (colocation customers maintaining IT of 50 kW or more) must meet the management-system requirements of § 12(1)-(2) correspondingly.
quote: Betreiber von Informationstechnik haben die Anforderungen nach den Absätzen 1 und 2 entsprechend zu erfüllen.
conditional_on: Not applicable if the IT is scheduled out of operation before 1 July 2027 (§ 12(6))

summary: From 1 January 2026, IT operators with IT connected load of 500 kW or more (300 kW or more if operated on behalf of public bodies) must have their management system validated or certified.
quote: Für Betreiber von Informationstechnik, die im Auftrag öffentlicher Träger betrieben werden, besteht die Pflicht nach Satz 2 zur Validierung oder Zertifizierung
conditional_on: Not applicable if the IT is scheduled out of operation before 1 July 2027 (§ 12(6))

summary: To use the § 12(6) exemption for planned decommissioning before 1 July 2027, the data-centre or IT operator must provide corresponding evidence.
quote: Entsprechende Nachweise sind vom Betreiber des Rechenzentrums oder der Informationstechnik zu erbringen.

summary: Data-centre operators must publish the Anlage 3 information about their data centre (identity, size class, location, floor area, connected load, electricity, renewable share, waste heat, data volume, PUE, reused energy, cooling and water efficiency) for the previous calendar year by 31 March each year.
quote: Informationen über ihr Rechenzentrum nach Maßgabe der Anlage 3 für das vorangegangene Kalenderjahr zu veröffentlichen

summary: Data-centre operators must transmit the Anlage 3 information to the Federation by 31 March each year, using the federal electronic template; first transmission by 15 May 2024 (500 kW or more) or 1 July 2025 (200 kW to under 500 kW).
quote: Betreiber von Rechenzentren haben die Informationen nach § 13 Absatz 1 Satz 1 erstmals

summary: IT operators must provide information for 2023 to the Federation by 31 March 2024, preferably using the federal electronic template.
quote: hierzu soll die vom Bund bereitgestellte elektronische Vorlage verwendet werden

summary: Data-centre operators offering services to third parties must show each customer the annual energy consumption directly attributable to that customer, from 1 January 2024.
quote: Bieten Betreiber von Rechenzentren Dienstleistungen für Dritte (Kunden) an

summary: The Federal Government establishes an energy-efficiency register for data centres storing the § 13(1) information and transferring it to a European database on data centres.
quote: Die Bundesregierung errichtet ein Energieeffizienzregister für Rechenzentren

summary: Firms (Unternehmen) averaging more than 7.5 GWh must set up an energy or environmental management system, including recording of energy flows and waste heat, identification of feasible savings and waste-heat measures, and economic assessment under DIN EN 17463; deadline 18 July 2025 or 20 months after reaching the status.
quote: hat mindestens folgende zusätzliche Anforderungen als Teil des Energie- oder Umweltmanagementsystems zu erfüllen
conditional_on: Until the system is set up (at most until the deadline), exempt from energy audits under § 8(1) EDL-G

summary: Firms averaging more than 2.5 GWh must, within three years, prepare and publish concrete implementation plans for all savings measures identified as economic in their management systems or energy audits, confirmed beforehand by certifiers, environmental verifiers or energy auditors; trade secrets are excluded from publication.
quote: Unternehmen sind verpflichtet, sich die Vollständigkeit und Richtigkeit der nach Satz 1 erstellten Umsetzungspläne vor der Veröffentlichung durch Zertifizierer, Umweltgutachter oder Energieauditoren bestätigen zu lassen.

summary: Firms must, on request of the Bundesamt für Wirtschaft und Ausfuhrkontrolle in sample checks, submit Anlage 2 evidence within four weeks, and prove the § 9 confirmation via the authority's electronic template.
quote: Das Bundesamt für Wirtschaft und Ausfuhrkontrolle ist berechtigt, zu dem in Satz 1 genannten Zweck von Unternehmen die Vorlage von Nachweisen nach der Anlage 2

summary: Firms must avoid waste heat according to the state of the art, reduce it to the technically unavoidable share, and reuse it, so far as possible and reasonable; installations requiring a BImSchG § 4 permit are excluded where more specific rules exist.
quote: Unternehmen haben die anfallende Abwärme durch Maßnahmen und Techniken zur Energieeinsparung durch Abwärmenutzung wiederzuverwenden, soweit dies möglich und zumutbar ist.
conditional_on: Not for firms averaging 2.5 GWh or less (§ 16(4))

summary: Firms must, on request of heat-network or district-heating operators and other potential heat buyers, give information on their waste heat (name, site, annual heat quantity and maximum thermal output, time profiles, control options, average temperature).
quote: Unternehmen sind auf Anfrage von Betreibern von Wärmenetzen oder Fernwärmeversorgungsunternehmen und sonstigen potenziellen wärmeabnehmenden Unternehmen verpflichtet, Auskunft zu geben
conditional_on: Not for firms averaging 2.5 GWh or less (§ 17(4))

summary: Firms must transmit the § 17(1) waste-heat information to the Bundesstelle für Energieeffizienz by 31 March each year and update it without delay on changes; first transmission by 1 January 2024.
quote: Unternehmen sind verpflichtet, unabhängig vom Vorliegen einer konkreten Anfrage die in Absatz 1 aufgeführten Informationen zu anfallender Abwärme an die Bundesstelle für Energieeffizienz
conditional_on: Not for firms averaging 2.5 GWh or less (§ 17(4))

summary: The Bundesstelle für Energieeffizienz publishes the waste-heat information on a public platform, protecting trade secrets; information whose publication would endanger public or national security is kept in a non-public area.
quote: Die Bundesstelle für Energieeffizienz stellt die übermittelten Informationen unter Wahrung von Betriebs- und Geschäftsgeheimnissen nach Satz 1 auf einer öffentlich zugänglichen Plattform für Abwärme übersichtlich bereit.

summary: Public bodies using 1 GWh or more per year must cut final energy consumption by 2% per year until 2045 through individual measures, with shortfalls made up within two years.
quote: Bei Verfehlung des Ziels muss die Menge der nicht erbrachten Einsparung in den zwei jeweiligen Folgejahren eingespart werden.
conditional_on: Exclusions for research installations (§ 6(5)) and housing companies (§ 6(6))

summary: Public bodies averaging 3 GWh or more must set up an energy or environmental management system, and those of 1 to under 3 GWh a simplified one, by 30 June 2026.
quote: sind verpflichtet, ein vereinfachtes Energiemanagementsystem bis zum Ablauf des 30. Juni 2026 einzurichten

summary: The Länder ensure implementation of the public-sector exemplary-role rules of Directive 2012/27/EU in their territory and report total final energy consumption of public bodies and municipalities by 1 November each year; federal public bodies report their data to the competent body.
quote: Die öffentlichen Stellen des Bundes sind verpflichtet, ihre Daten an die zuständige Stelle nach § 7 Absatz 1 und 2 Nummer 2 und 3 zu berichten.

summary: The Federation must achieve new final-energy savings of at least 45 TWh per year, and the Länder at least 3 TWh per year (split by Anlage 1), through strategic measures from 2024 to 2030, with at least 5% benefiting households lacking means for essential energy services.
quote: Strategische Maßnahmen nach den Absätzen 1 und 2 müssen zu einem Anteil von je mindestens 5 Prozent dazu beitragen, dass der Endenergieverbrauch von privaten Haushalten sinkt

summary: The Bundesamt für Wirtschaft und Ausfuhrkontrolle, as Bundesstelle für Energieeffizienz, monitors savings duties, supplies reporting templates, supports the ministry, and builds and runs the waste-heat platform.
quote: Aufbau und Betrieb einer Plattform für Abwärme nach § 17 Absatz 2 und 3

summary: The Bundesamt für Wirtschaft und Ausfuhrkontrolle must check by sampling the set-up and operation of firms' management systems and the preparation and publication of implementation plans.
quote: durch Stichproben bei den Unternehmen zu kontrollieren

summary: The Federal Government reports to the Bundestag on the act's effects at the start of each electoral term, and reviews the savings figures and reports on post-2030 targets in 2027.
quote: dem Deutschen Bundestag einen Bericht zur Fortschreibung der Energieeffizienzziele für den Zeitraum nach 2030 vorlegen

summary: The Federal Ministry of Defence reports, in aggregated and anonymised form, final energy consumption and savings of defence facilities not excluded under § 21(1) No. 2.
quote: Das Bundesministerium der Verteidigung berichtet Endenergieverbräuche und -einsparungen

summary: The Bundeskartellamt may determine by order that an undertaking active to a considerable extent on markets under § 18(3a) has overriding cross-market significance for competition; the order must be time-limited to five years after it becomes final (Bestandskraft), and the authority may consider the listed factors (dominance, financial resources, vertical integration, access to competition-relevant data, access of third parties to markets).
quote: Das Bundeskartellamt kann durch Verfügung feststellen
conditional_on: Applies to the determination order under § 19a(1) Satz 1; time limit runs from the order becoming final (Bestandskraft)

summary: An undertaking determined under § 19a(1) may be prohibited by the Bundeskartellamt from the conduct listed in § 19a(2) Nr. 1 to 7, including preferential treatment of own offers when mediating market access, obstructing other undertakings' market activity, tying or conditioning use of services, using competition-relevant data to raise entry barriers, refusing interoperability or data portability, insufficient information to other undertakings, and demanding disproportionate advantages; the prohibition does not apply where the conduct is objectively justified, with the burden of proof on the undertaking; the prohibition order may be combined with the determination under § 19a(1).
quote: dem Unternehmen untersagen
conditional_on: Requires a prior determination under § 19a(1) and a prohibition order by the Bundeskartellamt; does not apply where the conduct is objectively justified (sachlich gerechtfertigt)

summary: The Federal Ministry for Economic Affairs and Energy (Bundesministerium für Wirtschaft und Energie) reports to the legislative bodies on experience with the provision after four years from entry into force of paragraphs 1 and 2.
quote: Das Bundesministerium für Wirtschaft und Energie berichtet den gesetzgebenden Körperschaften
conditional_on: Four years after entry into force (Inkrafttreten) of the regulations in § 19a(1) and (2); the text gives no calendar date

summary: Providers and prospective providers of Annex I Section A and Annex III high-risk AI systems must submit the real-world testing plan to the competent market surveillance authority before testing outside a sandbox; the test must take place before placing on the market or putting into service and needs the authority's approval (deemed granted after 30 days without reply).
quote: müssen sie den Plan für den Test unter Realbedingungen bei der zuständigen Marktüberwachungsbehörde vorlegen
conditional_on: Real-world testing under Art. 60 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 outside an AI regulatory sandbox

summary: Before placing on the market or putting into service an Annex III No. 2 (critical infrastructure) high-risk AI system, providers or their authorised representatives must register themselves and the system in the Bundesnetzagentur's non-public register, supplying the Annex VIII Section A information; Länder public bodies are exempt.
quote: müssen Anbieter oder deren Bevollmächtigte sich und das Hochrisiko-KI-System im Register nach Absatz 1 registrieren
conditional_on: High-risk AI system listed in Annex III No. 2 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689

summary: Deployers that are federal public bodies must register themselves and an Annex III No. 2 high-risk AI system in the non-public register before putting it into service or using it, supplying the Annex VIII Section C information.
quote: müssen Betreiber sich und das Hochrisiko-KI-System im Register nach Absatz 1 registrieren, wenn es sich bei den Betreibern um öffentliche Stellen des Bundes im Sinne des § 2 des Bundesdatenschutzgesetzes handelt
conditional_on: Deployer is a federal public body within § 2 of the Bundesdatenschutzgesetz

summary: If a provider or an authorised representative established in Germany ceases business, the person responsible for liquidation or dissolution takes over the documentation-keeping duty of Art. 18(1) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689.
quote: so hat der für die Liquidation oder Auflösung der juristischen Person Verantwortliche die Pflicht aus Artikel 18 Absatz 1 der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689
conditional_on: Cessation of business of the provider or authorised representative

summary: The competent market surveillance authorities supervise real-world testing outside sandboxes and approve the test and plan if Art. 60(4) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 is met.
quote: Die zuständige Marktüberwachungsbehörde genehmigt den Test unter Realbedingungen und den Plan für den Test unter Realbedingungen, wenn die Vorgaben des Artikels 60 Absatz 4 der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689 eingehalten sind.

summary: The KI-Marktüberwachungskammer acts with complete independence and submits an annual activity report to the Bundestag (first for 2026, due each 31 March).
quote: Die KI-Marktüberwachungskammer legt dem Bundestag jährlich einen Tätigkeitsbericht vor.

summary: A coordination and competence centre at the Bundesnetzagentur supports authorities with expertise on request, coordinates cooperation and uniform answers to horizontal legal questions, facilitates codes of conduct, involves civil society, unions, business, research and the Länder, and provides training and guidance.
quote: Bei der Bundesnetzagentur wird ein zentrales Koordinierungs- und Kompetenzzentrum für die Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689 eingerichtet.

summary: The single point of contact (Bundesnetzagentur) publishes the authorities' electronic contact addresses, notifies the Commission of the authorities' names and tasks, receives submissions from the AI Office, the public and others and forwards them; market surveillance and notifying authorities supply and update their contact information.
quote: Die zentrale Anlaufstelle gibt die elektronischen Kontaktadressen nach Absatz 2 sowie ihre eigene elektronische Kontaktadresse öffentlich bekannt.

summary: Authorities under §§ 2 and 3 fulfil their reporting obligations under Regulation (EU) 2024/1689 through the single point of contact using its electronic forms; the Art. 70(6) report is the Federal Ministry for Digital Affairs' responsibility, and BaFin may report directly where legal reasons require.
quote: erfüllen die nach den §§ 2 und 3 zuständigen Behörden die aus der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689 resultierenden Berichtspflichten über die zentrale Anlaufstelle

summary: Market surveillance authorities must notify the Commission and other Member States of non-compliance not confined to Germany (Art. 79, 81) and of risks despite compliance (Art. 82) without delay, through the Bundesanstalt für Arbeitsschutz und Arbeitsmedizin.
quote: hat die zuständige Marktüberwachungsbehörde unverzüglich über die Bundesanstalt für Arbeitsschutz und Arbeitsmedizin vorzunehmen

summary: The Bundesnetzagentur, as central complaints office, receives complaints about infringements of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, forwards them to the competent authority and informs the complainant, and sets up an accessible complaints management system; other market surveillance authorities forward or copy complaints they receive.
quote: richtet die Bundesnetzagentur ein Beschwerdemanagementsystem ein, das leicht zugänglich, barrierefrei und benutzerfreundlich ausgestaltet ist

summary: Market surveillance and notifying authorities cooperate, inform each other of intended measures, involve data protection authorities, the CRA market surveillance authority and the Bundeskartellamt, and may exchange information including personal data and trade secrets where strictly necessary.
quote: Die Marktüberwachungsbehörden und die notifizierenden Behörden arbeiten zur Erfüllung ihrer Aufgaben im Rahmen ihrer jeweiligen Zuständigkeiten kooperativ und vertrauensvoll zusammen.

summary: Before taking measures against a federal or Länder public body found in breach, market surveillance authorities must inform its supervisory authority and give it the opportunity to comment within a reasonable period, unless urgency or overriding public interest requires otherwise.
quote: so ist dies der für die jeweilige öffentliche Stelle zuständigen Rechts- oder Fachaufsichtsbehörde mitzuteilen und dieser vor Durchführung von Maßnahmen gegenüber der öffentlichen Stelle Gelegenheit zur Stellungnahme innerhalb einer angemessenen Frist einzuräumen

summary: BaFin staff and persons it engages, and recipients of facts passed on by BaFin, must not disclose or use without authorisation confidential facts, including trade secrets, learned in their work, also after leaving office.
quote: Die bei der Bundesanstalt für Finanzdienstleistungsaufsicht beschäftigten und die von ihr beauftragten Personen dürfen solche ihnen bei ihrer Tätigkeit bekanntgewordenen Tatsachen

summary: The CRA market surveillance authority (BSI in the interim) informs the competent AI market surveillance authority of suspected cybersecurity non-compliance of high-risk AI systems; the Bundesnetzagentur and the CRA authority draw up joint cybersecurity testing specifications (BaFin its own for financial entities), and they contribute to Commission guidelines, harmonised standards and common specifications on Art. 15(5).
quote: erstellen hierfür gemeinsame Vorgaben für die Prüfung der für Hochrisiko-KI-Systeme gemäß Artikel 6 der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689 geltenden Anforderungen an die Cybersicherheit

summary: Tax authorities must disclose tax-secret data (§ 30 Abgabenordnung) to market surveillance authorities on request without delay when the request shows the data are needed for tasks under Regulations (EU) 2024/1689 and 2019/1020.
quote: Die Finanzbehörden haben nach § 30 der Abgabenordnung geschützte Daten den Marktüberwachungsbehörden auf Ersuchen unverzüglich zu offenbaren

summary: The Bundesnetzagentur carries out innovation-support measures: general information and guidance (especially for SMEs, start-ups and public bodies), case-specific advice to public bodies on AI-system and high-risk status (subject to an administrative agreement covering costs; main considerations published), training, studies, networking and standardisation work.
quote: Die Bundesnetzagentur führt innovationsfördernde Maßnahmen gemäß der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689 durch.

summary: The Bundesnetzagentur must establish and operate at least one AI regulatory sandbox under Art. 57-58 of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689, cooperating with affected authorities (the data protection authority assesses Art. 59 requirements).
quote: Die Bundesnetzagentur errichtet und betreibt mindestens ein KI-Reallabor nach den Artikeln 57 und 58 der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689.

summary: Beyond Art. 62(1)(a) of the AI Act, the Bundesnetzagentur must give research institutions, universities and their spin-offs with a seat or branch in the EU priority access to its sandbox if they meet the eligibility and selection criteria of the Art. 58(1) implementing acts.
quote: auch Forschungseinrichtungen sowie Hochschulen und deren Ausgründungen, die ihren Sitz oder eine Zweigniederlassung in der Europäischen Union haben, vorrangigen Zugang zu dem KI-Reallabor
conditional_on: Eligibility and selection criteria set in Commission implementing acts under Art. 58(1) of Regulation (EU) 2024/1689

summary: The Bundesnetzagentur keeps a non-public register (Art. 49(5) AI Act) of Annex III No. 2 high-risk AI systems and may share its contents only with competent market surveillance authorities, the Commission and other bodies under the AI Act, not with third parties.
quote: Die Bundesnetzagentur führt ein nicht-öffentliches Register nach Artikel 49 Absatz 5 der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689 über Hochrisiko-KI-Systeme nach Anhang III Nummer 2 der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689.

summary: The Federal Government must carry out a first evaluation of the supervisory and authority structure within 18 months of entry into force and report the results to the Bundestag.
quote: Die Bundesregierung führt spätestens 18 Monate nach Inkrafttreten dieses Gesetzes eine erste Evaluierung der Aufsichts- und Behördenstruktur durch.

summary: The Federal Government must evaluate within three years of entry into force the effectiveness of the structure for an innovation-friendly, low-bureaucracy and effective implementation, considering firms', authorities' and civil-society assessments, and report to the Bundestag.
quote: im Hinblick auf eine innovationsfreundliche, bürokratiearme und wirksame Durchführung der Verordnung (EU) 2024/1689

summary: Reproductions of lawfully accessible works may be made for text and data mining (permission; the text names no specific addressee).
quote: Zulässig sind Vervielfältigungen von rechtmäßig zugänglichen Werken für das Text und Data Mining.
conditional_on: Works must be lawfully accessible.

summary: Reproductions made for text and data mining must be deleted once they are no longer necessary for that purpose.
quote: Die Vervielfältigungen sind zu löschen, wenn sie für das Text und Data Mining nicht mehr erforderlich sind.
conditional_on: Reproductions are no longer necessary for text and data mining.

summary: Uses under the text and data mining permission are not permitted where the rights holder has reserved them.
quote: Nutzungen nach Absatz 2 Satz 1 sind nur zulässig, wenn der Rechtsinhaber sich diese nicht vorbehalten hat.
conditional_on: The rights holder has not reserved the use.

summary: A rights holder's reservation of use for online-accessible works is effective only if made in machine-readable form.
quote: Ein Nutzungsvorbehalt bei online zugänglichen Werken ist nur dann wirksam, wenn er in maschinenlesbarer Form erfolgt.
conditional_on: The work is online-accessible and the rights holder reserves use.

summary: Designates Digitaliseringsstyrelsen, Datatilsynet and Domsstolsstyrelsen as national competent authorities; Digitaliseringsstyrelsen also as bemyndigende myndighed, central contact point and market surveillance authority for certain prohibited-practice supervision; Datatilsynet and Domsstolsstyrelsen as market surveillance authorities for other parts.
quote: Digitaliseringsstyrelsen, Datatilsynet og Domsstolsstyrelsen udpeges som nationale kompetente myndigheder

summary: National competent authorities supervise compliance with the AI Regulation, this Act and rules issued under it.

applies_from: annually after entry into force, until end of delegation period
quote: Kommissionen vurderer behovet for at ændre listen i bilag III

summary: By 2 Aug 2028 and every four years, the Commission evaluates and reports on Annex III areas, transparency-list changes and governance effectiveness; it also evaluates the AI Office, energy-efficiency standardisation (for general-purpose models) and voluntary codes (every three years).
applies_from: 2 Aug 2028 and every four years thereafter
quote: Senest den 2. august 2028 og hvert fjerde år derefter evaluerer Kommissionen og aflægger rapport

summary: By 2 Aug 2029 and every four years thereafter, the Commission reports to Parliament and Council on evaluation and revision of the Regulation, including enforcement structure.
applies_from: 2 Aug 2029 and every four years thereafter
quote: Senest den 2. august 2029 og hvert fjerde år derefter forelægger Kommissionen Europa-Parlamentet og Rådet en rapport

summary: By 2 Aug 2031 the Commission evaluates enforcement of the Regulation and reports to Parliament, Council and the EESC.
quote: Senest den 2. august 2031 foretager Kommissionen en evaluering af håndhævelsen af denne forordning

summary: The AI Board, Member States and national competent authorities provide information to the Commission on request, without undue delay, for the review tasks in Art. 112(1)-(7).
quote: Med henblik på stk. 1-7 indgiver AI-udvalget, medlemsstaterne og de nationale kompetente myndigheder oplysninger til Kommissionen på dennes anmodning
conditional_on: Commission request for information for evaluations

summary: The Dirección General de Inteligencia Artificial is designated as notifying authority and must establish and carry out procedures for evaluating, designating and notifying conformity assessment bodies, and supervising and sanctioning them (Art. 4.1 also transfers the notifying authority's functions under Art. 28 of the Regulation).
quote: siendo el órgano responsable de establecer y llevar a cabo los procedimientos necesarios para la evaluación, designación y notificación de los organismos de evaluación de la conformidad

summary: The notifying authority must limit, suspend or withdraw the designation of a notified body that fails its obligations or requirements, after an administrative procedure with a hearing, and must inform the European Commission and other Member States.
quote: limitará, suspenderá o retirará la designación, según el caso
conditional_on: Notified body no longer meets Art. 31 requirements or fails its obligations

summary: Market surveillance authorities perform the functions of surveillance, inspection and sanctioning power for AI systems under Chapter IX, Section 3 of the Regulation.
quote: Corresponden a las autoridades de vigilancia del mercado todas las funciones de vigilancia, inspección

summary: Designates AESIA as market surveillance authority for listed prohibited practices, high-risk systems in Annex III points 1(c), 2, 3, 4 and 5 (with exceptions), Annex I point 6 systems, and systems subject to Art. 50 transparency; Art. 5(3) designates the AEPD and regional data protection authorities, Art. 5(4) the CGPJ, Art. 5(5) the Banco de España, Art. 5(6) the CNMV, Art. 5(7) the DGSFP, each for defined systems.
quote: Se designa a la AESIA como autoridad de vigilancia del mercado de los siguientes sistemas de IA

summary: Where a sectoral market surveillance authority notifies AESIA that it lacks adequate technical, financial and human means, AESIA assumes those functions, coordinating with the sectoral authority until it confirms it has the means.
quote: asumirá tales funciones la Agencia
conditional_on: Sectoral authority notifies lack of adequate means

summary: The Council of Ministers, by agreement on a proposal of the Secretaría de Estado, designates market surveillance authorities for cases not expressly covered, including new prohibited-practice areas; AESIA is the default authority until such designation.
quote: corresponderá al Consejo de Ministros, mediante Acuerdo
conditional_on: Cases not expressly covered by the law, or new supervision areas from delegated acts or amendment of the Regulation

summary: The Secretaría de Estado de Digitalización e Inteligencia Artificial makes communications to the European Commission on the identities and functions of market surveillance authorities.
quote: Corresponden a la Secretaría de Estado de Digitalización e Inteligencia Artificial las comunicaciones a la Comisión Europea

summary: A market surveillance authority whose decisions may affect the interests or competences of another must obtain a mandatory report from that other authority before deciding; the report must be sent within a maximum of ten working days.
quote: deberá aquella recabar informe preceptivo de estas antes de resolver
conditional_on: Decision or action may affect interests or competences of another authority

summary: Market surveillance authorities submit to the European Commission, through the single point of contact and every two years, a report on the state of their financial and human resources, including an assessment of their adequacy.
quote: presentarán a la Comisión Europea, a través del punto de contacto único, y con carácter bienal, un informe sobre el estado de sus recursos financieros y humanos

summary: AESIA is designated as single point of contact under Art. 70.2 of the Regulation.
quote: Se designa a la AESIA como punto de contacto único

summary: The single point of contact must keep publicly accessible, by electronic means, the contact information of the competent market surveillance authorities and of itself, and provide a single identifiable contact channel.
quote: Mantener públicamente accesible, por medios electrónicos, la información de contacto de las autoridades de vigilancia del mercado competentes

summary: The single point of contact coordinates the presentation to the Commission and AI Board of advisory opinions on qualified alerts, the biennial resource report, annual information on competition-relevant findings, annual information on prohibited practices, and the annual report on administrative fines and litigation under Art. 99.11.
quote: la presentación del informe anual a la Comisión Europea de las multas administrativas que se hayan impuesto

summary: Market surveillance authorities carry out the actions needed for supervision and control, in preliminary actions and during sanctioning proceedings; inspection staff must be career officials or hold public authority status, and AESIA inspection staff must keep secrecy.
quote: realizarán las actuaciones que sean precisas para el ejercicio de su función de supervisión y control

summary: Confidentiality duties under Art. 78 of the Regulation must be guaranteed in all market surveillance or sanctioning action.
quote: se deberán garantizar los deberes de confidencialidad exigidos en el artículo 78

summary: Market surveillance authorities must exchange any operational information needed for coordination, taking into account incidents and information exchanged in the AI Board and Commission guidelines.
quote: se suministrarán e intercambiarán cualquier información operativa que asegure la adecuada coordinación

summary: Market surveillance authorities inform about serious incidents under Arts. 73 and 76, about evaluation, corrective and provisional measures under Arts. 79 and 80 (where the infringement exceeds national territory or a system is high-risk), and about findings under Art. 82, subject to the Art. 74.4 exclusion.
quote: Informarán sobre los incidentes graves, de acuerdo con los artículos 73 y 76
conditional_on: Subject to exclusion in Art. 74.4 of the Regulation; some items depend on cross-border or risk conditions

summary: Where a high-risk AI system presents a risk to public health or fundamental rights, the market surveillance authority must notify the risk within a maximum of ten working days to the competent ministries and rights authorities, who must issue a mandatory report within the same period.
quote: notificarán el riesgo detectado en un plazo no superior a diez (10) días hábiles
conditional_on: Compliant high-risk system presents risk to public health or fundamental rights

summary: Market surveillance authorities use the information system of Art. 34 of the Market Surveillance Regulation to exchange data on application of the AI Regulation and other product safety law.
quote: harán uso del sistema de información y comunicación del artículo 34

summary: AESIA promotes effective collaboration among market surveillance authorities for risk prevention and application of the supervision regime.
quote: La AESIA fomentará la efectiva colaboración de las actuaciones de las autoridades de vigilancia del mercado

summary: A collegiate body, the Comisión mixta de colaboración entre autoridades de vigilancia del mercado, is created to exchange information and good practice; AESIA chairs it and provides its secretariat, and it must publish its operating rules.
quote: se creará, como órgano colegiado, la Comisión mixta de colaboración entre autoridades de vigilancia del mercado

summary: Market surveillance authorities exchange information on their activities for the annual report under Art. 5(5) and (6) of the Regulation, and transfer documentation to the authority supervising fundamental rights obligations where risks to fundamental rights are detected.
quote: intercambiarán información sobre las actividades que realicen para garantizar la elaboración del informe anual
conditional_on: Where fundamental rights risks are detected

summary: Any natural or legal person with grounds to consider the Regulation has been breached may submit a complaint to the competent market surveillance authority under Art. 85 of the Regulation; complaints do not confer interested-party status in sanctioning proceedings.
quote: podrá presentar una reclamación ante la autoridad de vigilancia del mercado competente
conditional_on: Grounds to consider a breach of the Regulation

summary: AESIA establishes a single window for complaints and must forward them to the competent surveillance authorities within a maximum of ten working days from receipt.
quote: La AESIA establecerá un sistema de ventanilla única para la presentación de dichas reclamaciones

summary: Persons who report, through the channels of Directive (EU) 2019/1937 and Law 2/2023, infringements of the Regulation or of this law, in a work or professional context, are entitled to the protection of that law by the Autoridad Independiente de Protección del Informante or regional authorities.
quote: tendrán derecho a la protección establecida en dicha norma
conditional_on: Reports made through the channels of Directive (EU) 2019/1937 and Law 2/2023

summary: AESIA is the competent authority responsible for establishing the one sandbox that is mandatory under Art. 57.1 of the Regulation.
quote: La AESIA será la autoridad competente responsable de establecer el espacio controlado de pruebas para la IA de obligada creación

summary: Additional AI regulatory sandboxes may be created by at least one competent authority (notifying or market surveillance) within its own competence; market surveillance authorities for Annex I section B products may also create them where requirements have been integrated into their harmonisation acts.
quote: deberá ser llevada a cabo por, al menos, una autoridad competente designada en los artículos 4 y 5 de la presente ley
conditional_on: Within the authority's competence; Annex I section B products under Art. 2.2 of the Regulation

summary: The authority responsible for a sandbox must inform the AI Office and AI Board through the single point of contact, demonstrate sufficient resources, submit annual reports under Art. 57.16 of the Regulation through the single point of contact, and make those reports public from the start of operation.
quote: la autoridad competente deberá acreditar la asignación de recursos suficientes para el desarrollo del espacio controlado de pruebas para la IA

summary: Coordination of the AI sandboxes must include the authorities that define public policy in the sectors concerned and, where relevant, the authorities protecting fundamental rights.
quote: En la coordinación de los espacios controlados de pruebas para la IA se deberá incluir a las autoridades responsables de definir las políticas públicas

summary: Entities of the state public sector must provide relevant and up-to-date information on their use of AI systems in exercising their functions; Art. 12(4) excludes military, national security, critical infrastructure, research, cybersecurity, access-to-information and fraud-prevention systems.
quote: Las entidades que forman el sector público estatal deberán ofrecer información pertinente y actualizada sobre la utilización de sistemas de IA en el ejercicio de sus funciones
conditional_on: Art. 12(4) exemptions apply to listed systems

summary: An inventory of AI systems for the state public sector, interoperable with the EU high-risk registry under Art. 49 of the Regulation, must be prepared; for each algorithm or AI system the information must include at least the provider, deployer, other operators and the categorisation of the system.
quote: se elaborará un inventario de sistemas de IA para el sector público estatal interoperable

summary: Information on AI systems used to prevent and control tax fraud must be incorporated into the inventory only in a manner compatible with the confidential nature of the tax control plan, and must not allow those systems to be known, reproduced, inferred or circumvented.
quote: sin que pueda incluirse información que permita conocer, reproducir, inferir o eludir dichos sistemas
conditional_on: Information on AI systems used for tax fraud prevention

summary: State public sector entities must promote awareness, dissemination and training on responsible, sustainable and trustworthy development and use of AI within their scope.
quote: Las entidades del sector público estatal promoverán, en su ámbito, actuaciones dirigidas a la concienciación

summary: Each state public sector entity must designate an AI delegate for internal policy development and compliance; the delegate advises on impact assessments under Art. 23.1 of Law 15/2022 and Art. 27 of the Regulation; the delegate must be a career civil servant, or permanent employee with AI and regulatory expertise, with functions set by regulation.
quote: Cada entidad del sector público estatal deberá designar, en el ejercicio de sus competencias, a un delegado de IA
conditional_on: Where the entity has competences over AI systems

summary: Competent authorities exercising sanctioning power must observe proportionality between sanction and infringement, weighing factors listed in Art. 31(1)(a) to (j), including harm to health, safety and fundamental rights, duration, cooperation and recidivism.
quote: Las autoridades competentes, en el ejercicio de su potestad sancionadora, deberán guardar la debida proporcionalidad entre la sanción y el hecho constitutivo de la infracción

summary: Competent authorities must communicate to AESIA the sanctions imposed, the facts constituting the infringements, the identity of the offender where a legal person, and the progress of related litigation, safeguarding confidentiality under Art. 78 of the Regulation.
quote: Las autoridades competentes comunicarán a la AESIA las sanciones impuestas

summary: AESIA must publish the sanctions imposed by all market surveillance authorities within a maximum of 15 working days from receiving the communication; published resolutions must exclude personal data and confidential matters.
quote: La AESIA publicará en un plazo no superior a 15 días hábiles desde la comunicación

summary: AESIA, as single point of contact, must communicate to the European Commission the administrative sanctions imposed each year under this law and related litigation, under Art. 99.11 of the Regulation, and to the AI Board where applicable under Art. 101.4.
quote: La AESIA, en calidad de punto de contacto único, comunicará a la Comisión Europea las sanciones administrativas

summary: Sanctioning proceedings are initiated ex officio and must be resolved within eighteen months for very serious and serious infringements and nine months for minor ones; the authority must issue a reasoned final resolution stating whether an infringement exists.
quote: El plazo para resolver en estos procedimientos será de dieciocho meses en los expedientes por infracciones muy graves y graves

summary: Persons within the subjective scope of the law must deal with the competent authority by electronic means under Art. 14(2) of Law 39/2015.
quote: Los sujetos comprendidos en el ámbito subjetivo de esta norma deberán relacionarse con el órgano competente por medios electrónicos

summary: For public sector entities and constitutional bodies that commit infringements, the market surveillance authority must issue a resolution declaring the infringement and issuing a formal warning, with corrective measures, excluding administrative fines under Art. 99.8 of the Regulation; the resolution must be notified to the entity and its hierarchical superior.
quote: dictará resolución declarando la infracción, apercibiendo a la entidad u órgano actuante
conditional_on: Infringement committed by a public sector entity or constitutional body

summary: The Government must promote the regulatory initiative to adapt AESIA into a public law entity, with separate legal personality, own assets, management autonomy and administrative power, and must ensure its independence and resources.
applies_from: Within six months from entry into force of this law
quote: el Gobierno impulsará la correspondiente iniciativa normativa para la adaptación de la Agencia Española de Supervisión de Inteligencia Artificial

summary: Algorithmic, automated and AI systems used in the prevention and control of tax fraud are reserved: they must not be made public, communicated or accessible, nor disclosed to taxpayers or to bodies outside tax application, where disclosure could compromise enforcement.
provision: Disposición final primera (art. 116.3 Ley 58/2003, as inserted)
quote: no será objeto de publicidad, comunicación o acceso público
conditional_on: Where disclosure could compromise the effectiveness of tax enforcement actions

summary: The social security management entities must cooperate with the competent market surveillance authority for AI systems, supplying strictly necessary data to identify those responsible for infringements where identification by other means has failed, under Art. 5 of the law.
provision: Disposición final segunda (art. 77.1.p Ley General de la Seguridad Social, as inserted)
quote: La colaboración con la autoridad de vigilancia del mercado competente
conditional_on: Identification of responsible persons by other means has not been possible

summary: AESIA is designated as market surveillance authority for high-risk AI systems listed in Annex III point 8 used in democratic processes (systems intended to influence election or referendum outcomes or voting behaviour), excluding campaign administration tools; and for Annex III point 1 biometric systems used in democratic processes, excluding biometric verification-only systems.
provision: Disposición final tercera (Disposición adicional novena, Ley Orgánica 5/1985, as inserted)
quote: Se designa a la AESIA como autoridad de vigilancia de mercado de los siguientes sistemas de IA de alto riesgo
conditional_on: Systems used in democratic processes

summary: The Government is empowered to adopt all regulations necessary for the development and application of the law (regulatory development power).
quote: Se faculta al Gobierno para que pueda dictar cuantas disposiciones sean necesarias

summary: A royal decree must regulate the national database for registering high-risk AI systems associated with critical infrastructure under Annex III point 2 of the Regulation, as provided by Art. 49.5 of the Regulation.
quote: Se regulará mediante real decreto la base de datos nacional para el registro

summary: The national critical-infrastructure AI registry database is to be jointly managed by the designated market surveillance authority and the Secretaría de Estado de Seguridad, in accordance with rules on critical entities and classified matters.
quote: Esta base de datos será gestionada de forma conjunta entre la autoridad de vigilancia del mercado designada

summary: Controller or processor must allow relatives, de facto partners or heirs of a deceased person to request access, rectification or erasure, subject to the deceased's prohibition or legal bar.
quote: podrán dirigirse al responsable o encargado del tratamiento al objeto de solicitar el acceso a los datos personales de aquella
conditional_on: Applies to data of deceased persons, which the Law covers in Art. 3 only

summary: Royal decree to set requirements and conditions for proving validity and currency of mandates and instructions of deceased persons, and possibly their register.
quote: Mediante real decreto se establecerán los requisitos y condiciones para acreditar la validez y vigencia de estos mandatos

summary: Personal data must be accurate and, where necessary, kept up to date, as required by GDPR Art. 5(1)(d).
quote: los datos serán exactos y, si fuere necesario, actualizados

summary: All persons involved in any phase of processing are bound by the duty of confidentiality, which continues after the relationship ends.
quote: estarán sujetas al deber de confidencialidad al que se refiere el artículo 5.1.f) del Reglamento (UE) 2016/679

summary: Where consent is relied on for several purposes, it must be specific and unambiguous for all of them.
quote: será preciso que conste de manera específica e inequívoca que dicho consentimiento se otorga para todas ellas
conditional_on: Consent is the legal basis, and processing has several purposes

summary: Performance of a contract may not be made conditional on consent to processing for purposes unrelated to the contractual relationship.
quote: No podrá supeditarse la ejecución del contrato a que el afectado consienta el tratamiento de los datos personales para finalidades que no guarden relación

summary: Processing of a minor's data on the basis of consent is lawful only when the minor is over fourteen; exceptions where law requires parental assistance.
quote: únicamente podrá fundarse en su consentimiento cuando sea mayor de catorce años
conditional_on: Processing based on consent of the minor

summary: For minors under fourteen, consent-based processing is lawful only with consent of the holder of parental authority or guardianship.
quote: solo será lícito si consta el del titular de la patria potestad o tutela
conditional_on: Processing of data of minors under fourteen based on consent

summary: Consent alone does not lift the prohibition on processing whose main purpose is to identify ideology, union membership, religion, sexual orientation, beliefs or racial or ethnic origin.
quote: el solo consentimiento del afectado no bastará para levantar la prohibición del tratamiento
conditional_on: Main purpose of processing is identifying the listed characteristics

summary: Processing of criminal-offence data outside the listed cases is allowed only when carried out by lawyers and solicitors to collect information from their clients.
quote: solo serán posibles cuando sean llevados a cabo por abogados y procuradores
conditional_on: Processing outside the cases of Art. 10(1) and 10(2)

summary: Basic information layer must include controller identity, purpose and the exercise of rights; also profiling and the right to object where data are obtained from the data subject, and categories and sources where they are not.
quote: La información básica a la que se refiere el apartado anterior deberá contener, al menos:
conditional_on: Where the controller uses the layered information option of Art. 11

summary: Controller must inform data subjects of the means available to exercise their rights, which must be easily accessible and cannot be refused for choosing another means.
quote: El responsable del tratamiento estará obligado a informar al afectado sobre los medios a su disposición para ejercer los derechos

summary: Actions taken by the controller to answer rights requests are free of charge, subject to the GDPR exceptions.
quote: Serán gratuitas las actuaciones llevadas a cabo por el responsable del tratamiento para atender las solicitudes

summary: A data subject exercising the right of rectification must specify the data and the correction, and attach supporting documents where needed.
quote: el afectado deberá indicar en su solicitud a qué datos se refiere y la corrección que haya de realizarse
conditional_on: Exercise of the right of rectification

summary: Restriction of processing must be clearly recorded in the controller's information systems.
quote: debe constar claramente en los sistemas de información del responsable
conditional_on: Processing has been restricted

summary: Credit information system operator must notify the data subject of inclusion of unpaid debt data and inform of GDPR rights within thirty days, data remaining blocked meanwhile.
quote: deberá notificar al afectado la inclusión de tales datos
conditional_on: Credit information systems covered by the presumption in Art. 20(1)

summary: Video surveillance images must be deleted within one month of capture, unless needed to prove acts against persons, goods or installations.
quote: Los datos serán suprimidos en el plazo máximo de un mes desde su captación
conditional_on: Video surveillance under Art. 22

summary: Where images must be kept to prove unlawful acts, they must be made available to the competent authority within seventy-two hours of knowledge of the recording.
quote: en un plazo máximo de setenta y dos horas desde que se tuviera conocimiento de la existencia de la grabación
conditional_on: Images retained to prove acts against integrity of persons, goods or installations

summary: Only images of the public road strictly necessary for the security purpose may be captured, except strategic sites or transport infrastructure; never inside a private home.
quote: Solo podrán captarse imágenes de la vía pública en la medida en que resulte imprescindible
conditional_on: Video surveillance capturing public road images

summary: Video surveillance information duty is met by a visible information device stating processing, controller identity and rights; full information must remain available to data subjects.
quote: se entenderá cumplido mediante la colocación de un dispositivo informativo en lugar suficientemente visible
conditional_on: Video surveillance under Art. 22

summary: Operators of advertising exclusion systems must notify the competent authority of their creation, general or sectoral character and how data subjects join.
quote: comunicarán a la autoridad de control competente su creación
conditional_on: Advertising exclusion systems

summary: When asked to stop commercial communications, controller must inform the data subject of existing advertising exclusion systems.
quote: deberá informarle de los sistemas de exclusión publicitaria existentes
conditional_on: Data subject objects to commercial communications

summary: Direct marketing senders must consult relevant advertising exclusion systems beforehand and exclude opted-out data subjects, unless consent was given to the sender.
quote: deberán previamente consultar los sistemas de exclusión publicitaria que pudieran afectar a su actuación
conditional_on: Direct marketing communications, absent prior consent to the sender

summary: Employees and third parties must be informed of the existence of internal whistleblowing systems.
quote: Los empleados y terceros deberán ser informados acerca de la existencia de estos sistemas de información
conditional_on: Private entity operates an internal information system

summary: Access to whistleblowing system data is limited to internal control and compliance functions or designated processors, with narrow exceptions.
quote: El acceso a los datos contenidos en estos sistemas quedará limitado exclusivamente a quienes
conditional_on: Internal whistleblowing system

summary: Necessary measures must be adopted to preserve the identity and confidentiality of persons concerned by a whistleblowing report, especially the reporter.
quote: Deberán adoptarse las medidas necesarias para preservar la identidad
conditional_on: Internal whistleblowing system

summary: Whistleblowing data must be deleted from the system within three months, except to evidence the compliance model; unprocessed reports only anonymised.
quote: transcurridos tres meses desde la introducción de los datos, deberá procederse a su supresión del sistema de denuncias
conditional_on: Internal whistleblowing system

summary: Special-category and criminal data for public statistics may be collected only with express consent of the data subjects, as the collection is voluntary.
quote: solo podrán recogerse previo consentimiento expreso de los afectados
conditional_on: Public statistics collection of data under Arts. 9 and 10 GDPR

summary: Processing of administrative infringement and sanction data requires that the controller be the competent body and that processing be limited to strictly necessary data; otherwise consent or a law is needed.
quote: Que el tratamiento se limite a los datos estrictamente necesarios
conditional_on: Processing of data on administrative infringements and sanctions

summary: Controllers and processors must determine and apply appropriate technical and organisational measures to ensure and demonstrate GDPR compliance.
quote: determinarán las medidas técnicas y organizativas apropiadas que deben aplicar a fin de garantizar y acreditar que el tratamiento es conforme

summary: Controllers and processors must assess whether a data protection impact assessment and prior consultation are needed.
quote: En particular valorarán si procede la realización de la evaluación de impacto en la protección de datos

summary: In adopting measures, controllers and processors must consider listed higher-risk situations, including profiling, large-scale processing and processing of vulnerable persons' data.
quote: tendrán en cuenta, en particular, los mayores riesgos que podrían producirse

summary: Controllers and processors must keep a record of processing activities and tell the DPO of any changes to it.
quote: deberán mantener el registro de actividades de tratamiento

summary: Public-sector subjects listed in Art. 77(1) must publish an electronic inventory of their processing activities with their legal basis.
quote: harán público un inventario de sus actividades de tratamiento
conditional_on: Subjects listed in Art. 77(1)

summary: Controller must block data when it rectifies or erases them, keeping them only for the limitation period, then destroy them.
quote: estará obligado a bloquear los datos cuando proceda a su rectificación o supresión
conditional_on: Rectification or erasure of data

summary: Blocked data may not be processed for any purpose other than making them available to courts, prosecutors or data protection authorities.
quote: Los datos bloqueados no podrán ser tratados para ninguna finalidad distinta de la señalada
conditional_on: Data have been blocked

summary: On termination of a processor's services, the controller decides whether data are destroyed, returned or handed to a new processor; retention where law requires.
quote: El responsable del tratamiento determinará si, cuando finalice la prestación de los servicios del encargado
conditional_on: Termination of processor services

summary: Controllers and processors must designate a data protection officer in the cases of GDPR Art. 37(1) and in the listed entity categories (a to o).
quote: deberán designar un delegado de protección de datos en los supuestos previstos en el artículo 37.1
conditional_on: GDPR Art. 37(1) cases or the listed entity types in Art. 34(1)

summary: Designation, appointment and dismissal of a DPO, whether mandatory or voluntary, must be notified to the AEPD or regional authority within ten days.
quote: comunicarán en el plazo de diez días a la Agencia Española de Protección de Datos
conditional_on: Designation, appointment or dismissal of a DPO

summary: Controller must give the DPO access to data and processing, without opposing confidentiality or secrecy duties.
quote: no pudiendo oponer a este acceso el responsable o el encargado del tratamiento
conditional_on: DPO exercising functions

summary: DPO must document a relevant data protection breach it finds and immediately report it to the governing bodies of the controller or processor.
quote: lo documentará y lo comunicará inmediatamente a los órganos de administración
conditional_on: DPO finds a relevant data protection violation

summary: Where a data subject first complains to the DPO, the DPO must communicate its decision within two months of receipt.
quote: comunicará al afectado la decisión que se hubiera adoptado en el plazo máximo de dos meses
conditional_on: Data subject files complaint with the controller's DPO before lodging one with the authority

summary: Codes of conduct under GDPR Section 5 Chapter IV are binding on controllers and processors that adhere to them.
quote: serán vinculantes para quienes se adhieran a los mismos
conditional_on: Adherence to a code of conduct

summary: Adhering controllers and processors must submit to the code's supervisory body complaints they do not wish to grant, before the authority can be approached.
quote: se obligan a someter al organismo o entidad de supervisión las reclamaciones
conditional_on: Adherence to a code of conduct

summary: AEPD and regional authorities must keep interconnected registers of the codes of conduct they approve, electronically accessible.
quote: mantendrán registros de los códigos de conducta aprobados por las mismas

summary: Before a data transfer based on compelling legitimate interests, controllers must inform the AEPD or regional authority and the data subjects.
quote: Los responsables del tratamiento deberán informar a la Agencia Española de Protección de Datos
conditional_on: Transfer based on compelling legitimate interests under GDPR Art. 49(1)

summary: AEPD and the General Council of the Judiciary must cooperate in exercising their data protection competences in the justice sector.
quote: colaborarán en aras del adecuado ejercicio de las respectivas competencias

summary: Government must approve the AEPD statute by royal decree.
quote: aprobará su Estatuto mediante real decreto

summary: AEPD supervises application of the Organic Law and the GDPR and exercises the GDPR Art. 57 functions and Art. 58 powers.
quote: Corresponde a la Agencia Española de Protección de Datos supervisar la aplicación de esta ley orgánica

summary: AEPD must publish the listed decisions on access requests, complaint outcomes, closed preliminary investigations, reprimands and provisional measures.
quote: La Agencia Española de Protección de Datos publicará las resoluciones de su Presidencia

summary: Officials carrying out AEPD investigations must keep secret the information they learn, even after leaving the role.
quote: estarán obligados a guardar secreto sobre las informaciones que conozcan

summary: Public administrations and private persons must provide the AEPD with data, reports and documents needed for its investigations.
quote: estarán obligados a proporcionar a la Agencia Española de Protección de Datos los datos, informes, antecedentes y justificantes necesarios
conditional_on: AEPD investigation activity

summary: Public electronic communications operators and information society service providers must provide identifying data to the AEPD when it requests them, within the conditions of Art. 52(3).
quote: podrá recabar de los operadores que presten servicios de comunicaciones electrónicas disponibles al público
conditional_on: Identification not possible by other means and conduct carried out through an information society service or electronic communication

summary: AEPD audit-plan guidelines are binding on the audited sector or controller.
quote: Las directrices serán de obligado cumplimiento para el sector o responsable al que se refiera el plan de auditoría.
conditional_on: AEPD issues guidelines after a preventive audit plan

summary: AEPD circulars, once published in the Official State Gazette, are binding.
quote: Las circulares serán obligatorias una vez publicadas en el Boletín Oficial del Estado
conditional_on: Publication of the circular in the BOE

summary: AEPD and regional authorities must hold cooperation meetings every six months.
quote: En todo caso, se celebrarán reuniones semestrales de cooperación.

summary: Regional authority must adopt measures to end a processing it is competent for that violates the GDPR, within one month of AEPD request.
quote: podrá requerirlas a que adopten, en el plazo de un mes, las medidas necesarias para su cesación
conditional_on: AEPD considers processing within regional competence violates the GDPR

summary: Government must regulate by royal decree the procedures AEPD handles under Title VIII.
quote: El Gobierno regulará por real decreto los procedimientos que tramite la Agencia Española de Protección de Datos

summary: AEPD must resolve access-right complaints within six months of notifying admission, and sanction procedures within a maximum of nine months.
applies_from: Six months from notice of admission; nine months from start agreement
quote: el plazo para resolver el procedimiento será de seis meses

summary: AEPD must notify the complainant of its decision on admission or inadmission within three months.
quote: deberá notificarse al reclamante en el plazo de tres meses

summary: Where no DPO is designated and no out-of-court body is adhered to, the controller or processor must respond to a complaint forwarded by AEPD within one month.
quote: deberá dar respuesta a la reclamación en el plazo de un mes
conditional_on: AEPD forwards complaint and no DPO or out-of-court mechanism exists

summary: AEPD must act in all cases where investigation of mass data processing is needed; preliminary investigations may not exceed twelve months.
quote: no podrán tener una duración superior a doce meses
conditional_on: Preliminary investigation actions

summary: Resolutions adopted in respect of public-sector controllers must be communicated to the data protection authority.
quote: Se deberán comunicar a la autoridad de protección de datos las resoluciones
conditional_on: Measures and actions against public-sector controllers under Art. 77

summary: Actions and resolutions under Art. 77 must be communicated to the Ombudsman or the equivalent regional institutions.
quote: Se comunicarán al Defensor del Pueblo
conditional_on: Actions under Art. 77

summary: Where AEPD is competent, it must publish on its website, with proper separation, resolutions relating to public-sector entities, naming the controller or processor.
quote: esta publicará en su página web con la debida separación las resoluciones
conditional_on: AEPD is the competent authority

summary: Information society service providers and internet service providers must contribute to guaranteeing the application of constitutional and treaty rights online.
quote: contribuirán a garantizar su aplicación

summary: Internet service providers must offer transparent services without discrimination for technical or economic reasons.
quote: proporcionarán una oferta transparente de servicios sin discriminación

summary: Internet service providers must inform users of their security-of-communications rights.
quote: informarán a los usuarios de sus derechos
