summary: Educational administrations must include digital competence, and risks of misuse of ICT, in the design of optional subject blocks; the education system must ensure safe digital use.
quote: Las Administraciones educativas deberán incluir en el diseño del bloque de asignaturas

summary: Teachers must receive the digital competences and training needed to teach digital values and rights.
quote: El profesorado recibirá las competencias digitales y la formación necesaria

summary: University degree curricula, especially those qualifying for teaching, must guarantee training in safe digital media use and fundamental rights online.
quote: garantizarán la formación en el uso y seguridad de los medios digitales
conditional_on: University degrees qualifying for professional teaching

summary: Public administrations must include digital rights and data protection in the syllabi of civil service entry exams for relevant posts.
quote: incorporarán a los temarios de las pruebas de acceso
conditional_on: Entry examinations for corps handling personal data

summary: Parents, guardians and legal representatives must ensure minors make balanced and responsible use of digital devices and services.
quote: procurarán que los menores de edad hagan un uso equilibrado y responsable de los dispositivos digitales

summary: Where publication of images or information about minors on social networks may unlawfully intrude on their rights, the public prosecutor intervenes and seeks protective measures.
quote: determinará la intervención del Ministerio Fiscal
conditional_on: Unlawful intrusion on minors' rights through social networks

summary: Social network and equivalent service operators must adopt protocols to enable rectification of harmful user content.
quote: Los responsables de redes sociales y servicios equivalentes adoptarán protocolos adecuados
conditional_on: Users spread content infringing honour, privacy or rectification rights

summary: Digital media that must grant a rectification request must publish a clarifying notice next to the original news item in their digital archives.
quote: deberán proceder a la publicación en sus archivos digitales de un aviso aclaratorio
conditional_on: Digital media must grant a rectification request

summary: On a reasoned request, digital media must include a visible update notice next to news about a person where later events have changed the situation, causing harm.
quote: la inclusión de un aviso de actualización suficientemente visible junto a las noticias que le conciernan
conditional_on: Reasoned request and harm from later circumstances

summary: Employers must set criteria for use of digital devices respecting minimum privacy standards, with worker representatives participating; private use requires precise authorised uses and guarantees.
quote: Los empleadores deberán establecer criterios de utilización de los dispositivos digitales
conditional_on: Employer provides digital devices to workers

summary: Workers must be informed of the criteria for use of digital devices.
quote: Los trabajadores deberán ser informados de los criterios de utilización
conditional_on: Employer provides digital devices to workers

summary: Employer must prepare an internal policy on disconnection, after hearing worker representatives, covering remote work and tools used for work purposes.
quote: elaborará una política interna dirigida a trabajadores

summary: Employers using workplace video surveillance must inform workers and, where relevant, their representatives in advance, expressly, clearly and concisely.
quote: Los empleadores habrán de informar con carácter previo, y de forma expresa, clara y concisa
conditional_on: Use of camera data for worker control

summary: Sound recording or video surveillance is prohibited in rest areas such as changing rooms, toilets and canteens.
quote: En ningún caso se admitirá la instalación de sistemas de grabación de sonidos ni de videovigilancia
conditional_on: Workplace locations intended for rest or leisure

summary: Workplace sound recording is permitted only where risks to security are relevant, respecting proportionality and minimal intervention, with deletion under Art. 22(3).
quote: se admitirá únicamente cuando resulten relevantes los riesgos para la seguridad
conditional_on: Relevant security risks from the workplace activity

summary: Before using geolocation for worker control, employers must inform workers and their representatives expressly, clearly and unequivocally, and of access, rectification, restriction and erasure rights.
quote: los empleadores habrán de informar de forma expresa, clara e inequívoca
conditional_on: Use of geolocation systems for worker control

summary: Educational centres and persons running activities with minors must protect the best interest of the minor when publishing their data online, and obtain consent for social network publication.
quote: garantizarán la protección del interés superior del menor y sus derechos fundamentales
conditional_on: Publication of minors' personal data through information society services

summary: Internet search engines must delist from name-based results links that are inadequate, inaccurate, irrelevant, outdated or excessive, where the listed conditions apply.
quote: eliminen de las listas de resultados que se obtuvieran tras una búsqueda efectuada a partir de su nombre
conditional_on: Person requests delisting from name-based search results

summary: Social network and equivalent providers must erase personal data the user provided on simple request, and data provided by third parties under the listed conditions; erasure without delay for data provided during minority.
quote: sean suprimidos, a su simple solicitud, los datos personales que hubiese facilitado
conditional_on: Request by the data subject

summary: On request, social network and equivalent providers must transmit user content directly to another provider designated by the user, where technically possible.
quote: a que los prestadores los transmitan directamente a otro prestador designado por el usuario
conditional_on: Technically possible transmission

summary: Social network and equivalent providers must delete a deceased person's profile without delay when the legitimated persons so decide, unless the deceased decided otherwise.
quote: deberá proceder sin dilación a la misma
conditional_on: Request by a legitimated person for profile removal

summary: Government must set by royal decree the requirements for proving validity of instructions about deceased persons' digital content and their register.
quote: Mediante real decreto se establecerán los requisitos y condiciones para acreditar la validez y vigencia de los mandatos

summary: The Government, with the autonomous communities, shall draw up an Internet Access Plan with objectives including closing digital gaps through an internet social bonus.
quote: elaborará un Plan de Acceso a Internet

summary: A Plan de Actuación shall be approved to promote training, awareness and balanced, responsible use of digital devices and social networks by minors.
quote: se aprobará un Plan de Actuación

summary: The Government shall present an annual report to the relevant committee of the Congreso de los Diputados on the evolution of the digital rights set out in the Title.
quote: El Gobierno presentará un informe anual ante la comisión parlamentaria correspondiente del Congreso de los Diputados

summary: The National Security Scheme shall include the measures to be implemented for processing of personal data, adapting risk criteria to Art. 32 GDPR.
quote: El Esquema Nacional de Seguridad incluirá las medidas que deban implantarse en caso de tratamiento de datos personales

summary: Controllers listed in Art. 77(1) shall apply the security measures of the National Security Scheme to personal data processing and promote equivalent measures in linked private-law companies or foundations.
quote: deberán aplicar a los tratamientos de datos personales las medidas de seguridad que correspondan

summary: A data protection authority that considers a European Commission transfer decision invalid shall immediately suspend the proceeding and seek judicial authorisation to so declare.
quote: acordará inmediatamente la suspensión del procedimiento
conditional_on: Where a data protection authority considers that a Commission decision on international transfers, on whose validity the proceeding depends, infringes GDPR.

summary: Debts whose principal is below fifty euros shall not be entered into credit information systems.
quote: No se incorporarán a los sistemas de información crediticia

summary: The Government may, by royal decree, update the fifty-euro debt amount in the credit information provision.
quote: El Gobierno, mediante real decreto, podrá actualizar esta cuantía.

summary: Where an administrative act is published, the name and surnames shall not be published together with the full identity document number; identification is limited by the rules in DA 7(1).
quote: En ningún caso debe publicarse el nombre y apellidos de manera conjunta con el número completo del documento nacional de identidad

summary: The Government shall promote a collaboration protocol defining secure publication and notification procedures for administrative acts to prevent risks to victims of gender violence.
quote: el Gobierno impulsará la elaboración de un protocolo de colaboración

summary: Controllers listed in Art. 77(1) may communicate requested personal data to private-law entities where the data subjects consent or a legitimate interest prevails.
quote: podrán comunicar los datos personales que les sean solicitados por sujetos de derecho privado
conditional_on: Consent of the data subjects, or a legitimate interest of the requester that prevails over the data subjects' rights and interests.

summary: Public-sector personnel registers may process data on criminal and administrative offences only as strictly necessary for their purposes.
quote: limitándose a los datos estrictamente necesarios para el cumplimiento de sus fines

summary: Electronic communications operators and information society service providers must transfer requested non-content data to the CNMV only after prior judicial authorisation.
quote: La cesión de estos datos requerirá la previa obtención de autorización judicial
conditional_on: Where the CNMV cannot obtain the information by other means and needs it for supervision or inspection.

summary: Listed practices (impersonating or implying collaboration with the AEPD or regional authorities, coercive references to sanctions, false compliance documents, and unauthorised DPO claims) are deemed aggressive practices under Art. 8 of Law 3/1991.
quote: Actuar con intención de suplantar la identidad de la Agencia Española de Protección de Datos

summary: In health research reuse of data, controllers shall publish the Art. 13 GDPR information on an easily accessible page of the research centre's website and notify data subjects electronically.
quote: los responsables deberán publicar la información establecida por el artículo 13 del Reglamento (UE) 2016/679
conditional_on: Reuse of data for health and biomedical research compatible with the original consent area.

summary: Use of pseudonymised data for health research requires technical and functional separation between the research team and those performing pseudonymisation and holding re-identification information, plus access limits and confidentiality commitments.
quote: Una separación técnica y funcional entre el equipo investigador y quienes realicen la seudonimización

summary: Public health and biomedical research using personal data under Art. 89 GDPR shall carry out an impact assessment, including re-identification risks, and follow research quality standards.
quote: Realizar una evaluación de impacto que determine los riesgos derivados del tratamiento
conditional_on: Processing for public health or biomedical research under Art. 89 GDPR.

summary: A clinical trial sponsor not established in the EU shall designate a legal representative established in the Union under Art. 74 of Regulation 536/2014.
quote: Designar un representante legal establecido en la Unión Europea
conditional_on: The sponsor of a clinical trial is not established in the European Union.

summary: Pseudonymised data use for public health and biomedical research requires prior report of the research ethics committee (or DPO/expert absent one). DA 17(2)(c) also requires prior favourable ethics committee report for reuse of data.
quote: deberá ser sometido al informe previo del comité de ética de la investigación
conditional_on: Pseudonymised data use for public health and biomedical research.

summary: Health, biomedical and medicines research ethics committees shall include a data protection officer, or a suitably knowledgeable expert, among their members when handling personal or pseudonymised data.
applies_from: Within one year of entry into force of the law.
quote: deberán integrar entre sus miembros un delegado de protección de datos
conditional_on: Committees handling research involving personal, pseudonymised or anonymised data.

summary: The AEPD shall develop tools, guides, directives and guidance for professionals, microenterprises and SMEs to comply with accountability obligations.
quote: La Agencia Española de Protección de Datos desarrollará, con la colaboración

summary: The Government shall send the Congreso de los Diputados a bill specifically guaranteeing minors' rights in relation to the impact of the Internet.
applies_from: Within one year of entry into force of the law.
quote: el Gobierno remitirá al Congreso de los Diputados un proyecto de ley

summary: Educational administrations shall comply with the mandate in Art. 83(1) second paragraph (digital education).
applies_from: Within one year of entry into force of the law.
quote: darán cumplimiento al mandato contenido en el párrafo segundo del apartado 1 del artículo 83

summary: Competent public authorities shall facilitate access to public and ecclesiastical archives for data requested in missing-person police or judicial investigations; religious bodies shall respond promptly.
quote: Las autoridades públicas competentes facilitarán el acceso a los archivos públicos y eclesiásticos
conditional_on: Data requested in police or judicial investigations of missing persons.

summary: Promoters of codes of conduct registered with the AEPD or regional authorities shall adapt their content to Art. 40 GDPR within one year, failing which registration is cancelled.
applies_from: Within one year of entry into force of the law.
quote: deberán adaptar su contenido a lo dispuesto en el artículo 40 del Reglamento (UE) 2016/679 en el plazo de un año
conditional_on: Codes of conduct registered under the prior law.

summary: During the transitional periods for pre-GDPR processor contracts, either party may require the other to modify the contract to conform to Art. 28 GDPR.
quote: cualquiera de las partes podrá exigir a la otra la modificación del contrato
conditional_on: Processor contracts entered into before 25 May 2018 under the prior law.

summary: Electoral activity recipients of political parties' communications shall be provided a simple, free means to exercise the right to object (amending LOREG Art. 58 bis(5)).
provision: Disposición final tercera (inserting LOREG Art. 58 bis(5))
quote: Se facilitará al destinatario un modo sencillo y gratuito de ejercicio del derecho de oposición.

summary: Electoral outreach activities shall prominently identify their electoral nature (amending LOREG Art. 58 bis(4)).
provision: Disposición final tercera (inserting LOREG Art. 58 bis(4))
quote: Las actividades divulgativas anteriormente referidas identificarán de modo destacado su naturaleza electoral.

summary: Controllers listed in Art. 77(1) shall publish their inventory of processing activities under Art. 31 (inserting Law 19/2013, Art. 6 bis).
provision: Disposición final undécima, Uno (inserting Ley 19/2013, Art. 6 bis)
quote: publicarán su inventario de actividades de tratamiento en aplicación del artículo 31

summary: Access to information revealing ideology, union membership, religion or beliefs may be authorised only with the affected person's express written consent, unless the data were made manifestly public (amending Law 19/2013, Art. 15(1)).
provision: Disposición final undécima, Dos (amending Ley 19/2013, Art. 15(1))
quote: el acceso únicamente se podrá autorizar en caso de que se contase con el consentimiento expreso y por escrito del afectado
conditional_on: Unless the affected person had manifestly made the data public before the request.

summary: Public administrations shall not require from interested parties data or documents not required by the applicable regulation, or already provided to any administration (amending Law 39/2015, Art. 28(3)).
quote: Las Administraciones Públicas no requerirán a los interesados datos o documentos no exigidos por la normativa reguladora aplicable

summary: Public administrations shall obtain documents electronically through corporate networks or data intermediation platforms; reports from other bodies must be sent within ten days (amending Law 39/2015, Art. 28(2)).
quote: Las Administraciones Públicas deberán recabar los documentos electrónicamente

summary: Access to clinical history for judicial, epidemiological, public health, research or teaching purposes must keep patient identification data separate from clinical-care data, ensuring anonymity as a general rule (amending Law 41/2002, Art. 16(3)).
quote: obliga a preservar los datos de identificación personal del paciente, separados de los de carácter clinicoasistencial
conditional_on: Unless the patient consented to not separating the data.

summary: The Government is empowered to develop by regulation the provisions of Arts. 3(2), 38(6), 45(2), 63(3), 96(3) and DA 6.
quote: Se habilita al Gobierno para desarrollar lo dispuesto en los artículos 3.2, 38.6, 45.2, 63.3, 96.3 y disposición adicional sexta

summary: Closed cover pool for mortgage, territorial, internationalisation and other covered bonds; open cover pool for cédulas (Art. 3(3)).
quote: dispondrán de un conjunto de cobertura cerrado a lo largo de toda la vida del instrumento

summary: Only entities listed in Art. 1(2) may issue covered bonds; specific denominations may be used only by instruments meeting the decree.
quote: Únicamente las entidades contempladas en el artículo 1.2 podrán emitir bonos garantizados

summary: Every programme must at all times have a cover pool of primary assets, substitute assets, liquid assets and derivatives in the required amount and characteristics.
quote: Todo programa de bonos garantizados deberá contar, en todo momento, con un conjunto de cobertura integrado por activos primarios

summary: Issuers must ensure diversified risk characteristics of cover-pool assets, with internal granularity and concentration policies approved by the board and relevant information included in contractual terms.
quote: Las entidades emisoras deberán velar porque el conjunto de cobertura esté integrado por activos en garantía que tengan diferentes características

summary: For non-EU immovable collateral, the issuer must ensure equivalent security and enforceability; partial inclusion of assets is not permitted (Art. 8(1)).
quote: la entidad emisora se asegurará de que los activos:

summary: Issuers must keep an updated special register identifying each asset and derivative in each cover pool, with the fields listed in Art. 9(3).
quote: las entidades emisoras deberán contar con un registro especial actualizado

summary: Programmes must meet minimum coverage requirements at all times: all liabilities covered by cover-pool claims and aggregate principal coverage at least equal to outstanding bonds.
quote: deberán cumplir en todo momento, como mínimo, los requisitos de cobertura establecidos en este real decreto-ley

summary: Covered bonds are subject to a minimum level of overcollateralisation relative to the coverage requirements of Art. 10; higher levels may be contractually committed.
quote: Los bonos garantizados estarán sujetos a un nivel mínimo de sobregarantía

summary: The cover pool must at all times include a liquidity buffer covering the maximum cumulative net liquidity outflow over 180 days, composed only of assets listed in Art. 11(3).
quote: deberá incluir en todo momento un colchón de liquidez

summary: Derivatives may be included in the cover pool only if they serve hedging purposes, are documented, segregated, non-terminable on insolvency or resolution, and meet Art. 12(2)-(3).
quote: los instrumentos financieros derivados estén suficientemente documentados

summary: Issuers must submit to the cover-pool monitor and the Banco de España any documentation requested to assess derivative compliance.
quote: Las entidades deberán presentar tanto al órgano de control del conjunto de cobertura como al Banco de España cuanta documentación les sea requerida

summary: Intragroup structures must meet listed conditions (sale of internally issued bonds, use as cover assets, single group entity, intention to sell externally, eligibility parity).
quote: En las estructuras intragrupo deberán cumplirse los requisitos siguientes

summary: The Banco de España must notify the European Banking Authority of any decision on intragroup structures with lower-quality bonds.
quote: El Banco de España notificará posteriormente a la Autoridad Bancaria Europea cualquier decisión

summary: When acquiring loans from a non-credit originator, the issuer must assess the originator's lending standards or carry out its own solvency assessment.
quote: la entidad emisora deberá evaluar las normas de concesión de créditos de la empresa que originó los activos de cobertura

summary: For extendable maturity structures, issuers must give investors enough information to judge the risk (triggers, effect of insolvency or resolution, roles of the Banco de España and special administrator) (Art. 15(1)(c)), and must state the possibility of extension in the contractual terms and, where applicable, the prospectus (Art. 15(3)).
quote: la información facilitada a los inversores sobre la estructura de vencimiento será suficiente

summary: Any extension of maturity of covered bonds requires prior authorisation by the Banco de España, requested by the issuer or special administrator.
quote: deberá ser autorizada por el Banco de España a solicitud de la entidad emisora o del administrador especial

summary: Each cover asset must be valued when included in the cover pool and the valuation reviewed at least annually under internal policies.
quote: deberán ser objeto de valoración en el momento de su inclusión en el conjunto de cobertura

summary: Issuers must document and retain valuation documentation for cover assets and make it available to the Banco de España and the cover-pool monitor.
quote: Las entidades emisoras deberán documentar y conservar la documentación de la valoración de los activos de cobertura

summary: Physical collateral must be valued by an approved, independent appraiser not involved in credit decisions, without speculative elements; the issuer must check for significant falls in value at least annually (Art. 17(2)).
quote: la valoración la efectúe una sociedad de tasación homologada o un profesional homologado independiente

summary: Where a mortgage valuation shows a significant fall in value, the issuer must update the valuation by full appraisal or automated valuation methods; recognised value may not exceed the original appraisal.
quote: este deberá proceder a una actualización de la valoración mediante tasación completa o utilizando métodos automatizados de valoración

summary: Issuers must give investors sufficiently detailed programme information (Art. 19(1)), publish quarterly data on cover pool, bonds, coverage, overcollateralisation, delinquencies and cover-pool monitor (Art. 19(2)(a)-(h)), and publish this on their website (Art. 19(3)).
quote: Trimestralmente, las entidades publicarán la siguiente información sobre los programas

summary: Credit institutions must accept any appraisal of a property submitted by the client from an approved appraiser that is not expired, may verify it, and may not pass its cost to the client.
quote: estarán obligadas a aceptar cualquier tasación de un bien aportada por el cliente

summary: Appraisal companies and credit institution appraisal services are subject to prior approval (homologación), independence and confidentiality requirements set by regulation.
quote: estarán sometidas a los requisitos de homologación previa, independencia y secreto

summary: Appraisal companies with 10% or more of revenue from one credit institution group must have mechanisms to ensure independence and avoid conflicts of interest, including an internal code of conduct.
quote: deberán disponer de mecanismos adecuados para favorecer la independencia de la actividad de tasación y evitar conflictos de interés

summary: Credit institutions with own appraisal services and outstanding covered bonds must set up a technical committee to verify independence and produce an annual report to the board and the Banco de España.
quote: deberán constituir una comisión técnica que verificará el cumplimiento de los requisitos de independencia

summary: Appraisal companies must align their financial year with the calendar year and have their annual accounts audited.
quote: someter sus cuentas anuales a la auditoría de cuentas regulada en la Ley 22/2015, de 20 de julio, de Auditoría de Cuentas

summary: Appraisal companies and credit institution appraisal services must comply with valuation rules, write certificates and reports truthfully, and act with professional diligence.
quote: deberán respetar las normas aplicables en las valoraciones de bienes

summary: Any person intending to acquire a significant holding (10% or more or significant influence) in an appraisal company must inform the Banco de España in advance and notify later changes.
quote: deberá informar previamente de ello al Banco de España

summary: Credit institutions may not acquire or hold, directly or indirectly, a significant holding in an appraisal company, nor may persons linked to the property the company appraises.
quote: Queda prohibida la adquisición o mantenimiento por parte de las entidades de crédito

summary: Mortgage cover-pool assets must be eligible mortgage loans secured by first-ranking charges, with legal conditions on title; cover-pool overcollateralisation (Art. 23(5)) and insurance of mortgaged properties at least at appraisal value (Art. 23(6)) are required.
quote: deberán estar en todo momento garantizadas por los activos primarios admisibles

summary: Mortgage loans in the cover pool may not exceed 60% of appraised value (80% for residential property); cancellation or waiver of mortgages or loan changes without control-monitor authorisation are restricted (Art. 23(7)).
quote: no podrá exceder del 60 por ciento del valor de tasación del bien hipotecado

summary: Issuers of mortgage covered bonds must document that cover assets and lending policies comply with the decree.
quote: deberán documentar la conformidad de los activos de cobertura

summary: Territorial covered bonds must at all times be backed by loans or credits to eligible public-sector counterparties, not linked to export or internationalisation finance; Art. 23(3),(5),(7),(8),(9) apply.
quote: Las cédulas territoriales deberán estar en todo momento garantizadas por préstamos o créditos

summary: Internationalisation cédulas must at all times be backed by export or internationalisation loans to non-public-sector borrowers, with personal guarantees meeting CRR Chapter 4 where applicable.
quote: deberán estar en todo momento garantizadas por los préstamos o créditos

summary: Mortgage, territorial and internationalisation bonds must keep cover assets fixed and undeliverable as substitutes; if substitute assets exceed limits after amortisation, the issuer must cover the difference with a cash or public-fund deposit at the Banco de España.
quote: la entidad emisora deberá cubrir la diferencia mediante un depósito de efectivo o de fondos públicos en el Banco de España

summary: Issuers must assess enforceability of receivables and the legal and economic ability to realise collateral before including them in the cover pool.
quote: Las entidades emisoras de bonos garantizados deberán evaluar la exigibilidad de los derechos de crédito

summary: Bonds backed by loans to or guaranteed by public enterprises must have a legal minimum overcollateralisation of 10% and meet listed conditions (essential public services, public supervision, revenue capacity).
quote: estarán sujetos a un nivel mínimo de sobregarantía legal del 10 %

summary: The issuer of covered bonds must designate a cover pool control body for each programme, which acts in investors' interest and continuously monitors the cover pool.
quote: La entidad emisora de bonos garantizados deberá designar un órgano de control del conjunto de cobertura para cada programa

summary: The cover pool control body must continuously monitor the cover pool and ensure correct eligibility assessment, compliance with cover-pool requirements and over-collateralisation levels, liquidity buffer, soundness of stress-test assumptions, risk monitoring and traceability of the special register (Art. 30(2)); it authorises entries to and exits from the special register (Art. 30(3)).
quote: el órgano de control deberá asegurar que:

summary: Assets or rights may not be removed from the special register except in the listed cases (ordinary maturity, loss of eligibility, substitution, excess cover or over-collateralisation), and removals in cases (c)-(e) require the control body's authorisation; the issuer itself manages the register.
quote: No se podrán dar de baja activos o derechos incluidos en el mismo, salvo:

summary: The issuer may not designate as external control body a company that falls within the listed exclusions (audit, group links, lack of internal conduct protocol, lack of reputation).
quote: La entidad emisora no podrá designar como órgano externo de control a una sociedad que:

summary: After authorisation, the issuer and the external control body (or the issuer, if internal) must submit a responsible declaration of compliance with the listed requirements.
quote: una vez autorizado el programa de bonos garantizados, una declaración responsable

summary: The external control body must immediately notify the issuer of any supervening breach of the conditions in Art. 31(2) and (3).
quote: deberá en todo caso notificar inmediatamente a la entidad emisora cualquier incumplimiento sobrevenido
conditional_on: supervening breach of conditions

summary: At least three months before expiry of the external control body contract (or of the maximum contract period), the issuer must notify Banco de España of the new control body.
applies_from: at least three months before contract expiry
quote: la entidad emisora de bonos garantizados comunicará al Banco de España el nuevo órgano de control del programa de emisión
conditional_on: contract expiry or expiry of maximum contract period

summary: The external control body (or the issuer, if the control body is internal) must immediately notify Banco de España of any supervening breach of the Art. 31 conditions.
quote: deberá notificar al Banco de España inmediatamente cualquier incumplimiento sobrevenido
conditional_on: supervening breach of conditions

summary: The control body must immediately communicate detected legal or regulatory breaches to the head of internal control or to the board, and record those communications.
quote: deberán ser comunicadas de inmediato por el órgano de control

summary: The control body must prepare a semi-annual report to the head of internal control (or the board), covering its activities, results and eligibility assessment; the reports are available to Banco de España.
quote: El órgano de control elaborará un informe semestral

summary: The external control body, its partners and staff (or issuer staff serving as internal control body) must keep confidential information obtained and may not use it for other purposes, without prejudice to cooperation with Banco de España.
quote: estarán obligados a mantener el secreto de cuanta información conozcan en el ejercicio de su actividad

summary: The issuer must record and keep documentation for all operations affecting a covered bond programme and make it available for supervision.
quote: La entidad emisora deberá dejar constancia y conservará la documentación correspondiente

summary: Issuing a covered bond programme requires prior administrative authorisation from Banco de España, subject to the requirements in Art. 34(2).
quote: requerirá la previa autorización administrativa por parte del Banco de España

summary: Issuers must provide Banco de España, on request and at least quarterly, information on asset eligibility, cover pool requirements, register, control body, liquidity buffer and maturity extension structures.
quote: Las entidades emisoras deberán proporcionar al Banco de España a requerimiento de este y, al menos, con carácter trimestral la información siguiente
conditional_on: on request, and at least quarterly

summary: Banco de España must publish on its website circulars and guidance, the list of authorised issuers, and the lists of bonds eligible for the European Covered Bond labels, keep it updated (Art. 38(1)-(2)), and notify these lists annually to the European Banking Authority (Art. 38(3)).
quote: El Banco de España publicará en su página web la siguiente información

summary: Banco de España must cooperate closely with the insolvency judge, the ordinary insolvency administrator, the special administrator and FROB during insolvency or resolution of an issuer, and with the issuer's supervisor (Art. 39(1)); it must share essential information with other EU competent authorities and cooperate with EBA and ESMA (Art. 39(2)).
quote: El Banco de España cooperará estrechamente con el juez del concurso
conditional_on: insolvency or resolution of the issuer

summary: Upon notification of insolvency or resolution, the control body must issue a certificate of the assets and rights in the special register as of that date.
quote: a fin de que emita una certificación de los activos y derechos incluidos en el registro especial
conditional_on: notification of insolvency or resolution decision

summary: The special administrator must ensure that the interests of covered bond investors are preserved, verifying continued and sound management of the programme (addressee role is the special administrator, a court or FROB appointee).
quote: El administrador especial velará por que se preserven los derechos e intereses de los inversores en bonos garantizados
conditional_on: appointment of special administrator

summary: The special administrator must supply information to the insolvency judge and the ordinary administrator, and to Banco de España under Art. 35 (addressee is the special administrator).
quote: El administrador especial se coordinará y suministrará la información necesaria al juez del concurso
conditional_on: appointment of special administrator

summary: Liquidation of the separate estate proceeds under a liquidation plan prepared by the special administrator within fifteen days of appointment (addressee is the special administrator).
quote: que elaborará el administrador especial dentro de los quince dias siguientes a su nombramiento
conditional_on: appointment of special administrator

summary: FROB must notify the decision to start resolution of the issuer to the cover pool control body.
quote: el FROB lo notificará al organo de control del conjunto de cobertura a los efectos previstos en el artículo 40
conditional_on: decision to initiate resolution

summary: Banco de España must inform the European Banking Authority, as soon as possible, of final criminal convictions and administrative sanctions relating to covered bond supervision.
quote: El Banco de España informará a la Autoridad Bancaria Europea, a la mayor brevedad posible

summary: Management companies must send the CNMV an informal letter within two weeks of starting pre-marketing, listing Member States, periods, and strategies presented (new Art. 2 bis.3 of Ley 35/2003).
quote: Las sociedades gestoras enviarán a la CNMV, en el plazo de dos semanas tras haber comenzado la precomercialización, una carta informal

summary: Management companies must ensure that pre-marketing is sufficiently documented (new Art. 2 bis.5 of Ley 35/2003).
quote: Las sociedades gestoras se asegurarán de que la precomercialización esté suficientemente documentada

summary: A foreign-marketed collective investment institution must ensure that services for investors (orders, information, contact point) are provided in Spanish or another language admitted by CNMV, by itself or by a regulated third party under written contract (amended Art. 15.1, Ley 35/2003).
quote: La IIC velará por que los servicios para llevar a cabo estas tareas, incluidos los electrónicos, sean prestados
conditional_on: marketing in Spain of an EU-authorised IIC

summary: A foreign-marketed IIC must inform the CNMV in writing at least one month before any modification of the notified information takes effect (amended Art. 15.3, Ley 35/2003).
applies_from: at least one month before the modification takes effect
quote: la IIC informará de ello por escrito a la CNMV, como mínimo un mes antes de que dicha modificación sea efectiva
conditional_on: modification of notified information

summary: Spanish IIC wishing to market in other EU Member States must submit a notification to the CNMV with the listed documents (amended Art. 16.1, Ley 35/2003).
quote: deberán remitir a la CNMV un escrito de notificación que contenga información sobre las disposiciones y modalidades

summary: Management companies must notify the CNMV of the cessation of marketing in a Member State, after the conditions in the article are met (new Art. 16 bis.1, Ley 35/2003).
quote: Las SGIIC notificarán el cese de las medidas adoptadas para la comercialización
conditional_on: cessation of marketing in a Member State, with the listed conditions met

summary: Spanish management companies marketing non-UCITS funds in other Member States must submit a notification to the CNMV with the listed information (new Art. 16 ter.1, Ley 35/2003).
quote: deberán remitir a la CNMV un escrito de notificación que contenga la siguiente información

summary: Management companies must provide retail-investor services (order processing, information, access to rights, contact point) in each Member State where they market (new Art. 16 quater.1, Ley 35/2003).
quote: las sociedades gestoras facilitarán, en cada Estado miembro en el que se propongan comercializar participaciones o acciones de una IIC entre inversores minoristas, servicios
conditional_on: marketing to retail investors in a Member State

summary: For 36 months after the cessation notification, the management company may not take part in pre-marketing of the notified IICs or similar strategies in that Member State (new Art. 16 quinquies.3, Ley 35/2003).
quote: la SGIIC no participará en la precomercialización de participaciones o acciones de IIC que figuren en la notificación
conditional_on: 36 months after cessation notification

summary: Management companies must send the CNMV an informal letter within two weeks of starting pre-marketing of ECR or EICC (new Art. 75 bis.3, Ley 22/2014).
quote: Las SGEIC enviarán a la CNMV, en el plazo de dos semanas tras haber comenzado la precomercialización, una carta informal

summary: The management company of an investment entity must register with the CNMV the listed information on the entity to be marketed (amended Art. 77.2, Ley 22/2014).
quote: La sociedad gestora de la entidad de inversión deberá asimismo registrar en la CNMV la siguiente información

summary: The management company of an ECR must submit and register with the CNMV the listed documentation, including the prospectus approved by the CNMV and financial statements (amended Art. 79.2, Ley 22/2014).
quote: la gestora de la ECR que pretende comercializar deberá aportar y registrar en la CNMV la siguiente documentación

summary: Spanish management companies marketing ECR or EICC in other Member States must submit a notification to the CNMV with the listed information (amended Art. 80.1, Ley 22/2014).
quote: deberán remitir a la CNMV un escrito de notificación que contenga la siguiente información

summary: For 36 months after the cessation notification, the management company may not take part in pre-marketing of the notified ECR or EICC or similar strategies in that Member State (new Art. 80 bis.3, Ley 22/2014).
quote: la SGEIC no participará en la precomercialización de participaciones o acciones de ECR o EICC
conditional_on: 36 months after cessation notification

summary: The management company must notify the CNMV in writing of any modification of the notified data at least one month before it takes effect, or immediately if unforeseen (amended Art. 81.5, Ley 22/2014).
quote: la gestora notificará por escrito dicha modificación a la CNMV, al menos un mes antes de hacer efectiva la modificación
conditional_on: modification of notified data

summary: The Ministry of Economic Affairs and Digital Transformation must approve the list of national high-value datasets, published by resolution (new Art. 3 ter.3, Ley 37/2007).
quote: El Ministerio de Asuntos Económicos y Transformación Digital aprobará la lista de los conjuntos de datos de alto valor nacionales

summary: Research entities that carry out or fund research must adopt measures to support that publicly funded research data are fully reusable, interoperable and openly accessible, subject to listed limitations (new Art. 3 bis.1, Ley 37/2007).
quote: adoptarán medidas para apoyar que los datos de investigaciones financiadas públicamente sean plenamente reutilizables
conditional_on: publicly funded research data

summary: Public-sector bodies must ensure their documents can be re-used under the listed modalities, may not exercise the database maker's sui generis right to prevent or restrict re-use, and must create document management systems for effective online retrieval; the General State Administration maintains the national catalogue of re-usable information (amended Art. 4, Ley 37/2007).
quote: no ejercerán el derecho del fabricante de una base de datos

summary: Public-sector bodies must make dynamic data available immediately after collection via APIs and, where appropriate, bulk download; high-value datasets must be available in machine-readable format via APIs (amended Art. 5.4 and 5.5, Ley 37/2007).
quote: Los sujetos previstos en el artículo 2 pondrán a disposición los datos dinámicos de los que dispongan para su reutilización inmediatamente después de su recopilación
conditional_on: dynamic data; high-value datasets held by the bodies

summary: A body granting an exclusive agreement for a service of public interest must carry out a periodic review, at least every three years, and publish the agreement at least two months before it enters into force (amended Art. 6.2, Ley 37/2007).
quote: quedará obligado a la realización de una revisión periódica, y en todo caso, cada tres años
conditional_on: exclusive agreement for a service of public interest

summary: Public-sector bodies must publish online, where possible and appropriate, the reuse fees they set, the conditions applicable and the actual amounts, with the basis of calculation (amended Art. 7.7, Ley 37/2007).
quote: Los sujetos previstos en el artículo 2 publicarán por medios electrónicos, siempre que sea posible y apropiado, las tarifas fijadas
conditional_on: where a fee is applied to reuse

summary: Each public-sector subject must determine the responsible information unit for making its information available (new Art. 10 bis.1, Ley 37/2007).
quote: Cada sujeto previsto en el artículo 2 determinará la Unidad responsable de garantizar la puesta a disposición de su información

summary: Research organisations and cultural heritage institutions storing reproductions made for text and data mining must keep them with an adequate level of security, and may keep them to verify research results.
quote: se almacenarán con un nivel adecuado de seguridad
conditional_on: reproductions made for scientific research text and data mining

summary: The digital teaching exception (reproduction, distribution and communication of works for educational illustration without authorisation) applies only to acts by teachers of formal education and staff of universities and research bodies, carried out in a secure electronic environment and indicating the source, including the author's name where possible.
quote: tengan lugar en un entorno electrónico seguro
conditional_on: digital illustration for educational purposes

summary: Online content-sharing service providers must obtain prior authorisation from rights holders for communication to the public or making available of protected works uploaded by users. Negotiations must follow good faith, due diligence, transparency and free-competition principles.
quote: los prestadores de servicios para compartir contenidos en línea deberán obtener previamente la autorización de los titulares de los derechos

summary: Absent authorisation, content-sharing providers are liable for unauthorised communication to the public unless they show best efforts to obtain authorisation, best efforts (under strict professional diligence) to make unavailable works for which rights holders supplied information, and expeditious disabling/removal on sufficiently motivated notice plus best efforts to prevent future uploads; for live content they must disable access or remove it during the live event.
quote: serán responsables de los actos no autorizados de comunicación al público
conditional_on: Absence of authorisation from the rights holder

summary: On request of rights holders, providers must give adequate information every six months on the functioning of their cooperation practices; where licence agreements are concluded, they must also inform on the use of the content under those agreements.
quote: Deberán proporcionar a los titulares de derechos que lo soliciten información adecuada, con carácter semestral
conditional_on: Request by rights holders; licence agreements concluded

summary: Providers must establish an agile and effective complaint and appeal mechanism for users in case of conflict over disabling access to or removal of works they uploaded. Disputed works are not kept accessible while the procedure is pending.
quote: establecerán un mecanismo de reclamación y recurso ágil y eficaz a disposición de sus usuarios
conditional_on: Conflict over disabling access or removal of uploaded works

summary: Decisions to disable access to or remove uploaded content are subject to review by persons, without automated intervention by robots or similar means. Complaints under the mechanism must be processed within 10 business days (deadline); rights holders must justify their requests.
quote: estarán sujetas a examen por parte de personas, esto es, sin intervención automatizada de robots u otros medios análogos
conditional_on: Complaints under the mechanism in Art. 73(10)

summary: Content-sharing service providers must inform their users about their general terms and about the limits to intellectual property rights for the purposes of this article and of the consolidated IP law.
quote: informarán a sus usuarios sobre sus condiciones generales y sobre los límites a los derechos de propiedad intelectual

summary: Assignees or licensees of exploitation rights, and licence holders for works managed by collective management entities, must provide authors and performers at least once a year, by electronic means, updated information on exploitation, total revenues and corresponding remuneration. Authors may also request identity of successive assignees.
quote: deberá facilitar a los autores o a los artistas intérpretes o ejecutantes, al menos una vez al año y por medios electrónicos, información actualizada

summary: Retransmission of programmes must be authorised by the holders of the exclusive right of communication to the public. Rights holders that are not broadcasters must exercise their rights exclusively through a collective management entity.
quote: Los actos de retransmisión de programas deben ser autorizados por los titulares del derecho exclusivo de comunicación al público.

summary: Broadcasting organisations exercise retransmission rights over their own transmissions; negotiations between broadcasters and retransmission service operators on authorisation must be conducted in good faith.
quote: se llevarán a cabo de buena fe

summary: In direct injection transmissions, the broadcasting organisation and the signal distributor must obtain authorisation from the rights holders for the single act of communication to the public.
quote: para el que obtendrán autorización de los titulares de derechos
conditional_on: Direct injection of programme-carrying signals to a signal distributor

summary: Making available to the public, by electronic content aggregation service providers, of texts or text fragments of press publications requires authorisation from rights holders under Art. 129 bis. Search-tool providers are exempt from authorisation and remuneration under stated conditions, including a link to the source page.
quote: requerirá la concesión, por parte de los titulares de derechos en lo relativo a usos en línea, de la correspondiente autorización prevista en el artículo 129 bis
conditional_on: Aggregation of press publication texts online

summary: In licence agreements with press publishers, the information society service provider must inform in detail and sufficiently about the main parameters governing content ranking and their relative importance, and keep that information updated.
quote: deberá informar de forma detallada y suficiente sobre los parámetros principales que rigen la clasificación de los contenidos
conditional_on: Licence agreement with a press publisher or news agency under Art. 129 bis(3)

summary: Licence agreements with press publishers must respect editorial independence of the publishers and news agencies and must not link other contracts or services not concerning press publication exploitation.
provision: Art. 80, Siete (adding LPI Art. 129 bis(3)(a) and (c))
quote: Se deberá respetar la independencia editorial de las editoriales de publicaciones de prensa y agencias de noticias.
conditional_on: Licence agreement under Art. 129 bis(3)

summary: Press publishers and news agencies must give authors of works incorporated in a press publication an adequate share of the revenues obtained from online use by information society service providers.
quote: Los autores de las obras incorporadas a una publicación de prensa recibirán una parte adecuada de los ingresos
conditional_on: Revenues from use of press publications by information society service providers

summary: The First Section of the Intellectual Property Commission determines tariffs for mandatory collective management rights and for concurrent voluntary rights; its decisions must be published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado and apply from the day after publication.
quote: dichas decisiones se publicarán en el «Boletín Oficial del Estado»
conditional_on: Absence of agreement within six months of formal start of negotiation

summary: The competent public administration may restrict, in the terms established, certain forms of unsolicited visits and organised excursions by traders to consumers' homes; restrictions must be proportionate and non-discriminatory.
quote: podrá restringir, en los términos que se establezca, determinadas formas y aspectos de las visitas no solicitadas
conditional_on: Protection of consumers' legitimate interests

summary: Commercial practices presenting goods or services with price must include at least trader identity and address, essential characteristics, full final price incl. taxes, payment/delivery terms where departing from professional diligence, withdrawal right where applicable, and for online marketplaces whether the third-party seller is a trader; information must be clear and accessible (esp. for vulnerable consumers). Traders giving access to consumer reviews must state whether and how they ensure reviews come from actual users/purchasers and how reviews are processed.
quote: deberán contener, al menos, la siguiente información
conditional_on: Commercial practices that include information on characteristics and price enabling a decision

summary: Where consumers can search offers by keyword, the trader must provide in a specific section of the interface general information on the main ranking parameters and their relative importance. Search-engine providers under Regulation (EU) 2019/1150 are excluded.
quote: deberán contener, en una sección específica de la interfaz en línea que sea fácil y directamente accesible
conditional_on: Keyword-based search offering goods or services from different traders

summary: Before a consumer is bound by a distance or off-premises contract, the trader must give clear, comprehensible pre-contract information (accessible formats for vulnerable consumers), including identity and contact details, total price, payment/delivery terms, withdrawal conditions, legal guarantee, digital functionality and interoperability, ADR, and, where applicable, the fact that the price was personalised on the basis of automated decision-making.
quote: el empresario le facilitará de forma clara y comprensible
conditional_on: Distance or off-premises contracts

summary: Before a consumer is bound by a contract or offer on an online marketplace, the marketplace provider must give information on the main ranking parameters, whether the third party is a trader, allocation of obligations between third party and provider, guarantees and insurance, and dispute resolution methods.
quote: el proveedor del mercado en línea le facilitará
conditional_on: Contract concluded on an online marketplace

summary: Where an order involves payment obligations, the trader must present the information in Art. 97.1(a), (e), (p) and (q) just before ordering, ensure the consumer expressly confirms the payment obligation, and label the ordering button only as 'pedido con obligación de pago' or an equivalent unambiguous wording.
quote: estos deberán etiquetarse, de manera que sea fácilmente legible
conditional_on: Distance contract concluded electronically that implies payment obligations

summary: If a consumer wants services or supply of water, gas or electricity to start within the withdrawal period and the contract imposes payment, the trader must require an express request for the start of the contract and a declaration that the consumer loses the withdrawal right once the contract is fully performed.
quote: el empresario le exigirá que presente una solicitud expresa solicitando el comienzo del contrato
conditional_on: Start of services or supply within the withdrawal period, with payment obligation

summary: After withdrawal, the trader must not use content other than personal data provided or created by the consumer, except in the listed situations. On request the trader must make such content available to the consumer.
quote: El empresario se abstendrá de utilizar cualquier contenido, distinto de los datos personales
conditional_on: Withdrawal from contract for digital content or services; exceptions in Art. 107(5)(a)-(c)

summary: On withdrawal from digital content/services contracts, the trader must comply with GDPR and LOPDGDD for personal data and, except where Art. 107(5)(a)-(c) applies, must make available to the consumer on request any other content the consumer provided or created, free of charge, within a reasonable time and in a commonly used machine-readable format (Art. 107(4), (6), (7)).
quote: el empresario pondrá a disposición del consumidor o usuario, a petición de éste, cualquier contenido distinto de los datos personales
conditional_on: Consumer request; no exception under Art. 107(5)(a), (b) or (c)

summary: Trader must provide, among other items, information on the existence and conditions of after-sales services and commercial guarantees, the functionality of goods with digital elements and interoperability information known or reasonably expected to be known to the trader, as amended in Art. 60(2) letters e), i) and j).
quote: la existencia y las condiciones de los servicios posventa y las garantías comerciales
conditional_on: Contract covered by Art. 60(2) information duties

summary: Marketing a product as identical to one sold in other Member States is considered unfair where it has significantly different composition or characteristics, unless justified by legitimate and objective factors.
quote: se considera desleal cualquier operación de comercialización de un bien como idéntico a otro comercializado en otros Estados miembros
conditional_on: Significantly different composition or characteristics, without legitimate objective justification

summary: Covert advertising is considered misleading unfair practice: paid promotional content in media or online services not clearly identified as advertising, and paid promotion aimed at higher ranking in search results without clear disclosure.
quote: Se consideran desleales por engañosas las prácticas que

summary: Unfair practices include: reselling tickets acquired by automated means circumventing purchase limits; claiming reviews come from consumers who used the product without reasonable checks; and adding or commissioning fake reviews or distorting reviews.
quote: Afirmen que las reseñas de un bien o servicio son añadidas por consumidores y usuarios que han utilizado o adquirido realmente el bien o servicio, sin tomar medidas razonables y proporcionadas para comprobar

summary: Where goods are offered at a reduced price, the prior price (the lowest applied to identical products in the preceding 30 days) must be clearly shown on each item, unless the goods are offered for the first time. Prices applied to reduce food waste are excluded from this computation.
quote: deberá figurar con claridad, en cada uno de ellos, el precio anterior junto con el precio reducido
conditional_on: Goods offered with a price reduction; not first-time offered items

summary: Contracting authorities and contracting entities must meet minimum public procurement targets for clean light and heavy vehicles (Annex tables 3 and 4), expressed as minimum shares of clean vehicles across reference periods; the Ministry of Transport, Mobility and Urban Agenda must promote and adopt measures ensuring compliance and determine the allocation of targets among administrations.
quote: Se establecen como objetivos mínimos a alcanzar los que figuran en el cuadro 3 del Anexo
conditional_on: Contracts in scope of Art. 87 with publication or approval after 2 August 2021

summary: All public administrations must comply with the clean-vehicle targets, cooperate with the State and report vehicle procurement data to the Ministry of Transport (non-public contracting entities likewise, as the Ministry sets); regions with equivalent platforms must publish the data on the Public Sector Contracting Platform, which makes it available to the Ministry; state, regional and local entities must report Art. 87.1(b) data electronically; the Ministry prepares the Directive 2009/33/EC Art. 10 reports for the triennial report, by 15 February 2027 and every three years thereafter.
quote: proporcionando asimismo los datos sobre el número de vehículos y categorías

summary: Mortgage participations and mortgage transmission certificates may not be marketed, distributed or sold to retail clients; issuing entities may not postpone, voluntarily cancel, waive, settle or condone the participated mortgages, or otherwise reduce their rank or value, without the express consent of all participants (DA 3, apdos. 3 and 6).
quote: Se prohíbe la comercialización, distribución o venta de participaciones hipotecarias y certificados de transmisión de hipoteca a clientes minoristas

summary: The issuing entity of mortgage participations and mortgage transmission certificates must keep a register of the loans and credits that secure the issues; essential data must be reflected in its annual accounts.
quote: llevará un libro registro de los préstamos y créditos que sirven de garantía

summary: Under the Banco de España's powers in Real Decreto-ley 19/2018 DA 4, in case of complaint or suspicion of breach, the businesses concerned must make available to the Banco de España all books, records and documents it considers necessary, including software and databases.
provision: Disposición final tercera (adding RDL 19/2018 DA 4, apartado 3(a))
quote: quedarán obligadas a poner a disposición del Banco de España cuantos libros, registros y documentos este considere precisos
conditional_on: Complaint or suspicion of a breach

summary: Importers or first distributors in the national market of consumer products that may affect safety and health must ensure the products meet the applicable requirements before being made available to consumers; they are jointly liable for penalties imposed on their suppliers where they failed to take available measures.
quote: tienen el deber de asegurar que dichos productos cumplen los requisitos exigibles
conditional_on: First placing on the market of consumer products that may affect safety and health

summary: The Government may adopt implementing regulations for the decree-law; the Minister of Economic Affairs may regulate collateral appraisal rules; the Government and the Minister of Finance are empowered for Book 5; the Government is empowered to approve the consumer-protection sanctioning procedure regulation and the General Register of Consumer Infractions and Sanctions; the Ministers of Finance, Transport and Ecological Transition may amend the Annex procurement targets for periods after 1 January 2030 by joint order (DF 9.1, 9.2, 9.4, 9.5, 9.6).
quote: El Gobierno podrá dictar las disposiciones reglamentarias necesarias para el desarrollo de este real decreto-ley

summary: The Banco de España may develop by Circular the additional information needed for supervision of covered bonds, the format and timing of information, and the information for monitoring the liquidity buffer.
quote: El Banco de España podrá desarrollar, mediante Circular

summary: The Government may modify by regulation the monetary amounts set in the decree-law, with amounts in Arts. 49 and 148 adjusted by consumer price index variation.
provision: Art. 82 Veinte (replacing TRLGDCU Disposición final primera)
quote: Se autoriza al Gobierno a modificar las cuantías establecidas esta norma.

summary: The Government is empowered to adopt provisions necessary for the application of the consumer law, including determining durable goods.
provision: Art. 82 Veintiuno (replacing TRLGDCU Disposición final segunda)
quote: Se faculta al Gobierno para dictar, en materia de su competencia, las disposiciones precisas para la aplicación de esta norma.

summary: Where the issuer designates an internal cover pool control body, it must ensure its independence: head appointed and removed by the board and reporting to the chair or head of internal control, procedures barring its access to credit-decision information and identifying conflicts of interest, and remuneration policies that preserve its autonomy.
quote: La entidad emisora debe diseñar, aprobar y aplicar los procedimientos y los mecanismos necesarios para que el órgano interno de control no pueda disponer de acceso a la información sobre el proceso de decisión crediticia
conditional_on: issuer opts for an internal control body

summary: The issuer must dismiss and replace the external control body when it no longer meets the Art. 31 requirements, is barred by an administrative sanction, or reaches the maximum contract period (ten years).
quote: El órgano externo de control del conjunto de cobertura de un programa de bonos garantizados deberá ser cesado por la entidad emisora y sustituido por otro órgano de control idóneo
conditional_on: loss of requirements, disqualifying sanction, or end of maximum contract period

summary: Banco de España must supervise compliance of each covered bond programme with the decree (Art. 33(1)); the CNMV supervises marketing, public offers and secondary-market aspects of covered bonds (Art. 33(3)).
quote: El Banco de España supervisará el cumplimiento de lo previsto en este real decreto-ley para cada uno de los programas de bonos garantizados

summary: In insolvency of the issuer the competent judge must appoint a special administrator for each covered bond programme, after consulting the Banco de España, from a shortlist of three proposed by FROB (Art. 41(1)); in resolution, FROB appoints the special administrator (Art. 41(2)).
quote: El juez competente, por razon del concurso, deberá nombrar un administrador especial para administrar un programa de bonos garantizados
conditional_on: insolvency or resolution of the issuer

summary: A UCITS from another Member State marketed in Spain must give investors in Spain all information and documents it must give home-state investors; the key investor information document must be in Spanish or another CNMV-admitted language, translations being faithful and under the IIC's responsibility (amended Art. 15.2, Ley 35/2003).
quote: La IIC a que se refiere el apartado anterior proporcionará a los inversores radicados en España toda la información y documentación
conditional_on: marketing in Spain of an EU-authorised UCITS
