summary: A request by a national competent authority for information shall contain a statement of reasons (unless a criminal or serious administrative offence investigation would be jeopardised) and information on available redress.
quote: The request referred to in paragraph 1 shall contain the following elements:

summary: Providers of political advertising services shall designate a contact point for interaction with national competent authorities; micro, small and medium-sized undertakings may appoint an external natural person.
quote: Providers of political advertising services shall designate a contact point for the interaction with competent national authorities.

summary: At the request of interested entities (vetted researchers, civil society organisations, political actors, electoral observers, journalists), providers of political advertising services shall transmit promptly and free of charge the information required under Arts. 9, 11 and 12, in machine-readable form where possible, within one month or with a reasoned response; they may aggregate or range amounts to protect commercial interests, may refuse manifestly unclear or excessive requests, and may charge a reasonable fee for significant costs.
quote: providers of political advertising services shall transmit promptly and free of charge, and where technically possible in a machine-readable format
conditional_on: at the request of interested entities

summary: Targeting or ad-delivery techniques involving personal data in online political advertising are permitted only if the controller collected the data from the data subject, the data subject gave explicit consent separately for political advertising, and the techniques do not involve profiling using special categories of personal data.
quote: Targeting techniques or ad-delivery techniques that involve the processing of personal data in the context of online political advertising shall be permitted only when the following conditions are fulfilled:
conditional_on: processing of personal data for online political advertising targeting or ad-delivery

summary: Targeting or ad-delivery techniques involving processing of personal data of a data subject known with reasonable certainty to be at least one year under the national voting age are prohibited; controllers are not required to process additional data to assess age.
quote: targeting techniques or ad-delivery techniques that involve the processing of the personal data of a data subject
conditional_on: data subject known with reasonable certainty to be at least one year under the voting age

summary: When requesting or withdrawing explicit consent for political advertising processing, controllers shall not request consent from a data subject who has already indicated by automated means refusal (unless a substantial change of circumstances), and shall offer a non-refusing data subject an equivalent alternative for using the online service without political advertising.
quote: the data subject is not requested to consent if he or she has already indicated by automated means that he or she does not consent to data processing for political advertising purposes

summary: Controllers using targeting or ad-delivery techniques shall adopt, implement and make publicly available an internal policy in plain language on their use, retain it for seven years from last use, and provide with each political advertisement the logic, main parameters, recipient groups, data categories, targeting goals, use of AI systems, period and number of recipients, and a link to the policy.
quote: adopt, implement and make publicly available an internal policy describing clearly and in plain language how such techniques are used
conditional_on: use of targeting or ad-delivery techniques involving processing of personal data

summary: Controllers shall keep records on the use of targeting and ad-delivery techniques, including the relevant mechanisms and parameters used.
quote: keep records on the use of such techniques, the relevant mechanisms and parameters used
conditional_on: use of targeting or ad-delivery techniques involving processing of personal data

summary: Controllers shall prepare an internal annual risk assessment of the use of targeting or ad-delivery techniques on fundamental rights and freedoms, with results made publicly available.
quote: prepare an internal annual risk assessment of the use of targeting techniques or ad-delivery techniques on the fundamental rights and freedoms
conditional_on: use of targeting or ad-delivery techniques involving processing of personal data

summary: Controllers shall provide, with the advertisement (unless included in the transparency notice), a reference to effective means to exercise data protection rights, including rights to amend data or withdraw consent, with a link to an interface for exercising them.
quote: a reference to effective means to support individuals exercise their rights under Regulations (EU) 2016/679 or (EU) 2018/1725
conditional_on: use of targeting or ad-delivery techniques involving processing of personal data

summary: Where the controller differs from the publisher, the controller shall communicate the Art. 19(1)(c) and (e) information to the publisher in a timely and accurate manner, by standardised automated process where technically possible.
quote: Where the controller is different from the political advertising publisher, the controller shall ensure that the information referred to in paragraph 1
conditional_on: controller is different from the political advertising publisher

summary: Providers of political advertising services shall, as necessary, transmit to controllers the information needed to comply with Art. 19(1) and (2).
quote: Providers of political advertising services shall, as necessary, transmit to the controllers the information necessary to comply with paragraphs 1 and 2.

summary: The Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts amending Art. 19 by adding points to Art. 19(1) in light of technological and market developments.
quote: The Commission is empowered to adopt delegated acts in accordance with Article 28 to amend this Regulation by adding points

summary: Controllers shall take appropriate measures to transmit to interested entities, at their request and free of charge, the Art. 19 information.
quote: Controllers shall take appropriate measures to transmit to interested entities referred to in Article 17(2), at their request and free of charge
conditional_on: request by an interested entity referred to in Art. 17(2)

summary: Service providers offering political advertising services in the Union without an EU establishment shall designate in writing a legal representative in one Member State, register it with the competent authority, and give it the necessary powers and resources; the legal representative is responsible for compliance and is the addressee of communications.
quote: shall designate, in writing, a natural or legal person as its legal representative in one of the Member States where that provider offers its services
conditional_on: provider has no establishment in the Union

summary: Member States shall designate a national competent authority to keep publicly available, machine-readable online registers of legal representatives; the Commission shall set up and maintain a public portal linking to them.
quote: Member States shall designate one national competent authority responsible for keeping publicly available and machine-readable online registers

summary: Member States shall designate competent authorities for Arts. 18 and 19 (data protection supervisory authorities), for intermediary service providers under Arts. 7 to 17 and 21 (with Digital Services Coordinators coordinating), and one or more independent authorities for other aspects; they shall provide resources and national cooperation, and designate a national contact point. The EDPB shall prepare guidelines for supervisory authorities on Arts. 18 and 19, and the network of national contact points shall meet at least twice a year.
quote: Each Member State shall designate one or more competent authorities to be responsible for the application and enforcement of the aspects of this Regulation

summary: Competent authorities shall, on a justified request from another authority, provide assistance and information without undue delay (within one month, or 14 days for requested information); a competent authority suspecting an infringement shall notify the authority of the main establishment, which shall communicate its assessment within one month; authorities shall cooperate in good faith in any joint investigation.
quote: A competent authority shall, upon receipt of a justified request from another competent authority, provide the other competent authority, without undue delay and no later than one month
conditional_on: justified request from another competent authority, or suspected infringement in another Member State

summary: Competent authorities shall duly address every notification of possible infringements, inform the notifier of follow-up on request, and transmit complaints falling within another Member State's competence without undue delay; during the last month before elections or referendums, notifications about them shall be addressed without undue delay.
quote: competent authorities shall duly address every notification of possible infringements of this Regulation

summary: Member States shall notify the Commission of their sanctions rules and measures by 10 January 2026 and of subsequent amendments without delay.
quote: Member States shall, by 10 January 2026, notify the Commission of those rules and of those measures

summary: Member States shall report annually to the Commission on the sanctions imposed to enforce the Regulation, including the types of sanctions and amounts of fines.
quote: Member States shall report annually to the Commission on the sanctions imposed to enforce the provisions of this Regulation

summary: Member States shall publish the dates of their elections and referendums and, where applicable, their electoral periods, in an easily accessible place with a reference to this Regulation.
quote: Member States shall publish the dates of their elections and referendums and, where applicable, of their electoral periods

summary: The Commission shall provide a publicly available portal through which Member States provide election and referendum dates immediately after announcement.
quote: The Commission shall provide a portal through which Member States shall provide, immediately after announcement

summary: The Commission shall submit a public report on the evaluation and review of the Regulation to Parliament and Council, assessing need for amendment on listed matters.
applies_from: within two years after each election to the European Parliament
quote: Within two years after each election to the European Parliament, the Commission shall submit a report on the evaluation and review of this Regulation

summary: The Commission's power to adopt delegated acts under Art. 12(6) and Art. 19(5) is conferred for four years from 9 April 2024, tacitly extendable; the Commission shall draw up a report at least nine months before the period ends, consult Member State experts before adopting delegated acts, notify them simultaneously to Parliament and Council, and no objection period applies under Art. 28(6).
quote: The power to adopt delegated acts referred to in Article 12(6) and Article 19(5) shall be conferred on the Commission for a period of four years from the 9 April 2024.

summary: In Member State court proceedings for product damage, the defendant is required, on a reasoned request and after the claimant presents sufficient facts and evidence, to disclose relevant evidence at its disposal; disclosure must be limited to what is necessary and proportionate. Member States must ensure this (Art. 9(1) to (3)).
quote: the defendant is required to disclose relevant evidence that is at the defendant’s disposal
conditional_on: at the request of a claimant in national court proceedings who has presented facts and evidence sufficient to support the plausibility of the claim

summary: Member States shall not maintain or introduce national provisions diverging from this Directive, including more or less stringent provisions, unless the Directive otherwise provides.
quote: Member States shall not maintain or introduce, in their national law, provisions diverging from those laid down in this Directive
conditional_on: unless otherwise provided for in this Directive

summary: Member States that maintain existing measures under the development risk defence derogation must notify the text of those measures to the Commission, and the Commission informs the other Member States (Art. 18(1), second subparagraph).
quote: shall notify the text of the measures to the Commission no later than 9 December 2026
conditional_on: Member State wishes to maintain existing measures under Art. 18(1)

summary: Measures introduced or amended under Art. 18(2) must be limited to specific categories of products, justified by public interest objectives, and proportionate.
quote: The measures referred to in paragraph 2 shall be:
conditional_on: Member State introduces or amends a development risk derogation measure under Art. 18(2)

summary: A Member State introducing or amending a development risk derogation measure must notify the proposed text to the Commission with a justification of compliance with Art. 18(3); the Commission informs other Member States.
quote: shall notify the text of the proposed measure to the Commission
conditional_on: Member State wishes to introduce or amend a measure under Art. 18(2)

summary: After notification under Art. 18(4), the Member State must hold the proposed measure in abeyance for six months unless the Commission issues its opinion earlier. The Commission may issue a non-binding opinion within six months.
quote: shall hold that measure in abeyance for six months following its notification to the Commission
conditional_on: notification of a proposed measure under Art. 18(4)

summary: Member States must publish in an easily accessible electronic format final judgments delivered by national courts of appeal or the highest instance in proceedings under the Directive.
quote: Member States shall publish, in an easily accessible and electronic format, any final judgment
conditional_on: final judgment delivered by a national court of appeal or of the highest instance in proceedings under this Directive

summary: The Commission must set up and maintain an easily accessible, publicly available database containing the judgments referred to in Art. 19(1).
quote: The Commission shall set up and maintain an easily accessible and publicly available database

summary: The Commission must evaluate the application of the Directive by 9 December 2030 and every five years thereafter, and submit a report to Parliament, the Council and the EESC, including cost-benefit information, an OECD comparison and product liability insurance availability.
applies_from: by 9 December 2030, and every five years thereafter
quote: The Commission shall by 9 December 2030, and every five years thereafter, evaluate the application of this Directive and submit a report

summary: Member States must bring into force the laws, regulations and administrative provisions necessary to comply with the Directive, inform the Commission immediately, and include a reference to the Directive in those measures.
quote: Member States shall bring into force the laws, regulations and administrative provisions necessary to comply with this Directive by 9 December 2026.

summary: Member States must communicate to the Commission the text of the main national law measures they adopt in the field covered by the Directive.
quote: Member States shall communicate to the Commission the text of the main measures of national law which they adopt
conditional_on: adoption of main measures of national law in the field covered by the Directive

summary: The market surveillance authorities named in §3 supervise high-risk AI systems under AI Act Art. 6(1) and 6(2), each within its designated sector (Safety and Chemicals Agency, Customs, Traficom, Energy Authority, Occupational Safety authority, Data Protection Ombudsman, Financial Supervisory Authority, Licensing and Supervisory Agency, Medicines Agency and others). Also covers supervision of accessibility-product cases under the Accessibility Act.
quote: valvova markkinavalvontaviranomainen on

summary: The Data Protection Ombudsman, as market surveillance authority, supervises compliance with the prohibited AI practices in AI Act Art. 5.
quote: Tietosuojavaltuutettu valvoo markkinavalvontaviranomaisena tekoälyasetuksen 5 artiklan mukaisten kiellettyjen tekoälyyn liittyvien käytäntöjen noudattamista.

summary: Traficom, as market surveillance authority, supervises compliance with the transparency obligations in AI Act Art. 50. For high-risk AI systems providers and deployers, the competent authority under §3 supervises Art. 50 instead.
quote: Liikenne- ja viestintävirasto valvoo markkinavalvontaviranomaisena

summary: Traficom acts as the single point of contact under AI Act Art. 70(2) and coordinates authority cooperation, contacts with EU bodies and with other Member State authorities, and provides expert support to authorities; it may obtain necessary information free of charge despite secrecy provisions.
quote: Liikenne- ja viestintävirasto toimii tekoälyasetuksen 70 artiklan 2 kohdassa tarkoitettuna keskitettynä yhteyspisteenä.

summary: The single point of contact is responsible, together with the other market surveillance authorities, for reporting to the European Commission under AI Act Art. 99(11).
quote: Keskitetty yhteyspiste vastaa tekoälyasetuksen 99 artiklan 11 kohdassa tarkoitetusta raportointivelvoitteesta Euroopan komissiolle yhteistyössä muiden markkinavalvontaviranomaisten kanssa.

summary: The Financial Supervisory Authority is the authority that notifies the European Central Bank of the information referred to in AI Act Art. 74(7), second subparagraph.
quote: Finanssivalvonta on tekoälyasetuksen 74 artiklan 7 kohdan toisessa alakohdassa tarkoitettu ja siinä tarkoitetut tiedot Euroopan keskuspankille ilmoittava viranomainen.

summary: The notifying authority named in §8 designates conformity assessment bodies as notified bodies, under AI Act Arts. 29–31. The Safety and Chemicals Agency's accreditation service issues accreditation certificates confirming that a body meets Art. 31 requirements.
quote: Edellä 8 §:ssä tarkoitettu toimivaltainen ilmoittamisesta vastaava viranomainen nimeää vaatimustenmukaisuuden arviointilaitoksen ilmoitetuksi laitokseksi.

summary: Members and deputy members of the penalty fee board (seuraamusmaksulautakunta) act independently and impartially in their duties; the board's members must be civil servants with the specified expertise, and its chair and deputy chair must have legal expertise.
quote: Lautakunnan jäsen ja varajäsen toimivat tehtävässään riippumattomasti ja puolueettomasti.

summary: A provider, or an authorised representative established in Finland, must ensure that the technical documentation under AI Act Art. 18(1) is available to market surveillance and notifying authorities for 10 years after the high-risk AI system is placed on the market or put into service, even if the business ceases or is wound up.
quote: Tarjoajan tai Suomeen sijoittautuneen valtuutetun edustajan on varmistettava

summary: Market surveillance authorities may issue orders on the principles and procedures for retaining the documentation referred to in §26(1).
quote: Markkinavalvontaviranomaiset voivat antaa määräyksiä

summary: Electricity for data-storage infrastructure qualifies for a reduced excise rate on the part of annual consumption above one gigawatt-hour only if eight cumulative conditions are met: secure access; dedicated thermal, air, power and fire controls; an energy management system; membership of a recognised best-practice programme with periodic reporting; heat recovery or a power-efficiency indicator; a water-use indicator for cooling; and electro-sensitive activities.
quote: Relève d'un tarif réduit de l'accise, pour la fraction qui excède un gigawattheure sur une année civile, l'électricité
conditional_on: Electricity consumption exceeds one gigawatt-hour per calendar year and the eight cumulative conditions in points 1° to 8° are met.

summary: Decree (décret) sets the multi-year efficiency-in-power-use indicator under point 6° (by reference to the space occupied by IT equipment and, where relevant, its use) and the multi-year water-use indicator under point 7°.
quote: déterminé par décret en fonction de l'espace occupé par les équipements informatiques
conditional_on: Applies only where the data-center infrastructure is assessed under points 6° and 7° of the eligibility conditions.

summary: Injunction to the company not to collect or process personal data of persons located in French territory for its facial recognition software without a legal basis.
quote: une injonction de ne pas procéder sans base légale à la collecte et au traitement de données à caractère personnel relatives à des personnes concernées qui se trouvent sur le territoire français

summary: Injunction to delete all personal data of the persons concerned, including the complainant's data, after responding to access requests already made.
quote: supprimer l’ensemble des données à caractère personnel de ces personnes
conditional_on: after having responded to access requests already made, where applicable

summary: Course content under Code de l'éducation L. 312-9 must include awareness of the environmental impact of digital tools and a digital sobriety component.
provision: Art. 1 (amending Code de l'éducation L. 312-9, 2nd para.)
quote: Cette formation comporte également une sensibilisation à l'impact environnemental des outils numériques

summary: Course content under Code de l'éducation L. 611-8 must include awareness of the environmental impact of digital tools and a digital sobriety component.
provision: Art. 2 (amending Code de l'éducation L. 611-8, 2nd para.)
quote: Cette formation comporte une sensibilisation à l'impact environnemental des outils numériques

summary: The body under Code de l'éducation L. 642-3 verifies that engineering programmes include a module on ecodesign of digital services and digital sobriety. Applies from the start of the 2022 school term per Art. 3 II.
applies_from: first day of the rentrée scolaire 2022
provision: Art. 3 I (amending Code de l'éducation L. 642-3, 1st para.)
quote: Elle vérifie que les formations d'ingénieur comportent un module relatif à l'écoconception des services numériques et à la sobriété numérique.

summary: The observatory of environmental impacts of digital technology analyses and quantifies direct and indirect impacts of digital technology, and develops a definition of digital sobriety.
quote: Un observatoire des impacts environnementaux du numérique analyse et quantifie les impacts directs et indirects du numérique

summary: The observatory's work is made public and may include proposals to reduce environmental impacts of digital technology.
quote: Les travaux de l'observatoire des impacts environnementaux du numérique sont rendus publics

summary: Planned obsolescence techniques under Code de la consommation L. 441-2 are extended to include software techniques.
provision: Art. 6 (amending Code de la consommation L. 441-2)
quote: y compris logicielles

summary: The prohibited practices under Code de la consommation L. 441-3 are extended to limiting restoration of all functionalities of a device. The inserted text does not name the addressee.
provision: Art. 7 (amending Code de la consommation L. 441-3, 1st para.)
quote: ou à limiter la restauration de l'ensemble des fonctionnalités d'un tel appareil

summary: New L. 441-6 prohibits any technique, including software, that restricts the consumer's freedom to install software or operating systems of choice after the period in L. 217-12, except to ensure conformity of the terminal with essential requirements in CPCE L. 34-9.
applies_from: after the period in Code de la consommation L. 217-12
provision: Art. 8 (new Code de la consommation L. 441-6)
quote: Toute technique, y compris logicielle, dont l'objet est de restreindre la liberté du consommateur d'installer les logiciels ou les systèmes d'exploitation de son choix
conditional_on: unless the technique ensures conformity with essential requirements under CPCE L. 34-9

summary: The seller informs the consumer, in a clear and understandable way, of the essential characteristics of each update of digital elements of the goods (storage required, impact on performance, changes in functions) (Code de la consommation L. 217-22).
provision: Art. 9 2° (amending Code de la consommation L. 217-22)
quote: Le vendeur informe le consommateur, de façon lisible et compréhensible, des caractéristiques essentielles de chaque mise à jour

summary: Where the contract provides supply of digital content or service for more than two years, the seller ensures the consumer is informed of updates and receives them during the supply period (Code de la consommation L. 217-23 I).
provision: Art. 10 2° (amending Code de la consommation L. 217-23, new para. I)
quote: le vendeur veille à ce que le consommateur soit informé de telles mises à jour et à ce qu'il les reçoive
conditional_on: where the contract provides supply of digital content or service for more than two years

summary: For software updates not needed to maintain conformity, the seller informs the consumer of each planned update, with its date, reasonably in advance and on a durable medium, and informs the consumer of the right to refuse or uninstall an update with negative impact.
provision: Art. 11 (new Code de la consommation L. 217-33, 2°)
quote: Le vendeur informe le consommateur, de manière claire et compréhensible, de chaque mise à jour envisagée
conditional_on: only for software updates not necessary to maintain conformity of the good; the contract must authorise such updates and give a valid reason

summary: Non-conformity updates under new Code de la consommation L. 217-33 are made without additional cost to the consumer.
provision: Art. 11 (new Code de la consommation L. 217-33, 3°)
quote: Chaque mise à jour est effectuée sans coût supplémentaire pour le consommateur
conditional_on: only for software updates not necessary to maintain conformity of the good

summary: Recycling, reuse and repair objectives set in eco-organisation or individual system specifications are to be broken down specifically for certain goods with digital elements. The text does not name the addressee; the duty is passive.
quote: sont déclinés de manière spécifique pour certains biens comportant des éléments numériques, au plus tard le 1er janvier 2028

summary: Producers of electrical and electronic equipment or their eco-organisation run an annual national collection operation with a return bonus for consumers returning phones, tablets and laptops, where needed to reach collection targets.
quote: les producteurs d'équipements électriques et électroniques ou leur éco-organisme mènent, chaque année, des opérations de collecte nationale
conditional_on: where necessary to reach collection objectives and reduce stocks of unused used equipment

summary: The Government submits a report to Parliament on measures to improve recycling, reuse and re-utilisation of digital equipment and their feasibility.
quote: Dans un délai de six mois à compter de la promulgation de la présente loi, le Gouvernement remet au Parlement un rapport

summary: In public purchases of digital products with a repairability index, State services and local authorities take the repairability index into account.
quote: A compter du 1er janvier 2023, lors de l'achat public de produits numériques disposant d'un indice de réparabilité

summary: In public purchases of digital products with a durability index, State services and local authorities take the durability index into account.
quote: A compter du 1er janvier 2026, lors de l'achat public de produits numériques disposant d'un indice de durabilité

summary: Functional IT equipment that State services or local authorities dispose of is directed to reuse or re-utilisation, in proportions, on a schedule and under modalities set by decree. Equipment older than ten years is directed to recycling.
quote: Les équipements informatiques fonctionnels dont les services de l'Etat ou les collectivités territoriales et leurs groupements se séparent sont orientés vers le réemploi ou la réutilisation
conditional_on: proportions, schedule and modalities set by decree

summary: Access to spare parts and information for repair is extended to reconditioners (amends Code de la consommation L. 111-4, and L. 441-4 extended to reuse and re-utilisation).
provision: Art. 18 1° a) (amending Code de la consommation L. 111-4)
quote: et les reconditionneurs

summary: Remuneration for pre-owned or refurbished recording media under CPI L. 311-4 must be specific and differentiated from that for new media, with exceptions for refurbishing by certain social economy entities. The text does not name the payer.
quote: la rémunération due doit être spécifique et différenciée de celle établie pour les supports d'enregistrements neufs de même nature

summary: The amount of remuneration fixed for pre-owned or refurbished recording media may not be changed before 31 December 2022.
quote: ne peut être modifié avant le 31 décembre 2022

summary: The Government submits to Parliament a report on private copy remuneration, covering its base, scale, use of revenue, publication of data and proposals on transparency of the commission and refund practices.
quote: Le Gouvernement remet au Parlement, au plus tard le 31 décembre 2021, un rapport portant sur la rémunération pour copie privée

summary: The Government submits to Parliament a study of the economic impacts of private copy remuneration, especially on pre-owned recording media, with possible scenarios for its evolution.
quote: Le Gouvernement remet également au Parlement, au plus tard le 31 décembre 2022, une étude des impacts économiques

summary: Any professional selling or leasing new mobile terminal equipment informs the consumer of the existence of refurbished mobile terminal offers (new Code de la consommation L. 122-25).
provision: Art. 21 1° (new Code de la consommation L. 122-25)
quote: Tout professionnel qui propose à la vente ou à la location des équipements terminaux mobiles neufs informe le consommateur

summary: Before contracting, internet access and interpersonal electronic communications providers disclose the price of each element of a bundled offer where the elements are also sold separately (new Code de la consommation L. 224-27-3).
provision: Art. 21 2° (new Code de la consommation L. 224-27-3)
quote: Préalablement à la conclusion d'un contrat, les fournisseurs de services d'accès à l'internet et de communications électroniques interpersonnelles accessibles au public communiquent
conditional_on: where the bundle elements are also sold separately

summary: Distributors of IT equipment communicate to consumers, free of charge and during use, alerts and advice on usage, maintenance or cleaning to optimise performance and extend device lifespan (new CE L. 541-9-3-1).
quote: Les distributeurs d'équipements informatiques communiquent sans frais aux consommateurs de leurs produits

summary: Manufacturers or importers of radio terminals connectable to the public telephone network ensure availability of compatible earphones during the terminal's marketing period (CPCE L. 34-9, last para.).
quote: assurent la disponibilité d'écouteurs compatibles avec le modèle de terminal pendant sa période de commercialisation

summary: The prohibition on routing calls and messages with a caller identifier from the EU-number-scope is changed to national scope (CPCE L. 44 V). Exceptions are added for international roaming end users and for operators able to guarantee that the caller is the number holder or has consented.
quote: « de l'Union européenne » sont remplacés par le mot : « national »

summary: The regulatory authority may specify categories of national telephone numbers that may not be used as caller identifiers by automated call and message systems, and the measures operators implement to interrupt non-compliant calls and messages (CPCE L. 44 VI).
quote: L'autorité peut préciser les catégories de numéros du plan national de numérotation téléphonique qu'il est interdit d'utiliser

summary: ARCEP and the Conseil supérieur de l'audiovisuel, with ADEME, define the content of a general reference for ecodesign of digital services (new CPCE L. 38-5), including criteria on display and reading of multimedia content to limit attention-capture strategies.
quote: définissent le contenu d'un référentiel général de l'écoconception des services numériques

summary: The Conseil supérieur de l'audiovisuel, with ARCEP and ADEME, publishes a recommendation on consumer information about energy use and greenhouse gas equivalents of data consumption by television, on-demand audiovisual and video-sharing services (new CPCE L. 38-6).
quote: publie une recommandation quant à l'information des consommateurs par les services de télévision

summary: The Government submits a report to Parliament on the development of cryptocurrencies and their present and future environmental impacts, including hosting on private hardware for mining abroad.
quote: Dans un délai d'un an à compter de la promulgation de la présente loi, le Gouvernement remet au Parlement un rapport

summary: For the data-centre tax exemption under Loi 2020-1721 Art. 167 I, the data storage centre must recover waste heat (including via a heat or cold network) or meet a numerical efficiency indicator set by decree over a multi-year horizon. A further water-use indicator is added in 4° (set by decree).
quote: Le centre de stockage de données numériques valorise la chaleur fatale, notamment à travers un réseau de chaleur ou de froid
conditional_on: alternative: meet an indicator set by decree on power-use efficiency

summary: Electronic communications operators publish key indicators on their environmental footprint policies, covering emissions, handset collection and renewal, ecodesign, recycling and reuse of boxes and decoders, and responsible-use awareness. A decree sets the content and an annual turnover threshold below which operators are exempt.
quote: Les opérateurs de communications électroniques publient des indicateurs clefs sur leurs politiques de réduction de leur empreinte environnementale
conditional_on: not applicable below the annual France turnover threshold set by decree

summary: In rural and low-density zones defined by decree, the site-sharing or pylon-sharing file includes, at the mayor's request, justification for not using a shared site or pylon solution.
provision: Art. 30 (CPCE L. 34-9-1, II D, added sentence)
quote: il comprend également, pour information et à la demande du maire, la justification du choix de ne pas recourir à une solution de partage de site ou de pylône
conditional_on: in zones defined by decree; at the request of the mayor

summary: The report under CPCE L. 135 includes the level of active and passive sharing of mobile telephony infrastructure nationally (new 5° bis).
quote: Fait état du niveau de partage actif et passif des infrastructures de téléphonie mobile sur le territoire national

summary: Frequency-assignment conditions under CPCE L. 42-1 I must take account of land-planning needs and the environmental protection objective.
quote: en tenant compte des objectifs mentionnés à l'article L. 32-1, notamment des besoins d'aménagement du territoire et de l'objectif de protection de l'environnement

summary: A purchaser or lessee of land for mobile antenna masts, not itself subject to CPCE L. 33-1, informs the mayor or intercommunal president in writing and attaches a mandate document from the mobile operator.
quote: en informe par écrit le maire de la commune où se situe ce terrain
conditional_on: where the land is intended for masts or towers supporting antennas, and the acquirer is not itself subject to CPCE L. 33-1

summary: Works for land development or construction of masts or towers may not begin before the information required under CPCE L. 34-9-1-1, where applicable (new Code de l'urbanisme L. 425-17).
provision: Art. 33 II (new Code de l'urbanisme L. 425-17)
quote: ne peuvent être réalisés avant, s'il y a lieu, l'information mentionnée à l'article L. 34-9-1-1
conditional_on: where the information under CPCE L. 34-9-1-1 is required

summary: The climate-air-energy plans of local authorities (Code de l'environnement L. 229-26 II 2°) must include heat recovery potential from data centres and the aim to reduce the digital environmental footprint. This applies to plans whose preparation or revision is decided after the law's publication.
quote: y compris le potentiel de récupération de chaleur à partir des centres de données
conditional_on: plans whose preparation or revision is decided after publication of the law (Art. 34 II)

summary: Communes with more than 50,000 inhabitants (and EPCIs with own tax of more than 50,000 inhabitants) define a responsible digital strategy with reduction objectives and measures.
quote: Les communes de plus de 50 000 habitants définissent, au plus tard le 1er janvier 2025, une stratégie numérique responsable
conditional_on: communes and EPCIs with more than 50,000 inhabitants

summary: Communes with more than 50,000 inhabitants prepare a preparatory work programme for the responsible digital strategy, including an inventory of stakeholders.
quote: Elles élaborent, au plus tard le 1er janvier 2023, un programme de travail préalable à l'élaboration de la stratégie
conditional_on: communes and EPCIs with more than 50,000 inhabitants

summary: The responsible digital strategy is reviewed annually within the sustainable development report under CGCT L. 2311-1-1.
quote: La stratégie numérique responsable fait l'objet d'un bilan annuel dans le cadre du rapport sur la situation en matière de développement durable

summary: Content and preparation procedures for the responsible digital strategy are specified by decree.
quote: Le contenu de cette stratégie et les modalités de son élaboration sont précisés par décret.

summary: The sustainable development report under CGCT L. 2311-1-1 (amended) includes the annual review of the responsible digital strategy.
quote: qui comprend notamment le bilan annuel de la stratégie numérique responsable

summary: The Government submits a report to Parliament on the environmental impact of cloud gaming (jeu à la demande) with a cost-benefit assessment.
quote: Le Gouvernement remet au Parlement, dans un délai de six mois à compter de la promulgation de la présente loi, un rapport sur l'impact environnemental de la pratique du jeu à la demande.

summary: Advertising and promotion rules for online services (EU Regulation 1924/2006 and listed provisions of the Code de la santé publique, Code de la consommation, Code monétaire et financier and Code du sport) apply to the influencer activity; promotion of sugary or sweetened drinks and manufactured foods is subject to CSP Art. L. 2133-1. Influencers are the addressees named in the article.
quote: sont applicables à l'activité d'influence commerciale définie à l'article 1er

summary: The Conseil d'Etat decree specifies, as needed, the application rules for Art. 3.
quote: Un décret en Conseil d'Etat précise, en tant que de besoin, les modalités d'application du présent article.

summary: Where the influencer activity is carried out by a person under 16, the employer is subject to Law 2020-1266 on commercial use of images of children under 16 on online platforms.
quote: l'employeur est soumis à la loi n° 2020-1266 du 19 octobre 2020
conditional_on: Activity carried out by a person under sixteen years of age.

summary: Prohibits direct or indirect promotion by influencers of: aesthetic acts and procedures (I); products or methods presented as substitutes for therapeutic acts (II); nicotine products (III); animals outside the listed species, with an exception for authorised establishments (IV); listed financial products and services (V); sports betting advice subscriptions (VI); and, under VIII, any sale, promotional offer or payment in exchange for registration in training actions. Penalty references are excluded.
quote: Est interdite aux personnes exerçant l'activité d'influence commerciale par voie électronique toute promotion

summary: Gambling and betting commercial communications by influencers are authorised only on online platforms that technically allow excluding all users under 18 from the audience, and only if that exclusion mechanism is effectively activated. The exclusion mechanisms must conform to an ARCOM referential.
quote: sont autorisées uniquement sur les plateformes en ligne offrant la possibilité technique d'exclure de l'audience dudit contenu tous les utilisateurs âgés de moins de dix-huit ans
conditional_on: The platform offers the technical possibility to exclude users under 18 and the mechanism is activated.

summary: Gambling communications must carry a clear, legible and identifiable mention that the content is prohibited for under-18s, throughout the whole promotion.
quote: Ces communications commerciales sont accompagnées d'une mention signalant l'interdiction dudit contenu aux moins de dix-huit ans.

summary: Promotion contracts with gambling operators must include a clause in which the influencer attests knowledge of the applicable gambling communication laws and undertakes to comply with them.
quote: Les contrats de promotion avec les opérateurs de jeux d'argent et de hasard comportent une clause

summary: Promotion must be explicitly marked « Publicité » or « Collaboration commerciale », clearly and identifiably on the image or video throughout. Also requires labels « Images retouchées » (body or face retouching) and « Images virtuelles » (AI-generated faces or silhouettes) (II), and information on funding, commitments, eligibility and providers for promotion of training actions (III).
quote: doit être explicitement indiquée par la mention « Publicité » ou la mention « Collaboration commerciale »

summary: Persons who only market products without handling delivery must give the buyer the information required by Code de la consommation Art. L. 221-5 and the supplier's identity, and must ensure product availability and lawfulness, including that products are not counterfeit.
quote: Ces personnes communiquent à l'acheteur les informations prévues à l'article L. 221-5 du code de la consommation
conditional_on: Activity limited to marketing products where delivery is made by the supplier.

summary: Influencer agents must take all necessary measures to defend the interests of the persons they represent, avoid conflicts of interest and ensure their activity complies with the law.
quote: prennent toutes les mesures nécessaires pour garantir la défense des intérêts des personnes qu'ils représentent

summary: Contracts between an influencer and an agent or advertiser must be in writing, under penalty of nullity, and contain listed items: party identities and tax residence, nature of missions, remuneration or benefit terms, rights and obligations including intellectual property, and submission to French law where the content targets a French public. Contracts below a decree threshold are exempt.
quote: est, sous peine de nullité, rédigé par écrit et comporte notamment les mentions et les clauses suivantes

summary: Influencers established outside the EU, EEA and Switzerland, and certain sole traders, must designate in writing a legal representative in the EU. The representative must ensure contract compliance and respond to requests from competent authorities; the designation does not constitute an EU establishment.
quote: désignent par écrit une personne morale ou physique pour assurer une forme de représentation légale sur le territoire de l'Union européenne.
conditional_on: Persons established outside the EU, Switzerland or the EEA.

summary: Influencers must give the representative the necessary powers and sufficient resources to cooperate effectively with authorities, and must communicate on request to the administrative authorities the representative's name, postal address, email and telephone number.
quote: communiquent, sur demande, aux autorités administratives compétentes le nom
conditional_on: Persons established outside the EU, Switzerland or the EEA.

summary: Influencers established outside the EU, EEA and Switzerland whose activity targets, even incidentally, a French public must hold civil liability insurance for professional liability, with an insurer established in the EU.
quote: Est tenue de souscrire, auprès d'un assureur établi dans l'Union européenne, une assurance civile
conditional_on: Persons established outside the EU, Switzerland or the EEA whose activity targets, even incidentally, a public in France.

summary: The Conseil d'Etat decree specifies the application rules for Art. 9.
quote: Les modalités d'application du présent article sont définies par décret en Conseil d'Etat.

summary: Hosting service providers must set up mechanisms allowing any entity or individual to report specific information elements considered illegal content, including under the 2023 law, under the conditions of DSA Art. 16. Intermediary services must publish reports on their content moderation activities under DSA Art. 15.
applies_from: date d'application prévue à l'article 93 du règlement (UE) 2022/2065
quote: mettent en place des mécanismes permettant à toute entité ou à tout particulier de leur signaler
conditional_on: Entry into force not before the EU Commission response under Art. 18.

summary: Intermediary service providers must make public reports on their content moderation activities, under the conditions of DSA Art. 15.
applies_from: date d'application prévue à l'article 93 du règlement (UE) 2022/2065
quote: Les fournisseurs de services intermédiaires mettent à la disposition du public des rapports sur leurs éventuelles activités de modération des contenus
conditional_on: Entry into force not before the EU Commission response under Art. 18.

summary: Online platform providers must take necessary measures so that notices submitted by trusted flaggers are processed as a priority, under DSA Art. 22.
applies_from: date d'application prévue à l'article 93 du règlement (UE) 2022/2065
quote: prennent les mesures nécessaires pour veiller à ce que les notifications soumises par des signaleurs de confiance soient traitées prioritairement
conditional_on: Entry into force not before the EU Commission response under Art. 18.

summary: The competent Digital Services Coordinator grants trusted flagger status to entities meeting the DSA Art. 22 conditions and acting against violations of the 2023 law, the Consumer Code, the Public Health Code or the Intellectual Property Code.
applies_from: date d'application prévue à l'article 93 du règlement (UE) 2022/2065
quote: Le coordinateur pour les services numériques compétent attribue le statut de signaleur de confiance
conditional_on: Entry into force not before the EU Commission response under Art. 18.

summary: Intermediary service providers must act promptly on injunctions to act issued by competent national judicial or administrative authorities, under DSA Arts. 9 and 10.
applies_from: date d'application prévue à l'article 93 du règlement (UE) 2022/2065
quote: prennent les mesures nécessaires pour donner suite, dans les meilleurs délais, aux injonctions d'agir
conditional_on: Entry into force not before the EU Commission response under Art. 18.

summary: Competent national authorities must make available to intermediary service providers, at least every six months, the list of websites promoting goods or services considered illegal under the 2023 law.
applies_from: date d'application prévue à l'article 93 du règlement (UE) 2022/2065
quote: au moins tous les six mois, la liste des sites internet faisant la promotion de biens ou de services considérés comme illicites
conditional_on: Entry into force not before the EU Commission response under Art. 18.

summary: Online platform operators must adopt a commitments protocol with the State aimed at: public information on rights and duties of influencers and agents; public access to training; and encouraging users to report breaches of sector rules by influencers.
applies_from: date d'application prévue à l'article 93 du règlement (UE) 2022/2065
quote: Les opérateurs de plateforme en ligne adoptent un protocole d'engagements
conditional_on: Entry into force not before the EU Commission response under Art. 18.

summary: Amends Education Code Art. L. 312-9 so that the education curriculum includes awareness of commercial manipulation and online fraud risks, awareness of gender image, and awareness of the reporting tools that platforms provide for illegal content.
quote: Elle comporte une sensibilisation à l'usage des dispositifs de signalement des contenus illicites mis à disposition par les plateformes.

summary: The Government must submit an evaluation report to Parliament covering the application of the law, the competences and resources of the regulators, the scope of the prohibition regime in Art. 4 and of the specific regime in Art. 5.
applies_from: Dans un délai de deux ans à compter de la promulgation de la présente loi
quote: le Gouvernement remet au Parlement un rapport d'évaluation

summary: The Conseil d'Etat decree specifies the application rules for the labelling duties in Art. 5.
quote: Les modalités d'application du présent article sont définies par décret en Conseil d'Etat.

summary: Extends the grounds listed in the existing hosting-provider duty (LCEN Art. 6 I 7) to include representation, privacy and security of persons, and fighting blackmail and harassment; the base text is not reproduced in the document, so only the inserted words are coded.
applies_from: date fixed by décret under Art. 7 I (no later than three months after the Government receives the European Commission's response)
provision: Art. 2 (inserting into Loi 2004-575, Art. 6 I 7, third para., 1°)
quote: à la représentation, à la vie privée et à la sécurité des personnes et à la lutte contre toutes les formes de chantage et de harcèlement
conditional_on: Art. 7 I: entry into force by decree after EU notification

summary: Platforms must make visible to their users prevention messages against harassment (as defined in Art. 222-33-2-2 of the Penal Code) and indicate to persons who report content the support structures against online harassment.
applies_from: date fixed by décret under Art. 7 I (no later than three months after the Government receives the European Commission's response)
provision: Art. 3 (inserting into Loi 2004-575, Art. 6 I 7, fourth para., second sentence)
quote: Elles rendent visibles à leurs utilisateurs des messages de prévention contre le harcèlement
conditional_on: Art. 7 I: entry into force by decree after EU notification

summary: Social network providers must refuse registration of minors under fifteen unless a holder of parental authority authorises it. The same paragraph also requires a device to monitor time spent on the service with regular notifications to the user, and requires suspension of a minor's account on a parent's request.
applies_from: date fixed by décret under Art. 7 I (no later than three months after the Government receives the European Commission's response)
provision: Art. 4 (inserting Loi 2004-575, Art. 6-7 I, first para., first sentence)
quote: refusent l'inscription à leurs services des mineurs de quinze ans, sauf si l'autorisation de cette inscription est donnée par l'un des titulaires de l'autorité parentale sur le mineur
conditional_on: social network service providers operating in France (Art. 6-7 I)

summary: For accounts already created and held by minors under fifteen, providers must collect the express authorisation of a holder of parental authority.
applies_from: two years after the entry-into-force date in Art. 7 I (Art. 7 II 1°)
provision: Art. 4 (inserting Loi 2004-575, Art. 6-7 I, first para., second sentence; Art. 7 II 1°)
quote: Ils recueillent également, dans les mêmes conditions et dans les meilleurs délais, l'autorisation expresse
conditional_on: social network service providers operating in France; accounts already held by minors under fifteen

summary: At registration, providers must give the under-fifteen user and parents information on risks of digital use and prevention means, and give the user clear, adapted information on use of their data and rights under Law 78-17.
applies_from: date fixed by décret under Art. 7 I (no later than three months after the Government receives the European Commission's response)
provision: Art. 4 (inserting Loi 2004-575, Art. 6-7 I, first para., third sentence)
quote: Lors de l'inscription, ces entreprises délivrent une information à l'utilisateur de moins de quinze ans
conditional_on: social network service providers operating in France; registration of a user under fifteen

summary: To verify the age of end users and parental authorisation, providers must use technical solutions conforming to a referential prepared by Arcom after consulting the CNIL.
applies_from: date fixed by décret under Art. 7 I (no later than three months after the Government receives the European Commission's response)
provision: Art. 4 (inserting Loi 2004-575, Art. 6-7 I, fourth para.)
quote: utilisent des solutions techniques conformes à un référentiel
conditional_on: social network service providers operating in France

summary: Arcom must prepare the referential for technical age-verification and parental-authorisation solutions, after consulting the CNIL.
provision: Art. 4 (inserting Loi 2004-575, Art. 6-7 I, fourth para.)
quote: un référentiel élaboré par l'Autorité de régulation de la communication audiovisuelle et numérique, après consultation de la Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés

summary: The modalities of application of Art. 6-7 are to be fixed by a decree in Conseil d'Etat, issued after the CNIL's opinion.
quote: Les modalités d'application du présent article sont fixées par un décret en Conseil d'Etat
conditional_on: decree in Conseil d'Etat after CNIL opinion

summary: Hosting providers must act on a request under Art. 6 VI within ten days of receiving it, or within eight hours where there is an imminent risk of serious harm to persons. The provision is amended and the duty applies to the addressees of Art. 6 VI 1.
applies_from: date fixed by décret under Art. 7 I (no later than three months after the Government receives the European Commission's response)
provision: Art. 5 (inserting into Loi 2004-575, Art. 6 VI 1, first para.)
quote: dans un délai de dix jours à compter de la réception de la demande
conditional_on: Art. 7 I: entry into force by decree after EU notification; urgency only where there is imminent risk of serious harm

summary: The Government must submit a report to Parliament on the consequences of online platform use, information overload and exposure to false information for the physical and mental health of young people, including minors, and on their learning capacities.
applies_from: one year after promulgation of the law
quote: Le Gouvernement remet au Parlement, dans un délai d'un an à compter de la promulgation de la présente loi, un rapport

summary: Arcom must establish and publish a referential setting minimum technical requirements for age verification systems, after CNIL opinion.
provision: Art. 1 I (new Art. 10 para. 2 of Loi 2004-575)
quote: Elle établit et publie à cette fin, après avis de la Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés, un référentiel déterminant les exigences techniques minimales applicables aux systèmes de vérification de l'âge.

summary: Online public communication editors and video-sharing platform providers offering pornographic content must display a screen with no pornographic content until the user's age is verified.
provision: Art. 1 I (new Art. 10 para. 4 of Loi 2004-575)
quote: prévoient l'affichage d'un écran ne comportant aucun contenu à caractère pornographique tant que l'âge de l'utilisateur n'a pas été vérifié.
conditional_on: user's age not yet verified

summary: Arcom must establish and publish the age verification referential within two months of promulgation.
applies_from: two months from promulgation of the law
quote: établit et publie le référentiel mentionné au I de l'article 10

summary: Persons whose service gives access to pornographic content must implement an age verification system conforming to the referential's technical characteristics.
applies_from: three months from publication of the referential by Arcom
quote: mettent en œuvre un système de vérification de l'âge conforme aux caractéristiques techniques du référentiel
conditional_on: service gives access to pornographic content

summary: Internet access and DNS providers must prevent access to blocked addresses within 48 hours of notification; search engines and directories must cease referencing them within 48 hours where notified.
quote: Ces fournisseurs doivent alors empêcher l'accès à ces adresses dans un délai de quarante-huit heures.
conditional_on: non-compliance with the Arcom mise en demeure under Art. 10-1 I

summary: Arcom must reassess at least once a year whether blocking measures remain necessary; blocking measures last at most two years.
quote: Leur nécessité est réévaluée, d'office ou sur demande, au moins une fois par an.
conditional_on: blocking measures under Art. 10-1 III

summary: Arcom must publish an annual activity report covering its conditions of action and results, including injunctions and blocking figures.
quote: rend public chaque année un rapport d'activité sur les conditions d'exercice et les résultats de son activité

summary: App stores must prevent download of the app concerned within 48 hours of an Arcom request under the new Art. 6-8.
quote: Ces boutiques disposent d'un délai de quarante-huit heures pour satisfaire cette demande.
conditional_on: Arcom request under Art. 6-8 I or II

summary: The administrative authority must inform a hosting provider that has never received a removal request of procedures and deadlines at least 12 hours before issuing a removal request.
quote: communique à ladite personne des informations sur les procédures et les délais applicables, au moins douze heures avant d'émettre la demande de retrait.
conditional_on: hosting provider never previously subject to a removal request under Art. 6-1

summary: A hosting provider unable to comply with a removal request for force majeure or technical reasons must promptly inform the issuing authority; it must also report requests with manifest errors and request clarification.
quote: il informe de ces motifs, sans retard indu, l'autorité administrative qui a émis la demande de retrait
conditional_on: inability to comply with a removal request

summary: A hosting provider that removes child sexual abuse imagery must inform the content provider of the reasons, the possibility to obtain a copy of the removal order, and its rights to challenge the request.
quote: il en informe dans les meilleurs délais le fournisseur de contenus
conditional_on: removal of content under Art. 227-23 Penal Code

summary: Hosting providers must remove images or representations of minors of a pornographic nature within 24 hours of receiving an removal request; failure is an offence (enforcement not summarised here).
applies_from: 24 hours from receipt of the removal request
quote: dans un délai de vingt-quatre heures à compter de la réception de la demande de retrait
conditional_on: removal request under Art. 6-1

summary: In the two-year experiment, hosting providers must prevent access without delay to addresses notified by the authority after 24 hours without removal of torture or barbarity content.
quote: Ces personnes doivent alors empêcher sans délai l'accès à ces adresses.
conditional_on: experiment of two years from entry into force of the implementing decree; no removal within 24 hours

summary: A hosting provider that removes torture or barbarity imagery must inform the content provider of the reasons, the possibility of obtaining a copy of the removal order, and its challenge rights.
quote: il en informe, dans les meilleurs délais, le fournisseur de contenus
conditional_on: removal under Art. 222-1 Penal Code in the experiment

summary: The Government must submit an evaluation report on the experiment to Parliament at least three months before its end.
quote: Au plus tard trois mois avant son terme, le Gouvernement remet au Parlement un rapport d'évaluation de l'expérimentation

summary: The Government must submit a report to Parliament on extending the competences of the central cybercrime office to removal of certain content.
applies_from: six months from promulgation of the law
quote: Dans un délai de six mois à compter de la promulgation de la présente loi, le Gouvernement remet au Parlement un rapport

summary: Schools must provide an annual information session on digital citizenship to pupils' legal representatives, covering screen time, illegal content, online fraud, reporting tools and harassment.
provision: Art. 7 (Code de l'éducation L. 312-9, added para.)
quote: Une information annuelle sur l'apprentissage de la citoyenneté numérique est dispensée au début de chaque année scolaire aux représentants légaux des élèves

summary: A digital citizenship certificate is mandatory for all pupils at the end of the first year of collège and must be renewed at the end of the last year of collège.
provision: Art. 7 (Code de l'éducation L. 312-9, added para.)
quote: Cette attestation est obligatoire pour tous les élèves à l'issue de la première année de collège

summary: Education programme under Art. L. 611-8 must include awareness of digital citizenship, digital rights and duties, prevention of online sexual violence and use of reporting tools.
quote: Elle comporte également une sensibilisation à la citoyenneté numérique

summary: The Government must submit to Parliament a report on anti-harassment prevention and awareness actions in schools within one year.
applies_from: one year from promulgation of the law
quote: Le Gouvernement remet au Parlement, dans un délai d'un an à compter de la promulgation de la présente loi, un rapport

summary: Producers of pornographic content simulating certain crimes must display a warning, visible before access and throughout viewing, that the depicted behaviour is illegal.
quote: affichent un message avertissant l'utilisateur du caractère illégal des comportements ainsi représentés.
conditional_on: content simulating offences listed in para. 2

summary: Hosting providers must act promptly to remove pornographic content reported as disseminated in breach of a rights-assignment agreement, or make it inaccessible.
quote: agissent promptement pour retirer tout contenu pornographique signalé
conditional_on: notified under Art. 16 DSA

summary: It is prohibited to disseminate an algorithmically generated visual or audio content depicting a person's image or voice without consent, unless it is evident or expressly stated that it is algorithmically generated.
quote: un contenu visuel ou sonore généré par un traitement algorithmique et représentant l'image ou les paroles d'une personne, sans son consentement.
conditional_on: no evident or express indication that content is algorithmically generated

summary: Online platform providers must block accounts subject to a court-ordered suspension once the decision is served on them.
quote: ces derniers procèdent au blocage des comptes faisant l'objet d'une suspension
conditional_on: service of the conviction decision imposing the suspension

summary: It is prohibited to disseminate a sexual montage made with a person's words or image without consent, including AI-generated sexual content reproducing a person.
quote: un montage à caractère sexuel réalisé avec les paroles ou l'image d'une personne, sans son consentement.
conditional_on: no consent of the person depicted

summary: Members of the civic digital reserve who learn of an offence or find illegal content in their duties must immediately notify the public prosecutor and transmit related information.
provision: Art. 23 I (new Code des postes et communications électroniques Art. L. 136 para. 3)
quote: est tenu d'en aviser sans délai le procureur de la République
conditional_on: knowledge of an offence or illegal content acquired in the mission

summary: Decree in Conseil d'Etat sets the management authority and admission and operating conditions of the civic digital reserve.
provision: Art. 23 I (new Code des postes et communications électroniques Art. L. 136 para. 4)
quote: L'autorité de gestion ainsi que les conditions d'admission et de fonctionnement de la réserve citoyenne du numérique sont fixées par décret en Conseil d'Etat.

summary: Operators receiving a conservatory notification for a site with fraudulent interface must display a warning message to users, for seven days, pointing to the official site.
provision: Art. 24 (new Art. 12 I para. 3 of Loi 2004-575)
quote: La personne destinataire d'une notification prend sans délai, à titre conservatoire, toute mesure utile consistant à afficher un message avertissant l'utilisateur du risque de préjudice encouru
conditional_on: notification under Art. 12 I (new Loi 2004-575 Art. 12)

summary: Internet access and DNS providers must prevent access to the service address for up to three months under an injunction; browser providers must display a warning and require explicit user confirmation.
quote: de prendre sans délai toute mesure utile destinée à empêcher l'accès à l'adresse de ce service
conditional_on: reasoned administrative decision where the operator has not provided identification or the finding remains valid

summary: The administrative authority must publish blocked service addresses in an open format in a single list within 72 hours of sending a notification or injunction.
provision: Art. 24 IV (new Art. 12 IV of Loi 2004-575)
quote: sont rendues publiques par l'autorité administrative dans un format ouvert soixante-douze heures après l'envoi de la notification ou de l'injonction

summary: Arcom must ensure that very large online platforms adopt the charters provided for in Art. 25 II and publish periodic reviews of their application.
quote: veille à l'adoption, par les services de très grandes plateformes en ligne

summary: Very large online platforms must adopt charters for monitoring and supporting content moderators, covering training, mental health support, rotation, peer groups, well-being policies, recognition and periodic evaluation.
quote: adoptent des chartes de suivi et de soutien des modérateurs de contenus en ligne

summary: Cloud providers may grant cloud credits to production, distribution or service businesses only for a limited duration, and credits may not be subject to any exclusivity condition.
provision: Art. 26 I (new Code de commerce Art. L. 442-12 II)
quote: Un fournisseur de services d'informatique en nuage ne peut octroyer un avoir d'informatique en nuage à une personne exerçant des activités de production, de distribution ou de services que pour une durée limitée.
conditional_on: credits granted to businesses engaged in production, distribution or services

summary: Decree in Conseil d'Etat sets the application rules for cloud credits, including maximum validity periods not exceeding one year.
provision: Art. 26 I (new Code de commerce Art. L. 442-12 II, para. 4)
quote: Un décret en Conseil d'Etat précise les modalités d'application du présent II

summary: No person may make the sale of a product or service conditional on the simultaneous conclusion of a cloud services contract where this is an unfair commercial practice.
provision: Art. 26 I (new Code de commerce Art. L. 442-12 IV)
quote: Il est interdit à toute personne de subordonner la vente d'un produit ou d'un service à la conclusion concomitante d'un contrat de fourniture de services d'informatique en nuage
conditional_on: constitutes an unfair commercial practice under Code de la consommation Art. L. 121-1

summary: The competition authority must submit a report to Parliament and Government on its activity regarding self-preferencing practices and possible improvements.
applies_from: 18 months from promulgation of the law
quote: Dans un délai de dix-huit mois à compter de la promulgation de la présente loi, l'Autorité de la concurrence remet au Parlement et au Gouvernement un rapport

summary: Cloud providers may not charge data transfer fees or switching fees above costs directly linked to the switch, nor data transfer fees above costs when a client uses several providers simultaneously.
quote: Il est interdit à tout fournisseur de services d'informatique en nuage de facturer, dans le cadre des contrats qu'il conclut avec un client, des frais de transfert de données
conditional_on: switching provider, or simultaneous use of several providers for data transfer fees

summary: A ministerial order sets the maximum tariff for data transfer fees.
quote: un montant maximal de tarification fixé par arrêté du ministre chargé du numérique

summary: ARCEP must adopt guidelines, after public consultation, on costs that may be taken into account in switching and data transfer fees.
quote: adopte des lignes directrices portant sur les coûts susceptibles d'être pris en compte

summary: Cloud providers must clearly inform clients and prospective clients, before contract signature, about data transfer and switching fees, and inform them of changes during the contract; fees must appear in contracts.
applies_from: from promulgation of the law; existing contracts must be expressly informed
quote: Les fournisseurs de services d'informatique en nuage communiquent aux clients et aux potentiels clients de façon claire et compréhensible

summary: Cloud providers must ensure their services meet the essential requirements of interoperability, portability of digital assets and exportable data, and free provision of APIs and detailed service information.
quote: Les fournisseurs de services d'informatique en nuage assurent la conformité de leurs services aux exigences essentielles

summary: ARCEP specifies the rules and modalities for the interoperability and portability requirements, including interoperability specifications.
quote: précise les règles et les modalités de mise en œuvre des exigences mentionnées au II de l'article 28

summary: Cloud providers must publish and regularly update a technical reference offer for interoperability setting out how their services comply with the requirements.
quote: Ils publient et mettent à jour régulièrement une offre de référence technique d'interopérabilité

summary: Providers of infrastructure-level cloud services must take reasonable measures to facilitate functional equivalence when moving to a destination service of the same type.
quote: prennent les mesures raisonnables en leur pouvoir afin de faciliter une équivalence fonctionnelle
conditional_on: infrastructure-only cloud services

summary: A decree after ARCEP opinion sets the implementing conditions for the cloud interoperability article and the deadline for ARCEP's rules.
quote: sont précisés par un décret pris après avis de l'Autorité de régulation des communications électroniques

summary: State administrations and designated bodies using a private cloud provider for particularly sensitive data must ensure the provider applies security and data protection criteria against access by non-authorised third-state authorities.
quote: veillent à ce que le service d'informatique en nuage fourni par le prestataire privé mette en œuvre des critères de sécurité et de protection des données
conditional_on: system or application processing data of particular sensitivity under Art. 31 II

summary: A decree in Conseil d'Etat specifies the security criteria for sensitive public cloud use, including capital criteria, and the conditions for temporary derogations.
applies_from: six months from promulgation of the law
quote: Dans un délai de six mois à compter de la promulgation de la présente loi, un décret en Conseil d'Etat précise les modalités d'application du présent article

summary: The Government must submit a report to Parliament on extra-territorial legislation risks to sensitive data and on a possible certified encryption audit for non-EU cloud providers.
applies_from: 18 months from promulgation of the law
quote: Dans un délai de dix-huit mois à compter la promulgation de la présente loi, le Gouvernement remet au Parlement un rapport

summary: Health data hosts that keep data within an electronic archiving service are subject to the hosting obligation under Art. L. 1111-8 para. II.
applies_from: date set by decree, not later than 1 July 2025
provision: Art. 32 I.1.b and II (Code de la santé publique L. 1111-8 II)
quote: Si l'hébergeur de données mentionnées au premier alinéa du I conserve des données dans le cadre d'un service d'archivage électronique, il est soumis à l'obligation mentionnée au premier alinéa du présent II.

summary: A decree in Conseil d'Etat sets health data hosting services, roles, storage location in the EU/EEA and contract terms, including measures against third-state access.
provision: Art. 32 I.2 (Code de la santé publique L. 1111-8 IV)
quote: sont précisés par un décret en Conseil d'Etat, pris après avis de la Commission nationale de l'informatique et des libertés
