quote: L'utilizzo dei sistemi di cui al comma 1 è subordinato alla garanzia della supervisione umana, della trasparenza delle decisioni e della tutela dei diritti degli utenti e dei lavoratori
conditional_on: Use of AI systems for employment-service activities under Art. 48(1)

summary: Within twelve months, the existing decrees on professional fees and the related decrees are supplemented with parameters for fee modulation reflecting the AI system's risk classification.
applies_from: twelve months from entry into force of this decree
quote: sono integrati con la determinazione dei parametri utili alla modulazione

summary: The Committee for financial education promotes and coordinates measures to raise public awareness of opportunities and risks of AI in the financial sector.
quote: promuove e coordina, anche attraverso l'azione dei suoi componenti, misure atte a sensibilizzare il pubblico

summary: Continuing education courses for health professionals must include AI literacy and training paths covering technical, legal and professional-ethics profiles.
quote: I corsi di formazione continua dei professionisti sanitari includono percorsi di alfabetizzazione e formazione all'uso dei sistemi di intelligenza artificiale

summary: Within six months, the National Commission for Continuing Education must set a specific percentage of the triennial individual training obligation for AI paths, and the national agency for regional health services must identify AI training programmes for managerial courses.
applies_from: six months from entry into force of this decree
quote: definisce una specifica percentuale dell'obbligo formativo individuale triennale da destinare ai percorsi formativi di cui al comma 1

summary: The public administrations concerned carry out the activities of the decree using existing human, instrumental and financial resources, without new or greater charges on public finance.
quote: le amministrazioni interessate provvedono alle attività previste dal presente decreto

summary: AGCOM compiles and updates a list of the operators subject to the measure and communicates it to the European Commission.
quote: Detti soggetti sono individuati in una lista compilata e aggiornata dall’Autorità, nonché comunicata dalla stessa alla Commissione europea.

summary: AGCOM may extend the scope to operators established in other Member States case by case, under Article 3(4) and (5) of Directive 2000/31/EC.
quote: individuati caso per caso dall’Autorità in conformità alla normativa europea
conditional_on: Conditions of Article 3(4) of Directive 2000/31/EC are met.

summary: AGCOM recommends that the methods of this measure be used also by other subjects beyond the list in Art. 1(1) and for other content harmful to minors.
quote: siano altamente raccomandate

summary: Age assurance systems used by the listed operators must meet the process and system requirements set out in Art. 3(2).
quote: deve rispettare i requisiti e le specifiche di processo e di sistema di seguito descritti

summary: Operators must use a tool that is as non-invasive as possible to reach the verification aim, and must choose the tools themselves while respecting proportionality.
quote: devono utilizzare uno strumento per quanto possibile non invasivo

summary: Operators must demonstrate the effectiveness of the tool used under the principles and requirements set by the Authority, and its compliance with data protection rules.
quote: a dimostrare l'efficacia dello strumento utilizzato

summary: Age assurance methods must comply with GDPR principles, in particular data minimisation and data protection by design and by default; third parties involved in the process are covered by the no-profiling and no-identity-collection duties in the same article.
quote: rispettosi del principio di minimizzazione dei dati

summary: Operators implementing age assurance must give users appropriate information on the processing of personal data and collect only the data necessary for the purpose.
quote: fornendo opportuna informativa agli utenti

summary: Operators and third parties involved in age assurance must not carry out any profiling of users, and the mechanisms must not allow identity, age, date of birth or other personal information to be collected; the personal data used for verification must not be processed.
quote: non devono effettuare alcuna profilazione degli utenti

summary: The age verification provider must be legally and technically independent of the adult content sites and video-sharing platforms, and those sites must have no access to the verification data.
quote: deve essere giuridicamente e tecnicamente indipendente

summary: Under the double anonymity model, the system must not allow the adult services to recognise a user who has already used it, to know the source of the age proof, or to recognise two proofs as coming from the same source; the proof providers must not know the service for which verification is performed.
quote: non deve consentire ai soggetti mirati interessati di riconoscere un utente
conditional_on: Double anonymity model used.

summary: For systems not based on apps on the user terminal, the age proof must be issued in three separate phases: issuance after identification, delivery to the user only, and verification by the site or platform; the proof must contain only the information that the user is an adult.
quote: deve essere diviso in tre fasi distinte
conditional_on: Systems not based on applications installed on the user terminal.

summary: The Authority considers it advisable that the operators do not carry out age verification themselves and rely on independently verified third-party solutions.
quote: non effettuino personalmente operazioni di verifica dell'età

summary: Providers of age proofs that are not already subject to legal identification obligations must undergo assessment by a third party, with certification by a dedicated Authority as stated in the text.
quote: siano soggetti a una valutazione da parte di terzi
conditional_on: Providers not already subject to specific legal identification obligations.

summary: Very large online platforms under the DSA that require users to authenticate must also accept European digital identity wallets, at the user's voluntary request, for the minimum attributes needed, such as the age proof.
quote: dovranno accettare anche l'uso dei portafogli europei di identità digitale
conditional_on: Very large online platforms under the DSA; use only on voluntary user request.

summary: The age assurance system must take account of cyberattacks, adopt sufficient cybersecurity measures to mitigate risks, and prevent circumvention attempts, including liveness detection.
quote: deve prevedere misure di sicurezza informatica sufficienti a mitigare i rischi

summary: The operator subject to the law must not promote or refer to any mechanism for circumventing age assurance systems.
quote: non deve promuovere o fare comunque riferimento a qualsiasi meccanismo di elusione dei sistemi di age assurance

summary: The verification mechanism must perform reliably in real operating conditions and over time, with continuous monitoring of accuracy and correction where needed; self-declaration is not an effective method; the system must be neutral or independent of the access device and operating system.
quote: Il meccanismo di verifica dell'età deve fornire prestazioni che non variano nel tempo

summary: Operators must ensure that no user accesses pornographic content until age is verified, that verification is repeated at each access, and that verification validity ends when the user leaves the service, ends the session or after 45 minutes of effective inactivity.
quote: devono garantire che nessun utente acceda a contenuti pornografici finché non abbia dimostrato la maggiore età

summary: The age assurance system must be easy to use and accessible to all users, including users with disabilities, and must not unduly prevent adults from accessing lawful content; account creation must not be required.
quote: devono garantire che il sistema implementato sia facile da usare

summary: Where applicable, the verification mechanisms must be trained on diverse datasets to avoid discriminatory results for groups of users, including minors wrongly identified as adults and adults wrongly identified as minors.
quote: siano stati addestrati su diversi dataset
conditional_on: Where applicable.

summary: The age assurance provider must provide at least one channel to receive and handle complaints about wrong age decisions promptly.
quote: deve prevedere almeno un canale per acquisire e gestire, tempestivamente, i reclami

summary: AGCOM will assess technical age verification solutions case by case once implemented and under real operating conditions.
quote: valuterà caso per caso ed in concreto le soluzioni tecniche di verifica dell'età

summary: AGCOM cooperates closely with the European Commission and with the national digital services coordinators of other Member States, including through the IMI system, and provides mutual assistance.
quote: coopera strettamente con la Commissione e con i Coordinatori nazionali dei servizi digitali designati negli altri Stati membri

summary: Operators publishing adult content in Italy must have effective age verification systems complying with the measure within six months of its publication.
applies_from: six months from the date of publication of this measure
quote: si dotano di efficaci sistemi di verifica della maggiore età conformi alle prescrizioni indicate entro sei mesi dalla data di pubblicazione del presente provvedimento

summary: The measure applies also to operators established in other Member States, regardless of their Member State of establishment, subject to the conditions of Art. 1(3).
applies_from: three months after publication of the list referred to in Art. 1
quote: le disposizioni del presente provvedimento si applicano anche con riferimento ai gestori di siti web
conditional_on: Publication of the list referred to in Art. 1.

summary: Where necessary, AGCOM commits to amend the measure to align it with EU rules adopted later, concerning operators established in other Member States.
applies_from: from the date of entry into force of the guidelines adopted under Article 28 of Regulation (EU) 2022/2065
quote: si impegna a modificare ed adeguare il presente provvedimento
conditional_on: Entry into force of the guidelines under Art. 28 of Regulation (EU) 2022/2065.

summary: AGCOM must adopt a regulation setting procedures for the rights-related functions the decree assigns to it; the same 60-day AGCOM regulation pattern recurs in the amendments to Arts. 46-bis, 80 and 84.
applies_from: within 60 days of entry into force of the amending provision
quote: dall'Autorità per le garanzie nelle comunicazioni secondo le procedure previste da apposito regolamento da adottare entro sessanta giorni

summary: Information society service providers, including media monitoring and press review companies, must pay publishers of journalistic publications fair compensation for online use of those publications (Art. 43-bis(8)).
quote: i prestatori di servizi della società dell'informazione riconoscono ai soggetti di cui al comma 1 un equo compenso
conditional_on: online use of journalistic publications under Art. 43-bis(1)

summary: AGCOM must adopt a regulation setting reference criteria for determining the fair compensation under Art. 43-bis(8).
applies_from: within 60 days of entry into force of the provision
quote: Entro sessanta giorni dalla data di entrata in vigore della presente disposizione, l'Autorità per le garanzie nelle comunicazioni adotta un regolamento

summary: During negotiations over the publishers' fair compensation, information society service providers must not limit the visibility of publishers' content in search results.
quote: Nel corso della negoziazione i prestatori di servizi delle società dell'informazione non limitano la visibilità dei contenuti degli editori nei risultati di ricerca.
conditional_on: negotiation of the contract under Art. 43-bis(9)

summary: On a party's request, AGCOM must indicate within 60 days which economic proposal conforms to the criteria or, if none does, set the amount of fair compensation itself.
quote: l'Autorità indica, sulla base dei criteri stabiliti dal regolamento di cui al comma 8, quale delle proposte economiche formulate è conforme ai suddetti criteri
conditional_on: failure to agree the amount of fair compensation within 30 days of the negotiation request

summary: Information society service providers must provide, on request of the interested party, the data needed to determine the amount of fair compensation; AGCOM supervises this duty.
quote: sono obbligati a mettere a disposizione, su richiesta della parte interessata
conditional_on: request by the interested party, by collective management bodies or by AGCOM

summary: Publishers of journalistic publications must recognise a share of 2 to 5 percent of the fair compensation to the authors of the articles.
quote: Gli editori di cui al comma 3, sia in forma singola che associata o consorziata, riconoscono agli autori degli articoli giornalistici una quota, compresa tra il 2 per cento e il 5 per cento

summary: Summaries, quotations, reproductions and communications to the public of extracts under the education exception must always mention the title of the work and the names of author, publisher and translator where they appear on the work.
quote: sono sempre accompagnati dalla menzione del titolo dell'opera
conditional_on: use of the educational exception under Art. 70-bis(1)

summary: Copies made for text and data mining for scientific research must be stored at an adequate security level and may be kept and used only for scientific research purposes, including verification of results.
quote: Le copie di opere o di altri materiali realizzate in conformità al comma 1 sono memorizzate con un adeguato livello di sicurezza
conditional_on: copies made under Art. 70-ter(1)

summary: Reproductions and extractions made for text and data mining under Art. 70-quater may be retained only for as long as needed for the text and data mining.
quote: Le riproduzioni e le estrazioni eseguite ai sensi del comma 1 possono essere conservate solo per il tempo necessario ai fini dell'estrazione di testo e di dati.
conditional_on: reproductions and extractions made under Art. 70-quater(1)

summary: Security levels for text and data mining under Art. 70-quater must be guaranteed at no less than those required under Art. 70-ter.
quote: sono in ogni caso garantiti livelli di sicurezza non inferiori a quelli definiti per lo svolgimento delle attività di cui all'articolo 70-ter
conditional_on: activities under Art. 70-quater

summary: Online content-sharing service providers must obtain authorisation from rights holders, directly or via collective management, for communicating or making available protected works uploaded by users.
quote: per i quali devono ottenere un'autorizzazione dai titolari dei diritti
conditional_on: providers of online content-sharing services as defined in Art. 102-sexies(1)

summary: To avoid liability for unauthorised uploads, content-sharing providers must, after a sufficiently reasoned notice, expeditiously disable access to or remove the notified works and make best efforts to prevent their future upload; the same article also requires best efforts to obtain authorisation.
quote: tempestivamente disabilitato l'accesso o rimosso dai propri siti web le opere o gli altri materiali oggetto di segnalazione
conditional_on: exemption from liability under Art. 102-septies(1)

summary: Content-sharing providers must provide rights holders, on request and promptly, complete and adequate information on how the liability-exemption measures are implemented and on use under licence agreements.
quote: forniscono tempestivamente ai titolari dei diritti, su richiesta di questi ultimi, informazioni complete e adeguate
conditional_on: request by rights holders

summary: Content-sharing providers with more than 5 million average monthly unique visitors in the previous calendar year must show best efforts to prevent future uploads of notified works for which rights holders supplied relevant information.
quote: devono dimostrare altresì di aver compiuto i massimi sforzi per impedire il futuro caricamento di opere o di altri materiali segnalati
conditional_on: more than 5 million average monthly unique visitors in the previous calendar year; applies to new providers under Art. 102-octies(1) that have the exemption

summary: Content-sharing providers must inform their users, in their terms and conditions, of the possibility to use works under the copyright exceptions.
quote: informano i propri utenti, tramite la comunicazione dei loro termini e condizioni del servizio, della possibilità di utilizzare opere

summary: Decisions on rights holders' requests to disable or remove content are subject to human review.
quote: Le decisioni sulla richiesta di disabilitazione o la rimozione dei contenuti sono soggette a verifica umana.
conditional_on: rights holders' requests to disable access to or remove specific works under Art. 102-decies(1)

summary: Content-sharing providers must immediately notify users when content has been disabled or removed at a rights holder's request.
quote: Il prestatore dà immediata comunicazione agli utenti dell'avvenuta disabilitazione o rimozione.
conditional_on: disabling or removal under Art. 102-decies(1)

summary: Content-sharing providers must set up and make available to users fast and effective complaint mechanisms against disabling or removal decisions.
quote: istituiscono e rendono disponibili agli utenti dei servizi meccanismi di reclamo celeri ed efficaci

summary: AGCOM must adopt guidelines for the complaint mechanisms of content-sharing providers.
quote: A tal fine l'Autorità per le garanzie nelle comunicazioni adotta apposite linee guida.

summary: Contested content must remain disabled while a complaint decision is pending.
quote: Nelle more della decisione sul reclamo, i contenuti in contestazione rimangono disabilitati.
conditional_on: a complaint under Art. 102-decies(2) is pending

summary: AGCOM must set by regulation the modalities for appeals against content-sharing providers' complaint decisions.
applies_from: within 60 days of entry into force of the provision
quote: secondo le modalità da essa definite tramite regolamento, da adottare entro sessanta giorni dalla data di entrata in vigore della presente disposizione

summary: The Minister of Culture may by decree identify further specific requirements for defining out-of-commerce works.
quote: Con decreto del Ministro della cultura possono essere individuati ulteriori requisiti specifici
conditional_on: prior consultation with rights holders, collective management organisations and cultural heritage institutions

summary: Cultural heritage institutions must assess, with reasonable effort and in good faith, whether works in their permanent collections are out of commerce, consulting appropriate sources and, where relevant, checking availability in third countries.
quote: ne valutano la disponibilità effettiva nei canali commerciali abituali, compiendo un ragionevole sforzo
conditional_on: determining whether a work in the institution's permanent collections is out of commerce

summary: A cultural heritage institution that establishes an out-of-commerce work must request a non-exclusive non-commercial licence from the competent collective management organisation, attaching its availability verification documentation.
quote: richiede all'organismo di gestione collettiva di cui al decreto legislativo 15 marzo 2017, n. 35 rappresentativo dei titolari dei diritti per tipologia di opera o di diritto oggetto della licenza, il rilascio di una licenza non esclusiva
conditional_on: the institution has established that the work is out of commerce under Art. 102-undecies

summary: A collective management organisation receiving a licence request must inform all rights holders and verify the adequacy of the availability check; if inadequate it must request further information or reject the request.
quote: informa tutti i titolari dei diritti e accerta l'adeguatezza della verifica della disponibilità nei canali commerciali abituali
conditional_on: receipt of a licence request under Art. 102-duodecies

summary: The Ministry of Culture must publish on its institutional website the licence requests it receives from the collective management organisation.
quote: comunica la richiesta di licenza al Ministero della cultura, che la pubblica nel proprio sito istituzionale
conditional_on: adequacy of the availability check has been confirmed

summary: After 30 days from publication, and absent objection by rights holders, the collective management organisation grants the licence and communicates it, with relevant information, to the EU portal run by EUIPO.
quote: Trascorsi trenta giorni dalla data di pubblicazione, l'organismo di gestione collettiva, in mancanza di opposizione da parte dei titolari dei diritti, rilascia la licenza
conditional_on: no objection by rights holders within 30 days of publication

summary: If rights holders exclude works from the licensing mechanism after a licence was granted, the collective management organisation must revoke the licence and notify the cultural heritage institution and the Ministry of Culture.
quote: Se l'esclusione interviene dopo il rilascio della licenza, l'organismo di gestione collettiva la revoca e ne dà comunicazione
conditional_on: exclusion by rights holders under Art. 102-quaterdecies(1) after licence grant

summary: Before a work is published on a cultural heritage institution's website under the Art. 102-duodecies(4) exception, the publication must be preceded by notice to the EU portal; uses may start only six months after publication on the portal.
applies_from: six months after publication on the EU portal
quote: La pubblicazione sul sito web dell'opera deve essere preceduta dalla comunicazione al portale unico europeo
conditional_on: use under the exception of Art. 102-duodecies(4)

summary: The Ministry of Culture must promote regular dialogue between user and rights-holder representative bodies to facilitate the out-of-commerce licensing procedures.
quote: Il Ministero della cultura promuove un regolare dialogo tra gli organismi rappresentativi degli utilizzatori e dei titolari di diritti

summary: On request, AGCOM must provide guidance on suitable negotiation solutions, including fee determination, for audiovisual works on video-on-demand services.
quote: che fornisce indicazioni sulle opportune soluzioni negoziali
conditional_on: request by a party facing difficulty reaching a licence agreement

summary: Licensees, transferees and their successors must provide authors and performers, at least every six months, with updated, relevant and complete information on exploitation and remuneration; sublicensees must provide supplementary information on request, and AGCOM supervises.
quote: I soggetti ai quali sono stati concessi in licenza o trasferiti i diritti e i loro aventi causa hanno l'obbligo di fornire agli autori e artisti interpreti e esecutori

summary: Where the agreed remuneration is disproportionately low relative to the revenues from exploitation, the counterparty must pay authors and performers additional, adequate and fair remuneration.
quote: hanno diritto a una remunerazione ulteriore, adeguata ed equa, dalla parte con cui hanno stipulato un contratto
conditional_on: agreed remuneration proves disproportionately low relative to revenues over time; not applicable to collective management contracts under Art. 2(1)-(2) of Decreto legislativo 35/2017

summary: AGCOM must resolve disputes over the transparency obligations and the contract-adjustment mechanism within 90 days of the request.
quote: che risolve la controversia nel termine di novanta giorni dalla richiesta
conditional_on: request by a party, or by representative bodies on a specific request of authors or performers

summary: AGCOM must adopt a regulation setting the procedure for resolving the disputes under Art. 110-sexies.
applies_from: within 60 days of entry into force of the provision
quote: in conformità a quanto stabilito da apposito regolamento, da adottare entro sessanta giorni dalla data di entrata in vigore della presente disposizione

summary: The exploitation of a work or performance must take place within the term set by the contract, not longer than five years or two years after the publisher or producer made it available; otherwise the author or performer sets a reasonable term.
quote: lo sfruttamento dell'opera o della prestazione artistica deve avvenire nel termine stabilito dal contratto
conditional_on: unless otherwise provided by contract or by law

summary: Sums collected by a collective management organisation under Art. 180-ter that are not claimed by the rights holder must be kept available for the period in Art. 19 of Decreto legislativo 35/2017.
quote: vengono tenute a disposizione per il periodo indicato dall'articolo 19 del decreto legislativo 15 marzo 2017, n. 35
conditional_on: sums not claimed by the rights holder under Art. 180-ter(1)

summary: AGCOM must adopt a regulation setting criteria for determining the representativeness of collective management organisations, publicity measures for the licences, and the procedure for the rights-holder exclusion under Art. 180-ter(2).
applies_from: within three months of entry into force of Art. 180-ter
quote: Con regolamento dell'Autorità per le garanzie nelle comunicazioni, da adottare entro tre mesi dalla data di entrata in vigore del presente articolo

summary: Clearview is prohibited from further collection, by web scraping, of images and related metadata of persons located in Italian territory, and from any further processing of common and biometric data of such persons.
provision: Sez. 4 (Misure correttive), punto i); Parte dispositiva, lett. a)
quote: divieto di ulteriore raccolta, mediante tecniche di web scraping, di immagini e relativi metadati concernenti persone che si trovano nel territorio italiano

summary: Clearview is ordered to erase common and biometric data processed through its facial recognition system concerning persons located in Italy, without prejudice to responding to data subject rights requests under Arts. 15-22 GDPR.
provision: Sez. 4 (Misure correttive); Parte dispositiva, lett. b)
quote: ordina la cancellazione dei dati, comuni e biometrici

summary: Clearview must continue to provide timely responses to data subject requests under Arts. 15-22 GDPR received in the meantime, in compliance with the timing rules of Art. 12(3) GDPR.
quote: fermo l’obbligo di fornire puntuale riscontro alle richieste di esercizio dei diritti di cui agli artt. 15-22 del Regolamento

summary: Clearview is ordered to designate a representative in the European Union to act as contact point, in addition to or in place of the controller, for data subjects.
applies_from: within thirty days from notification of the decision
quote: di designare un rappresentante nel territorio dell’Unione europea

summary: Clearview must report to the Garante, with documented evidence, the measures taken to implement the prohibition, erasure and data subject measures ordered.
applies_from: within thirty days from notification of the decision
quote: la Società dovrà comunicare a questa Autorità

summary: Clearview is ordered to pay an administrative fine of EUR 20 million; under Art. 166(8) of the Codice it may settle the dispute by complying with the orders and paying half the fine within sixty days, otherwise payment is due within 30 days of notification.
applies_from: within thirty days from notification if the dispute is not settled under Art. 166(8) Codice
quote: di pagare la somma di euro venti milioni a titolo di sanzione amministrativa pecuniaria
conditional_on: no settlement under Art. 166(8) of the Codice

summary: The Garante is directed to publish the full decision on its website, under Art. 166(7) of the Codice.
quote: la pubblicazione per intero del presente provvedimento nel sito web del Garante

summary: The Garante is directed to record the violations and measures adopted in its internal register under Art. 57(1)(u) GDPR.
quote: l’annotazione nel registro interno dell’Autorità

summary: Publish on its website an information notice for data subjects whose data were collected for algorithm training, whether or not they are users, covering processing, underlying logic, rights and other Regulation elements (Art. 12 terms). Compliance due by 30 April 2023 per premises.
quote: la predisposizione e pubblicazione sul proprio sito internet di un’informativa

summary: Provide on its website, at least to data subjects connecting from Italy (users or not), a tool to exercise the right to object to processing of data obtained from third parties for algorithm training and service provision. Compliance due by 30 April 2023 per premises.
quote: di uno strumento attraverso il quale possano esercitare il diritto di opposizione

summary: Provide on its website, at least to data subjects connecting from Italy (users or not), a tool to request and obtain rectification of inaccurately processed personal data in content generation, or erasure where rectification is not possible under state-of-the-art technology. Compliance due by 30 April 2023 per premises.
quote: di uno strumento attraverso il quale chiedere e ottenere la correzione di eventuali dati personali

summary: Include a link to the user information notice in the registration flow, placed so that it must be viewed before registration, including by already-registered users at first access after any reactivation of the service. Compliance due by 30 April 2023 per premises.
quote: l’inserimento di un link all’informativa rivolta agli utenti dei propri servizi nel flusso di registrazione
conditional_on: reactivation of the service in Italy

summary: Change the legal basis for processing users’ personal data for algorithm training, removing any reference to contract and relying on consent or legitimate interest, with an accountability assessment. Compliance due by 30 April 2023 per premises.
quote: la modifica della base giuridica del trattamento dei dati personali degli utenti ai fini dell’addestramento algoritmico

summary: Provide on its website, at least to users connecting from Italy, an easily accessible tool to object to processing of their data for algorithm training, where the legal basis chosen under point 5 is legitimate interest. Compliance due by 30 April 2023 per premises.
quote: di uno strumento facilmente accessibile attraverso il quale esercitare il diritto di opposizione
conditional_on: legal basis under point 5 is legitimate interest

summary: On any reactivation of the service in Italy, require all users connecting from Italy, including already-registered users, to pass an age gate at first access that filters out minors based on declared age. Compliance due by 30 April 2023 per premises.
quote: la richiesta, a tutti gli utenti che si collegano dall’Italia, ivi inclusi quelli già registrati, di superare, in sede di primo accesso, un age gate
conditional_on: reactivation of the service in Italy

summary: Submit to the Garante a plan for age verification tools that excludes access by users under 13, and by users under 18 without parental consent.
quote: la sottoposizione al Garante, entro il 31 maggio 2023, di un piano per l’adozione di strumenti di age verification

summary: Implement the age verification plan, starting at the latest on 30 September 2023.
quote: L’implementazione di tale piano dovrà decorrere, al più tardi, dal 30 settembre 2023

summary: Promote a non-marketing information campaign on main Italian mass media, with content agreed with the Garante, informing individuals of likely collection of their data for algorithm training, of the published detailed notice, and of the erasure tool.
quote: la promozione, entro il 15 maggio 2023 di una campagna di informazione, di natura non promozionale

summary: Communicate to the Garante, by 30 April 2023, the steps taken to implement points 1 to 7, and by the respective dates, the steps taken for points 8 and 9; requested under Art. 58(1) GDPR and Section 157 of the Code.
quote: entro il 30 aprile 2023, quali iniziative siano state intraprese al fine di dare attuazione a quanto prescritto ai punti da 1 a 7

summary: The Garante suspends enforcement of its temporary limitation decision No 112 of 30 March 2023 as from compliance with points 1 to 7, subject to further action if implementation is inadequate.
quote: sospende il provvedimento di limitazione provvisoria adottato
conditional_on: compliance with points 1 to 7

summary: OpenAI must provisionally stop processing personal data of data subjects established in Italy through ChatGPT, pending the investigation.
quote: dispone, in via d’urgenza, nei confronti di OpenAI L.L.C., società statunitense sviluppatrice e gestrice di ChatGPT, in qualità di titolare del trattamento
conditional_on: Receipt of the order

summary: OpenAI must report within 20 days the initiatives taken to comply and any information justifying the alleged breaches.
quote: a comunicare quali iniziative siano state intraprese al fine di dare attuazione a quanto prescritto e di fornire ogni elemento ritenuto utile a giustificare le violazioni sopra evidenziate
conditional_on: Within 20 days of receipt

summary: The Garante must record the violations and measures found in its internal register under Art. 57(1)(u) GDPR (Dispositivo, DISPONE a).
quote: l’annotazione nel registro interno dell’Autorità, previsto dall’art. 57, par. 1, lett. u) del Regolamento, delle violazioni e delle misure adottate

summary: The Garante must transmit the file to the Irish supervisory authority as lead authority under Art. 56(1) GDPR, for the violation of Art. 5(1)(d) and continuing processing issues (Dispositivo, DISPONE b).
quote: la trasmissione degli atti all’autorità di controllo irlandese, in qualità di autorità di controllo capofila ai sensi dell’art. 56, par. 1, del Regolamento a far data dal 15 febbraio 2024

summary: OpenAI must send the Garante, within sixty days after the end of the ordered information campaign, all information needed to assess compliance, including the terms and means by which data subjects exercised opposition and erasure rights (Dispositivo, INGIUNGE c).
applies_from: entro sessanta giorni dal termine della campagna di comunicazione
quote: alla Società di trasmettere all’Autorità entro sessanta giorni dal termine della campagna di comunicazione ogni informazione utile a valutare il corretto adempimento

summary: Under Art. 58(2)(f) GDPR, the Garante orders Hangzhou DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd. and Beijing DeepSeek Artificial Intelligence Co., Ltd. to definitively limit the processing of personal data of data subjects located in Italy in the context of the DeepSeek service, with immediate effect from receipt of the order, subject to any other decision on the outcome of the investigation.
applies_from: con effetto immediato a decorrere dalla data di ricezione del presente provvedimento [with immediate effect from the date of receipt of this order]
quote: la limitazione definitiva delle attività di trattamento dei dati personali di interessati che si trovano nel territorio italiano [the definitive limitation of processing of personal data of data subjects located in the Italian territory]
conditional_on: subject to any other decision upon the outcome of the investigation initiated on the case

summary: The Garante records the violations found and the measures adopted in its internal register, pursuant to Art. 17 of its Internal Regulation No. 1/2019 and Art. 57(1)(u) GDPR.
quote: l’annotazione nel registro interno dell’Autorità, previsto dall’art. 57, par. 1, lett. u) del Regolamento, delle violazioni e delle misure adottate

summary: Cybersecurity must be ensured across the life cycle of AI systems and general-purpose models, with a proportionate, risk-based approach and specific security controls (framed as a precondition for the law's principles).
quote: deve essere assicurata, quale precondizione essenziale, la cybersicurezza lungo tutto il ciclo di vita dei sistemi e dei modelli di intelligenza artificiale per finalità generali, secondo un approccio proporzionale e basato sul rischio

summary: Information on processing of personal data linked to AI use must be given in clear, simple language, so users know the risks and their right to object.
quote: Le informazioni e le comunicazioni relative al trattamento dei dati connesse all'utilizzo di sistemi di intelligenza artificiale sono rese con linguaggio chiaro e semplice

summary: Access to AI technologies by children under 14, and the related data processing, requires parental consent; minors aged 14-17 may consent to processing themselves if the information is accessible and understandable.
quote: richiedono il consenso di chi esercita la responsabilità genitoriale

summary: The State directs public e-procurement platforms so that AI suppliers that localise and process strategic data in data centers in Italy, and models with high security and transparency standards, may be favoured, subject to competition and non-discrimination rules.
quote: possano essere privilegiate quelle soluzioni che garantiscono la localizzazione e l'elaborazione dei dati strategici presso data center posti nel territorio nazionale

summary: Regulations are to define how the law's principles apply to AI activities of the intelligence agencies and, separately, of ACN, and to other national-security AI activities.
quote: Con regolamento adottato ai sensi dell'articolo 43 della legge n. 124 del 2007, sono definite le modalità di applicazione dei principi e delle disposizioni di cui al presente articolo

summary: AI systems introduced in the health system may not select or condition access to health services on discriminatory criteria.
quote: L'introduzione di sistemi di intelligenza artificiale nel sistema sanitario non può selezionare e condizionare l'accesso alle prestazioni sanitarie secondo criteri discriminatori

summary: The data subject (patient) has the right to be informed of the use of AI technologies.
quote: L'interessato ha diritto di essere informato sull'impiego di tecnologie di intelligenza artificiale

summary: AI in health care only supports prevention, diagnosis, treatment and therapeutic choice; the decision always rests with the medical professional.
quote: lasciando impregiudicata la decisione, che è sempre rimessa agli esercenti la professione medica

summary: AI systems used in health care and their data must be reliable, periodically verified and updated to minimise errors.
quote: I sistemi di intelligenza artificiale utilizzati in ambito sanitario e i relativi dati impiegati devono essere affidabili, periodicamente verificati e aggiornati

summary: Secondary use of de-identified personal data (including special categories) for AI health research is authorised without further consent, but the controller must still inform data subjects, possibly through a general notice on its website.
quote: fermo restando l'obbligo di informativa in favore dell'interessato, che può essere assolto anche mediante un'informativa generale messa a disposizione nel sito web del titolare del trattamento
conditional_on: Processing by public or non-profit bodies, IRCCS, or private health-sector parties in projects with them, for the purposes listed in Art. 8(1)

summary: Health-research AI processing under Art. 8(1)-(2) must be notified to the Garante with the information required by GDPR Arts. 24, 25, 32 and 35 and any processors; it may start after 30 days unless blocked.
quote: I trattamenti di dati di cui ai commi 1 e 2 devono essere comunicati al Garante per la protezione dei dati personali con l'indicazione di tutte le informazioni previste dagli articoli 24, 25, 32 e 35 del regolamento (UE) 2016/679

summary: The Minister of Health must issue, within 120 days of entry into force, a decree regulating simplified processing of personal data for AI research and experimentation, including sandboxes and secondary use.
quote: è disciplinato con decreto del Ministro della salute da emanare entro centoventi giorni dalla data di entrata in vigore della presente legge

summary: Decrees of the Minister of Health (with the digital-innovation and cybersecurity authorities, after the State-Regions Conference) regulate AI solutions supporting the electronic health record and identify who may access them.
quote: con uno o più decreti del Ministro della salute, di concerto con l'Autorità politica delegata in materia di innovazione tecnologica e transizione digitale e con l'Autorità delegata per la sicurezza della Repubblica e per la cybersicurezza

summary: AGENAS designs, builds, runs and owns a national AI platform giving non-binding suggestions to health professionals and doctors and access support to users, is controller of its data, and specifies by measure the services, data types and security measures.
quote: La progettazione, la realizzazione, la messa in servizio e la titolarità della piattaforma di cui al primo periodo sono attribuite all'AGENAS in qualità di Agenzia nazionale per la sanità digitale

summary: Employers and principals must inform workers of the use of AI, in the cases and manner set by art. 1-bis of Legislative Decree 152/1997.
quote: Il datore di lavoro o il committente è tenuto a informare il lavoratore dell'utilizzo dell'intelligenza artificiale nei casi e con le modalità di cui all'articolo 1-bis del decreto legislativo 26 maggio 1997, n. 152

summary: AI used at work must be safe, reliable and transparent, may not conflict with human dignity or breach privacy, and AI in managing employment must not discriminate on sex, age, ethnicity, religion, sexual orientation, political opinion or personal conditions.
quote: garantisce l'osservanza dei diritti inviolabili del lavoratore senza discriminazioni in funzione del sesso, dell'età, delle origini etniche, del credo religioso, dell'orientamento sessuale, delle opinioni politiche e delle condizioni personali, sociali ed economiche

summary: The Ministry of Labour hosts the new Osservatorio on AI in work (strategy, labour-market monitoring, training); the Minister must set its members and functioning by decree within 90 days.
quote: è istituito presso il Ministero del lavoro e delle politiche sociali l'Osservatorio sull'adozione di sistemi di intelligenza artificiale nel mondo del lavoro

summary: In intellectual professions AI may be used only for instrumental and support activities, with intellectual work prevailing.
quote: L'utilizzo di sistemi di intelligenza artificiale nelle professioni intellettuali è finalizzato al solo esercizio delle attività strumentali e di supporto all'attività professionale e con prevalenza del lavoro intellettuale oggetto della prestazione d'opera

summary: Professionals must tell clients, in clear, simple and complete language, which AI systems they use.
quote: le informazioni relative ai sistemi di intelligenza artificiale utilizzati dal professionista sono comunicate al soggetto destinatario della prestazione intellettuale con linguaggio chiaro, semplice ed esaustivo

summary: Public administrations using AI must ensure that those concerned can know how it works and that its use is traceable.
quote: assicurando agli interessati la conoscibilità del suo funzionamento e la tracciabilità del suo utilizzo

summary: In public administration AI is only instrumental and supportive; the person deciding remains solely responsible for decisions and procedures in which AI was used.
quote: nel rispetto dell'autonomia e del potere decisionale della persona che resta l'unica responsabile dei provvedimenti e dei procedimenti in cui sia stata utilizzata l'intelligenza artificiale

summary: Public administrations must adopt technical, organisational and training measures for responsible AI use.
quote: Le pubbliche amministrazioni adottano misure tecniche, organizzative e formative finalizzate a garantire un utilizzo responsabile dell'intelligenza artificiale

summary: When AI is used in judicial activity, every decision on interpreting and applying the law, assessing facts and evidence and adopting measures is reserved to the magistrate.
quote: è sempre riservata al magistrato ogni decisione sull'interpretazione e sull'applicazione della legge, sulla valutazione dei fatti e delle prove e sull'adozione dei provvedimenti

summary: The Ministry of Justice regulates AI uses for organising justice services, simplifying judicial work and ancillary administration, and the Minister promotes AI training for magistrates and staff.
quote: Il Ministero della giustizia disciplina gli impieghi dei sistemi di intelligenza artificiale per l'organizzazione dei servizi relativi alla giustizia

summary: Until the AI Act is fully implemented, experimentation and use of AI in ordinary judicial offices require authorisation by the Ministry of Justice, after hearing the national AI authorities.
quote: la sperimentazione e l'impiego dei sistemi di intelligenza artificiale negli uffici giudiziari ordinari sono autorizzati dal Ministero della giustizia, sentite le Autorità nazionali di cui all'articolo 20

summary: Delegation: within 12 months the Government may adopt legislative decrees on the use of data, algorithms and methods to train AI systems, without obligations beyond the AI Act, setting rights and duties, damages or injunctive remedies and sanctions, with disputes assigned to the specialised business courts.
quote: senza obblighi ulteriori, negli ambiti soggetti al regolamento (UE) 2024/1689, rispetto a quanto già ivi stabilito

summary: Delegation: within 12 months the Government may adopt legislative decrees adapting national law to the AI Act, giving the Art. 20 authorities the Regulation's supervisory, inspection and sanctioning powers, and providing for AI literacy and training, school STEM curricula, rules on police use of AI and market-surveillance powers.
quote: uno o più decreti legislativi per l'adeguamento della normativa nazionale al regolamento (UE) 2024/1689

summary: Delegation: within 12 months the Government may adopt legislative decrees on unlawful AI uses: tools to block and remove illegally generated content, new offences for failing to adopt AI security measures, criminal and corporate liability criteria, burden of proof in civil liability, and AI in preliminary investigations.
quote: introduzione di autonome fattispecie di reato, punite a titolo di dolo o di colpa, incentrate sull'omessa adozione o sull'omesso adeguamento di misure di sicurezza per la produzione, la messa in circolazione e l'utilizzo professionale di sistemi di intelligenza artificiale

summary: The Presidency of the Council structure for digital transformation prepares and updates the national AI strategy, approved at least every two years by the CITD.
quote: è approvata con cadenza almeno biennale dal Comitato interministeriale per la transizione digitale (CITD)

summary: The same structure coordinates and monitors implementation of the strategy, with AgID, and sends the monitoring results to Parliament every year.
quote: I risultati del monitoraggio sono trasmessi annualmente alle Camere

summary: AgID promotes AI innovation and, as notifying authority, sets procedures for and carries out notification, assessment, accreditation and monitoring of conformity-assessment bodies.
quote: L'AgID provvede altresì a definire le procedure e a esercitare le funzioni e i compiti in materia di notifica, valutazione, accreditamento e monitoraggio dei soggetti incaricati di verificare la conformità dei sistemi di intelligenza artificiale

summary: ACN supervises AI systems, including inspections and sanctions, as market-surveillance authority and single point of contact with the EU, and promotes AI for cybersecurity.
quote: è responsabile per la vigilanza, ivi incluse le attività ispettive e sanzionatorie, dei sistemi di intelligenza artificiale

summary: AgID and ACN jointly establish and manage experimentation spaces (sandboxes) for compliant AI systems, after hearing the Ministries of Defence and Justice; the fintech sandbox under D.L. 34/2019 continues for financial institutions.
quote: assicurano l'istituzione e la gestione congiunta di spazi di sperimentazione finalizzati alla realizzazione di sistemi di intelligenza artificiale conformi alla normativa nazionale e dell'Unione europea

summary: The national AI authorities coordinate with other administrations and independent authorities, through a coordination committee at the Presidency of the Council (with Banca d'Italia, CONSOB and IVASS on matters within their remit).
quote: presso la Presidenza del Consiglio dei ministri è istituito un Comitato di coordinamento, composto dai direttori generali delle due citate Agenzie e dal capo del Dipartimento per la trasformazione digitale

summary: The implementing rules of the MISE decree of 27 June 2019 on the venture-capital fund must be updated to this article, adapted for investments in non-SME firms.
quote: La normativa di attuazione di cui al citato decreto del Ministro dello sviluppo economico 27 giugno 2019 è aggiornata alle disposizioni del presente articolo

summary: No one may cause unjust harm to a person by disseminating without consent images, videos or voices falsified or altered with AI that can mislead about their authenticity (new criminal offence, c.p. art. 612-quater).
quote: Chiunque cagiona un danno ingiusto ad una persona, cedendo, pubblicando o altrimenti diffondendo, senza il suo consenso, immagini, video o voci falsificati o alterati mediante l'impiego di sistemi di intelligenza artificiale e idonei a indurre in inganno sulla loro genuinità

summary: Up to EUR 1 billion of equity and quasi-equity investment, through the venture-capital fund, in SMEs and larger high-growth innovative firms with an operating seat in Italy in AI, cybersecurity, quantum and telecommunications technologies.
quote: è autorizzato, fino all'ammontare complessivo di un miliardo di euro, l'investimento, sotto forma di equity e quasi equity, nel capitale di rischio direttamente o indirettamente

summary: Central government must formulate and implement comprehensive measures needed to ensure proper handling of personal information by government bodies, local governments, incorporated administrative agencies and business operators.
quote: 必要な施策を総合的に策定し、及びこれを実施する責務を有する。

summary: Local governments must formulate and implement measures needed to ensure proper handling of personal information in their areas.
quote: 必要な施策を策定し、及びこれを実施する責務を有する

summary: Government must establish a Basic Policy on personal information protection (prepared by the PPC, decided by Cabinet and published); the basic policy content is listed in Art. 7(2).
quote: 政府は、個人情報の保護に関する施策の総合的かつ一体的な推進を図るため、個人情報の保護に関する基本方針

summary: Government must take measures for personal information held by its own organs and by incorporated administrative agencies.
quote: その機関が保有する個人情報の適正な取扱いが確保されるよう必要な措置を講ずるものとする

summary: Government must provide information, guidelines and other support to local governments and business operators.
quote: 必要な措置を講ずるものとする

summary: Government must take measures to achieve prompt and appropriate handling of complaints between business operators and individuals.
quote: 苦情の適切かつ迅速な処理を図るために必要な措置を講ずるものとする

summary: Government must take measures to ensure proper handling by business operators and, through local governments, by local public bodies.
quote: 個人情報取扱事業者による個人情報の適正な取扱いを確保するために必要な措置を講ずるものとする

summary: Government must provide necessary measures to ensure the appropriate handling of personal information in local government and local incorporated administrative agency holdings.
quote: 必要な措置を講ずるものとする

summary: Local governments must take measures for personal information held by their organs and by local incorporated administrative agencies they establish.
quote: その機関が保有する個人情報の適正な取扱いが確保されるよう必要な措置を講ずるものとする

summary: Local governments must endeavour to provide support to businesses and residents in their areas to ensure proper handling of personal information.
quote: 支援に必要な措置を講ずるよう努めなければならない

summary: Local governments must endeavour to arrange mediation and other measures for complaints between businesses and individuals.
quote: 苦情の処理のあっせんその他必要な措置を講ずるよう努めなければならない

summary: National and local governments must cooperate in implementing personal information protection measures.
quote: 国及び地方公共団体は、個人情報の保護に関する施策を講ずるにつき、相協力するものとする

summary: Government must take legislative and other measures for personal information requiring special protection and international coordination.
quote: 必要な法制上の措置その他の措置を講ずるとともに

summary: A business handling personal information must specify the purpose of use as far as possible; changes of purpose must stay within the reasonably related scope (Art. 17(2)).
quote: その利用の目的（以下「利用目的」という。）をできる限り特定しなければならない。

summary: Business may not handle personal information beyond the specified purpose without prior consent, subject to exceptions in Art. 18(3); successor and merger rules in Art. 18(2).
quote: あらかじめ本人の同意を得ないで、前条の規定により特定された利用目的の達成に必要な範囲を超えて、個人情報を取り扱ってはならない。
conditional_on: Unless prior consent is obtained, and subject to exceptions in Art. 18(3) (legal basis, life/body/property, public health, cooperation with public bodies, academic research).

summary: Business may not use personal information in a way that may foster or induce illegal or improper conduct.
quote: 違法又は不当な行為を助長し、又は誘発するおそれがある方法により個人情報を利用してはならない。

summary: Business may not acquire personal information by deceit or other improper means.
quote: 偽りその他不正の手段により個人情報を取得してはならない。

summary: Business may not acquire sensitive personal information without prior consent, except in the cases listed in Art. 20(2)(i) to (viii).
quote: あらかじめ本人の同意を得ないで、要配慮個人情報を取得してはならない。
conditional_on: Unless one of the exceptions in Art. 20(2) applies.

summary: On acquiring personal information, business must promptly notify the individual of the purpose of use or publish it; Art. 21(2) requires express indication for contract-based acquisition; Art. 21(3) requires notice of changed purposes.
quote: 速やかに、その利用目的を、本人に通知し、又は公表しなければならない。
conditional_on: Unless the purpose was already published, subject to exceptions in Art. 21(4).

summary: Business must endeavour to keep personal data accurate and up to date and to erase it promptly when no longer needed for the purpose.
quote: 当該個人データを遅滞なく消去するよう努めなければならない

summary: Business must take necessary and appropriate measures to prevent leakage, loss or damage of personal data and for its security management.
quote: その取り扱う個人データの漏えい、滅失又は毀損の防止その他の個人データの安全管理のために必要かつ適切な措置を講じなければならない。

summary: Business must exercise necessary and appropriate supervision over employees handling personal data.
quote: 当該従業者に対する必要かつ適切な監督を行わなければならない

summary: Business that entrusts all or part of personal data handling must exercise necessary and appropriate supervision over the entrusted party.
quote: 委託を受けた者に対する必要かつ適切な監督を行わなければならない

summary: Business must report to the PPC specified security incidents involving personal data posing a large risk to rights and interests, under PPC rules; Art. 26(1) proviso covers entrusted cases.
quote: 個人情報保護委員会に報告しなければならない

summary: Business must notify affected individuals of specified security incidents, or take substitute measures where notice is difficult.
quote: 本人に対し、個人情報保護委員会規則で定めるところにより、当該事態が生じた旨を通知しなければならない
conditional_on: Applies to incidents reportable under Art. 26(1), subject to the substitute-measure exception.

summary: Business may not provide personal data to a third party without prior consent, except in the cases listed in Art. 27(1) (legal basis, life protection, public bodies, academic research).
quote: あらかじめ本人の同意を得ないで、個人データを第三者に提供してはならない
conditional_on: Unless an exception in Art. 27(1) applies.

summary: For opt-out third-party provision under Art. 27(2), business must give prior notice of listed items to individuals or make them easily accessible, and file a notification with the PPC; changes must be notified (Art. 27(3)); Art. 27(6) requires notice of changes to the responsible person.
quote: 個人情報保護委員会に届け出なければならない
conditional_on: Only where business uses opt-out provision under Art. 27(2).

summary: PPC must publish items notified under Art. 27(2) and changes under Art. 27(3).
quote: 当該届出に係る事項を公表しなければならない

summary: Business providing personal data to a third party outside Japan must obtain prior consent, unless the recipient has the equivalent system or an exception applies.
quote: あらかじめ外国にある第三者への提供を認める旨の本人の同意を得なければならない
conditional_on: Unless the third party is in a country recognised as equivalent or has the systems specified in Art. 28(1).

summary: Before obtaining consent for overseas transfer, business must provide information on the foreign data protection system and measures taken by the recipient.
quote: その他当該本人に参考となるべき情報を当該本人に提供しなければならない

summary: After transfer to a third party outside Japan with equivalent systems, business must take measures to ensure continuous implementation of equivalent measures and provide information on request.
quote: 当該第三者による相当措置の継続的な実施を確保するために必要な措置を講ずるとともに
conditional_on: Applies where personal data is transferred to a third party under Art. 28(1) systems.

summary: Business must create records of third-party provision of personal data (date, recipient, other PPC-rule items) and keep them for the period set by PPC rules (Art. 29(2)).
quote: 当該個人データを提供した年月日、当該第三者の氏名又は名称その他の個人情報保護委員会規則で定める事項に関する記録を作成しなければならない
conditional_on: Unless an exception in Art. 27(1) or Art. 27(5) applies.

summary: When receiving personal data from a third party, business must verify the third party's name, address, representative and how it acquired the data.
quote: 次に掲げる事項の確認を行わなければならない
conditional_on: Unless an exception in Art. 27(1) or Art. 27(5) applies.

summary: Business receiving personal data from a third party must record the verification (date of receipt, verified items, other PPC-rule items) and keep the record for the PPC-set period (Art. 30(4)).
quote: 当該確認に係る事項その他の個人情報保護委員会規則で定める事項に関する記録を作成しなければならない

summary: Business providing personal-related information to a third party expected to hold it as personal data must first confirm the individual's consent to that transfer, unless an exception applies.
quote: 当該個人関連情報を当該第三者に提供してはならない
conditional_on: Where the third party is expected to acquire it as personal data; subject to Art. 27(1) exceptions.

summary: Business must make available to individuals information about retained personal data (name, address, representative, purposes of use, procedures and fees, and other items), or respond on request.
quote: 本人の知り得る状態（本人の求めに応じて遅滞なく回答する場合を含む。）に置かなければならない

summary: On request, business must promptly disclose retained personal data by electromagnetic record provision or other specified method; partial or full non-disclosure grounds are in Art. 33(2)(i) to (iii); Art. 33(3) requires notice of non-disclosure decisions.
quote: 遅滞なく、当該保有個人データを開示しなければならない
conditional_on: Subject to the non-disclosure grounds in Art. 33(2).

summary: On a request for correction, addition or deletion of inaccurate retained personal data, business must investigate without delay and correct as needed, then notify the individual of the decision (Art. 34(3)).
quote: その結果に基づき、当該保有個人データの内容の訂正等を行わなければならない
conditional_on: Where the content is not factual and no other law provides a special procedure.

summary: On a request to stop use, delete, or stop third-party provision of retained personal data processed in breach of Art. 18, 19, 20, 27 or 28 (or where no longer needed or a Art. 26(1) incident occurred), business must act without delay and notify the individual (Art. 35(6)-(7)).
quote: 遅滞なく、当該保有個人データの利用停止等を行わなければならない
conditional_on: Where the request is well-founded and, for third-party provision stops, subject to the substitute-measure exception.

summary: Business must endeavour to explain the reasons when it declines or takes different action on a request for disclosure, correction or stop of use.
quote: その理由を説明するよう努めなければならない

summary: Business may set request procedures but must provide information to identify the data and take appropriate measures for the individual's convenience; must not impose excessive burden (Art. 37(4)).
quote: 本人の利便を考慮した適切な措置をとらなければならない

summary: Business may charge a fee for purpose notices and disclosure requests (Art. 38(1)), and must set the fee amount reasonably in light of actual costs.
quote: 実費を勘案して合理的であると認められる範囲内において、その手数料の額を定めなければならない

summary: Business must endeavour to handle complaints about personal information appropriately and promptly and to maintain a system to do so.
quote: 適切かつ迅速な処理に努めなければならない

summary: When creating pseudonymously processed information, business must process personal information under the PPC-rule standards so that individuals cannot be identified without cross-referencing other information.
quote: 個人情報保護委員会規則で定める基準に従い、個人情報を加工しなければならない

summary: Business holding deleted information and matching data for pseudonymised information must take PPC-rule security measures for that deleted information.
quote: 削除情報等の安全管理のための措置を講じなければならない

summary: Business may not handle pseudonymously processed information beyond the purpose range under Art. 17(1), except where required by law; Art. 41(4)-(5) apply modified notice and erasure rules.
quote: 仮名加工情報（個人情報であるものに限る。以下この条において同じ。）を取り扱ってはならない
conditional_on: Unless required by law.

summary: Business may not provide pseudonymously processed personal data to third parties, except where required by law.
quote: 仮名加工情報である個人データを第三者に提供してはならない
conditional_on: Unless required by law.

summary: Business may not cross-reference pseudonymised information to identify individuals, and may not use contact information in it to call, post, send telegrams, fax, electronic means or visit homes (Art. 41(8)).
quote: 当該仮名加工情報を他の情報と照合してはならない

summary: Business may not use contact information or other information in pseudonymised data to make calls, send mail, telegrams, fax, electronic messages or visit homes.
quote: 当該仮名加工情報に含まれる連絡先その他の情報を利用してはならない

summary: Business may not provide pseudonymously processed information (not personal information) to third parties, except where required by law; Art. 42(2) applies the Art. 27(5)-(6) recipient rules.
quote: 仮名加工情報（個人情報であるものを除く。次項及び第三項において同じ。）を第三者に提供してはならない
conditional_on: Unless required by law.

summary: When creating anonymously processed information, business must process personal information under PPC-rule standards to prevent identification and restoration of the source data.
quote: 個人情報保護委員会規則で定める基準に従い、当該個人情報を加工しなければならない

summary: Business creating anonymously processed information must take PPC-rule security measures for the deleted items and processing method information.
quote: これらの情報の安全管理のための措置を講じなければならない

summary: Business creating anonymously processed information must publish the categories of personal information it contains (Art. 43(3)); before third-party provision it must publish the categories and method and explicitly mark the information as anonymously processed (Art. 43(4)).
quote: 当該匿名加工情報に含まれる個人に関する情報の項目を公表しなければならない

summary: Business creating anonymously processed information may not cross-reference it with other information to identify the individuals.
quote: 当該匿名加工情報を他の情報と照合してはならない

summary: Business must endeavour to take and publish security and complaint-handling measures for anonymously processed information.
quote: 当該措置の内容を公表するよう努めなければならない

summary: Business providing anonymously processed information to a third party must publish beforehand the categories and method of provision and explicitly tell the recipient that the information is anonymously processed.
quote: 当該第三者に対して、当該提供に係る情報が匿名加工情報である旨を明示しなければならない
conditional_on: Applies to business providing anonymously processed information to a third party.

summary: Anonymous-information business may not obtain identifying data or cross-reference anonymously processed information to identify individuals.
quote: 当該匿名加工情報を他の情報と照合してはならない

summary: Anonymous-information business must endeavour to take necessary security measures and complaint handling for such information and publish the measures.
quote: 当該措置の内容を公表するよう努めなければならない

summary: Organisations seeking PPC certification as an accredited personal information protection organisation must apply to the PPC under the government-set procedure.
quote: 個人情報保護委員会に申請しなければならない
conditional_on: Applies to organisations wishing to be certified under Art. 47(1).

summary: PPC must publicly announce each certification and any scope limitation.
quote: 公示しなければならない

summary: PPC may not certify an application unless it meets the criteria in Art. 49(1) to (3).
quote: その認定をしてはならない
conditional_on: Unless the application meets the criteria in Art. 49.

summary: A certified organisation must obtain PPC approval before changing the scope of its certified business, except for minor changes under PPC rules.
quote: 個人情報保護委員会の認定を受けなければならない
conditional_on: Except for minor changes defined by PPC rules.

summary: A certified organisation intending to discontinue certified business must notify the PPC in advance.
quote: あらかじめ、その旨を個人情報保護委員会に届け出なければならない

summary: PPC must publicly announce a notified discontinuation of certified business.
quote: その旨を公示しなければならない

summary: A certified organisation must make only consenting business operators its covered entities, and may exclude a covered operator that fails to comply with the guidelines after measures under Art. 54(4).
quote: 対象事業者としなければならない

summary: A certified organisation must publish the names of its covered entities.
quote: 対象事業者の氏名又は名称を公表しなければならない

summary: A certified organisation receiving a complaint about a covered entity must advise the complainant, investigate, notify the covered entity and request prompt resolution.
quote: その苦情の内容を通知してその迅速な解決を求めなければならない

summary: Covered entities may not refuse without justifiable reason a request from the certified organisation for explanation or documents in complaint handling.
quote: 正当な理由がないのに、これを拒んではならない
conditional_on: Absent a justifiable reason.

summary: A certified organisation must endeavour to prepare guidelines (personal information protection guidelines) consistent with the Act, after hearing consumer and other stakeholder views.
quote: この法律の規定の趣旨に沿った指針（以下この節及び第六章において「個人情報保護指針」という。）を作成するよう努めなければならない

summary: A certified organisation must notify the PPC of any guidelines it prepares or amends, without delay.
quote: 当該個人情報保護指針を個人情報保護委員会に届け出なければならない

summary: After the guidelines are published, the certified organisation must take guidance, recommendations and other necessary measures to make covered entities comply.
quote: 対象事業者に対し、当該個人情報保護指針を遵守させるため必要な指導、勧告その他の措置をとらなければならない

summary: A certified organisation may not use information obtained in certified work for purposes other than the certified work.
quote: 認定業務の用に供する目的以外に利用してはならない

summary: Bodies that are not certified may not use the name certified personal information protection organisation or a confusingly similar name.
quote: 認定個人情報保護団体という名称又はこれに紛らわしい名称を用いてはならない

summary: Media, religious, writing and political entities exempted from Chapter 4 must endeavour to take security, complaint and other measures for personal information and publish them.
quote: 当該措置の内容を公表するよう努めなければならない
conditional_on: Applies to the exempted entities listed in Art. 57(1) when they process information for their exempt purposes.

summary: Academic research institutions handling personal information for research must comply with the Act and endeavour to take and publish necessary measures for proper handling.
quote: この法律の規定を遵守するとともに、その適正を確保するために必要な措置を自ら講じ
conditional_on: Applies to academic research institutions when handling personal information for academic research purposes.

summary: Government bodies must specify the purpose of use as far as possible when holding personal information, may hold it only where necessary for their functions, and may not hold it beyond the purpose (Art. 61(2)) or change the purpose beyond the reasonably related scope (Art. 61(3)).
quote: その利用目的をできる限り特定しなければならない

summary: When acquiring personal information directly from the individual in writing, government bodies must state the purpose of use in advance, subject to exceptions in Art. 62(i) to (iv).
quote: あらかじめ、本人に対し、その利用目的を明示しなければならない
conditional_on: Subject to the exceptions in Art. 62.

summary: Government bodies may not use personal information in a way that may foster or induce illegal or improper conduct.
quote: 違法又は不当な行為を助長し、又は誘発するおそれがある方法により個人情報を利用してはならない

summary: Government bodies may not acquire personal information by deceit or other improper means.
quote: 偽りその他不正の手段により個人情報を取得してはならない

summary: Government bodies must endeavour to keep retained personal information accurate and consistent with facts within the purpose.
quote: 保有個人情報が過去又は現在の事実と合致するよう努めなければならない

summary: Government bodies must take necessary and appropriate measures to prevent leakage, loss or damage of retained personal information and for its security management.
quote: 保有個人情報の安全管理のために必要かつ適切な措置を講じなければならない

summary: Contractors and designated administrators handling retained personal information for government bodies bear the same security duty for their entrusted work.
quote: 前項の規定は、次の各号に掲げる者が当該各号に定める業務を行う場合における個人情報の取扱いについて準用する
conditional_on: Applies to the entities listed in Art. 66(2)(i) to (v) for their entrusted work.

summary: Staff of government bodies and dispatched workers handling personal information may not disclose it without cause or use it for improper purposes.
quote: その業務に関して知り得た個人情報の内容をみだりに他人に知らせ、又は不当な目的に利用してはならない

summary: Government bodies must report specified security incidents involving retained personal information to the PPC under PPC rules.
quote: 個人情報保護委員会に報告しなければならない

summary: Government bodies must notify affected individuals of specified security incidents, subject to the substitute-measure and sensitive-information exceptions in Art. 68(2).
quote: 本人に対し、個人情報保護委員会規則で定めるところにより、当該事態が生じた旨を通知しなければならない
conditional_on: Applies to incidents under Art. 68(1), subject to Art. 68(2) exceptions.

summary: Government bodies may not use or provide retained personal information for purposes other than the purpose of use, except as required by law or permitted by the exceptions in Art. 69(2).
quote: 利用目的以外の目的のために保有個人情報を自ら利用し、又は提供してはならない
conditional_on: Unless required by law or within the exceptions in Art. 69(2).

summary: Where a government body decides it is necessary to protect individual rights, it must limit internal use of retained personal information beyond the purpose to specified divisions, organs or staff.
quote: 保有個人情報の利用目的以外の目的のための行政機関等の内部における利用を特定の部局若しくは機関又は職員に限るものとする
conditional_on: Where the body finds it specially necessary to protect individual rights and interests.

summary: When providing retained personal information for a purpose or under Art. 69(2)(iii)-(iv), government bodies must require the recipient to impose use limits or security measures.
quote: 提供に係る個人情報について、その利用の目的若しくは方法の制限その他必要な制限を付し
conditional_on: Where the body considers it necessary.

summary: Government bodies providing retained personal information for a purpose other than its use purpose to a third party in a foreign country must obtain prior consent, unless an exception applies.
quote: あらかじめ外国にある第三者への提供を認める旨の本人の同意を得なければならない
conditional_on: Unless required by law or Art. 69(2)(iv) applies, and subject to the equivalent-system exception in Art. 71(1).

summary: Before obtaining consent for overseas provision, government bodies must provide information on the foreign data protection regime and measures taken by the recipient.
quote: その他当該本人に参考となるべき情報を当該本人に提供しなければならない

summary: After providing retained personal information to a foreign recipient with equivalent systems, government bodies must take measures to ensure continuous implementation of equivalent measures and provide information on request.
quote: 当該第三者による相当措置の継続的な実施を確保するために必要な措置を講ずるとともに

summary: When providing personal-related information to a third party expected to hold it as personal information, government bodies must, where necessary, require use limits or security measures from the recipient.
quote: その漏えいの防止その他の個人関連情報の適切な管理のために必要な措置を講ずることを求めるものとする
conditional_on: Where government body finds it necessary and the third party is expected to acquire it as personal information.

quote: を第三者（当該仮名加工情報の取扱いの委託を受けた者を除く。）に提供してはならない
conditional_on: Unless required by law or where the recipient is a contractor.

summary: Government bodies must take necessary and appropriate measures to prevent leakage and for security of pseudonymously processed information.
quote: 仮名加工情報の安全管理のために必要かつ適切な措置を講じなければならない

summary: Government bodies may not obtain deleted information or cross-reference pseudonymously processed information to identify individuals, and may not use contact details in it for calls, mail, telegrams, fax, electronic means or home visits (Art. 73(4)).
quote: 当該仮名加工情報を他の情報と照合してはならない
conditional_on: Unless required by law.

quote: 開示請求者に対し、当該保有個人情報を開示しなければならない
conditional_on: Except where a non-disclosure ground in Art. 78(1) applies.

conditional_on: Where the non-disclosable part can easily be separated.

summary: Government bodies must notify requesters in writing of a disclosure decision (with purpose and implementation details) or of a non-disclosure decision.
quote: その旨、開示する保有個人情報の利用目的及び開示の実施に関し政令で定める事項を書面により通知しなければならない

summary: Government bodies must decide disclosure requests within 30 days of receipt (excluding correction periods); the period may be extended once by 30 days with notice (Art. 83(2)).
quote: 開示決定等は、開示請求があった日から三十日以内にしなければならない

summary: Before deciding on disclosure of third-party information in certain cases, government bodies must give the third party an opportunity to submit an opinion; if the third party objects and disclosure is decided, at least two weeks must elapse (Art. 86(3)).
quote: 意見書を提出する機会を与えなければならない
conditional_on: Where the case falls under Art. 86(2)(i) or (ii) and the third party's whereabouts are known.

summary: Government bodies must make publicly available the rules on the disclosure method for electromagnetic records.
quote: 電磁的記録についての開示の方法に関する定めを一般の閲覧に供しなければならない

summary: The PPC may make rules (PPC rules) within its competence to implement or carry out the Act or specific delegations.
quote: 個人情報保護委員会規則を制定することができる

summary: The PPC is responsible for the basic policy formulation and implementation, supervision of business operators, government monitoring, certified organisations, complaints assistance, public awareness, research and international cooperation, among other functions.
quote: 基本方針の策定及び推進に関すること

summary: The PPC must annually compile and publish a summary of reports from government bodies on enforcement of the Act.
quote: その概要を公表するものとする

summary: A local government head must notify the PPC of any personal information protection ordinance enacted under the Act, without delay.
quote: 個人情報保護委員会規則で定めるところにより、その旨及びその内容を委員会に届け出なければならない
conditional_on: Applies to ordinances enacted under this Act.

summary: The PPC must publish notified local ordinances on the internet or by other appropriate means.
quote: 当該届出に係る事項をインターネットの利用その他適切な方法により公表しなければならない

summary: The PPC must report annually to the Diet through the Prime Minister on its work and publish a summary.
quote: 所掌事務の処理状況を報告するとともに、その概要を公表しなければならない

quote: 総合的な案内所を整備するものとする

quote: 指定するものとする

quote: 当該指定を決定で変更するものとする
conditional_on: designated provider's business for other specified software reaches the cabinet-order scale

summary: Designated providers may not use or let affiliates use, for competing goods or services, non-public data acquired through basic software, app stores or browsers.

conditional_on: designation under Chapter 2 as provider of the specified software concerned

quote: 不当に差別的な取扱いその他の不公正な取扱いをしてはならない
conditional_on: designation as basic software or app store provider

quote: 次に掲げる行為を行ってはならない

quote: 個別アプリ事業者に対し、次に掲げる行為を行ってはならない
conditional_on: designation as app store provider; exception for cybersecurity measures where other means cannot achieve the purpose

summary: Designated search engine providers may not give their own goods or services priority over competing ones in search results without a justifiable reason.
applies_from: date set by cabinet order, no later than 1 year 6 months after promulgation (Supplementary Provisions Art. 1, main text)
quote: 優先的に取り扱ってはならない
conditional_on: designation as search engine provider; absence of a justifiable reason (正当な理由)

summary: Designated providers must disclose to other individual app and web business operators the conditions for acquiring and using data, and the terms for those operators' data acquisition, by measures set in JFTC rules.

quote: 当該各号に定める措置を講じなければならない
conditional_on: designation as provider of the specified software concerned

summary: Designated providers must disclose to smartphone users the conditions for their acquisition and use of data arising from the use of specified software, by measures set in JFTC rules.
