summary: Shall not process resident registration numbers except as permitted by statute, decree, rules, or to protect urgent life, body or property interests, or as the Commission specifies.
quote: 주민등록번호를 처리할 수 없다
conditional_on: Exceptions listed in Art. 24-2(1).

summary: Store resident registration numbers securely using encryption, with coverage and timing set by decree.
quote: 암호화 조치를 통하여 안전하게 보관하여야 한다
conditional_on: Processing of resident registration numbers.

summary: Where resident registration numbers are processed, provide a way to join an online membership without using them.
quote: 회원으로 가입할 수 있는 방법을 제공하여야 한다
conditional_on: Processing of resident registration numbers under Art. 24-2(1).

summary: No person shall install or operate fixed video processing devices in public places except in the listed cases; installation in bathrooms, changing rooms and similar places is prohibited (Art. 25(2)).
quote: 공개된 장소에 고정형 영상정보처리기기를 설치ㆍ운영하여서는 아니 된다
conditional_on: Exceptions listed in Art. 25(1)(1)-(6); Art. 25(2) exception for decree-designated detention facilities.

summary: Before installing fixed video devices in public places, public agency heads and persons under Art. 25(2) must collect views of experts and stakeholders through the decree procedure.
quote: 관계 전문가 및 이해관계인의 의견을 수렴하여야 한다
conditional_on: Public agencies under Art. 25(1) and persons under Art. 25(2) proviso.

summary: Install a sign showing purpose and location, scope and time of recording, controller contact details and other decree items so that data subjects can easily recognise the device.
quote: 정보주체가 쉽게 인식할 수 있도록 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함된 안내판을 설치하는 등 필요한 조치를 하여야 한다
conditional_on: Operators under Art. 25(1), except listed military and national facilities.

summary: Operators of fixed video devices shall not manipulate the device or point it elsewhere beyond the installation purpose, and shall not use audio recording.
quote: 임의로 조작하거나 다른 곳을 비춰서는 아니 되며, 녹음기능은 사용할 수 없다

summary: Take Art. 29 safety measures to prevent leakage of video personal information.
quote: 제29조에 따라 안전성 확보에 필요한 조치를 하여야 한다
conditional_on: Operators of fixed video devices.

summary: Establish an operation and management policy for fixed video devices, which may be included in the privacy policy under Art. 30.
quote: 고정형 영상정보처리기기 운영ㆍ관리 방침을 마련하여야 한다
conditional_on: Operators of fixed video devices, unless included in the Art. 30 privacy policy.

summary: Public agencies that outsource fixed video device operation must follow the decree procedure and requirements (Art. 25(8)).
quote: 대통령령으로 정하는 절차 및 요건에 따라야 한다
conditional_on: Public agency outsourcing of fixed video device operation.

summary: Persons operating mobile video devices for business purposes shall not record images of people in public places except in the listed cases (consent by notice and no objection; legal basis).
quote: 업무를 목적으로 이동형 영상정보처리기기를 운영하려는 자는
conditional_on: Exceptions listed in Art. 25-2(1).

summary: No person shall record people with mobile video devices in places where the inside of bathrooms, changing rooms and similar places can be seen, except for rescue or emergency cases under decree.
quote: 이동형 영상정보처리기기로 사람 또는 그 사람과 관련된 사물의 영상을 촬영하여서는 아니 된다
conditional_on: Exception: rescue or emergency under decree.

summary: When recording with mobile video devices under Art. 25-2(1), indicate and notify the recording by light, sound, signs or other decree means.
quote: 촬영 사실을 표시하고 알려야 한다
conditional_on: Recording under Art. 25-2(1).

summary: A controller entrusting personal information processing to a third party must do so by a document with the listed contents (purpose limit, safeguards, other decree matters).
quote: 다음 각 호의 내용이 포함된 문서로 하여야 한다
conditional_on: Outsourcing of personal information processing.

summary: Disclose the outsourced tasks and the trustees (including sub-trustees) so that data subjects can easily check them.
quote: 대통령령으로 정하는 방법에 따라 공개하여야 한다
conditional_on: Outsourcing of personal information processing.

summary: For outsourcing of marketing or sales promotion, notify data subjects of the outsourced tasks and trustees, and again on any change.
quote: 위탁하는 업무의 내용과 수탁자를 정보주체에게 알려야 한다
conditional_on: Outsourcing of marketing or sales promotion tasks.

summary: Educate trustees and supervise their safe processing, including checking processing status, to prevent leakage.
quote: 수탁자를 교육하고, 처리 현황 점검 등
conditional_on: Outsourcing of personal information processing.

summary: A trustee shall not use or provide personal information beyond the scope of the outsourced task.
quote: 위탁받은 해당 업무 범위를 초과하여 개인정보를 이용하거나 제3자에게 제공하여서는 아니 된다

summary: A trustee must obtain the trustor's consent before re-outsourcing the processing to a third party.
quote: 위탁자의 동의를 받아야 한다
conditional_on: Re-outsourcing by a trustee.

summary: Trustees are subject to listed provisions of the Act (Arts. 15-18, 21-25, 27-31, 33-38, 59, 63, 64-2, etc.) as if they were controllers, with the trustee read as controller.
quote: 수탁자에 관하여는 제15조부터 제18조까지
conditional_on: Trustees processing under Art. 26.

summary: Before transferring personal information in a business transfer or merger, notify data subjects of the transfer, the transferee's details and how to refuse transfer.
quote: 미리 다음 각 호의 사항을 대통령령으로 정하는 방법에 따라 해당 정보주체에게 알려야 한다
conditional_on: Business transfer, merger or similar transfer of personal information.

summary: A transferee of personal information in a business transfer must notify data subjects without delay, unless the transferor already did so.
quote: 그 사실을 대통령령으로 정하는 방법에 따라 정보주체에게 알려야 한다
conditional_on: Transfer under Art. 27(1); exception where transferor notified.

summary: A transferee may use or provide transferred personal information only for the original purpose at transfer.
quote: 이전 당시의 본래 목적으로만 개인정보를 이용하거나 제3자에게 제공할 수 있다
conditional_on: Transfer by business transfer or merger.

summary: Limit staff who process personal information to the minimum and supervise them appropriately.
quote: 범위를 최소한으로 제한하고, 개인정보취급자에 대하여 적절한 관리ㆍ감독을 하여야 한다

summary: Provide regular necessary training to staff who process personal information.
quote: 정기적으로 필요한 교육을 실시하여야 한다

summary: Pseudonymised information may be processed without consent for statistics, scientific research and public-interest archiving.
quote: 정보주체의 동의 없이 가명정보를 처리할 수 있다
conditional_on: Statistics, scientific research or public-interest archiving purposes.

summary: When providing pseudonymised information to a third party, it must not include information that could identify a specific individual.
quote: 특정 개인을 알아보기 위하여 사용될 수 있는 정보를 포함해서는 아니 된다
conditional_on: Third-party provision of pseudonymised information.

summary: Combination of pseudonymised information across controllers is performed by a designated specialised institution; combined data may leave that institution only after pseudonymisation and approval by it.
quote: 가명정보의 결합은 보호위원회 또는 관계 중앙행정기관의 장이 지정하는 전문기관이 수행한다
conditional_on: Combination of pseudonymised information across different controllers.

summary: When processing pseudonymised information, keep additional restoring information separately and take technical, managerial and physical safety measures.
quote: 안전성 확보에 필요한 기술적ㆍ관리적 및 물리적 조치를 하여야 한다
conditional_on: Processing of pseudonymised information under Art. 28-2 or 28-3.

summary: Create and keep records of pseudonymised information processing (purpose, recipients, processing period where set) and keep them for at least three years after destruction.
quote: 가명정보를 파기한 경우에는 파기한 날부터 3년 이상 보관하여야 한다
conditional_on: Processing of pseudonymised information under Art. 28-2 or 28-3.

summary: Shall not process pseudonymised information for the purpose of identifying a specific individual.
quote: 특정 개인을 알아보기 위한 목적으로 가명정보를 처리해서는 아니 된다

summary: If information that can identify an individual is generated during pseudonymised processing, stop processing immediately and recover and destroy it without delay.
quote: 즉시 해당 정보의 처리를 중지하고, 지체 없이 회수ㆍ파기하여야 한다
conditional_on: Generation of identifiable information during processing under Art. 28-2 or 28-3.

summary: Shall not transfer personal information abroad (provision, outsourcing or storage, including remote access) except in the listed cases (separate consent, specific treaty or law, contract with notice or disclosure, certification, or adequacy recognised by the Commission).
quote: 개인정보처리자는 개인정보를 국외로 제공(조회되는 경우를 포함한다)ㆍ처리위탁ㆍ보관(이하 이 절에서 “이전”이라 한다)하여서는 아니 된다
conditional_on: Exceptions in Art. 28-8(1)(1)-(5).

summary: When seeking separate consent for cross-border transfer, inform the data subject beforehand of the listed items; notify and re-consent for changes.
quote: 미리 다음 각 호의 사항을 정보주체에게 알려야 한다
conditional_on: Cross-border transfer under the consent ground in Art. 28-8(1)(1).

summary: When transferring abroad under the contract or certification exceptions, comply with the other provisions of the Act, Arts. 17-19 and Chapter 5, and take decree-prescribed safeguards.
quote: 제17조부터 제19조까지의 규정 및 제5장의 규정을 준수하여야 하고
conditional_on: Transfer under the proviso of Art. 28-8(1).

summary: Shall not conclude a cross-border transfer contract whose content violates this Act.
quote: 이 법을 위반하는 사항을 내용으로 하는 개인정보의 국외 이전에 관한 계약을 체결하여서는 아니 된다

summary: A transferee who further transfers personal information to a third country must comply with Arts. 28-8 and 28-9 mutatis mutandis.
quote: 제28조의8 및 제28조의9를 준용한다
conditional_on: Onward transfer to a third country by a transferee.

summary: Take technical, managerial and physical safety measures, including an internal management plan and access records, to prevent leakage of personal information.
quote: 안전성 확보에 필요한 기술적ㆍ관리적 및 물리적 조치를 하여야 한다

summary: Establish a privacy policy with the listed contents (purposes, retention, third-party provision, destruction, outsourcing, rights, DPO contact, etc.) and disclose it when established or changed so it is easy to check.
quote: 개인정보처리자는 다음 각 호의 사항이 포함된 개인정보의 처리 방침
conditional_on: Public agencies establish policies for files subject to registration under Art. 32.

summary: The Commission may evaluate privacy policies and recommend improvements to processors.
quote: 개선을 권고할 수 있다

summary: The owner or representative of a processor is the final responsible party and must ensure, with adequate expert staff and budget, effective overall management measures for safe processing and data subject rights.
quote: 총괄적인 관리 조치를 실효성 있게 하여야 한다

summary: Designate a Chief Privacy Officer; for processors meeting the size tests, board approval is needed for designation and changes (Art. 31(3)(1)); the CPO performs the duties listed in Art. 31(4), including planning, reporting, complaint handling and internal control, and must take remedial action on violations (Art. 31(6)).
quote: 개인정보 보호책임자를 지정하여야 한다
conditional_on: Art. 31(1): exception for processors below decree size tests. Art. 31(3): processors meeting decree criteria.

summary: Report to the Commission the designation, change or release of the Chief Privacy Officer, as prescribed by decree.
quote: 보호위원회에 대통령령으로 정하는 바에 따라 개인정보 보호책임자 지정ㆍ변경 또는 해제에 관한 사항을 신고할 것
conditional_on: Processors meeting decree criteria under Art. 31(3).

summary: Shall not give the Chief Privacy Officer unjustified disadvantage or accept it, and must guarantee that the CPO can perform duties independently.
quote: 정당한 이유 없이 불이익을 주거나 받게 하여서는 아니 되며

summary: Processors may form a council of Chief Privacy Officers for joint activities.
quote: 개인정보 보호책임자 협의회를 구성ㆍ운영할 수 있다

summary: The Commission may support the activities of the Chief Privacy Officers council.
quote: 활동에 필요한 지원을 할 수 있다

summary: Qualifications of the CPO, the reporting method and duties, and the independence guarantees are to be set by presidential decree.
quote: 필요한 사항은 매출액, 개인정보의 보유 규모 등을 고려하여 대통령령으로 정한다

summary: A processor with no address or office in Korea that meets the decree criteria must designate in writing a domestic representative for complaints and remedies, the notices and breach reports under Art. 34, and submission of materials under Art. 63(1); the representative must have an address in Korea and be supervised and trained (Art. 31-2(1)-(3)).
quote: 대리하는 자(이하 “국내대리인”이라 한다)를 지정하여야 한다
conditional_on: Processors without an address or office in Korea meeting decree criteria.

summary: Include the domestic representative's name, address, telephone and e-mail in the privacy policy.
quote: 다음 각 호의 사항을 개인정보 처리방침에 포함하여야 한다
conditional_on: Designation of a domestic representative.

summary: Public agency heads must register with the Commission the names, legal basis, purposes, items, processing methods, retention periods and recipients of personal information files they operate, and register changes.
quote: 다음 각 호의 사항을 보호위원회에 등록하여야 한다
conditional_on: Personal information files operated by public agencies, except those listed in Art. 32(2).

summary: The Commission may make the register of personal information files publicly searchable.
quote: 누구든지 쉽게 열람할 수 있도록 공개할 수 있다

summary: The Commission may certify that a processor's personal information processing and protection measures comply with the Act; certification is valid for three years (Art. 32-2(2)), may be revoked (Art. 32-2(3)), and holders may display it (Art. 32-2(6)).
quote: 이 법에 부합하는지 등에 관하여 인증할 수 있다
conditional_on: Application for certification by a processor.

summary: The Commission shall carry out post-certification management at least once a year to maintain the effectiveness of certification.
quote: 연 1회 이상 사후관리를 실시하여야 한다
conditional_on: Certified processors.

summary: Public agency heads must carry out an impact assessment of personal information files likely to threaten data subjects' privacy, as set by decree, have it performed by a designated assessor, submit the results to the Commission, and attach them when registering the file (Art. 33(1), (2), (5)).
quote: 그 결과를 보호위원회에 제출하여야 한다
conditional_on: Personal information files meeting the decree criteria.

summary: Non-public processors are encouraged to conduct impact assessments where personal information files may threaten data subjects' privacy.
quote: 영향평가를 하기 위하여 적극 노력하여야 한다
conditional_on: Non-public processors operating personal information files that may threaten privacy.

summary: On discovering a leak, notify the affected data subjects without delay of the listed items (leaked items, timing and circumstances, self-protective steps, response and remedies, contact, legal rights); where the data subjects cannot be reached, a substitute notice may be used. Art. 34(2) also requires notice to all data subjects at risk of possible leakage as prescribed by decree.
quote: 지체 없이 해당 정보주체에게 다음 각 호의 사항을 알려야 한다
conditional_on: Art. 34(2) applies to possible leakage events as prescribed by decree, from the effective date stated in Art. 2(2) of the 2026 amending act.

summary: Take measures to minimise harm from a leak, including recovery and deletion (Art. 34(3)); report the leak without delay to the Commission or a decree-designated specialised institution, as prescribed by decree (Art. 34(4)).
quote: 지체 없이 보호위원회 또는 대통령령으로 정하는 전문기관에 신고하여야 한다
conditional_on: Leakage of personal information; reporting timing and method prescribed by decree.

summary: Prevent exposure of unique identifiers, account and card information on information networks to the public, and delete or block such information when the Commission or a designated specialised institution requests it.
quote: 공중(公衆)에 노출되지 아니하도록 하여야 한다
conditional_on: Art. 34-2(2): upon request by the Commission or a designated specialised institution.

summary: Enable data subjects to access their personal information within the period set by decree; where delay is justified, notify the reason and allow access once it ends. Restrictions on access must be notified with reasons (Art. 35(4)).
quote: 정보주체가 해당 개인정보를 열람할 수 있도록 하여야 한다
conditional_on: Access request under Art. 35(1)-(2).

summary: Transmit to the data subject, or to a designated recipient, the personal information covered by the portability right, in a form processable by computer, within reasonable time, cost and technical limits (Art. 35-2(3)); tax and local tax law duties to transmit apply (Art. 35-2(4)).
quote: 해당 정보를 컴퓨터 등 정보처리장치로 처리 가능한 형태로 전송하여야 한다
conditional_on: Controllers meeting decree criteria under Art. 35-2(1)-(2); data subject request.

summary: Any person that wants to carry out the transfer-request support, transfer system, or personal information management and analysis services must be designated as a personal information management specialised institution (Art. 35-3(1)); it must meet the requirements in Art. 35-3(2).
quote: 개인정보관리 전문기관의 지정을 받아야 한다
conditional_on: Providers of the listed services.

summary: Designated personal information management specialised institutions shall not force or improperly induce data subjects to request transfers, nor carry out other acts that may infringe personal information or restrict data subjects' rights (Art. 35-3(3)).
quote: 개인정보의 전송 요구를 강요하거나 부당하게 유도하는 행위
conditional_on: Designated personal information management specialised institutions.

summary: The Commission shall systematically manage and supervise processors and designated institutions under the portability rules, including their status and use records (Art. 35-4(1)).
quote: 체계적으로 관리ㆍ감독하여야 한다

summary: The Commission may build and operate a transfer support platform, which may cover the lists of institutions and transferable items, transfer requests and history (Art. 35-4(2)-(3)).
quote: 개인정보 전송 지원 플랫폼을 구축ㆍ운영할 수 있다

summary: On a request to correct or delete, investigate without delay, take the requested correction or deletion, and notify the data subject of the result; delete in an irrecoverable manner (Art. 36(3)).
quote: 지체 없이 그 개인정보를 조사하여 정보주체의 요구에 따라 정정ㆍ삭제 등 필요한 조치를 한 후
conditional_on: Data subject request under Art. 36(1); exception where another law requires collection.

summary: If a correction or deletion request is refused because another law requires the data to be collected, notify the data subject without delay.
quote: 지체 없이 그 내용을 정보주체에게 알려야 한다
conditional_on: Refusal of a correction or deletion request under Art. 36(1) proviso.

summary: On a request to stop processing or on withdrawal of consent, stop all or part of processing without delay; destroy data whose processing has been stopped or consent withdrawn, unless an exception in Art. 37(2) applies.
quote: 지체 없이 정보주체의 요구에 따라 개인정보 처리의 전부를 정지하거나 일부를 정지하여야 한다
conditional_on: Data subject request under Art. 37(1); exceptions in Art. 37(2).

summary: If a stop-processing request is refused under Art. 37(2) proviso or no consent-withdrawal measures are taken under Art. 37(3) proviso, inform the data subject without delay of the reason.
quote: 정보주체에게 지체 없이 그 사유를 알려야 한다
conditional_on: Refusal under Art. 37(2) proviso or Art. 37(3) proviso.

summary: Where a data subject objects to a significant automated decision or requests an explanation, do not apply the decision or provide human re-processing or explanation unless there is a justified reason.
quote: 정당한 사유가 없는 한 자동화된 결정을 적용하지 아니하거나 인적 개입에 의한 재처리ㆍ설명 등 필요한 조치를 하여야 한다
conditional_on: Objection or explanation request under Art. 37-2(1)-(2) regarding a significant automated decision.

summary: Disclose the criteria and procedure for automated decisions and the way personal information is processed so data subjects can easily check them.
quote: 자동화된 결정의 기준과 절차, 개인정보가 처리되는 방식 등을 정보주체가 쉽게 확인할 수 있도록 공개하여야 한다
conditional_on: Automated decisions based on personal information processing.

summary: Establish and publish the concrete methods and procedures for data subjects to exercise access, portability, correction, deletion, suspension, consent withdrawal and automated decision rights; the procedure must be no harder than data collection.
quote: 구체적인 방법과 절차를 마련하고, 이를 정보주체가 알 수 있도록 공개하여야 한다

summary: Establish procedures and inform data subjects of how to object to refusals of access and other data subject requests.
quote: 이의를 제기할 수 있도록 필요한 절차를 마련하고 안내하여야 한다
conditional_on: Refusal of a data subject request.

summary: Processors meeting the decree size tests must take insurance, mutual aid or reserve measures to cover damages under Art. 39 and 39-2; certain public bodies, non-profits, small enterprises entrusting processing, and insured processors are exempt (Art. 39-7(2)).
quote: 보험 또는 공제에 가입하거나 준비금을 적립하는 등 필요한 조치를 하여야 한다
conditional_on: Processors meeting decree thresholds for turnover and holdings.

summary: When notified of a dispute mediation request by the Dispute Mediation Committee, comply with mediation unless there is a special reason.
quote: 분쟁조정에 응하여야 한다
conditional_on: Notification of a mediation request under Art. 43(2).

summary: The Dispute Mediation Committee shall prepare a mediation proposal within 60 days of receiving a request, and notify the applicant of the reasons for any extension (Art. 44(1)-(2)).
quote: 60일 이내에 이를 심사하여 조정안을 작성하여야 한다

summary: Parties to a dispute mediation must follow the Committee's request for materials unless they have a justified reason.
quote: 분쟁당사자는 정당한 사유가 없으면 요청에 따라야 한다
conditional_on: Mediation request under Art. 43(1).
