conditional_on: Seized materials unrelated to the investigation or no longer needed

summary: The Commission must decide a dispute referred for arbitration within 90 days of receipt, extendable once by 90 days.
quote: 재정신청을 접수한 날부터 90일 이내에 재정을 하여야 한다

summary: The dispute mediation committee must review a mediation request and prepare a proposal within 60 days of receipt, extendable once by 30 days.
quote: 분쟁조정 신청을 접수한 날부터 60일 이내에 이를 심사하여 조정안을 작성하여야 한다

summary: Mobile operators must submit data on agents and dealers to the Minister and the Commission every quarter.
quote: 자료를 분기마다 과학기술정보통신부장관과 방송미디어통신위원회에 각각 제출하여야 한다

summary: Mobile operators, agents and dealers may not pay discriminatory subsidies on grounds of residence, age or physical condition without justified reason.
quote: 부당하게 차별적인 지원금을 지급하여서는 아니 된다

summary: Mobile device manufacturers may not unfairly refuse to supply devices to mobile operators, distorting fair distribution.
quote: 부당하게 이동통신단말장치의 공급을 거절하여

summary: Mobile operators must provide users with a clear, public notice of the criteria for refusing, delaying or withdrawing agent approvals before applying them.
quote: 사전에 공지하여야 하며

summary: Mobile operators must publicly disclose a report on the stability of their services each year, covering stability efforts, investment and training.
quote: 보고서를 작성하고, 이를 공개하여야 한다
conditional_on: Basic operator meeting thresholds set by decree under Art. 32-10(2)

summary: Basic operators offering loyalty benefits that accumulate from service use must notify the Minister of their scope of use, validity and method of use.
quote: 과학기술정보통신부장관에게 신고하여야 한다

summary: Mobile operators must offer fee discounts or other benefits to subscribers who sign up for mobile service without receiving subsidies.
quote: 요금할인 등 혜택을 제공하여야 한다
conditional_on: Subscriber signs up without receiving a device subsidy

summary: Mobile operators must inform users of the optimal fee plan derived from analysis of their usage.
quote: 이용자에게 최적화된 전기통신서비스 요금제(이하 “최적요금제”라 한다)를 알려야 한다
conditional_on: Operator designated by decree under Art. 32-21(1)

summary: Telecommunications business operators (including affiliates, agencies, sales outlets, handset makers under Art. 52(3)) must comply with Commission orders within the period set by Presidential decree; the Commission may extend the period once for force majeure.
quote: 전기통신사업자는 제1항에 따른 방송미디어통신위원회의 명령을 대통령령으로 정한 기간에 이행하여야 한다.

summary: Before ordering a Art. 52(1) measure the Commission must inform the party of its content, set a period, and give an opportunity to state an opinion; it may summon interested persons and experts.
quote: 방송미디어통신위원회는 제1항에 따른 조치를 명하기 전에 그 조치의 내용을 당사자에게 알리고 기간을 정하여 의견을 진술할 기회를 주어야 하며

summary: The Commission must notify the Minister of Science and ICT when it orders measures under Art. 52(1)-(3).
quote: 방송미디어통신위원회는 제1항부터 제3항까지의 규정에 따른 조치를 명한 때에는 그 사실을 과학기술정보통신부장관에게 통보하여야 한다.

summary: For the measures in Art. 52(1) items 1-5, 8 and 9 the Commission must hear the opinion of the Minister of Science and ICT.
quote: 다만, 제1호부터 제5호까지, 제8호 및 제9호의 조치를 명하는 경우에는 과학기술정보통신부장관의 의견을 들어야 한다.
conditional_on: measures under items 1-5, 8 and 9 of Art. 52(1)

summary: Standards, procedure and other matters for the Minister's business-suspension disposition under Art. 52(5) are set by Presidential decree.
quote: 제5항에 따른 처분의 기준, 절차, 그 밖에 필요한 사항은 대통령령으로 정한다.

summary: Telecommunications business operators must endeavour to improve the quality of the telecom services they provide.
quote: 전기통신사업자는 그가 제공하는 전기통신역무의 품질을 개선하기 위하여 노력하여야 한다.

summary: The Minister of Science and ICT must adopt measures such as quality assessment of telecom services to improve quality and user benefit.
quote: 과학기술정보통신부장관은 전기통신역무의 품질을 개선하고 이용자의 편익을 증진하기 위하여 전기통신역무의 품질 평가 등 필요한 시책을 마련하여야 한다.

summary: Telecommunications business operators must give users information needed to choose a telecom service, including areas of availability and provision method.
quote: 전기통신사업자는 이용자들에게 그가 제공하는 전기통신역무의 이용 가능 지역 및 제공 방식 등 전기통신역무를 선택하는 데 필요한 정보를 제공하여야 한다.

summary: The Minister sets, by notice, the types of information, method and procedure for the Art. 56-2(1) information duty.
quote: 제1항에 따라 제공하여야 하는 정보의 종류와 정보 제공 방법 및 절차는 과학기술정보통신부장관이 정하여 고시한다.

summary: The Minister must regularly inspect the information provision under Art. 56-2(1) and publish the results annually.
quote: 과학기술정보통신부장관은 제1항에 따른 정보 제공 현황을 정기적으로 점검하고 매년 그 결과를 공표하여야 한다.

summary: The Minister must implement a preselection system under which users pre-select the telecom operator for a service.
quote: 과학기술정보통신부장관은 이용자가 전기통신서비스를 제공받으려는 전기통신사업자를 사전에 선택하는 제도

summary: Telecom operators must not force or improperly induce users to pre-select a particular operator.
quote: 전기통신사업자는 이용자에게 특정한 전기통신사업자를 사전선택하도록 강요하거나 부당한 방법으로 권유ㆍ유도하는 행위를 하여서는 아니 된다.

summary: Basic telecom operators (and related persons) above the Art. 39(3) categories may not exercise voting rights on shares of another basic operator above the stated ownership limit; the excess shares are excluded.
quote: 그 한도를 초과하는 주식에 대하여는 의결권을 행사할 수 없다.
conditional_on: operators under Art. 39(3)(1) or (2) holding more than the Art. 59 ownership limit in another basic operator

summary: Telecom operators must provide a number-guide service that publicises user telecom numbers, based on user consent, unless exempted by a notice for small businesses.
quote: 이용자의 동의를 받아 일반에게 음성ㆍ책자ㆍ인터넷 등으로 안내하는 서비스(이하 “번호안내서비스”라 한다)를 제공하여야 한다.
conditional_on: user consent; exemption for minor businesses set by Minister notice

summary: Mobile operators must share the unique device identification numbers of reported lost or stolen handsets among telecom operators in order to block their use.
quote: 이동통신사업자는 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 이동통신단말장치의 사용 차단을 위하여 해당 이동통신단말장치의 고유식별번호를 전기통신사업자 간에 공유하여야 한다.
conditional_on: devices reported lost or stolen, or used in telecom financial fraud

summary: No one may damage, forge or alter a device's unique identification number with the purpose of obstructing the use blocking under Art. 60-2(1).
quote: 누구든지 제60조의2제1항 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 이동통신단말장치의 사용 차단을 방해할 목적으로 이동통신단말장치의 고유식별번호를 훼손하거나 위조 또는 변조하여서는 아니 된다.
conditional_on: purpose of obstructing device use blocking

summary: Telecom operators must maintain and repair telecom equipment to the technical standards set by Presidential decree.
quote: 전기통신사업자는 그가 제공하는 전기통신역무의 안정적인 공급을 위하여 해당 전기통신설비를 대통령령으로 정하는 기술기준에 적합하도록 유지ㆍ보수하여야 한다.

summary: Basic operators must notify the Minister in advance before installing or changing important telecom equipment; first installation of a new technology requires the Minister's approval.
quote: 기간통신사업자는 중요한 전기통신설비를 설치하거나 변경하려는 경우에는 대통령령으로 정하는 바에 따라 미리 과학기술정보통신부장관에게 신고하여야 한다.
conditional_on: important telecom equipment; new technology requires approval

summary: The Minister determines by notice the scope of important telecom equipment.
quote: 제1항에 따른 중요한 전기통신설비의 범위는 과학기술정보통신부장관이 정하여 고시한다.

summary: Basic operators above a business-scale criterion must form and run a council for joint construction of telecom equipment.
quote: 사업규모 등이 대통령령으로 정하는 기준에 해당하는 기간통신사업자는 제1항에 따른 전기통신설비의 공동구축 협의를 위하여 협의회를 구성ㆍ운영하여야 한다.
conditional_on: business scale meets the criteria set by Presidential decree

summary: The Minister sets by notice the criteria for the composition and operation of the joint-construction council.
quote: 과학기술정보통신부장관은 제2항에 따른 협의회의 구성, 운영 절차 및 협의 대상설비ㆍ대상지역의 범위 등에 관한 기준을 정하여 고시한다.

summary: Persons installing self-use telecom equipment must report it to the competent provincial governor (or the Minister, for provincial governors' own installations); changes of important matters require a change report.
quote: 자가전기통신설비를 설치하려는 자는 대통령령으로 정하는 바에 따라 주된 설비가 설치되어 있는 사무소 소재지를 관할하는 특별시장ㆍ광역시장ㆍ특별자치시장ㆍ도지사ㆍ특별자치도지사(이하 “시ㆍ도지사”라 한다)에게 신고하여야 하며

summary: After completing installation or change work on self-use telecom equipment, the installer must obtain a confirmation from the competent authority before use.
quote: 그 설치공사 또는 변경공사를 완료한 때에는 그 사용 전에 대통령령으로 정하는 바에 따라 다음 각 호의 구분에 따른 사람의 확인을 받아야 한다.

summary: Installers of self-use telecom equipment must not use it to relay others' communications, operate it contrary to its purpose, or operate it differently from the filed report.
quote: 자가전기통신설비를 설치한 자는 그 설비를 이용하여 타인의 통신을 매개하거나 설치한 목적에 어긋나게 운용하거나 제64조제1항에 따라 신고 또는 변경신고한 사항과 다르게 운용하여서는 아니 된다.
conditional_on: exceptions for other statutes and listed police, disaster-rescue and affiliated uses

summary: Costs of emergency telecom services under Art. 66 are borne by the government, except where self-use equipment is provided to a basic operator.
quote: 제1항의 경우에 그 업무의 취급 또는 설비의 접속에 소요되는 비용은 정부가 부담한다.
conditional_on: emergency measures under Art. 66(1)

summary: Builders of listed facilities (roads, railways, urban rail, industrial complexes, free trade zones, airports, ports) must reflect a basic operator's opinion on joint ducts or conduits; if not reflected, they must notify reasons within 30 days.
quote: 전기통신설비를 수용할 수 있는 공동구 또는 관로 등의 설치에 관한 기간통신사업자의 의견을 들어 그 내용을 반영하여야 한다.
conditional_on: facilities listed in Art. 68(1)

summary: Before mediating a duct-coordination request, the Minister must consult the heads of relevant central administrative agencies.
quote: 과학기술정보통신부장관은 제5항에 따른 조정 요청을 받아 조정을 할 경우 관계 중앙행정기관의 장과 미리 협의하여야 한다.
conditional_on: mediation request under Art. 68(5)

summary: Buildings under the Building Act must be equipped with in-building telecom line equipment and secure an area for connection to telecom line facilities.
quote: 「건축법」 제2조제1항제2호에 따른 건축물에는 구내용(構內用) 전기통신선로설비 등을 갖추어야 하며
conditional_on: buildings within the scope set by Presidential decree

summary: Scope, installation standards and connection-area requirements for building telecom line equipment are set by Presidential decree.
quote: 제1항에 따른 건축물의 범위, 전기통신선로설비 등의 설치기준 및 전기통신회선설비와의 접속을 위한 면적 확보 등에 관한 사항은 대통령령으로 정한다.

summary: Listed facilities (buildings above a floor-area threshold, housing complexes above a household threshold, urban rail facilities) must be fitted with in-building mobile communication equipment.
applies_from: one year after promulgation of Act No. 19545 (2023), per 부칙 제1조 proviso
quote: 다음 각 호의 시설에는 구내용 이동통신설비(이동통신서비스를 이용하기 위하여 필요한 전기통신설비를 의미한다)를 설치하여야 한다.
conditional_on: facility size and household thresholds set by Presidential decree

summary: For designated facilities, the basic operator must connect the in-building mobile equipment to the building owner's emergency power terminal; the building owner must cooperate unless there is a justified reason.
applies_from: one year after promulgation of Act No. 19545 (2023), per 부칙 제1조 proviso
quote: 기간통신사업자는 화재, 재난 등이 발생한 경우에도 구내용 이동통신설비가 안정적으로 운용될 수 있도록 건축주의 비상전원단자에 연결하여야 하며, 건축주는 정당한 사유가 없는 한 협조하여야 한다.
conditional_on: facilities designated by Presidential decree under Art. 69-2(1)(1)

summary: Types, installation standards and procedures for in-building mobile equipment are set by Presidential decree.
quote: 제1항 및 제2항에 따라 설치하여야 하는 구내용 이동통신설비의 종류, 설치기준 및 절차에 관한 사항은 대통령령으로 정한다.

summary: A basic operator must consult the owner or occupier in advance before using their land or buildings for telecom lines and antennas.
quote: 이 경우 기간통신사업자는 미리 그 토지등의 소유자나 점유자와 협의하여야 한다.

summary: No one may obstruct, without justification, surveying, construction or maintenance work on telecom lines or the temporary use of land for it.
quote: 누구든지 제1항에 따른 선로등의 측량, 전기통신설비의 설치공사 또는 보전공사와 이를 위한 전기통신설비 및 토지등의 일시 사용을 정당한 사유 없이 방해하여서는 아니 된다.

summary: Before temporarily using private or public property, a basic operator must notify the occupier of the purpose and period (or notify afterwards or by public notice if prior notice is impossible); the user must also show an identity document (Art. 73(5)).
quote: 기간통신사업자는 제1항에 따라 사유 또는 국유ㆍ공유 재산을 일시 사용하려면 미리 점유자에게 사용목적과 사용기간을 알려야 한다.
conditional_on: temporary use of private or state/public property under Art. 73(1)

summary: The period of temporary use of land under Art. 73(1) may not exceed six months.
quote: 제1항에 따른 토지등의 일시 사용기간은 6개월을 초과할 수 없다.

summary: Before entering a residential building for survey or maintenance of telecom equipment, the operator must obtain the resident's consent.
quote: 다만, 출입하려는 곳이 주거용 건물인 경우에는 거주자의 승낙을 받아야 한다.
conditional_on: entry into a residential building

summary: No one may obstruct, without justification, survey or investigation work for telecom equipment or entry onto land for it.
quote: 누구든지 제1항에 따른 전기통신설비의 설치와 보전을 위한 측량ㆍ조사 등과 이를 위하여 토지등에 출입하는 것을 정당한 사유 없이 방해하여서는 아니 된다.

summary: Owners or occupiers of obstacles (e.g., gas, water, power lines) that affect telecom equipment must consult the operator in advance before installing, altering, removing or modifying them.
quote: 그 장해물등을 신설ㆍ증설ㆍ개선ㆍ철거 또는 변경할 필요가 있으면 미리 기간통신사업자와 협의하여야 한다.
conditional_on: obstacles that may obstruct telecom equipment

summary: When use of land under Arts. 72-73 ends or the land is no longer needed, the basic operator must restore it to its original state, or pay appropriate compensation if restoration is impossible.
quote: 기간통신사업자는 제72조 및 제73조에 따른 토지등의 사용이 끝나거나 사용하고 있는 토지등을 전기통신업무에 제공할 필요가 없게 되면 그 토지등을 원상으로 회복하여야 하며
conditional_on: end of use under Arts. 72 or 73

summary: Before paying compensation under Art. 76 or 77, a basic operator must consult the affected person; without agreement it must apply to the expropriation commission for a ruling.
quote: 그 손실을 입은 자와 협의하여야 한다.
conditional_on: compensation under Art. 76 or 77

summary: No one may damage telecom equipment or obstruct telecom traffic by touching or otherwise impairing its function; under Art. 79(2) no one may throw objects at it or damage it by tying animals or vessels to it.
quote: 누구든지 전기통신설비를 파손하여서는 아니 되며, 전기통신설비에 물건을 접촉하거나 그 밖의 방법으로 그 기능에 장해를 주어 전기통신의 소통을 방해하는 행위를 하여서는 아니 된다.

summary: Procedure and method for applying for, designating and marking submarine cable boundary zones are set by Presidential decree.
quote: 해저케이블 경계구역의 지정 신청, 지정ㆍ고시의 방법과 절차, 경계구역 표시의 방법 등에 관한 사항은 대통령령으로 정한다.

summary: When a relocation request under Art. 80(1) is received, the basic operator must take the necessary measures unless technically or operationally difficult.
quote: 기간통신사업자는 제1항에 따른 요구를 받은 경우 해당 조치를 하는 것이 업무의 수행상 또는 기술상 곤란한 경우가 아니면 필요한 조치를 하여야 한다.
conditional_on: relocation request under Art. 80(1), absent operational or technical difficulty

summary: Public agencies asked by a basic operator for cooperation in moving vehicles, vessels or aircraft for telecom work must comply unless there is a justified reason.
quote: 이 경우 협조를 요청받은 공공기관은 정당한 사유가 없으면 그 요청에 따라야 한다.
conditional_on: cooperation request by a basic operator

summary: No one may infringe or disclose the secrecy of communications handled by a telecom operator.
quote: 누구든지 전기통신사업자가 취급 중에 있는 통신의 비밀을 침해하거나 누설하여서는 아니 된다.

summary: Persons who work or worked in telecom services must not disclose others' secrets learned about communications during their employment.
quote: 전기통신업무에 종사하는 사람 또는 종사하였던 사람은 그 재직 중에 통신에 관하여 알게 된 타인의 비밀을 누설하여서는 아니 된다.

summary: Telecom operators may comply with requests by courts, prosecutors, investigators and intelligence agencies for subscriber information listed in Art. 83(3)(1)-(6).
quote: 그 요청에 따를 수 있다.
conditional_on: request by a court, prosecutor, investigative agency or intelligence agency for subscriber information

summary: A request for subscriber information must be in writing, stating the reason, relation to the user and the scope of information; urgent requests may be oral and must be documented afterwards.
quote: 통신이용자정보 제공 요청은 요청사유, 해당 이용자와의 연관성, 필요한 통신이용자정보의 범위를 기재한 서면

summary: After providing subscriber information, the operator must keep a register in the form set by Presidential decree and the related request documents.
quote: 대장과 정보제공요청서 등 관련 자료를 갖추어 두어야 한다.
conditional_on: subscriber information was provided under Art. 83(3)-(4)

summary: Operators must report to the Minister twice a year on the subscriber information provided; the Minister may check the reports and the record-keeping.
quote: 통신이용자정보 제공을 한 현황 등을 연 2회 과학기술정보통신부장관에게 보고하여야 하며

summary: Operators must inform the head of the requesting central agency of the register contents, or the Supreme Court Administration Office for court requests.
quote: 중앙행정기관의 장에게 제5항에 따른 대장에 기재된 내용을 대통령령으로 정하는 방법에 따라 알려야 한다.

summary: Operators must set up and run a dedicated unit for user communications-secrecy matters.
quote: 전기통신사업자는 이용자의 통신비밀에 관한 업무를 담당하는 전담기구를 설치ㆍ운영하여야 하며

summary: Scope of officials authorised to approve information requests is set by Presidential decree.
quote: 정보제공요청서에 대한 결재권자의 범위 등에 관하여 필요한 사항은 대통령령으로 정한다.

summary: Investigative agencies must notify the subject of a subscriber-information disclosure in writing or electronically within 30 days after receipt, with the content listed in Art. 83-2(1).
quote: 통신이용자정보 제공의 대상이 된 당사자에게 서면 또는 문자메시지, 메신저 등 전자적 방법으로 통지하여야 한다.
conditional_on: subscriber information was received under Art. 83(3)

summary: Investigative agencies may defer the notice in Art. 83-2(1) for the listed security, safety, judicial or administrative reasons, for periods set in Art. 83-2(3).
quote: 통지를 유예할 수 있다.
conditional_on: reasons listed in Art. 83-2(2)

summary: A telecom operator asked by investigative agencies to confirm whether a subscriber's information has changed or whether a person is a user must comply unless there is a special reason.
quote: 이 경우 요청을 받은 전기통신사업자는 특별한 사유가 없으면 그 요청에 따라야 한다.
conditional_on: confirmation request under Art. 83-2(5)

summary: Procedure for notifying and deferring notices of subscriber-information disclosure is set by Presidential decree.
quote: 통신이용자정보 제공을 받은 사실의 통지 절차, 제2항 및 제3항에 따른 통지유예 절차 등에 관하여 필요한 사항은 대통령령으로 정한다.

summary: When an investigative agency decides to defer a notice, it must inform the designated agency (KISA) of that decision.
quote: 그 사실을 대행기관에 통보하여야 한다.
conditional_on: deferral decision under Art. 83-2(2) or (3)

summary: The designated notice agency must keep a notice-management register and the deferral-notification materials, which it may keep electronically.
quote: 통지관리대장과 제3항에 따른 통지유예 통보 관련 자료를 갖추어 두어야 한다.
conditional_on: performing the notice task under Art. 83-3(1)(1)

summary: The designated notice agency must set up and run a dedicated unit for communications-secrecy matters.
quote: 대행기관은 이용자의 통신비밀에 관한 업무를 담당하는 전담기구를 설치ㆍ운영하여야 한다.

summary: Investigative agencies must pay the designated agency for the cost of the delegated work, as set by Presidential decree.
quote: 수사기관등은 대행기관에 대하여 업무의 대행에 드는 비용을 대통령령으로 정하는 바에 따라 지급하여야 한다.

summary: Officers and staff of the designated notice agency (current or former) must not disclose or misuse others' information obtained in performing delegated tasks.
quote: 타인의 정보를 누설하거나 업무 목적 외의 용도로 이용하여서는 아니 된다.

summary: At a subscriber's request, a telecom operator may disclose the sender's telephone number, except where the sender refused; Art. 84(2) lists cases where disclosure is also allowed.
quote: 전기통신사업자는 수신인의 요구가 있으면 송신인의 전화번호를 알려줄 수 있다.
conditional_on: recipient request, and sender has not refused disclosure

summary: No one may falsely display a sender's telephone number to defraud or harass; under Art. 84-2(2) no one may provide for profit services or devices that enable such falsification.
quote: 송신인의 전화번호를 변작하는 등 거짓으로 표시하여서는 아니 된다.
conditional_on: purpose of gain or harm as stated

summary: To prevent user harm from falsified numbers, telecom operators must block or correct the number, give notice of overseas calls, suspend the line of the sender, or take other measures set by the Minister.
quote: 전기통신사업자는 거짓으로 표시된 전화번호로 인한 이용자의 피해를 예방하기 위하여 다음 각 호의 조치를 하여야 한다.
conditional_on: unless the justified-purpose exception in Art. 84-2(2) applies

summary: The Minister may set by notice the detailed procedures and methods for justified-purpose exceptions and for the measures in Art. 84-2(3)-(4).
quote: 제4항의 이행을 위한 구체적인 절차ㆍ방법을 정하여 고시할 수 있다.

summary: A telecom operator must obtain the Minister's approval before concluding, amending or ending an agreement on cross-border supply of basic telecom services or certain international telecom services, unless the exceptions in Art. 86(2) apply.
quote: 과학기술정보통신부장관의 승인을 받아야 하고, 이를 변경하거나 폐지하려는 때에도 또한 같다.
conditional_on: agreements under Art. 87(1) or specified international telecom services; exceptions for listed FTA-country satellite broadcasting services

summary: A basic telecom operator must notify the Minister when it concludes a settlement agreement on international telecom charges with a foreign government or foreign person, unless below the decree thresholds.
quote: 외국정부 또는 외국인과 국제전기통신서비스의 취급에 따른 요금 정산에 관한 협정을 체결한 때에는 과학기술정보통신부장관에게 신고하여야 한다.
conditional_on: basic telecom service provider; exception for equipment, capital and numbering criteria set by Presidential decree

summary: Matters relating to the Art. 86(3) notification are set by Minister notice.
quote: 제3항에 따른 신고와 관련된 사항은 과학기술정보통신부장관이 정하여 고시한다.

summary: A foreign provider without a domestic place of business that supplies basic telecom services from abroad into Korea must conclude a cross-border supply agreement with a domestic basic operator providing the same service.
quote: 같은 기간통신역무를 제공하는 국내의 기간통신사업자와 기간통신역무의 국경 간 공급에 관한 협정을 체결하여야 한다.
conditional_on: cross-border supply of basic telecom services without a domestic place of business

summary: Standards, procedure and other matters for the Minister's approval-revocation or suspension of cross-border supply under Art. 87(3) are set by Presidential decree.
quote: 제3항에 따른 처분의 기준 및 절차, 그 밖에 필요한 사항은 대통령령으로 정한다.

summary: Manufacturers, importers and sellers of mobile handsets may place a warning on the device that using it while moving carries accident risk; the government may support the cost.
quote: 이동 중 이동통신단말장치의 사용은 사고의 위험성이 있다는 내용의 경고문구를 이동통신단말장치에 표기할 수 있다.

summary: Content and method of the warning text under Art. 87-2(1) are set by Minister notice.
quote: 제1항에 따른 경고문구의 표기 내용ㆍ방법 등에 필요한 사항은 과학기술정보통신부장관이 정하여 고시한다.

summary: Telecom operators must report telecom statistics (facilities, usage, subscribers, call-volume data for billing) to the Minister by decree procedure and keep related data available.
quote: 과학기술정보통신부장관에게 보고하고 관련 자료를 갖추어 두어야 한다.

summary: Basic operators and their shareholders must submit documents needed to confirm facts under Art. 8 when requested by the Minister.
quote: 기간통신사업자 및 그 주주는 대통령령으로 정하는 바에 따라 제8조의 사실을 확인하는 데에 필요한 관계 자료를 제출하여야 한다.

summary: An agency asked by the Minister to review or verify submitted data must comply unless there is a justified reason.
quote: 이 경우 요청을 받은 기관은 정당한 사유가 없으면 그 요청에 따라야 한다.
conditional_on: review or verification request under Art. 88(3)

summary: Provincial governors must report to the Minister on self-use equipment filings and changes, corrective measures, surcharges and fines, and keep related records.
quote: 시ㆍ도지사는 다음 각 호의 사항을 대통령령으로 정하는 바에 따라 과학기술정보통신부장관에게 보고하고 관련 자료를 갖추어 두어야 한다.

summary: The Minister must hold a hearing before revoking or dissolving a basic operator's registration, dissolving a value-added service, or revoking a cross-border approval.
quote: 과학기술정보통신부장관은 다음 각 호의 어느 하나에 해당하는 처분을 하려면 청문을 하여야 한다.
conditional_on: dispositions listed in Art. 89 items 1-3

summary: Certain Minister powers (business suspension order, enforcement fines, surcharges in lieu of suspension) are entrusted to the Broadcasting Media and Communications Commission.
quote: 과학기술정보통신부장관의 권한 중 다음 각 호의 권한은 방송미디어통신위원회에 위탁한다.

summary: Other powers of the Minister and the Commission may be delegated in part to subordinate agency heads, as set by Presidential decree.
quote: 그 일부를 대통령령으로 정하는 바에 따라 각각 소속 기관의 장에게 위임할 수 있다.

summary: Institutions must require persons who apply in person for passive operations linked to Level 4 accounts, or for active operations, services or payment means linked to Levels 3 and 4, to provide identity data and perform the verification actions of Art. 51 Bis 4 fracción I for the person presenting; no online biometric verification of a represented person.
quote: Las Instituciones deberán requerir a las personas físicas que de manera presencial soliciten la celebración de operaciones pasivas relacionadas con Cuentas Bancarias Nivel 4
conditional_on: Applies to in-person requests by natural persons for the listed operations.

summary: Institutions must perform the verification actions of Art. 51 Bis 4 fracciones I (inciso b), II (inciso b) and V for the person presenting, and must not verify online the biometric data of a represented person when a representative acts.
provision: Art. 51 Bis, fracción I, inciso a) (reformado)
quote: Las Instituciones deberán efectuar las acciones de verificación a que alude el Artículo 51 Bis 4, fracción I de las presentes disposiciones respecto de la persona que se presenta.

summary: For database-based identity verification, institutions must verify that the client's biometric data match the registries of the INE, SRE, Mexican tax authority or federal agency, keep documentary evidence, verify the client's credential, passport or consular ID and corroborate the CURP with the Registro Nacional de Población; verification is only against each institution's own database.
provision: Art. 51 Bis 2, párrafos segundo, tercero y fracciones I, III y IV
quote: Lo anterior, siempre que las Instituciones realicen, para la integración de dicha base de datos, la verificación de la coincidencia de la información biométrica del cliente
conditional_on: Applies when the institution forms its own biometric database under Art. 51 Bis 2.

summary: Institutions must keep documentary evidence of the custody of the biometric matching verification results with the authorities listed in the article.
quote: Asimismo, las instituciones deberán contar con la evidencia documental del resguardo de la verificación de la coincidencia realizada
conditional_on: Applies when the institution forms a biometric database under Art. 51 Bis 2.

summary: Institutions must first capture the biometric data of their employees, directors and officials who will collect client data, and then capture client data, meeting the technical requirements of Anexo 71.
quote: Hacer primeramente la captura de la información biométrica de sus empleados, directivos o funcionarios
conditional_on: Applies when the institution forms a biometric database under Art. 51 Bis 2.

summary: Institutions with a biometric database must carry out an annual validation of the security mechanisms in Anexo 71, in compliance with Art. 168 Bis 14 fracción IX.
quote: deberá realizar una validación anual respecto de los mecanismos de seguridad mencionados en el Anexo 71
conditional_on: Applies when the institution holds a biometric database under Art. 51 Bis 2.

summary: Institutions must send the Commission, within 20 business days after completing the annual validation, the actions taken to address the deviations identified.
applies_from: Within 20 días hábiles after conclusion of the annual validation.
quote: enviar a la Comisión, a más tardar dentro de los 20 días hábiles posteriores a la conclusión de la validación
conditional_on: Applies when the institution holds a biometric database under Art. 51 Bis 2.

summary: The Commission may at any time request additional information to supervise compliance and, after a hearing for the institution, may order partial or total, temporary or definitive suspension of the biometric database use for serious or repeated non-compliance.
provision: Art. 51 Bis 2, sexto y séptimo párrafos
quote: La Comisión podrá requerir a la Institución en todo momento información adicional
conditional_on: Applies to institutions with a biometric database under Art. 51 Bis 2.

summary: Biometric client data in the database must not be sold, transferred, shared or requested under any exchange, custody, reuse or interoperability scheme between institutions or with third parties for identity verification, without prejudice to Art. 113 of the Ley para Regular las Agrupaciones Financieras.
quote: no deberá ser enajenada, vendida, transferida, compartida o solicitada bajo cualquier esquema de intercambio

summary: When an institution stops using its biometric database, it must notify the Commission using Anexo 75 at least 20 business days after the end of use.
applies_from: At least 20 días hábiles after the end of use of the database.
quote: deberán de dar un aviso a la Comisión de conformidad con el formato correspondiente del Anexo 75
conditional_on: Applies when the institution decides to stop using the database.

summary: After ceasing use of the biometric database, the institution must delete the biometric data using administrative, technical and physical measures that prevent recovery or unauthorised access, and keep documentary evidence for the Commission.
applies_from: After the end of use of the database.
quote: deberán realizar la supresión de los datos biométricos contenidos en la base referida
conditional_on: Applies when the institution stops using the database.

summary: To use a process other than that of Art. 51 Bis 2 fracciones I and II, the institution must obtain Commission authorization by submitting Anexo 75 with a detailed description of the mechanism, approved by its Board, and of the technological infrastructure.
provision: Art. 51 Bis 3, primer párrafo y fracción I
quote: La descripción detallada del mecanismo, el cual deberá ser aprobado por su Consejo
conditional_on: Commission authorization of other processes under Art. 51 Bis 3.

summary: Under the alternative process, institutions must verify the match of the client's biometric data with the registries of the INE, SRE, Mexican tax authority or federal agency and keep the security elements for custody and integrity of the information.
quote: las Instituciones deberán realizar la verificación de la coincidencia de la información biométrica del cliente
conditional_on: Applies under an authorized alternative process under Art. 51 Bis 3.

summary: Institutions must keep documentary evidence of the custody of the verification result under the alternative process and make it available to the Commission.
quote: Las Instituciones deberán contar con la evidencia documental del resguardo del resultado de la verificación
conditional_on: Applies under an authorized alternative process under Art. 51 Bis 3.

summary: When an institution stops using the alternative database, it must notify the Commission using Anexo 75 at least 20 business days after the end of use, then delete the personal data with documented evidence.
applies_from: At least 20 días hábiles after the end of use.
quote: deberán de dar un aviso a la Comisión de conformidad con el formato correspondiente del Anexo 75 de las presentes disposiciones, al menos 20 días hábiles
conditional_on: Applies when the institution stops using the database under Art. 51 Bis 3.

summary: For in-person identification with the INE credential (fracción I, inciso b), institutions must verify online that the biometric data obtained match at least 90 percent with INE records, using the technical requirements set by the INE, with reader and application safeguards; the same 90 percent online verification applies to the passport (fracción II, inciso b) and consular ID (fracción V).
provision: Art. 51 Bis 4, fracción I, inciso b), párrafo primero
quote: Verificar en línea que la información biométrica que se obtenga de la persona física que presenta la credencial para votar
conditional_on: Applies to in-person operations under Art. 51 Bis.

summary: Biometric readers and institution applications must ensure that biometric data are obtained directly from the holder, prevent recording of data from simulation mechanisms, and include security measures so that stored, processed or transmitted information is not known or used by unauthorised third parties.
provision: Art. 51 Bis 4, fracción I, inciso b), párrafo primero
quote: deberán asegurar que la información biométrica se obtenga directamente de la persona titular
conditional_on: Applies to the biometric verification processes of Art. 51 Bis 4.

summary: Institutions must provide documented mechanisms and procedures for contracting and payment requests, and operations, with persons who cannot provide at least one biometric datum for authentication before the INE, SRE or other authority, recorded in the client file.
provision: Art. 51 Bis 4, fracción I, párrafo segundo
quote: Las Instituciones deberán prever mecanismos y procedimientos documentados para llevar a cabo las contrataciones y la solicitud de medios de pago
conditional_on: Applies to persons with a permanent physical impediment to providing biometric data.

summary: To request approval of other identity documents or verification actions under Art. 51 Bis 5, institutions must submit Anexo 75 with the proposed process, a description of the process approved by their Board, and a validation method for the documents; changes to an approved procedure require prior Commission authorization.
quote: Al solicitar las aprobaciones a que se refiere el párrafo primero de este artículo, las Instituciones deberán presentar lo siguiente
conditional_on: Applies when the institution seeks Commission authorization under Art. 51 Bis 5.

summary: When an institution stops using an approved identity document and verification action, it must notify the Commission using Anexo 75 within 20 business days after the end of use.
applies_from: Within 20 días hábiles after the end of use.
quote: deberán de dar un aviso a la Comisión de conformidad con el formato correspondiente del Anexo 75 de las presentes disposiciones, dentro de los 20 días hábiles posteriores respecto del término de su uso
conditional_on: Applies under Art. 51 Bis 5.

summary: Institutions that already hold a client biometric database at entry into force must file a notice with the Commission using Anexo 75, stating the database creation date, the date from which it is used for verification, and the type of biometric identification and verification used.
applies_from: Within 30 días naturales of the entry into force of the Resolution.
quote: deberán presentar dentro de un plazo de 30 días naturales, un aviso a la Comisión
conditional_on: Applies to institutions that hold a biometric database at entry into force.

summary: Institutions must comply with the Resolution as amended within a maximum period of 90 business days from its entry into force.
applies_from: 90 días hábiles contados a partir de su entrada en vigor.
quote: deberán apegarse a lo establecido en esta Resolución modificatoria, dentro de un plazo máximo de 90 días hábiles

summary: Institutions may form client biometric databases only for fingerprint and facial biometrics under Art. 51 Bis 2 and 51 Bis 3, until technical specifications are issued for other biometric data types.
quote: solo podrán conformar la base de datos de información biométrica de sus clientes de conformidad con el artículo 51 Bis 2 y 51 Bis 3
conditional_on: Until the Commission issues technical specifications for other biometric data types.

summary: Institutions must at all times guarantee the integrity, preservation, availability and non-manipulation of stored or transmitted biometric information and, for the first capture process, prevent an employee from registering their own biometric data in place of the client's; the list of minimum measures (a to h) covers logical segregation, dedicated infrastructure, secure configuration, access control with audit records, encryption, vulnerability and penetration testing, integrity and secure deletion controls, and restriction of unauthorised access.
quote: Las Instituciones en todo momento deberán garantizar la integridad de la información biométrica almacenada o trasmitida
conditional_on: Applies to biometric databases under Art. 51 Bis 2 and 51 Bis 3.

summary: The first capture process of biometric data must be verified annually by the internal control officers (Contraloría Interna) of the institution.
quote: este proceso deberá de ser verificado de manera anual por los responsables de Contraloría Interna de la Institución.

summary: Fingerprint capture requires at least six fingerprints per client, using dual readers for at least two fingers per reading, with minimum image parameters, quality analysis per NFIQ, deduplication against existing records, compression at most WSQ 10:1, and at least three recapture attempts when minimum quality is not met.
quote: Las Instituciones deberán capturar al menos seis huellas dactilares de sus clientes.
conditional_on: Applies to fingerprint capture for client databases.

summary: Facial capture requires a duplicate check against existing records (NIST FRVT 1:N), spoofing detection under ISO/IEC 30107-3 or Face Verification Certification, and image requirements under ISO/IEC 19794-5 and ICAO standards.
provision: Anexo 71, sección II (tabla de primera captura de biometría facial)
quote: Validar que las capturas de los clientes o empleados de la Institución no se encuentren previamente registradas
conditional_on: Applies to facial biometric capture for client databases.

summary: Where clients are permanently unable to provide fingerprints, the institution must capture as many fingerprints as possible and record the annotations in the client file; for such clients it must also use verification procedures under Art. 51 Bis 4 fracciones I, II and V.
provision: Anexo 71, excepción a la captura de huellas dactilares, párrafo segundo
quote: haciendo las anotaciones correspondientes en el expediente
conditional_on: Applies where a client cannot permanently provide fingerprints.

summary: Capture applications, processes, parameters or devices that do not conform to Anexo 71 must be submitted to the Commission for approval under Art. 51 Bis 3.
provision: Anexo 71, excepción a la captura de huellas dactilares, párrafo cuarto
quote: deberán someterlos a la aprobación de la Comisión a la que se refiere el artículo 51 Bis 3
conditional_on: Applies where capture applications or devices do not conform to Anexo 71.

summary: Generation under self-consumption must be carried out by the holder of a valid generation permit.
quote: La generación eléctrica en Autoconsumo debe realizarse por el titular de un permiso de generación vigente

summary: Applicants for interconnected self-consumption permits of 0.7 to 20 MW must follow the simplified procedure of the referenced Acuerdo Primero.
quote: para el cual deben sujetarse a lo establecido en el Acuerdo Primero
conditional_on: Interconnected plants between 0.7 and 20 MW

summary: Applicants for interconnected permits above 20 MW, or isolated plants from 0.7 MW, must request the permit in the authorized format and meet the Disposiciones de Permisos requirements.
quote: deben solicitar el permiso en el formato autorizado y atender a los requisitos establecidos en las Disposiciones de Permisos
conditional_on: Interconnected plants above 20 MW or isolated plants from 0.7 MW

summary: Surplus delivered with consideration must not affect SEN operation, according to the reliability criteria set by CENACE.
quote: Los Excedentes de Autoconsumo entregados con contraprestación no deben afectar la operación del SEN
conditional_on: Surplus delivered with consideration

summary: Where cogeneration produces more than the demand of the users, the holder must comply with the Disposiciones de Permisos.
quote: en este caso debe cumplir con las Disposiciones de Permisos
conditional_on: Self-consumption from a cogeneration system whose generation exceeds maximum demand

summary: A holder of a plant under 0.7 MW that interconnects with the Red Particular must first request a permit modification for capacity increase.
quote: la persona permisionaria debe solicitar a la Comisión la modificación del Permiso de Autoconsumo
conditional_on: Small plants interconnected to the Red Particular

summary: The Red Particular must meet the safety and reliability conditions of applicable rules and the Código de Red; the holder must obtain rights of way or free-access agreements where it crosses private property.
quote: Para la instalación de la Red Particular se debe cumplir con las condiciones de seguridad y confiabilidad estipuladas en la normativa aplicable

summary: Red Particulares must be independent and linked only to the self-consumption site facilities in the permit.
quote: Las Redes Particulares deben ser independientes y asociadas únicamente a las instalaciones del sitio de Autoconsumo

summary: An isolated self-consumption plant must not be synchronized with the SEN.
quote: Una Central Eléctrica de Autoconsumo aislado no debe estar sincronizada con el SEN
conditional_on: Isolated self-consumption

summary: Consumption centres that do not meet their needs through the plant must carry out the studies and works and sign the connection contract for the demand to be connected.
quote: Realizar los Estudios y las obras necesarias, así como celebrar el contrato de conexión para la demanda que se desea conectar
conditional_on: Isolated self-consumption; consumption centres that choose to connect to RNT or RGD

summary: The holder must update the Registro de Autoconsumo in the following period and submit evidence of the actions taken.
quote: se debe actualizar el Registro de Autoconsumo en el periodo posterior correspondiente
conditional_on: Consumption centres connecting to the RNT or RGD in isolated self-consumption

summary: Users of micro-grids must be registered by the permit holder in the Registro de Autoconsumo, under the procedures set by the Comisión.
quote: Las usuarias de micro-redes deben ser inscritos por la persona permisionaria en el Registro de Autoconsumo
conditional_on: Small electrical systems in micro-grid regime

summary: The community representative must register the community micro-grid with the Comisión, attaching the required documents.
quote: El representante comunitario debe realizar ante la Comisión el Registro de Autoconsumo
conditional_on: Community micro-grid scheme

summary: Community micro-grids in isolated self-consumption operate separately from the SEN and must not interconnect to the RNT or RGD.
quote: no puede interconectarse a la RNT ni a las RGD
conditional_on: Community micro-grid scheme with capacity from 0.7 to 5 MW

summary: Costs of the community micro-grid must be shared among beneficiaries under a prior community agreement.
quote: deben ser socializados entre los beneficiarios previo acuerdo comunitario
conditional_on: Community micro-grid scheme

summary: Contribution agreements in the community scheme must be clear, accessible and understandable, with translations or assisted readings where needed.
quote: Los convenios de aportación deben ser claros, accesibles y comprensibles
conditional_on: Community micro-grid scheme

summary: For interconnected self-consumption, the holder must submit the interconnection or connection request, undergo the studies and sign the interconnection-connection contract.
quote: debe firmar el contrato de interconexión-conexión correspondiente
conditional_on: Interconnected self-consumption

summary: Without surplus sale, the holder must install reverse power or low-consumption protection to prevent injection of surplus.
quote: El titular del permiso debe instalar un dispositivo de protección inversa de potencia o bajo consumo para evitar inyección de Excedentes de Autoconsumo.
conditional_on: Interconnected self-consumption without sale of surplus

summary: Without surplus sale, the holder must submit to CENACE the letter waiving surplus sale by its MEM market participant at registration of physical assets.
quote: debe presentar al CENACE la carta de renuncia de venta de excedentes
conditional_on: Interconnected self-consumption without sale of surplus

summary: Registration and representation in the MEM is required for purchasing Faltantes de Autoconsumo.
quote: Se requiere de registro y representación en el MEM para la compra de Faltantes de Autoconsumo.
conditional_on: Interconnected self-consumption without sale of surplus

summary: The MEM representative must register and keep updated the reference parameters of the plant for CEL and surplus offers in the short-term market; consumption centres must register for purchases and sales.
quote: el representante en el MEM debe registrar y mantener actualizados los parámetros de referencia de la Central Eléctrica de Autoconsumo
conditional_on: Interconnected self-consumption with sale of surplus

summary: CENACE must carry out the studies for the listed operating scenarios, both with and without surplus sale, and take the MIC into account for fees and timing.
quote: El CENACE debe realizar los Estudios para los siguientes escenarios
conditional_on: Interconnected self-consumption

summary: CENACE must assess the Capacidad Neta del Punto de Interconexión as the maximum volume of surplus injection into the SEN.
quote: el CENACE debe evaluar como volumen máximo de inyección de Excedentes de Autoconsumo al SEN la Capacidad Neta del Punto de Interconexión
conditional_on: Interconnected self-consumption

summary: Surplus storage in a SAE must be registered and any change updated as an infrastructure change in the Registro de Autoconsumo.
quote: lo cual debe registrarse y en caso de cambios actualizarse como cambio de infraestructura en su Registro de Autoconsumo
conditional_on: Surplus stored through a SAE

summary: An intermittent generating plant must have backup service for ramp, intermittency and variability management, through a SAE or a contracted service.
quote: Cuando la generación de la Central Eléctrica de Autoconsumo sea intermitente, debe contar con un servicio de respaldo
conditional_on: Intermittent generation in interconnected self-consumption

summary: For sale of surplus, the holder must sign a surplus sale and associated products contract following the Anexo 1 model.
quote: el titular del permiso debe suscribir un contrato de venta de Excedentes de Autoconsumo y Productos Asociados (Anexo 1)
conditional_on: Sale of surplus in interconnected self-consumption

summary: Consumption centres connecting directly to the RNT or RGD must carry out studies, necessary works and a connection contract, and implement measurement and communication infrastructure.
quote: Realizar los Estudios, obras necesarias y celebrar el contrato de conexión para la demanda que se desea conectar
conditional_on: Interconnected self-consumption; consumption centres that choose a direct connection

summary: After a direct connection by consumption centres, the holder must update the Registro de Autoconsumo and submit evidence of compliance.
quote: el titular del permiso debe actualizar su Registro de Autoconsumo y presentar las evidencias
conditional_on: Interconnected self-consumption; consumption centres with direct connection

summary: Each Red Particular may have only one active interconnection point to the RNT or RGD, which must be made exclusively in national territory.
quote: Cada Red Particular sólo puede tener un punto de interconexión activo a la RNT o a las RGD
conditional_on: Interconnected self-consumption

summary: The Grupo de Autoconsumo must comply with the POC and with the MTIC at the interconnection point.
quote: El Grupo de Autoconsumo debe dar cumplimiento a lo establecido en el POC
conditional_on: Interconnected self-consumption

summary: Power credited as an associated product must be transferred exclusively to the Empresa Pública del Estado, or waived under the sale contract.
quote: la cual se debe transferir exclusivamente a favor de la Empresa Pública del Estado
conditional_on: Interconnected self-consumption crediting Potencia

summary: The electricity service to self-consumption users must be defined by a contract with listed minimum elements (a to n), including tariffs of penalties, notifications and termination causes.
quote: debe definirse mediante un contrato para la prestación del servicio de producción y aprovechamiento de energía eléctrica
conditional_on: Users other than the sole self-consumption user

summary: Modifications of demand, installations, contracts or exclusion of users must be notified to the Comisión through the OPE with the registry update form.
quote: debe notificarse a la Comisión mediante la OPE con el formato de Actualización del Registro de Autoconsumo
conditional_on: Changes in demand, installations, contracts or exclusion of users

summary: In every case of interconnected operation, studies and the interconnection-connection contract are required.
quote: En cualquiera de los casos antes mencionados se requiere de los Estudios y la celebración del contrato de interconexión-conexión correspondiente
conditional_on: Interconnected self-consumption operating with the SEN

summary: Injection of surplus and demand for Faltantes must be carried out through a single MEM representation; users are represented only in grouped form.
quote: debe realizar sus operaciones de inyección de Excedentes de Autoconsumo y demanda de Faltantes de Autoconsumo a través de una sola representación en el MEM

summary: The MEM market participant representing surplus sales must submit sale offers to the Mercado de Energía de Corto Plazo equivalent to the surplus that can be injected.
quote: debe presentar ofertas de venta al Mercado de Energía de Corto Plazo equivalente a la energía excedente
conditional_on: Sale of surplus

summary: The market participant representing the permit holder must enter into bilateral financial transactions with the Empresa Pública del Estado to transfer financial responsibility for 100% of the energy.
quote: debe realizar transacciones bilaterales financieras con la Empresa Pública del Estado
conditional_on: Sale of surplus

summary: A measurement system at the interconnection-connection point that complies with applicable rules must be in place for MEM settlement.
quote: se debe contar con un Sistema de Medición en el punto de interconexión-conexión que cumpla con la normatividad aplicable
conditional_on: Energy transactions in the MEM

summary: The holder must submit the registry update format and supporting documents to the Comisión at least 3 months before commissioning tests, including authorization for use of property, the surplus sale contract and a layout plan.
applies_from: At least 3 months before the start of commissioning tests
quote: el titular del permiso de generación debe presentar a la Comisión, el formato de Actualización del Registro de Autoconsumo
conditional_on: Permit granted; Programa de Obras

summary: The holder must submit documentation of compliance with applicable norms NOM-001-SEDE-2012 (including a technical report on the Red Particular) and NOM-029-STPS-2011.
quote: Documentación que acredite el cumplimiento de la normatividad vigente aplicable
conditional_on: Registry update submission

summary: The registry must be updated within 15 business days after any change, and in any case by 31 March each year, using the Anexo 2 format.
applies_from: 15 días hábiles posteriores a la modificación; a más tardar el 31 de marzo de cada año
quote: el registro debe ser actualizado cuando exista una modificación en un plazo máximo de 15 días hábiles
conditional_on: Any modification in the registry

summary: The Comisión must notify prevention within 15 business days of receipt of the registry update and must resolve on the update within 90 calendar days of receipt.
quote: La Comisión dispone de 90 días naturales contados a partir de la recepción del formato antes mencionado para resolver sobre la actualización del registro
conditional_on: Receipt of a registry update format

summary: The registry or modification must include users, changes in demand, installation modifications, exclusions of users and any waiver of consideration.
quote: El Registro de Autoconsumo o bien la modificación correspondiente debe incluir la siguiente información

summary: Permit holders under the former Abasto Aislado scheme may keep operating unchanged, but must obtain a self-consumption permit if capacity or connected load changes.
quote: En caso contrario debe obtener un permiso de Autoconsumo conforme a las disposiciones aplicables
conditional_on: Changes to the capacity of the plant or the demand of the associated load centres

summary: Pending updated market rules, surplus injected into the SEN must be represented in the MEM by a Generadora market participant, and shortfall demand by a suministradora or a Usuario Calificado Participante del Mercado.
quote: debe ser representada en el MEM a través de una Participante del Mercado en modalidad de Generadora
conditional_on: Until the Reglas del Mercado include a single representation figure

summary: Until the Comisión issues a single interconnection-connection contract model, the holder must formalize an interconnection contract and a connection contract.
quote: el titular del permiso de autoconsumo debe formalizar un contrato de interconexión y un contrato de conexión
conditional_on: Until the Comisión issues the single interconnection-connection contract model

summary: The Comisión has 180 calendar days to publish in the DOF the terms for operation of the Registro de Autoconsumo through the OPE.
quote: Para este fin la Comisión cuenta con 180 días naturales para su publicación en el DOF

summary: Until the MEM models can process offers under item 6.4 I, market participants representing the holder must submit fixed-programme offers to CENACE for the surplus.
quote: los Participantes del Mercado que representen a la persona permisionaria deben presentar al CENACE ofertas de programa fijo
conditional_on: Until the functionalities are enabled in the Mercado de Energía de Corto Plazo models

summary: Under the model surplus sale contract, the permit holder must notify the Suministradora and its MEM representatives electronically at least 72 hours before presenting offers to the MEM.
applies_from: At least 72 hours before presenting offers to the MEM
quote: con al menos 72 horas de anticipación a la presentación de ofertas al MEM, debe notificar a la Suministradora
conditional_on: Model contract Anexo 1

summary: The Suministradora must publish the levelized cost figures on its website by the last day of January each year, after Comisión validation.
applies_from: A más tardar el último día de enero de cada año
quote: La Suministradora debe publicar en su portal electrónico a más tardar el último día de enero de cada año los costos nivelados
conditional_on: Model contract Anexo 1

summary: The Suministradora must pay the Permisionaria the charges resulting from surplus and associated products injected, under the payment clause.
quote: La Suministradora debe pagar a la Permisionaria los cargos que resulten por los Excedentes de Autoconsumo inyectados
conditional_on: Model contract Anexo 1; no waiver of consideration by the Permisionaria

summary: The Permisionaria must cover the cost of the measurement system for MEM settlement under the model surplus sale contract.
quote: la Permisionaria debe cubrir el costo del Sistema de Medición
conditional_on: Model contract Anexo 1

summary: A community scheme must form a Grupo de Autoconsumo and have at least one normative instrument setting operating rules, cost contributions and dispute mechanisms.
provision: Anexo 2, Sección II, numeral 4 (datos de acreditación, micro-red comunitaria)
quote: La comunidad debe integrar un Grupo de Autoconsumo y debe contar con al menos un instrumento normativo
conditional_on: Community micro-grid scheme

summary: The applicant declares under oath that it knows the applicable regulatory framework and undertakes to comply with it.
provision: Anexo 2, Manifestaciones de la persona permisionaria, numeral 4
quote: Tiene conocimiento del marco regulatorio aplicable a la actividad a desarrollar, y se compromete a cumplirlo
conditional_on: Registry update form, manifestations of the permit holder

summary: The State guarantees access to information and communication technologies, broadband and Internet; the executive agency for telecommunications policy must establish conditions of effective competition in these services.
quote: El Estado garantizará el derecho de acceso a las tecnologías de la información y comunicación

summary: Obligated subjects (sujetos obligados) must have sufficient powers to attend to personal data protection (Apartado A, fracción II) and must establish mechanisms of access to public information and expedited review procedures (fracción IV).
provision: Art. 6o. Apartado A, fracciones II y IV
quote: Se establecerán mecanismos de acceso a la información pública y procedimientos de revisión expeditos

summary: Obligated subjects must promote, respect, protect and guarantee the rights of access to public information and to personal data protection; the state laws set the bases and procedures for these rights.
provision: Art. 6o. Apartado A, fracción VIII, párrafo primero
quote: Los sujetos obligados deberán promover, respetar, proteger y garantizar los derechos de acceso a la información pública y a la protección de datos personales.

summary: The body of Art. 26 Apartado B (the national statistical and geographical information system's autonomous body) is also put in charge of measuring poverty and evaluating social development policy programmes, objectives, goals and actions, and of issuing recommendations as the law provides.
quote: El organismo también estará a cargo de la medición de la pobreza y la evaluación de los programas

summary: The executive, through the competition authority, must prevent, investigate and combat monopolies, monopolistic practices, concentrations and other restrictions on efficient markets.
quote: El Ejecutivo Federal, a través de la autoridad en materia de libre competencia y concurrencia deberá prevenir, investigar y combatir los monopolios

summary: The executive, through the telecommunications policy agency, must guarantee efficient development of broadcasting and telecommunications and take charge of regulation, promotion and supervision of spectrum, networks and services, and of access to infrastructure and essential inputs.
quote: garantizará el desarrollo eficiente de la radiodifusión y las telecomunicaciones

summary: The executive must set the amount of consideration (contraprestaciones) for granting concessions and for authorising related services; concessions are granted by public tender except public and social uses; a public concession registry and a national infrastructure information system are to be maintained.
provision: Art. 28, párrafos décimo quinto y siguientes
quote: El Ejecutivo Federal fijará el monto de las contraprestaciones por el otorgamiento de las concesiones

summary: The executive must issue general administrative provisions to regulate telecommunications and broadcasting, as well as economic competition.
quote: El Ejecutivo Federal proveerá en la esfera administrativa las disposiciones de carácter general

summary: The Chamber of Deputies must issue the agreement for election of the Presidential Counsellor and electoral counsellors, containing the public call, stages, deadlines and the process for an evaluation committee.
provision: Art. 41 fracción V, Apartado A, inciso a)
quote: La Cámara de Diputados emitirá el acuerdo para la elección del consejero Presidente

summary: State constitutions, in terms of the general law, must define the competence of the comptroller bodies and other obligated subjects responsible for access to public information and personal data protection.
quote: Las Constituciones de los Estados en términos de la ley general, definirán la competencia de los órganos encargados de la contraloría

summary: The federal decentralised body must hear matters on public information access by trade unions and review appeals filed by individuals against union decisions.
provision: Art. 123 Apartado A, fracción XX, párrafo quinto
quote: El organismo descentralizado federal también tendrá competencia para conocer de los asuntos relacionados con el acceso a la información pública de los sindicatos

summary: The Federal Conciliation and Arbitration Tribunal must hear matters on public information access by unions of state workers and review appeals against union decisions.
provision: Art. 123 Apartado B, fracción XII, párrafo primero
quote: conocerá de los asuntos relacionados con el acceso a la información pública de los sindicatos de los trabajadores al servicio del Estado

summary: Public entities must adjust their organic and occupational structures on principles of rationality and republican austerity, eliminating functional or organisational duplicities.
quote: Los entes públicos ajustarán sus estructuras orgánicas y ocupacionales

summary: The Congress of the Union must make the necessary legislative adjustments to implement the Decree, including eliminating duplicated bodies and integrating decentralised and deconcentrated bodies into the centralised administration.
applies_from: 90 días naturales a partir de la entrada en vigor del presente Decreto
quote: El Congreso de la Unión tendrá un plazo de noventa días naturales a partir de la entrada en vigor del presente Decreto para realizar las adecuaciones necesarias

summary: The Federal Executive must issue the corresponding extinction decrees to comply with Article 134, third paragraph.
quote: El Ejecutivo Federal deberá emitir los decretos de extinción correspondientes

summary: Savings and economies generated by the extinction of the public entities are to be allocated to the Fondo de Pensiones para el Bienestar.
quote: Las economías y ahorros que se generen con la extinción de los entes públicos materia del presente Decreto se destinarán al Fondo de Pensiones para el Bienestar

summary: State legislatures must harmonise their legal frameworks on public information access and personal data protection with the Decree.
applies_from: 90 días naturales contados a partir de la expedición de la legislación a la que alude el artículo Segundo transitorio
quote: Las Legislaturas de las entidades federativas, en el ámbito de su competencia, tendrán el plazo máximo de noventa días naturales
conditional_on: issuance of the legislation referred to in Transitorio Segundo

summary: The Congress of the Union must issue secondary laws on competition and free concurrence, and on telecommunications and broadcasting, to exercise the powers of Article 28.
quote: El Congreso de la Unión expedirá las leyes secundarias en materia de competencia y libre concurrencia

summary: The competition authority must have legal personality and its own assets, technical and operational independence, and separation between the authority that investigates and the one that decides procedures.
quote: se garantizará la separación entre la autoridad que investiga y la que resuelve los procedimientos

summary: Concessionaires must comply with the obligations and consideration payments that the Federal Executive imposes on them in exercise of its powers, without prejudice to the validity of the licences previously granted by the Federal Telecommunications Institute.
quote: los concesionarios deban cumplir con las obligaciones y contraprestaciones que en su caso les imponga el Ejecutivo Federal
conditional_on: as imposed by the Federal Executive in exercise of its powers

summary: Labour rights of public servants of the extinguished entities must be respected in full, and their human resources transfer to the bodies that assume their functions where applicable.
quote: Los derechos laborales de las personas servidoras públicas serán respetados en su totalidad

summary: Mobile service providers must enable and keep the service enabled only for lines linked to a Titular.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Habilitar y mantener habilitado el Servicio de Telefonía Móvil, únicamente para las Líneas Telefónicas Móviles vinculadas a un Titular

summary: Providers must enable the management and consultation platforms under these Lineamientos; also advise users via the customer service system (fr. III) and allow free platform access (fr. V).
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Habilitar las Plataformas de Gestión y Consulta de Líneas Telefónicas Móviles, conforme a las características establecidas en los presentes Lineamientos

summary: Providers must not charge users for linking, unlinking or consulting mobile lines.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Abstenerse de realizar cobros a los Titulares y/o Usuarios por la Vinculación, Desvinculación o Consulta de Líneas Telefónicas Móviles

summary: Providers must clearly and promptly publish linking and unlinking requirements on websites and in service centres, and notify users when linking or unlinking concludes (fr. VII, X).
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Difundir de manera clara, accesible y oportuna, a través de páginas o sitios de Internet, así como en sus centros de atención, los requisitos y modalidades

summary: Providers must immediately notify the Comisión, competent authorities, Titulares and Usuarios of any information security incident or personal data breach.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Dar aviso de forma inmediata a la Comisión, a las autoridades competentes, a los Titulares y a los Usuarios, de cualquier incidente de seguridad de la información o vulneración de datos personales

summary: Providers must validate the identity of persons before linking and unlinking lines.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Validar la identidad de las personas previo a la Vinculación y Desvinculación de Líneas Telefónicas Móviles

summary: For linking, providers may keep only the listed data (name or company name, CURP or RFC, phone number, ID type, validation result and source, folio), without prejudice to other records.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: resguardar únicamente los siguientes datos de los Titulares y/o Usuarios

summary: Providers are responsible for protecting users' personal data and complying with the federal personal data protection law.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Ser los responsables de la protección de los datos personales de los Titulares y/o Usuarios

summary: Providers must assist, on request, persons with disabilities or belonging to indigenous, Afro-Mexican and other vulnerable groups to link and unlink lines.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Asistir, cuando así lo soliciten, a las personas con alguna discapacidad, o que pertenezcan a pueblos y comunidades indígenas, afromexicanas

summary: Providers must enable the Plataforma de Gestión and the Plataforma de Consulta.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Los Proveedores del Servicio de Telefonía Móvil deberán habilitar las siguientes soluciones tecnológicas

summary: Wholesale mobile concessionaires offering the platforms to resellers must comply with listed Art. 7 duties (fracciones I, II, V, VI, XI and XII) and include personal data protection measures in their contracts.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: deberán observar lo establecido en las fracciones I, II, V, VI, XI y XII del artículo 7 de los presentes Lineamientos
conditional_on: If they offer the platforms as an additional service to Comercializadoras

summary: Providers must limit the number of mobile lines that natural persons may link, permitting up to ten lines; not applicable to legal persons or natural persons with business activity.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: limitarán el número máximo de Líneas Telefónicas Móviles que pueden ser Vinculadas por personas físicas

summary: For natural persons with business activity, providers must require a tax situation certificate to establish that status.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: el Proveedor del Servicio de Telefonía Móvil requerirá la constancia de situación fiscal
conditional_on: Natural persons with business activity

summary: In emergencies or disasters, providers must enable new lines in the affected zone without linking; such lines are disabled after the period set (fifteen days or as the Comisión determines).
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: habilitarán, sin necesidad de Vinculación, las Líneas Telefónicas Móviles nuevas que se ubiquen en la zona afectada
conditional_on: Emergency or disaster communicated by the competent authority, or determined by the Comisión

summary: To enable contracted services, a SIM must be linked to a Titular; the first paragraph restricts what an unlinked SIM sold through any channel may do.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Para habilitar los servicios contratados, se deberá realizar el proceso de Vinculación con un Titular.

summary: Providers must enable in-person and remote means for Titulares and Usuarios to link lines.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: deberán habilitar medios presenciales y remotos para que los Titulares y/o Usuarios puedan realizar la Vinculación de las Líneas Telefónicas Móviles

summary: Every mobile line must be linked to a Titular; one additional Usuario may be linked to the same line.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Toda Línea Telefónica Móvil deberá estar vinculada a un Titular.

summary: After a portability, receiving providers must request linking from their Titulares.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: los Proveedores del Servicio de Telefonía Móvil receptores de la Línea Telefónica Móvil solicitarán a sus Titulares la Vinculación
conditional_on: Following execution of portability

summary: Linking of any line must include identity validation, in person or remotely; for public bodies and legal persons, linking is in person only.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: El proceso de Vinculación para cualquier Línea Telefónica Móvil deberá incluir mecanismos para la Validación de Identidad

summary: For natural persons, a valid Identificación Oficial is required and providers must validate the holder's data against trusted sources held by competent authorities.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Los datos de la persona titular de la Identificación Oficial serán validados por los Proveedores del Servicio de Telefonía Móvil

summary: For linking natural persons, providers register only name, CURP, phone number, source consulted and validation result.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: únicamente registrarán el nombre, la CURP, el número telefónico asociado, la fuente de confianza consultada y el resultado de la Validación de Identidad

summary: Legal representatives of legal persons must present the company name and RFC document, a valid Identificación Oficial, and proof of representative authority.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Para la Validación de Identidad de las personas representantes legales de las personas morales, se deberá presentar
conditional_on: Linking of lines for legal persons

summary: For linking lines of legal persons, providers register only name or company name, RFC, phone number, source consulted and validation result.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)

summary: For linking lines of public entities, providers register only name or company name, RFC, phone number, source consulted and validation result.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: únicamente registrarán el nombre o razón social, el RFC, el número telefónico asociado
conditional_on: Linking of lines for Entes Públicos

summary: Foreign natural persons must present a passport or a temporary CURP.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Para la Validación de Identidad de personas físicas de nacionalidad extranjera, se deberá presentar

quote: únicamente registrarán nombre, país de origen, número de pasaporte o, en su caso, CURP temporal para extranjeros
conditional_on: Foreign nationals linking lines

applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)

conditional_on: In-person linking
