quote: El Proveedor del Servicio de Telefonía Móvil será responsable de realizar el proceso de Validación de Identidad
conditional_on: In-person linking

summary: In in-person linking, providers must show the privacy notice; they must also request ID, validate the CURP with the RNP, and inform the result.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Mostrar el Aviso de Privacidad conforme a lo previsto en la Ley Federal de Protección de Datos Personales en Posesión de los Particulares
conditional_on: In-person linking

summary: In in-person linking, providers must validate the CURP with the Registro Nacional de Población.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Validar la CURP con el Registro Nacional de Población
conditional_on: In-person linking

summary: In in-person linking, a different linking process may not begin until the current one is fully concluded.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: no se podrá comenzar uno diverso, hasta que el primero de ellos se haya concluido totalmente
conditional_on: In-person linking

summary: For remote linking, providers send an SMS to the Titular or Usuario with access information and use the operator's SMS Sender ID.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: enviarán un SMS al Titular y/o Usuario, con la información para acceder a la Plataforma de Gestión de Líneas Telefónicas Móviles
conditional_on: Remote linking

summary: In remote linking, the platform must show the privacy notice; the other steps are ID capture, Prueba de Vida, CURP validation and up to three attempts.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Mostrar el Aviso de Privacidad conforme a la Ley Federal de Protección de Datos Personales en Posesión de los Particulares
conditional_on: Remote linking

summary: In remote linking, the platform must request a Prueba de Vida; also ID capture and CURP validation.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Solicitar una Prueba de Vida del Titular y/o Usuario
conditional_on: Remote linking

summary: Remote linking allows up to three attempts per line; after rejection the user is notified and invited to contact the service centre.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Permitir hasta tres intentos para realizar la Vinculación de una misma Línea Telefónica Móvil
conditional_on: Remote linking

summary: Providers must unlink lines in the cases listed: at the Titular's express request (immediately), upon portability once executed, or on termination of the contract.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Los Proveedores del Servicio de Telefonía Móvil Desvincularán las Líneas Telefónicas Móviles en los siguientes casos
conditional_on: Cases listed in fracciones I to III

summary: For in-person unlinking, the Titular or Usuario must go to a service centre and present an Identificación Oficial.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: el Titular y/o Usuario deberá acudir al centro de atención del Proveedor del Servicio de Telefonía Móvil y presentar su Identificación Oficial
conditional_on: In-person unlinking

summary: For in-person unlinking, providers must show the privacy notice, and notify the Titular by SMS when the Usuario requests unlinking.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Mostrar el Aviso de Privacidad, conforme a la Ley Federal de Protección de Datos Personales en Posesión de los Particulares
conditional_on: In-person unlinking

summary: For in-person unlinking, providers must generate a unique folio for each unlinking, including date and time.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Generar un folio identificador único para cada Desvinculación, que incluya fecha y hora en la que se realizó
conditional_on: In-person unlinking

summary: For remote unlinking, providers must show the privacy notice and, on success, notify the Titular and Usuario that unlinking is complete.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Mostrar el Aviso de Privacidad, conforme a la Ley Federal de Protección de Datos Personales en Posesión de los Particulares
conditional_on: Remote unlinking

summary: For remote unlinking, providers must validate identity by the enabled mechanisms and request a Prueba de Vida.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Solicitar una Prueba de Vida del Titular o Usuario
conditional_on: Remote unlinking

summary: For remote unlinking, up to three attempts are allowed per line; after rejection the user is notified and invited to contact the service centre.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Permitir hasta tres intentos para realizar la Desvinculación de una misma Línea Telefónica Móvil
conditional_on: Remote unlinking

summary: For remote unlinking, providers must generate a unique folio for each unlinking, including date and time.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Generar un folio con identificador único para cada Desvinculación, que incluya fecha y hora en la que se realizó
conditional_on: Remote unlinking

summary: When the Titular unlinks a line, providers must immediately disable the contracted services.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Cuando sea el Titular el que realice la Desvinculación, se deberán Deshabilitar de forma inmediata los servicios contratados
conditional_on: Unlinking by the Titular

summary: Management platforms may be administered and operated only by mobile service providers.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Las Plataformas de Gestión de Líneas Telefónicas Móviles únicamente serán administradas y operadas por los Proveedores del Servicio de Telefonía Móvil

summary: Management platforms must not store biometric data, photographs or copies of the Identificación Oficial.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: No almacenar ningún dato biométrico, fotografía, ni copia de Identificación Oficial

summary: Management platforms must keep the name or company name, CURP or RFC, phone number, ID type, folio, and validation result and source; they must also generate a folio for each linking and unlinking.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Resguardar el nombre o razón social, la CURP o RFC, el número telefónico asociado, tipo de Identificación Oficial, folio

summary: Management platforms must have information security measures guaranteeing integrity, authenticity, confidentiality and availability, and backup and recovery protocols.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Contar con los mecanismos y medidas de seguridad de la información que garanticen su integridad, autenticidad, confidencialidad y disponibilidad

summary: Management platforms must send notifications by SMS, and by the channels of Art. 23, on the results of linking and unlinking; they must also show the privacy notice and terms.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Enviar notificaciones al Titular y/o Usuario por SMS

summary: When the management platform is unavailable, providers must have temporary alternative mechanisms for linking and unlinking.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: los Proveedores del Servicio de Telefonía Móvil deberán contar con mecanismos alternativos temporales
conditional_on: Platform unavailability

summary: Consultation platforms must not store personal data and may show only the last four digits of linked lines.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: no almacenarán datos personales, y únicamente permitirán visualizar los últimos cuatro dígitos

summary: Consultation platforms must allow lookup of lines by CURP or RFC, show the link to the management platform, and include accessibility features.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Permitir mediante el uso de la CURP o RFC, la consulta de Líneas Telefónicas Móviles Vinculadas a un Titular y/o Usuario

summary: Consultation platforms must list lines showing only the last four digits and the provider's trade name.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Listar las Líneas Telefónicas Móviles asociadas a una CURP o RFC, mostrando únicamente los últimos 4 dígitos

summary: Consultation platforms must have information security measures guaranteeing integrity, authenticity, confidentiality and availability.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Contar con los mecanismos y medidas de seguridad de la información que garanticen su integridad, autenticidad, confidencialidad, disponibilidad

summary: Providers must enable access to the consultation platform through secure means such as the official web portal or official mobile apps.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: deberán habilitar el acceso a la Plataforma de Consulta de Líneas Telefónicas Móviles a través de medios seguros

summary: Providers must notify the Comisión of platform failures lasting more than three hours within twelve hours, using the Anexo A format.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: deberán dar aviso a la Comisión, en un plazo no mayor a doce horas, remitiendo el formato establecido en el Anexo A
conditional_on: Failures from fortuitous events or force majeure persisting for more than three hours

summary: Providers must inform users of platform failures through the platform access page from the start of the failure until resolved.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: deberán informar a través de la página de ingreso a las Plataformas, las fallas a que se refiere el párrafo que antecede
conditional_on: Platform failures

summary: Scheduled maintenance or update windows must be announced 24 hours in advance on the provider's websites, with start and end times.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Las ventanas programadas deberán ser comunicadas con 24 horas de anticipación a través de sus sitios de internet
conditional_on: Scheduled windows

summary: Maintenance windows must be scheduled at times that minimize impact on Titulares or Usuarios.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Dichas ventanas deberán realizarse en horarios que minimicen el impacto a los Titulares o Usuarios
conditional_on: Scheduled windows

summary: Providers must protect personal data of Titulares and Usuarios under the federal personal data law and maintain administrative, technical and physical security measures against unauthorized access, loss or alteration.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: deberán establecer y mantener medidas de seguridad administrativas, técnicas y físicas

summary: Providers must inform Titulares and Usuarios about the use, processing and protection of their personal data.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: informarán a los Titulares y Usuarios sobre el uso, tratamiento y protección de sus datos personales

summary: Information collected for linking and unlinking is confidential and may not be commercialized, disclosed, shared or used for other purposes, nor copied.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: Los Proveedores del Servicio de Telefonía Móvil no podrán comercializar, divulgar, compartir y/o utilizar dicha información para fines distintos

summary: Providers may not retain any biometric data, photograph, copy of the Identificación Oficial, or other document of Titulares or Usuarios.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: En ningún caso los Proveedores de Servicio Móvil conservarán ningún dato biométrico, fotografía, copia de Identificación Oficial

summary: The Comisión executes compliance verification without prior notice to providers.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: será ejecutada por la Comisión sin previo aviso a los Proveedores del Servicio de Telefonía Móvil

summary: The Comisión must prepare and execute a verification programme: determine the number and modality of verification actions per year; each action covers all concessionaires and at least one comercializadora; and test linking and consultation platforms.
applies_from: Desde la entrada en vigor de los Lineamientos (Transitorio Primero)
quote: La Comisión elaborará y ejecutará un programa de verificación conforme a lo siguiente

summary: From the day after entry into force, providers must begin disseminating clear, accessible and timely information on requirements and modalities for linking, unlinking and consulting lines, and on the deadlines for Titulares to link.
applies_from: Al día siguiente de la entrada en vigor (Transitorio Segundo)
quote: todos los Proveedores del Servicio de Telefonía Móvil deberán iniciar con la difusión de información clara, accesible y oportuna

summary: Providers must enable the Plataforma de Gestión within thirty natural days of entry into force and then notify the Comisión by email the platform link.
applies_from: Treinta días naturales después de la entrada en vigor (Transitorio Tercero)
quote: deberán habilitar la Plataforma de Gestión de Líneas Telefónicas Móviles

summary: Providers must enable the Plataforma de Consulta within sixty natural days of entry into force and notify the Comisión by email the platform link.
applies_from: Sesenta días naturales después de la entrada en vigor (Transitorio Cuarto)
quote: deberán habilitar la Plataforma de Consulta de Líneas Telefónicas Móviles

summary: Providers have thirty natural days from entry into force to start linking new lines or lines already enabled.
applies_from: Treinta días naturales después de la entrada en vigor (Transitorio Quinto)
quote: para iniciar la vinculación de las Líneas Telefónicas Móviles nuevas o de aquellas que se encuentren habilitadas

summary: After the thirty-day period, only disabled SIMs may be sold, except SIMs without technical capacity for voice, SMS or internet calls.
applies_from: Al término del plazo de treinta días naturales (Transitorio Quinto)
quote: únicamente se podrán comercializar SIM deshabilitadas

applies_from: 120 días hábiles después del plazo del primer párrafo del Transitorio Tercero (Transitorio Sexto)
quote: deberán Deshabilitar el servicio de toda Línea Telefónica Móvil que no se encuentre Vinculada a un Titular

summary: During the Transitorio Sexto period the Comisión promotes collaboration with the Instituto Nacional de los Pueblos Indígenas to assist indigenous and Afro-Mexican communities with linking and unlinking.
applies_from: Durante el plazo del Transitorio Sexto
quote: la Comisión promoverá la colaboración con el Instituto Nacional de los Pueblos Indígenas

quote: la Comisión Reguladora de Telecomunicaciones definirá los mecanismos necesarios para la Vinculación de las Líneas Telefónicas Móviles que utilicen servicios de Roaming Internacional
conditional_on: Conclusion of the World Cup event

summary: All authorities, within their competence, must promote, respect, protect and guarantee the human right to water.

provision: Ley General de Aguas, Art. 8, párr. 1
quote: Las Normas Oficiales Mexicanas establecerán regulaciones técnicas adecuadas y actualizadas para garantizar el derecho humano al agua

provision: Ley General de Aguas, Art. 9, párr. 1
quote: El Estado mexicano garantizará, de acuerdo con el principio de progresividad, el acceso y uso equitativo y sustentable de las aguas

quote: Los organismos operadores no podrán suspender totalmente el suministro de agua potable y el servicio de saneamiento por falta de pago

summary: The three orders of government and participation bodies must ensure women's substantive participation in water management, gender-based public policies, protection of women's water uses, and water access for girls, adolescents and menstruating persons in schools and homes.

quote: los tres órdenes de gobierno, las instituciones e instancias de participación ciudadana, en ejercicio de sus funciones están obligadas a

summary: The Federation must prepare and implement the National Strategy and the National Hydric Program.
provision: Ley General de Aguas, Art. 25, fr. III
quote: Elaborar e instrumentar la Estrategia Nacional y el Programa Nacional Hídrico en los términos de la presente Ley

summary: The Comisión prepares the National Strategy in collaboration with the Instituto Mexicano de Tecnología del Agua; the Secretaría approves it and it is published in the DOF.
quote: La Estrategia Nacional será elaborada por la Comisión, en colaboración con el Instituto Mexicano de Tecnología del Agua

summary: The Secretaría, with the Comisión and the Instituto Mexicano de Tecnología del Agua, must review the National Strategy at least every ten years.
provision: Ley General de Aguas, Art. 31, párr. final (segundo bloque)
quote: deben revisar la Estrategia Nacional, por lo menos cada diez años

summary: States must promote at all times the installation of rainwater capture systems for domestic use; the same article has states encouraging building codes to require storage capture systems.
provision: Ley General de Aguas, Art. 34, párr. 1
quote: Las entidades federativas promoverán en todo momento la instalación de sistemas de captación pluvial para uso doméstico

summary: Authorities of the three orders of government must promote education on water, its socio-hydrological cycle, women's role, participation and conservation.
quote: promoverán la educación orientada a

summary: Authorities of the three orders of government must provide timely, accessible, complete, free and understandable information needed for participation in water decisions.
quote: proporcionarán de manera oportuna, accesible, completa, gratuita y comprensible, la información necesaria

summary: States must issue provisions determining how the Organismos Operadores de Agua function and promote training of their staff.
provision: Ley General de Aguas, Art. 45, párr. 1
quote: Las entidades federativas expedirán las disposiciones en las que se determine el funcionamiento de los Organismos Operadores de Agua

summary: States must harmonize their legal provisions with the Ley General de Aguas.
applies_from: 180 natural days from entry into force
provision: Ley General de Aguas, Transitorio Segundo
quote: Las entidades federativas deben armonizar sus disposiciones jurídicas con lo dispuesto en la presente Ley, en un plazo que no exceda de ciento ochenta días naturales

summary: Any authorization, permit, concession, assignment or extension granted under the Ley de Aguas Nacionales must prioritize human and domestic water consumption.
provision: Art. Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 4, párr. 2)
quote: debe priorizar el consumo humano y doméstico del agua

summary: Where water availability for human or domestic use is at risk, the Autoridad del Agua, after technical assessment and timely information to users, must reduce or cancel the concessioned volume.
provision: Art. Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 4, párr. 3)
quote: previa valoración técnica e información oportuna a las personas usuarias, disminuirá o cancelará el volumen de agua concesionada
conditional_on: risk of water availability for human or domestic consumption

summary: The Autoridad del Agua must resolve water-title requests expeditiously within the time limits set by the law.
provision: Art. Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 9, fr. XLVIII)
quote: Gestionar y resolver de manera expedita las solicitudes de trámite que le sean presentadas en los plazos establecidos en la presente Ley

summary: The Autoridad del Agua must integrate the national information system on water quantity, quality, uses and conservation, with Organismos de Cuenca participating.
provision: Art. Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 9, fr. XLVII)
quote: Integrar el Sistema Nacional de Información sobre cantidad, calidad, usos y conservación del agua

summary: The Executive must establish measures to maintain adequate water quality for human consumption and thereby protect public health.
provision: Art. Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 14 BIS 5, fr. XIV)
quote: el Ejecutivo Federal establecerá las medidas necesarias para mantener una adecuada calidad del agua para consumo humano

summary: Water users must pay for their use, exploitation or benefit under the user-pays principle, under the Ley Federal de Derechos.
provision: Art. Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 14 BIS 5, fr. XVI)
quote: Las personas usuarias del agua deben pagar por su explotación, uso o aprovechamiento

summary: Water planning must be implemented as ten successive six-year phases, covering population growth, climate change and related factors.
provision: Art. Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 15, párr. 2)
quote: se implementará una planificación y programación hídrica constituida por diez fases sucesivas de seis años

summary: The Comisión must carry out periodic, systematic studies and assessments of the occurrence of water, as responsible body under national security framing.
provision: Art. Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 19 BIS, párr. 1)
quote: de realizar periódica, sistemática y prioritariamente los estudios y evaluaciones necesarias

summary: Concessionaires and assignees must state in their tax returns that their water use is registered in the Registro Público Nacional del Agua.

quote: deberán señalar que su aprovechamiento se encuentra inscrito en el Registro Público Nacional del Agua
conditional_on: groundwater use subject to tax

quote: Nombre, razón social y domicilio de la persona solicitante

summary: The application must state the applicant's full acceptance of the duty to pay tax contributions arising from the title, use and discharge of water, and of the consequences of non-payment.
provision: Art. Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 21, párr. tras fr. IX)
quote: La solicitud especificará la aceptación plena de la persona beneficiaria sobre su obligación de pagar regularmente y en su totalidad las contribuciones fiscales

summary: The applicant must attach the listed documents; incomplete applications may be corrected once, and total absence of documents or failure to respond to a request leads to rejection.
provision: Art. Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 21 BIS, párr. 1)
quote: La persona promovente deberá adjuntar a la solicitud a que se refiere el Artículo anterior, al menos los documentos siguientes

summary: Average annual water availability, on which concessions are granted, must be reviewed at least every two years under the water programming.
provision: Art. Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 22, párr. 1)
quote: que se revisará al menos cada dos años, conforme a la programación hídrica

summary: Rights under concessions and assignments may not be transferred.
provision: Art. Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 22, párr. 2)
quote: Los derechos amparados en las concesiones y asignaciones no serán objeto de transmisión.

summary: The Comisión must publish the availability of national waters by basin, region or locality, within the first three months, at least every two years.
provision: Art. Segundo (reforming Ley de Aguas Nacionales, Art. 22, último párr.)

summary: If measures under Arts. 142 and 143 prove ineffective, the Commission refers the matter to the Agencia so it may order appropriate action under applicable law.
quote: la Comisión dará vista a la Agencia para que esta, en su caso, ordene lo conducente
conditional_on: Measures imposed under Arts. 142 and 143 are not effective

summary: For the first designation of the Investigating Authority, the nominee must not have held a post or represented economic agents subject to earlier proceedings in the three years before appointment (fr. VII of Art. 31).
quote: deberá atenderse en el sentido de que durante los tres años previos a su nombramiento
conditional_on: First designation of the Autoridad Investigadora

summary: The Pleno must adapt its Estatuto Orgánico to the decree within thirty days of entry into force.
applies_from: en un plazo que no excederá de treinta días contados a partir de su entrada en vigor
quote: El Pleno de la Comisión deberá adecuar su Estatuto Orgánico a lo dispuesto en el presente Decreto

summary: The Chamber of Deputies must set up a technical working group within thirty days to analyse and propose adjustments to criminal legislation, and the group must present proposals within sixty days of its installation.
applies_from: dentro de los treinta días siguientes a la entrada en vigor del presente Decreto
quote: la Cámara de Diputados del Congreso de la Unión deberá integrar un grupo de trabajo técnico

summary: The Pleno must publish the Disposiciones Regulatorias under Art. 12 fr. XXII within six months of entry into force.
applies_from: en un plazo no mayor a seis meses a partir de la entrada en vigor del presente Decreto
quote: el Pleno publicará las Disposiciones Regulatorias

summary: The Congreso de la Unión must make the adjustments to the legal framework needed to harmonise it with competition principles in Art. 28 of the Constitution within one year; it may request the Commission opinion.
applies_from: Dentro del plazo de un año contado a partir de la entrada en vigor del presente Decreto
quote: deberá realizar las adecuaciones al marco jurídico

summary: The Chamber of Deputies must start the designation processes for heads of the Internal Control Bodies within 180 days of publication.
applies_from: dentro de los 180 días siguientes a la publicación de este Decreto
quote: iniciará los procesos de designación de los titulares de los Órganos Internos de Control

summary: Governing bodies of constitutionally autonomous organisms that use federal budget resources have 180 days to harmonise their internal rules.
applies_from: a partir de la publicación del presente Decreto
quote: tendrán un plazo de ciento ochenta días, a partir de la publicación del presente Decreto, para armonizar su normatividad interna

summary: The Congreso de la Unión must harmonise its legislation with the decree within 180 days.
applies_from: en un plazo no mayor a ciento ochenta días
quote: deberá armonizar su legislación conforme al presente Decreto

summary: The head of the Fiscalía General de la República must issue its Estatuto orgánico within ninety natural days of entry into force.
applies_from: noventa días naturales siguientes a la entrada en vigor del presente Decreto
quote: contará con un término de noventa días naturales siguientes a la entrada en vigor del presente Decreto, para expedir el Estatuto orgánico

summary: The Oficialía Mayor must set up the designated trust fund within ninety natural days or amend an existing instrument with similar purpose.
quote: contará con el plazo de noventa días naturales para constituir el Fideicomiso

summary: The Oficialía Mayor must issue guidelines for transferring human, material, financial and budgetary resources and settling liabilities of the former Procuraduría General de la República.
quote: emitirá los lineamientos para la transferencia de recursos humanos

summary: The head of the Fiscalía General de la República must issue a Plan Estratégico de Procuración de Justicia within one year and present it to the Senate.
applies_from: un año a partir de la publicación del presente Decreto
quote: contará con un plazo de un año a partir de la publicación del presente Decreto para emitir el Plan Estratégico de Procuración de Justicia

summary: Fiscalía units handling administrative liability procedures must send them to the Internal Control Body within ninety natural days.
quote: tendrán el plazo de noventa días naturales para remitirlos al Órgano Interno de Control

summary: Seized assets held by the former Procuraduría or Fiscalía must be placed at the disposal of the Instituto para Devolver al Pueblo lo Robado under applicable law.
quote: se pondrán a disposición del Instituto para Devolver al Pueblo lo Robado
conditional_on: Assets seized before entry into force that are capable of administration or have a legal destination

summary: The first commissioners of the Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio must be appointed and ratified under Art. 13 Bis; the Executive names the first Presidente within ten natural days; the procedure starts on entry into force.
applies_from: al momento en que entre en vigor el presente Decreto
quote: deberá realizarse en términos del artículo 13 Bis de la Ley Federal de Competencia Económica

summary: The Autoridades Investigadoras must issue, within ten natural days, an agreement identifying the files whose processing is suspended, to be published in the DOF.
applies_from: En un plazo no mayor a diez días naturales a partir de que entre en vigor el presente Decreto
quote: deberán emitir un acuerdo donde identifiquen los expedientes cuya tramitación se suspende

summary: The Comisión Federal de Competencia Económica, the Secretaría de Economía and other federal agencies must start the administrative steps so the Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio is fully functional once its Pleno is seated.
applies_from: A partir de que entre en vigor el presente Decreto
quote: iniciarán los trámites administrativos correspondientes

summary: The Estatuto Orgánico of the Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio and the Reglamento of the LFCE must be issued within 180 natural days after the Pleno is seated.
applies_from: en un plazo no mayor a ciento ochenta días naturales contados a partir del día siguiente a aquel en el que se integre el Pleno de la Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio
quote: se deberán emitir en un plazo no mayor a ciento ochenta días naturales
conditional_on: Pleno of the Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio integrated

summary: The Presidente of the Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio must register it in the Registro Público de Organismos Descentralizados.
applies_from: Una vez que sea designada la Persona Comisionada Presidente
quote: deberá realizar el registro de la Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio en el Registro Público de Organismos Descentralizados
conditional_on: Presidente of the Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio designated

summary: The Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio must have sufficient budget for its mandate; the Cámara de Diputados or the SHCP assigns the budget for 2026 and later years.
applies_from: durante el resto del ejercicio fiscal de 2025
quote: La Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio deberá contar con el presupuesto suficiente

summary: The Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio must guarantee the confidentiality, safekeeping and integrity of the confidential information it receives, kept separately from other bodies.
quote: La Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio garantizará la confidencialidad, resguardo e integridad de la información confidencial que reciba
conditional_on: Receipt of confidential information

summary: Former public servants of the Comisión Federal who held office in the ten natural days before entry into force must deliver an institutional and individual entrega-recepción record; the transitional text also imposes asset and interest declaration duties on departing servants.
quote: deben presentar acta administrativa de entrega-recepción institucional e individual
conditional_on: Former public servant of the Comisión Federal de Competencia Económica within the ten days before entry into force

summary: On integration of the Pleno of the Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio, the Comisión Federal must remit all available budget and financial resources to the Tesorería de la Federación and deliver information needed for the Cuenta Pública to the new body.
applies_from: A la fecha de integración del Pleno de la Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio
quote: deberá enterar la totalidad de los recursos presupuestales y financieros disponibles

summary: The Órgano Interno de Control of the Comisión Federal is extinguished the day after the Pleno is seated; its files are transferred to the Órgano Interno de Control at the Secretaría de Economía.
applies_from: día siguiente a aquel en el que se integre el Pleno de la Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio
quote: serán transferidos al Órgano Interno de Control en la Secretaría de Economía

summary: Administrative heads of the Comisión Federal, the IFT and the Secretaría de Economía must coordinate the transfer of human, material, financial, budgetary and IT resources.
applies_from: A partir de la entrada en vigor del presente Decreto
quote: deberán coordinar el proceso de transferencia de los recursos humanos

summary: With SHCP authorisation, the Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio must set its tariffs or consideration for services within 180 natural days; its own revenues must contribute to its operation and reduce budget needs, and it must request any complementary amount in the budget process.
applies_from: En un plazo no mayor a ciento ochenta días naturales contados a partir del día siguiente a aquel en el que se integre su Pleno
quote: la Comisión Nacional Antimonopolio deberá fijar las tarifas o determinar las contraprestaciones
conditional_on: Previa autorización de la Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público

summary: Controller must observe the principles of lawfulness, purpose, loyalty, consent, quality, proportionality, information and accountability in processing personal data.
quote: El responsable deberá observar los principios de licitud, finalidad, lealtad, consentimiento, calidad, proporcionalidad, información y responsabilidad en el tratamiento de datos personales.

summary: Controller shall not obtain or process personal data by deceptive or fraudulent means; data must be collected and processed lawfully and the reasonable privacy expectation protected.
quote: El responsable no deberá obtener y tratar datos personales a través de medios engañosos o fraudulentos

summary: All processing of personal data requires the data subject's consent, subject to legal exceptions; financial or patrimonial data require express consent; controller must set out in the privacy notice how consent can be revoked.
quote: Todo tratamiento de datos personales estará sujeto al consentimiento de la persona titular, salvo las excepciones previstas por la presente Ley.
conditional_on: Subject to the exceptions provided by this Law (Arts. 9 and 36 for financial data)

summary: For sensitive personal data, controller must obtain express written consent of the data subject, by handwritten or electronic signature or another authentication mechanism.
quote: Tratándose de datos personales sensibles, el responsable deberá obtener el consentimiento expreso y por escrito de la persona titular para su tratamiento
conditional_on: Sensitive personal data

summary: Databases containing sensitive personal data may not be created without justification for legitimate, concrete purposes consistent with the regulated subject's explicit activities.
quote: No podrán crearse bases de datos que contengan datos personales sensibles
conditional_on: Sensitive personal data

summary: Personal data no longer necessary for the stated purposes must be deleted after blocking and the conservation period; data on breach of contractual obligations must be deleted after seventy-two months from the calendar date of the breach.
quote: deberán ser suprimidos previo bloqueo
conditional_on: Data no longer necessary for the purposes in the privacy notice; contractual-breach data after 72 months

summary: Controller must endeavour to keep personal data in databases accurate, complete, correct and up to date for the purposes for which they were collected.
quote: procurará que los datos personales contenidos en las bases de datos sean exactos

summary: Processing must be limited to the purposes in the privacy notice; for a different purpose, controller must obtain consent again from the data subject.
quote: se requerirá obtener nuevamente el consentimiento de la persona titular
conditional_on: Processing for a purpose other than those in the privacy notice

summary: Processing must be necessary, adequate and relevant to the purposes in the privacy notice; for sensitive data, controller must make reasonable efforts to limit the processing period to the minimum indispensable.
quote: el responsable deberá realizar esfuerzos razonables para limitar el periodo de tratamiento de los mismos
conditional_on: Sensitive personal data for the period limit

summary: Controller must adopt the necessary and sufficient measures to apply the data protection principles and to ensure the privacy notice is respected by it and by third parties with which it has a legal relationship.
quote: debiendo adoptar las medidas necesarias y suficientes para su aplicación

summary: Controller must inform the data subject, through the privacy notice, of the existence and main characteristics of the processing of their personal data.
quote: El responsable tendrá la obligación de informar a la persona titular, a través del aviso de privacidad

summary: Privacy notice must contain at least: identity and address of controller; data processed (identifying sensitive data); purposes (distinguishing those requiring consent); options to limit use or disclosure; ARCO mechanisms; and the procedure for notifying changes.
quote: El aviso de privacidad deberá contener, al menos, la siguiente información

summary: Privacy notice must be made available in the form suited to the collection: at the time of collection for printed formats; for electronic collection, a simplified notice with items I to IV of Art. 15 and a link to the full notice.
quote: El responsable debe poner a disposición de las personas titulares el aviso de privacidad

summary: Where data were not obtained directly from the data subject, controller must notify them of the change in the privacy notice; the duty does not apply to historical, statistical or scientific purposes, and compensatory measures are allowed where direct notice is impossible or disproportionate.
quote: el responsable deberá darle a conocer el cambio en el aviso de privacidad
conditional_on: Data not obtained directly from the data subject; excluding historical, statistical or scientific purposes

summary: Controller must establish and maintain administrative, technical and physical security measures to protect personal data against damage, loss, alteration, destruction or unauthorised use, access or processing; minimum level is that used for its own information.
quote: Todo responsable deberá establecer y mantener medidas de seguridad administrativas, técnicas y físicas

summary: Security breaches at any stage of processing that significantly affect the data subject's property or moral rights must be reported to the data subject immediately.
quote: le serán informadas de forma inmediata por el responsable
conditional_on: Breaches that significantly affect patrimonial or moral rights of the data subject

summary: Controller or third party must establish controls or mechanisms so that all persons involved in any stage of processing keep the data confidential, also after their relationship ends.
quote: El responsable o tercero deberá establecer controles o mecanismos

summary: Personal data must be kept so as to allow the ARCO rights to be exercised without delay.
quote: Los datos personales deben ser resguardados de tal manera que permitan el ejercicio sin dilación de estos derechos.

summary: Right of access to personal data held by the controller and to information on the conditions and generalities of processing; corresponding duty to grant access through the privacy notice.
quote: La persona titular tendrá derecho a acceder a sus datos personales que obren en posesión del responsable

summary: Right to rectification or correction of inaccurate, incomplete or outdated data; corresponding duty of the controller to rectify.
quote: La persona titular tendrá derecho a solicitar la rectificación o corrección de sus datos personales

summary: Right to cancellation (blocking, then deletion); after cancellation the controller must notify the data subject, and must notify third parties who still process the transferred data of rectification or cancellation requests.
quote: una vez cancelado el dato se dará aviso a la persona titular

summary: Right to object to processing for legitimate cause, and to object to automated processing producing undesired legal effects or significantly affecting interests, without human intervention; corresponding duty of controller to cease processing.
quote: La persona titular tendrá derecho en todo momento y por causa legítima a oponerse al tratamiento de sus datos
conditional_on: Legitimate cause, or automated processing evaluating personal aspects without human intervention

summary: Controller must promote personal data protection within the organisation and designate a person or department to process ARCO requests.
quote: designará a una persona, o departamento de datos personales

summary: Controller must communicate its decision on an ARCO request within twenty days of receipt and, if appropriate, give effect to it within fifteen days; the periods may be extended once for an equal period.
quote: El responsable comunicará a la persona titular, en un plazo máximo de veinte días

summary: When denying ARCO rights, controller must state the reason for its decision, communicate it by the same means as the request, and attach relevant evidence.
quote: el responsable deberá informar el motivo de su decisión
conditional_on: Cases of denial under Art. 33

summary: Exercise of ARCO rights is free; charges are limited to recovering reproduction, copy or shipping costs; data delivered on the data subject's own medium must be delivered at no cost.
quote: El ejercicio de los derechos ARCO es gratuito, solo podrán realizarse cobros para recuperar los costos de reproducción, copias o envío

summary: Before transferring data to third parties other than processors, controller must communicate to them the privacy notice and purposes; the notice must include a clause on whether the data subject accepts the transfer; the receiving third party assumes the same obligations.
quote: deberá comunicar a éstos el aviso de privacidad y las finalidades a las que la persona titular sujetó su tratamiento
conditional_on: Transfers to third parties other than the processor

summary: Binding self-regulation schemes must be notified simultaneously to the competent authorities and to the Secretaría; schemes must contain mechanisms to measure their effectiveness and corrective measures.
quote: Dichos esquemas serán notificados de manera simultánea a las autoridades correspondientes y a la Secretaría
conditional_on: Self-regulation schemes agreed under Art. 37

summary: The Secretaría must disseminate knowledge of the right to personal data protection, promote its exercise and monitor observance of the Law by regulated subjects.
quote: vigilar por la debida observancia de las disposiciones previstas en la presente Ley

summary: Secretaría must verify compliance with the Law, give administrative interpretation, technical support on request, divulge international security standards, cooperate with other authorities, provide training to obligated subjects, and prepare privacy impact studies before new processing or substantial modifications.
quote: Vigilar y verificar el cumplimiento de las disposiciones contenidas en esta Ley

summary: Secretaría issues criteria and recommendations, in accordance with the applicable provisions of the Law, for its functioning and operation.
quote: Emitir los criterios y recomendaciones

summary: Secretaría has a maximum of fifty days to issue its resolution in a data protection rights procedure, extendable once for an equal period for justified cause.
quote: El plazo máximo para dictar la resolución en el procedimiento de protección de derechos será de cincuenta días

summary: When a rights protection resolution is favourable to the data subject, controller must make the rights effective within ten days of notification (or a longer period set by the resolution) and report compliance in writing to the Secretaría within a further ten days.
quote: se requerirá al responsable para que, en el plazo de diez días siguientes a la notificación
conditional_on: Favourable rights protection resolution

summary: Secretaría must verify compliance with a binding conciliation agreement between data subject and controller.
quote: la Secretaría verificará el cumplimiento del acuerdo respectivo
conditional_on: Conciliation agreement reached

summary: After the Secretaría gives notice of a missing response to an ARCO request, controller must respond within ten days or prove timely response; if the resolution finds the request valid, controller must comply at no cost to the data subject and bear reproduction and shipping costs.
quote: el responsable procederá a su cumplimiento, sin costo alguno para la persona titular
conditional_on: Failure to respond to an ARCO request

summary: Secretaría's resolutions may be published in public versions, removing references that identify or make identifiable the data subject.
quote: eliminando aquellas referencias a la persona titular de los datos que lo identifiquen

summary: Secretaría verifies compliance with the Law and the regulations derived from it, ex officio or at the request of a party.
quote: La Secretaría verificará el cumplimiento de la presente Ley

summary: Public servants participating in verification must keep confidential the information they learn from it.
quote: Las personas servidoras públicas estarán obligadas a guardar confidencialidad

summary: Transitional: the CFCE and the IFT must make available to the public and update the information referred to in Art. 72 of the General Transparency Law, once they are extinguished.
applies_from: When the Comisión Federal de Competencia Económica and the Instituto Federal de Telecomunicaciones are extinguished under the cited decree
quote: deberán poner a disposición del público y actualizar la información

summary: Transitional: INAI must transfer resources corresponding to its staff inventory or positions to the Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público.
applies_from: Within twenty business days after entry into force of the Decree
quote: transferirá los recursos correspondientes al valor del inventario o plantilla de plazas a la Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público

summary: Transitional: INAI's material resources must be transferred to the Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno.
applies_from: Within twenty business days after entry into force of the Decree
quote: serán transferidos a la Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno, dentro de los veinte días hábiles siguientes

summary: Transitional: INAI must transfer financial resources to the Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público and deliver the information and formats needed for the Cuenta Pública and first-quarter reports.
applies_from: Within ten business days after entry into force of the Decree (information); financial transfer per applicable law
quote: deberá entregar a la citada dependencia la información y formatos necesarios

summary: Transitional: INAI registries, systems and documentation of the Plataforma Nacional de Transparencia must be transferred to the Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno.
applies_from: Within fifteen business days after entry into force of the Decree
quote: serán transferidos a la Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno dentro de los quince días hábiles

summary: Transitional: pending access-to-information procedures before INAI are to be processed before Transparencia para el Pueblo under the rules in force when they began.
applies_from: Procedures begun before entry into force
quote: se sustanciarán ante Transparencia para el Pueblo
conditional_on: Procedures begun before entry into force of the Decree

summary: Transitional: pending personal data and other INAI procedures are to be processed before the Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno under the rules in force when they began.
applies_from: Procedures begun before entry into force
quote: sustanciarán conforme a las disposiciones vigentes al momento de su inicio ante la Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno
conditional_on: Procedures begun before entry into force of the Decree

summary: Transitional: the Federal Executive must issue the necessary adjustments to regulations and other provisions, including the Reglamento Interior de Transparencia para el Pueblo.
applies_from: Within ninety natural days after entry into force of the Decree
quote: La persona titular del Ejecutivo Federal deberá expedir las adecuaciones correspondientes a los reglamentos

summary: Transitional: INAI files and archives used for its substantive functions must be transferred to the Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno.
applies_from: Within twenty business days after entry into force of the Decree
quote: serán transferidos a la Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno dentro de los veinte días hábiles

summary: Transitional: the INAI Órgano Interno de Control matters, files and archives must be transferred to the Órgano Interno de Control of the Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno.
applies_from: Within twenty business days after entry into force of the Decree
quote: serán transferidos al Órgano Interno de Control de la Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno

summary: Transitional: the INAI Plenary must set up a Comité de Transferencia, composed of the Commissioners and eleven public servants, on the date of publication of the Decree.
applies_from: Date of publication of the Decree
quote: deberá integrar, en la fecha de publicación de este instrumento, un Comité de Transferencia

summary: Transitional: the Consejo del Sistema Nacional de Acceso a la Información Pública must be installed, following a call by the Secretaría Anticorrupción y Buen Gobierno.
applies_from: Within sixty natural days after entry into force of the Decree
quote: El Consejo del Sistema Nacional de Acceso a la Información Pública deberá instalarse a más tardar en sesenta días naturales

summary: Transitional: the Executive Secretary of the Consejo del Sistema Nacional de Acceso a la Información Pública proposes operating rules for approval at the Council's installation.
quote: propondrá las reglas de operación y funcionamiento

summary: Transitional: the judicial and constitutional-body control organs and other listed bodies must make the necessary adjustments to their internal rules to comply with the Decree.
applies_from: Within thirty natural days after entry into force of the Decree
quote: deberán realizar las adecuaciones necesarias a su normativa interna

summary: Transitional: the Poder Judicial de la Federación must set up specialised district courts and collegiate circuit courts in access to information and personal data protection.
applies_from: Within one hundred and twenty natural days after entry into force of the Decree
quote: El Poder Judicial de la Federación deberá habilitar juzgados de Distrito

summary: Image, including voice, of performing artists and their characters may be used or published only with their express consent or that of their representatives or rights holders. The protection covers results generated by AI systems or any other technology (second paragraph, added by the 14-05-2026 reform).
applies_from: not stated in text (reform published DOF 14-05-2026)
quote: sólo puede ser usada o publicada, con su consentimiento expreso, o bien con el de sus representantes o los titulares de los derechos correspondientes.

summary: Where a performer has received specific remuneration for use of their image, consent is presumed only for the purposes and modalities expressly agreed; any other use requires new authorization and remuneration.
applies_from: not stated in text (reform published DOF 14-05-2026)
quote: Cualquier uso distinto requerirá una nueva autorización y remuneración.
conditional_on: performer received specific remuneration for use of image

summary: Performers have the right to authorize or prohibit the impersonation of their performances by AI systems or other technology that generates clones or simulates their voice identifiably, unless for parody, satire or creative imitation and not substituting the performer's professional services.
applies_from: not stated in text (reform published DOF 14-05-2026)
quote: La suplantación de sus interpretaciones o ejecuciones por sistemas de inteligencia artificial o cualquier otra tecnología que resulten en generación de clones de sus interpretaciones
conditional_on: conduct is not for parody, satire or creative imitation and does not aim or have the effect of substituting the performer's professional services

summary: Users who use fixed performances for profit must make the corresponding payment before the first public communication, before the performer's rights are considered exhausted; phonogram, videogram or audiogram producers may pay according to agreements between the parties.
applies_from: not stated in text (reform published DOF 14-05-2026)
quote: efectúen el pago correspondiente previo a la primera
conditional_on: use of fixed performance media for profit

summary: Performance and execution contracts must specify the times, periods, remuneration and other terms and modalities under which the performance may be fixed, reproduced and communicated to the public; in case of doubt, contractual clauses are interpreted most favourably to the performer.
applies_from: not stated in text (reform published DOF 14-05-2026)
quote: Los contratos de interpretación o ejecución deberán precisar los tiempos, períodos, contraprestaciones y demás términos y modalidades

summary: Any cloning or impersonation of a performer's voice or image made with AI systems or other technology that generates clones or identifiably simulates the voice requires a prior written agreement between the parties (added by the 14-05-2026 reform to the audiovisual production article).
applies_from: not stated in text (reform published DOF 14-05-2026)
quote: Cualquier clonación o suplantación de la voz o imagen realizada con sistemas de inteligencia artificial
conditional_on: cloning or impersonation of voice or image by AI or other technology

summary: The Reglamento of the Ley Federal del Derecho de Autor must be reformed and supplemented within sixty days after the decree enters into force. The transitorio does not name the issuing authority.
applies_from: 60 days after entry into force of the decree (sesenta días siguientes a la entrada en vigor del presente Decreto)
provision: Transitorio Tercero, Artículo Segundo of the decree published in the DOF on 14-05-2026
quote: El Reglamento de la Ley Federal del Derecho de Autor deberá ser reformado y adicionado dentro de los sesenta días siguientes a la entrada en vigor del presente Decreto.

summary: For platform workers, the employer may be exempt from mandatory reinstatement by paying the indemnification under Art. 50; mandatory reinstatement applies only to violations of collective rights (freedom of association, union autonomy, strike, collective bargaining).
quote: Cuando se trate de personas trabajadoras en plataformas digitales.
conditional_on: Dismissal of a platform worker (Art. 49 applies)

summary: In dismissal of a platform worker where indemnification is due, the employer shall pay three months of salary, plus twenty days of salary per year of service (counted by time actually worked, per Art. 291-D), plus accrued wages and interest under Art. 48.
quote: Para las personas trabajadoras de plataformas digitales la indemnización consistirá en tres meses de salario.
conditional_on: Indemnification under Art. 49 (platform workers)

summary: Platform workers are entitled to participate in the company's profits when their effective time worked, under Art. 291-D, exceeds 288 hours per year; the employer shall pay that share.
quote: Las personas trabajadoras en plataformas digitales tendrán derecho a participar en las utilidades de la empresa
conditional_on: Effective time worked above 288 hours per year (Art. 291-D)

summary: Platform administrators are responsible for paying social security insurance coverage when an occupational risk occurs during effectively worked time (Art. 291-C, third paragraph).
quote: las personas físicas y morales que administren plataformas digitales, serán responsables del pago del aseguramiento en el régimen del seguro social cuando ocurra un riesgo de trabajo

summary: The Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social shall issue general provisions setting the procedures for calculating the net income referred to in Art. 291-C.
quote: La Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social expedirá las disposiciones de carácter general que determinen los procedimientos relativos al cálculo del ingreso neto

summary: Platform work shall be set out in a written contract, distinct from the platform's terms and conditions of service; it may be signed digitally.
quote: El trabajo en plataformas digitales deberá fijarse mediante un contrato que será distinto de los términos y condiciones de la prestación del servicio en la plataforma

summary: The Centro Federal de Conciliación y Registro Laboral shall authorize and register the model platform-work contract.
quote: El modelo de contrato será autorizado y registrado por el Centro Federal de Conciliación y Registro Laboral.

summary: The platform work contract shall contain, in addition to Art. 25 items, the parties' identification, nature of work, income and time recording system, equipment and health and safety obligations, payment percentage or method, contact and supervision mechanisms, and other agreed conditions.
quote: el contrato al que se refiere el artículo 291-G, contendrá lo siguiente:

summary: Platform companies shall establish mechanisms that guarantee the full exercise of all rights of platform workers, including collective rights.
quote: las empresas de plataformas digitales deberán establecer mecanismos que garanticen su ejercicio pleno

summary: Platform service providers shall prepare an algorithmic labour management policy document, in plain language, informing workers of the elements used by algorithms for decisions affecting the employment relationship (listed items I to V); it forms part of the contract, is provided at the start and on any change, and must be accepted by each worker.
quote: Los prestadores de servicios en plataformas digitales deberán elaborar un documento de política de gestión algorítmica del trabajo que informe a las personas trabajadoras

summary: Algorithms used for work allocation and management shall be reasonable in their requirements and elements, shall not endanger workers' health and integrity, and shall not be a factor of discrimination against them.
quote: El algoritmo deberá ser razonable en sus requisitos y elementos, atendiendo a las condiciones objetivas del trabajo

summary: As employer, the platform operator shall pay for services rendered within a period not exceeding one week.
quote: Pagar los trabajos derivados de los servicios otorgados, en un plazo no mayor a una semana;

summary: Platform operators shall keep records of hours worked and waiting times, and issue weekly payment receipts showing tasks, effective working time, time at the platform's disposal, legal deductions and related items.
quote: Establecer mecanismos para llevar registro de las horas trabajadas y tiempos de espera;

summary: Platform operators shall implement mechanisms guaranteeing the security of workers' personal data used through the platform and enabling exercise of access, rectification, cancellation, opposition and portability rights under applicable law.
quote: Implementar mecanismos que garanticen la seguridad de la información y datos personales de las personas trabajadoras utilizados desde la plataforma

summary: Platform operators shall register platform workers with the Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social, determine, withhold and remit employer and worker contributions, and make contributions to the national housing fund (INFONAVIT).
quote: Inscribir a las personas trabajadoras en plataformas digitales ante el Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social

summary: Platform operators shall establish training, instruction and advisory mechanisms to ensure adaptation to and proper use of the platforms, and provide information on occupational safety and health measures.
quote: Establecer mecanismos de adiestramiento, capacitación y asesoría necesarios para garantizar la adaptación y el uso adecuado de las plataformas digitales

summary: Platform operators shall establish specific mechanisms to handle and follow up complaints about dishonesty, workplace or sexual violence, harassment, discrimination and similar conduct against platform workers.
quote: Establecer mecanismos específicos de atención y seguimiento de quejas o denuncias

summary: Platform operators shall inform platform workers of the payment they will receive for each task, itemising the concepts used to calculate it.
quote: Informar a las personas trabajadoras en plataformas digitales el pago que recibirán por cada tarea, servicio, obra o trabajo

summary: Platform operators shall provide all information requested by labour and other authorities about platform services, including data on third parties providing services through the platforms.
quote: Proporcionar toda la información que le requieran las autoridades laborales y de cualquier otro tipo

summary: Platform workers have special duties, including safety and traffic rules, care of supplies and work, performing accepted tasks at agreed times, using platform tracking and communication systems, following data protection policies, and acting with probity without discrimination or harassment.
quote: Las personas trabajadoras en plataformas digitales, tienen las obligaciones especiales siguientes:

summary: Before rescinding for repeated non-performance (fracción IV), the platform shall notify the worker at least three days in advance, after exhausting the platform's internal review mechanisms.
quote: Para el caso de la fracción IV, se deberá avisar a la persona trabajadora con al menos tres días de anticipación
conditional_on: Rescission for the grounds in Art. 291-M, fracción IV

summary: Platforms may not limit or prohibit a worker's connection, linkage or access to the platform where non-performance results from the listed circumstances (e.g., platform deception, serious danger, non-acceptance of unpaid tasks, disproportionately low pay).
quote: No será imputable a las personas trabajadoras ni podrá limitarse o prohibirse la conexión, vinculación o acceso a la plataforma digital
conditional_on: Circumstances listed in Art. 291-O, fracciones I to V

summary: Platforms shall make available mechanisms for review of decisions that affect or interrupt a worker's connection or access, managed by personnel with autonomy and review power, not by algorithms.
quote: pondrán a disposición de las personas trabajadoras mecanismos para la atención y revisión de decisiones que afecten o interrumpan la conexión, vinculación o acceso a la plataforma digital

summary: Any termination, restriction or prohibition of connection or access must be notified in writing (or equivalent, including through the platform), stating the conduct behind it, with a detailed report of tasks, connection times, observations and ratings; otherwise it is null.
quote: Será nula toda rescisión, limitante o prohibición en la conexión, vinculación o acceso a la plataforma en la que no se entregue un aviso escrito

summary: Before a justified closure or disablement of the platform, the operator shall give prior notice to workers, of not less than fifteen days counted from when the employer knew of the justified cause.
applies_from: Not less than fifteen days, counted from when the employer knew of the justified cause
quote: El aviso deberá darse en un plazo no menor a quince días, contados a partir que el patrón tuvo conocimiento de la causa justificada
conditional_on: Justified disablement or closure of the platform

summary: Platform companies shall observe a gender perspective protecting workers from discrimination, workplace and sexual violence, harassment, and enabling reconciliation of work with personal and family life.
quote: Las empresas de plataformas digitales deberán observar una perspectiva de género que proteja a las personas trabajadoras

summary: Platform companies are prohibited from charging workers for registration or use; employing minors; withholding money beyond legal deductions; restricting connection except under Art. 291-M; disguising employment through civil or commercial contracts; providing personnel placement services; and manipulating worker income to avoid classification as subordinate workers.
quote: Las empresas de plataformas digitales tienen prohibido:

summary: It is prohibited to transfer workers in a traditional employment relationship to a digital-platform work scheme in order to undermine the employment relationship, its rights, or to reduce tax, social security or labour burdens.
quote: Queda prohibido transferir a las personas trabajadoras que se encuentren sujetas a una relación laboral tradicional a un esquema de trabajo en plataformas digitales
conditional_on: Purpose of undermining the employment relationship or reducing burdens

summary: The Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social must review the disease tables and the Catálogo de las Cédulas at least every five years, or earlier when studies justify it, taking account of advances in occupational medicine.
quote: serán revisadas al menos cada cinco años a partir de su publicación o cuando existan estudios e investigaciones que lo justifiquen.

summary: After the review under Art. 514 is concluded, the Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social must submit the Tabla de Enfermedades de Trabajo and the Tabla para la Valuación de Incapacidades Permanentes to the head of the Federal Executive for consideration and, if appropriate, initiation of the legislative process.
quote: la Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social pondrá a disposición de la persona titular del Ejecutivo Federal
conditional_on: Once the review referred to in Art. 514 is concluded.

summary: The authorities listed in Art. 523 (including the Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social, the Centro Federal de Conciliación y Registro Laboral, the Inspección del Trabajo and the courts) are responsible for applying labour standards within their jurisdictions.
quote: La aplicación de las normas de trabajo compete, en sus respectivas jurisdicciones:

summary: The Secretaría de Educación Pública must oversee compliance with the employer obligations in educational matters under the Ley, and coordinate with the Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social on training and apprenticeship of workers; the Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público has the intervention assigned in Title Three, Chapter VIII.
quote: la Secretaría de Educación Pública, la vigilancia del cumplimiento de las obligaciones que esta Ley impone a los patrones en materia educativa

summary: The Poder Judicial de la Federación and the local judicial powers must establish a judicial career service for the entry, promotion, retention, performance evaluation, separation and retirement of their officials, subject to applicable budget rules.
quote: establecerán, con sujeción a las disposiciones presupuestales aplicables, un servicio de carrera judicial
conditional_on: Subject to applicable budget provisions.

summary: Federal authorities apply labour norms for the listed federal industries and enterprises (Art. 527 I-II). The Autoridad Registral handles registration of collective contracts, internal regulations and unions.
quote: La aplicación de las normas de trabajo corresponde a las autoridades federales

summary: Federal authorities are assisted by state authorities for training and occupational safety matters where enterprises fall under local jurisdiction.
quote: las autoridades de la Federación serán auxiliadas por las locales

summary: State authorities shall (I) provide federal executive departments with requested information, (II-III) take part in state employment and safety councils, (IV) report employer safety and training violations to the STPS and take part in corrective measures, (V-VII) support productivity committees and assist federal bodies as determined.
quote: las autoridades de las Entidades Federativas deberán:

summary: The Procuraduría de la Defensa del Trabajo represents or advises workers and unions on request, files remedies for them, proposes amicable settlements, and assists the conciliation centres with information and hearings.
quote: La procuraduría de la Defensa del Trabajo tiene las funciones siguientes:

summary: All authorities must provide the Procuraduría with the data and reports it requests for performing its functions.
quote: Las Autoridades están obligadas a proporcionar a la Procuraduría de la Defensa del Trabajo, los datos e informes que solicite

summary: The National Employment Service has objectives including promoting employment policies, tracking placement, supervising training, registering skills certificates, linking training to productive demand, and coordinating competency certification.
quote: El Servicio Nacional de Empleo tendrá los siguientes objetivos

summary: The STPS carries out activities in employment promotion (I), job placement including authorizing and supervising private placement agencies (II), training and skills (III), skills registry (IV), linking training to productive demand (V), and competency certification with the SEP (VI).
quote: a la Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social corresponden las siguientes actividades

summary: State labour authorities assist the STPS in performing its functions under Arts. 527-A and 529.
quote: Las autoridades laborales estatales auxiliarán a la Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social

summary: Worker placement services must be free of charge for workers, provided by the STPS or competent state bodies.
quote: El servicio para la colocación de los trabajadores será invariablemente gratuito para ellos

summary: Authorizations for profit-making placement agencies may be granted only exceptionally, for special work; the STPS must set in advance the tariffs such agencies charge, and the service must be free for workers.
quote: Las autorizaciones para el funcionamiento de agencias de colocaciones, con fines lucrativos, sólo podrán otorgarse excepcionalmente

summary: The Labour Inspection function includes watching compliance with labour norms, advising workers and employers, reporting deficiencies and violations to the authority, and carrying out studies.
quote: La Inspección del Trabajo tiene las funciones siguientes:

summary: Labour inspectors have duties and powers to visit enterprises during working hours, examine documents, order removal of proven defects, order immediate safety measures in imminent danger (with a report within 24 hours), and examine hazardous substances.
quote: Los Inspectores del Trabajo tienen los deberes y atribuciones siguientes:

summary: Inspectors must identify themselves with an authorized credential, inspect enterprises periodically, carry out extraordinary inspections on complaints, draw up minutes with worker and employer participation, and give special attention to domestic, field, migrant, indigenous and other vulnerable workers.
quote: Las y los Inspectores del Trabajo tienen las obligaciones siguientes:

summary: Labour inspectors may not hold a direct or indirect interest in supervised enterprises, disclose industrial or commercial secrets learned in their duties, or represent workers or employers in labour disputes.
quote: Queda prohibido a los Inspectores de Trabajo:

summary: The President of the National Minimum Wage Commission submits the annual work plan to the Consejo, meets the Director and technical advisers at least monthly, and presides over Consejo sessions.
quote: Reunirse con el Director y los Asesores Técnicos, una vez al mes, por lo menos

summary: The Dirección Técnica must carry out studies on the general economic situation, cost of living, labour market and wage structures, periodic studies on minimum-wage workers' conditions, and prepare a report for the Consejo.
quote: Practicar y realizar las investigaciones y estudios necesarios y apropiados para determinar, por lo menos:

summary: Minimum wages are fixed each year and take effect on 1 January of the following year. They may be revised during their term on STPS initiative or on union or employer request meeting a 51 percent representation test.
applies_from: primero de enero del año siguiente
quote: Los salarios mínimos se fijarán cada año y comenzarán a regir el primero de enero del año siguiente.
conditional_on: annual fixing of minimum wages

summary: Annual minimum-wage steps: the Dirección Técnica submits its report by the last day of November; the Consejo fixes minimum wages in December before its last working day; the Commission President orders publication in the DOF by 31 December.
quote: La Dirección Técnica presentará a la consideración del Consejo de Representantes, a más tarde el último día de noviembre

summary: For minimum-wage revisions, the Commission President convenes the Consejo within three days of receiving the request; the Dirección Técnica has five days to report; the Consejo rules within three days; the effective date may not be more than ten days after the resolution; publication follows within three days.
quote: El Presidente de la Comisión Nacional, dentro de los tres días siguientes a la fecha en que haya recibido la solicitud
conditional_on: revision requested under Art. 570

summary: The Consejo de Representantes fixes general and professional minimum wages, determines the geographic areas where they apply (resolution published in the DOF), and conducts studies.
quote: Fijar los salarios mínimos generales y profesionales

summary: The profit-sharing Consejo determines and revises the percentage of company profits due to workers, and within fifteen days of its installation determines its working method.
quote: Determinar y revisar el porcentaje que deba corresponder a los trabajadores en las utilidades de las empresas

summary: For profit-sharing reviews, the Commission President publishes a notice in the DOF giving workers and employers three months to submit suggestions; the Commission has eight months for the work plan; the resolution is issued within a month, sets the percentage on taxable income without deductions, and is published in the DOF within five days.
quote: El Presidente publicará un aviso en el Diario Oficial, concediendo a los trabajadores y a los patrones un término de tres meses

summary: The Centro Federal de Conciliación y Registro Laboral has federal conciliation functions, keeps the registry of collective contracts, internal regulations and unions, establishes a professional career service, and sets training plans.
quote: Corresponde al Centro Federal de Conciliación y Registro Laboral las siguientes atribuciones:

summary: The Junta de Gobierno of the Centro Federal meets at least four times a year as set in its organic statute, with the STPS representative required for a valid session.
quote: se reunirá con la periodicidad que se señale en el Estatuto orgánico sin que pueda ser menor de cuatro veces al año

summary: Local conciliation centres have local conciliation functions, establish the professional career service, and train conciliators.
quote: Corresponde a los Centros de Conciliación locales las siguientes atribuciones:

summary: Conciliation conducted by the local centres must follow the procedure in this Law.
quote: La conciliación que imparta deberá ajustarse al procedimiento contemplado en la presente Ley.

summary: In their conduct, judges and instructing secretaries must observe the principles of legality, impartiality, transparency, autonomy and independence.
quote: En su actuación, los jueces y secretarios instructores deberán observar los principios de legalidad

summary: The judge in charge of the Tribunal must be present during the development of hearings, and may use an instructing secretary only for written-stage acts before the preliminary hearing.
quote: el juez a cargo del Tribunal deberá estar presente en el desarrollo de las audiencias

summary: The Secretary of Labour and Social Welfare publishes the call for representative elections in the DOF and in major newspapers.
quote: El Secretario del Trabajo y Previsión Social, publicará en el Diario Oficial de la Federación y en los periódicos de mayor circulación, la convocatoria para la elección de representantes.

summary: Labour inspectors verify and certify the accuracy of the registers (padrones) used in representative elections.
quote: Los Inspectores del Trabajo comprobarán y certificarán la exactitud de los padrones.

summary: On 15 May of each odd-numbered year the STPS Secretary calls workers and employers to elect representatives to the National Minimum Wage Commission.
quote: El día quince de mayo del año impar que corresponda, el Secretario del Trabajo y Previsión Social convocará a los trabajadores y patrones para la elección de sus representantes.

summary: Advisory commissions are created by resolution of the Consejo de Representantes, which must be published in the DOF and state the subject, duration, representation, designation terms and start of work.
quote: Las Comisiones consultivas serán creadas por resolución del Consejo de Representantes

summary: Before going to the Tribunals, workers and employers must attend the competent Conciliation Centre to request conciliation, except for the cases exempted by this Law.
quote: Antes de acudir a los Tribunales, los trabajadores y patrones deberán asistir al Centro de Conciliación correspondiente
conditional_on: unless exempted under Art. 685 Ter

summary: Information provided by the parties in conciliation may not be disclosed to any person or authority, except the certificate of non-conciliation and any settlement, which the Centre forwards electronically to the Tribunal. Personal data are subject to the general data protection and transparency laws.
quote: no podrá comunicarse a persona o autoridad alguna

summary: The conciliation authority schedules the hearing within fifteen days and notifies the employer personally at least five days before.
