It gives free legal advice (III), takes measures so that alleged victims of harassment or discrimination are not confronted with the accused (XII), and issues certificates and copies of settlements (XIII-XIV).
quote: que deberá efectuarse dentro de los quince días siguientes

summary: The conciliation procedure may not exceed forty-five calendar days, and the Autoridad Conciliadora must take the measures needed to keep its actions within that period.
quote: La Autoridad Conciliadora tomará las medidas conducentes para que sus actuaciones se ajusten a dicho plazo.

summary: The Autoridad Conciliadora assigns participants folio references for the selection process.
quote: Las Autoridades Conciliadoras elaborarán la lista de los participantes

summary: The conciliator must (I) issue summonses, (II) assess justifications for absence, (III) state the scope and limits of conciliation, (IV-V) invite and evaluate settlement proposals, (VI-VIII) draft, sanction and certify settlements and minutes, and (IX) verify that settlements do not violate workers' rights.
quote: El conciliador tendrá las siguientes atribuciones y obligaciones:

summary: Conciliators must safeguard workers' non-waivable rights, observe the principles of neutrality, impartiality, equity, good faith and confidentiality, complete training for certification renewal, abstain from acting as witnesses or advocates in later trials, and work to balance production factors and social justice.
quote: Los conciliadores en el desempeño de sus atribuciones tendrán las siguientes obligaciones especiales:

summary: Conciliator selection is by open public competition; calls must be published in the DOF or state official organs and on the Centre's website for the whole competition.
quote: El procedimiento de selección se llevará a cabo a través de concurso

summary: The Centre guarantees the principles of legality, impartiality, quality, objectivity, certainty, equity, merit, publicity and transparency in conciliator selection, and its call must set the rules, evaluation committee and guidelines.
quote: El Centro de Conciliación garantizará el cumplimiento de los principios de legalidad

summary: Results of the conciliator competition are published in the DOF or state official organs and on the Centre's website.
quote: Los resultados del concurso se publicarán en el Diario Oficial de la Federación

summary: The Centre establishes the procedure for conciliator ratification every three years, based on objective performance criteria assessed through public, technical and objective instruments.
quote: El Centro de Conciliación establecerá el procedimiento para tales efectos

summary: Tribunals must guarantee compliance with the principles of labour procedure (immediacy, continuity, speed, free, predominantly oral, conciliatory), and apply the principle of reality over contrary formal elements.
quote: Los Tribunales deben garantizar el cumplimiento de los principios y condiciones citados.

summary: Where a representative is manifestly and systematically technically incompetent, the Tribunal must require the affected party to appoint another within three natural days. Workers are entitled to a Procuraduría or public defender lawyer.
quote: Cuando el Tribunal advierta que exista una manifiesta y sistemática incapacidad técnica del apoderado legal, prevendrá a la parte afectada para que designe otro

summary: Tribunals must order correction of any irregularity or omission in the proceedings to regularize them, without revoking their own decisions.
quote: Los Tribunales ordenarán que se corrija cualquier irregularidad u omisión

summary: Administrative authorities must assist the Tribunals within their competences, and are liable under applicable law if they refuse.
quote: Las autoridades administrativas están obligadas, en la esfera de sus respectivas competencias, a auxiliar a los Tribunales

summary: For minors under 16 without a representative, the Procuraduría designates one; if a minor worker is not assisted, the Tribunal requests the Procuraduría's intervention.
quote: la Procuraduría de la Defensa del Trabajo les designará un representante cuando no lo tuvieren

summary: Where a claim includes training or occupational safety matters within federal competence, the Tribunal sends copies immediately to the Federal Tribunal.
quote: las que remitirá inmediatamente al Tribunal Federal

summary: A Tribunal must declare itself incompetent on its own motion at any stage before the trial hearing when the file shows grounds for it.
quote: El Tribunal de oficio, deberá declararse incompetente en cualquier estado del proceso

summary: Judges and instructing secretaries are compelled to recuse themselves in the listed cases (I-XVII), such as direct interest, family ties, prior involvement or public opinion.
quote: se tendrán por forzosamente impedidos y tendrán el deber de excusarse

summary: Judges and instructing secretaries must recuse immediately on taking up a matter they should not hear, or within twenty-four hours of the fact or knowledge, stating the cause.
quote: tendrán la obligación de excusarse inmediatamente que se avoquen al conocimiento de un negocio

summary: A worker who does not know the employer's name must state in the claim the address where the work was or is performed and the activity of the employer.
quote: deberá precisar por lo menos en su escrito de demanda el domicilio de la empresa

summary: Tribunal receiving units must forward filings to the competent Tribunal no later than the next day and provide service on the days set in Art. 715 (every day for strike procedures).
quote: remitirán los escritos que reciba al Tribunal que corresponda, a más tardar al día siguiente

summary: Tribunals must guarantee the fidelity, integrity, reproduction, conservation and safekeeping of case files.
quote: los Tribunales garantizarán su fidelidad, integridad, reproducción, conservación y resguardo

summary: Hearings are public (closed where privacy or minors require); the judge presides over all acts of proof and records the hearing minutes (I-IV) and the certification of the recording medium.
quote: Las audiencias serán presididas íntegramente por el juez

summary: Hearings are recorded electronically or by another suitable means that guarantees the fidelity and integrity of the information and access for those entitled.
quote: las audiencias se registrarán por medios electrónicos

summary: The Tribunal must issue certified copies of any document or record in the file to the requesting party.
quote: está obligado a expedir a la parte solicitante, copia certificada

summary: On disappearance of a file or action, the Tribunal, on its own motion, files a complaint with the competent public prosecutor, attaching the minutes.
quote: El Tribunal, de oficio, hará la denuncia correspondiente ante el Ministerio Público

summary: If facts leading to a disciplinary measure may constitute a crime, the Tribunal draws up a detailed record and forwards it to the public prosecutor.
quote: el Tribunal levantará un acta circunstanciada y la turnará al Ministerio Público

summary: In the first appearance or filing, parties must designate an address to receive notifications within the place of residence of the Tribunal or Centre; the employer's address for notifications must also be given. Otherwise notifications are made by board or list.
quote: deberán señalar domicilio para oír y recibir notificaciones

summary: Labour court decisions must be notified no later than the third working day after issue, with the reason recorded immediately after the decision.
quote: Las resoluciones que se dicten en los juicios laborales deben notificarse a más tardar dentro del tercer día hábil siguiente.

summary: The listed notifications must be made personally, including summons to trial, the first order, rulings on incompetence, and the summons to the conciliation hearing (XIII).
quote: Se harán personalmente las notificaciones siguientes:

summary: The process server (actuario) must verify that the person to be notified lives, works or is domiciled at the address on the record, and follow the rules for personal notification, including the posted-notice method (V) and the record of evidence.
quote: El actuario se cerciorará de que la persona que deba ser notificada, habita, trabaja o tiene su domicilio

summary: The Federal and Local Tribunals must publish a printed and electronic bulletin listing non-personal notifications.
quote: deberán acordar la publicación de un boletín impreso y electrónico

summary: Board and list notices must be posted at the court premises and on the judicial power website at the start of the next business day, with the case number, party names and a summary of the decision.
quote: Las notificaciones por boletín o lista se fijarán y publicarán en el local del órgano jurisdiccional

summary: Parties and third parties with an electronic mailbox must access it every day and obtain the receipt within two days of the court sending it; otherwise the notification is deemed made. In system outages parties must notify the Tribunal by other means.
quote: Las partes o terceros interesados están obligados a ingresar al buzón electrónico asignado

summary: Notifications, summonses and service must be carried out within five days of their date, unless the decision or the Law provides otherwise.
quote: Las notificaciones, citaciones o emplazamientos deberán realizarse dentro de los cinco días siguientes a su fecha

summary: Letters rogatory between authorities are transmitted through the electronic platform linking labour authorities, except for taking testimony.
quote: El envío, recepción y devolución de los exhortos excepto en el caso de desahogo de prueba testimonial, se realizará vía plataforma electrónica

summary: The Tribunal must issue letters rogatory and dispatches on the day after the decision ordering them takes effect.
quote: El Tribunal deberá expedir los exhortos y despachos, al día siguiente

summary: The Tribunal must ensure that proceedings do not remain inactive, taking the steps required by law until judgment, under its strict responsibility.
quote: El Tribunal cuidará, bajo su más estricta responsabilidad, que los juicios que ante él se tramiten no queden inactivos

summary: Where the worker has not filed a required step within forty-five natural days, the Tribunal must order that the worker be personally required to file it, with a warning of the consequences.
quote: el Tribunal deberá ordenar que se le requiera personalmente para que la presente
conditional_on: worker's failure to file a required step

summary: Any authority or person outside the proceeding that holds documents useful to establish the truth must produce them by the hearing or before the close of the investigation when the Tribunal requests them.
quote: Toda autoridad o persona ajena al juicio que tenga documentos en su poder que puedan contribuir al esclarecimiento de la verdad deberá aportarlos
conditional_on: when the Tribunal requests the documents

summary: The employer must keep and produce in court the listed documents (individual contracts, payroll or attendance records, profit-sharing, vacation and social security payment records), for periods set by the article.
quote: El patrón tiene obligación de conservar y exhibir en juicio los documentos que a continuación se precisan

summary: Every person with knowledge of the facts the parties must prove is obliged to testify as a witness.
quote: Todos los que tengan conocimiento de los hechos que las partes deben probar, están obligados a declarar como testigos.

summary: Social security bodies must produce, on pain of a presumption of the claimant's allegations, the documents they are legally bound to issue and keep, and must prove their own case on the listed points.
quote: Los organismos de seguridad social, conforme a lo dispuesto por el artículo 784 deberán exhibir los documentos que, de acuerdo con las Leyes, tienen la obligación legal de expedir y conservar
conditional_on: when a dispute arises on the listed points

summary: Social security institutions must make an IT platform available to the tribunals, giving access to their databases so the tribunal can establish the disputed facts.
quote: Las instituciones de seguridad social deberán poner a disposición de los tribunales una plataforma informática

summary: The Federal Judicial Council must form a corps of official medical experts in occupational medicine attached to the federal judiciary; public health institutions must designate experts when the tribunal requests them.
quote: El Consejo de la Judicatura Federal integrará un cuerpo de peritos médicos oficiales especializados en medicina del trabajo

summary: The judge must act proactively, driving the procedure forward and correcting formal defects, and must promote conciliation.
quote: el juez deberá asumir un desempeño proactivo

summary: Where there is a risk that a judgment will not be enforced, or the employer takes steps toward non-compliance, the judge must take necessary measures, including attachment of bank accounts or real estate, and notify social security institutions.
quote: el juez tomará las medidas necesarias a efecto de lograr el cumplimiento eficaz de la sentencia
conditional_on: where there is a risk of non-enforcement or the employer acts toward non-compliance

summary: Judgments must be complied with within fifteen days after notification takes effect; the condemned party is addressed, which may be the employer.
quote: Las sentencias deben cumplirse dentro de los quince días siguientes al día en que surta efectos la notificación.

summary: The tribunal must notify the Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social of the condemnatory judgment so that it can act within its powers on the convicted party's social security obligations.
quote: El Tribunal deberá dar vista al Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social con la sentencia condenatoria

summary: Banks, securities institutions and other debtors notified of an attachment must make the payment available to the tribunal, under penalty of double payment for disobedience.
quote: que el importe del pago lo ponga a disposición del Tribunal
conditional_on: when notified of an attachment of accounts, securities, credits or income

summary: In a dispute on the number of workers, the employer must, under oath, provide the names of all workers with their position, salary and hiring date, and list workers hired or dismissed in the preceding three months.
quote: Al patrón, para que bajo protesta de decir verdad, informe el nombre de todos sus trabajadores
conditional_on: in a strike-recount procedure, when requested

summary: The tribunal must send the employer a copy of the strike summons within forty-eight hours of receipt, and the notice effects are set by the article.
quote: harán llegar al patrón la copia del escrito de emplazamiento dentro de las cuarenta y ocho horas siguientes a la de su recibo

summary: Workers giving notice of a strike must do so at least six days before the stoppage (ten days for public services), counted from the employer's notification.
quote: El aviso para la suspensión de las labores deberá darse, por lo menos, con seis días de anticipación

summary: The Labour Tribunal and labour inspectors must report employers of industrial, field, mining, commercial or service establishments who fail to pay field workers at least the general minimum wage to the Ministerio Público.
quote: tienen la obligación de denunciar ante el Ministerio Público a la persona empleadora

summary: Labour authorities or tribunals must immediately notify competent authorities whenever irregular acts are presumed, in all cases.
quote: las Autoridades del Trabajo o los Tribunales de manera inmediata deberán hacerlo del conocimiento de las autoridades competentes

summary: The Secretary of Labour, state governors or the Head of Government of Mexico City may delegate the power to impose administrative sanctions to subordinate officials by published agreement.
quote: quienes podrán delegar el ejercicio de esta facultad en los funcionarios subordinados que estimen conveniente

summary: The Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social must refer the facts of subcontracting violations to the competent authorities.
quote: La Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social dará vista de los hechos a las autoridades que resulten competentes.

summary: The Consejo Técnico of the IMSS and, where applicable, the Consejo de Administración of INFONAVIT must publish in the DOF the general rules guaranteeing compliance with the platform-work obligations in art. 291-K fracciones V and VI, via a mandatory pilot.
applies_from: within 5 days after entry into force of the Decree
quote: publicarán en el Diario Oficial de la Federación, dentro de los 5 días siguientes a la entrada en vigor del presente Decreto

summary: The IMSS has 180 natural days, counted from publication of the general rules, to prepare the initiatives that will define the platform-worker social security obligations for the Legislative Power.
applies_from: 180 días naturales contados a partir de la publicación de las reglas de carácter general
quote: contará con un plazo de 180 días naturales, contados a partir de la publicación de las reglas de carácter general

summary: The STPS may collect, prepare, process and disseminate information to help people understand rights and obligations in platform work relationships.
quote: La Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social podrá recopilar, elaborar, procesar y divulgar información

summary: The STPS must publish the general provisions defining the calculation of net income referred to in art. 291-F.
applies_from: 5 días posteriores a la entrada en vigor del presente Decreto
quote: contará con 5 días posteriores a la entrada en vigor del presente Decreto para publicar las disposiciones de carácter general

summary: The STPS must set up mechanisms to collect, process and evaluate data on the implementation of the working-hours reduction.
quote: La Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social instrumentará los mecanismos que correspondan para recopilar, procesar y evaluar datos

summary: The reduction of the working day may not in any case reduce wages, salaries or benefits of workers.
quote: En ningún caso la reducción de la jornada laboral implicará la disminución de sueldos, salarios o prestaciones

summary: The working-day duration under art. 59 is reached gradually from 1 January of each year, following the table in the transitional provision (48 hours in 2026 down to 40 in 2030).
applies_from: 1 de enero del año que corresponda, gradually to 2030
quote: se alcanzará de manera gradual, a partir del 1 de enero del año que corresponda

summary: The governing bodies of INFONAVIT must issue the policies and rules for granting housing under social leasing (arrendamiento social) within 180 days.
applies_from: 180 días siguientes a la entrada en vigor del presente Decreto
quote: deberán expedir las políticas y reglas conforme a las cuales se otorgarán viviendas en arrendamiento social

summary: Federal, state, municipal and Mexico City authorities must make the legislative and regulatory adjustments required by the Decree.
quote: deberán llevar a cabo las adecuaciones legislativas y reglamentarias correspondientes

summary: Natural or legal persons providing subcontracting services must obtain registration with the STPS under art. 15 of the Ley Federal del Trabajo.
applies_from: a más tardar el 1 de septiembre de 2021
quote: deberán obtener el registro ante la Secretaría del Trabajo y Previsión Social

summary: Persons providing specialised services or works must begin providing the information referred to in art. 15 A fracciones I and II of the Ley del Seguro Social.
applies_from: a más tardar el 1 de septiembre de 2021
quote: deberán empezar a proporcionar la información a que se refieren las fracciones I y II del artículo 15 A de la Ley del Seguro Social

summary: Until the IMSS coverage for domestic workers enters into force, the employer must guarantee medical care and funeral expenses for domestic workers.
quote: el patrón garantizará la atención médica y los gastos por concepto de sepelio
conditional_on: until the Ley del Seguro Social provisions on domestic work in the obligatory regime enter into force

summary: Prohibits discrimination in the provision of public telecommunications and broadcasting services on listed grounds.
quote: estará prohibida toda discriminación motivada por origen étnico o nacional

summary: The State must guarantee access to broadband Internet and information and communication technologies and establish effective competition conditions.
quote: garantizará el acceso al Internet de banda ancha

summary: No additional taxes or economic considerations may be imposed on a concessionaire beyond those agreed with the property owner for installing infrastructure.
quote: No podrán imponerse contribuciones u otras contraprestaciones económicas adicionales

summary: Federal, state and municipal governments must cooperate and provide facilities for installing and deploying telecommunications and broadcasting infrastructure.
quote: colaborarán y otorgarán facilidades para la instalación y despliegue de infraestructura

summary: The Federal Executive, directly or through the Commission, issues general administrative provisions for regulating and supervising telecommunications and broadcasting.
quote: expedirá las disposiciones administrativas de carácter general

summary: The Commission issues Official Mexican Standards and technical guidelines for network infrastructure and connected equipment, including type approval, conformity assessment and unlocking.
quote: La Comisión emitirá Normas Oficiales Mexicanas y lineamientos técnicos relativos

summary: The Agency must prepare federal telecommunications, satellite and broadcasting policies.
quote: Elaborar las políticas de telecomunicaciones, satelital y de radiodifusión del Gobierno Federal

summary: The Agency, with the Commission, issues the national radio spectrum programme; the Agency must also prepare the national connectivity and Internet access plan.
quote: Emitir, en coordinación con la Comisión, el programa nacional de espectro radioeléctrico

summary: The Commission issues general administrative provisions needed to regulate telecommunications and broadcasting, including technical plans, guidelines and Official Mexican Standards.
quote: Emitir las disposiciones administrativas de carácter general, necesarias para regular las telecomunicaciones y radiodifusión

summary: The Commission authorises, registers and publishes tariffs for telecommunications and broadcasting services, and for measures imposed on preponderant or substantial-power agents.
quote: Autorizar, registrar y publicar las tarifas de los servicios de telecomunicaciones y de radiodifusión

summary: The Commission must keep the Public Telecommunications Registry (Registro Público de Telecomunicaciones) up to date.
quote: Llevar y mantener actualizado el Registro Público de Telecomunicaciones

summary: The Commission sets quality indices for telecommunications and broadcasting services and publishes periodic verification results.
quote: Fijar los índices de calidad por servicio a que deberán sujetarse los prestadores

summary: The Commission supervises that programming aimed at children respects the values and rules set out in the law.
quote: Supervisar que la programación dirigida a la población infantil respete los valores

summary: The Commission publishes its general agreements and resolutions in the Diario Oficial de la Federación.
quote: El Pleno ordenará la publicación en el Diario Oficial de la Federación de los acuerdos y resoluciones de carácter general

summary: Minutes of Commission plenary sessions are published on its website within ten business days of approval.
quote: Las actas de las sesiones se publicarán en la página de Internet de la Comisión dentro de los diez días hábiles

summary: The Commission must hold public consultations for issuing or amending rules, guidelines and other administrative provisions, unless publicity would compromise an emergency response.
quote: la Comisión deberá realizar consultas públicas bajo los principios de transparencia y participación ciudadana

summary: The Commission must appoint commissioners in staggered form within a 30-day period after the proposal; the Federal Executive makes the nominations.
quote: Las Personas Comisionadas serán nombradas en forma escalonada por la persona titular del Ejecutivo Federal

summary: The Commission President must notify the Federal Executive three months before commissioners' terms end.
quote: la Persona Comisionada Presidenta, con tres meses de anticipación, deberá notificar esta circunstancia

summary: Commissioners must reject any recommendation intended to influence proceedings improperly, and must act with technical independence and conduct regulated-party meetings only by registered interview.
quote: Rechazar cualquier tipo de recomendación que tienda a influir en la tramitación o resolución

summary: Commissioners must excuse themselves immediately from matters in which an interest or impediment exists.
quote: deberán excusarse inmediatamente de conocer asuntos en los que exista una o varias situaciones

summary: Concessionaires, authorised parties and registrants must provide the Commission with information on spectrum use, exploitation, technology and location of emissions.
quote: Los concesionarios y, en su caso, autorizados y registratarios, se encuentran obligados a entregar a la Comisión

summary: Concessionaires and registrants must comply within the period set by the Commission with measures it dictates on radio emissions, and assist its inspection work.
quote: están obligados a cumplir en el plazo que se les fije, las medidas que al efecto dicte la Comisión

summary: Deployment and operation of wireless infrastructure must observe maximum human exposure limits to non-ionising radiofrequency radiation defined by the Commission.
quote: se deberá observar el cumplimiento de los límites de exposición máxima para seres humanos

summary: A single concession (concesión única) is required to provide any type of public telecommunications and broadcasting service.
quote: Se requerirá concesión única para prestar todo tipo de servicios públicos de telecomunicaciones y radiodifusión.

summary: The single concession is granted only to Mexican natural or legal persons.
quote: sólo se otorgará a personas físicas o morales de nacionalidad mexicana

summary: Applicants for a single concession must submit to the Commission a request with the minimum contents listed (name, project characteristics, capacity documentation, gender equality measures).
quote: deberán presentar a la Comisión solicitud que contenga como mínimo

summary: Spectrum and orbital-resource concessions are granted only to Mexican natural or legal persons.
quote: sólo se otorgarán a personas físicas o morales de nacionalidad mexicana

summary: Public-use and social-use spectrum concessions may not provide services for profit or share the spectrum with third parties.
quote: Bajo esta modalidad de concesiones no se podrán prestar servicios con fines de lucro

summary: Public-use broadcasting concessionaires may not pursue profit accumulation; their surpluses may only be invested in the object of the concession.
quote: no perseguirán dentro de sus actividades la obtención de ganancias con propósitos de acumulación

summary: Social-use broadcasting concessionaires must deliver to the Commission, by 30 April each year, information verifying the source and use of prior-year income.
quote: deberán entregar a más tardar el treinta de abril de cada año a la Comisión

summary: A concession, its rights, facilities and assets may not be ceded, pledged or otherwise transferred to any foreign government or state.
quote: En ningún caso se podrá ceder, gravar, dar en prenda o fideicomiso, hipotecar o enajenar

summary: Concessionaires that are legal persons must file their shareholding structure and percentages, and a list of shareholders holding 5% or more, by 30 June each year.
quote: presentará a la Comisión, a más tardar el treinta de junio de cada año, su estructura accionaria

summary: For share transfers of 10% or more of capital, the concessionaire must give the Commission prior notice with details of the acquirers, subject to a 30-business-day objection period.
quote: el concesionario estará obligado a observar el régimen siguiente

summary: Social-use concessionaires that are legal persons must obtain Commission authorisation for their members and associates and for admitting new ones.
quote: deberán presentar para autorización de la Comisión, la relación de los integrantes

summary: Only commercial-use or private-use concessions may be ceded, and only with prior Commission authorisation.
quote: Solo las concesiones para uso comercial o privado podrán cederse previa autorización de la Comisión

summary: Concessionaires must pay the contributions and consideration due for use of the spectrum for the duration of the concession.
quote: obliga al concesionario o autorizado al pago de las contribuciones y contraprestaciones

summary: The Commission must ensure that consideration for concessions and related contributions has been paid before the concession is delivered.
quote: La Comisión estará obligada a cerciorarse del pago de las contraprestaciones

summary: Public-network operators must interconnect directly or indirectly, must not delay or obstruct interconnection, and must offer number portability.
quote: Ofrecer y permitir la portabilidad efectiva de números en los términos establecidos en esta Ley

summary: Public-network operators must provide emergency-number and public-service calls to end users free of charge.
quote: Prestar sin costo para sus usuarios finales los servicios de llamadas a los números de emergencia

summary: Public-network operators must not establish contractual or other barriers preventing other concessionaires from installing or accessing telecommunications infrastructure in shared buildings.
quote: Abstenerse de establecer barreras contractuales o de cualquier otra naturaleza

summary: Public-network operators must not enter exclusivity agreements limiting users' access to purchase any terminal equipment.
quote: Abstenerse de celebrar acuerdos de exclusividad para limitar el acceso de los usuarios

summary: Mobile-service operators may only activate and keep active lines linked to end users who presented an official identification under Commission guidelines.
quote: únicamente podrán activar y mantener activo el servicio de aquellas líneas que estén asociadas a usuarios finales

summary: Information transmitted over telecommunications networks and services is confidential, except where public by nature or on judicial order.
quote: La información que se transmita a través de las redes y servicios de telecomunicaciones será confidencial

summary: Public-network operators must adopt open network architecture designs to ensure interconnection and interoperability.
quote: deberán adoptar diseños de arquitectura abierta de red para garantizar la interconexión

summary: A preponderant or substantial-power agent must notify the Commission before adopting a technology or design change in its network, so the Commission can authorise it.
quote: deberá comunicarlo a la Comisión a fin de autorizar la tecnología o el cambio propuesto

summary: Public-network concessionaires must interconnect their networks with those of other concessionaires on non-discriminatory, transparent and objective terms.
quote: estarán obligados a interconectar sus redes con las de otros concesionarios

summary: Concessionaires must sign interconnection agreements within 40 business days of a request, following the Commission procedure if no agreement is reached.
quote: suscribirán un convenio en un plazo no mayor de cuarenta días hábiles

summary: Interconnection agreements must be registered with the Commission in the Public Telecommunications Registry within 30 business days of signature.
quote: deberán registrarse ante la Comisión en el Registro Público de Telecomunicaciones dentro de los treinta días hábiles

summary: Interconnection agreements must contain minimum content set out in the law, including interconnection points, reciprocity, and no volume discounts on interconnection tariffs.
quote: En los convenios de interconexión las partes deberán establecer, cuando menos

summary: Preponderant or substantial-power agents must provide all interconnection services listed in Art. 112; other concessionaires must provide the first four.
quote: será obligatoria para el Agente Económico Preponderante o con poder sustancial

summary: Only concessionaires operating public networks, or persons authorised by the Commission, may install telecommunications equipment and transmission media crossing the national border.
quote: Sólo podrán instalar equipos de telecomunicaciones y medios de transmisión que crucen las fronteras del país

summary: Concessionaires must submit cross-border traffic exchange agreements to the Commission before they are concluded.
quote: Los concesionarios deberán presentar a la Comisión, previamente a su formalización, los convenios de intercambio de tráfico

summary: The Commission publishes in the Diario Oficial de la Federación the minimum technical conditions and tariffs resulting from its cost methodologies, which are mandatory.
quote: La Comisión publicará en el Diario Oficial de la Federación, en el primer semestre del año previo

summary: Preponderant or substantial-power agents must register with the Commission a list of disaggregated interconnection services, updated at least once a year.
quote: Registrar ante la Comisión una lista de los servicios de interconexión desagregados

summary: Preponderant or substantial-power agents must publish annually a public interconnection offer in the Diario Oficial de la Federación, subject to Commission approval.
quote: Publicar anualmente en el Diario Oficial de la Federación una oferta pública de interconexión

summary: Preponderant or substantial-power agents must submit to the Commission and the competition authority, at least annually, separate accounting and costing for interconnection services.
quote: Presentar a la Comisión y a la autoridad en materia de libre competencia y concurrencia, cuando menos una vez al año

summary: Preponderant or substantial-power agents must have physical presence at Internet traffic exchange points in the national territory.
quote: Contar con presencia física en los puntos de intercambio de tráfico de Internet en el territorio nacional

summary: Internet access providers must follow the general guidelines the Commission issues on network neutrality.
quote: deberán sujetarse a los lineamientos de carácter general que al efecto expida la Comisión

summary: Internet access providers must deliver access respecting the contracted capacity, speed and quality, regardless of content, origin, destination, terminal or application.
quote: deberán prestar el servicio de acceso a Internet respetando la capacidad, velocidad y calidad contratada por el usuario

summary: INDAABIN, under the Federal Executive, must set technical, economic, security and operating conditions for making federal public property and infrastructure available to all concessionaires on non-discriminatory terms.
quote: establecerá las condiciones técnicas, económicas, de seguridad y operación que posibiliten

summary: Orbital-resource concessionaires and authorised parties must provide the satellite capacity reserve required by the Commission for national security and government needs.
quote: La Comisión se asegurará que los concesionarios y autorizados proporcionen la reserva de capacidad satelital

summary: Orbital-resource concessionaires must complete all necessary preliminary acts on time to ensure service operations start as the concession provides.
quote: deberán realizar en tiempo y forma todos los actos previos necesarios

summary: Orbital-resource concessionaires with national coverage must establish at least one satellite control and operations centre in national territory.
quote: deberán establecer al menos un centro de control y operación de los satélites respectivos en territorio nacional

summary: Geostationary orbital-resource concessionaires need Commission authorisation to operate in an inclined orbit or under specific conditions, and to relocate, co-locate or deorbit a satellite.
quote: requerirán autorización de la Comisión para operar en órbita inclinada

summary: Satellites designed for atmospheric re-entry disintegration or meeting environmental best practice need only notify the Commission before deorbiting, not obtain authorisation.
quote: únicamente deberán dar aviso a la Comisión

summary: Orbital resource concessionaires must report unexpected or irremediable satellite failures to the Commission, then report every 24 hours until the failure is fixed.
applies_from: within three business days following the failure
quote: deberán informar a la Comisión dentro de los tres días hábiles siguientes a la falla presentada
conditional_on: unexpected or irremediable failure in satellite control or event affecting service continuity

summary: Report total satellite loss to the Commission.
applies_from: within twenty-four hours after the loss is determined or known
quote: deberá informarlo a la Comisión dentro de las veinticuatro horas siguientes a que dicha pérdida sea determinada
conditional_on: failure results in total loss of the satellite

summary: Provide a compliance guarantee (bond or letter of credit in favour of the Federal Government, amount set by the Commission) for the commitment to occupy the orbital position and resume services.
quote: deberá presentar una garantía de cumplimiento del compromiso para ocupar la posición orbital geoestacionaria

summary: Submit a contingency plan to the Commission for approval to prevent and address service interruptions in case of replacement or failure of satellite system elements.
applies_from: within ninety business days after grant of the orbital resource concession or authorization
quote: deberán presentar para aprobación de la Comisión, dentro de los noventa días hábiles

summary: Notify the Commission of launch delays, failures or losses of the satellite and propose measures to ensure continuity.
applies_from: within three business days after knowledge of the delay, failure or loss
quote: deberá avisar a la Comisión dentro de los tres días hábiles siguientes al conocimiento del retraso del lanzamiento
conditional_on: delays, failures or losses in satellite launch

summary: State to the Commission whether there is interest in continuing to exploit the orbital resources, with supporting documentation.
applies_from: before the start of the last third of the satellite useful life, or upon total loss
quote: deberán manifestar a la Comisión si existe interés para continuar explotando los recursos orbitales

summary: Submit a satellite replacement plan for Commission approval; failing this, authorization will not be granted.
applies_from: before the start of the last third of the satellite useful life, or within ten days after notice of total loss
quote: deberán presentar para aprobación de la Comisión, previo al inicio de la última tercera parte de la vida útil del satélite
conditional_on: interest in continuing to exploit the orbital resources

summary: Broadcasting stations and their complementary equipment must be built, installed and operated under the technical requirements set by the Commission; technical changes require Commission approval.
quote: se construirán, instalarán y operarán con sujeción a los requisitos técnicos que fije la Comisión

summary: Request Commission approval, with favourable aeronautical authority opinion, before installing, raising or relocating towers or changes affecting propagation or interference.
quote: el concesionario deberá presentar solicitud a la Comisión acompañada de la opinión favorable
conditional_on: installation, height increase or relocation of towers or changes affecting propagation or interference

summary: Broadcast concessionaires must guarantee continuity of the public broadcasting service and may not suspend transmissions except for force majeure, which must be justified to the Commission.
quote: tiene la obligación de garantizar la continuidad del servicio público de radiodifusión

summary: Inform the Commission of the cause, use of emergency equipment, and expected restoration date of a service suspension.
applies_from: within three business days after the events occur
quote: deberá presentar a la Comisión la información a la que se refieren las fracciones anteriores, en un término de tres días hábiles
conditional_on: suspension of broadcasting service

summary: Give the Commission notice of planned temporary suspension for maintenance or replacement at least fifteen business days in advance.
applies_from: at least fifteen business days before the planned suspension
quote: los concesionarios deben dar aviso a la Comisión de la suspensión temporal del servicio de radiodifusión
conditional_on: maintenance or replacement of station installations

summary: The Commission must issue general provisions setting the procedure and deadlines for notices of partial or total suspension in case of force majeure.
quote: La Comisión emitirá las disposiciones de carácter general que tendrán por objeto establecer el procedimiento

summary: Commission may not authorize a preponderant or substantial-power operator to transmit more than fifty percent of the open television channels in the region.
quote: la Comisión no les autorizará la transmisión de un número de canales superior al cincuenta por ciento
conditional_on: concessionaire belongs to an economic agent declared preponderant or with substantial power

summary: Multiprogramming authorizations may never allow use of spectrum to provide restricted television or audio services.
quote: En ningún caso se autorizará que los concesionarios utilicen el espectro radioeléctrico para prestar servicios de televisión o audio restringidos.

summary: Restricted television and audio concessionaires must free-retransmit the most-watched multiprogramming broadcast signal; satellite operators only signals with national coverage of fifty percent or more.
quote: deberán retransmitir de manera gratuita la señal radiodifundida multiprogramada que tenga mayor audiencia

summary: Each multiprogramming application must state the transmission channel, number of programming hours with innovative technology, start date, video quality and related details.
quote: deberán señalar en la solicitud lo siguiente
conditional_on: application for a multiprogramming channel

summary: TV channels must provide an electronic programme guide and Spanish subtitling or dubbing and Mexican Sign Language services, as set by the Commission.
quote: Contar con guía electrónica de programación, conforme a las disposiciones aplicables

summary: Commission must decide multiprogramming access requests within forty business days; silence means denial.
quote: La Comisión resolverá la solicitud de acceso a la multiprogramación en un plazo máximo de cuarenta días hábiles

summary: Broadcast TV concessionaires must allow restricted TV concessionaires to retransmit their signal free of charge, in full, simultaneously and unmodified, including advertising.
quote: están obligados a permitir a los concesionarios de televisión restringida la retransmisión de su señal

summary: Restricted TV concessionaires must retransmit broadcast TV signals free, unmodified and without extra charge; satellite operators only signals of fifty percent national coverage or more, and all must carry federal public institution signals.
quote: están obligados a retransmitir la señal de televisión radiodifundida, de manera gratuita y no discriminatoria

summary: Preponderant or substantial-power broadcasters must agree conditions and prices for broadcast content or retransmission; the Commission sets the tariff in case of dispute.
quote: deberán acordar las condiciones y precios de los contenidos radiodifundidos o de la retransmisión
conditional_on: declared preponderant or with substantial power

summary: Commission authorization is required to establish and operate a telecommunications marketer without concession, operate earth stations for satellite signals, install cross-border equipment, use foreign satellite rights, and use spectrum for embassies, diplomatic visits, experiments, secondary use or smart radio networks.
quote: Se requiere autorización de la Comisión para:
conditional_on: activities listed in fractions I to IX

summary: Authorization holders must request extension within the year before the last fifth of the term, remain in compliance and accept Commission conditions.
quote: lo solicite el autorizado dentro del año anterior al inicio de la última quinta parte de la autorización
conditional_on: authorization extension

summary: Commission must issue general rules setting requirements and deadlines for the authorizations of Article 159.
quote: La Comisión establecerá reglas de carácter general que establezcan los requisitos y plazos para solicitar las autorizaciones

summary: For authorization under Article 159 fraction IV (foreign satellite systems), a space debris mitigation plan must be submitted as a mandatory requirement.
quote: se deberá presentar un plan de mitigación de desechos espaciales como requisito obligatorio
conditional_on: authorization under Article 159 fraction IV

summary: Authorizations for secondary spectrum use and smart radio networks are granted only after payment of consideration.
quote: se otorgarán previo pago de una contraprestación
conditional_on: authorizations under fractions VIII and IX

summary: Telecommunications marketers must permit number portability.
quote: Permitir la portabilidad numérica

summary: Telecommunications marketers are responsible to end users for services offered and must comply with user-rights obligations of this Law.
quote: Ser responsable ante el usuario final por la prestación de los servicios que oferten

summary: Marketers must activate and keep active lines of end users who presented official identification (CURP or RFC for entities; name, nationality and passport for foreigners), per Commission guidelines, except emergency and citizen-service calls.
quote: Activar y mantener activo el servicio de aquellas líneas que estén asociadas a usuarios finales que hayan presentado una identificación oficial
conditional_on: end users presented official identification

summary: A preponderant telecommunications agent, or its group concessionaires, may not hold direct or indirect participation in a telecommunications marketer.
quote: no podrán participar de manera directa o indirecta en alguna empresa comercializadora de servicios
conditional_on: declared preponderant in telecommunications

summary: Commission must resolve requests for granting, modification or extension of authorizations within sixty business days; silence means denial.
quote: serán resueltas por la Comisión en un plazo no mayor a sesenta días hábiles siguientes a su presentación

summary: Commission must issue general provisions for dynamic spectrum access and shared use, including coexistence bands, detection mechanisms, databases, interference prevention and sharing conditions.
quote: la Comisión emitirá disposiciones de carácter general, las cuales deberán incluir, al menos, lo siguiente
conditional_on: temporary spectrum authorization for dynamic access and shared use

summary: Commission must resolve requests for temporary spectrum or orbital resource use within fifty business days, with emergencies handled as priority.
quote: La Comisión tendrá hasta cincuenta días hábiles para resolver sobre las solicitudes de autorización de uso temporal

summary: Requirements for temporary spectrum and orbital authorizations are set by Commission provisions.
quote: Los requisitos para obtener las autorizaciones a que se refiere el presente Capítulo se sujetarán a las disposiciones que al efecto emita la Comisión.

summary: Commission must create, keep and update the Public Concessions Registry, including concessions, authorizations, tariffs, control changes and sanctions that became final.
quote: La Comisión será la encargada de crear, llevar y mantener actualizado el Registro Público de Concesiones

summary: Commission registers information at no cost to concessionaires and authorized parties and publishes the registry online with search functions, without password.
quote: La Comisión inscribirá la información a que se refiere la presente Ley sin costo alguno para los concesionarios

summary: Any change to information in the registry under Article 170 must be notified to the Commission.
applies_from: within thirty business days after the change
quote: deberá ser notificada a la Comisión en un plazo no mayor de treinta días hábiles al que se realice el supuesto
conditional_on: change to registered information

summary: Concessionaires and authorized parties must provide the Commission, in writing and electronically, all data and documents it requests for the Telecommunications Public Registry.
quote: están obligados a poner a disposición de la Comisión en los términos que ésta determine
conditional_on: Commission request

summary: Commission must create and maintain a national geo-referenced database of active and passive infrastructure and public sites.
quote: La Comisión creará y mantendrá actualizada una base de datos nacional geo-referenciada

summary: Concessionaires must deliver active infrastructure and transmission means data for registration in the national infrastructure information system, at the periodicity set by the Commission.
quote: deberán entregar la información de infraestructura activa y medios de transmisión
conditional_on: Commission requirement

summary: Concessionaires and federal, state, municipal and autonomous bodies must deliver passive infrastructure and right-of-way data to the Commission, and contracts with third parties must secure this delivery.
quote: deberán entregar a la Comisión la información de infraestructura pasiva y derechos de vía

summary: Federal public bodies, autonomous organs, universities and public research centres must provide public-site and passive infrastructure data to the Commission.
quote: proporcionarán a la Comisión, la información de sitios públicos en términos de la Sección II

summary: Telecommunications concessionaires, authorized parties and application and content service providers must comply with written, reasoned orders from competent authorities.
quote: están obligados a atender todo mandamiento por escrito, fundado y motivado de la autoridad competente
conditional_on: written reasoned order from competent authority

summary: Security and justice bodies must designate public servants to receive requests from concessionaires, published by agreement in the Official Gazette.
quote: designarán a las personas servidoras públicas encargadas de gestionar los requerimientos

summary: Designated concessionaires must collaborate with security and justice authorities on real-time geographic location of terminal equipment, under Commission guidelines.
quote: Colaborar con las instancias de seguridad, procuración y administración de justicia en la localización geográfica, en tiempo real, de los equipos terminales
conditional_on: designated by the Commission

summary: Designated concessionaires must keep records of communications data (subscriber identity, communication type, origin and destination, date, time, duration, device identifiers, location) for twelve months in real-time accessible systems and twelve further months in storage.
quote: deberá conservar los datos referidos en el párrafo anterior durante los primeros doce meses
conditional_on: designated by the Commission

summary: Retained data must be protected against unauthorized access, alteration, destruction or cancellation, with authorized personnel controlled; personal data protection follows the private-sector personal data law.
quote: tomarán las medidas técnicas necesarias respecto de los datos objeto de conservación

summary: Retained data must be delivered to competent authorities within twenty-four hours of notification unless another authority provides otherwise.
quote: están obligados a entregar la información dentro de un plazo máximo de veinticuatro horas
conditional_on: request from competent authority

summary: Retained communications data may not be used for purposes other than those in the chapter.
quote: Queda prohibida la utilización de los datos conservados para fines distintos a los previstos en este Capítulo

summary: Designated concessionaires must maintain a responsible area available 24/7 for information, geolocation and interception requests, notify the responsible person and give 24 hours notice of any change.
quote: Contar con un área responsable disponible las veinticuatro horas del día y los trescientos sesenta y cinco días del año
conditional_on: designated by the Commission

summary: Designated concessionaires must establish expedited procedures for users to report theft or loss of mobile terminals and prove ownership.
quote: Establecer procedimientos expeditos para recibir los reportes de los usuarios del robo o extravío
conditional_on: designated by the Commission

summary: Suspend service of mobile terminals reported stolen or lost at the owner request, and immediately block lines reported stolen or lost or suspend them when ordered by the Commission or authority.
quote: Realizar el bloqueo inmediato de líneas de comunicación móvil
conditional_on: designated by the Commission

summary: Permanently cancel radio, data and image signals inside prisons and juvenile detention centres and cooperate with the national public security system on monitoring the blocking equipment.
quote: Realizar la cancelación o anulación permanente de las señales de radiocomunicación
conditional_on: designated by the Commission

summary: Implement a nationally harmonized single emergency number with location identification and emergency text messaging, as set by the Commission with public security.
quote: Implementar un número único armonizado a nivel nacional y, en su caso, mundial para servicios de emergencia
conditional_on: designated by the Commission

summary: Inform users promptly and free of charge of emergency and security service numbers, and provide free access to those services.
quote: Informar oportuna y gratuitamente a los usuarios el o los números telefónicos asociados a los servicios de seguridad y emergencia
conditional_on: designated by the Commission

summary: Give priority to communications in emergency situations, including broadcast of alert messages, as defined by the Commission.
quote: dar prioridad a las comunicaciones en situaciones de emergencia, incluyendo la difusión de mensajes de alerta
conditional_on: designated by the Commission

summary: Carry out, under Commission coordination, studies and research on technologies to inhibit misuse of telecommunications equipment for crime or national security threats, reporting results in an annual report.
quote: Realizar bajo la coordinación de la Comisión, los estudios e investigaciones que tengan por objeto
conditional_on: designated by the Commission

summary: Manufacture, sale, acquisition, installation, possession or operation of equipment that blocks or cancels cellular, radio or data signals is prohibited, with exceptions for prisons and national security.
quote: Queda prohibida la fabricación, comercialización, adquisición, así como la instalación, portación, uso y operación de equipos que bloqueen

summary: Concessionaires of Article 159 fraction I must give users a letter setting out their rights under this Law and the Consumer Protection Law, which may be sent electronically.
quote: deberán entregar a los usuarios una carta que contenga los derechos que esta Ley

summary: Users have a right to prior consent before additional services are charged, and to cancel them at any time.
quote: A que se requiera su consentimiento previo para el cobro de servicios adicionales a los originalmente contratados
conditional_on: charging of additional services beyond the original contract

summary: Users have a right not to receive unsolicited calls or messages from the provider for promotion or contract renewal, unless they expressly consent electronically.
quote: A no recibir llamadas ni mensajes no solicitados del concesionario o autorizado para la promoción de servicios

summary: PROFECO must verify that adhesion contracts set reasonable penalties for early cancellation or suspension, and that users can conclude and cancel contracts by quick mechanisms including electronic means.
quote: La PROFECO verificará que en los contratos de adhesión se establezcan penas razonables

summary: Contract clauses allowing unilateral modification or release from liability, shifting liability, shortening limitation periods, imposing formalities for actions, or waiving rights or consenting to foreign courts are null and void.
quote: Serán nulas de pleno derecho y se tendrán por no puestas las cláusulas que:

summary: Concessionaires and authorized parties must register adhesion contract models with PROFECO before using them.
applies_from: before use of the contract models
quote: deberán registrar ante la PROFECO, previamente a su utilización, los modelos de contratos de adhesión

summary: Secretariat of Economy, with PROFECO, must issue Official Mexican Standards setting specific obligations for concessionaires to protect user rights.
quote: La Secretaría de Economía emitirá las Normas Oficiales Mexicanas en coordinación con la PROFECO

summary: Concessionaires must inform and respect prices, rates, guarantees, penalties and other conditions offered to users and may not deny goods or services to anyone.
quote: están obligados a informar y respetar los precios, tarifas, garantías, penalidades

summary: Commission must issue rules requiring transparent, comparable and up-to-date publication of prices, termination costs and service access information.
quote: La Comisión emitirá las disposiciones que establezcan las condiciones para que los concesionarios

summary: Provide service in accordance with the terms and conditions offered or implied in advertising, unless otherwise agreed or consented in writing.
quote: están obligados a suministrar al usuario o suscriptor el servicio de acuerdo con los términos y condiciones ofrecidas

summary: Block content, applications or services at the express request of the user, without arbitrary extension to other content or providers.
quote: deberán bloquear contenidos, aplicaciones o servicios a petición expresa, escrita o grabada del usuario
conditional_on: user request

summary: Make a parental control service available on request and publish its operating characteristics and instructions.
quote: deberán tener disponible para los usuarios que lo soliciten, un servicio de control parental
conditional_on: user request

summary: PROFECO must promote equal access to telecommunications services for users with disabilities.
quote: La PROFECO promoverá que los usuarios con discapacidad, tengan acceso a los servicios de telecomunicaciones

summary: For users with disabilities: contracts shall be available in accessible formats, a device catalogue with accessibility features shall be offered by sellers, emergency numbers shall be accessible, and accessibility adaptations shall be provided where not disproportionate.
quote: la cual deberá contar con formatos que tengan funcionalidades de accesibilidad

summary: Government portals and applications must be built under universal design with accessibility functions.
quote: deberán ser construidos bajo el principio de diseño universal, con funciones de accesibilidad para personas con discapacidad

summary: Concessionaires must file electronically with the Commission their user tariffs before they take effect, with service description, application rules and penalties.
quote: deberán presentar solicitud electrónica de registro de sus tarifas a los usuarios, previo a su entrada en vigor
conditional_on: commercial or social use concessionaires

summary: A preponderant concessionaire may not give preferential treatment to its own services, including through subsidiaries, affiliates or group companies.
quote: no podrá otorgar trato preferencial a los servicios que ofrecen
conditional_on: declared preponderant agent

summary: Telecommunications concessionaires with duration-based charges must include per-second billing plans in their commercial offers.
quote: deberán incluir dentro de su oferta comercial, planes y tarifas, el cobro por segundo
conditional_on: services charged by duration offered to consumers

summary: Tariffs of preponderant or substantial-power telecom operators must be approved by the Commission and recorded in its registry.
quote: Estas tarifas deberán ser aprobadas por la Comisión
conditional_on: declared preponderant or with substantial power in telecommunications

summary: The preponderant agent in call and SMS termination may not impose different commercial conditions on its users, charge differently for calls from other networks, charge other concessionaires more than its own retail rates, or enter exclusivity deals for terminal equipment or points of sale.
quote: No podrá establecer a sus usuarios cargas o condiciones comerciales distintas en calidad y precio
conditional_on: preponderant agent in call and SMS termination

summary: Concessionaires must guarantee that subscribers can keep their numbers on request, independently of the provider, following Commission guidelines.
quote: Los concesionarios garantizarán, de conformidad con los lineamientos que a tal efecto apruebe la Comisión
conditional_on: subscriber request

summary: Concessionaires may not charge end users or subscribers any fee for number portability.
quote: Los concesionarios no podrán cobrar al usuario final o abonado cargo alguno por la portabilidad de su número.

summary: The Agency must prepare an annual social coverage programme and a public-site connectivity programme for priority areas.
quote: la Agencia elaborará cada año un programa de cobertura social y un programa de conectividad

summary: The Agency, with the Commission and INEGI, must define and publish indicators measuring the development of telecom and broadcasting services.
quote: definirá y publicará los indicadores que permitan medir la evolución de los servicios de telecomunicaciones

summary: Concessionaires in social coverage programmes in priority areas must report data to the Agency to measure progress and compliance.
quote: estarán obligados a reportar a la Agencia los datos que permitan cuantificar el avance de los programas
conditional_on: participation in social coverage programmes in priority areas

summary: The Secretariat of Science, Humanities, Technology and Innovation, with the Agency, must set administrative and technical mechanisms for financial and technical support to link public higher-education and research networks.
quote: establecerá los mecanismos administrativos y técnicos necesarios para otorgar apoyo financiero y técnico

summary: Federal Public Administration bodies must support the social coverage and public-site connectivity programmes and the Agency digital strategy.
quote: Las dependencias y entidades de la Administración Pública Federal deberán apoyar el desarrollo

summary: The Commission must supervise compliance with children's programming rules and monitor and sanction non-compliance with maximum advertising time limits.
quote: Vigilar y sancionar el incumplimiento de los tiempos máximos establecidos para la transmisión de mensajes comerciales

summary: The Secretariat of Government orders and administers the transmission of State time, supervises it and sanctions non-compliance, and must set specific rules for advertising in children's programming.
quote: Ordenar y administrar la transmisión de los tiempos de Estado en los términos previstos en esta Ley

summary: The Secretariat of Health must authorize advertising of medical practice and listed health products, including food supplements, medicines and medical equipment.
quote: Autorizar la transmisión de publicidad relativa al ejercicio de la medicina y sus actividades conexas
conditional_on: advertising of medical practice or listed products

summary: Authorities must promote respect for human rights, the best interest of children and gender perspective within their competence.
quote: Las autoridades en el ámbito de su competencia promoverán el respeto a los derechos humanos

summary: Programming broadcast over radio, TV or restricted services must promote family integration, child development, education, cultural values, sustainable development, gender equality and scientific knowledge.
quote: deberá propiciar:

summary: Each multiprogramming channel must comply with the same content, advertising, independent production, ombudsman, State time and sanctions rules as the main channel.
quote: se deberá cumplir con las mismas reglas y disposiciones aplicables en términos de contenido, publicidad

summary: Restricted TV and audio concessionaires must provide technical means allowing users to block channels and programmes they do not wish to receive.
quote: deberán establecer las medidas técnicas necesarias que permitan al usuario realizar el bloqueo de canales

summary: Radio programming aimed at children and adolescents must strengthen cultural and ethical values, avoid content promoting violence or discrimination, and inform on children's rights, among other duties listed.
quote: la programación radiodifundida dirigida a este sector de la población deberá:

summary: Broadcasters and programmers must take timely measures to warn audiences of content that may harm the free development of children and adolescents.
quote: adoptarán las medidas oportunas para advertir a la audiencia de contenidos que puedan perjudicar

summary: Restricted TV concessionaires must display programme titles and classification at the start and midpoint of programmes; programmers must comply with classification rules; electronic guides must show classification and schedules.
quote: deberá presentar en pantalla los títulos de los programas y su clasificación al inicio y a la mitad de los programas

summary: Broadcasters and programmers must make content classification known to the public and warn about content unsuitable for minors, including foreign material when classification is equivalent.
quote: deberán hacer del conocimiento del público la clasificación y advertir sobre determinados contenidos

summary: Broadcasting contests offering prizes must be previously authorized and supervised at all stages by the Secretariat of Government.
quote: será previamente autorizada y supervisada en todas sus etapas por la Secretaría de Gobernación
conditional_on: transmission or promotion of contests offering prizes

summary: Broadcasters with transmissions in foreign languages must use Spanish subtitles or translation, except as the Secretariat of Government authorizes exceptionally.
quote: deberá utilizarse el subtitulaje o la traducción respectiva al español
conditional_on: transmissions in a foreign language

summary: Broadcasters must include in daily programming information on political, social, cultural, sporting and other events of general interest.
quote: incluirán en su programación diaria información sobre acontecimientos de carácter político, social, cultural

summary: Restricted TV and audio concessionaires must free-retransmit federal public institution signals and reserve free channels for federal public institution TV signals in set numbers by channel count.
quote: deberán retransmitir de manera gratuita las señales radiodifundidas por instituciones públicas federales

summary: Restricted TV concessionaires must reserve free channels for federal public institution TV signals, in one, two or three channels depending on channel count.
quote: deberán reservar gratuitamente canales para la distribución de las señales de televisión de instituciones públicas federales

summary: Concessionaires must bear the cost of equipment and installations needed to receive and distribute government-designated signals, at quality at least equal to the rest of the service.
quote: El concesionario cubrirá por su cuenta el costo de los equipos e instalaciones necesarios para la recepción y distribución

summary: Commercial broadcasting must keep advertising within caps: eighteen percent of time per TV channel and forty percent per radio channel; restricted TV up to six minutes per hour per channel.
quote: el tiempo destinado a publicidad comercial no excederá del dieciocho por ciento del tiempo total de transmisión

summary: The Commission must implement a register of programmers and signal operators with legal representative and email details.
quote: La Comisión implementará un padrón de programadores y operadores de señales

summary: Disguised advertising presented as journalistic or news information is prohibited.
quote: se prohíbe la transmisión de publicidad o propaganda presentada como información periodística o noticiosa

summary: Broadcasters, restricted services, programmers and signal operators may not transmit propaganda or advertising of foreign governments, except cultural, tourism or sports promotion; digital platforms may not sell advertising space for such content.
quote: no podrán transmitir propaganda política, ideológica, comercial o de cualquier tipo de gobiernos extranjeros

summary: Restricted TV advertising for products or services not available in the national market must include visual or audio indication, and the concessionaire must include this in programmer contracts.
quote: deberá incluir recursos visuales o sonoros que indiquen tal circunstancia
conditional_on: advertising of products or services not available in the national market

summary: Broadcasters offering advertising space to any person must do so on market, non-discriminatory terms and may not restrict, deny or discriminate access to advertisers.
quote: no podrán restringir, negar o discriminar el acceso o contratación de espacios publicitarios a ningún anunciante

summary: Broadcasters must file minimum advertising tariffs with the Commission for registration in the Telecommunications Public Registry.
quote: presentar ante la Comisión para su inscripción en el Registro Público de Telecomunicaciones las tarifas mínimas respectivas

summary: Advertising of lotteries, raffles and draws is allowed only if previously authorized by the Secretariat of Government.
quote: Sólo podrá hacerse publicidad o anuncio de loterías, rifas y sorteos cuando éstos hayan sido previamente autorizados

summary: Advertising content must follow the classification system and air in the schedule slots set for it.
quote: Los contenidos de los mensajes publicitarios atenderán al sistema de clasificación

summary: Advertising may not depict the absence of a product or service as grounds for discrimination.
quote: La publicidad no deberá de presentar conductas o situaciones en las que la falta de un producto o servicio sea motivo de discriminación

summary: Advertising aimed at children may not promote illegal or violent conduct, harmful products, sexualize minors, exploit inexperience, directly urge purchases, promote discrimination or bullying, or contain subliminal messages.
quote: En la publicidad destinada al público infantil no se permitirá:

summary: Programming with personal performance must include a greater share of time covered by Mexicans.
quote: La programación diaria que utilice la actuación personal, deberá incluir un mayor tiempo cubierto por mexicanos.

summary: The Federal Executive must promote financing measures for national, independent national and indigenous and Afro-Mexican production.
quote: el Ejecutivo Federal impulsará medidas de financiamiento para estos sectores

summary: Commercial, public and social radio broadcasters must make free daily transmissions of up to thirty minutes per station and channel for educational, cultural and social-interest content, scheduled by the Secretariat of Government.
quote: deberán efectuar transmisiones gratuitas diarias en cada estación y por cada canal de programación

summary: Commercial, public and social broadcasters must broadcast the National Anthem at 6:24 and, for TV, the National Flag image simultaneously.
quote: estarán obligados a transmitir el Himno Nacional a las seis y veinticuatro horas

summary: Broadcasters must preferentially and free-of-charge transmit authority bulletins on national security, public order, emergencies, and distress messages for vessels and aircraft.
quote: están obligados a transmitir gratuitamente y de manera preferente

summary: Broadcasters must link radio stations and TV channels nationwide for information of national importance as judged by the Secretariat of Government.
quote: estarán obligados a encadenar las estaciones de radio y canales de televisión en el país
conditional_on: information of national importance as judged by the Secretariat of Government

summary: Broadcasters must draw up Codes of Ethics protecting audience rights, conforming to Commission guidelines that ensure freedom of expression and no prior censorship.
quote: deberán expedir Códigos de Ética con el objeto de proteger los derechos de las audiencias

summary: The Commission must promote conditions for audiences with disabilities to access broadcasting services on equal terms.
quote: La Comisión promoverá condiciones para que las audiencias con discapacidad, tengan acceso a los servicios de radiodifusión

summary: Broadcasters must provide Spanish subtitling, dubbing and Mexican Sign Language for audiences with disabilities in at least one major news and one children's programme, plus accessible programme guides.
quote: Contar con servicios de subtitulaje, doblaje al español y lengua de señas mexicana

summary: Radio broadcasters must establish an audience ombudsman (defensoría) and designate an ombudsman for three-year terms, renewable up to two times.
quote: Los concesionarios que presten el servicio de radiodifusión deberán contar con una defensoría de las audiencias.

summary: Audience ombudsmen and codes of ethics must be registered in the Public Concessions Registry, where they are publicly available.
quote: deberán inscribirse en el Registro Público de Concesiones

summary: Audience ombudsman candidates must be at least 30 years old, have relevant experience, have no disqualifying conviction and have not worked for the broadcaster in the prior two years.
quote: Para ser defensor de audiencias se deberá cumplir, con al menos los siguientes requisitos

summary: The ombudsman must answer complaints within twenty business days, and publish any recommendation or corrective action within twenty-four hours on the broadcaster website.
applies_from: within twenty business days for responses; within twenty-four hours for publication
quote: El defensor responderá al radioescucha o televidente en un plazo máximo de veinte días hábiles

summary: The competition authority may impose necessary measures on preponderant agents to prevent harm to competition and users.
quote: impondrá las medidas necesarias para evitar que se afecte la competencia

summary: The Commission must set criteria for measuring traffic and capacity of public telecom networks.
quote: La Comisión establecerá los criterios de medición de tráfico y capacidad de las redes públicas

summary: Where the competition authority imposes measures on a preponderant broadcaster, it must deliver separate accounts of broadcasting concessionaires to the Commission and the competition authority.
quote: Entregar a la Comisión y a la autoridad en materia de libre competencia y concurrencia la contabilidad separada
conditional_on: measures imposed by the competition authority

summary: Where imposed, a preponderant broadcaster must allow access and use of its passive infrastructure on non-discriminatory terms, with exceptions for concessionaires holding 12 MHz or more of spectrum.
quote: Permitir a los concesionarios de radiodifusión el acceso y uso de su infraestructura pasiva
conditional_on: measures imposed by the competition authority

summary: A preponderant broadcaster may not hold direct or indirect shares or control in the preponderant telecom agent.
quote: Abstenerse de participar de manera directa o indirecta en el capital social, administración o control del Agente Económico Preponderante en telecomunicaciones
conditional_on: measures imposed by the competition authority

summary: A preponderant telecom agent must submit annual or multi-year public reference offers for interconnection, user roaming, passive infrastructure sharing, unbundling, access and wholesale resale for Commission approval.
quote: Someter para aprobación de la Comisión de manera anual o multianual, según lo determine la Comisión, las ofertas públicas de referencia
conditional_on: measures imposed by the competition authority

summary: A preponderant telecom agent must submit for Commission authorization its tariffs for public services, intermediate services and operations, disaggregated and without cross-subsidies, with public disclosure of the Commission opinion.
quote: Presentar para la autorización de la Comisión las tarifas que aplica
conditional_on: measures imposed by the competition authority

summary: A preponderant telecom agent may not discriminate between its own network traffic and that of other public network concessionaires.
quote: No podrán discriminar entre el tráfico de su propia red y el tráfico de los demás concesionarios
conditional_on: measures imposed by the competition authority

summary: A preponderant telecom agent must give the Commission and competition authority detailed separate accounts by service, with the cost catalogue of its companies and implicit discounts and cross-subsidies.
quote: Proporcionar a la Comisión y a la autoridad en materia de libre competencia y concurrencia información contable separada por servicio
conditional_on: measures imposed by the competition authority

summary: A preponderant telecom agent must provide services to other public network concessionaires on the same terms, conditions and quality as to itself, serving competitors in order of request.
quote: Ofrecer y proveer los servicios a los concesionarios de redes públicas de telecomunicaciones en los mismos términos, condiciones y calidad
conditional_on: measures imposed by the competition authority

summary: Public reference offers must be submitted in July, published by the first fifteen days of December and take effect on 1 January.
applies_from: offers submitted in July; published in first fifteen days of December; effective 1 January
quote: las ofertas públicas deberán presentarse a la Comisión en el mes de julio

summary: After public consultation of twenty business days, the Commission has twenty business days to approve or modify reference offers.
quote: la Comisión contará con veinte días hábiles para aprobar o modificar la oferta

summary: A preponderant telecom agent must submit annually or multi-year public reference offers for passive infrastructure sharing and local network unbundling for Commission approval by 30 June.
