quote: Someter a la aprobación de la Comisión, de forma anual o multianual, según determine la Comisión, y a más tardar el 30 de junio del año que corresponda
conditional_on: measures imposed by the competition authority

summary: A preponderant telecom agent must, at its own cost, create and implement processes and systems needed for efficient unbundling, including fault reporting, co-location, quality levels, billing and equipment testing.
quote: Realizar a su costa la creación, desarrollo y la implantación de procesos, sistemas, instalaciones
conditional_on: measures imposed by the competition authority

summary: A preponderant telecom agent must give other public network concessionaires disaggregated access to elements, infrastructure and functions of its network on non-discriminatory terms, not exceeding Commission-set tariffs, if so imposed.
quote: Permitir a otros concesionarios de redes públicas de telecomunicaciones el acceso de manera desagregada
conditional_on: measures imposed by the competition authority

summary: A preponderant telecom agent must allow concessionaires and authorized parties to resell its mobile services in their concession areas, on the same payment modalities and in competitive conditions.
quote: deberá permitir a los concesionarios y a los autorizados a comercializar servicios de telecomunicaciones en el ámbito geográfico de su concesión

summary: A preponderant telecom agent must allow resellers to choose the infrastructure and platform for their business model and integrate it with its systems.
quote: deberá permitir a los concesionarios y a los autorizados a comercializar servicios de telecomunicaciones, seleccionar la infraestructura y plataforma

summary: Wholesale prices for preponderant telecom agent services must be supported by a methodology allowing resellers a reasonable margin, and wholesale traffic may not be discriminated against.
quote: deberá estar soportado en una metodología que le permita al concesionario o al autorizado vender los mismos servicios

summary: Tariffs, conditions and promotions applied by the preponderant telecom agent to resellers must be authorized by the Commission.
quote: deberán ser autorizadas por la Comisión

summary: Interconnection agreements with the preponderant agent must allow the reseller to hold and manage its own numbering, port users to other concessionaires, and pursue its business model.
quote: En el convenio se deberá permitir al concesionario y, en su caso, al autorizado

summary: The competition authority must analyse, evaluate and approve a preponderant agent divestiture plan within ninety business days, extendable once by ninety days, with a technical opinion from the Commission.
applies_from: within ninety business days after submission, extendable once by ninety days
quote: analizará, evaluará y, en su caso, aprobará el plan propuesto dentro de los noventa días hábiles siguientes a su presentación
conditional_on: preponderant agent submits a divestiture or separation plan

summary: Preponderant agents may bid for spectrum licences only when the competition authority authorizes it and within spectrum accumulation limits.
quote: cuando lo autorice la autoridad en materia de libre competencia y concurrencia y se apeguen a los límites de acumulación de espectro radioeléctrico que al efecto determine.
conditional_on: authorization by the competition authority

summary: The Commission must apply competition-promotion measures for television, radio, telephony and data services across all segments.
quote: deberán aplicarse por la Comisión en todos los segmentos

summary: Products and equipment for telecommunications or broadcasting that connect to a network or use spectrum must be homologated under applicable standards and the Law on Quality Infrastructure.
quote: deberán homologarse conforme a las normas o disposiciones técnicas aplicables
conditional_on: products connecting to a telecommunications network or using the radio spectrum

summary: Applicants for homologation of products evaluated abroad must have a domicile in Mexico.
quote: deberá contar con domicilio en los Estados Unidos Mexicanos
conditional_on: reciprocal recognition of conformity assessment abroad

summary: The Commission must issue, publish and keep updated the homologation procedures and guidelines, and address any objection on the homologation procedure.
quote: La Comisión elaborará, publicará y mantendrá actualizados los procedimientos y lineamientos aplicables a la homologación

summary: Concessionaires must deliver unlocked mobile terminal equipment, in prepaid and postpaid plans, directly or through third parties, under Commission guidelines.
quote: deberán entregar por sí o a través de terceros, los equipos terminales móviles desbloqueados

summary: Concessionaires must refrain from exclusivity contracts with points of sale and distribution of terminal equipment, including airtime and balance recharge outlets, that block other concessionaires.

summary: The state company or project developers must prepare and submit to the Secretaría a Manifestación de Impacto Social del Sector Energético with the content listed in Art. 136 I-IV.
quote: deben elaborar y presentar a la Secretaría la Manifestación de Impacto Social del Sector Energético

summary: The state company or project developers must request authorization of the social impact statement, except in the cases listed in Art. 137.
quote: deben presentar a la Secretaría, la solicitud de autorización de la Manifestación de Impacto Social
conditional_on: except cases in Art. 137

summary: Definitive authorisation of the social impact statement is required before infrastructure development linked to the project may begin.
quote: es necesaria la autorización definitiva de la Manifestación de Impacto Social del Sector Energético
conditional_on: before start of infrastructure development linked to the project

summary: The Secretaría must make the social impact statement available to the public under the Reglamento.
quote: La Secretaría debe poner a disposición del público la Manifestación de Impacto Social del Sector Energético

summary: The Secretaría must issue its decision on the social impact statement within ninety calendar days, granting authorisation outright, conditionally, or refusing it.
quote: debe emitir la autorización de la Manifestación de Impacto Social del Sector Energético en un término no mayor a noventa días naturales

summary: Conditions attached to authorisations must include an annual report to the Secretaría on implementation of the social management plan.
quote: Presentar a la Secretaría un informe anual de la implementación del Plan de Gestión Social

summary: Project holders must keep updated project information for five years and present it when the Secretaría requires; they must also notify changes to the authorised project.
quote: Conservar para los fines que establezca la Secretaría, y por un periodo de cinco años

summary: The Secretaría must verify compliance with the conditions of social impact authorisations and the obligations in the applicable regulations.
quote: La Secretaría debe verificar el cumplimiento de los términos y condicionantes de las autorizaciones

summary: The Secretaría must implement mechanisms for energy source diversification, energy transition and promotion of clean energy, and establish instruments to measure decarbonisation.
quote: La Secretaría debe implementar mecanismos que permitan la diversificación de fuentes de energía

summary: Requirements for acquiring clean energy certificates must be set as a proportion of electricity consumed in load centres, under binding planning.
quote: Los requisitos para adquirir Certificados de Energías Limpias se deben establecer como una proporción

summary: Retailers, qualified users and end users supplied by self-consumption are subject to energy transition and decarbonisation obligations under the Ley and sector regulation.
quote: están sujetos al cumplimiento de las obligaciones para la transición energética y descarbonización

summary: In the first four months of each calendar year the Secretaría must set clean energy certificate requirements for the following three years.
applies_from: first four months of each calendar year
quote: En el primer cuatrimestre de cada año calendario, la Secretaría debe establecer los requisitos

summary: The applicable regulation must make clean energy certificates negotiable, encourage long-term hedging contracts including them, and allow transfer of surplus or deficit certificates between periods.
quote: La regulación aplicable debe permitir que estos certificados sean negociables

summary: The CNE must grant the appropriate clean energy certificates, issue rules to validate their ownership and verify compliance with those obligations.
quote: La CNE debe otorgar los Certificados de Energías Limpias que correspondan

summary: The Secretaría issues general provisions on clean energy certificates, energy transition and decarbonisation.
quote: Corresponde a la Secretaría la emisión de disposiciones de carácter general en materia de Certificados de Energías Limpias

summary: The CNE must create and maintain the Certificate Registry, recording each certificate's issue date, validity and ownership history.
quote: La CNE debe crear y mantener el Registro de Certificados

summary: The Secretaría de Medio Ambiente y Recursos Naturales must set emission-reduction obligations for the electricity sector through Normas Oficiales Mexicanas.
quote: La Secretaría de Medio Ambiente y Recursos Naturales debe establecer, a través de Normas Oficiales Mexicanas

summary: Permit holders must be natural or legal persons constituted under Mexican law.
quote: Los permisionarios deben ser personas físicas o morales constituidas conforme a las leyes mexicanas

summary: Applicants for generation and commercialization permits must file the application with proof of fees, legal, technical and financial capacity, and a project description.
quote: Para su otorgamiento los interesados deben presentar la solicitud correspondiente

summary: The Secretaría must establish the policy on efficiency, quality, reliability, continuity, safety and sustainability of the national electric system.
quote: La Secretaría debe establecer la política en materia de eficiencia, Calidad, Confiabilidad

summary: Electricity sector members may not apply technical reference specifications other than those issued or authorised by the Secretaría.
quote: no pueden aplicar especificaciones técnicas de referencia distintas a la regulación

summary: Inspection units referred to in Art. 48 must be accredited under the Ley de Infraestructura de la Calidad and approved by the CNE to certify compliance with Normas Oficiales Mexicanas.
quote: las unidades de inspección a que se refiere el artículo 48 de esta Ley deben ser acreditadas

summary: When CENACE deems a plant with a scheduled retirement necessary for reliability, the generator representing it must offer its capacity, energy and ancillary services in the procurement mechanism at cost-based terms.
quote: la Generadora que la represente está obligada a ofrecer su potencia, energía y Servicios Conexos
conditional_on: CENACE deems the scheduled-retirement plant necessary for reliability

summary: Transmission, distribution, basic supply, last-resort supply and CENACE operating costs must be subject to regulatory accounting, and the entities must submit the information the CNE determines.
quote: están obligadas a presentar la información que la CNE determine

summary: The CNE must publish the calculation memoranda used to determine tariffs and prices.
quote: La CNE debe publicar las memorias de cálculo usadas para determinar dichas tarifas y precios

summary: For expansion and modernization of the transmission and distribution networks, the CNE must determine tariff methodologies under the applicable provisions.
quote: la CNE debe determinar las metodologías tarifarias

summary: Regulated tariff determination and service provision may not be conditioned on the purchase of unnecessary products or services.
quote: no debe condicionarse a la adquisición de productos o servicios innecesarios

summary: The transmission company, distribution company, basic supplier and CENACE must publish their tariffs as the CNE establishes; any tariff change automatically modifies supply contracts.
quote: deben publicar sus tarifas en los términos que al efecto establezca la CNE

summary: The Federal Government must pay compensation for actual damages and losses to persons affected by a requisition, except in international war or armed conflict; if no agreement exists, experts set the amounts.
quote: debe indemnizar a las personas afectadas pagando los daños y perjuicios a su valor real
conditional_on: requisition under Art. 174, excluding international war or armed conflict

summary: Costs, revenues and profit margins agreed in contracts of the Empresa Pública del Estado (and affiliates) must be public, broken down in detail, except information that endangers the continuity, security or accessibility of the national electricity system.
quote: deben ser públicos los costos, ingresos y márgenes de utilidad previstos por las partes en los contratos

summary: Electricity sector participants must provide the Secretaría, CNE and CENACE with all information they require for their functions, including data to assess sector performance; the agencies may issue data-collection formats and requirements.
quote: están obligadas a proporcionar a la Secretaría, a la CNE y al CENACE toda la información que éstos requieran

summary: Electricity sector participants must give verifiers access to their installations and facilities, deliver the information and documentation required, and permit verification, inspection or surveillance visits ordered by competent authorities.
quote: están obligadas a permitir a los verificadores el acceso a sus instalaciones

summary: The Secretaría and CNE, within their respective powers, must verify compliance with the Law, its regulations, the permits granted and applicable provisions.
quote: deben verificar el cumplimiento de esta Ley

summary: Authorities and CENACE must protect confidential or reserved information received from electricity sector participants, including when used by their contractors or external experts.
quote: Las autoridades y el CENACE deben proteger la información confidencial o reservada

summary: The Secretaría, CNE and CENACE must facilitate transparency of information in the Mercado Eléctrico Mayorista, taking into account public interest, market integrity and efficiency, economic competition and consumer protection.
quote: deben facilitar la transparencia de la información en el Mercado Eléctrico Mayorista

summary: The CNE must establish the modalities and minimum information that sector participants must make public.
quote: La CNE debe establecer las modalidades y la información mínima que deben hacer pública

summary: Electricity sector participants must make public the minimum information set by the CNE.
quote: la información mínima que deben hacer pública las personas integrantes del sector eléctrico
conditional_on: Minimum information as set by the CNE under Art. 178, para. 2.

summary: CENACE must publish reports on the performance and evolution of the Mercado Eléctrico Mayorista.
quote: los informes sobre el desempeño y evolución del Mercado Eléctrico Mayorista que debe publicar el CENACE

summary: The CNE, and the experts or body it designates, must issue their own reports on the performance and evolution of the wholesale market and may require information needed to monitor it.
quote: deben emitir informes propios sobre el desempeño y evolución del Mercado Eléctrico Mayorista

summary: CENACE must publish wholesale market offers within 60 natural days after the day concerned, subject to terms defined by the CNE.
applies_from: Within 60 natural days following the day concerned
quote: Las ofertas en el Mercado Eléctrico Mayorista se deben publicar por el CENACE dentro de los 60 días naturales
conditional_on: Subject to the terms defined by the CNE.

summary: CENACE must make available to Market Participants, within 7 natural days, the complete models used to calculate wholesale market prices, the availability of plant and network elements, and the models used for grid expansion programmes; it must also provide requesters the models and studies for interconnection or load connection infrastructure.
applies_from: Within 7 natural days after the day of determination
quote: El CENACE debe poner a disposición de los Participantes del Mercado dentro de los 7 días naturales siguientes

summary: The Secretaría must determine criteria and procedures for user control of access to the market information listed in Art. 179.
quote: La Secretaría debe determinar criterios y procedimientos de control de usuarios para el acceso a esta información

summary: The Secretaría must establish and maintain a free public website publishing and keeping updated the contracts, agreements and annexes of the Empresa Pública del Estado and state companies relating to the electricity sector, and other information it determines.
quote: La Secretaría debe establecer y mantener un sitio de Internet, de acceso libre al público en general

summary: The Secretaría must promote that holders of permits under the former electricity law can request migration to the Law's figures expeditiously, and must instruct sector institutions to set up a single window (ventanilla única) for processing.
quote: La Secretaría debe promover que personas titulares de los permisos al amparo de la Ley del Servicio Público de Energía Eléctrica

summary: The Secretaría must issue guidelines regulating the expedited migration procedure.
quote: la Secretaría debe emitir los lineamientos que regulen el procedimiento expedito de migración

summary: Holders and members of self-supply companies, cogeneration establishments and interconnection contracts under the former law that wish to participate in the wholesale market as generators must migrate all their capacity to the generation figures of this Law and enter contracts subject to the Market Rules.
quote: deben migrar la totalidad de su capacidad a las figuras de generación de la presente Ley
conditional_on: If they wish to participate in the Mercado Eléctrico Mayorista as Generadora.

summary: The Secretaría must issue guidelines for the expedited migration procedure for holders of permits and contracts under the former Electricity Industry Law, and instruct sector institutions to set up a single window.
quote: la Secretaría debe emitir los lineamientos que regulen el procedimiento expedito de migración

summary: The Empresa Pública del Estado must keep its nominations and offers activities for the wholesale market separated, and maintain operational and functional separation so that generation, Basic Supply, transmission and distribution activities operate in differentiated ways, as listed in the transitional provision.
quote: la Empresa Pública del Estado debe mantener la separación de sus actividades en materia de nominaciones y ofertas

summary: CENACE must establish differentiated memorandum accounts for each horizontal segment to maintain the integrity of settlement, invoicing and collection processes.
quote: el CENACE debe establecer cuentas de orden diferenciadas por cada segmento horizontal

summary: Authorisation, approval or permit applications received before the Law's entry into force must be processed under the law in force when they were filed.
quote: se deben tramitar conforme a las disposiciones jurídicas vigentes al momento de su ingreso

summary: The CNE must review the tariff methodology and the costs of the CENACE's operation, research, updating and development services under Arts. 116 and 158, with effect once issued.
applies_from: A la entrada en vigor de la presente Ley
quote: la CNE debe revisar la metodología tarifaria y los costos del servicio de operación

summary: The CNE must review and update the transmission methodologies and the regulated tariff methodologies for the Public Transmission Service within 180 days of entry into force.
applies_from: Within the first 180 days after entry into force
quote: la CNE debe revisar y actualizar las metodologías de transmisión

summary: The Cámara de Diputados must make the budget provisions necessary so that agencies and entities can carry out the powers granted in the Decree.
quote: La Cámara de Diputados debe realizar las previsiones presupuestales necesarias

summary: Taxpayers (personas morales and personas físicas named in Art. Primero) must meet cumulative requirements to obtain the incentive: RFC registration with buzón tributario, positive tax compliance opinion, submission of the investment project and SEP dual-education agreement (and patent or initial certification project where applicable), a constancia de cumplimiento from the Comité de Evaluación, and compliance with its guidelines.
applies_from: Investments acquired from the date of entry into force of the decree until 30 September 2030 (Art. Primero, first paragraph of the incentive).
provision: Art. Primero, fracciones I a V
quote: siempre que cumplan, entre otros, los siguientes requisitos
conditional_on: Applies to the taxpayers that elect the immediate deduction under Art. Primero.

summary: Taxpayers electing the immediate deduction must keep a specific register of the investments, with supporting documentation, type of asset, link to principal activity, process in which used, applied percentage, year of deduction and date of disposal, loss or obsolescence.
provision: Art. Primero, cuarto párrafo del estímulo
quote: Los contribuyentes deben llevar un registro específico de las inversiones por las que optó por aplicar la deducción inmediata
conditional_on: Applies to taxpayers that opt for the immediate deduction of new fixed assets under Art. Primero.

summary: The immediate deduction applies only to investments kept in use for a minimum of two years after the year of deduction (exceptions under Art. 37 LISR), and only to new fixed assets acquired for exclusive use in the taxpayer's activities; listed assets (office furniture, internal-combustion automobiles, armour equipment, non-individually identifiable assets, aircraft other than agricultural spraying) are excluded.
provision: Art. Primero, párrafos segundo y tercero del estímulo
quote: solo será aplicable respecto de aquellas inversiones que los contribuyentes mantengan en uso durante un periodo mínimo de dos años inmediatos siguientes
conditional_on: Applies to investments made under the immediate deduction in Art. Primero.

summary: Taxpayers applying the immediate deduction must compute the provisional-payment profit coefficient by adding the deduction to taxable profit or reducing the tax loss for the relevant year, must spread the deducted amount evenly over provisional payments from the month of investment, and must not recalculate the coefficient under Art. 14 fracción I LISR.
applies_from: Fiscal years 2025 to 2030 (deduction years) and provisional payments of 2026 to 2031.
provision: Art. Primero, tercer y cuarto párrafos del estímulo
quote: deben calcular el coeficiente de utilidad de los pagos provisionales que se efectúen durante el ejercicio fiscal de 2026
conditional_on: Applies to taxpayers that apply the immediate deduction in fiscal years 2025 to 2030.

summary: Taxpayers with two or more activities listed in Art. Segundo fracción II must apply the percentage for the activity that produced most of their income in the year of the deduction.
applies_from: Fiscal year in which the immediate deduction is applied.
provision: Art. Segundo, fracción II, párrafo final
quote: se debe aplicar el porciento que le corresponda a la actividad en la que hubiera obtenido la mayor parte de sus ingresos
conditional_on: Applies to taxpayers engaged in two or more activities listed in Art. Segundo, fracción II.

summary: Taxpayers that opt for the immediate deduction must follow the adjustment, disposal and deduction rules of Art. Tercero, including inflation-factor adjustment of the original investment and the annual deduction schedules for disposed or lost assets.
quote: Los contribuyentes que ejerzan la opción establecida en el artículo Primero de este decreto, por los bienes a los que la aplicaron, deben estar a lo siguiente
conditional_on: Applies to taxpayers that exercise the option in Art. Primero for the assets to which they applied it.

summary: Taxpayers claiming the additional training or innovation deduction must register the specific training or investment projects under the guidelines issued under Art. Primero.
quote: Los contribuyentes deben realizar el registro específico de la capacitación o de los proyectos de inversión
conditional_on: Applies to taxpayers claiming the additional deduction in Art. Cuarto.

summary: The additional training deduction applies only to training given to active workers registered with the Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social, under the guidelines issued under Art. Primero; taxpayers that do not claim it in the year of the expense lose the right in later years.
quote: sólo será procedente respecto de la capacitación proporcionada por los contribuyentes a sus trabajadores activos registrados ante el Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social
conditional_on: Applies to taxpayers claiming the additional deduction in Art. Cuarto.

summary: Creates the Comité de Evaluación for the incentives, composed of representatives of the Secretaría de Economía, the Consejo Asesor de Desarrollo Económico Regional y Relocalización (voice without vote) and the Secretaría de Hacienda y Crédito Público, which presides and has casting vote.
quote: Se crea el Comité de Evaluación para la aplicación de los estímulos fiscales a que se refiere el presente decreto.

summary: The Comité de Evaluación must determine, for each fiscal year, the maximum amount of incentives that taxpayers may apply for each incentive, under the guidelines.
quote: El comité determinará para cada ejercicio fiscal, el monto máximo que los contribuyentes podrán aplicar

summary: Integration, powers, quorum, sessions, decisions, procedure, criteria and eligibility parameters of the Comité de Evaluación, including the constancia procedure, are to be set in guidelines (lineamientos) under Art. Primero.
quote: se establecerán en los lineamientos a que se refiere dicho artículo Primero

summary: Taxpayers in listed situations may not apply the incentives: those in the Código Fiscal de la Federación presumption and listing situations (arts. 69, 69-B, 69-B Bis), those with final tax claims not guaranteed, those without compliance with decree requirements, those in liquidation, those with restricted or cancelled digital seals or certificates, and those breaching the guidelines.
quote: No pueden aplicar los estímulos fiscales previstos en el presente decreto los contribuyentes que se encuentren en cualquiera de los siguientes supuestos
conditional_on: Applies to any taxpayer falling within one of the nine listed situations.

summary: The Servicio de Administración Tributaria may issue general rules necessary for the proper application of the decree.
quote: El Servicio de Administración Tributaria podrá emitir las reglas de carácter general necesarias para la debida y correcta aplicación de este decreto.

summary: The Comité de Evaluación must issue and publish in the Diario Oficial de la Federación the guidelines referred to in Art. Primero.
applies_from: Within 60 natural days counted from publication of the decree in the Diario Oficial de la Federación.
quote: El Comité de Evaluación deberá emitir y publicar en el Diario Oficial de la Federación, los lineamientos a que se refiere el artículo Primero de este decreto

summary: Taxpayers (individuals and companies resident in Mexico, or non-residents with a permanent establishment) that start operations after the decree enters into force and carry out productive activities inside the Polos qualify for the stated fiscal incentives.
applies_from: from the decree's entry into force (PRIMERO transitorio: day of publication in the DOF)
quote: que inicien operaciones con posterioridad a la entrada en vigor del presente decreto y realicen actividades económicas productivas al interior de los Polos de Desarrollo Económico para el Bienestar
conditional_on: starting operations after entry into force and carrying out productive activities inside a Polo de Desarrollo Económico para el Bienestar

summary: The Secretaría de Economía must issue and publish in the DOF the declaratoria of each Polo, after determining its viability, taking into account the committee's collegiate opinion; it may issue the declaratoria directly when the Polo's nature requires it.
applies_from: once the viability of the Polo is determined
quote: La Secretaría de Economía emitirá y publicará en el Diario Oficial de la Federación la declaratoria de los Polos de Desarrollo Económico para el Bienestar
conditional_on: determination of the Polo's viability

summary: Companies taxed under Título II or Título VII, Capítulo XII of the ISR law that hold an authorization as developers of a Polo may apply the incentives of Articles Tercero and Cuarto.
applies_from: upon obtaining the authorization as developer
quote: que hayan obtenido autorización que los acredite como desarrolladores de un Polo de Desarrollo Económico para el Bienestar, podrán aplicar los estímulos fiscales
conditional_on: holding an authorization accrediting the company as developer of a Polo de Desarrollo Económico para el Bienestar

summary: Taxpayers and developers seeking the incentives must comply with listed requirements: be current on tax obligations with a positive compliance opinion under CFF Art. 32-D; have fiscal domicile in the Polo; for the Art. Cuarto incentive, hold a collaboration agreement with the SEP on dual education or an invention/patent or initial-certification investment project. Developers must meet items I and III and present the state-issued authorization. Upon non-compliance, the incentives cease from the time of the breach.
quote: deben cumplir con los siguientes requisitos
conditional_on: claiming the incentives under the decree

summary: Taxpayers and developers that fail a requirement must stop applying the incentives from the date of the breach and pay the tax, inflation adjustment and surcharges due under the applicable law.
applies_from: from the moment the non-compliance occurs
quote: debiendo cubrir el impuesto, la actualización y los recargos correspondientes
conditional_on: failure to meet any requirement of the decree

summary: Taxpayers may apply the 100% immediate deduction only for new fixed-asset goods used exclusively inside the Polos, and only for investments kept in use for at least two years after the year of the deduction; goods not individually identifiable, office furniture, combustion-engine cars and armoured car equipment are excluded from the option.
applies_from: for goods acquired from the date the state signs the coordination agreement until 30 September 2030
quote: que se realicen exclusivamente al interior de los referidos polos
conditional_on: goods are new (first used in Mexico), used exclusively inside the Polos, and kept in use for at least two years

summary: Taxpayers (not developers) may apply the immediate deduction to goods acquired from the date the state signs the coordination agreement under Art. Décimo until 30 September 2030.
applies_from: from the date the entidad federativa signs the convenio de coordinación (Art. Décimo) until 30 September 2030
quote: que se hayan adquirido a partir de que la entidad federativa celebre el convenio de coordinación a que se refiere el artículo Décimo de este decreto y hasta el 30 de septiembre de 2030
conditional_on: signing of the coordination agreement by the state

summary: Developers may apply the immediate deduction to goods acquired from the date the state authorizes them under Art. Décimo Primero until 30 September 2030.
applies_from: from the date the developer is authorized by the state until 30 September 2030
quote: Los desarrolladores aplicarán el estímulo a que se refiere este artículo respecto de aquellos bienes que se hayan adquirido a partir de que hayan sido autorizados por la entidad federativa
conditional_on: authorization of the developer by the entidad federativa

summary: On transfer of property of goods deducted immediately, the taxpayer must accumulate the greater of the transfer income and the arm's-length value; deducted amounts must be added to or subtracted from the relevant tax profit or loss and are reduced in provisional payments as the text sets out.
applies_from: on transfer of the goods, and in each fiscal year of deduction
quote: se deberá acumular el monto que resulte mayor entre el total de los ingresos obtenidos por la transmisión de propiedad
conditional_on: the immediate deduction has been applied to the goods

summary: Taxpayers and developers must keep a specific register of investments for which the immediate deduction was chosen, with supporting documents, asset description, link to activities in the Polo, the process where the asset is used, the year of deduction and the disposal date if any, under SAT general rules.
quote: deben llevar un registro específico de las inversiones por las que se optó por aplicar la deducción inmediata
conditional_on: choosing the immediate deduction for investments

summary: The additional deduction for training expenses applies only to training given to active workers registered with the IMSS, and only where the taxpayer or developer has an education program authorized by the SEP. Taxpayers that do not apply the additional deduction in the year of the expense lose the right to apply it later.
quote: sólo será procedente respecto de la capacitación proporcionada por los contribuyentes o los desarrolladores a sus trabajadores activos registrados ante el Instituto Mexicano del Seguro Social
conditional_on: claiming the additional training deduction under Art. Cuarto

summary: Taxpayers and developers must keep a specific accounting record of training expenses and of invention or initial-certification investment projects, with supporting documents, describing the training or project and its relation to Polo activities, under SAT general rules.
applies_from: during the fiscal year in which the additional deduction is claimed
quote: deben realizar el registro específico en su contabilidad de los gastos de capacitación
conditional_on: claiming the additional deduction under Art. Cuarto

summary: For the incentives of Arts. Tercero and Cuarto, taxpayers must determine the ISR and provisional payments under the cited ISR articles, considering only income attributable to Polo activities and strictly necessary deductions; any loss is offset only against income from Polo activities; other income is taxed separately without the incentives.
applies_from: for each fiscal year in which the incentives are applied
quote: deben determinar el impuesto sobre la renta causado en el ejercicio y sus pagos provisionales
conditional_on: applying the incentives under Arts. Tercero and Cuarto

summary: Taxpayers and developers must file their required tax returns and make payments through the systems the SAT provides.
applies_from: per the applicable tax filing deadlines
quote: deben presentar las declaraciones a las que se encuentren obligados a través de los sistemas que disponga el Servicio de Administración Tributaria
conditional_on: being obligated to file returns

summary: Taxpayers and developers may not combine the incentives of this decree with the listed ISR regimes and incentives: Arts. 181-182, the group-of-companies regime, Arts. 187-188 (real estate trusts), Arts. 189, 190, 202 and 203, and the 21 January 2025 Plan México incentive decree.
applies_from: from the decree's entry into force
quote: no podrán aplicar conjuntamente
conditional_on: applying the incentives under this decree

summary: The incentives do not apply to taxpayers or developers in listed situations: listed as presumed-invoice issuers under CFF Art. 69 or Art. 69-B presumption, with unresolved tax credits without adequate guarantee, in liquidation, subject to temporary restriction or cancellation of digital seals or certificates, or not meeting decree requirements including the specific investment and training registers.
applies_from: from the decree's entry into force
quote: No procederá la aplicación de los estímulos fiscales establecidos en este decreto cuando los contribuyentes o desarrolladores se encuentren en cualquiera de los siguientes supuestos
conditional_on: falling within one of the listed situations

summary: The Comité Intersecretarial de Promoción (chaired by the SE, with representatives of SHCP, SEDATU, SENER and SEMARNAT, and permanent invitees CFE, CONAGUA and the Consejo Asesor) must issue a collegiate opinion to the SE on whether to declare each Polo, and must consider the viability opinions of its members and the land-surface proposals.
applies_from: from the decree's entry into force
quote: El comité tiene como objeto emitir un dictamen colegiado
conditional_on: a Polo declaration is being considered

summary: The Comité Intersecretarial de Promoción must issue guidelines (lineamientos) covering its composition, powers, quorum, session rules, land-selection criteria and the tender calls of the states.
quote: el comité emitirá los lineamientos en los que establecerá

summary: Entidades federativas that propose a land surface to become a Polo must enter into a coordination agreement with the Secretaría de Economía under the Ley de Planeación and meet the requirements of the committee's guidelines.
applies_from: once the declaratoria is issued, as the guidelines set
quote: deben celebrar un convenio de coordinación con la Secretaría de Economía
conditional_on: the state proposes a land surface to be declared a Polo

summary: Where the state does not opt for direct assignment of the developer authorization, it must issue public calls in the DOF and hold public tenders under the committee's guidelines.
applies_from: when the state uses public tender rather than direct assignment
quote: emitirán convocatorias públicas en el Diario Oficial de la Federación y realizarán concursos públicos
conditional_on: the state does not opt for direct assignment

summary: The SAT must issue general rules needed for the correct application of the incentives and of the other provisions of the decree.
quote: El Servicio de Administración Tributaria debe emitir las reglas de carácter general

summary: The Comité Intersecretarial de Promoción must issue and publish in the DOF the Polo guidelines within 30 natural days of the decree's publication.
applies_from: within 30 días naturales after publication of the decree
quote: deberá emitir y publicar en el Diario Oficial de la Federación los lineamientos
conditional_on: publication of the decree

summary: Costs arising from the decree's entry into force must be met from the approved budget of the competent agencies and entities for the current and later fiscal years; no budget extensions will be authorized.
applies_from: from the decree's entry into force
quote: deben cubrirse con cargo al presupuesto aprobado

summary: Secretaría must notify electronically only with the express acceptance of the person to be notified.
quote: se debe contar con la aceptación expresa del promovente o la persona que se pretenda notificar
conditional_on: when notifications are made by electronic or other digital means

summary: Secretaría, CNE and their units must issue the corresponding pronouncement on procedures under the Law and the Regulation.

summary: Operator must follow up that suppliers, contractors and others performing work for or on behalf of the operator comply with security requirements set in or under law.
quote: En datasenteroperatør skal følge opp at leverandører, entreprenører og andre som utfører arbeid for eller på vegne av operatøren, etterlever sikkerhetskrav fastsatt i eller med hjemmel i lov.

summary: Operator must notify Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet without undue delay of incidents causing significant breaches of availability, authenticity, integrity or confidentiality of the data centre or its services, with minimum content listed in the provision (cause, consequences, economic and societal impact, affected customers, geographic scope, measures, duration).
quote: En datasenteroperatør skal uten ugrunnet opphold varsle Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet om hendelser som har medført vesentlige brudd
conditional_on: incidents causing significant breaches

summary: Operator must notify customers of possible protective or remedial measures under concrete and significant threats to authenticity, integrity or confidentiality (and may inform them of the threat itself where appropriate), and must notify customers of planned work that may affect the data centre services.
quote: Ved konkrete og betydelige trusler med fare for brudd på autentisitet, integritet eller konfidensialitet skal datasenteroperatør varsle kundene
conditional_on: concrete and significant threats (for the threat notice); planned work (for the planned-work notice)

summary: Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet may issue regulations on more detailed notification procedures.
quote: Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet kan gi forskrift om nærmere prosedyrer for varsling.

summary: When Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet orders it in a crisis or emergency situation, operator must operate and maintain the service with personnel and technical solutions in Norway.
quote: pålegge datasenteroperatørene å drifte og vedlikeholde tjenestetilbudet med personell og tekniske løsninger i Norge.
conditional_on: order by Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet in a crisis or emergency situation

summary: When Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet orders it after disruption of data centre services, operator must prioritise important societal actors when normal operation is restored.
quote: pålegge datasenteroperatørene å prioritere viktige samfunnsaktører når normal drift skal gjenopprettes.
conditional_on: services stopped or disrupted, and prioritisation necessary to safeguard public interests, on order by Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet

summary: Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet supervises compliance with the regulation.
quote: Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet fører tilsyn med at kravene i forskriften blir oppfylt

summary: Appeals against individual decisions of Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet under the regulation are decided by the ministry.
quote: Klage over enkeltvedtak fattet av Nasjonal kommunikasjonsmyndighet etter denne forskriften, avgjøres av departementet
conditional_on: appeal against an individual decision

summary: Operators that offered data centre services or operated a data centre when the Act entered into force must meet the registration duty in § 1-3 by 1 July 2025.
quote: skal oppfylle registreringsplikten i § 1-3 senest 1. juli 2025.
conditional_on: operators offering data centre services or operating a data centre at the Act's entry into force

summary: The Regulation and this Decree are to be published on the official digital platforms on the same day as their publication in El Peruano.
quote: son publicados en la Plataforma Digital Única del Estado Peruano para Orientación al Ciudadano (www.gob.pe)

summary: Controllers must comply with the legal regime for personal data protection and the specific principles, and be able to demonstrate compliance (accountability principle).
quote: debe cumplir con el régimen jurídico en materia de protección de los datos personales

summary: Controllers or processors without establishment in Peru that are subject to Peruvian law must provide the means for compliance and designate a representative in or for Peru, who is the contact point with the ANPD.
quote: designar un representante en el territorio peruano o para el territorio peruano
conditional_on: Applies where Art. VI(3) or (4) applies, other than processing for transit purposes only

summary: Consent for processing must be obtained, in accordance with the Law and the Regulation, except where Art. 14 of the Law applies.
quote: debe obtener el consentimiento para el tratamiento de los datos personales
conditional_on: Except cases under Art. 14 of the Law

summary: Consent must be requested from the data subject before collection of the data or before a different processing than the one for which the data were collected.
quote: El consentimiento debe ser solicitado al titular de los datos personales con anterioridad a la recopilación

summary: When data are obtained directly from the data subject, the controller must inform clearly and in simple language a minimum list of items (identity, purposes, recipients, transfers, automated decisions, retention period, rights mechanisms, etc.); where data are not collected directly, the source must be available on first contact and on request.
quote: se le debe comunicar de forma clara, con lenguaje sencillo

summary: Consent for processing of sensitive data must be given in writing, with a handwritten, digital or electronic signature or other guaranteed means.
quote: este debe ser otorgado por escrito
conditional_on: Processing of sensitive data

summary: Once consent is revoked, new processing must be adapted to the revocation, within a period not exceeding 10 days; revocation mechanisms must be easily accessible, unconditional, simple, fast and free of charge.
quote: es obligación de quien efectúa el tratamiento de los datos personales adecuar los nuevos tratamientos a la revocatoria
conditional_on: Upon revocation of consent

summary: Processing of personal data obtained from publicly accessible sources must respect the principles of the Law and the Regulation.
quote: debe respetar los principios establecidos en la Ley y en el presente Reglamento
conditional_on: Data obtained from publicly accessible sources

summary: The recipient of transferred personal data is bound, by the transfer itself, to comply with the Law and the Regulation.
quote: se obliga, por el solo hecho de la transferencia, a la observancia de la Ley y del presente Reglamento

summary: Any transfer of personal data requires the consent of the data subject, except the exceptions in Art. 14 of the Law; transfer must be limited to the purpose that justifies it.
quote: Toda transferencia de datos personales requiere el consentimiento de su titular
conditional_on: Except exceptions in Art. 14 of the Law

summary: Every transfer of personal data must be reported to the data subject, as provided in Art. 18 of the Law.
quote: la transferencia de datos personales debe ser informada al titular de los datos personales

summary: Intra-group transfers require the consent of the data subject, unless an exception under Art. 14 of the Law applies (e.g., a processing contract).
quote: se debe solicitar el consentimiento del titular de los datos personales a menos que
conditional_on: Except exceptions in Art. 14 of the Law

summary: The recipient must process data in accordance with what the sender informed the data subject and the consent given; for additional purposes, it must obtain consent where appropriate.
quote: debe recabar el consentimiento cuando así corresponda
conditional_on: For additional purposes

summary: Domestic transfers must be formalised through mechanisms that demonstrate that the conditions of consent were communicated to the recipient.
quote: mecanismos que permitan demostrar que el titular del banco de datos personales o el responsable del tratamiento cumple con comunicar al receptor
conditional_on: Domestic transfers

summary: Cross-border flows are permitted to countries with an adequate level of protection; where there is none, the exporter must provide adequate guarantees.
quote: el emisor o exportador debe otorgar las garantías adecuadas para asegurar
conditional_on: Where the destination country lacks an adequate level of protection

summary: The Directorate General issues a resolution determining whether a country has adequate protection for cross-border transfers.
quote: emite una resolución a efectos de determinar si este cuenta con una protección equiparable

summary: The Directorate General issues model contractual clauses for cross-border transfers.
quote: emite modelos de cláusulas contractuales

summary: Every cross-border flow must be notified to the Directorate General, with the information required for the transfer, and recorded in the National Registry.
quote: debe ponerse en conocimiento de la Dirección General de Transparencia

summary: Opinions on the compliance of a cross-border flow, when requested, are issued within a maximum of 30 days.
quote: Dicha opinión es emitida en un plazo máximo de treinta (30) días.
conditional_on: When a controller requests an opinion

summary: Lawful processing of children's and adolescents' data requires the consent of the holders of parental authority or guardianship.
quote: se considera lícito cuando se obtenga el consentimiento de aquel o aquellos que ejercen la patria potestad o tutela
conditional_on: Children (under 14 for consent by guardians)

summary: Consent for processing of children's and adolescents' data may not be used to allow them access to activities linked to goods or services restricted for their age.
quote: puede otorgarse para que accedan a actividades, vinculadas con bienes o servicios restringidos para su edad

summary: Personal data of children and adolescents that would reveal information about their family members may not be collected without the consent of those family members.
quote: No se puede recopilar datos personales de niños, niñas y adolescentes que permitan obtener información

summary: All database owners, especially public entities, must collaborate in promoting knowledge of the right to protection of children's and adolescents' data.
quote: Es obligación de todos los titulares de bancos de datos personales, especialmente de las entidades públicas, colaborar

summary: Controllers must guarantee the protection of the best interests of the child and of children's fundamental rights in the digital environment.
quote: garantizar la protección del interés superior del niño y de sus derechos fundamentales en el entorno digital

summary: For digital services offered to adolescents aged 14 to under 18, processing is lawful with their consent; for services aimed at children under 14, it requires the consent of the holders of parental authority or guardianship.
quote: el tratamiento de datos personales es lícito cuando se haya obtenido su consentimiento
conditional_on: Digital services aimed at minors

summary: On digital platforms and services, controllers must make reasonable efforts to verify the identity of those giving consent for minors, taking into account available technology.
quote: la identidad de quienes otorgan el consentimiento
conditional_on: Cases described in Art. 25(2) and (3)

summary: Processing of personal data for advertising and commercial prospecting is lawful only with direct consent; after a first contact without consent, no new contact or processing is lawful; the source must be disclosed on request.
quote: es lícito cuando se obtiene el consentimiento de forma directa por parte del titular del dato personal

summary: The controller must provide a simple and free means to refuse, revoke or object to advertising processing, handle such requests within 10 days, and set procedures so that requests received by processors are forwarded to it.
quote: debe brindar un medio sencillo y gratuito para tramitar dicha solicitud

summary: The Directorate issues the provisions it considers pertinent on advertising and commercial prospecting processing.
quote: emite las disposiciones que considere pertinentes sobre lo regulado

summary: Telecommunications operators are responsible for ensuring the confidentiality, availability, appropriate use and integrity of personal data obtained from subscribers and users.
quote: Los operadores de los servicios de comunicaciones o telecomunicaciones tienen la responsabilidad de velar por la
conditional_on: Operators of communications or telecommunications services

summary: Telecommunications operators may not process subscribers' personal data for purposes other than those authorised by the holder, except on a court order or express legal mandate.
quote: no pueden realizar un tratamiento de los citados datos personales
conditional_on: Except court order or express legal mandate

summary: Outsourced processing may be contracted only if the contract guarantees compliance with the Law and the Regulation.
quote: siempre y cuando para la ejecución de aquel se garantice el cumplimiento de lo establecido en la Ley
conditional_on: Outsourced processing through technological means

summary: Minimum service terms for outsourced processing: transparency about subcontracting, no ownership of databases by the provider, confidentiality, integrity and availability, controller keeps control and responsibility, and verifiable destruction of data at the end of the service.
quote: se debe considerar como prestaciones mínimas las siguientes
conditional_on: Outsourced processing through technological means

summary: The provider must notify the controller of changes to its privacy policies or service conditions, and obtain consent where those changes would expand its processing powers.
quote: Dar a conocer los cambios en sus políticas de privacidad

summary: The provider must establish and maintain adequate security measures, guarantee and evidence deletion of data after the service ends, and prevent access by those without access privileges.
quote: Establecer y mantener medidas de seguridad adecuadas para la protección de los datos personales

summary: A processor may not transfer to third parties the personal data processed under a service contract, unless the controller authorised it and, where required, the data subject consented.
quote: se encuentra prohibido de transferir a terceros los datos personales
conditional_on: Except where authorised by the controller and consented by the data subject where required

summary: Retention of personal data by the processor is limited to a maximum of two years from the end of the last engagement; indefinite retention is generally prohibited.
quote: es como máximo de dos (2) años contados desde
conditional_on: Unless retention is required by the Law or a legal provision

summary: Subcontracting of processing requires prior authorisation from the controller; the authorisation may be contained in the original contract.
quote: se requiere, de manera previa, una autorización por parte del titular del banco de datos personales o responsable del tratamiento
conditional_on: Subcontracting of processing

summary: The subcontracted party assumes the same obligations as the processor, and the obligations of the controller where it uses data for an unauthorised purpose or makes an unauthorised transfer.
quote: asume las mismas obligaciones que se establezcan para el encargado del tratamiento en la Ley
conditional_on: Subcontracted third party

summary: Where a security incident involves large volumes of data, large numbers of people, sensitive data or evident harm to other rights, the controller must notify the ANPD within 48 hours, with the content listed in Art. 34(2); late notice must state the reasons; the duty persists even if the incident was resolved internally.
quote: como máximo dentro de las 48 horas posteriores a haber tomado conocimiento
conditional_on: Incidents of the kind described in Art. 34(1)

summary: Where a security incident affects the data subject's other rights, the controller must notify the data subject within 48 hours, in plain language, with the mitigation measures adopted.
quote: debe comunicarlo dentro de las 48 horas a dicho titular
conditional_on: Where the incident affects other rights of the data subject and is not exempted by Art. 34(4)

summary: For incidents occurring in or through the digital environment, notification must also be made to the National Center of Digital Security for the National Registry of Digital Security Incidents.
quote: al Centro Nacional de Seguridad Digital para su incorporación al Registro Nacional de Incidentes
conditional_on: Incidents occurring in or through the digital environment

summary: The Digital Government Secretariat and the ANPD propose and establish protocols for interoperability and information exchange on incident notifications in the digital environment (numbered 34.6 in the text, the second paragraph of that number).
quote: proponen y establecen protocolos para asegurar
conditional_on: Incidents in or through the digital environment

summary: The ANPD approves the provisions and guidelines necessary for compliance with Art. 34.
quote: aprueba las disposiciones y/o lineamientos necesarios para el debido cumplimiento del presente artículo

summary: The controller must document every security incident, including the facts, their effects and the measures adopted, so that the ANPD can verify compliance.
quote: debe documentar cualquier incidente de seguridad

summary: The processor must inform the controller immediately of any security incident it becomes aware of.
quote: debe informar de forma inmediata al titular del banco de datos personales

summary: A public entity processing personal data must designate a Data Protection Officer, under the phase-in of the transitional provisions.
applies_from: 120 calendar days after publication (Disposición Complementaria Final Primera)
quote: El tratamiento lo lleve a cabo una entidad pública
conditional_on: When the processing is carried out by a public entity under Digital Government regulation para. 68.6

summary: Phase-in of the duty to designate a Data Protection Officer for companies with annual sales above 2300 UIT, when processing large volumes of data, sensitive data or in the other cases of Art. 37(1)(2) and (3).
applies_from: 1 year after the date of publication of this Regulation
quote: Para empresas con ventas anuales superiores a 2300 UIT
conditional_on: Applies where Art. 37(1)(2) or (3) is met

summary: Phase-in of the duty to designate a Data Protection Officer for medium-sized companies with annual sales above 1700 UIT and up to 2300 UIT, under Art. 37(1)(2) or (3).
applies_from: 2 years after the date of publication of this Regulation
quote: Para empresas medianas con ventas
conditional_on: Applies where Art. 37(1)(2) or (3) is met

summary: Phase-in of the duty to designate a Data Protection Officer for small companies with annual sales above 150 UIT and up to 1700 UIT, under Art. 37(1)(2) or (3).
applies_from: 3 years after the date of publication of this Regulation
quote: Para pequeñas empresas con ventas
conditional_on: Applies where Art. 37(1)(2) or (3) is met

summary: Phase-in of the duty to designate a Data Protection Officer for microenterprises with annual sales up to 150 UIT and other equivalent entities, under Art. 37(1)(2) or (3).
applies_from: 4 years after the date of publication of this Regulation
quote: Para microempresas con ventas
conditional_on: Applies where Art. 37(1)(2) or (3) is met

summary: The contact details of the Data Protection Officer must be published in a visible place accessible to data subjects.
quote: en un lugar visible que permita a los titulares de datos personales tomar conocimiento de ello
conditional_on: Where a DPO is designated

summary: The contact details of the designated Data Protection Officer, and any update, must be communicated to the ANPD within 15 days of designation or update.
quote: deben ser comunicados a la Autoridad Nacional de Protección de Datos Personales dentro de los 15 días
conditional_on: Where a DPO is designated

summary: The Data Protection Officer must, at a minimum, inform and advise, verify and report on compliance, cooperate with the ANPD and act as its contact point, paying due attention to processing risks.
quote: Informar y asesorar al titular del banco de datos personales
conditional_on: Where a DPO is designated

summary: The controller may carry out a data protection impact assessment before processing, especially for sensitive data, profiling, vulnerable groups or large volumes of data.
quote: puede realizar la Evaluación de impacto relativa a la protección de datos personales

summary: The ANPD issues complementary provisions for the data protection impact assessment.
quote: emite las disposiciones complementarias que resulten pertinentes

summary: When dissociating data, the controller or processor must choose an adequate technique, considering the type and number of data subjects and the risk factor.
quote: debe elegir la técnica adecuada al momento de realizar el procedimiento de disociación

summary: The ANPD approves complementary or guidance provisions on dissociation and anonymisation procedures.
quote: aprueba las disposiciones complementarias u orientativas

summary: Private or public entities that create, modify or cancel personal data banks must register those acts with the National Registry.
quote: están obligadas a tramitar la inscripción de dichos actos ante el Registro Nacional de Protección de Datos Personales

summary: Registration of a personal data bank must be kept up to date at all times; modifications or cancellations must be communicated to the Directorate through the prescribed form.
quote: debe mantenerse actualizada en todo momento

summary: Data bank owners must request registration through the prescribed form before the Directorate of Personal Data Protection; the registration procedure is automatic approval.
quote: solicitan la inscripción de los bancos de datos ante el Registro Nacional de Protección de Datos Personales

summary: Digital platforms, websites, mobile applications, digital services and IT systems used for processing must have documented and implemented access control (including periodic privilege review at least semi-annually), monitoring and training, activity logs, and controls against unauthorised copying.
quote: deben tener documentado e implementado lo siguiente

summary: Interaction logs that provide evidence of processing must be kept for a minimum of two years and be available immediately.
quote: Dichos registros deben conservarse por un periodo mínimo de dos (2) años.

summary: The controller must have a security document that is formally approved, dated, kept up to date, covers access management, privilege management and periodic verification of privileges, and includes an inventory of data and systems indicating sensitive data; staff with system access must comply with it.
quote: debe contar con un documento de seguridad el cual debe ser aprobado formalmente y contar con fecha cierta

summary: At a minimum, controls must be designed and implemented for secure areas, secure equipment inside and outside premises, and secure, continuous backups with integrity verification.
quote: se debe diseñar e implementar como mínimo los siguientes controles de seguridad

summary: Controls for secure areas must include security perimeters, appropriate entry controls, protection against disasters and attacks, procedures for secure areas and control of access points.
quote: Perímetros de seguridad que protegen áreas donde se realice el tratamiento de datos personales

summary: Controls for equipment must cover location and protection against environmental risks and power failures, cabling protection, prohibition of unauthorised removal, erasure of storage before disposal or reuse, protection of unattended equipment and a clear-desk and clear-screen policy.
quote: Asegurar, antes de su disposición o reutilización, que los equipos

summary: Backup copies must be made at least weekly (unless no personal data were updated in that period), with security measures for storage, transfer and destruction, and integrity verification including full recovery.
quote: Las copias de respaldo se realizan con una frecuencia semanal como mínimo

summary: Data sent outside the premises must be transferred only with the authorisation of the data bank holder, through authorised transport and with measures such as encryption, digital signatures and checksums.
quote: solo procede con la autorización del titular del banco de datos personales

summary: Cabinets and filing units with non-automated personal data must be protected with locked doors and keys formally assigned; where areas cannot be kept closed, alternative measures under the Directorate's directives must be adopted.
quote: son protegidos con puertas dotadas de sistemas de apertura mediante llave

summary: Copies or reproductions of documents with personal data may be made only under the control of authorised personnel, and discarded copies must be destroyed so that their content cannot be accessed or recovered.
quote: Debe procederse a la destrucción de las copias o reproducciones desechadas

summary: Access to documentation is limited to authorised personnel; access to shared documents must be traceable, and access by unauthorised persons must be recorded.
quote: El acceso a la documentación se limita exclusivamente al personal autorizado.

summary: When physically moving documentation from a data bank, measures must be adopted to prevent unauthorised access, misuse, manipulation and alteration.
quote: debe adoptarse medidas dirigidas a impedir el acceso no autorizado

summary: For services that do not involve processing, the controller or processor must limit staff access to personal data; contracts with outside staff must expressly prohibit access to personal data and impose secrecy.
quote: debe implementar los mecanismos o medidas

summary: Codes of conduct must be drafted in clear and accessible terms and include, at a minimum, the listed content (scope, principles, rights procedures, transfers, promotion, confidentiality, supervision mechanisms and template clauses). Codes are voluntary.
quote: Los códigos de conducta deben redactarse en términos claros y accesibles.
conditional_on: If a code of conduct is prepared

summary: A data subject exercising rights must prove identity by presenting a national identity document or equivalent, or a legal or express representative must prove the representation.
quote: acreditando su identidad y presentando copia del Documento Nacional de Identidad

summary: Rights requests must be made in writing to the controller or processor and contain the requester's name, the specific request, an address for notifications, date and signature, and supporting documents where relevant.
quote: El ejercicio de los derechos se lleva a cabo mediante solicitud

summary: All requests must be received and receipt recorded; if a request is incomplete, the controller must, within 5 days of receipt, raise the observations that cannot be cured ex officio and invite the holder to cure them within 5 days.
quote: Todas las solicitudes presentadas deben ser recibidas dejándose constancia de su recepción

summary: Where a request is submitted to a processor, it must be forwarded to the controller within 3 days; where the processor holds the database and receives the request, it must forward it immediately and inform the data subject.
quote: este debe trasladarlo en un plazo máximo de tres (3) días
conditional_on: Requests submitted to a processor

summary: The controller must establish a simple procedure for exercising rights; for private data banks exercise is free of charge, and no additional fees may be imposed for the means of exercise.
quote: está obligado a establecer un procedimiento sencillo para el ejercicio de los derechos

summary: The response to a rights request must be given in the form and within the time set by the Regulation, and must be clear, legible, comprehensible and easily accessible; the controller bears the burden of proving compliance.
quote: debe responder a la solicitud en la forma y plazo establecido en el presente Reglamento

summary: Response time limits: 8 days for the right to information, 20 days for access, and 10 days for rectification, cancellation and objection, counted from the day after the request.
quote: ante el ejercicio del derecho de acceso es de veinte (20) días

summary: Where a request is insufficient or erroneous, the controller may request additional information or documents within 7 days of receipt; the response period is suspended until the requested information is provided.
quote: puede requerir dentro de los siete (7) días siguientes de recibida la solicitud
conditional_on: Where the request is insufficient or erroneous

summary: When additional information is requested, the data subject must provide the supporting documentation within 10 days, failing which the request is deemed not filed.
quote: debe acompañar la documentación adicional que estime pertinente
conditional_on: When the controller requests additional documentation

summary: Where response periods are extended (once, by an equal period at most), the justification must be communicated to the data subject within the period being extended.
quote: debe comunicarse al titular del dato personal dentro del plazo que se pretenda ampliar
conditional_on: Where the response period is extended

summary: A total or partial refusal of a rights request must be duly justified and must inform the data subject that it may appeal to the Directorate of Personal Data Protection or to the courts.
quote: indicar al titular de datos personales que puede recurrir ante la Dirección de Protección de Datos Personales
conditional_on: Where a request is refused in whole or in part

summary: The response to a right of information must contain the items listed in Art. 18 of the Law.
quote: La respuesta debe contener los extremos previstos en el artículo 18 antes mencionado.

summary: On an access request, the data subject must be clearly informed of the data processed, how and why they were collected, who requested the collection, and the transfers made or planned.
quote: se le comunique de forma clara, expresa e indubitablemente con lenguaje sencillo lo siguiente

summary: On a portability request, the controller must transmit the data directly to another controller where technically possible; where it considers this technically impossible, it must be able to demonstrate this to the ANPD.
quote: tiene derecho a que sus datos se transmitan directamente de un responsable o titular del banco de datos a otro
conditional_on: Where technically possible and not excessively burdensome

summary: The ANPD issues complementary provisions necessary for the correct application of data portability.
quote: emite las disposiciones complementarias necesarias para la correcta aplicación de la portabilidad de datos personales

summary: Access information must be given in a clear, legible and intelligible format, without codes requiring mechanical devices, or with an accompanying explanation, in language accessible to the average population.
quote: el acceso debe ser en formato claro, legible e inteligible

summary: Information provided on an access request must be comprehensive and cover the items of Art. 75, even where the request concerns only one aspect; it may not disclose data relating to third parties.
quote: debe ser amplia y comprender lo indicado en el artículo 75 del presente Reglamento

summary: A deletion request implies that processing ceases, through blocking of the data, while deletion is assessed.
quote: la presentación de la solicitud de supresión al responsable del tratamiento implica el cese en el tratamiento de los datos personales

summary: The controller must document for the data subject that the deletion or cancellation was carried out, identifying the recipients of the deleted data and the communication of the deletion.
quote: debe documentar ante el titular de los datos personales haber cumplido con lo solicitado

summary: Where deletion is refused for reasons that permit it, dissociation or anonymisation must be used to continue processing, where possible.
quote: se deben emplear medios de disociación o anonimización para continuar el tratamiento
conditional_on: Where deletion is refused and the reasons permit it

summary: Where an objection is justified, the controller must cease the processing that gave rise to the objection.
quote: debe proceder al cese del tratamiento que ha dado lugar a la oposición
conditional_on: Where the objection is justified

summary: When personal data are processed as part of a decision-making process without the participation of the data subject, the controller must inform the data subject as soon as possible.
quote: debe informárselo a la brevedad posible
conditional_on: Automated or other decisions made without the data subject's participation

summary: Direct requests to the controller must be answered within the periods set by the Regulation, stating the response to each element of the request.
quote: debe dar respuesta, en los plazos previstos en el presente Reglamento

summary: A request for a tutela procedure must meet listed requirements, including a copy of the prior request to the controller and the controller's response, and documents evidencing the harm where applicable.
quote: la solicitud del titular de los datos personales debe cumplir con los siguientes requisitos

summary: Once a complaint is admitted, it is served on the respondent, who has 15 days to respond.
quote: se corre traslado al reclamado y se otorga un plazo de quince (15) días
conditional_on: Once the complaint has been admitted

summary: The tutela procedure must be resolved within 30 days, extendable by up to 30 additional days depending on the complexity of the case.
quote: El plazo máximo en que debe resolverse el procedimiento trilateral de tutela es de treinta (30) días

summary: The Directorate grants the appeal and forwards the file within 2 days; the Directorate General serves the appeal and decides it within 30 days.
quote: debe emitir la concesión del recurso de apelación
conditional_on: Upon an appeal against a tutela resolution

summary: The Directorate of Personal Data Protection must require from the holder, processor or responsible party information about the processing or the necessary documentation; supervision is initiated ex officio or upon a complaint.
quote: requiere al titular del banco de datos personales, al encargado o a quien resulte responsable, información relativa al tratamiento de datos personales

summary: The supervision authority must notify the supervised party of the date and time of an on-site inspection, except where prior notice is not given.
quote: en un plazo razonable, comunica al
conditional_on: Except where there is no prior notice for an on-site inspection

summary: Each on-site inspection visit must be recorded in a minutes document, signed by the inspectors and the supervised party or staff who participated, with a copy given to the supervised party.
quote: requieren el levantamiento del acta correspondiente, en la que se deja constancia

summary: Inspection staff must display a valid credential bearing a photograph and carry a signed written order identifying the place, the purpose and the legal basis of the visit.
quote: debe exhibir credencial vigente con fotografía
